Fourth, agentic systems outperform pure language models across dimensions, but they do so at a substantial inference-time cost, averaging about 15× the token budget for the same topic.

The evaluator-calibration result is also practically important. Uncalibrated LLM judges correlate poorly with expert rankings; on D5 the reported alignment is only around ρ≈0.467. After calibration using LitReviewBench, the correlation rises to about ρ≈0.792. For people working on reward modeling, evaluator design, or scalable preference supervision, this is one of the most useful findings in the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the Introduction to understand why literature-review quality cannot be reduced to overlap-style metrics. Then focus on the evaluation protocol: annotator selection, topic sourcing, expertise matching, and the five dimensions. That is where the paper either succeeds or fails. After that, read the main result tables and figures: model-vs-human win rates, per-dimension gaps, the token-cost comparison between agentic systems and plain LMs, and the before/after calibration results for the evaluator.

If time is limited, 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main ideas. Prioritize the task definition, protocol design, headline results, and judge calibration. You can safely skip lower-level implementation details. The right way to read it is as a reference for building high-quality evaluation pipelines for open-ended scientific tasks, not as a paper about pretraining recipes.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent eval 的人可以看，但对 pretrain 只属间接相关；重点看专家 judge 协议和 LLM judge 失配分析，别把 arena 排名当能力真值。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agent evaluation, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining; focus on the expert protocol and judge misalignment, not the leaderboard itself.

paper.title: When Does Visual Generation Help Visual Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models?
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can perform both understanding and generation, raising a central question: can visual generation improve understanding? Existing evaluations provide mixed evidence, but confound task difficulty, reasoning paradigms, and the closed-loop interaction between generation and understanding. We introduce VGAU-Diag, a fine-grained evaluation framework for vision generation-assisted understanding. It stratifies samples by difficulty, enables unified evaluation of multiple

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“统一多模态模型能不能做视觉生成”，而是更具体的一个诊断问题：视觉生成在什么条件下真的能帮助视觉理解。现有结论之所以摇摆，作者认为主要有三类评测混淆：样本难度混在一起、不同生成辅助范式没有在统一设置下比较、生成与理解在闭环中纠缠导致失败归因不清。论文因此把问题从方法宣称转成评测诊断：如果把难度、范式和 oracle 条件都控制住，视觉生成到底是在帮忙、添噪声，还是误导理解。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为核心贡献是评测框架而不是新的训练方法。但它对统一多模态建模有一个很有用的纠偏：很多“生成帮助理解”的收益，可能并不是模型真的学会了把生成结果当作可靠中间表示，而是评测协议、样本分布或先验泄漏造成的表面提升。这个结论对做 AR+diffusion 联合建模、native multimodal pretrain、以及把图像生成当 reasoning scaffold 的工作都有参考价值。更具体地说，论文指出当前瓶颈往往不在生成器不够强，而在理解器不会用生成出来的视觉辅助。这会影响后续研究的资源分配：是继续堆更强的视觉生成，还是先解决视觉状态读取、对齐和利用的问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文提出 VGAU-Diag，一个面向 vision generation-assisted understanding 的细粒度评测框架。它有三根主线。第一，difficulty-aware evaluation：把样本按难度分层，而不是只报混合平均分。作者认为如果不分层，模型在简单样本上的偶然收益会掩盖复杂样本上的失效。第二，unified paradigm comparison：在同一任务和协议下比较三类代表性范式，分别是 VCoT（交错视觉-文本链式推理）、GtA（先生成辅助视觉再文本作答）和 VR（直接输出视觉结果完成求解）。这样可以区分“视觉生成本身有帮助”与“某个范式恰好更适配评测”的差别。第三，Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols：通过给模型提供 oracle 级别的视觉辅助，或者控制生成中间结果的真实性与相关性，把生成能力和理解能力拆开诊断。

任务选择上，作者采用 visual planning。模型需要从图像中推断任务相关的空间状态，再输出可执行动作序列。这个设定比常见多选题更适合做诊断，因为结果可验证，且中间视觉状态与最终动作之间有明确因果链。论文还特别指出此前一些 Vision-CoT 评测存在 optimal-step prior leakage，即模型可能借助步骤数等先验而不是借助真实生成内容获益。修正这一点后，VCoT 的收益变得不稳定，而更有针对性的 GtA 更可靠。

从方法性质看，这是一篇 eval 论文，不是提出新的统一模型架构。它的价值在于把“生成辅助理解”拆成可测的几个子问题：生成内容是否相关、是否真实、理解器是否会用、收益是否随难度稳定存在。
summary.experiments:
实验结论主要有四点。第一，视觉生成的帮助强烈依赖难度分层：在较容易样本上，生成的视觉辅助可以带来可见收益；但随着推理复杂度上升，这种收益迅速变得不稳定。第二，oracle 诊断显示主要瓶颈常常在视觉理解而不是视觉生成。也就是说，即便给出忠实的视觉辅助，当前 UMM 仍未必能有效利用；而一些 proprietary VLM 在 oracle aid 下提升更明显，说明问题不只是“生成图不够好”。第三，作者观察到一个三阶段转变：任务无关的视觉中间物主要是干扰；看起来合理但实际错误的视觉辅助会产生误导；只有当视觉辅助既高保真又任务对齐时，才会稳定帮助理解。第四，在修正 prior leakage 后，目标更明确的 GtA 方法比泛化的逐步 VCoT 更可靠，说明有效的视觉生成应围绕 decision-critical visual states，而不是机械增加更多中间视觉步骤。

给出的全文片段没有完整数字表，但从作者的叙述可以确定，论文不是在追求某个单一 benchmark 的最高分，而是在用分层和 oracle 对照解释为什么不同论文会得出互相矛盾的结论。对读者来说，最重要的实验不是平均准确率，而是难度分层曲线、oracle 与非 oracle 的差距、以及不同视觉辅助质量区间下性能的相变。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看评测设计而不是具体模型实现。建议先读 Introduction，把作者指出的三类评测混淆记清楚；再看 VGAU-Diag 的协议设计，尤其是 difficulty stratification、三种范式的统一比较方式，以及 Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols；最后看结果分析部分，重点关注三阶段转变和对 VCoT prior leakage 的修正。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以读完主线。

如果你做统一多模态预训练，最值得带走的不是某个方法优于另一个方法，而是两个判断：一，生成辅助理解的收益不是单调随生成能力增强而增长；二，理解器是否会消费视觉辅助，可能比能否生成视觉辅助更关键。读表时不要只盯 aggregate score，要看分难度、分范式、分 oracle 条件的拆解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a diagnostic question rather than a capability question: under what conditions does visual generation actually help visual understanding in unified multimodal models? Prior evidence has been mixed, and the authors argue that the inconsistency comes from three confounds in existing evaluations: mixed sample difficulty, lack of controlled comparison across generation-assisted reasoning paradigms, and the closed-loop entanglement of generation and understanding that makes failures hard to attribute. The work is therefore about disentangling when visual generation is useful, when it is noise, and when it becomes misleading.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is modest because the core contribution is evaluation, not a new training objective or architecture. Still, it provides an important correction for unified multimodal modeling. Many reported gains from generation-assisted understanding may not reflect a robust capability to use generated visuals as intermediate representations; they may instead come from evaluation artifacts, easy samples, or prior leakage. That matters for research on unified AR-plus-diffusion systems, native multimodal pretraining, and any setup that treats visual generation as a reasoning scaffold. The paper’s strongest message is that the bottleneck often lies not in generating better visuals, but in the model’s ability to interpret and use those visuals once they are available.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper introduces VGAU-Diag, a fine-grained evaluation framework for vision generation-assisted understanding. The framework has three main components. First, it performs difficulty-aware evaluation by stratifying samples rather than collapsing everything into one aggregate score. This is meant to reveal whether visual generation helps consistently or only on easier cases. Second, it supports controlled comparison across three representative paradigms under the same setting: Vision-CoT, where textual and visual reasoning are interleaved; Generate-then-Answer, where the model first creates auxiliary visual content and then reasons in text; and Vision-Reasoning, where the visual output itself serves as the reasoning product. Third, it introduces Oracle-Assisted Reference Protocols that decouple generation quality from understanding ability by supplying faithful or controlled visual aids.

The task domain is visual planning. Models must infer task-relevant spatial states from images and produce executable action sequences. This is a useful choice because it is verifiable and exposes a clearer causal chain between visual state estimation and final decision quality than standard multiple-choice benchmarks. The paper also revisits prior Vision-CoT evaluations and argues that some gains were inflated by optimal-step prior leakage, meaning the model could benefit from structural priors rather than from the actual generated visual content. After correcting for that issue, targeted Generate-then-Answer becomes more reliable than generic stepwise visual reasoning.

This is fundamentally an evaluation paper. Its value lies in decomposing the broad claim that generation helps understanding into measurable sub-questions: Is the generated visual aid relevant? Is it faithful? Can the model use it? Does the benefit persist as reasoning difficulty increases?
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical findings are organized around diagnosis rather than leaderboard performance. First, the benefit of visual generation is strongly difficulty-dependent. It can help on easier instances, but the gains become unstable as reasoning complexity increases. Second, oracle-assisted analysis suggests that visual understanding is often the dominant bottleneck. Even when faithful visual aids are provided, current unified multimodal models may still fail to exploit them effectively. In contrast, stronger proprietary VLMs benefit more from oracle aids, which indicates that the limitation is not only generation quality.

Third, the paper identifies a three-stage transition in generation-assisted understanding. Task-irrelevant visuals mostly act as interference. Visually plausible but incorrect aids can actively mislead the model. Only high-fidelity, task-aligned visual aids provide stable assistance. Fourth, after removing prior leakage in earlier Vision-CoT-style evaluations, a more targeted Generate-then-Answer strategy is more reliable than generic visual step-by-step reasoning. The implication is that useful visual generation should focus on decision-critical states rather than simply adding more intermediate visual outputs.

The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, but the structure of the experiments is clear. The key evidence comes from stratified performance by difficulty, oracle versus non-oracle comparisons, and controlled variation in the quality and relevance of generated visual aids. Those analyses matter more here than any single average score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as an evaluation and diagnosis paper, not as a new modeling paper. Start with the introduction to understand the three confounds the authors want to remove. Then read the VGAU-Diag protocol carefully, especially the difficulty stratification, the unified comparison across VCoT, GtA, and VR, and the oracle-assisted setup. Finally, focus on the analysis sections that discuss the three-stage transition and the correction of prior leakage in Vision-CoT evaluations. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

If your interest is multimodal pretraining, the useful takeaways are conceptual. Gains from generation-assisted understanding do not increase monotonically with stronger generation. Also, the ability to consume visual aids may matter more than the ability to produce them. When reading the results, do not focus on aggregate scores alone; the important evidence is in the breakdowns by difficulty, paradigm, and oracle condition.

recommendation.zh: 对统一多模态模型（如 Chameleon）中'生成反哺理解'的假设进行了很好的诊断，指出当前瓶颈在理解端而非生成端，做统一建模的值得看其 Oracle 实验设计。
recommendation.en: Provides a good diagnostic of the 'generation benefits understanding' assumption in unified multimodal models (e.g., Chameleon), pointing out the bottleneck is on the understanding side; the Oracle experiment design is worth reading for unified modeling researchers.

paper.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib
paper.abstract: Formal proofs in Lean 4 that pass the kernel's type checker can nonetheless vary widely in quality. We introduce ProofJudge, an agentic LLM-as-judge system that scores formal proof quality along five dimensions beyond correctness: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. We evaluate ProofJudge on a novel dataset of 218 declarations drawn from distinct Mathlib PRs. The judge agent is grounded by tool access to the commit the PR is applied t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“证明是否正确”，而是“通过 Lean kernel 检查的证明，是否达到了 Mathlib 可合入的质量标准”。在形式化数学里，正确性只是底线；真正影响库可维护性和后续复用价值的，是是否善用现有库、是否写出可复用的 lemma、结构是否清楚、是否符合社区约定。论文要解决的是：能否用带工具访问的 LLM judge，稳定地复现 Mathlib 人类 reviewer 对 proof quality 的偏好，而不是只做编译通过/不通过的二元判断。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献不大，但对“可验证环境中的高质量奖励建模”有明确启发。Lean 证明生成近来常用 verifiable reward，只奖励 type-check correctness；这会把模型推向“能过 kernel 但人不想合”的方向。ProofJudge 提供了一个更接近真实维护者偏好的软质量信号，适合作为后续 RL、rejection sampling 或 self-improvement 的奖励源。更重要的是，它说明在工具接地后，LLM 可以读出代码审查里那些难以形式化但又真实存在的标准。不过这篇工作的量级仍偏评测与 judge 设计，不是预训练范式层面的推进。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个 agentic LLM-as-judge。输入不是单纯的 proof text，而是某个 Mathlib PR 中同一 declaration 的两个版本：早期被要求修改的版本，以及最终被合入的版本。judge 在评估单个版本时并不知道另一个版本的分数，也不知道自己正在做 pairwise 比较，从而避免显式比较带来的提示泄漏。评分 rubric 被拆成五个维度：library leverage、automation fit、structural clarity、statement quality、Mathlib conventions，每个维度打 1 到 10 分，再由 harness 加权成总分。关键设计在于 tool grounding：judge 可以通过 bash 查询 PR 所对应 commit 的 Mathlib 状态，搜索现有定理、查看签名、检查库中已有 API，从而像人类 reviewer 一样判断“你是不是重复造轮子”“这个 lemma 是否应该更一般化”“是否已有一行可调用的现成结果”。这和只靠静态文本 judge 的区别很大，因为 proof quality 很多时候依赖库上下文，而不是 proof token 本身。数据集构造上，作者先用 Claude Sonnet 5 回顾历史 PR，筛出那些 revision 差异显著、且不是纯 linting 或新增 declaration 的样本，再形成 dev split 和 test split。这个筛法有一定人工启发式成分，但能把评测集中在真正涉及 reviewer judgment 的案例上。
summary.experiments: 评测集包含 218 个 declaration pair，另有 123 个 dev pair 用于 rubric 调整。作者测试了 6 个 judge，含 3 个开源权重和 3 个闭源模型，每个模型做 3 次 replicate；每次评估时每个样本最多允许 20 次工具调用，以控制成本。指标是 preference alignment：judge 是否给最终被 Mathlib 接受的 revision 更高分。结果上，所有模型都显著高于 50% 随机基线。最好的是 claude-sonnet-5，达到 80.8%；较弱的 deepseek-v4-flash 也有 63.5%，sign test 的显著性都达到 p < 1e-5。开源模型里，muse-glimmer-30b 为 70.2%，inkling-small 为 69.3%，说明这件事并不完全依赖最强闭源模型。更有价值的是作者对噪声的分析：同一个 judge 在同一批样本上重复运行，约五分之一到接近一半的 verdict 会翻转；某些 ablation 在一次 replicate 上 p=0.34，另一次却是 p=0.006。这说明 judge 方差很大，单次跑分很容易误判方法差异。文中给出的 PR 11640 案例也很说明问题：初版证明重复构造了库里已有结果，修订版直接调用 H.restrictPreimage s；judge 通过搜索库发现已有 declaration，并在 library leverage 维度稳定压低初版分数。这类判断无法靠 lint 或正则完成，必须依赖语义级工具使用。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三处。第一是方法部分对五维 rubric 的定义，以及为什么需要 tool grounding；这是整篇工作的真正方法点。第二是结果部分关于 replicate variance 的讨论，这比主表分数更重要，直接关系到以后把 judge 当 reward 用时的稳定性。第三是代表性案例，尤其是 judge 如何通过库搜索发现“已有更好写法”。如果只花 15 到 25 分钟，建议看引言最后一段、方法第 2 节、结果第 3 节前半和噪声分析。阅读时要带着两个问题：一是这个 judge 学到的是 reviewer 偏好，还是数据构造里的时间顺序偏差；二是如果把它接到 RL 里，当前这种高方差 reward 是否会导致训练不稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about proof correctness per se. It asks whether a Lean 4 proof that already passes the kernel also meets the quality bar required for inclusion in Mathlib. In formal math, correctness is only the floor. What matters for maintainers is whether the proof reuses the library well, exposes reusable lemmas, has clear structure, and follows community conventions. The core problem is whether a tool-grounded LLM judge can recover those human review preferences, rather than merely checking compile success.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is limited, but it is relevant to reward design in verifiable domains. Recent Lean work often uses kernel-verified correctness as reward, which pushes models toward proofs that type-check but are still undesirable for humans to merge. ProofJudge adds a softer quality signal that is closer to actual maintainer preferences, making it potentially useful for RL, rejection sampling, or iterative self-improvement. The more general lesson is that once the judge is grounded with tools, LLMs can access review criteria that are hard to formalize but operationally real. Still, this is mainly an evaluation-and-judge-design paper, not a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is an agentic LLM-as-judge setup. The data consists of pairs of revisions for the same declaration from Mathlib PRs: an earlier version that was sent back for revision, and the later version that was accepted. Importantly, each version is scored independently. The judge does not know the score of the other revision and is not explicitly told it is doing pairwise comparison, which reduces comparison leakage. The rubric decomposes proof quality into five dimensions: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. Each dimension is scored from 1 to 10, then combined by a harness into a final score. The key design choice is tool grounding. The judge can query the exact Mathlib state at the relevant commit through bash, search for existing lemmas, inspect signatures, and check available APIs. That lets it reason like a human reviewer: is this proof reinventing something already in the library, should the statement be more general, is there a cleaner one-line invocation already available. This is materially different from a text-only judge because proof quality often depends on library context, not just the local proof text. For dataset construction, the authors used Claude Sonnet 5 to inspect historical PRs and identify cases with substantial revision differences that were not just linting or newly added declarations, then split them into development and test sets.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 218 declaration pairs in the test split and 123 pairs in the dev split used for rubric tuning. Six judges were evaluated, including three open-weight and three closed models, with three replicates per judge. Each evaluation allows up to 20 tool calls per sample to cap inference cost. The main metric is preference alignment: whether the judge assigns a higher score to the revision that Mathlib ultimately accepted. All models perform well above the 50% random baseline. Claude Sonnet 5 is best at 80.8%, while even DeepSeek-V4-Flash reaches 63.5%, with all sign tests reported at p < 1e-5. Among open models, muse-glimmer-30b gets 70.2% and inkling-small 69.3%, showing that the task is not exclusive to frontier closed models. The most useful experimental finding is the variance analysis. Re-running the same judge on the same declarations flips roughly one-fifth to nearly half of the verdicts. Some ablations look non-significant in one replicate, p = 0.34, and significant in another, p = 0.006. That means single-run judge benchmarks can easily overstate differences. The PR 11640 case study is also informative: the initial proof reconstructed a result already present in Mathlib, while the merged revision replaced it with a one-line call to H.restrictPreimage s. The judge found the existing declaration via tool use and consistently penalized the initial version on library leverage. This kind of semantic review cannot be replicated by linting or regex heuristics.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the rubric and the motivation for tool grounding in the methods section; that is where the actual methodological contribution sits. Second, pay attention to the replicate-variance discussion in the results. It matters more than the headline alignment numbers because it determines whether the judge can later serve as a stable reward. Third, read the worked PR example showing how the judge searches the library and identifies a better existing abstraction. If you only spend 15 to 25 minutes, read the end of the introduction, Section 2, and the first half of Section 3 including the noise discussion. Two useful questions while reading: is the judge learning reviewer preference or exploiting temporal artifacts in revision history, and would this level of reward variance be acceptable if plugged into RL?

recommendation.zh: 针对形式化证明（Lean 4）质量的自动化评估，超越了单纯的 type check，引入了代码风格和库利用率等维度，对做数学推理和代码生成数据合成的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Automated evaluation of formal proof (Lean 4) quality that goes beyond mere type checking, introducing dimensions like code style and library leverage, valuable for those working on data synthesis for mathematical reasoning and code generation.

paper.title: Evaluation-as-Search: Adaptive Discovery of Grounding Failures in Meeting Assistants
paper.abstract: LLM-powered meeting assistants are deployed at scale, yet systematic evaluation of their grounding fidelity remains limited to static benchmarks that miss failure modes tied to specific discourse structures or reasoning demands. We propose Evaluation-as-Search (EaS), a feedback-driven methodology that frames quality evaluation as an adaptive search over the space of natural questions a meeting participant might ask. Rather than sampling uniformly, EaS learns from evaluator feedback across iterat

summary.core_problem: 静态 benchmark 很难发现会议助手在特定话语结构和认知需求下的 grounding failure，论文试图把评测过程本身做成自适应搜索。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与 benchmark 构建。它不是基座训练论文，但对如何更高效地挖掘 LLM 失败模式有方法论价值，尤其适合做高成本人工评测的团队参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Evaluation-as-Search，把问题生成视为在自然问题空间上的主动搜索：根据评审反馈，用 UCB 评分的 coverage map 迭代聚焦更可能出错的认知需求区域，并配合 blind multi-dimensional quality evaluation。基于该流程构建 MeetingProbe。
summary.experiments: MeetingProbe 含 20 份会议转录、3 种会议类型、3 个 LLM 助手、3000+ 标注 QA。消融显示自适应搜索比随机 probing 多发现 2.5 倍失败案例，failure finding rate 从 2.9% 提升到 7.1%。摘要未给出底层模型规模。
summary.authors_note: Microsoft。Ross Cutler 长期做语音、会议智能与多模态系统。

summary_en.core_problem: Static benchmarks miss grounding failures in meeting assistants that depend on discourse structure and cognitive demand; this paper turns evaluation itself into an adaptive search process.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation methodology plus benchmark construction. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for teams that need more sample-efficient failure discovery under expensive human evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Evaluation-as-Search, treating question generation as active search over the space of natural user questions. Guided by evaluator feedback, a UCB-scored coverage map focuses probing on cognitive-demand regions likely to expose failures, combined with blind multi-dimensional quality assessment. This process yields the MeetingProbe benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: MeetingProbe contains 3,000+ annotated QA pairs over 20 transcripts, three meeting genres, and three LLM assistants. Ablations show adaptive search finds 2.5x more failures than random probing, improving failure discovery rate from 2.9% to 7.1%. No model scale is given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Microsoft. Ross Cutler is known for work on speech, meeting intelligence, and multimodal systems.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但评测设计很干净；只看方法和消融就够，尤其是 adaptive probing 比随机抽样高 2.5 倍这一点可直接迁到内部 red-teaming。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the eval design is clean; read the method and ablation only, especially the 2.5x gain over random probing for internal red-teaming.

paper.title: AGIDefect-4K: A Richly Annotated Dataset for AI-Generated Image Defect Detection, Localization and Explanation
paper.abstract: Generative AI can now produce highly realistic images, yet current models still exhibit subtle but critical defects that undermine their reliability. While existing AI-generated image (AGI) evaluation benchmarks have made notable progress, comprehensive AGI defect diagnosis remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce AGIDefect-4K, a richly annotated dataset of 4,000 images from 15 state-of-the-art generative models spanning both open-source and closed-source systems. AGIDefect-4K fea

summary.core_problem: 现有AIGC图像评测多停留在“好不好看/像不像”，缺少对缺陷的系统化诊断：是否有缺陷、缺陷在哪、缺陷是什么。
summary.importance: 提供面向生成模型可靠性的评测资产：把“缺陷检测+定位+解释”打包成可训练/可评测的数据集；对多模态模型的对齐与自检能力评估有直接用途。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AGIDefect-4K：来自15个生成模型的4000张图，带层级标注（缺陷存在性、像素级mask、文本解释、总体质量分）；并给出基线AGIDA，用MLLM联合做检测/定位/解释（更像诊断助手设定）。
summary.experiments: 数据规模4K、覆盖15个SOTA生成模型（开源+闭源）；摘要未给出基线模型名称与具体指标提升，重点应是多任务评测与不同缺陷类型的性能分解。
summary.authors_note: Xidian University

summary_en.core_problem: Move beyond coarse “realism/quality” scoring for AI-generated images toward structured defect diagnosis: detect defects, localize them, and explain them.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation asset for generative-model reliability, enabling training/evaluation of multimodal self-checking and defect explanation capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: AGIDefect-4K: 4,000 images from 15 generative models with hierarchical annotations (defect presence, pixel-level masks, textual explanations, overall quality score). AGIDA baseline uses MLLMs for joint detection/localization/explanation.
summary_en.experiments: 4K dataset spanning 15 SOTA generators (open + closed). The abstract does not report exact baselines/metrics; likely multi-task results and breakdown by defect taxonomy.
summary_en.authors_note: Xidian University

recommendation.zh: 把“生成缺陷”做成可监督的分层标注（含像素mask）是亮点；但4K偏小、缺陷定义主观性强，适合作为诊断评测而非训练主粮。
recommendation.en: The key value is hierarchical, mask-level supervision for generation defects; but 4K is small and defect taxonomy is subjective—use it as a diagnostic eval, not core training data.

paper.title: JuryProbe: An Empirical Consensus-Risk Diagnostic for Routing Reference-Free Factuality Judge Panels to Grounded Verification
paper.abstract: Panels of inexpensive LLM judges increasingly make accept-or-escalate decisions. In factuality settings, accepting a claim because several reference-free judges agree can create a hidden risk: agreement may reflect shared false-negative blind spots rather than independent evidence. We introduce JuryProbe, an empirical consensus-risk diagnostic for reference-free factuality judge panels, paired with a calibration-based routing policy. JuryProbe estimates consensus risk from a labeled calibration

summary.core_problem: 诊断多个 reference-free LLM factuality judges 达成一致时，是否只是共享同类漏判盲点，而不是提供独立可靠证据。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测与校准方法：提出 consensus-risk diagnostic，用标注校准集估计 judge panel 的 false-negative 相关性，并据此决定何时升级到带可信 reference 的验证流程。
summary.technical_approach: JuryProbe 使用 false-negative-only judge correlation 和 false-consensus lift 两个量度衡量一致性风险；当 reference-free 多数接受被标记为高风险时，将样本路由到同一批 judge，但提供 trusted references 进行 grounded verification。
summary.experiments: 在 FEVER corruption 审计中，reference-free panels 出现相关漏判，FN-only correlations 为 0.402 和 0.368，false-consensus lift 分别为 3.13x 和 18.13x；在 trusted-reference best-case diagnostic 下，minimal-pair 与 non-minimal-pair evidence 的 unanimous false consensus 降至 0。摘要未说明 judge 模型规模和完整样本规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者标注为 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses whether agreement among reference-free factuality judges reflects shared false-negative blind spots rather than independent evidence.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation and calibration procedure for judge panels: estimate consensus risk from a labeled probe and route risky accepts to grounded verification with trusted references.
summary_en.technical_approach: JuryProbe measures false-negative-only judge correlation and false-consensus lift on a calibration set. If a reference-free majority accept is flagged as high risk, the claim is re-evaluated by the same judges with trusted references.
summary_en.experiments: On audited FEVER corruptions, reference-free panels show correlated false negatives, with FN-only correlations of 0.402 and 0.368 and false-consensus lifts of 3.13x and 18.13x. Under a trusted-reference best-case diagnostic, unanimous false consensus drops to zero for both minimal-pair and non-minimal-pair evidence. The abstract does not specify judge model sizes or full sample details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are listed as independent researchers.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 judge panel 风险清单，不必细读；关键数字说明多数投票在事实性上会放大共享盲点。
recommendation.en: Useful as a checklist for judge-panel risk, not a deep read; the key numbers show majority voting can amplify shared factuality blind spots.

paper.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interleaves retrieval, reasoning, and answer generation across multiple hops. A retrieval error at hop 1 can surface only as a wrong answer at hop 3, while later retrieval can also repair the trajectory. This paper introduces AgenticRAG-FP, an interventional benchmark for causal failure attribution in agentic RAG. The benchmark injects a certified fault at a specified hop, re-executes the downstream trajectory, and evaluates diagnosers against the kno

summary.core_problem: 评估 agentic RAG 中多跳检索、推理和生成交织时，错误是否能被准确归因到真正引入故障的 hop。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent/RAG 评测资产与诊断 protocol：通过干预式注入已知故障，检验事后 trace 诊断器能否在后续轨迹变化后仍定位故障来源。对预训练本身无直接贡献，但对长链路系统评测有参考。
summary.technical_approach: AgenticRAG-FP 在指定 hop 注入 certified fault，然后重新执行后续 trajectory，用已知 intervention 作为标签评估 diagnoser。设计区分早期检索错误被后续放大、后续检索修复轨迹、以及证据内容被局部污染等情况。
summary.experiments: 在 80 个三跳 MuSiQue 问题上完成 strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep；失败轨迹中，coverage-based diagnosis 在 hop 1 的准确或覆盖表现为 0.91，但在 hop 2 和 hop 3 为 0.00，对应 n=43、36、21。另有较小的 content-corruption study，在 depth 2 过滤后剩 18 个失败案例。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构标注为 Anote。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether failures in multi-hop agentic RAG can be causally attributed to the hop where the fault was actually injected.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an interventional benchmark and diagnostic protocol for agent/RAG failure attribution. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to evaluating long-chain LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticRAG-FP injects a certified fault at a specified hop, re-executes the downstream trajectory, and scores diagnosers against the known intervention. The setup captures cases where early retrieval errors surface later, later retrieval repairs the path, or evidence content is corrupted while remaining topical.
summary_en.experiments: A completed strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep is reported on 80 three-hop MuSiQue questions. For failed trajectories, coverage-based diagnosis scores 0.91 at hop 1 and 0.00 at hops 2 and 3, with n=43, 36, and 21. A smaller content-corruption study leaves 18 failed cases at depth 2 after filtering.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliation is Anote.

recommendation.zh: 看实验表就够；它提醒 RAG trace 归因在后段 hop 很脆，样本小，不能外推到通用 agent 能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the result table; it usefully shows late-hop RAG attribution is brittle, but the small setup should not be overread.

paper.title: Stopping and Routing LLM Judge Panels
paper.abstract: LLM evaluation pipelines often have many candidate judges: general LLM-as-a-judge prompts, reward models, safety classifiers, confidence variants, and task-specific verifiers. The deployment question is not only which judge is best, but which judges should be called, on which examples, and when panel construction should stop. We formulate judge-panel design as a role-conditioned allocation problem. From a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates target-rela

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 评测中多 judge 并存时，如何按样本选择、组合与停止调用 judge panel，以在成本和评测质量之间取得更好平衡。
summary.importance: 这是 evaluation protocol 层面的工作。贡献不在于提出新 judge，而在于把 judge panel 设计形式化为带成本约束的分配问题，并区分 copy、complement、specialist 三类 judge 角色。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从一个小规模标注 audit set、预定义数据切片和各 judge 成本出发，估计 judge 相对目标的角色：copy 表示条件信息冗余，complement 提供全局增益，specialist 只在特定 slice 上有效。基于此构造策略：去掉 copy、全局加入 complement、按条件路由 specialist，并在验证增益低于阈值时停止扩 panel。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖 reasoning、code、safety、preference、reward-model、summarization、math 等多类 audit，并与单 judge、平铺式 panel、多样性启发式、full-call stacking、reliability juries 等方案比较。若正文给出稳定的 cost-quality frontier，这对大规模评测流水线有实际价值，但对预训练方法本身是间接相关。
summary.authors_note: 机构为中山大学。未见可明确识别的业界广为人知作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to select, route, and stop LLM judge panels so that evaluation quality improves without paying the full cost of calling every judge on every example.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution. The novelty is not a new judge model, but a cost-aware formulation of judge-panel design that distinguishes redundant, complementary, and slice-specialized judges.
summary_en.technical_approach: Given a small labeled audit set, declared slices, and judge costs, the method estimates each judge’s role relative to the target: copies add no conditional information, complements improve the panel globally, and specialists help only on certain slices. The resulting policy drops copies, adds complements globally, routes specialists conditionally, and stops expanding the panel when validation gain falls below a threshold.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments across reasoning, code, safety, preference, reward-model, summarization, and math audits, compared against single judges, flat panels, diversity heuristics, full-call stacking, and reliability-jury style baselines. If the full paper shows a stable cost-quality frontier, it is practically useful for large evaluation pipelines, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Sun Yat-sen University. No widely recognizable industry-famous author is evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 做评测基础设施的人可以看；对 pretrain 研究员，读角色划分和 stopping rule 即可，它更像评测成本工程，不是能力建模新结论。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you build eval infrastructure; for pretraining researchers, just read the role taxonomy and stopping rule—it is mostly evaluation cost engineering, not a new capability insight.

institutions: Affiliation:School of Computer Science and Engineering

paper.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
paper.abstract: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 LLM watermarking 几乎只在英文上评测，导致跨语言部署时，检测阈值、质量指标和公平性结论都可能失真。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在评测方法而不在新水印算法本身。它补上了 multilingual watermarking 里最容易被忽略的一层：同一套英文评测设计在多语言环境下并不稳，尤其会把 calibration failure 和 detection failure 混在一起。对做模型安全、生成可追踪性的团队有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个四部分评测框架：第一，按部署语境经验校准每种语言/模型/方案的检测阈值；第二，引入与阈值无关的伴随指标，用来区分是阈值没校准好，还是水印检测本身失效；第三，把文本质量拆成三类互补测量：分布一致性、成对语义质量、参考困惑度；第四，用 generalized entropy decomposition 在语言类型学家族划分上分解跨语言差异，分析 disparity 来自哪些语言簇。随后把该框架应用到 6 种水印方案、3 个开源生成模型、11 种语言、base 与 instruction-tuned 两种设定。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 11 种语言、4 种书写系统、8 个类型学家族，评测对象包括 6 种 watermarking schemes 和 3 个 open-weight generators，并比较 base 与 instruction-tuned regime。摘要给出的核心发现是：单一语言、单一阈值、单一质量指标会掩盖明显的跨语言失败模式；而更细的校准和分解后，可以看到不同方案在某些语言上是检测失灵，在另一些语言上则是质量代价过高。论文更像 evaluation protocol 的清洗，而不是提出更强方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Case Western Reserve University。未见该方向上特别强的基座预训练代表作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a simple but under-examined issue: LLM watermarking is mostly evaluated in English, so conclusions about detectability, quality, and fairness can break under multilingual deployment.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is evaluative rather than algorithmic. The key value is showing that multilingual watermarking needs context-specific threshold calibration and richer quality diagnostics; otherwise calibration errors get conflated with true detection failures. This is relevant to model safety and provenance, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a four-part evaluation framework: (1) empirically calibrated detection thresholds per deployment context, (2) a threshold-independent companion metric to separate calibration failure from detection failure, (3) three disjoint quality paradigms—distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity, and (4) a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over typological family partitions. They apply this framework to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages, and both base and instruction-tuned settings.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans 11 languages, 4 scripts, and 8 typological families, evaluating 6 watermarking schemes on 3 open-weight generators under both base and instruction-tuned regimes. The main empirical takeaway is that single-threshold, English-centric evaluation hides important multilingual failure modes. Some failures are due to poor calibration, while others reflect genuine degradation in detection or quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Case Western Reserve University. No widely recognized foundation-model pretraining authors are apparent from the paper metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，正文不必细读；若你碰 watermarking 或 multilingual safety，只看评测框架设计和 disparity decomposition 那部分即可。
recommendation.en: Not really a pretraining paper; skip the full read unless you work on watermarking or multilingual safety, and then only the evaluation design and disparity decomposition are worth your time.

paper.title: When Text and Numbers Disagree: Evidence Arbitration in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in settings where textual summaries, numerical observations, and external tool outputs may provide conflicting evidence. We study how LLMs arbitrate between such sources when they support opposing decisions. To do so, we introduce a controlled synthetic benchmark in which latent risk trajectories generate both numerical time series and natural language summaries, allowing us to construct conflicts where exactly one evidence source is aligned wit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究当文本摘要、数值时间序列和外部工具输出彼此冲突时，LLM 如何在相互矛盾的证据之间做裁决。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把一个常被混在真实任务里的问题拆干净：模型不是单纯“会不会推理”，而是会不会在不同证据源冲突时做可靠 arbitration。对 tool use、RAG、multimodal reasoning 和 post-train 行为塑形都有启发，但与 pretrain 的关系仍是间接的。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个受控合成 benchmark：用潜在风险轨迹同时生成数值时间序列与自然语言摘要，再人为制造冲突，使得恰好只有一个证据源与真实标签一致。这样可以独立操控四个因素：模态类型、时间新近性、来源可靠性、证据 provenance。随后在开源 instruction-tuned 模型上测量其偏向文本还是数字、是否遵循 recency、是否会过度信任外部 forecast。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和分数，但核心结果很清楚：模型的 arbitration 不是随机的，而是有稳定偏好；它们通常比起显式 reliability cue，更一致地跟随 temporal recency；并且会在外部 forecast 与上下文直接证据冲突时，过度依赖 forecast。这个实验设计比一般混杂真实数据的分析更干净，适合拿来研究后训练偏置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 GlaxoSmithKline 与牛津大学相关机构。属于较强应用研究机构，但不是典型基座预训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLMs arbitrate between conflicting evidence sources—text summaries, numerical observations, and external tool outputs—when they imply different decisions.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is methodological clarity: it isolates evidence arbitration as a distinct capability rather than conflating it with generic reasoning. This matters for tool use, RAG, multimodal reasoning, and post-training behavior shaping, though it is only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a controlled synthetic benchmark where latent risk trajectories generate both numerical time series and natural-language summaries. They then construct conflicts such that exactly one source matches the ground-truth label. This allows independent manipulation of modality, temporal recency, source reliability, and evidence provenance. Open-weight instruction-tuned models are then probed for text-vs-number preference, recency following, and over-reliance on external forecasts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list exact models or scores, but the main findings are clear: arbitration behavior is systematic rather than random; models show stable text-versus-number preferences; they follow temporal recency more consistently than explicit reliability cues; and they can over-trust external forecasts even when those conflict with direct contextual evidence. The setup is cleaner than typical real-world evaluations because the conflict structure is controlled.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with GlaxoSmithKline and the University of Oxford ecosystem. This is a strong applied-research setting, though not a canonical foundation-model pretraining lab.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但实验设计很干净；若你做 tool-use/RAG/post-train，直接看冲突构造和 recency-vs-reliability 结论，能拿来做内部诊断。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup is unusually clean; if you work on tool use, RAG, or post-training, read the conflict construction and the recency-vs-reliability result and turn it into an internal diagnostic.

institutions: Oxford Suzhou Centre for Advanced Research
Affiliation:Oxford Suzhou Centre for Advanced Research, University of Oxford

paper.title: The Asymmetric Harms of LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) compression reduces deployment costs, but standard aggregate metrics like perplexity and accuracy often mask underlying behavioral shifts. In this work, we systematically evaluate 3 LLMs across 11 compression methods to investigate the effects of compression on knowledge retention, model confidence, and social bias. We find that compression disproportionately reduces the relative retention of head knowledge compared to tail knowledge. Furthermore, compressed models o

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 压缩在平均 perplexity、accuracy 之外造成的非对称行为变化，尤其是知识保持、置信度和社会偏见。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是压缩后行为分析。它提醒压缩不是简单的均匀降质，平均指标会掩盖知识分布、错误置信度和群体偏见方向的变化，对部署评测和压缩后验收有意义。
summary.technical_approach: 系统比较 3 个 LLM 和 11 种压缩方法，从知识保留的 head/tail 差异、丢失知识上的置信度、以及不同人口子群体的刻板偏好变化三个角度做细粒度测量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 LLM、11 种压缩方法。主要发现包括：压缩后 head knowledge 的相对保留下降比 tail knowledge 更明显；模型在新近丢失的知识上仍可能保持较高错误置信度；总体 bias 分数稳定时，子群体层面的刻板偏好可能发生方向相反的变化。摘要未给出具体模型名和压缩方法清单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Rice University、University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill 和 Rutgers University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies asymmetric behavioral shifts caused by LLM compression that are hidden by aggregate perplexity or accuracy.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis contribution for compressed-model validation. It shows that compression can change knowledge retention, confidence calibration, and subgroup-level bias in non-uniform ways.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate three LLMs under eleven compression methods, measuring head-versus-tail knowledge retention, confidence on newly lost knowledge, and demographic subgroup shifts in stereotypical preferences.
summary_en.experiments: Across three LLMs and eleven compression techniques, compressed models lose relatively more head knowledge than tail knowledge, often remain confident on newly incorrect answers, and can show opposing subgroup bias shifts despite stable aggregate bias scores. The abstract does not specify the exact model list or compression methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Rice University, the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, and Rutgers University.

recommendation.zh: 作为压缩验收清单备查即可；head/tail 知识结论反直觉，但缺模型清单前别改训练判断。
recommendation.en: Use it as a compression-validation checklist; the head/tail result is interesting, but do not update training priors without the model and method details.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
Affiliation:University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: ComponentBench: Diagnosing Component-Level Failures in Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Current evaluation of computer-use agents is split between long-horizon workflow benchmarks and atomic GUI-grounding tests. This leaves an under-instrumented middle layer: realistic component-centered interactions (e.g., toggle a button set) that are short enough to diagnose and rich enough to capture the burdens of modern interfaces. We present ComponentBench, a benchmark and diagnostic pipeline for component-level evaluation of computer-use agents on modern web UIs. ComponentBench is organized

summary.core_problem: 现有的计算机使用 Agent 评测要么是长程工作流，要么是原子的 GUI 基础测试，缺乏针对现实中组件级交互（如切换按钮组）的诊断性评测。
summary.importance: 填补了 Agent 评测在原子操作与长程任务之间的空白，提出了 ComponentBench，提供了细粒度、组件级的诊断基准，有助于深入分析 Agent 在现代 Web UI 上的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个独立于库的本体，包含 97 种规范 UI 组件，实例化为 2910 个经过程序化验证的任务，跨越广泛使用的组件库。配有清理过的人类参考轨迹，用于评估任务成功率和交互效率。引入了可扩展的管道，用于在实现后审计结构难度，并综合跨任务和组件家族的结构化失败分析。
summary.experiments: 评测了几个现有的 Agent，发现它们在组件级交互上存在显著的失败模式，证明了该基准的诊断价值。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Duke University 和 Amazon AGI SF Lab 的合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of computer-use agents are either long-horizon workflows or atomic GUI-grounding tests, lacking diagnostic evaluation for realistic component-level interactions (e.g., toggling a button set).
summary_en.importance: Fills the gap between atomic operations and long-horizon tasks in agent evaluation by introducing ComponentBench, a fine-grained, component-level diagnostic benchmark that helps deeply analyze agent failure modes on modern Web UIs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a library-agnostic ontology of 97 canonical UI components, instantiated as 2,910 programmatically verified tasks across widely used component libraries. Pairs tasks with cleaned human reference trajectories to evaluate both task success and interaction efficiency. Introduces a scalable pipeline for auditing structural difficulty and synthesizing structured failure analyses across tasks and component families.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates several existing agents, revealing significant failure modes in component-level interactions and demonstrating the diagnostic value of the benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Duke University and Amazon AGI SF Lab.

recommendation.zh: 填补了 GUI Agent 评测中原子操作与长程任务之间的空白，其细粒度的组件级诊断思路对构建更鲁棒的 Web Agent 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Fills the gap between atomic operations and long-horizon tasks in GUI Agent evaluation; its fine-grained component-level diagnostic approach is valuable for building more robust Web Agents.

paper.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
paper.abstract: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183

summary.core_problem: 论文研究开放式生成任务中自动评测指标如何构造，重点是没有参考答案、LLM judge 又有偏置时，能否让指标通过自身误判逐步改进。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在训练目标本身，而在评测信号构造。它提供了一种可审计、可执行、可组合的自动评测生成方法，适合思考开放式任务、agent 训练、报告生成、代码生成等场景中的 reward 或 verifier 如何从局部缺陷检测开始建立。对基座研究员的启发是：复杂质量判断不一定要先学一个整体打分器，也可以拆成一组小的、可验证的 defect operator，再用反例驱动覆盖盲点。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 EvalCEGAR，借鉴程序验证里的 counterexample-guided abstraction refinement。系统维护一个 Python operator 池，每个 operator 读取任务和候选答案，判断是否存在某个命名缺陷，或者选择 abstain。operator 池把一个候选答案映射成一串 verdict signature；如果两个答案得到相同 signature，但真实标签不同，就说明当前指标无法区分这对样本。系统把这对 collision 作为新的规格说明交给模型，让模型生成能区分它们的 operator。这样做的关键区别是：不是反复要求模型“写一个评测器”，而是用当前指标的失败样例限定下一次生成目标。论文还强调接口问题：如果现有 operator 可读信息不足以表达某个区分，继续采样没有意义，需要扩大 operator 的输入接口。operator 是否纳入池中，不看它覆盖多少已知错误，而看它是否改善下游二分类决策。
summary.experiments: 实验选择代码任务，因为隐藏测试可以提供精确 oracle，但 operator 本身不能读取 oracle。数据来自 MBPP+ 和 HumanEval+。作者抽取 150 个 MBPP+ 任务，其中 75 个用于运行循环、75 个保留；再加入 228 个 MBPP+ 任务和 125 个 HumanEval+ 任务，形成 428 个 unseen tasks。直接让模型生成 operator 的朴素循环表现很差：5 次运行产生 183 个会触发 flag 的 operator，但只对应 96 种不同 flag set，行为重复明显；对研究中写出的 295 个 operator 重新打分也没有带来发现。EvalCEGAR 的 8 次运行中有 6 次成功纳入 operator，且这 6 个 operator 在 428 个未见任务上都有帮助。最好的自动生成 operator 只有 55 行 Python，在第二个 benchmark 上达到最佳手写 operator 的效果，但触发 flag 数只有后者约三分之一。消融显示，单独改变 admission question 可把 admission 从 0 提到 1；窄接口设置下 336 次尝试没有纳入任何 operator。组合实验枚举了约 230 万个可组合子集，发现原循环使用的组合目标在全集中排名可低至第 5 百分位，而一个未调参的 class-weighted 目标可达到第 91 百分位以上，说明 operator 生成和 operator 组合是两个需要分开处理的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Section 4、Section 5.1–5.3，约 25–35 分钟。重点看三个问题：第一，signature collision 如何定义指标盲点；第二，operator admission 为什么绑定下游决策，而不是绑定覆盖率；第三，Section 5.3 的组合枚举结果，它提醒读者不要把“发现有用局部检查器”和“构造好整体指标”混为一谈。Appendix A 和 B 可快速查看，主要用于确认 oracle 隔离和少量训练任务是否足够支持迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build automatic metrics for open-ended outputs when there is no reference answer and LLM judges are unreliable or biased.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is evaluation signal construction, rather than pretraining itself. The work suggests a concrete way to turn vague quality judgments into a pool of small, executable, auditable defect detectors. This is useful for thinking about reward models, verifiers, agent training signals, and open-ended generation evaluation, especially in settings where a scalar judge is hard to trust.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvalCEGAR adapts counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. The metric is represented as a pool of Python operators. Each operator reads the task and one candidate answer, then flags one named defect, passes the answer, or abstains. The pool maps each answer to a verdict signature. If two answers share the same signature but have different oracle labels, the current metric is too coarse. That collision becomes the next specification given to the model. This is the main departure from simply prompting a model to write evaluators: diversity comes from failures of the current abstraction, not from resampling. The method also treats interface width as a first-class issue. If an operator cannot see the information needed to distinguish a pair, further sampling is not expected to help; the operator interface must be expanded. Operators are admitted only when they improve the deployed decision rule.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use code-generation tasks because hidden unit tests provide an exact oracle while remaining unavailable to the operators. The data comes from MBPP+ and HumanEval+. The loop runs on 75 MBPP+ training tasks. Evaluation uses 428 unseen tasks: 75 held-out MBPP+ tasks, 228 additional MBPP+ tasks, and 125 HumanEval+ tasks. A naive operator-generation loop is highly redundant: five runs produce 183 flagging operators but only 96 distinct flag sets. Scoring all 295 authored operators at the narrow interface yields no discovery. EvalCEGAR admits an operator in six of eight runs, and all six admitted operators help on the 428 unseen tasks. The best generated operator is 55 lines of Python and matches the best hand-written operator on a second benchmark while using about one third as many flags. Ablations show that changing the admission question alone moves admissions from zero to one, while the narrow interface admits nothing in 336 attempts. For composition, the authors enumerate about 2.3M subsets and show that the loop’s original composition objective can rank near the 5th percentile, whereas an untuned class-weighted objective reaches the 91st percentile or above.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction, Section 4, and Sections 5.1–5.3. Expected reading time is about 25–35 minutes. The most useful parts are the signature-collision formulation, the admission criterion tied to downstream decisions, and the subset-enumeration result for metric composition. Appendix A and Appendix B are worth a quick pass to check oracle isolation and the small amount of supervision used to seed the loop.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法循环；把 evaluator 当可调程序而非 judge prompt，这对 RL/数据筛选信号质量更有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the refinement loop; treating evaluators as editable programs rather than judge prompts is the useful signal for RL and data filtering.

paper.title: Competence, Not Accuracy: A Diagnostic for Reference-Free Judge Gates in Skill Optimization
paper.abstract: Text-space skill optimization adapts a frozen agent by evolving a natural-language skill document, accepting each candidate through a validation gate. Existing gates rely on verifiable rewards, confining these methods to tasks with an automatic verifier. Replacing the verifier with an LLM-judge gate would lift that restriction, but whether such a gate carries usable signal is untested. We ask a prior question: can we tell, before placing a judge in the loop, whether its scores separate correct f

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在 text-space skill optimization 中，如果没有 verifier，能否用 reference-free LLM judge 作为候选 skill 的接受门控；如果能，部署前应怎样判断这个 judge gate 是否可靠。论文把问题从“judge 准不准”改成“judge 是否能区分 verifier 标记的正确输出和错误输出”。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和基座预训练的距离不近，但对训练信号质量有清晰启发。很多后训练流程会用 LLM judge 做数据筛选、reward、拒绝采样或自动评测。论文指出，benchmark accuracy 往往高估 judge 在实际 gating 场景里的有效能力；真正相关的是 judge 在当前任务、当前输入分布、当前候选答案上的 discriminability。这个观点可以迁移到 SFT/RL 数据过滤、reward model 审计和 synthetic data 质量控制。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由一个简单但有用的 judge-as-latent-solver 模型开始。对于答案空间大小为 k 的单答案任务，judge 在没有 gold answer 的情况下先隐式求解，求对的概率记为 competence c；如果求错，则在其余 k-1 个答案上均匀分布；judge 的评分由候选答案是否等于其内部答案决定。在这些假设下，二值 judge score 的 TPR 为 c，FPR 为 (1-c)/(k-1)，因此 AUC = 1/2 * (1 + c - (1-c)/(k-1))。这给出一个必要条件：只有 c > 1/k 时，judge 才可能高于随机区分。论文进一步指出 marginal AUC 会被题目难度混淆：一个只读出题目难度、不看答案内容的打分器也可能得到高于随机的 AUC。因此它提出 within-question estimator，用同一问题内的正确和错误候选做比较，并用 question-clustered bootstrap 给不确定性估计。测量流程是 non-intervening probe：真实优化仍由 verifier gate 决策，judge 只旁路记录分数，不改变 accept/reject，从而避免 judge 本身改变优化动态。
summary.experiments: 实验发现 judge discriminability 随任务变化很大。在研究数学任务上接近随机；在事实问答和研究生级科学题上较可用。论文还检验了 competence c 与 AUC 的闭式关系：在难度混淆较少、可干净测试的设置中，预测边界能解释观测结果。另一个重要发现是，headline benchmark accuracy 是偏乐观的 competence 代理。差距来自至少三类因素：censoring convention、benchmark exposure、以及 solve/grade context gap。闭环 gating 实验显示，未通过诊断的 judge 会引入 regression；通过诊断的 judge 没有引入 regression，但会出现 over-rejection，即过度拒绝本可接受的候选。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看模型假设 A1-A3 和 Proposition 1，公式很简单，但它把 reference-free judging 的边界讲清楚了。然后看 within-question estimator，因为这是论文里最可复用的测量设计。实验部分重点看三处：不同任务上 AUC 的分布，benchmark accuracy 到 grading-context competence 的分解，以及 closed-loop gate 的错误类型。如果关心 reward hacking 或自动数据筛选，可以细读 non-intervening probe 的协议：episode-level scoring、answer-content feeding、within-question stratification、clustered bootstrap 和 proxy-based decontamination。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a reference-free LLM judge can replace a verifier gate in text-space skill optimization. Instead of asking whether the judge is generally accurate, it asks whether the judge score can separate verifier-correct outputs from verifier-wrong outputs on the actual candidates produced during optimization.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is useful for thinking about training-signal quality. LLM judges are often used for data filtering, reward construction, rejection sampling, and automatic evaluation. The key lesson is that benchmark accuracy is not the right deployment diagnostic. What matters is discriminability under the target task, candidate distribution, and grading context. This transfers directly to audits of reward models, synthetic-data filters, and judge-based SFT/RL pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main tool is a judge-as-latent-solver model. For a single-answer task with answer-space size k, a reference-free judge implicitly solves the problem with grading-context competence c. If it is wrong, its internal answer is assumed to be uniformly distributed over the other k-1 answers. The judge score is then whether the candidate answer matches the judge’s internal answer. Under this model, TPR is c and FPR is (1-c)/(k-1), giving AUC = 0.5 * (1 + c - (1-c)/(k-1)). This yields a necessary condition: c must exceed 1/k for the judge to discriminate above chance. The paper also shows that marginal AUC can be confounded by item difficulty; a scorer that only reads difficulty can appear useful. The proposed measurement therefore uses a within-question estimator, comparing correct and incorrect candidates for the same question, with question-clustered bootstrap uncertainty. The judge is run as a non-intervening probe: the real optimizer still accepts or rejects candidates using the verifier, while the judge only records scores.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical results show large task dependence. Judge discriminability is near chance on research mathematics, but more usable on factual QA and graduate-level science tasks. Where difficulty confounding can be controlled, the closed-form competence-to-AUC relation matches the observed pattern. The paper also decomposes why headline benchmark accuracy overstates grading-context competence: censoring convention, benchmark exposure, and the solve-versus-grade context gap all push the estimate in the optimistic direction. In a closed-loop gating study, judges that fail the diagnostic import regressions, while a judge that passes the diagnostic imports no regressions and mainly makes over-rejection errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-35 minute skim is sufficient. Read assumptions A1-A3 and Proposition 1 first; the formula is simple but captures the operational limit of reference-free judging. Then read the within-question estimator, which is the most reusable part of the method. In the experiments, focus on task-level AUC variation, the decomposition from benchmark accuracy to grading-context competence, and the closed-loop gate error analysis. For reward-hacking or automatic data-filtering use cases, spend extra time on the non-intervening probe protocol: episode-level scoring, answer-content feeding, within-question stratification, clustered bootstrap, and proxy-based decontamination.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“judge 能不能当训练信号”拆成可测条件，做 RL/skill optimization 的人应先看这个诊断，再决定要不要把 judge 接进环里。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns “can a judge be used as training signal?” into a measurable condition; worth reading before wiring any judge into RL or skill-optimization loops.

paper.title: Judge, Retrieve, or Abstain: Uncertainty-Guarded LLM Judging with Provable Risk Guarantees
paper.abstract: Using LLMs as judges has become standard practice for evaluating model outputs at scale. This is particularly common for subjective, open-ended tasks such as assessing helpfulness or alignment, where no single reference answer exists. However, objective tasks introduce a distinct reliability challenge for reference-free LLM judging. In the absence of a reference answer, the judge evaluates factual correctness either through its parametric knowledge or through tool augmentation. Although the form

summary.core_problem: 在“无参考答案”的客观事实评测里，用 LLM 当 judge 往往会在知识缺口或幻觉时给出看似自信但错误的判决。论文要解决的是：如何让 LLM judge 在保持较高覆盖率（coverage）的同时，对“被接受的判决”给出可证明的错误率上界，并且在不确定时能先用检索补证据、再决定判或弃权。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更像评测基础设施而不是预训练算法，但对预训练研究有直接外溢：一是把 LLM-as-a-judge 从“经验上还行”推进到“可控风险”的统计保证，能降低用 judge 做数据筛选、RM 训练信号构造、持续预训练回归测试时的隐性噪声；二是把“检索增强”从提升 judge 准确率的工程技巧，变成带校准阈值的决策流程（judge / retrieve / abstain），在固定算力预算下更可控地换取覆盖率。对做大规模训练的人来说，价值在于把评测噪声的尾部风险显式化，避免错误评测反向驱动数据/模型选择。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个两阶段路由的 selective evaluation。
1) 设 examinee 模型 F 生成答案 y_hat，judge J 输出二值判决 v（认为正确/不正确）。有带标签的校准集提供真实评价 e*（来自人工或可计算的参考匹配函数）。定义失败指示 W=1[v≠e*]。
2) Mode 1（parametric judging）：judge 仅靠参数知识给判决，同时输出不确定性分数（论文表述为可用于阈值化的置信/不确定性信号；具体实现通常来自 judge 的自评置信、logprob margin、或结构化打分提示）。若不确定性低于阈值 τ1，则接受该判决进入“自动评测集合”。
3) Mode 2（retrieve-augmented judging）：若 Mode 1 不确定，则触发 web search 检索证据，将证据拼接回 judge 重新判决并再次给出不确定性；若低于第二阈值 τ2，则接受；否则 abstain（交给人工或不计入自动评测）。
4) 关键是风险控制校准：用 Clopper–Pearson（CP）对 Bernoulli 失败率给出有限样本上置信界，上界不超过用户指定 α（论文强调 FDR/错误发现率语境：在“被接受的判决”集合上控制错误比例）。他们证明在“两阈值+路由”的设置下，CP 所需的 Bernoulli 结构仍成立，因此对固定(τ1,τ2) 的风险保证可以扩展到该路由策略，不需要额外分布假设。
5) 与已有 selective prediction 的区别：以往多是“判或弃权”的单阈值；这里把“检索”作为介于两者之间的动作，并把两个阈值联合校准，从而在同等风险约束下提高 coverage，同时把检索成本集中用在真正不确定的样本上。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验结论主线是：在多个 open-domain QA 基准、不同规模的 judge 上，两模式（带自适应检索）在相同风险水平 α 下，相比单模式（只 parametric 或只检索或直接弃权）能显著提高 coverage；并且风险（被接受判决的错误率/FDR 上界）按校准目标被控制住。论文还强调：小 judge 更依赖检索来补知识缺口；大 judge 在 parametric 模式覆盖更高，但仍会在长尾事实/新近信息上受益于检索。
你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（如各基准的 coverage 提升幅度、α 取值、校准集大小、检索次数/成本），因此这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精读时应以主结果表为准，重点看“同一 α 下 coverage 的增量”和“检索触发率带来的成本曲线”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 把失败模式分清：知识缺口 vs 幻觉，以及为什么单纯阈值化不确定性没有形式保证。
- 精看 Methodology 里两点：
  (1) 两模式路由与两个阈值的定义（什么时候 retrieve，什么时候 abstain）。
  (2) CP 上置信界如何用于校准，以及他们证明“路由后仍满足 Bernoulli 结构/保证可迁移”的那段推导（这是论文最硬的部分）。
- 最后看主结果表：在固定 α 下 coverage 的提升、以及检索调用比例（成本）与 coverage 的权衡。若你关心把它接到训练闭环里，额外关注他们如何定义不确定性分数、以及校准集与目标分布偏移时的鲁棒性讨论（如果正文有）。

summary_en.core_problem: Reference-free LLM judging for objective factual tasks is brittle: the judge may lack knowledge or hallucinate yet still output confident verdicts. The paper targets a practical and formal question: how to run LLM-as-a-judge with (i) provable finite-sample risk control on the error rate among accepted verdicts, while (ii) preserving coverage by optionally retrieving external evidence before abstaining.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-infrastructure paper rather than a pretraining recipe, but it matters to pretraining loops because LLM judges are routinely used to (a) select data, (b) generate/score supervision for reward models, and (c) run regression tests during continual pretraining. The contribution is making judge noise tail-risk explicit and controllable via statistical calibration, and turning retrieval from an ad-hoc accuracy booster into a calibrated decision action (judge / retrieve / abstain) that trades compute for coverage under a fixed risk budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose a two-stage selective evaluation policy with joint threshold calibration.
- Setup: an examinee model produces an answer; a judge outputs a binary verdict. A held-out calibration set provides ground-truth evaluation labels (human or reference-based matching). Define a Bernoulli failure indicator for whether the judge verdict matches ground truth.
- Mode 1 (parametric judging): the judge decides using only its internal knowledge and emits an uncertainty/confidence score. If uncertainty is below threshold τ1, accept the verdict.
- Mode 2 (retrieval-augmented judging): otherwise, trigger web search, re-judge with retrieved evidence, and accept if uncertainty is below τ2; else abstain.
- Risk control: thresholds (τ1, τ2) are calibrated on the labeled calibration set using Clopper–Pearson upper confidence bounds to ensure the error rate (framed as FDR / false discovery among accepted verdicts) is bounded by a user-specified α with high probability.
- Key technical point: they argue the Bernoulli structure required for the CP bound still holds under the two-threshold routing scheme, so the finite-sample guarantee extends without extra distributional assumptions.
- Compared to prior selective prediction: prior work is typically single-threshold accept/abstain; here retrieval is an intermediate action, and the two thresholds are jointly calibrated to increase coverage under the same risk constraint while concentrating retrieval cost on uncertain cases.
summary_en.experiments:
Across multiple open-domain QA benchmarks and judge models of different sizes, the two-mode policy improves coverage at the same target risk level α compared to single-mode baselines (parametric-only with abstention, or retrieval-only strategies), while maintaining the calibrated risk guarantee. The qualitative pattern is that smaller judges gain more from retrieval (knowledge gaps), while larger judges still benefit on long-tail or time-sensitive facts.
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (coverage gains, α values, calibration set sizes, retrieval call rates/cost), so exact figures cannot be stated reliably here; the main results table and cost/coverage curves are the places to extract those numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
1) Introduction: focus on the two failure modes (knowledge gap vs hallucination) and why heuristic uncertainty thresholds are insufficient.
2) Methodology: read carefully the routing logic and how τ1/τ2 are defined; then focus on the proof/argument that Clopper–Pearson risk control carries over to the routed two-threshold setting.
3) Experiments: prioritize the main table showing coverage at fixed α, plus any plot/table reporting retrieval trigger rate (compute cost) vs coverage. If you intend to plug this into training pipelines, also check how uncertainty scores are instantiated and any discussion on distribution shift between calibration and deployment.

recommendation.zh: 只看风险控制形式化和路由准则；如果校准假设干净，可直接借到自动评测和偏好数据过滤。
recommendation.en: Read the risk-control formulation and routing rule; if the calibration assumptions are clean, it is reusable for automated eval and preference-data filtering.

paper.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models(LLMs) and agents have substantially improved the ability of AI systems to execute complex tasks. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful ag

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型会不会做某个子任务”，而是更难也更贴近真实使用的问题：通用 agent 能否在现实工作流里，按完整需求交付可用成品。作者认为现有 agent benchmark 的主要缺口有两个。第一，任务往往由研究者主观设计，未必对应真实用户已经愿意付费或持续使用的工作。第二，评测粒度过粗，常把复杂 deliverable 压成一个整体分数，难以判断模型到底是败在功能缺失、结构错误、格式不合规，还是领域知识不足。StartupBench 因而把任务来源改成“市场验证过的 AI-native startup 产品工作流”，并把评测单位改成“面向交付物的细粒度 rubric”。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义不在于提出新训练方法，而在于给 agent 能力提供了一个更接近真实需求分布的外部测量面。它的价值主要有三层。第一，它把 benchmark 的任务分布从研究者想象的 useful tasks，转成已经被市场筛过一轮的 delegated workflows，这对判断模型能力缺口更有约束力。第二，它强调 deliverable-level evaluation，而不是只看过程轨迹或单点答案，这对 post-train、tool use、长上下文规划都有直接影响。第三，它给出了一个很清楚的失败归因框架：当前系统的主要瓶颈不是“完全不会调用工具”，而是复杂指令遵循、跨约束一致性、领域专业性和成品质量控制。这些结论会反过来影响预训练和中后训练的数据构造：如果训练信号主要奖励局部正确，而不是完整交付，模型在真实工作流里就会系统性掉链子。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者没有直接从公开 demo 抽任务，也没有纯手工编题，而是做了一个多阶段构建流程。第一步，筛选 AI-native startup，要求有一定融资和真实采用证据，用它们作为“用户确实愿意把这类工作交给 AI”的外部信号。第二步，访谈深度用户，恢复真实使用场景中的任务目标、输入条件、约束、期望交付物和验收标准。第三步，由领域专家把这些场景抽象成可复现、可回答、可评测的 benchmark 实例。第四步，做多轮质量控制，检查 realism、answerability、evaluability 和 discriminative difficulty。最终形成 97 个任务，覆盖 6 个主要领域。

评测设计上，核心不是单一总分，而是每个任务配多维 rubric，分别覆盖功能、结构、格式和领域特定质量。这样做的原因很直接：真实工作产品往往不是“答对就行”，而是要同时满足多个约束。若只做整体打分，模型可能在某一维严重失真，但被其他维度掩盖。作者还构建了统一的 agent harness 来跑代表性模型，尽量控制工具接口和执行环境，减少“某个系统工程实现更好”对结论的干扰。这个 benchmark 的方法创新不在算法，而在任务来源、任务抽象和评测协议三者绑在一起，形成了一个更像真实委托工作的评测闭环。
summary.experiments:
关键结果是：在统一 agentic harness 下，最强模型的成功率也只有约 30%。这说明当前通用 agent 距离“稳定交付专业可用成品”还有明显距离，而不是只差一点 prompt engineering。分领域看，Finance、STEM & Computer Science、Education & Humanities 更难，说明高约束、高专业性、强结构化输出的任务仍是明显短板。

从论文给出的分析框架看，失败主要集中在几类：一是复杂 instruction following，模型能理解大方向，但难以同时满足多条细约束；二是 domain-specific expertise，不是泛泛写作能力不足，而是在专业内容、术语、规范和推理链条上不稳；三是 deliverable completion，模型可能能产出“像样的草稿”，但离可直接使用的成品还有差距。虽然摘要里没有展开所有模型和每个 domain 的完整数字，但全文重点不是刷榜，而是证明：当任务来源更真实、评分更细时，现有系统的能力上限会显著低于常见 benchmark 给人的印象。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 StartupBench 构建流程，重点理解作者为什么不用传统 researcher-designed tasks，也为什么不用直接抓 startup demo。这里决定了 benchmark 的可信度。然后看任务构建与 rubric 设计部分，关注每个任务如何保证可回答、可评测、且仍保留真实工作流的复杂性。再看实验总表和按领域拆分结果，重点不是记住谁排第一，而是看不同领域失败模式是否一致。最后看 error analysis，尤其是作者如何把失败归因到 instruction following、领域知识和交付物质量，而不是笼统地说“agent 还不够强”。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要判断它是否适合作为内部评测基线，则需要细读 rubric 和质量控制流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a harder and more practical question than standard agent benchmarks: can a general-purpose agent produce professionally usable end-to-end deliverables under realistic constraints? The authors argue that many existing benchmarks are limited in two ways. First, tasks are often researcher-selected rather than grounded in workflows that users have already shown willingness to adopt or pay for. Second, evaluation is usually too coarse relative to the deliverable itself, making it hard to tell whether failure comes from missing functionality, poor structure, formatting violations, or lack of domain expertise. StartupBench addresses both by sourcing tasks from market-validated AI-native startup workflows and evaluating them with fine-grained rubrics tied to the final deliverable.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is not a new training recipe but a more realistic measurement surface for agent capability. There are three concrete contributions. First, it shifts the task distribution from researcher-imagined usefulness to workflows already filtered by market demand, which gives stronger external validity. Second, it evaluates complete deliverables rather than intermediate steps or loosely judged outputs, which matters for post-training, tool use, planning, and long-context systems. Third, it offers a sharper failure decomposition: current systems are not mainly blocked by the inability to call tools, but by complex instruction following, consistency across many constraints, domain expertise, and final-product quality control. That diagnosis is relevant upstream: if training signals reward local correctness more than complete deliverable quality, models will predictably underperform on real delegated work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The benchmark construction pipeline is the main technical contribution. Instead of directly scraping product demos or manually inventing tasks, the authors use a multi-stage process. They first identify AI-native startups with evidence of funding and real adoption, using that as a proxy that users genuinely delegate these workflows to AI. They then interview deep users to recover actual usage contexts, task goals, inputs, constraints, expected deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Domain experts convert those validated scenarios into benchmark instances that are reproducible, answerable, and evaluable. A final quality-control stage checks realism, answerability, evaluability, and discriminative difficulty. The result is a 97-task benchmark spanning six major domains.

The evaluation protocol is equally important. Each task is scored with multiple independent rubrics covering functionality, structure, formatting, and domain-specific quality, rather than a single holistic score. The reason is straightforward: real work products must satisfy several coupled requirements at once, and a single score can hide severe failure on one dimension. The authors also evaluate representative models under a unified agentic harness to reduce confounding from system-specific tooling. The novelty here is not an algorithmic method but the coupling of task sourcing, task abstraction, and deliverable-level evaluation into one coherent benchmark design.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is that even the strongest model completes only about 30% of tasks under the unified harness. That is a strong signal that current general-purpose agents are still far from reliably producing professionally usable deliverables. Performance varies substantially by domain, with Finance, STEM & Computer Science, and Education & Humanities emerging as especially difficult. This suggests that high-constraint, expertise-heavy, and strongly structured tasks remain major weaknesses.

The paper’s analysis points to a few recurring failure modes. One is complex instruction following: models often capture the broad objective but fail to satisfy many detailed constraints simultaneously. Another is domain-specific expertise: the issue is not generic fluency, but instability in professional content, terminology, conventions, and reasoning. A third is deliverable completion: systems can often produce something plausible-looking, yet still fall short of a directly usable final product. The emphasis is less on leaderboard separation and more on showing that once task sourcing becomes more realistic and scoring becomes more faithful, the apparent capability ceiling of current agents drops materially.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the benchmark construction section. The key question is why the authors reject both traditional researcher-designed tasks and direct extraction from startup demos. That design choice determines the benchmark’s credibility. Then read the task construction and rubric sections carefully, focusing on how they preserve real workflow complexity while keeping tasks answerable and evaluable. After that, look at the main results table and the domain breakdown. The useful signal is not who ranks first, but whether failure patterns are stable across domains. Finally, read the error analysis, especially the parts that separate instruction-following failures from domain-knowledge failures and final-deliverable quality issues. A quick pass takes around 30 to 40 minutes. A deeper read is needed if you want to judge whether this benchmark is suitable as an internal evaluation target.

recommendation.zh: 一个基于真实 AI 初创产品工作流的 Agent Benchmark，评估视角新颖，有助于了解当前模型在实际商业落地中的能力瓶颈。
recommendation.en: An agent benchmark based on real AI startup product workflows; offers a novel evaluation perspective and helps identify capability bottlenecks of current models in actual commercial deployments.

paper.title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards
paper.abstract: Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5%

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 preference benchmark 中一个常被当作实现细节的问题：不同 annotator pool，例如众包标注者、领域专家、benchmark 作者，对同一 item 的偏好标签可能明显不同；但小规模 leaderboard 可能完全看不出这种差异。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练数据不直接相关，但对 post-training、reward model、LLM-as-judge、偏好评测和数据质量判断有明确启发。它说明“human preference gold”并不是单一稳定对象，标注者来源会改变 item-level 监督信号。leaderboard 不变不能说明标签可靠，只可能是模型数量少、模型间距大、聚合后扰动被抵消。对用偏好数据训练 RM、做 active annotation routing、验证 judge agreement 的工作，这个结论比对排行榜排序更重要。
summary.technical_approach: 作者利用保留了不同标注者池身份的偏好数据，直接比较同一 item 上不同 pool 的 majority label。为避免 tie-breaking 规则影响主结论，MultiPref 的主分析只使用两个 pool 内部都一致的 2,885 个 item；MT-Bench 也采用类似的 unanimous cell 子集。leaderboard 部分用同一批模型分别按 expert-gold 和 crowd-gold 打分，再用 Kendall τ 和 paired bootstrap 比较排名。论文还检查不同 tie convention 的敏感性，并测试 LLM judges 与不同人群 gold label 的 agreement 差异。
summary.experiments: MultiPref 包含 10,461 个 pairwise comparisons，覆盖 6 个模型，每个 item 有 2 名 crowdworker 和 2 名 screened expert 标注。主分析的 2,885 个 convention-free items 上，expert 与 crowd 的 majority label 有 23.6% 不同，9.2% 直接给出相反 winner；单个 item 上两名专家彼此不一致的比例为 50.1%。MT-Bench human judgments 包含 3,355 个 votes，其中 292 个 item cells 同时有 benchmark authors 和 recruited experts；在 246 个可比 unanimous cells 上，两组 majority label 差异为 30.5%，opposite winner 为 8.5%。尽管 item-level 差异明显，两个 corpus 的 6-model leaderboard 都完全不变，Kendall τ=1.00，0 个模型被换位。LLM judge 实验中，三个 judge 都更接近 crowd majority 而非 expert majority，差距分别约为 6.9、5.2、3.7 个百分点，置信区间均不跨零。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。先看 Setup，弄清楚 MultiPref 与 MT-Bench 的 annotator pool 结构，以及为什么作者优先使用 unanimous subset。再看 item-level divergence 与 leaderboard invariance 的结果表，重点理解 9.2% opposite winner 和 Kendall τ=1.00 同时成立的原因。tie convention 敏感性值得扫一遍，它解释了为什么二人标注池会让聚合规则变得重要。最后看 LLM judge agreement 部分，这对 reward model 评估和 judge 校准更有直接价值。若做偏好数据训练，重点不是排行榜是否变化，而是每条训练样本的 gold label 会随 annotator pool 系统性改变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much the identity of the annotator pool matters in preference benchmarks. Crowdworkers, experts, and benchmark authors can assign different labels to the same item, while small leaderboards may remain unchanged and hide the disagreement.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant to post-training, reward modeling, LLM-as-judge validation, and preference-data quality. It shows that a human-preference gold label is not a single stable target. The annotator pool can materially change item-level supervision, even when aggregate model rankings do not move. This distinction matters for reward-model training, active annotation, and judge calibration more than for a six-model leaderboard.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses preference datasets that preserve annotator-pool identity and compares majority labels assigned to the same items by different pools. To avoid making the main result depend on tie-breaking rules, the primary MultiPref analysis keeps only the 2,885 items where both pools are internally unanimous. A similar unanimous-cell analysis is used for MT-Bench. For leaderboards, the same models are scored once against expert gold and once against crowd or author gold, and rankings are compared with Kendall τ using paired bootstrap resampling. The paper also evaluates sensitivity to tie conventions and measures how several LLM judges align with different human pools.
summary_en.experiments: MultiPref has 10,461 pairwise comparisons over six models, with two crowdworker and two screened-expert annotations per item. On the 2,885 convention-free items, expert and crowd majority labels differ on 23.6%, and name opposite winners on 9.2%. The two experts disagree with each other on 50.1% of items. MT-Bench human judgments contain 3,355 votes; 292 item cells have both benchmark-author and recruited-expert labels. On 246 comparable unanimous cells, the two pools differ on 30.5% of majority labels and reverse the winner on 8.5%. Despite this item-level divergence, both six-model leaderboards are identical under the two gold sources: Kendall τ=1.00 with zero displaced models. In the judge analysis, three LLM judges agree more with the crowd majority than the expert majority, with gaps of about 6.9, 5.2, and 3.7 percentage points, all with confidence intervals excluding zero.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim should cover the main value. Read the setup first to understand the annotator-pool structure in MultiPref and MT-Bench, and why the unanimous subset is used. Then focus on the item-level divergence tables and the leaderboard invariance result; the important point is that a 9.2% winner reversal rate can coexist with Kendall τ=1.00 on a small leaderboard. Skim the tie-convention sensitivity analysis, since it explains why two-annotator pools make aggregation rules consequential. The LLM-judge agreement section is the most directly useful part for reward-model and judge-evaluation work. For preference-data training, the key implication is that per-item supervision can shift systematically with the hired annotator pool even when benchmark rankings appear stable.

recommendation.zh: 排行榜完全一致但 item 级 20-30% 分歧这个反常识结果值得所有做 RLHF/对齐的人警惕，重点看 §3 的 bootstrap 分析和 Fig 2。
recommendation.en: The counterintuitive finding of bit-identical leaderboards despite 20–30% item-level disagreement should alarm everyone working on RLHF/alignment; focus on §3 bootstrap analysis and Fig 2.

paper.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general arti

summary.core_problem: 现有单轮视频理解基准（如Video-MME、VideoMMMU）已接近饱和，前沿模型准确率接近90%，无法有效评估下一代多模态大模型的工具使用、长程推理、多轮交互等智能体能力，缺乏面向通用AI助手的代理式视频理解评测基准。
