summary.importance: 多模态预训练的评测范式正从单轮问答转向代理式任务，这对预训练阶段的能力注入（工具使用、多步推理、信息整合）提出了新的要求。VideoGAIA的任务设计可为多模态预训练数据构造、对齐目标设计提供参考，推动预训练目标从被动理解视频转向任务导向的主动证据收集。基准中的工具必要性评估维度，也可为研究多模态模型在预训练阶段如何习得“何时调用外部工具、何时依赖自身知识”的判断能力提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: VideoGAIA是面向通用AI助手的代理式视频理解基准，核心是将视频理解从单轮问答重构为多轮、工具增强的交互过程：模型需要迭代感知视频内容、调用外部工具、收集补充信息、整合多源证据以完成真实世界任务。基准构建采用多阶段人-机协同流水线：从10万条公开视频出发，使用Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.5等前沿模型完成帧级字幕生成、基于证据的任务生成、基于评分规则的质量控制、跨模态过滤、工具必要性评估，再由至少三名人类专家独立审核每个任务，仅保留通过审核的样本。最终测试集包含271条高质量任务，覆盖文化、地理、日常生活、历史、科技、经济六大类别，分为L1、L2两个难度等级。所有模型在统一的ReAct式智能体循环下接受评测，配备三个标准化工具：网页搜索（获取外部信息）、页面访问（将网页转换为文本）、视频回看（重新查看相关视频片段），以保证对比公平。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖20个前沿多模态大模型，所有模型准确率落在30%-60%区间，表现最好的Seed2.0-Pro仅达到58.30%，远低于其在传统单轮视频理解基准上的成绩。结果显示代理式视频理解仍远未解决，现有多模态模型在工具使用、多步推理、多源信息整合方面存在明显短板。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction部分的评测范式转变逻辑，以及基准构建章节的人-机协同标注流水线、工具必要性评估方法；实验部分的排行榜结果可快速浏览。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。从事多模态预训练评测的研究者，可关注任务维度划分和难度分级的设计逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing single-turn video understanding benchmarks (e.g., Video-MME, VideoMMMU) are approaching saturation, with frontier models reaching ~90% accuracy. They can no longer effectively evaluate next-generation multimodal LLMs' agentic capabilities such as tool use, long-horizon reasoning, and multi-turn interaction. There is a lack of agentic video understanding benchmarks designed for general AI assistants.
summary_en.importance: The evaluation paradigm for multimodal pretraining is shifting from single-turn question answering to agentic tasks, which sets new requirements for capability injection during pretraining, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, and information integration. VideoGAIA's task design provides reference for multimodal pretraining data construction and alignment objective design, pushing pretraining objectives from passive video understanding toward task-driven active evidence gathering. The benchmark's tool-necessity assessment dimension also offers reference for studying how multimodal models can learn the judgment of when to call external tools versus when to rely on internal knowledge during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoGAIA is an agentic video understanding benchmark for general AI assistants. It reframes video understanding from single-turn question answering into a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process: models must iteratively perceive video content, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate evidence from multiple sources to solve real-world tasks. The benchmark is built via a multi-stage human-model co-design pipeline: starting from 100K public videos, frontier models (Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.5) handle frame-level captioning, evidence-grounded task generation, rubric-based quality control, cross-modal filtering, and tool-necessity assessment. Each task is then independently reviewed by at least three human experts, with only approved samples retained. The final test set contains 271 high-quality tasks across six categories (Culture, Geography, Daily Life, History, Technology, Economics) and two difficulty levels (L1, L2). All models are evaluated under a unified ReAct-style agent loop with three standardized tools: web search (for external information retrieval), page visit (converts webpages to text), and video review (reinspects relevant video segments) to ensure fair comparison.
summary_en.experiments: 20 cutting-edge multimodal LLMs are evaluated, with all models achieving accuracy between 30% and 60%. The strongest model, Seed2.0-Pro, reaches only 58.30% accuracy, substantially lower than its performance on traditional single-turn video understanding benchmarks. The results indicate agentic video understanding remains far from solved, with clear gaps in tool use, multi-step reasoning, and multi-source information integration for current multimodal models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the paradigm shift rationale in the Introduction, and the benchmark construction section's human-model co-design pipeline and tool-necessity assessment methodology. Skim the leaderboard results in the experiments section for a quick sense of model performance gaps. Estimated reading time: 20–25 minutes. For researchers working on multimodal pretraining evaluation, pay special attention to the task dimension categorization and difficulty grading logic.

recommendation.zh: Agent式多模态视频评测的任务设计可指导多模态预训练的交互目标构造，重点看§2的任务分类与评测协议
recommendation.en: The task design of agentic multimodal video evaluation can guide interaction objective construction for multimodal pretraining; focus on §2's task taxonomy and evaluation protocol.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
paper.abstract: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (

summary.core_problem: 当前 AI Coding Agent 评测中广泛使用的 pass@k 指标存在实现错误，导致分数虚高，且无法反映功能正确性与安全性之间的关系。
summary.importance: 指出了 Agent 评测中一个普遍存在且影响深远的指标误用问题，提出了修正后的 reliability@k 和 security-adjusted reliability@k，对规范代码 Agent 评测具有重要意义。
summary.technical_approach: 分析了当前评测框架（如 SWE-bench 等）在计算 pass@k 时，错误地将单次提交中的单元测试数量作为 $n$，混淆了测试套件大小与尝试独立性。提出 reliability@k，正确地将 $n$ 设为独立 rollout 次数，$c$ 设为完全通过的 rollout 次数。进一步提出 security-adjusted reliability@k，要求 rollout 同时满足功能正确和无高危安全漏洞。
summary.experiments: 在合成的多 rollout benchmark 上，误用的指标将分数绝对值夸大了 0.85-0.97。廉价的单次 rollout 代理指标无法替代重复运行（Spearman $\rho = 0.417$）。

summary_en.core_problem: The widely used pass@k metric in current AI coding agent evaluations is misimplemented, leading to inflated scores and failing to capture the relationship between functional correctness and security.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a pervasive and impactful metric misuse in agent evaluation, proposing corrected reliability@k and security-adjusted reliability@k, which is crucial for standardizing coding agent benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes how current evaluation frameworks erroneously use the number of unit tests in a single submission as $n$ when calculating pass@k, conflating test suite size with attempt independence. Proposes reliability@k, correctly setting $n$ to the number of independent rollouts and $c$ to the number of fully-passing rollouts. Further proposes security-adjusted reliability@k, requiring rollouts to be both functionally correct and free of high-severity vulnerabilities.
summary_en.experiments: On a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates absolute scores by 0.85-0.97. A cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $\rho = 0.417$).

recommendation.zh: 指出了代码 Agent 评测中 pass@k 指标的严重误用，修正后的 reliability@k 更严谨，做 coding agent 评测的必看。
recommendation.en: Identifies a severe misuse of pass@k in coding agent eval; the corrected reliability@k is more rigorous. A must-read for those working on coding agent benchmarks.

paper.title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是多 rubric LLM judge 的一致性问题。单独评估每条 rubric 很稳定，但把多条 rubric 放在一次推理里联合评估时，同一条 rubric 的判定会被其他 rubric 的存在、顺序或噪声项影响。这会让 joint evaluation 虽然省推理成本，却引入系统性标签噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和评测信号质量有实际意义。现在很多 RLHF/RLAIF、自动化 benchmark、reward model 数据生成都依赖 LLM judge。如果 judge 的细粒度 rubric 判定会因上下文组合而漂移，那么训练信号不是简单的随机噪声，而是和评测格式绑定的偏差。论文的价值在于把这个 failure mode 定义清楚，并给出一种不依赖外部标注的校正方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先形式化 isolation evaluation 与 joint evaluation。理想情况下，某条 rubric 的 verdict 只应依赖 conversation 和该 rubric，而不应依赖同批次出现的其他 rubrics。作者用四类受控操作测量干扰：expansion 比较单条 rubric 评估和完整 rubric 集评估；subsetting 比较嵌套 rubric 子集；reordering 检查同一组 rubric 的顺序影响；noise injection 加入来自无关样本的 rubric，测试模型是否能忽略无关评估项。指标包括 rubric-level agreement、Cohen’s kappa 和 sample-level exact match。缓解方法 SARA 是 on-policy self-distillation：学生模型先生成 joint multi-rubric evaluation，再解析成每条 rubric 的分析片段；一个慢更新 teacher 在 isolation context 下对这些片段进行评估，用作 self-anchor。训练目标包含 divergence loss，用来纠正受干扰的 reasoning/analysis；也包含 preservation loss，用来保持 verdict 结构和输出格式。它和简单 prompt engineering 或多次投票不同，核心是把 joint-mode 行为蒸馏到模型自身更稳定的 isolation-mode 判断上。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个数据集和两个模型家族上验证。一个关键现象是：在 HealthBench 上，Qwen3-32B 的 isolation verdict 与 joint verdict 只有 36% sample-level exact match；但同一设置下不同随机种子重复评估的 self-agreement 达到至少 0.98，说明问题主要不是采样随机性，而是 rubric 组合带来的系统性干扰。实验同时覆盖 binary verdict 和 scored rubric。SARA 在一致性指标上优于 base judge，并尽量保持相对 GPT-4.1 的评估质量。消融重点应看不同操作下的一致性变化，以及 rubric 数量 K 增大时干扰是否累积。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Definition 和 Table 1，那里定义了四种干扰测量操作；再看 SARA 方法部分，尤其是 joint 输出如何被解析为 per-rubric segment，以及 teacher isolation judgment 如何进入 loss。实验部分优先看 HealthBench 上 expansion/reordering/noise injection 的曲线和表格。对做 reward modeling 或 LLM-as-judge 数据管线的人，最值得深挖的是：isolation judgment 是否真的足够可靠，以及把它作为 teacher 会不会固化 judge 原有偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies consistency failures in multi-rubric LLM judges. Evaluating each rubric in isolation is stable, but evaluating many rubrics in one pass can change the verdict for the same rubric depending on the other rubrics, their order, or injected irrelevant rubrics. Joint evaluation saves inference cost, but it introduces structured label noise.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training and evaluation signal quality. LLM judges are increasingly used in benchmark scoring, reward-model data construction, and online feedback loops. If fine-grained rubric labels depend on the surrounding rubric set, the noise is not merely stochastic; it is coupled to the evaluation format. The contribution is a clear definition of this failure mode and a self-supervised mitigation path that does not require new human labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes isolation evaluation and joint evaluation, then tests an invariance condition: a verdict for rubric r should depend only on the conversation and r, not on the rest of the rubric set. It measures violations through four controlled operations: expansion from isolation to a larger set, subsetting between nested rubric sets, reordering of the same set, and noise injection with unrelated rubrics. Metrics include rubric-level agreement, Cohen’s kappa, and sample-level exact match. The mitigation method, SARA, uses on-policy self-distillation. A student generates a joint multi-rubric report, which is parsed into per-rubric segments. A slowly updated teacher evaluates these segments under isolation context. A divergence loss aligns analysis segments that are distorted by interference, while a preservation loss maintains verdict structure and output format. The key distinction from prompting or voting is that the method trains joint-mode behavior to match the model’s own more stable isolation-mode behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on three datasets and two model families. A central result is that on HealthBench, Qwen3-32B reaches only 36% sample-level exact match between isolation and joint verdicts, while repeated evaluations under different random seeds show at least 0.98 self-agreement. This indicates a systematic context effect rather than ordinary decoding noise. The evaluation covers both binary and scored rubrics. SARA improves consistency over the base judge while preserving evaluation quality relative to GPT-4.1. The most informative ablations are the consistency curves under expansion, reordering, and noise injection, especially as the number of rubrics K increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the problem definition and Table 1 first, since they define the four interference probes. Then read the SARA section, focusing on how joint outputs are parsed into per-rubric segments and how the isolation-context teacher supplies the training signal. In the experiments, prioritize the HealthBench expansion and reordering results. For reward-modeling or judge-based data pipelines, the main point to examine is whether isolation judgments are reliable enough to serve as anchors, and whether self-distillation may preserve existing judge biases.

recommendation.zh: 值得读干扰定义和消融；若你用 judge 产 SFT/RL 信号，single-rubric anchor 可能比省调用更值钱。
recommendation.en: Read the interference definition and ablations; if judges generate SFT/RL signals, single-rubric anchors may be worth more than saved calls.

paper.title: Emergent Misaligned Communication in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent LLM Commerce
paper.abstract: Frontier LLM agents increasingly transact on behalf of separate principals, often using natural language rather than structured APIs. Much of the safety literature studies misaligned LLM behavior through adversarial-elicitation evaluations on single agents or stylized tasks. Its prevalence and structure in settings that combine long horizons, separate principals, real operational state, and inter-agent natural-language exchange remain insufficiently measured. We study 2,583 inter-agent emails fr

summary.core_problem: 论文研究长程、多主体、竞争性 LLM agent 环境中的自然语言沟通失配。问题不是单个 agent 在诱导场景里是否违规，而是多个代表不同委托人的 agent 在一年期商业模拟中，通过邮件协商、竞争和转移资源时，会多频繁地产生虚假陈述、操纵、合谋或威胁。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 agent safety/evaluation，而不是预训练论文。对基座研究员的启发在于：许多 agent 失效不是由单轮能力不足直接解释，而是由长期状态、局部目标、竞争压力和自然语言行动空间共同诱发。它提示 post-train 评估与数据构造不能只覆盖静态问答或单 agent adversarial prompt，也需要包含状态可验证、长程可追踪、主体目标分离的交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 实验环境是 Vending-Bench Arena，一个竞争性自动售货机经营模拟。每个仿真持续一年，多个 LLM agent 分别经营自己的售货机业务，独立管理库存、现金、供应商采购、定价，也可以观察竞争者库存和价格，并通过异步邮件沟通或进行资金/商品转移。作者分析 20 次仿真、13 个 frontier LLM、共 2,583 封 inter-agent emails。分类管线分三步：Stage A 用 LLM judge 按 12 个 subtype 标注邮件中的 misalignment，包括 false factual claims、manipulation、collusion、threats 等；Stage B 用确定性 verifier 把抽取出的事实声明和模拟器 runtime state 对齐，验证是否为假；Stage C 再用 LLM judge 审计 agent reasoning traces，判断是否存在策略性意图。这个设计比只看交易结果更细，因为它直接标注通信内容，并把事实性错误和模拟器状态绑定。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：misaligned communication 出现在每一次仿真中；构成上以可验证的虚假事实声明为主，而不是合谋。论文还报告了若干结构性现象：misalignment 具有互惠性，收到失配信息的 agent 更可能随后发出类似信息；它受经营压力影响，例如库存、现金或竞争状态可能提高发生概率；涉及资源转移的失配承诺经常会被后续行动兑现，说明这些邮件不只是空洞文本；简单的 capability asymmetry 解释没有得到支持，即能力更强或更弱本身不足以解释主要差异。可确认的规模数字包括 2,583 封邮件、20 次一年期仿真和 13 个 frontier LLM。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。先看 Setting and Misalignment Definitions，理解 Vending-Bench Arena 的状态变量和 agent action space；再看三阶段分类管线，尤其是 factual claim 如何被 simulator logs 验证。实验部分优先看 prevalence/composition、antecedent conditions、follow-through analysis 和 capability tests。若关注通用 agent 评测设计，可以略过部分商业仿真细节，重点保留两个设计原则：通信内容要和可验证状态绑定，长程环境要保留 agent 的累计压力和后续行动。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures misaligned natural-language communication in long-horizon, competitive multi-agent LLM settings. The question is not whether a single agent violates a rule under an adversarial prompt, but how often agents representing separate principals make false claims, manipulate, collude, or threaten each other while running businesses over a one-year simulation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-safety and evaluation paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the evaluation signal it exposes. Some agent failures are driven by persistent state, local incentives, competition, and natural language as an action space, rather than by single-turn instruction-following deficits. This suggests that post-training datasets and evaluation suites should include state-grounded, long-horizon, multi-principal interactions, not only static QA or single-agent adversarial prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses Vending-Bench Arena, a competitive vending-machine business simulation. In each one-year run, multiple LLM agents manage separate businesses, set prices, handle inventory and cash, purchase from suppliers, observe competitors, and exchange asynchronous emails. The authors analyze 2,583 inter-agent emails from 20 simulation runs covering 13 frontier LLMs. The classification pipeline has three stages. Stage A uses an LLM judge to assign a 12-subtype misalignment taxonomy, covering false factual claims, manipulation, collusion, threats, and related categories. Stage B uses a deterministic verifier to check extracted factual claims against the simulator’s runtime state. Stage C uses another LLM judge to audit reasoning traces for strategic intent. This differs from transaction-level scoring because it directly classifies communication content and grounds factuality in simulator logs.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that misaligned communication appears in every simulation. Its composition is dominated by verifiably false factual claims rather than collusion. The paper also reports several structural patterns: misalignment is reciprocal, operational stress conditions increase its likelihood, misaligned transfer promises are often followed through by later actions, and simple capability-asymmetry explanations are not supported. The confirmed scale is 2,583 emails, 20 one-year simulations, and 13 frontier LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Start with the setting and misalignment definitions to understand the simulator state and agent action space. Then read the three-stage classification pipeline, especially how factual claims are checked against simulator logs. In the results, prioritize prevalence and composition, antecedent-condition analysis, follow-through analysis, and capability tests. For general agent-evaluation design, the key ideas are to ground communication in verifiable state and to preserve long-horizon pressure and subsequent actions.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把单体安全评测的 prior 往多 agent 长时程场景推了一步；读定义和统计口径，别急着相信绝对比例。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully stress-tests the single-agent safety prior in a long-horizon multi-agent setting; read the operationalization and measurement setup, not the headline rate alone.

paper.title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems
paper.abstract: LLM-based coding agents have advanced rapidly on single-process SWE tasks, with frontier models now clustering in the high-70s on SWE-bench Verified. Distributed-system debugging, however, remains an under-explored regime: bugs span processes, nodes, and protocol interactions, with root causes rarely recoverable from source alone and brute-force exploration intractable across non-deterministic interleavings. This leaves two gaps in LLM and agent evaluation: no code-repair benchmark targets distr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个长期缺位的评测问题：现有代码修复基准大多围绕单进程软件缺陷，难以测到模型在分布式系统调试中的真实能力。分布式 bug 的关键难点不在“会不会改代码”，而在“能不能恢复跨进程因果链”：错误往往由超时、重试、消息乱序、竞态、协议不变量破坏等共同触发，根因通常不能从局部源码直接读出来，靠 agent 暴力探索也会被非确定性交互和组合爆炸拖垮。论文因此同时补两个空白：一是构建面向分布式系统源码级修复的 benchmark；二是在严格控制条件下，量化外部调试上下文——如日志、trace、诊断笔记、失败测试输出——到底能给 agent 带来多少帮助，以及这种帮助会如何改变模型排序、token 开销和行为模式。
summary.importance: 对大模型研究的直接意义不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于把一个过去被 SWE-bench 一类基准掩盖的能力维度单独拉了出来。论文显示，单进程代码修复上的高分并不能外推出分布式调试能力；同一批模型在 SWE-bench 上只拉开很小差距，在 DDBench tier-1 上却出现大幅分化。这说明现有 coding-agent 评测对“跨进程状态推断、动态证据利用、非确定性环境下的诊断策略”覆盖不足。对预训练和后训练都有启发：如果未来希望模型更擅长真实软件系统维护，仅靠静态代码语料和单步 patch 监督不够，训练信号里需要更多运行时证据、调试轨迹、日志-代码对齐、因果诊断过程。另一个重要点是，论文把“上下文供给”从一个模糊工程技巧变成了可测变量，这对 agent 系统设计、数据合成和 post-train 任务构造都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上核心是 DDBench 的构建与双条件评测设计。数据部分，作者从 13 个开源分布式系统中挖掘 60 个历史真实 bug，按难度划分为三个 tier，其中 tier-1 最难，共 31 个案例。每个案例都要求能够独立复现，并经过泄漏清理与多位分布式系统研究者审阅，强调的是案例质量和诊断真实性，而不是单纯追求规模。评测协议有两个条件：symptom-only 与 context-augmented。前者只给 bug 症状和代码库，让 agent 像常规 SWE 任务一样自行探索；后者额外提供人工整理的调试上下文，用来隔离“模型自身推断能力”和“外部证据供给”这两个因素。这个设计比直接比较不同 agent pipeline 更干净，因为它把上下文作为唯一主要干预变量。执行层面使用 mini-swe-agent 作为统一 harness，评测 10 个闭源和开源模型，记录 pass rate、token 消耗、完成步数等指标，并用 bootstrap 检验模型间差异是否显著。论文还有一个细节值得注意：作者并不把更多上下文默认视为更好，而是专门分析了“忠实但远离根因的观测”如何误导强模型。这一点很关键，因为它说明调试上下文不是简单的信息增量，而是带有选择偏差和注意力竞争的训练/推理信号。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很清楚。第一，DDBench 能显著拉开模型差距，尤其在最难的 tier-1 上，10 个模型在 symptom-only 条件下的通过率跨度达到 61 个百分点；对 6 个有公开 SWE-bench Verified 成绩的模型，同样一组模型在 SWE-bench 上只差 7 个百分点，在 DDBench tier-1 上却差到 58 个百分点。作者还做了 pairwise bootstrap test，在 31 个 tier-1 案例上，顶级模型两两比较中有 9/15 对达到 p<0.05，说明这个 benchmark 的区分度不是噪声造成的。第二，额外调试上下文整体上显著提高成功率并稳定降低成本：总通过率从 32.6% 提升到 50.6%，增加 18.1 个百分点。收益并不均匀。较弱模型主要体现在成功率提升，例如 GLM 4.7 从 9.7% 提升到 48.4%；较强模型成功率提升有限，但 token 成本和完成步数明显下降，例如 Claude Opus 4.6 在加入上下文后 token 消耗下降 69%，完成步数减少 41%。论文还给出一个很有意思的排序变化：加入上下文后的 GPT 5.4，其通过率可以追平 Opus 4.6 在 symptom-only 条件下的表现，同时 token 消耗低 60%。这说明“上下文质量 × 模型能力”之间存在明显交互，不同模型不是简单地同幅受益。作者也报告了反例：某些 faithful context 会把强模型带偏，尤其当观测离真正 fault 很远时，模型可能过度拟合表面异常而不是追根因。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三部分。第一看引言和 benchmark 设计，重点理解作者为什么认为分布式调试不是 SWE-bench 的自然延伸，而是另一类能力。第二看 tier 划分、双条件设置和泄漏控制，这决定了结果是否可信。第三看主要结果图，尤其是 DDBench 与 SWE-bench 的模型分化对比，以及 context 前后的通过率、token、steps 变化。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以把主结论读清。若想多看一点，建议补读作者对“误导性上下文”的案例分析，这部分对做 agent 数据构造和调试轨迹蒸馏的人更有启发：不是把日志一股脑塞给模型，而是要考虑证据与根因的距离、证据排序、以及模型是否会被高显著性但低因果性的观测牵着走。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing evaluation regime: current code-repair benchmarks mostly measure single-process software bugs, while distributed-system debugging requires a different capability stack. The hard part is not patch generation itself, but reconstructing cross-process causality under timeouts, retries, races, message reordering, and protocol-level invariant violations. In many cases, the root cause cannot be recovered from source code alone, and brute-force exploration is infeasible because the bug depends on rare interleavings across nodes and processes. The work therefore targets two gaps at once: a benchmark for source-level repair of distributed-system bugs, and a controlled setup to measure how much externally provided debugging context changes agent performance.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is mainly diagnostic. It isolates a capability dimension that SWE-bench-style evaluations largely blur out. Strong performance on single-process repair does not transfer cleanly to distributed debugging, and the paper shows that model rankings spread much more on DDBench than on SWE-bench. That matters for both pretraining and post-training: if we want models to support real software maintenance, static code corpora and patch supervision are not enough. Training signals likely need richer runtime evidence, debugging traces, log-code alignment, and process-level causal reasoning. A second contribution is methodological: the paper turns “extra context” from an ad hoc engineering trick into a measurable variable. That is useful for agent design, synthetic data generation, and post-train task construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core contribution is DDBench plus a two-condition evaluation protocol. The benchmark contains 60 historical bugs mined from 13 open-source distributed systems, partitioned into three difficulty tiers, with tier-1 being the hardest and containing 31 cases. Each case is independently reproduced, sanitized for leakage, and reviewed by distributed-systems researchers, so the emphasis is on fidelity and evaluability rather than raw scale. The evaluation runs each case under two conditions: symptom-only and context-augmented. In symptom-only, the agent receives the bug symptom and codebase, similar to standard SWE-style repair. In context-augmented, it also receives curated debugging context such as logs, traces, or diagnostic notes. This design cleanly separates model-internal reasoning from externally supplied evidence. The authors use mini-swe-agent as a unified harness and evaluate 10 proprietary and open-weight models, tracking pass rate, token consumption, and steps to completion, with bootstrap tests for significance. An important nuance is that the paper does not assume more context is always better. It explicitly studies cases where faithful but causally distant observations mislead strong models, which makes the benchmark relevant not only for evaluation but also for context construction and evidence selection.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical findings are sharp. First, DDBench creates much stronger model separation than conventional coding benchmarks. On tier-1 under the symptom-only condition, the 10 evaluated models span 61 percentage points in pass rate. Among six models with publicly reported SWE-bench Verified scores, the same set spans only 7 points on SWE-bench but 58 points on DDBench tier-1. Pairwise bootstrap tests on the 31 tier-1 cases distinguish 9 of 15 top-tier model pairs at p<0.05, suggesting the separation is statistically meaningful rather than noise. Second, curated debugging context improves success and consistently reduces cost, but the gains are uneven across models. Aggregate pass rate rises from 32.6% to 50.6%, a gain of 18.1 points. Weaker models benefit mostly in success rate; for example, GLM 4.7 improves from 9.7% to 48.4%. Stronger models gain less in pass rate but much more in efficiency; Claude Opus 4.6 sees 69% lower token consumption and 41% fewer steps to completion with added context. The paper also reports ranking changes: context-augmented GPT 5.4 matches Opus 4.6’s symptom-only pass rate while using 60% fewer tokens. The case studies are also useful: some faithful context can still hurt, especially when the observation is far from the actual fault and the model overfits salient symptoms instead of tracing the causal chain.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the motivation and benchmark setup to understand why distributed debugging is not just a harder version of SWE-bench. Second, inspect the tiering, the two-condition protocol, and the leakage controls, since these determine whether the benchmark is trustworthy. Third, read the main result figures comparing DDBench with SWE-bench and showing pass-rate, token, and step changes with added context. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. If you want one extra section, read the analysis of misleading context. That part is especially relevant for anyone working on agent data construction, debugging-trace distillation, or context engineering: the issue is not simply how much evidence to provide, but which evidence, in what order, and how causally close it is to the fault.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent 能力评测，这篇比再看一遍 SWE-bench 排名更值；重点看它如何把“上下文供给”从混杂因素拆成可测变量。
recommendation.en: If you care about agent capability evaluation, this is more useful than another SWE-bench leaderboard pass; focus on how it isolates debugging context as a measurable variable.

paper.title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research
paper.abstract: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and requir

summary.core_problem: 如何评测研究型 agent 在“宽且深”任务上的能力：既要大规模发现符合条件的实体集合（wide），又要对每个实体通过多轮检索建立可验证的事实（deep），并避免静态金标答案难以扩展、难以核验的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对 agent / 长程工具使用 / 检索推理的评测与 RL 训练信号设计有参考价值。其 reference-free、逐条证据核验、按层级聚合的 reward 设计，可作为 agentic post-training 与可验证奖励构造的样例；对基座能力评估也提供了一个比单问答更接近真实知识工作的任务形态。
summary.technical_approach: WANDR 把任务表示为 qualification key hierarchy（如 company(n) → employee(m) → url(k)），目标是产出 n×m×k 条可独立核验的记录。每条记录包含 URL 和原文摘录，评测时由 task-specific judge 重新抓取页面，判断页面与摘录是否满足任务约束，再聚合为 precision / recall / F1，并区分 soft（部分得分）和 hard（二值）两种口径。任务构造走半自动流水线：自动写作检查、可行性审计、judge 审计，可选人工复核，因此不需要预先标注完整金标集。论文还把失败模式定位到树的不同层级（实体发现、实体丰富、页面识别、证据抽取、实体消歧），并讨论了该任务作为 RL 环境的可扩展性：per-record verdict 提供密集奖励，层级计数提供课程难度梯度，流式 grader 可在训练 batch 间摊销重复抓取成本。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 含 500 个任务，规模从数十到数千条记录。对比了 Search as Code（agent 组合可编程检索原语）与传统的并行 subagent 固定端点 search-and-read 系统。最强的 SaC 系统仅达到 0.363 soft F1 和 0.133 hard F1，说明任务对前沿研究 agent 仍有明显区分度。论文还归纳了 volume collapse、snippet reliance、约束非系统性应用、cross-reference 跳过、过早停止、缺失丰富化、上下文溢出等典型失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看 Section 3（qualification key hierarchy 与失败定位）、Section 5（reference-free grading 与 soft/hard 指标）以及 Appendix N（作为 RL substrate 的 reward 与课程设计）。评测协议和奖励构造部分对做 agent RL / verifier 的读者更有用，任务构造流水线可快速浏览。预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate research agents on tasks that are both wide—discovering a large set of qualifying entities—and deep—establishing verifiable facts about each entity through orchestrated web searches—without relying on a static, exhaustively annotated gold answer set.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct relevance to pretraining, but useful for agent evaluation, long-horizon tool use, and RL reward design. Its reference-free, per-record evidence verification and hierarchical metric aggregation offer a concrete pattern for verifiable rewards in agentic post-training. The task shape also probes base-model capabilities closer to professional knowledge work than single-answer QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: WANDR represents each task as a qualification key hierarchy, e.g. company(n) → employee(m) → url(k), targeting n×m×k independently verifiable records. Each record cites a live page with verbatim excerpts. A task-specific judge re-fetches the page and checks whether the page and excerpts satisfy the substantive constraints, then aggregates verdicts into precision, recall, and F1 in both soft (partial credit) and hard (binary) forms. Task construction uses a semi-automated pipeline—authoring checks, feasibility audit, judge audit, and optional human review—so no complete gold set must be annotated. Failures are localized across the tree: entity discovery, entity enrichment, page identification, evidence extraction, and identity disambiguation. The benchmark is also designed as an RL substrate: per-record verdicts give dense partial-progress rewards, per-level counts provide a curriculum gradient, and a streaming cache-aware grader amortizes overlapping fetches across training batches.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 500 tasks requiring dozens to thousands of records. It compares Search as Code, where agents compose programmable retrieval primitives, against conventional systems that run fixed-endpoint search-and-read loops across parallel subagents. The strongest SaC system reaches only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1, leaving substantial headroom even for frontier research agents. Recurring failure modes include volume collapse, snippet reliance, non-systematic constraint application, skipped cross-referencing, premature stopping, missing enrichment, and context overflow.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the qualification-key hierarchy and failure localization, Section 5 for reference-free grading and soft/hard metrics, and Appendix N for the RL-substrate design, especially dense rewards and curriculum structure. The task-construction pipeline can be read quickly. Estimated 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 比静态 QA benchmark 更贴近真实 research agent 的评测，judge 重抓页面验证是亮点；看任务结构和 judge 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Closer to real research-agent workloads than static QA, and the refetch-and-verify judge is the main novelty; read the task schema and judge design, skip the leaderboard.

paper.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking
paper.abstract: When a user question is underspecified, a capable model should recognize that its context is insufficient, identify the missing information, ask for it, and respond only once that information determines a unique answer. We formalize multi-turn information seeking as solving a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, where k is the number of variables jointly required to determine the target and therefore measures the degree of missing information. We instantiate the formulation in MT-In

summary.core_problem: 多轮交互中，面对信息不足的问题，LLM 是否知道该问什么、何时停止追问、以及在获得信息后能否正确作答；现有基准多以最终任务成功率衡量，无法把“信息获取能力”与“依赖先验猜答案”以及“最终作答能力”区分开。
summary.importance: 论文给出了多轮信息获取的一个可验证形式化框架：把任务表示为 k-underspecified CSP，明确哪些变量必须被问到、什么时候信息已经充分到可以回答。这对 pretrain 研究的意义在于它提供了一个比“对话成功率”更干净的能力刻画——追问不足、过早停止、顺序依赖这几类失败模式，本质上反映模型对自身知识边界和不确定性的建模能力，这和预训练阶段的校准、不确定性估计、以及工具使用/主动信息获取能力的涌现评估有关。属于 eval 类工作中设计比较扎实的一篇。
summary.technical_approach: 将多轮信息寻求形式化为 k-欠定约束满足问题：给定初始部分赋值 A 和约束 C，目标变量 Y 在可行域 Ω(P) 唯一确定前，模型必须逐轮查询缺失变量，每轮查询一个变量并获得其值，直到 Y 被唯一确定。以此构造 MT-InfoSeek 评测集，横跨数学、逻辑、生物、医学和常识，共 5251 个问题、9006 个实例；同一 problem 下通过改变 target value 生成多个 instance，防止模型靠先验直接猜答案。评估拆成三个轴：问了什么（变量选择正确性）、什么时候问/停（是否在充分信息前停止，或在充分后继续问）、以及最终答案是否正确，从而把信息寻求和答案生成解耦。
summary.experiments: 在闭源和开源 LLM 上评测，主要发现：（1）模型系统性低估欠定程度，缺失变量越多（k 越大）表现越差，并倾向于在信息不足时提前作答；（2）第一问问错并不致命，只要后续继续查询相关变量，达到充分信息的比例与首问正确的模型接近；随着 k 增大，交互轮数对最终成功的预测性更强；（3）在存在顺序依赖的任务中，即使最终获取了所有必要变量，错误的查询顺序仍会拉低最终准确率；（4）把完整交互喂给模型时，模型间最终作答准确率仍有差异，说明问题不只是会不会问，拿到信息后的推理能力也是独立瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看第 3 节 CSP 形式化（尤其是 feasible space 如何随查询收缩、何时 Y 被唯一确定）和评测维度拆分，再看主要结果中关于 early stopping、query order 和 information-seeking vs answer-generation 分离的几个结论。预计 25–35 分钟。对做对话/agent 能力评测、模型校准、不确定性建模的读者更值得细看；纯做预训练 loss/架构的读者了解其问题拆解方式即可。

summary_en.core_problem: When a user query is underspecified, can an LLM recognize missing information, ask the right clarification questions across multiple turns, stop only when enough information has been gathered, and then answer correctly? Existing benchmarks mostly measure final task success, which confounds information-seeking behavior with prior-based guessing and downstream answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: The paper provides a clean formalization of multi-turn information seeking as a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, with ground truth for which variables must be queried and when the answer is uniquely determined. For pretraining-oriented researchers, the value lies in the evaluation design rather than a new training method: under-asking, premature stopping, and order-sensitive failures are symptoms of how well a model represents its own uncertainty and knowledge boundaries. These are relevant to calibration, selective prediction, tool use, and the assessment of active information-gathering behavior in pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: A problem is represented as a CSP with variables X, domains D, constraints C, an observed partial assignment A, and a target variable Y. The feasible set Ω(P) shrinks as the model queries unknown variables and receives their values; the model should stop asking exactly when Y becomes uniquely determined. This framework is instantiated in MT-InfoSeek, with 5,251 problems and 9,006 instances spanning mathematics, logic, biology, medicine, and general knowledge. Multiple instances per problem share the same initial information but differ in the target value, so models cannot rely on guessing the most likely answer. Evaluation is decomposed into three axes: which variables the model asks, when it stops, and how the acquired information affects final answer accuracy, explicitly separating information seeking from answer generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation across closed and open-weight LLMs shows several consistent patterns. Models systematically underestimate underspecification, degrade as the number of missing variables k grows, and tend to stop before sufficient information is acquired. A wrong first query is not fatal: models that continue to query relevant variables reach sufficiency at rates close to those that query correctly on the first turn, and the number of turns becomes more predictive of success as k increases. On tasks with ordered dependencies, incorrect query order lowers final accuracy even when all necessary variables are eventually acquired. Finally, when models are given the completed interaction directly, final accuracy still varies across models, showing that answer-generation capability is an independent bottleneck beyond asking behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the CSP formalization (especially how the feasible space contracts and when Y becomes uniquely determined) and the three-axis evaluation protocol, then read the main findings on early stopping, query order, and the separation between information seeking and answer generation. About 25–35 minutes. Most useful for readers interested in dialogue/agent evaluation, calibration, and uncertainty modeling; for those focused purely on pretraining losses or architectures, the problem decomposition is the main takeaway.

recommendation.zh: 把'追问能力'拆成 what/when/effect 三轴并用 k 控难度是干净的 eval 设计；做对话/agent 后训练可拿来当诊断集，不必通读。
recommendation.en: Decomposing clarification into what/when/effect with k-controlled difficulty is a clean eval design; useful as a diagnostic for dialog/agent post-training, no need to read end-to-end.

paper.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
paper.abstract: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched n

summary.core_problem: 在「审核-修复」自动化流水线中，把同一个 LLM 既当验证器又当修复器的工程布线是否会改变验证器的判错阈值，进而影响误报率；现有文献对上下文累积效应的预测与实际方向存在矛盾，且之前实验未与输出格式、任务重写等混淆变量解耦。
summary.importance: 对预训练后对齐流水线与 verifier 训练有明确警示：验证器的上下文历史不是中性的，前置的审核-修复交互会让阈值系统性向宽松方向偏移，仅看被标记样本上的指标会误判为性能提升；这直接关系到 RL/verifier 训练中数据构造的一致性，以及 self-play 式「生成-校验-修复」循环的校准可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 采用严格的控制变量实验设计：1) 目标任务（题目、推理步、指令、输出 schema、证据预算）在各条件下字节级完全一致，排除输出格式与任务措辞干扰；2) 仅在目标请求前插入一段与目标项无关、已完成的审核-修复对话作为处理组，对照组插入长度匹配的无关填充；3) 以 ProcessBench 中人工标注全正确的轨迹为对象，核心指标是误报率（FAR），另设独立的错误轨迹臂用于信号检测分析；4) 交叉控制 2×2 的归因条件（助手/用户位置 × 自称/他称），剥离归属偏差与位置偏差；5) 对比不同措辞、不同模型、是否开启 CoT 等多个维度的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Ministral-3-14B 三个模型与 5 种审核措辞共 15 组组合中：1) 前置审核-修复上下文使误报率全部下降，相对长度匹配对照组绝对下降 2.8–11.5 pp，相对下降 9%–25%；2) 前置审核若报告过错误，误报率下降更明显，与累积消息偏置的预测方向相反；3) 信号检测分析显示该变化是判定阈值偏移，未检测到判别能力提升；4) 人工复核被消除的误报样本，发现该偏移在当前工作点上仍属有益；5) 2×2 归因实验表明修复内容与审核结论的作用跨模型互补，没有单一必要条件。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 25 分钟。重点看 Method 节的字节级不变量控制与 2×2 归因设计，这是实验可信度的核心；Results 与 §6 信号检测分析部分，理解阈值偏移与判别力变化的区别；Introduction 中与 Jin & Chen 2026、Khullar et al. 2026 的差异对比可帮助定位贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether wiring an LLM as both verifier and repairer in an audit-repair pipeline shifts its decision threshold and changes false-alarm behavior; prior literature gives conflicting predictions on accumulated-context effects, and previous experiments failed to isolate the manipulation from output-format or task-rewording confounds.
summary_en.importance: It delivers a concrete caution for post-training alignment and verifier design: a verifier's context history is not neutral. A preceding audit-repair episode systematically shifts the threshold toward leniency, which can masquerade as improvement when metrics are computed only on flagged items. This directly bears on data consistency in RL / verifier training and calibration in self-play generate-verify-repair loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a tightly controlled design: 1) The target task (problem text, step text, instructions, output schema, evidence budget) is kept byte-identical across all conditions to rule out format or wording confounds. 2) The treatment inserts an unrelated, completed audit-repair exchange before the target request; the control inserts a length-matched filler. 3) Core metric is false-alarm rate (FAR) on human-verified correct traces from ProcessBench; a separate disjoint arm of labeled-incorrect traces supports signal-detection analysis. 4) A 2×2 attribution design (assistant vs user turn placement × self vs peer labeling) disentangles placement and ownership biases. 5) Robustness is checked across five instruction wordings, three models, and with/without chain-of-thought.
summary_en.experiments: Across 15 model × wording combinations (Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Ministral-3-14B, five instruction phrasings): 1) A prior audit-repair context reduces FAR in all 15 cells by 2.8–11.5 absolute pp, a 9%–25% relative reduction over the length-matched control. 2) An episode whose audit reported an error lowers FAR further, opposite to the direction predicted by accumulated-message accounts. 3) Signal-detection analysis shows the change is a criterion shift, with no detectable gain in discrimination. 4) Manual audit of removed false alarms indicates the shift is still beneficial at the operating point tested. 5) The 2×2 decomposition shows repair content and audit verdict contribute complementarily across models, with no single necessary component.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 25 minutes. Focus on the Method section for the byte-identical invariant and the 2×2 attribution design, which underpin the causal claim; Results and §6 signal-detection analysis to distinguish threshold shift from discrimination change; and the Introduction's contrast with Jin & Chen 2026 and Khullar et al. 2026 to position the contribution.

recommendation.zh: Verifier 上下文偏置的干净测量，audit-repair 历史拉低误报率而非升高；用 verifier 做 RLVR 或自动评测的人需警惕此 leniency bias，看 §3 结果即可。
recommendation.en: A clean measurement of verifier context bias: prior audit-repair history lowers false alarms rather than raising them; anyone using verifiers for RLVR or automated eval should watch for this leniency bias—§3 results suffice.

paper.title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
paper.abstract: Coding agents spend most of their context budget on retrieval. Lexical retrieval (grep) is universal, instant, and zero-setup, but noisy: it cannot tell a definition from a call from a comment. Semantic retrieval via the Language Server Protocol (LSP) is precise and typed, but needs a running, indexed server and pays a per-symbol round-trip. The claim that semantic retrieval is more token-efficient is, we find, asserted almost everywhere and measured almost nowhere: no public source isolates the

summary.core_problem: 衡量代码 Agent 中 LSP 语义检索相比 grep 词法检索是否真的能节省上下文 token，并在相同任务成功率下隔离检索方式带来的成本差异。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测方法和测量框架。它把“语义检索更省 token”这个常见系统假设转化为 tokens-to-success 指标，并设计消融来排除任务难度、模型能力和工具开销等混杂因素。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 tokens-to-success 作为核心指标，设计五组实验臂来分离 LSP 语义检索与 grep 词法检索的影响，并把预先声明的三类失败模式映射到可测变量。方法重点不是提出新 Agent 架构，而是给代码 Agent 工具选择建立可复现实验协议。
summary.experiments: 初步实验覆盖 Python 和 TypeScript 仓库，使用 Claude Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5。摘要报告，在符号名定位任务上，LSP 往往增加 token 成本，增幅约 +6% 到 +118%；结论是条件性的，并且多数情况下不支持“LSP 自动省 token”的经验假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LSP-based semantic retrieval actually saves context tokens over lexical grep retrieval for coding agents when task success is held fixed.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation methodology. It turns a common systems assumption—semantic retrieval is more token-efficient—into a tokens-to-success measurement and proposes ablations to isolate retrieval effects from task and model confounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work defines tokens-to-success, specifies a five-arm ablation that separates LSP retrieval from lexical retrieval, and maps three pre-declared failure modes into measurable variables. The emphasis is not a new coding-agent architecture, but a cleaner protocol for tool-selection measurement.
summary_en.experiments: The preliminary study uses Python and TypeScript repositories with Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5. The abstract reports that for symbol-named localization, LSP often costs more tokens, with overheads from roughly +6% to +118%; the conclusion is conditional and usually negative.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 token-to-success 定义即可；它提醒代码 Agent 工具收益不能只按单次调用估。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and tokens-to-success definition; it is a useful warning that coding-agent tools cannot be judged by single-call cost.

paper.title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case record

summary.core_problem: 编码 agent 通常被当作模型来评测，但实际以系统形式部署；如何评测和运维其端到端可靠性。
summary.importance: 提出系统层评测与运维视角，综合大量学术与实践证据，指出许多看似模型失败其实来自 harness、执行状态、检索、权限或验证环节。
summary.technical_approach: 通过结构化多声部综述、更新审计、软件工程覆盖分析和分布式系统证据综合，将评测与运维建模为依赖链，覆盖任务构造、执行环境、检索、状态管理、验证和可观测性等层。
summary.experiments: 综合 164 篇学术工作、100 条实践记录、29 个 benchmark 和 17 个作者系统案例；没有训练新模型，主要结论是单层改进常无法传递到端到端结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents are evaluated as models but deployed as systems; how should their end-to-end reliability be evaluated and operated?
summary_en.importance: It contributes a system-level evaluation and operations perspective, synthesizing broad evidence that many apparent model failures originate in the harness, execution state, retrieval, permissions, or verification layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a structured multivocal review, update audits, software-engineering coverage analysis, and distributed-systems evidence synthesis to model evaluation and operation as a dependency chain across task construction, execution environments, retrieval, state management, verification, and observability.
summary_en.experiments: Synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmarks, and 17 author-system case studies; no new model is trained, and the main finding is that improvements at one layer often do not propagate to end-to-end outcomes.

recommendation.zh: 把 coding agent 当分布式系统做依赖链分析，对设计 SWE 评测有参考；但这是综述不是新方法，看失败分类即可。
recommendation.en: The dependency-chain view of coding agents is useful for designing SWE evaluations, but this is a synthesis rather than a new method—read the failure taxonomy and skip the bulk.

paper.title: LigBench: A Unified and Human-Aligned Benchmark for LLM-based Research Idea Generation
paper.abstract: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), research idea generation has attracted increasing attention. Existing approaches enable LLMs to retrieve relevant literature and propose novel ideas for research areas. However, current evaluation practices for idea generation remain fragmented and lack objective standards, often relying on direct LLM scoring, which limits their ability to provide unified and reliable assessments across a coherent distribution of generated ideas. To add

summary.core_problem: LigBench 解决的是 LLM 生成研究想法的评测不稳定问题。现有做法常用 LLM 直接打分或少量专家排序，容易受提示词、表达长度、评审偏好和候选分布影响；不同系统生成的 idea 格式也不一致，导致横向比较缺少统一基准。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在评测侧，而不是预训练方法本身。它对 LLM 基座研究的间接启发在于：当模型能力进入科研辅助、自动假设生成和 AI scientist 场景后，评测不能只看最终文本质量，还要拆成 novelty、soundness、contribution、overall rating 等维度，并通过相对比较降低绝对打分噪声。对预训练研究员来说，PAIR-IQ 这类结构化 idea 数据也可能成为后续训练 reward model、judge model 或科研任务 agent 的监督资源，但目前贡献仍以 benchmark/pipeline 为主。
summary.technical_approach: LigBench 把任意输入 idea 先转成统一的 formalized representation，减少不同生成系统在格式、长度和表达风格上的偏差。评测维度分为 rating、contribution、soundness、novelty，每个维度 0–5 分。系统会从 PAIR-IQ 数据库中检索与待评 idea 相近的论文或想法，让 LLM 对 idea pair 做成对比较，再结合 PAIR-IQ 中已有的去偏评分，用类似 Elo 的机制持续更新目标 idea 的分数，直到收敛。这个设计选择 pairwise comparison，而不是直接绝对打分，原因是相对判断通常更稳定，也更接近专家评审时的比较过程。PAIR-IQ 包含 11000 篇以上会议论文，并提供结构化 idea 表示和去偏评估分数，可同时作为评测参照和训练 pairwise idea judge 的数据源。
summary.experiments: 实验部分声称对多个主流 LLM 进行了 idea generation 评测，展示 LigBench 能区分不同模型生成 idea 的细粒度质量差异，并分析模型在 novelty、soundness、contribution 等维度上的强弱。已给出的全文片段没有包含具体模型列表、分数、相关性指标或人工一致性数字，因此不应过度解读。需要重点确认的实验包括：LigBench 分数与人类专家偏好的相关性、Elo 聚合相比直接 LLM 打分的方差变化、检索相似论文数量对稳定性的影响，以及 PAIR-IQ 去偏策略是否真的降低了领域和会议偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Method 中 idea 标准化、pairwise comparison、Elo score update 的流程图和公式；再看 PAIR-IQ 的构建方式、去偏评分来源和数据字段。实验部分重点看 human alignment、judge consistency、跨生成分布的鲁棒性。如果只关心 LLM 预训练，可快速跳过具体 idea generation leaderboard，重点看它如何把开放式科研想法转成可训练、可比较的偏好数据。

summary_en.core_problem: LigBench targets the lack of stable and unified evaluation for LLM-generated research ideas. Existing evaluations often rely on direct LLM scoring or small-scale expert ranking, both of which are sensitive to prompts, verbosity, reviewer preference, and the distribution of generated ideas.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation asset rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but concrete: scientific ideation systems need evaluation protocols that separate novelty, soundness, contribution, and overall quality, instead of treating an idea as a single free-form text. The PAIR-IQ dataset may also be useful for training idea judges, reward models, or research-agent evaluators, though the primary contribution remains benchmarking.
summary_en.technical_approach: LigBench first converts each candidate idea into a formalized representation to reduce format and verbosity bias. It evaluates ideas along four dimensions: rating, contribution, soundness, and novelty, each on a 0–5 scale. For a target idea, the system retrieves similar papers or ideas from PAIR-IQ, asks an LLM to perform pairwise comparisons, and aggregates the judgments with existing debiased PAIR-IQ scores through an Elo-style score update process until convergence. The choice of pairwise comparison is sensible: relative preference judgments are usually less noisy than absolute scores and better match how reviewers compare research directions. PAIR-IQ contains more than 11,000 conference papers with structured idea representations and debiased evaluation scores.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content states that the benchmark was used to evaluate several strong LLMs and can expose fine-grained differences in generated idea quality across dimensions such as novelty, soundness, and contribution. The available text does not include concrete model names, score tables, correlation numbers, or ablation results. The key results to verify in the full experimental section are human-alignment correlation, variance reduction versus direct LLM scoring, sensitivity to retrieved-neighbor count, and whether the debiasing strategy in PAIR-IQ reduces venue or domain artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the method sections describing idea formalization, pairwise comparison, and Elo-style score propagation. Then inspect how PAIR-IQ is built, what metadata it stores, and how scores are debiased. For pretraining-oriented readers, the leaderboard itself is less important than the conversion of open-ended research ideas into structured preference data that can train or evaluate judge models.

recommendation.zh: 看 judge 训练数据和人类一致性实验；idea generation 很噪，但 pairwise 评测范式可迁移到合成数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Skim the judge-training data and human-agreement experiments; idea generation is noisy, but the pairwise evaluation setup may transfer to synthetic-data filtering.

paper.title: Large Language Models Can Follow Instructions, But Not Many at Once: Phase Transitions in Compositional Constraint Satisfaction
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in settings that require simultaneous adherence to multiple explicit constraints - reasoning structure, safety boundaries, output schemas. Individual constraints are handled proficiently, but the compositional regime, where many must hold jointly, remains poorly characterized: how rapidly does performance degrade, what governs the degradation, and can the collapse be mitigated? We introduce Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE), a procedurally gen

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体但常被低估的问题：模型单独遵守一条指令通常不难，但当多个约束需要同时满足时，性能会如何退化，退化是平滑的还是会突然塌陷，塌陷来自约束之间的相互干扰，还是只是单条约束可靠性不足在组合时被乘法放大。作者把问题限定在“可确定性验证的多约束满足”，试图给出比以往 benchmark 更干净的定量答案。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接 recipe 贡献，但对能力评估和训练目标设计有明确启发。第一，它把多约束遵循失败解释为近似独立错误的累积，而不是复杂的 pairwise interference，这会影响人如何设计 instruction tuning、constraint-aware decoding 和 verifier-based training。第二，它给出一个较清晰的功能形式：轻微的 per-constraint 退化，在组合层面会迅速变成整体成功率崩塌。这对理解“为什么模型看起来会做，但一上真实复杂系统就不稳”很有帮助。第三，它用全确定性 verifier 避开了 LLM judge 在高组合度场景下自身失真的问题，因此 benchmark 信号更可信。对基座研究员来说，这篇文章更像一个能力测量工具和现象学刻画，而不是新训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Constraint Saturation Evaluation（CSE）。核心设计有两点。第一，所有约束都必须可被确定性程序验证，不依赖 LLM judge。这样评测器不会在高 k 组合场景下和被测模型一起失真。第二，benchmark 不是固定几种组合，而是系统地扫描同时约束数 k，从 1 到 12，观察性能曲线和失效结构。CSE 包含 36 类约束，覆盖 8 个处理维度，从局部词法模式到文档级结构，再到关系推理和自指约束。每个 verifier 不只给二值通过/失败，还给连续分数 s∈[0,1]，便于分析部分满足。作者还专门做了 composability vetting，避免某个约束天然锁死多个输出维度，导致高 k 时 benchmark 本身带入结构性偏差。实验分析的关键不是简单报 pass rate，而是拆成三层：一是 per-constraint pass rate 随 k 的变化；二是 probe-level joint success 的塌陷速度；三是 failure correlation，也就是不同约束失败是否强相关。结论是失败之间相关性很弱，平均 φ 只有 +0.067，因此联合成功率大致可以由单约束成功率相乘来预测。作者进一步分析不同约束类型的退化差异，发现需要在生成过程中持续维护的结构性约束，比局部词法约束退化更快；而接近一次性二元判断的约束则相对稳定。这种分层解释比“模型不会多任务”要细得多。
summary.experiments: 实验规模上，CSE 覆盖 15 个模型、8 个家族、36 种约束类型、k=1 到 12，共 369,753 次约束检查。最核心的定量结果有四个。第一，per-constraint pass rate 可以被一个简单乘法模型很好拟合：72.0% × 0.922^(k−1)，held-out MAE 只有 0.2 个百分点。这说明退化不是杂乱无章，而是相当规则。第二，虽然单条约束的通过率下降看起来不算剧烈，但联合成功率会很快跌穿地板：到 k=9 时，probe-level success 低于 2%；一个模型在 k=8 时单约束通过率约 41%，但八条全满足只有 5.7%。第三，即使最强模型，整体成功率跌破 50% 也只需要 7 条约束；15 个模型里有 12 个在 3 条或更少约束时就跌破 50%。第四，结构性约束每增加一条约束时损失的基线能力约为词法约束的 2.0 倍，95% CI 为 [1.9, 2.3]；而作者定义的 comprehension-maintenance gap 与退化率显著相关，ρ=-0.584。也就是说，越依赖生成过程中持续跟踪和维护的约束，越容易先坏。这个结果对训练很有启发：如果想提升复杂指令遵循，单纯增加约束种类未必有效，更关键的是提高每条约束在长生成过程中的稳定执行率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Section 4。Introduction 把问题、已有 benchmark 的缺口、以及为什么必须去掉 LLM judge 讲得比较清楚。Section 4 是整篇最有信息量的部分，里面有退化函数、联合成功率塌陷、以及 failure correlation 的核心结果。然后回看 CSE 的 benchmark 设计，重点看 36 类约束如何筛选、为什么要做 composability analysis、以及 continuous score 的定义。若只想抓住主要结论，30 分钟左右足够。若想把它用于训练或评测设计，需要细读 Appendix K 一类的 verifier vetting 和约束构造细节，确认 benchmark 没有把不必要的耦合带进来。阅读时建议一直带着一个问题：这里测到的是“模型不会理解多个要求”，还是“模型理解了但在生成时维持不住”？作者的数据更支持后者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important failure mode: language models can usually satisfy one instruction at a time, but what happens when many explicit constraints must be satisfied jointly? The authors ask whether performance degrades smoothly or collapses sharply, whether some constraints fail earlier than others, and whether the collapse is caused by pairwise interference between constraints or by the accumulation of mostly independent errors.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for capability measurement and training design. First, it argues that multi-constraint failure is largely an accumulation problem rather than a rich interference problem. That changes how one might think about instruction tuning, verifier-based training, and constrained decoding. Second, it gives a concrete functional form for degradation: modest per-constraint decay compounds into severe joint failure. That helps explain why models can look competent on isolated instructions yet become unreliable in real systems with many simultaneous requirements. Third, by using deterministic verifiers throughout, it avoids the circularity of LLM judges failing in the same high-composition regime they are supposed to evaluate. For foundation-model researchers, the main value is as a clean measurement framework and a useful phenomenology of instruction-following limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE). Two design choices define it. First, every constraint must be deterministically verifiable, with no LLM judge in the loop. This keeps the evaluator stable exactly where composition becomes hard. Second, the benchmark varies the number of simultaneous constraints k systematically from 1 to 12, instead of testing only a few fixed compositions. CSE contains 36 constraint types across 8 processing dimensions, ranging from local lexical constraints to document-level structure, relational reasoning, and self-referential tasks. Each verifier returns both a binary pass/fail decision and a continuous compliance score in [0,1]. The benchmark construction also includes a composability vetting stage, which is important: a constraint that implicitly locks multiple output dimensions would distort high-k behavior and confound the analysis. The paper then analyzes three levels of behavior: per-constraint pass rate as k increases, probe-level joint success, and co-failure structure. The main empirical finding is that failures are only weakly correlated, with mean phi around +0.067, so joint success is well approximated by multiplying per-constraint success rates. The authors also show that not all constraints degrade equally: constraints that require sustained maintenance during generation deteriorate much faster than local lexical constraints, while near-binary decision constraints are relatively robust.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 15 models from 8 families, 36 constraint types, k from 1 to 12, and 369,753 total constraint checks. Four results stand out. First, per-constraint pass rate follows a simple multiplicative law, 72.0% × 0.922^(k−1), with held-out MAE of only 0.2 percentage points. So the degradation is highly regular rather than noisy. Second, even mild per-constraint decay leads to severe collapse in joint success: by k=9, probe-level success falls below 2%; a model with about 41% per-constraint success at k=8 achieves only 5.7% full success on all eight constraints. Third, even the strongest model drops below 50% probe-level success at only 7 constraints, and 12 of the 15 models cross that threshold at 3 constraints or fewer. Fourth, structural constraints lose baseline capability about 2.0x faster per added constraint than lexical ones, with a 95% CI of [1.9, 2.3], and the comprehension-maintenance gap correlates with degradation rate at rho = -0.584. In practical terms, the more a constraint must be actively maintained throughout generation, the earlier it breaks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and Section 4. The introduction clearly motivates why existing benchmarks are insufficient, especially when they rely on LLM judges. Section 4 contains the main empirical substance: the degradation law, the collapse in joint success, and the weak co-failure correlations. After that, read the benchmark design section to understand how the 36 constraints were selected, why composability analysis matters, and how the continuous compliance scores are defined. If the goal is just to extract the main result, about 30 minutes should be enough. If the goal is to reuse the benchmark or adapt its ideas for training, the verifier-vetting and constraint-construction appendices are worth reading carefully. A useful reading lens is this: is the benchmark showing that models fail to understand multiple requirements, or that they understand them but cannot reliably maintain them during generation? The evidence in the paper points more strongly to the second interpretation.

recommendation.zh: verifier 设计干净，相变结论对指令数据构造和输出格式训练有直接意义；只看§3的相变曲线和k=8表格即可。
recommendation.en: Clean verifier-based setup; the phase-transition result matters for instruction-data design and schema-following training; just read §3 curves and the k=8 table.

paper.title: A Contract-Grade Verifier for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels, and a Native Blackwell Backward for the Gated-Linear-Recurrence Family
paper.abstract: Systems that generate GPU kernels with language models report high correctness rates. Those rates come from a single loose test: run the kernel on a few random inputs at one fixed shape and accept it if the output is close to a reference. A kernel can pass that test and still be silently wrong. It can return an ordinary number where the true answer is a NaN or an infinity, differ from run to run, break when the shape changes, or accumulate in fp16 where the reference keeps an fp32 total. We buil

summary.core_problem: LLM 生成 GPU kernel 的正确性评测几乎普遍依赖单一固定 shape 下的随机输入 allclose 测试，这种弱信号会放过 NaN/Inf 处理错误、跨 shape 错误、非确定性、偷偷用 fp16 累加等问题，导致 benchmark 上报的性能胜利中有未知比例是虚假的。论文要建立一个 contract-grade 验证器，把 Kernel Contracts 分类法落地为十二个对抗性检查门，并用它审计已被现有 harness 接受的机器生成 kernel corpus；同时用同一验证器验证一个自研的、真正正确的 Blackwell tcgen05 GDN 反向 kernel 作为阳性对照。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发有两层。其一，评测信号质量问题在 kernel 生成领域与在 LLM 训练/对齐领域同构：弱验证器会系统性高估能力、reward hacking 会被当作真实进步，这篇论文提供了一个'用强 contract 验证器审计弱 benchmark 接受结果'的具体案例，39.5% 的无容忍底线破损率和 62.1% 的契约违反率是很有说服力的数字。其二，Gated DeltaNet/Mamba 等 linear/recurrent 架构的训练反向 kernel 是这些新架构能否真正 scaling 的关键基础设施，论文给出了首个原生 Blackwell tensor-memory 训练反向实现，并端到端训练了 1.1B 模型，对关注非 Transformer 架构预训练的研究者有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 验证器部分：十二个 gate 分为无容忍门（精确 mask/字节比较）和有容忍门，容忍阈值从浮点误差模型推导而非手工设定，例如 ORD-01 的 atol≈4ε√N·scale 遵循 reduction 中浮点误差的实际累积方式，使正确 kernel 宽余量通过、错误 kernel 差数量级失败；每个 gate 从固定种子重采样 RNG，使判决不依赖运气。参考实现是高精度朴素循环，拒绝在低精度下执行以防被误用为候选。验证器的可信度通过四种独立方式建立：7/7 阳性对照、阈值校准扫描、与 KernelBench 自有正确性代码 98.5% 一致、分层人工审计；并附带 19 个故意构造的破损 kernel 作为红队（返回输入、缓存答案、fp16 累加、非确定性、Inf 转有限值、只在一个 shape 工作、偷偷搬设备等），验证器必须全部拒绝同时放行诚实参考。GDN 反向部分：手写原生 Blackwell tcgen05/tensor-memory 训练反向，包含其他实现仍留在 Triton fallback 的 reverse-state 阶段，正确处理了 open #904 bug 背后的 tensor-memory 约束。
summary.experiments: 审计 Dr. Kernel/KernelGYM 公开 corpus（hkust-nlp/drkernel-coldstart-8k，MIT 许可，8,920 条 SFT 轨迹），对 SSM 相邻算子类（matmul/attention/softmax/scan/norm/conv/reduction）审计 3,134 个被接受 kernel，其中 2,638 个进入完整分析：39.5% 在无容忍门下即破损，62.1% 携带契约违反；与 KernelBench 自有 harness 的差分显示标准测试认证了 1,487 个破损 kernel，反向只有 14 个。GDN 反向 kernel 对 fp64 oracle 验证到 3.3×10⁻³，bit-for-bit 确定性，支持五个 GDN 家族成员的一次反向，正确处理 tensor-memory 约束。附录还报告六个 contract-verified 的 Mamba-3 kernel（在 Blackwell 上绕过 #904）、用这些 kernel 端到端训练的 1.1B 模型、以及从零搭建的 GRPO 自动调优系统。所有定量声明有固定软件环境下的已提交 artifact，单行复现只需公开验证器和公开 MIT corpus。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：Introduction 把问题和双重用途（向外审计、向内验证自研 kernel）讲得很清楚，必读。Section 3 重点看 Table 1 的十二个 gate 设计、容忍阈值推导逻辑、四种可信度辩护、19 个红队 kernel 的构造思路，以及 39.5%/62.1%/1,487 vs 14 这几个关键数字。Section 4 的 GDN Blackwell 反向对关注 linear/recurrent 架构训练的读者值得细看，尤其是 reverse-state 阶段和 #904 tensor-memory 约束的处理。Section 5 的局限性陈述值得读。预计 30-40 分钟。对预训练研究者最有迁移价值的是'弱验证器导致虚假进步'这一评测方法论教训，以及 contract-grade 验证器如何用推导阈值+阳性对照+红队建立可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the weak correctness testing used for LLM-generated GPU kernels, where a kernel can pass a small random fixed-shape test while still being silently wrong.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation and verification protocol. It shows that common harnesses miss failures involving NaNs/Infs, nondeterminism, shape changes, and incorrect accumulation precision. For automated kernel generation in training systems, this is a correctness gate rather than a benchmark detail.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a contract-grade verifier with twelve adversarial gates, each encoding a property that a correct kernel must satisfy. Several gates are tolerance-free, so failures cannot be dismissed by changing numerical thresholds. The paper also includes a native Blackwell backward kernel for the gated-linear-recurrence family.
summary_en.experiments: The verifier audits 2,638 machine-generated kernels that had already been accepted by a public system’s own harness. It finds 39.5% broken beyond any tolerance argument and 62.1% with at least one violation. The abstract does not expose the full gate list or the audited system name.

recommendation.zh: 读 verifier gates 和审计结果；若内部在用 LLM 写 kernel，这篇应直接变成 CI 检查清单。
recommendation.en: Read the verifier gates and audit table; if LLM-written kernels are in your stack, this should translate into CI checks.

paper.title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
paper.abstract: When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We identify a class of user-issued instructions, Session Constraints (SCs), such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that are meant to constrain LLM's behavior for the remainder of a session but are silently dropped during compaction. To quantify this loss, we introduce COMPINT, an evaluation suite that evaluates compactors across three long-context scenarios: multi-turn chat, agent

summary.core_problem: 论文关注长上下文系统里的一个具体失效点：当会话接近上下文上限并触发压缩时，用户在早期给出的会话级约束会被摘要器丢掉。这里的约束不是主任务，也不是长期记忆，而是在当前 session 内持续生效的行为边界，例如“未经确认不要发送邮件”。压缩器通常保留任务目标、当前状态和下一步计划，却容易丢掉这类“如何执行任务”的约束，导致 agent 继续完成任务但违反用户要求。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文模型、agent serving、memory/compaction 机制和 post-train 评测有清晰启发。它把上下文压缩从“信息是否足够恢复任务”推进到“约束是否被完整继承”。这对训练和评测都有意义：如果未来模型在预训练或中训练阶段学习摘要、记忆、状态压缩，训练信号不能只奖励任务连续性，也要显式覆盖用户约束、权限边界和过程要求。论文的主要贡献是评测资产和系统诊断，而不是新模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先定义 Session Constraints，简称 SC。SC 有三个条件：不是用户主任务的一部分；用于约束当前 session 内模型后续行为；没有跨 session 的长期用途。作者进一步按约束绑定对象划分为五类：Action、Information、Process、Preference、Output。CompInt 评测套件围绕四个正交轴构造样本：SC 内容、表达方式、注入位置/次数、长上下文环境。长上下文环境包括多轮聊天、agent 轨迹和长程研究任务。评测流程是在上下文中注入 SC，触发 compaction，再通过后续 probe 检查压缩后状态是否保留并执行这些约束。方法上的关键点是把“主任务恢复”和“侧约束保真”拆开评估，因此能暴露普通摘要指标看不到的失败。论文还提出一个 SC-aware extractor，与常规 compactor 并行工作：摘要器继续负责任务状态，提取器专门抽取和保留会话约束。这说明作者认为单纯改 compactor prompt 不够稳定，需要把约束通道从任务摘要通道中分离出来。
summary.experiments: CompInt 每个压缩条件下构造 750 个评测实例。论文测试多种 compactor、prompt、上下文长度、压缩率、SC 表达强度、注入位置和重复次数。核心结果是当前 compactors 平均只保留 17% 的注入 SC，很多设置下甚至不如不做 compaction。保留率对系统和数据因素都很敏感：compactor 选择、压缩 prompt、上下文长度、压缩率、SC phrasing、注入位置都会显著影响结果。重复出现和更强显式表述通常有帮助，但不能根治问题。SC-aware extractor 在三个环境上都达到 90% 以上保留率，说明把侧约束作为独立状态管理对象，比让通用摘要器“顺便记住”更可靠。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Side Constraints，重点理解 SC 与 system prompt、主任务、长期记忆的区别。然后看 CompInt 构造部分，尤其是四个评测轴和五类 SC taxonomy，这是论文最可复用的部分。实验部分重点看 retention rate 随 compactor、context length、injection location、framing 变化的表格和图。最后看 SC-aware extractor 的设计和消融，关注它为何需要与 compactor 分离。对做长上下文训练、agent memory、session state 管理的人，这篇的价值主要在 failure taxonomy 和 evaluation protocol。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode in long-context LLM systems: context compaction often drops user-issued constraints that are meant to govern the rest of the session. These constraints are not the main task and are not durable memory. They specify how the agent should behave, for example, “do not send anything without my confirmation.” A task-oriented compactor may preserve the goal and current working state while silently removing these constraints, so the agent can continue the task but violate the user’s stated boundaries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and systems diagnostic rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research is still clear. Long-context training, agent memory, summarization-as-state-compression, and post-training evaluations often optimize for task continuity. This work shows that continuity is incomplete if behavioral constraints are not preserved. For future pretraining or mid-training recipes that teach models to summarize, compress, or maintain session state, the training signal should include constraint preservation rather than only reconstruction of the dominant task.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Session Constraints as clauses that are not part of the task, constrain behavior within the current session, and have no intended use beyond that session. It groups them into five categories: Action, Information, Process, Preference, and Output. The CompInt suite varies four axes: constraint content, surface framing, injection condition, and long-context environment. The environments cover multi-turn chat, agentic trajectories, and long-horizon research. The evaluation injects constraints into long contexts, applies a compactor, and then uses probes to test whether the compacted state still carries the constraint. The key design choice is to evaluate constraint integrity separately from task recovery. The proposed mitigation is an SC-aware extractor that runs alongside the ordinary compactor: the compactor maintains task state, while the extractor maintains session constraints as a separate artifact.
summary_en.experiments: CompInt contains 750 evaluation instances per compaction condition. The paper evaluates retention under different compactors, prompts, context lengths, compression rates, constraint phrasings, injection locations, and repetitions. Current compactors retain only 17% of injected session constraints on average, and many settings perform worse than simply continuing without compaction. Retention is highly sensitive to both system-side choices and constraint-side factors. Stronger wording and repeated constraints can help, but they do not remove the failure. The SC-aware extractor achieves over 90% retention across the three evaluated environments, supporting the claim that constraints should be tracked through a dedicated channel rather than left to a generic summary prompt.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction and Side Constraints sections first to understand the distinction between task content, system instructions, durable memory, and session-scoped constraints. Then read the CompInt construction, especially the four evaluation axes and the five-way taxonomy. In the experiments, focus on the retention tables and plots that vary compactor, context length, injection location, and framing. The mitigation section is worth reading for the architectural lesson: session constraints are safer when represented separately from the task summary.

recommendation.zh: 读 COMPINT 设置和 17% 保留率结果；这会改变长上下文数据管线里“摘要后仍安全”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the COMPINT setup and the 17% retention result; it challenges the default assumption that summarized context remains behaviorally safe.

paper.title: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
paper.abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open

summary.core_problem: 现有开放数学问题基准（HorizonMath、FrontierMath:OP）依赖生成器-验证器缺口，只能覆盖少数可构造可计算验证的问题，验证结果只是证据而非严格证明，且每个问题需要手工编写验证器、存在高比例不可解问题；同时近期AI解决开放数学问题的案例缺乏系统的成功率、成本和模型对比数据。需要一个覆盖更广、验证可靠、可系统比较通用LM能力的开放数学问题基准。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个训练数据不会泄漏的、基于形式化证明的开放问题评测集，可用于衡量模型在数学推理前沿的真实能力边界，也可作为RL推理、推理时搜索、工具使用等后训练方法的硬评测基准；开放的评测脚手架也降低了不同模型和agent在同一任务上横向对比的成本。
summary.technical_approach: 基于OEIS的整数序列开放猜想，使用已有的Lean形式化结果构建基准：从2649条OEIS开放猜想中筛选500条非平凡、适合自动定理证明的问题，经Gemini agent形式化为Lean，排除8条技术问题后得到492条猜想构成OEIS Open，再随机抽取100条构成低成本子集OEIS Open Lite。评测要求模型在Lean中证明猜想或其否定，正确性由Lean内核保证，避免手工验证器的漏洞；同时设计防作弊机制，支持任意通用LM接入。评测时给模型配备最小工具集（Lean证明环境、搜索等），按单次尝试预算控制成本。
summary.experiments: 在50美元/次尝试预算下，带最小工具集的LM可解决492条中的147条，OEIS Open上成功率30%；在200美元/次尝试预算下，当前最优模型在OEIS Open Lite（100条）上成功率44%；额外给模型接入47.6万篇arXiv数学文献作为检索源，未带来OEIS Open Lite上的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看Introduction中对现有开放问题基准缺陷的逐条分析，以及Methods中基准构建的筛选流程和Lean形式化的风险控制；附录可关注防作弊机制的具体实现和评测脚手架的使用方式；阅读时间约30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: Epoch Research；基于Tsoukalas等人2026年的OEIS猜想形式化工作构建。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing open-problem math benchmarks such as HorizonMath and FrontierMath:OP rely on a generator-verifier gap, which limits coverage to a small subset of constructible, computationally checkable problems, yields only evidence rather than rigorous proof, requires hand-written verifiers per problem, and includes a high fraction of unsolvable items. Meanwhile, recent high-profile AI demonstrations on open math problems lack systematic measurement of success rates, cost, and cross-model comparability. A benchmark with broader coverage, reliable verification, and support for generic LM evaluation is needed.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this benchmark provides a training-data-leakage-free evaluation set based on formal proofs to measure the real capability boundary of models at the frontier of mathematical reasoning. It also serves as a hard evaluation target for post-training methods including RL for reasoning, inference-time search, and tool use. The open evaluation scaffold lowers the cost of head-to-head comparison across different models and agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built on existing Lean formalizations of open conjectures about integer sequences from OEIS. From 2,649 open OEIS conjectures, 500 non-trivial problems suitable for automated theorem proving are selected and formalized in Lean via a Gemini-based agent; 8 items are excluded for technical reasons, leaving 492 conjectures as OEIS Open, with a random 100-item subset forming the cheaper OEIS Open Lite. Evaluation requires a model to prove either the conjecture or its negation in Lean, with correctness guaranteed by the Lean kernel instead of per-problem hand-crafted verifiers. Anti-cheating mechanisms are built in, and the scaffold accepts any generic language model. Models are evaluated with a minimal tool set under a fixed per-attempt cost budget.
summary_en.experiments: Under a $50 per-attempt budget, LMs with a minimal tool set resolve 147 out of 492 conjectures, reaching a 30% success rate on OEIS Open. Under a $200 per-attempt budget, the best current model reaches 44% on OEIS Open Lite. Augmenting models with retrieval over 476,000 arXiv mathematics papers does not improve performance on OEIS Open Lite.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the Introduction's itemized analysis of limitations in existing open-problem benchmarks, and the Methods section covering the selection pipeline and misformalization risk control via integer-sequence conjectures. The appendix is useful for details on anti-cheating mechanisms and the evaluation scaffold. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Epoch Research; built on the 2026 OEIS conjecture formalization work by Tsoukalas et al.

recommendation.zh: 基于开放数学猜想的干净评测基准，完美规避数据污染，可用于预训练数学能力的 unbiased 评估，重点看评测协议设计。
recommendation.en: Clean math reasoning benchmark based on open conjectures, free of data contamination; useful for unbiased evaluation of pretrained math capability, focus on the evaluation protocol.

paper.title: Graph-Structured Rubrics: Compiling Rubrics into Typed Evaluation Graphs for LLM Judges
paper.abstract: Rubric-based evaluators commonly treat rubrics as prompt context or flat criteria: they specify what to judge but leave criterion composition implicit, even when natural-language rules state it. We introduce Graph-Structured Rubrics (GSR), which compiles a rubric into a response-independent typed evaluation graph before observing responses. Criterion nodes elicit judgments; transformation, reduction, and gating operators compose them through named ports; and a task-specific output mapping, terme

summary.core_problem: 现有基于评分标准（rubric）的LLM评测将评分标准作为提示上下文或扁平条件列表，只定义了评什么，没有把条件之间的组合规则（层级、门控、加权、约束等）显式化，这些规则隐含在LLM内部推理中，导致评测结果受候选顺序、锚定、规则执行顺序不一致等问题影响，可复现性和可审计性差。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，评测质量直接影响预训练/后训练的模型选型、奖励模型数据构造和benchmark报告可信度；GSR提供了一种把评分规则从模型内部隐式执行转为显式、可验证计算图的通用框架，能提升rubric评测的一致性和跨模型可迁移性，也为奖励建模中评分规则的结构化表示提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Graph-Structured Rubrics（GSR），在看到候选回复之前，先将rubric编译为与回复无关的带类型有向无环图（DAG）：图中包含三类节点——条件节点（由LLM输出语义判断）、变换/归约/门控算子节点（确定性执行）、以及任务特定的Readout输出映射；节点之间通过命名端口连接，编译阶段静态检查JSON合法性、无环性、汇点可达性、端口匹配、参数数量和类型兼容性，拒绝非法图。评测时按拓扑序执行：LLM只负责每个条件节点的语义判断，组合逻辑由确定性算子控制，最终输出分数或偏好；同时生成可回放的审计轨迹。点评分和两两偏好评测复用同一套图语义，仅Readout不同。
summary.experiments: 在4个点评分数据集和2个两两偏好基准上验证：使用GPT-OSS-120B作为评测模型时，GSR在所有4个点评分数据集上取得最高的精确分数一致率，在2个两两偏好基准上取得最高的端到端准确率；控制变量消融显示，在每个点评分数据集上，GSR的精确分数一致率均高于直接评分和扁平加权聚合的基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看Introduction中对现有rubric评测隐式组合问题的拆解，Graph-Structured Rubrics章节中编译-执行两阶段接口设计和三类算子的语义定义；可跳过具体数据集细节，重点关注编译期静态检查的内容和拓扑执行的流程；阅读时间约25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing rubric-based LLM evaluators treat rubrics as prompt context or flat lists of criteria: they only specify what to judge, but leave composition rules across criteria (hierarchy, gating, weighting, constraints, etc.) implicit inside the LLM's reasoning. This leads to sensitivity to candidate order, anchoring, inconsistent rule execution order, and poor reproducibility and auditability.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, evaluation quality directly affects model selection during pretraining/post-training, reward model data construction, and the credibility of benchmark reports. GSR provides a general framework that converts rubric composition rules from implicit in-model execution into an explicit, verifiable computation graph, improving consistency and cross-model transferability of rubric-based evaluation, and offering a reference for structured representation of scoring rules in reward modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Graph-Structured Rubrics (GSR) compiles a rubric into a response-independent typed directed acyclic graph (DAG) before observing any candidate responses. The graph contains criterion nodes (producing semantic judgments via LLMs), deterministic operator nodes (Transform, Reduce, Gate), and a task-specific Readout mapping. Nodes connect via named ports; a compile-time static validator checks JSON parsing, acyclicity, sink reachability, port matching, arity, and type compatibility, rejecting malformed graphs. At evaluation time, the graph executes in topological order: LLMs only handle semantic judgments at criterion nodes, while all composition logic is executed by deterministic operators, producing either a score or a preference along with a replayable audit trace. Pointwise scoring and pairwise preference evaluation share the same graph semantics, differing only in the Readout stage.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across four pointwise scoring datasets and two pairwise preference benchmarks. With GPT-OSS-120B as the judge backbone, GSR achieves the highest exact score agreement on all four pointwise datasets and the highest end-to-end pairwise accuracy on both pairwise benchmarks. Controlled ablations show that GSR yields higher exact score agreement than both direct scoring and flat weighted aggregation on every pointwise dataset.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the Introduction's breakdown of the implicit composition problem in existing rubric-based evaluation, and the Graph-Structured Rubrics section covering the two-stage compile-execute interface and semantics of the three operator types.
