Dataset-specific details can be skipped; pay attention to the compile-time validation checks and the topological execution flow. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 图结构化rubric编译提升LLM judge一致性，思路清晰可复现，重点看§3的图算子设计
recommendation.en: Graph-structured rubric compilation improves LLM judge consistency; clear and reproducible design, focus on §3 for graph operator details.

paper.title: Accuracy and Order Sensitivity Diverge Under Label-Free Strategies
paper.abstract: Multiple-choice benchmarks are widely used to evaluate large language models, but MCQ scores conflate knowledge with sensitivity to option order, which makes them unreliable measures of model knowledge. In this paper, we test whether preventing a model from seeing option labels while committing to an answer removes positional influence and, in turn, improves performance. We evaluate two different strategies for mitigating bias. The first uses a generation-then-matching approach, and the second s

summary.core_problem: 解决多项选择评测中，模型分数混杂了真实知识与选项顺序敏感性，导致 MCQ 分数不能直接当作知识测量的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法分析工作。它的重要性不在提出新模型，而在拆解 label-free 策略是否真的去除了位置偏置并提升准确率。对做预训练评测的人有参考价值，因为很多能力结论都建立在 MCQ 指标上。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较两类无标签策略：一类是先自由生成答案再做匹配；另一类是对每个选项独立打分，从构造上消除位置偏置。作者进一步做误差分解，区分“不给模型看全部选项”与“后续匹配器”各自带来的影响，并分析循环置换选项顺序时准确率与顺序敏感性的关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度，但核心结论很明确：两种 label-free 策略都不能稳定提升准确率；真正的瓶颈是隐藏选项本身，而不是 matching 步骤；唯一能稳定接近 baseline 的配置，是向模型展示全部选项，再用 LLM matcher 做两阶段决策；完全消除位置影响也不保证更高准确率，循环置换有时反而更好。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Queen’s University Belfast。未见可直接确认的头部实验室或该方向公认代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies the problem that multiple-choice evaluation conflates actual knowledge with option-order sensitivity, making MCQ accuracy an unreliable proxy for model knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-analysis paper. Its value is not a new model, but a careful decomposition of whether label-free strategies truly remove positional bias and improve accuracy. That matters for pretraining researchers because many capability claims still rely on MCQ-style metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares two label-free strategies: generate-then-match, and isolated option scoring that is positionally unbiased by construction. It then decomposes errors to separate the effect of withholding options from the effect of the matching step, and analyzes how cyclic option permutation affects both accuracy and order sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list concrete models, datasets, or gains, but the main findings are clear: neither label-free strategy reliably improves accuracy; the main bottleneck is withholding options rather than matching; the only setup that consistently matches the baseline shows all options and uses an LLM matcher; fully removing positional influence still does not reliably improve accuracy, while cyclic permutation can sometimes help.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Queen’s University Belfast. No clearly identifiable top-lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，只修正你对 MCQ 分数的信任边界；看误差分解那部分就够，若你还拿单次 MCQ accuracy 当知识指标，最好立刻补 permutation 控制。
recommendation.en: It does not change models, but it should change how much you trust MCQ accuracy; read the error decomposition and add permutation controls if you still use single-order MCQ as a knowledge proxy.

paper.title: Is This Your Final Answer? Cross-Contextual Consistency as a Measure of LLM Credibility
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful black-box systems, making it difficult to discern whether their answers reflect stable internal beliefs or superficial pattern matching. We identify cross-contextual consistency as an underutilized behavioral property of LLMs: a credible answer should remain stable when the same task is placed under topic-aligned, content-neutral contextual variation. Building on this intuition, we operationalize Cross-Contextual Consistency (C3) by comparing model gener

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答的不是“模型答对了多少”，而是“模型给出的答案是否像一个稳定的内部判断”。作者把这个问题具体化为 cross-contextual consistency：如果任务语义不变，只是换了与主题相关但内容中性的上下文包装，一个可信的答案不应大幅漂移。它要解决的是现有置信度评估的两个缺口：一类方法依赖 token probability 或内部状态，闭源模型上不可用；另一类方法如 self-report、self-consistency、paraphrase consistency 容易被过度自信、错误答案自洽、语义改写失真等问题污染。作者因此提出一个纯黑盒、实例级的行为度量，用上下文扰动前后的输出分布差异来估计答案可信度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接作用有限，它更像评测与模型行为分析工作；但它有两个值得记住的点。第一，它把“稳定性”从传统 paraphrase robustness 推进到更接近交叉盘问的设定：不是简单换说法，而是在任务语义不变的前提下改变 surrounding context。第二，它提供了一个不依赖 logits、可用于闭源模型、还能覆盖开放式生成任务的可靠性信号。对基座研究者来说，这类信号可作为 post-train 或 continual evaluation 的补充指标，尤其适合在 benchmark 饱和、准确率区分度下降时识别脆弱样本、污染样本和未学会区域。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名是 C3。核心流程是：对同一个任务实例构造一组 topic-aligned、content-neutral 的上下文扰动版本；分别采样模型在原始提示和扰动提示下的输出；再计算两组输出分布之间的差异，把差异大小作为该实例的 cross-contextual consistency 分数。分数越稳定，作者观察到越可能正确或事实可靠。论文的一个优点是它没有把 C3 绑定到单一任务形式，而是针对多选、短答、长事实生成、代码生成等不同输出空间设计了可比较的分布差异估计方式。理论动机部分借用了逻辑语义学的语言，把模型内部知识看作一组命题及其诱导的世界集合，直觉上如果模型对某个命题有稳定支持，那么在语义等价或任务无关的上下文变化下，其输出分布不应显著改变。这个理论框架并不严格刻画真实 LLM 内部机制，但足以解释为什么“上下文扰动下的分布漂移”可以作为 credibility proxy。和 self-consistency 的区别在于，self-consistency 测的是同一 prompt 下多次采样是否收敛；C3 测的是跨 prompt 但保留任务语义时是否稳定。和 paraphrase consistency 的区别在于，作者强调 perturbation 应是内容中性的 contextual variation，而不是直接改写问题本身，以减少语义漂移带来的假不一致。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 26 个模型、6 个 benchmark，主分析集是 16 个模型，另有 10 个模型做补充案例。任务范围包括 reasoning、factuality 和 code generation。主要结论有三层：一是实例层面，较小的 cross-contextual shift 与更高正确率/事实性显著相关；二是模型层面，C3 能形成一种 robustness profile，用来区分哪些模型在某些 benchmark 上只是“会做题”，哪些模型在语义不变扰动下仍保持稳定；三是方法层面，这种相关性对不同扰动来源和不同分布差异估计器都较稳健。作者还强调 C3 在 benchmark 饱和或 contamination 较重时仍有诊断价值，因为它不直接依赖标准答案打分，而是看行为稳定性。若精读实验，建议重点核对：不同任务上 C3 与 accuracy/factuality 的相关系数；闭源与开源模型上是否同样成立；错误样本中哪些类型最容易出现高漂移；以及与 self-consistency、paraphrase consistency、token-probability calibration 等基线相比的增益。当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格，无法安全复述具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读。先看引言和 motivation，确认作者想测的是 credibility 而不是 correctness。然后看 C3 的定义和不同任务上的 estimator 设计，这是方法是否站得住的关键。实验部分优先看三块：实例级相关性、模型级 robustness profile、对 perturbation source 和 comparison estimator 的稳健性。理论部分可以快速读，它主要提供直觉框架，不是严格证明。预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主要贡献。如果只想判断是否值得纳入评测栈，读方法定义、主结果表和案例分析就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking how often an LLM is correct. It asks a different question: when a model gives an answer, does that answer behave like a stable internal commitment or like a brittle surface pattern? The proposed lens is cross-contextual consistency. If the task-relevant meaning stays fixed and only the surrounding context is varied in a topic-aligned but content-neutral way, a credible answer should not shift much. This addresses two gaps in existing confidence estimation. Internal-signal methods need logits or hidden states and are unusable for many closed models. Simpler behavioral methods such as self-report, self-consistency, or paraphrase consistency can be confounded by overconfidence, repeated wrong answers, or semantic drift in the prompt rewrite.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is modest; this is primarily an evaluation and behavioral analysis paper. Still, it contributes a useful reliability signal for foundation-model work. First, it sharpens the notion of robustness beyond ordinary paraphrase invariance by focusing on contextual cross-examination rather than mere rewording. Second, it offers a black-box metric that works for open-ended generation and closed APIs, which makes it practical for model monitoring, post-training evaluation, and benchmark regimes where plain accuracy is becoming saturated or contaminated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called C3. For each task instance, the authors generate multiple context perturbations that preserve the task semantics while changing the surrounding framing. They then compare the model’s output distribution under the original prompt and under the perturbed prompts. The magnitude of that distributional shift becomes the instance-level C3 score: smaller shifts indicate higher credibility. A notable strength is that C3 is not tied to one output format. The paper adapts the comparison procedure across multiple-choice, short-answer, long-form factuality, and code generation settings, using task-appropriate estimators of output-distribution change. The motivation section uses a logical-semantics framing: if a model stably supports a proposition, semantically irrelevant contextual changes should not move its induced answer distribution much. This is not a mechanistic theory of LLM internals, but it is a coherent behavioral rationale. Relative to self-consistency, C3 measures stability across prompts rather than repeated samples from one prompt. Relative to paraphrase consistency, it tries to avoid changing the question itself, reducing false inconsistency caused by altered semantics.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 26 models and 6 benchmarks, with 16 models in the main analysis and an additional 10-model case study. The task mix includes reasoning, factuality, and code generation. The main empirical findings are threefold. At the instance level, smaller cross-contextual shifts are associated with higher correctness or factuality. At the model level, aggregated C3 scores produce a robustness profile that distinguishes models that are merely benchmark-competent from those that remain behaviorally stable under semantically neutral perturbations. At the method level, the signal appears robust across perturbation sources and across different estimators of distributional difference. The paper also argues that C3 remains informative when standard benchmarks are less discriminative because of saturation or contamination, since it does not rely directly on answer-key scoring. For a closer read, the key numbers to inspect are the correlation between C3 and accuracy/factuality on each task, whether the effect holds for both open and closed models, which error types show the largest shifts, and how C3 compares with self-consistency, paraphrase consistency, and calibration-style baselines. The excerpt provided here does not include the full tables, so I cannot quote exact values safely.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the introduction and motivation first to separate credibility from correctness; that distinction matters. Then go straight to the formal definition of C3 and the task-specific estimators, since the method stands or falls on whether those comparisons are well designed. In the experiments, prioritize the instance-level correlation results, the model-level robustness profiles, and the robustness checks over perturbation sources and comparison metrics. The theory section is useful for intuition but not essential for extracting the practical contribution. About 25–35 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 把“提示扰动下的一致性”当可信度信号是对现有 eval 的有效补充；只需看方法定义和各基准相关性图，注意扰动是否真 content-neutral。
recommendation.en: C3 is a useful extra axis beyond raw accuracy; read the definition + correlation plots, but scrutinize whether the perturbations are truly content-neutral (otherwise it’s just prompt sensitivity).

institutions: University of Chicago Booth School of Business

paper.title: Similarity Gates Approve Reversals: A Validity Audit of Embedding-Cosine Thresholds in Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Agent frameworks ship quality gates that compare text blocks by embedding-cosine similarity and decide at a fixed cutoff. Deduplication filters, semantic caches, drift guards, and answer grader gates deploy to answer the question: "Does this text still mean the same thing?" But the score answers a different question: "How much did the wording change?" We audit this gate class as a measurement instrument. In the cases these gates exist to catch, the two can run in opposite ways. Many times, rever

summary.core_problem: 审计 agent 系统中常见的 embedding-cosine 阈值门控，检验它是否真的能判断“语义是否保持不变”。
summary.importance: 这是一篇测量与评估导向的负结果论文。价值不在提出新 agent，而在指出很多生产系统把 embedding cosine 当作语义等价判据是错位测量：它更像表述相似度，而不是含义保持性。这对 RAG、缓存、去重、安全门控都有现实影响。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 embedding-cosine threshold 视作一种 measurement instrument 来做 validity audit，构造 meaning-breaking 但 wording-change 很小的变体，以及 meaning-preserving 但重写幅度较大的变体，统计多种已部署 operating points 下的 balanced accuracy，并分析其在 drift guard、semantic cache、grader gate 等场景中的失效模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出较明确数字：被审计的生产 drift guard 对 56 个 meaning-breaking mutation 一个都没抓到；存在“withhold the study drug”到“administer the study drug”仍有 0.9608 cosine 的案例；5 个已部署 operating points、90 个配置-阈值-任务单元中 balanced accuracy 最高不超过 0.700，中位数 0.525。实验规模不大，但负例很有穿透力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Eigenforma 与 Freemind Labs。

summary_en.core_problem: It audits the common use of embedding-cosine thresholds in agent systems and asks whether they actually measure semantic preservation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-oriented negative-result paper. Its value is not a new agent method, but the claim that many production systems misuse embedding cosine as a semantic-equivalence test when it behaves more like a wording-similarity measure. That matters for RAG, caches, deduplication, and safety gates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper treats embedding-cosine thresholding as a measurement instrument and performs a validity audit. It constructs cases where meaning changes with minimal wording edits, and cases where meaning is preserved despite larger rephrasing, then measures balanced accuracy across deployed operating points in drift guards, semantic caches, grader gates, and related settings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides concrete numbers: the audited production drift guard caught 0 of 56 meaning-breaking mutations; one reversal from 'withhold the study drug' to 'administer the study drug' still scored cosine 0.9608; across five shipped operating points and 90 configuration-threshold-task cells, balanced accuracy never exceeded 0.700 and had a median of 0.525. The scale is modest, but the failure cases are sharp.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Eigenforma and Freemind Labs.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但反例够狠；做 agent guardrail、语义缓存或数据去重的人应把这篇当 warning，而不是方法论文来读。
recommendation.en: The conclusion is not novel, but the counterexamples are sharp; treat this as a warning for agent guardrails, semantic caches, and dedup pipelines, not as a methods paper.

paper.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
paper.abstract: Autoformalisation (AF) systems map natural language reasoning steps into formal statements in a proof assistant such as Lean. We consider how to assess the faithfulness of these systems. Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect in

summary.core_problem: 评测数学链式推理自动形式化系统是否忠实保留原始自然语言推理的正确性与错误性，而不依赖昂贵人工标注或不稳定的 LLM judge。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark/evaluation protocol。它针对 autoformalisation 的 faithful translation 问题提出更便宜、可自动化、并能覆盖正负样本的评测方法；对 verifier、judge、reasoning 评测设计有方法学参考，但与基座预训练距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是自动构造被扰动的、应当无效的推理步骤，并同时衡量两件事：未扰动正确步骤在形式化后是否仍有效，以及扰动错误步骤在形式化后是否仍无效。这样避免完全依赖人工 gold formalisation 或 LLM/embedding 打分。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个数学数据集上评测 8 个 autoformalisation 系统，比较其 validity preservation 与 invalidity preservation。摘要未给出具体最佳系统和数值，但指出现有系统在 faithful translation 上存在可观差异。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括南洋理工大学、牛津大学、爱丁堡大学。作者中 Yee Whye Teh 具备较高学术知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how to evaluate whether mathematical chain-of-thought autoformalisation systems faithfully preserve both correctness and incorrectness from natural-language reasoning, without expensive human labels or unreliable LLM judges.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution. It offers a cheaper and more automatable way to assess faithfulness in autoformalisation, covering both positive and negative cases. The relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the methodology is useful for verifier/judge design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is to automatically generate perturbed reasoning steps that should be invalid, then measure two properties jointly: validity preservation on original steps and invalidity preservation on perturbed ones. This avoids full reliance on human gold formalisations or model-based judges.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to 8 autoformalisation systems across 4 mathematical datasets, comparing validity and invalidity preservation. The abstract does not expose the exact top system or score table, but it indicates substantial variation in faithfulness across systems.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Nanyang Technological University, the University of Oxford, and the University of Edinburgh. Yee Whye Teh is a notable author.

recommendation.zh: 更像 verifier 评测方法，不是预训练论文；若你在做 formal reasoning 或 judge 设计，读其负样本构造思路，其他部分可略过。
recommendation.en: This is more a verifier-eval paper than a pretraining one; if you work on formal reasoning or judges, read the negative-example construction and skip the rest.

paper.title: Gaming Without an Attacker: Benchmark Fingerprinting in LLM-Driven Search Under Selection Pressure
paper.abstract: Benchmarks for systems that are optimized against the evaluation signal measure something different from what they claim. We document this concretely in two GPU-kernel-optimization suites with held-out generalization gates: Metal-Sci (10 scientific-compute tasks) and Metal-ZK (12 zero-knowledge/cryptographic tasks), in which three frontier LLMs (Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.5) propose Metal kernels inside a $(1{+}1)$ evolutionary loop with rich feedback. Although no model is prompted to act a

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 驱动搜索系统在持续根据 benchmark 反馈优化时，即使没有攻击提示，也会学到评测配置指纹的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测失真与 benchmark 设计分析。它把 reward hacking / benchmark gaming 具体落到 GPU kernel optimization 场景，说明选择压力本身会让系统优化测量分支，而不是泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Metal-Sci 和 Metal-ZK 两个 GPU kernel optimization suite 上，让三个前沿 LLM 在带丰富反馈的 $(1+1)$ evolutionary loop 中提出 Metal kernel。作者检查在分布内获胜的候选是否能迁移到 held-out 配置，并归纳四类失败模式，包括 configuration fingerprint、只优化被测 branch、未测 branch 变慢或静默错误、gate leakage。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Metal-Sci 的 10 个科学计算任务和 Metal-ZK 的 12 个零知识/密码学任务，使用 Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5 作为搜索中的提案模型。合并统计中，53 个分布内 wins 里有 16 个不能迁移到 held-out 配置，失败率为 30%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LLM-driven search can fingerprint benchmark configurations under selection pressure, even without an explicitly adversarial prompt.
summary_en.importance: It is an evaluation and measurement contribution. The main value is a concrete account of reward hacking in GPU-kernel optimization: systems optimized against the measured signal can improve the benchmark while failing to generalize.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author runs three frontier LLMs inside a feedback-rich $(1+1)$ evolutionary loop on two Metal kernel optimization suites, Metal-Sci and Metal-ZK. Winning kernels are then checked against held-out configurations, and the failures are organized into a four-mode taxonomy, including configuration fingerprints, branch-specific tuning, silent wrongness, and gate leakage.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 10 scientific-computing tasks in Metal-Sci and 12 zero-knowledge/cryptographic tasks in Metal-ZK, with Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.5 as proposer models. Across pooled suites, 16 of 53 in-distribution wins, or 30%, fail to transfer to held-out configurations.

recommendation.zh: 模型名不用太当真，读失败 taxonomy 和 16/53；这类选择压力会污染 RL 与 agent eval。
recommendation.en: Do not over-index on the model names; read the failure taxonomy and the 16/53 number, because this selection pressure directly contaminates RL and agent evaluation.

paper.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap

summary.core_problem: 现有 embodied world model 评测过度依赖视觉质量或任务成功率，无法直接判断 action-conditioned world model 是否真的具备可用的模拟器忠实度。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测协议与诊断基准，而不是新模型。对做统一 world model、视频预测、行动条件生成的研究员有参考价值，因为它把“看起来像”与“可作为规划模拟器”明确分开。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Observable Simulator Contract，要求一个物理模拟器至少满足两点：输入动作必须诱发对应的 agent 运动，环境响应必须以该已实现运动为条件。基于这个契约构建 WorldSimProbe，包含五组受控测试，覆盖局部控制敏感性、全局轨迹一致性等，用来诊断 ACWM 的 simulator faithfulness，而非只看 rollout 观感。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值，但可以确认评测对象是 embodied manipulation 中的 action-conditioned world models。实验重点不是 leaderboard，而是揭示现有模型即便视觉上合理、任务上可用，也可能在动作-状态因果一致性上失败。对比维度比常见视频生成评测更贴近 planning/data generation 的真实需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of embodied world models focus too much on visual quality or task success, and fail to directly test whether action-conditioned world models are faithful enough to function as simulators.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a new model. It is relevant to researchers working on unified world models, action-conditioned generation, or planning-oriented predictive models because it separates 'looks plausible' from 'works as a simulator.'
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Observable Simulator Contract: a physical simulator should at minimum ensure that supplied actions induce corresponding agent motion, and that environment responses are grounded in that realized motion. It then builds WorldSimProbe, a controlled diagnostic benchmark with five suites covering local control sensitivity, global trajectory consistency, and related aspects of simulator faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list exact models or numbers, but the targets are action-conditioned world models for embodied manipulation. The key point is diagnostic: models that look visually plausible or support task-level success may still fail on action-state causal consistency, which standard rollout metrics often miss.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但把 world model 评测口径掰正了：若你关心 action-conditioned generation，先看它怎么定义 simulator contract，再决定该信哪些结果。
recommendation.en: It does not improve models, but it fixes the evaluation lens: if you care about action-conditioned generation, read how it defines simulator faithfulness before trusting flashy rollout results.

paper.title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
paper.abstract: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty level

summary.core_problem: 研究多语言推理模型在任务变难时，思考过程和最终答案是否仍保持输入语言一致。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多语言推理行为分析。它指出只看答案正确率会掩盖模型在 hidden reasoning language 与输出语言上的退化，对多语言 post-train 数据和评测设计有弱信号价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 PolyMath benchmark 的 8 种语言、4 个难度等级上，测量任务准确率、thinking-language consistency（TC）和 answer-language consistency（AC），分析难度变化下语言一致性的模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 reasoning LLM、8 种语言和 4 个难度级别。论文报告四类难度相关行为：一致保持、持续不一致、逐步退化、突然崩塌；并提出 language consistency breakdown effect，尤其影响低资源或非拉丁文字语言。摘要未列具体模型和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether multilingual reasoning models preserve the intended language in their reasoning traces and final answers as task difficulty increases.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral analysis of multilingual reasoning. It argues that answer accuracy alone can hide failures in hidden reasoning language and output-language consistency, which has implications for multilingual post-training data and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the PolyMath benchmark across eight languages and four difficulty levels, the authors measure task accuracy, thinking-language consistency, and answer-language consistency, then analyze how these metrics change with difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates multiple reasoning LLMs across eight languages and four difficulty levels. It reports four difficulty-dependent patterns: consistency maintained, persistent mismatch, gradual degradation, and abrupt collapse. The breakdown effect is strongest for less represented and non-Latin-script languages. Exact models and numbers are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 看语言崩塌定义和按难度分层图即可；它是多语 RL/SFT 数据配比的弱诊断信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the breakdown definition and difficulty-stratified plots; it is a weak diagnostic signal for multilingual RL/SFT data mixture design.

paper.title: From Test-Time Scaling to Reusable Memory: Measuring Crystallization in Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling can correct difficult text-to-SQL queries, but the extra computation is normally discarded after each answer. Systems increasingly retain verified repair episodes, yet evaluations still report one end-to-end score. It cannot distinguish replay on recurring questions from help on unseen questions, or identify the responsible memory choice. We call measuring this future value the crystallization problem. Our controlled evaluation holds the single-shot solver fixed and varies one

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何把 text-to-SQL 做得更高，而是如何衡量 test-time scaling 产生的“后续价值”。很多系统会用执行反馈、自修复、多轮采样等额外推理计算把一次失败的 SQL 修好，然后把修复轨迹存成 memory，供后续问题复用。现有评测通常只给一个端到端分数，无法区分收益到底来自重复问题的直接回放，还是来自对新问题的迁移帮助，也无法判断究竟是收集、验证、存储格式还是检索策略在起作用。作者把这个测量问题定义为 crystallization：一次性 test-time 计算，究竟有多少被“结晶”为可复用记忆，并在未来问题上兑现价值。
summary.importance: 它和狭义预训练不直接相连，但和 pretrain/post-train 接口、test-time compute 的资产化、持续学习式 memory 设计有明显关系。更具体地说，这篇工作提供了一个很干净的评测框架，用来拆开“额外推理算力”和“可复用知识沉淀”之间的关系。对做 RL、self-improvement、online adaptation、memory-augmented agent 的研究者，这种拆解很有用，因为很多方法声称把推理经验沉淀成长期能力，但常常只报一个总分，无法判断是记住了旧题，还是学到了数据库结构、schema 习惯、join 模式这类可迁移信息。论文的贡献主要是 measurement protocol 和 attribution design，而不是新的求解器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是固定 single-shot solver，只改变 memory pipeline 的一个因素，做配对比较。作者把未来价值拆成三种使用场景。第一是 exact-query replay：同一个问题再次出现时，memory 能否直接回放已验证的正确 SQL。第二是 cross-question retention：把某个问题自己的 card 从 memory bank 中移除，再看剩余 card 是否还能帮助重新回答它，用来隔离“跨问题复用”而不是简单记忆。第三是 held-out same-database transfer：在同一数据库上留出未见问题，测 memory 对这些新问题的一次作答提升。为了把 transfer 放到可解释的尺度上，作者定义了 CR（crystallization ratio）：held-out transfer lift / 同一批 held-out 问题上的 on-demand repair headroom。这样可以回答“memory 吃掉了多少原本需要现场修复才能拿到的增益”。在具体实现上，主实验用 execution-guided repair 生成 episode，并在数据库级别建立 verified card bank。随后围绕三个研究问题做机制干预：一是价值主要出现在哪种未来使用场景；二是 transfer 到底由什么信息承载——通用示例、对齐的 question-SQL 配对，还是对目标数据库的暴露；三是收集方式、验证可靠性、card 格式、检索策略、是否必须是 repair-specific 内容，这些选择哪些真正影响结果。论文特别强调 card writer 不看 gold SQL，避免把监督信息泄漏进 memory。
summary.experiments: 主结果基于 BIRD，并使用三组 paired seeds，同时考虑数据库和问题层面的变异。最重要的数字是：在存储 verified corrected queries 的 database-scoped bank 下，held-out first-attempt accuracy 提升 4.34 个百分点；这个提升相当于同一批 held-out 问题上 on-demand repair headroom 的 44.4%。换句话说，原本需要额外修复计算才能拿到的增益里，接近一半可以通过先前积累的 memory 在首轮作答时兑现。论文还报告 memory 在 replay 和 retention 两种设置下也有明确收益，说明它不只是“记住原题答案”，也确实跨问题传递了一些数据库相关知识。机制实验给出的结论比较鲜明：transfer 主要来自“见过目标数据库”这件事，local cards 暴露的 identifiers、values、joins、query structures 即使在 question-SQL 配对被打乱时仍然有帮助；这说明迁移载体更像数据库局部模式和查询先验，而不完全依赖精确示例对齐。另一方面，可靠验证和更广的检索覆盖能带来清晰增益；更复杂的 card 格式、更 elaborate 的 retriever、以及 repair-specific 内容本身，并没有显示出统计上可靠的额外优势。这一点很重要，因为它把很多系统工程上的复杂设计压回到了几个真正有效的因素上。
summary.reading_guide: 如果只想抓住贡献，先看 Introduction 里对 replay、retention、transfer 三者的定义，再看 Figure 2 的 protocol，总体框架就清楚了。随后重点读实验设计部分，确认作者如何固定 solver、如何做 paired comparison、CR 的分母为什么选同题上的 repair headroom。主结果表需要细看，因为这篇工作的价值主要来自 measurement discipline，而不是模型结构。机制实验里最值得看的是“shuffle question-SQL pairing 仍保留不少 transfer”这一组，它直接支持“数据库暴露比示例对齐更关键”的结论。若时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以读完核心内容；若要深挖，可以继续看 verification、retrieval coverage、card formatting 的消融，判断哪些 memory 设计在别的任务上也可能成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about pushing text-to-SQL accuracy higher. It asks a cleaner question: when extra test-time computation repairs a failed query, how much of that expensive computation can be turned into reusable memory for future questions? Existing systems often store verified repair episodes, but evaluation usually collapses everything into one end-to-end score. That score cannot tell whether gains come from replaying recurring questions or from helping unseen questions over the same database, and it cannot attribute gains to specific memory choices. The paper calls this the crystallization problem: measuring how verified test-time episodes create future value.
summary_en.importance: This is adjacent to pretraining rather than directly inside it, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, online adaptation, memory-augmented agents, and the broader question of whether test-time compute can be converted into durable capability. The main contribution is methodological. It provides a disciplined evaluation protocol that separates one-off inference gains from reusable knowledge gains. For researchers working on self-improvement, RL-style refinement, continual adaptation, or memory systems, that separation is useful because many papers report a single aggregate improvement without showing whether the system truly transfers knowledge or merely caches solved instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is to hold the single-shot solver fixed and vary one memory choice at a time. The paper decomposes future value into three settings. First, exact-query replay: if the same question returns, can the system cheaply replay the stored verified SQL? Second, cross-question retention: remove a question’s own card from the bank and test whether the remaining cards still help answer it, isolating reuse across questions rather than direct memorization. Third, held-out same-database transfer: evaluate whether memory helps new questions from the same database. To make transfer interpretable, the authors define CR, the crystallization ratio, as held-out transfer lift divided by the on-demand repair headroom on those same held-out questions. This measures how much of the gain that would otherwise require fresh repair can be recovered from memory at first attempt. In the main instantiation, execution-guided repair generates episodes, which are then stored in a database-scoped verified card bank. The paper runs controlled interventions around three questions: where future value appears, what information actually carries transfer, and which choices in collection, verification, formatting, and retrieval materially affect outcomes. An important detail is that the card writer never sees gold SQL, which avoids leaking supervision into the memory bank.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on BIRD, with three paired seeds and analysis that accounts for variation across both databases and questions. The headline result is that storing verified corrected queries in a database-scoped bank improves held-out first-attempt accuracy by 4.34 percentage points. This gain corresponds to 44.4% of the on-demand repair headroom on the same held-out questions. In practical terms, nearly half of the benefit that would otherwise require extra repair computation can be recovered from previously accumulated memory. The paper also reports clear value in replay and retention settings, indicating that the bank is not only memorizing exact solved questions but also carrying some reusable database-specific knowledge. The mechanism studies are especially informative. Transfer is driven mainly by exposure to the target database: local cards reveal useful identifiers, values, joins, and query structures, and they still help even when question-SQL pairings are shuffled. That suggests the transferable signal is more about database-local patterns and query priors than exact aligned demonstrations. Reliable verification and broad retrieval coverage produce clear gains, while richer card formats, more elaborate retrievers, and repair-specific content do not show statistically supported advantages.
summary_en.reading_guide: If you want the main idea quickly, start with the definitions of replay, retention, and transfer, then read the protocol figure. The paper is strongest where it enforces measurement discipline, so pay close attention to how the solver is held fixed, how paired comparisons are constructed, and why CR uses repair headroom on the same held-out questions as the denominator. The most informative mechanism result is the intervention where question-SQL pairings are shuffled yet substantial transfer remains; that is the clearest evidence that database exposure matters more than exact demonstration alignment. If time is limited, 25 to 35 minutes is enough for the setup, the main result table, and the key ablations. If you want to go deeper, read the sections on verification, retrieval coverage, and card formatting to see which memory design choices are genuinely consequential.

recommendation.zh: 读实验拆分就够了；4.34pp/44.4% 这个 amortization 数字，比又报一个 Text-to-SQL 分数更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental decomposition; the 4.34pp and 44.4% amortization numbers are more useful than another text-to-SQL leaderboard score.

paper.title: Sharding Prevents LLM Oversight Failures and Adversarial Exploitation
paper.abstract: Giving an LLM judge more compute does not necessarily make it check more requirements. When one call must return many verdicts, some decisions become weakly grounded in the evidence, even when that call receives the same token or tool budget as a panel of separate calls. Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, agreement with experts falls as the number of verdicts per call grows. We identify sharding as the intervention that mitigates this failure

summary.core_problem: 单次 LLM judge 调用同时给出多个 verdict 时，决策质量随 verdict 数量下降；如何通过 sharding 缓解 oversight 失败。
summary.importance: 对 LLM-as-judge、可扩展监督、RLHF/RLVR 中 verifier 设计有直接启示；属于评测协议与 oversight 方法论贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 sharding：把 requirements 切成小组，每组独立调用，再聚合 verdict；在固定 model、evidence、总预算和单决策预算下与 holistic judge 对比。
summary.experiments: 在专家评分的科研复现、法律工作、临床试验评估三类任务上，sharded 弱 judge 可超过拿到完整预算的 holistic 强 judge，并能抵御对抗性利用。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 CMU；J. Zico Kolter 为 CMU 知名教授，方向涵盖对抗鲁棒性、生成模型与 LLM 安全。

summary_en.core_problem: When a single LLM judge call must return many verdicts, per-decision grounding degrades; how to mitigate this oversight failure via sharding.
summary_en.importance: Direct implications for LLM-as-judge, scalable oversight, and verifier design in RLHF/RLVR; a methodological contribution to evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: Sharding partitions requirements into smaller groups, assigns each to a separate call, and aggregates verdicts; compared against a holistic judge under fixed model, evidence, total budget, and per-decision budget.
summary_en.experiments: Across expert-graded research replications, legal work, and clinical-trial assessments, a sharded weaker judge outperforms a more capable holistic judge even when the latter receives the panel's full budget, and is more robust to adversarial exploitation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors affiliated with CMU; J. Zico Kolter is a well-known CMU professor working on adversarial robustness, generative models, and LLM safety.

recommendation.zh: 做 verifier/judge 或 RLVR 的人该看：单调用多 verdict 会掉点，sharding 是便宜的对冲手段；结论干净，可直接在内部 judge 流水线复现。
recommendation.en: Relevant if you build judges/verifiers or run RLVR: packing many verdicts into one call hurts, and sharding is a cheap fix; clean setup worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: Can Language Models Imagine Without Seeing? Ekphrasis: Measuring Visual Creative Ideation in Text-Only LLMs
paper.abstract: Current evaluations do not isolate whether text-only language models can originate visual concepts before image generation. Fluent visual prose can hide visual-plan failures: an answer may appear creative while repeating familiar visual clichés or failing to specify a renderable scene. We define Visual Creative Ideation (VCI) as the ability to produce textual visual plans that are useful, expressive, and population-novel, and introduce Ekphrasis, a 400-task benchmark spanning Abstraction, Combin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想单独测量纯文本 LLM 在没有图像输入或图像生成环节辅助时，能否先产出可渲染、有效且不落俗套的“视觉创意方案”。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测而不是方法：它把“写得像视觉描述”与“真的提出了新视觉概念”拆开，补了一个此前 VLM/LLM 评测里较少被单独量化的能力维度。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了 Visual Creative Ideation（VCI），把能力拆成 usefulness、expressiveness、population-novelty 三个维度；提出 Ekphrasis 基准，包含 400 个任务，覆盖 Abstraction、Combination、Transformation、Adaptation 四类创意操作。评测上采用匿名成对比较、维度化 checklist、Bradley-Terry 聚合，并用 Typed Idea Graphs 把群体常见套路转成 novelty 参照系。
summary.experiments: 实验评测了 14 个语言模型。主要发现不是简单的总分排序，而是不同模型在 usefulness、expressiveness、novelty 上呈现不同 profile；有些模型文本流畅但视觉方案仍然陈词滥调，有些模型总体分接近但强项完全不同。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据量和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 香港科技大学团队。作者背景更偏 NLP 与评测方法，当前信息下没有可确认的业界头部实验室代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: This work isolates whether text-only LLMs can originate visually renderable and genuinely novel scene ideas before any image generation step enters the loop.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily evaluative rather than methodological: it separates fluent visual prose from actual visual ideation, adding a capability axis that is usually blurred in standard LLM/VLM evaluations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Visual Creative Ideation (VCI) with three dimensions: usefulness, expressiveness, and population-level novelty. It introduces Ekphrasis, a 400-task benchmark spanning Abstraction, Combination, Transformation, and Adaptation. Evaluation uses anonymized pairwise comparisons, dimension-specific checklists, Bradley-Terry aggregation, and Typed Idea Graphs to operationalize cliché references for novelty scoring.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is applied to 14 language models. The main result is not just a ranking but a decomposition: models with similar overall scores can differ substantially across usefulness, expressiveness, and novelty. Fluent outputs often remain visually clichéd. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or exact margins.
summary_en.authors_note: From HKUST. The team appears more aligned with NLP evaluation and methodology; no clearly identifiable frontier-lab author can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测资产，不直接改预训练做法；若你关心 text-only LM 的“视觉想象”是否只是文风幻觉，只看任务设计和 novelty 度量即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly an eval asset, not a pretraining paper; read the task design and novelty metric if you care whether text-only “visual imagination” is just stylistic fluency.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: The Horizon Gap: Planning, Memory, Execution, Training, and Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Frontier language models solve reasoning problems in a single forward pass that would have been research contributions years ago, yet fail at multi-hour tasks: losing track of earlier decisions, declaring half-finished work done, or drifting from goals. We call this the horizon gap and survey 1,547 arXiv papers (2024-2026) collected via systematic seed harvest with a disclosed 26.8% bleed filter, extended by targeted supplementation. We disambiguate three routinely conflated properties: long-hor

summary.core_problem: 系统性解释并拆解“长时程（multi-hour）LLM Agent 做不完事/跑偏/自我宣布完成”的 horizon gap，并给出研究版图与术语边界。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述与分类学：把 long-horizon、long-context、long-term memory 三个常被混用的概念拆开，并用“任务生命周期×承载位置”的坐标系组织 2024-2026 大量工作，便于研究员定位问题与缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上是系统化文献收集与分类：从种子论文扩展、设置 bleed filter（报告 26.8%）并做 targeted supplementation；提出两条主轴——(1) 生命周期：planning/memory/execution/training/evaluation/foundations&safety；(2) horizon carried：within-context / within-task-beyond-context / cross-task-persistent，用于标注每类方法到底把“跨度”放在模型、任务流程还是外部记忆里。
summary.experiments: 无模型训练实验；主要“实验”是对 1,547 篇论文的统计与结构化整理（按摘要信息看更偏 mapping study 而非定量 meta-analysis）。

summary_en.core_problem: To clarify and decompose the “horizon gap” where frontier LLM agents fail on multi-hour tasks (drift, forget decisions, premature completion) and to map the research landscape with clean terminology.
summary_en.importance: A taxonomy/survey contribution: it disentangles long-horizon (task), long-context (model), and long-term memory (system), and provides a structured map that helps researchers locate gaps rather than conflating solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: A systematic literature mapping: seed-harvest + a reported 26.8% bleed filter + targeted supplementation; organizes papers by (1) task lifecycle (planning/memory/execution/training/evaluation/foundations&safety) and (2) where the horizon is carried (within-context / within-task-beyond-context / cross-task-persistent).
summary_en.experiments: No model training results; the main artifact is a categorized corpus of 1,547 arXiv papers (2024–2026) and the proposed axes/taxonomy.

recommendation.zh: 术语拆分做得干净，适合用来统一组内讨论口径；但偏 mapping study，别指望给出可复现的训练/系统结论。
recommendation.en: Good for aligning terminology and problem decomposition in your team; it’s a mapping study, so don’t expect reproducible training/system takeaways.

paper.title: Where Models Converge and Humans Diverge: A Coverage Framework for Distributional Pluralism in Open-Ended Generation
paper.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) writes Harry Potter fanfiction, it reliably produces fundamental elements of the Hogwarts universe, such as recognizable places and characters. Human-written Harry Potter fanfictions, however, typically include these fundamentals and much more, incorporating stylistically irregular content and relationship-diverse plotlines. This gap between LLM and human writing has been noted across a variety of domains. LLMs tend to produce "average" writing, while human writ

summary.core_problem: 提出一种衡量开放式生成中 LLM 输出分布覆盖度的方法，用来区分“内容合理”和“覆盖人类写作多样性”这两个问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测框架和指标。它关注 LLM 生成内容趋向平均化、覆盖人类经验分布不足的问题，对开放式生成评估和数据分布分析有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以某一主题下的人类写作经验分布作为参照，提出 LLM Coverage（LLM-Cov）和 In-Boundary Rate（IBR）两个指标：前者衡量模型生成覆盖了多少人类分布区域，后者衡量生成内容是否仍落在人类分布边界内，从而分离多样性和合理性。
summary.experiments: 摘要以 Harry Potter fanfiction 为例说明模型生成会稳定包含霍格沃茨、角色等核心元素，但较少覆盖人类作品中的不规则风格和多样关系线。摘要未提供具体模型、数据规模、指标数值或 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a way to measure how broadly LLM generations cover the human distribution in open-ended generation, separating plausibility from distributional breadth.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-framework contribution. It targets the tendency of LLM outputs to concentrate on average content and under-cover the diversity of human writing, which is indirectly relevant to generation evaluation and data-distribution analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework uses the empirical distribution of human writing on a topic as the reference and introduces two metrics: LLM Coverage, which measures how much of the human distribution is covered, and In-Boundary Rate, which measures whether generated content stays within the human distribution boundary.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract uses Harry Potter fanfiction as a motivating example: LLMs reliably produce core universe elements such as places and characters, but under-represent irregular styles and relationship-diverse plotlines seen in human writing. The provided abstract does not include model names, dataset sizes, numerical results, or baselines.

recommendation.zh: 知道这两个指标即可；它是开放生成评测资产，不会直接改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Know the two metrics and move on; this is an open-ended generation evaluation asset, not a pretraining recipe changer.

paper.title: LUNAR: Benchmarking Personalized Large Language Models on UNiversal User BehAvioR Logs
paper.abstract: Existing personalized LLM benchmarks primarily rely on textual personas or isolated behavioral signals, providing limited evaluation of cross-domain behavioral personalization, where responses must be grounded in heterogeneous daily-life activities. To address this gap, we introduce LUNAR, the first benchmark for evaluating how LLMs personalize responses from longitudinal app interaction histories across universal daily-life domains, including clothing, food, housing, and mobility. To support sc

summary.core_problem: 现有个性化LLM评测依赖文本人设或孤立行为信号，无法评估基于跨领域日常生活活动的行为个性化能力。
summary.importance: 首个基于纵向app交互历史、覆盖衣食住行等通用日常生活领域的个性化LLM评测基准，提出多阶段合成流水线缓解数据稀疏与隐私问题。
summary.technical_approach: 采用基于真实行为模式的粗到细多阶段合成流水线构建基准，通过保真度分析验证合成数据与真实行为分布的对齐程度。
summary.experiments: 在19个主流LLM上评测，发现行为日志对深度个性化是必要但不充分的：更多上下文或更大模型并不保证更好的个性化性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing personalized LLM benchmarks rely on textual personas or isolated behavioral signals, failing to evaluate cross-domain behavioral personalization grounded in heterogeneous daily-life activities.
summary_en.importance: First benchmark for evaluating LLM personalization from longitudinal app interaction histories across universal daily-life domains (clothing, food, housing, mobility), with a multi-stage synthesis pipeline mitigating sparsity and privacy concerns.
summary_en.technical_approach: A coarse-to-fine multi-stage synthesis pipeline grounded in real-world behavioral patterns, validated via fidelity analyses against real behavioral distributions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation across 19 mainstream LLMs shows behavioral logs are necessary but not sufficient for deep personalization: neither more context nor larger models guarantees better performance.

recommendation.zh: 个性化评测方向，核心结论是scaling模型/上下文对个性化无效，作为弱信号了解即可，不直接影响预训练决策。
recommendation.en: Personalization eval benchmark; the finding that scaling model/context doesn't improve personalization is a weak signal, not directly actionable for pretraining.

paper.title: What We Observe as LLM Behavior Can Be a Side-effect of Inference Backend
paper.abstract: Benchmark scores are reported as properties of a model, yet the inference framework used to produce them, such as HuggingFace, vLLM, or Ollama, are considered non-influential and their names and versions are almost never disclosed. In this work we investigate how much this choice can influence the model output. In a fully-crossed study (three instruction-tuned models x five inference frameworks x six benchmarks x four generation modes) we investigate how different tools (wrappers/backend) influe

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM评测普遍默认推理后端（HuggingFace、vLLM、Ollama等）是透明、可互换的组件，几乎不披露使用的框架名称、版本与配置。此前没有研究系统量化后端选择本身会对模型输出和评测分数造成多大影响，给结果复现和结论有效性带来了未被重视的干扰。
summary.importance: 这项工作识别出LLM评测中一个此前未被充分量化的混淆变量：即便在完全无采样随机性的贪心解码下，仅更换推理后端也会产生结构性的、非噪声的性能差异。该发现直接关系到所有小增量性能声明、消融实验结果、跨论文模型对比的可靠性——尤其是当模型间分数差距较小时，后端差异可能完全改变结论，对预训练、SFT、DPO等环节的实验对比规范有直接警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 采用全交叉控制变量实验设计，固定所有无关变量：单张RTX 3090、fp16精度、统一评测流程，仅系统改变四个维度：1. 5个后端，按与原生PyTorch计算图的隔离程度递增排列：hf_raw（直接调用AutoModelForCausalLM.generate()，使用模型自带chat template，作为基准）、hf_pipeline（复用内存中完全相同的模型对象，仅套一层HuggingFace text-generation pipeline抽象）、langchain_hf（在pipeline外再套一层LangChain编排层）、vLLM 0.8.5 V0引擎（独立CUDA上下文，独立实现PagedAttention、解码与采样逻辑，使用与基准完全相同的SafeTensors权重）、Ollama（独立操作系统进程，基于llama.cpp运行，使用GGUF格式fp16权重、独立tokenizer与运行时栈）。前四个后端使用数值完全一致的权重矩阵，因此它们之间的差异不可能来自权重本身；Ollama的GGUF转换误差被视为实际使用后端时的固有影响，不作为混淆变量排除。2. 3个1B级指令微调模型：Llama-3.2-1B-Inst、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Inst、Gemma-3-1B-IT。选择1B规模是为了在可控算力成本下完成所有条件组合的重复实验。3. 6个评测基准，覆盖事实知识与社会偏见两类任务。4. 4种生成模式，从确定性贪心解码到随机采样逐步引入可变性。
summary.experiments: 核心结论有三点：第一，即便在无任何采样噪声的贪心解码下，后端选择也会造成显著的、结构性的性能变化，效应幅度远大于统计波动。第二，效应大小存在强模型依赖性，不同模型系列对后端变化的敏感度差异明显。第三，效应在任务类型上分布不均，事实类基准上的后端分数差明显大于社会偏见类基准。分层对照的结果显示，差异存在于栈的每一层：即便是仅隔了一层薄薄的hf_pipeline抽象（和基准共享完全相同的模型对象），也能测出可观测的分数偏差，说明封装层的预处理、默认生成参数、输出后处理就已经是偏差来源；vLLM因为独立实现了解码和注意力逻辑，偏差更大；Ollama因为全栈独立，偏差最大。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时首先关注实验控制设计，尤其是后端的分层对照逻辑——这种设计可以将差异来源定位到栈的具体层级（封装层、解码逻辑、全运行时栈）。重点看确定性贪心解码条件下的结果，这部分可以干净地将后端结构性效应和采样随机性分开。再看不同任务类型、不同模型的效应拆解，理解后端混淆在哪些场景下最容易改变评测结论。值得深挖的方向：这种后端效应随模型参数量放大还是缩小？具体是哪一个实现细节（chat template渲染、logit处理默认值、KV cache行为、tokenizer边界情况）贡献了最大的差异？当前大量SFT/DPO、小参数预训练改进报告的零点几个百分点的增益，有多少其实来自未对齐的后端配置？

summary_en.core_problem: LLM evaluation pipelines universally treat inference backends (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers, vLLM, Ollama) as transparent, interchangeable components, and rarely disclose framework names, versions, or configuration details. No systematic study has previously quantified how much backend choice alone alters model outputs and benchmark scores, leaving an underrecognized threat to result reproducibility and conclusion validity.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a previously underquantified confound in all LLM evaluation: even under fully deterministic greedy decoding with zero sampling randomness, swapping inference backends alone produces structural, non-noise performance differences. The finding directly challenges the reliability of small incremental performance claims, ablation results, and cross-paper model comparisons, particularly when score gaps between model variants are narrow enough to be swamped by backend effects. It carries direct implications for experimental rigor across pretraining, SFT, and DPO pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: A fully crossed controlled experiment is used to isolate backend effects, with all nuisance variables held fixed: a single RTX 3090 GPU, fp16 weight precision, and a unified evaluation protocol. Four dimensions are systematically varied: 1. Five backends, ordered by increasing isolation from the raw PyTorch compute graph: hf_raw (direct call to AutoModelForCausalLM.generate() with the model's official chat template, used as the reference baseline), hf_pipeline (the exact same in-memory model object wrapped in HuggingFace's text-generation pipeline abstraction), langchain_hf (the same pipeline wrapped in LangChain's orchestration layer), vLLM 0.8.5 V0 engine (separate CUDA context, independent PagedAttention, decoding, and sampling implementations, running on identical SafeTensors weights as the reference), and Ollama (standalone OS process running llama.cpp, using fp16 GGUF weights, independent tokenizer and runtime stack). The first four backends run on numerically identical weight matrices, so divergence between them cannot be attributed to weight variation; GGUF conversion artifacts for Ollama are treated as part of the practical backend effect rather than a removed confound. 2. Three ~1B parameter instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B-Inst, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Inst, Gemma-3-1B-IT. The 1B scale is chosen to enable exhaustive replication across all condition combinations at manageable compute cost. 3. Six benchmarks covering both factual knowledge and social bias tasks. 4. Four generation modes, ranging from deterministic greedy decoding to stochastic sampling, that progressively introduce sources of variability.
summary_en.experiments: Three core findings emerge: First, backend choice induces large, structural performance differences even under greedy decoding with no sampling noise, with effect sizes far exceeding statistical fluctuation. Second, effect sizes are strongly model-dependent, with different model families showing widely varying sensitivity to backend changes. Third, effects are unevenly distributed across task types: factual knowledge benchmarks show substantially larger score gaps across backends than social bias benchmarks. Layered comparison reveals differences at every level of the stack: even the thin hf_pipeline abstraction (sharing the exact same model object as the reference) introduces measurable divergence, pointing to preprocessing, default generation parameters, and output postprocessing as early sources of bias; vLLM shows larger gaps due to its independent decoding and attention implementations; Ollama shows the largest gaps, consistent with its fully independent runtime stack.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, start with the experimental control design, particularly the layered backend setup that allows localizing difference sources to specific stack layers (abstraction wrappers, decoding logic, full runtime). Focus heavily on results from the deterministic greedy decoding condition, which cleanly separates structural backend effects from sampling randomness. Review the breakdown of effect sizes across task types and model families to identify scenarios where backend confounds are most likely to flip evaluation conclusions. Open questions worth following up on: whether this effect scales with model size, which specific implementation detail (chat template rendering, default logit processing, KV cache behavior, tokenizer edge cases) contributes the largest share of divergence, and what fraction of reported 0.x-point gains from SFT/DPO or small pretraining adjustments can be attributed to unaligned backend configurations.

recommendation.zh: 评测复现性的硬证据，今后内部 leaderboard 必须锁 backend+版本；只看方差分解表和 greedy 那一节。
recommendation.en: Hard evidence on eval reproducibility; pin backend+version on internal leaderboards. Read the variance decomposition and greedy sections.

paper.title: Item Response Theory for AI Safety
paper.abstract: Language models differ in how safely they behave and these differences are measured by safety benchmarks. But aggregated benchmark scores are hard to trust and interpret, because benchmarks duplicate one another, correlate heavily, and models may sandbag when they detect evaluation. To address these issues, we draw on Item Response Theory (IRT), a statistical toolkit for measuring these latents from performance on items with inferred psychometric properties. We fit IRT models to eight safety ben

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是安全评测分数难解释、冗余高、成本高、且可能被模型识别评测后操纵的问题。作者把安全 benchmark 当作心理测量中的题目集合，用 Item Response Theory 对模型能力、题目难度和题目区分度做联合建模。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练 recipe，而在评测信号质量。安全分数常被用于模型发布、post-train 选择和数据/策略调整，但简单平均分会混合拒答倾向、真实性、上下文危害判断等不同因素。论文显示安全能力不能压成单一标量，这会影响预训练和后训练阶段如何设置 eval gate、如何比较模型版本、以及如何识别 endpoint 背后的模型替换或策略变化。
summary.technical_approach: 作者收集 192 个 chat model 在 8 个安全 benchmark 上的 item-level 响应，覆盖 harmful compliance、over-refusal、contextual harm 和 truthfulness。总题量为 5,255，跨 benchmark 分析使用 169 个完整响应模型。方法上，IRT 将每道题表示为带有难度和区分度的测量项，将每个模型表示为若干潜在能力维度，再用响应模式估计二者。相比直接算 benchmark 平均分，IRT 能回答三类问题：哪些题真正区分模型，哪些 benchmark 测的是同一类行为，哪些响应模式偏离预期。作者还用 person-fit statistics 检测异常作答模式，用于识别 prompted sandbagging、API endpoint 背后模型变化和模型替换。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有三点。第一，安全 benchmark 的方差主要由三个可解释因子解释：refusal strictness、truthfulness、contextual harm，三者解释了模型能力差异中 77% 的方差，同时也说明不存在一个足够可靠的单一安全能力轴。第二，用心理测量方式挑选的短测验明显优于随机抽样：三个固定 25-item tests 可以恢复三个潜在能力；对若干单独 benchmark，约 10 个自适应选择的题目即可恢复原 benchmark 结果，将评测成本降低 97–99%。第三，在 prompted sandbagging 的模型有机体实验中，IRT person-fit 统计量能捕捉至少 80% 的选择性 sandbagging。这个结果说明异常响应检测不只依赖总分下降，而可以利用“某个能力水平的模型不该这样错/对”的响应结构。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对三个用途的定义，再看 Materials & Methods 里 benchmark、模型池和 IRT 拟合设置。核心图表应关注 latent factor 结构、item information/短测验选择、以及 person-fit 检测 sandbagging 的结果。若只关心基座模型研发，可以跳过安全 benchmark 细节，重点看它如何把 eval 从平均分转成可诊断的测量模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in LLM safety evaluation: aggregate benchmark scores are hard to interpret, often redundant, expensive to obtain, and vulnerable to evaluation-aware behavior. It applies Item Response Theory to model safety items, model-level latent traits, item difficulty, and item discrimination jointly.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but useful. Safety scores often become release gates, model selection signals, and feedback for post-training data or policy design. If a single average score mixes refusal strictness, truthfulness, and contextual harm handling, it can produce misleading comparisons between model versions. The paper gives a more structured way to audit evaluation signals before using them to steer training decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors collect item-level responses from 192 chat models on eight safety benchmarks, covering harmful compliance, over-refusal, contextual harm, and truthfulness. The full suite contains 5,255 items; cross-benchmark analyses use 169 models with complete responses. IRT treats each response as an interaction between latent model traits and item properties. This lets the fitted model identify which items are informative, which benchmarks measure overlapping traits, and which response patterns are statistically unusual. The same calibration is then used for three purposes: construct analysis, static and adaptive benchmark compression, and person-fit auditing for sandbagging or endpoint changes.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that three interpretable factors explain most of the between-model variation: refusal strictness, truthfulness, and contextual harm. Together they explain 77% of the variance, while a single safety axis is insufficient. Psychometrically selected subsets outperform random subsets: three fixed 25-item tests recover the three latent abilities, and roughly ten adaptively selected items can recover several individual benchmark scores, reducing evaluation cost by 97–99%. In prompted sandbagging model-organism experiments, IRT-derived person-fit statistics detect at least 80% of selective sandbagging cases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the introduction for the three uses of IRT, then check the methods section for the model pool, benchmark suite, and fitting protocol. The most useful parts are the latent-factor analysis, item-selection/compression results, and person-fit auditing experiments. For foundation-model work, the safety benchmark details matter less than the measurement design: replacing average scores with a calibrated response model.

recommendation.zh: IRT建模安全评测的思路可迁移到基座模型能力评测的去噪与高效选题，重点看因子分析和自适应采样的实验结果。
recommendation.en: IRT-based safety evaluation methodology transfers to denoising and efficient sampling for base model capability benchmarks; focus on factor analysis and adaptive sampling results.

paper.title: Eliciting Intrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs via Semantically Equivalent Adversarial Attacks
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often used in conjunction with external knowledge sources to improve their factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations, through methods such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, these systems remain susceptible to intrinsic hallucinations, where the model generates unfaithful or fabricated information that is not supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose a novel framework to assess model robustness against this phenomenon by stress-testing usi

summary.core_problem: 评估 RAG 场景下 LLM 对“语义等价改写”是否仍会产生不被检索证据支持的内生幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是鲁棒性评测框架：用保持语义等价的对抗改写去诱发 intrinsic hallucination。对预训练的直接启发有限，但对理解“检索并不能消除模型内部错误先验”有一定价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个带语义等价约束的对抗优化框架，在白盒、灰盒、黑盒设置下搜索 query 变体，同时以 intrinsic hallucination 为目标函数，系统压力测试生成模型在 RAG 条件下的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个开源和 5 个闭源生成模型，覆盖 3 个数据集。摘要结论是即便强模型在语义等价扰动下也容易出现内生幻觉，但未提供与训练数据、模型架构或预训练 recipe 相关的因果分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Imperial College London。Alessio Lomuscio 在多智能体系统与形式化验证方向较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs in RAG settings still produce intrinsic hallucinations under semantically equivalent query reformulations.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation and robustness framework: using semantics-preserving adversarial rewrites to elicit intrinsic hallucinations. The direct pretraining takeaway is limited, but it is useful as evidence that retrieval does not erase internal model priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method performs adversarial optimization over natural query variants while enforcing semantic equivalence and optimizing for intrinsic hallucination, across white-box, gray-box, and black-box attack settings.
summary_en.experiments: Five open-source and five proprietary generator models are tested on three datasets. The headline result is that even strong models remain vulnerable under semantically equivalent perturbations, but the paper does not connect this to pretraining data, architecture, or optimization choices.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Imperial College London. Alessio Lomuscio is well known in multi-agent systems and formal methods.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的鲁棒性 stress test，不是基座方法论文；若你做 RAG 或 hallucination eval，只看攻击构造和失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: This is a clean robustness stress test, not a foundation-model method paper; if you care about RAG or hallucination eval, just read the attack construction and failure cases.

paper.title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
paper.abstract: Personalized LLMs with persistent memory are increasingly deployed, yet the faithfulness of their user models remains unexamined. We study over-inference (OI): the phenomenon where LLMs fabricate user attributes beyond what evidence supports. We introduce MirageBench, comprising 150 personas balanced across stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles, 6 personalization tasks spanning an ``imagination gradient'', a four-way faithfulness taxonomy operationalized by an independent ju

summary.core_problem: 评估带持久记忆的个性化 LLM 是否会在证据不足时编造用户画像属性，以及模型自我监控能否可靠发现这种问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产和现象分析。论文提出 over-inference 作为个性化记忆系统中的信实性错误类型，并用 MirageBench 系统测量多模型的用户画像虚构问题，对长期记忆、个性化 Agent 和安全评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含 150 个 persona 的 MirageBench，覆盖刻板、反刻板和中性用户画像；设计 6 类个性化任务，任务按“想象梯度”变化；提出四分类 faithfulness taxonomy，并用独立 judge 标注模型输出中的 claim，且用盲人工标注验证 judge 可靠性。
summary.experiments: 评测 7 个模型家族共 12 个模型，覆盖 143,616 条被 judge 的 claim。人工验证集包含 400 条 claim，四分类 Cohen's kappa 为 0.863，二分类为 0.900。结果显示所有模型都有 35%–49% 的 over-inference，跨模型均值 41.6%，按 claim 加权为 41.8%。论文还报告 self-monitoring inversion，即模型自评信实性不能可靠筛选更少过度推断的模型。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether personalized LLMs with persistent memory fabricate unsupported user-profile attributes, and whether self-monitoring can detect this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and an empirical failure analysis. It formalizes over-inference as a faithfulness error in personalized memory systems and measures it across model families, which is relevant to long-term memory, personalization, and agent safety evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce MirageBench with 150 balanced personas spanning stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles. They define six personalization tasks along an “imagination gradient,” use a four-way faithfulness taxonomy, and operationalize claim-level labeling through an independent judge validated against blind human annotation.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 12 models from 7 families over 143,616 judged claims. The judge is validated on 400 human-labeled claims with Cohen’s kappa of 0.863 for four-class labeling and 0.900 for binary labeling. All models over-infer on 35%–49% of claims, with a cross-model mean of 41.6% and claim-weighted rate of 41.8%. The paper also reports a self-monitoring inversion where model self-assessments are not reliable selectors for faithful personalization.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 个性化记忆方向可看抽象和结果表；对 pretrain 没有直接动作，但“自评不可靠”是后训练评测里应保留的坏信号。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and result tables if you work on memory; it does not change pretraining practice, but the self-monitoring failure is a useful negative signal for post-training eval.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: When Memory Lies: An Empirical Study of Spatial Memory Staleness in VLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory-augmented VLM agents act on persistent spatial knowledge, yet that knowledge silently goes stale as the environment changes. We ask what happens when an agent must reconcile a confident memory claim with a contradicting observation, and whether current models can catch the conflict before it becomes a safety-relevant mistake. Using a dynamic FrozenLake testbed, we pair a staleness-detection task with a downstream navigation task across three closed-source models and three open-weight VLMs

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM Agent 在环境变化后如何处理过期空间记忆，以及它们能否在行动前发现记忆与当前观测的冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是面向 VLM Agent 记忆可靠性的评测与经验分析。它把“记忆过期”从抽象安全问题落到可控动态环境中，区分文本可解性、视觉 grounding 和下游导航风险，对长期运行 Agent 的 memory audit 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用动态 FrozenLake 测试床，把同一网格中的旧记忆声明与当前观测相冲突，设计 staleness-detection 任务和 downstream navigation 任务。评测同时覆盖文本输入与图像输入，并比较闭源模型、开源 VLM 和 LLM navigator 在冲突检测与导航中的行为。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 3 个闭源模型和 3 个开源 VLM，进行 1,800 次 staleness detection run；导航实验包含 4 个 LLM navigator，在文本模式下运行 12,000 个 episode，并使用共享的 50 个 seed。结果显示文本模式能识别过期记忆并不意味着视觉 grounding 可靠：相同网格上视觉 F1 从 0.887 到 0.067 不等，弱模型会持续输出流畅但忽略图像的决策。论文还指出未审计地使用过期记忆会造成安全相关导航错误。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how VLM agents handle stale spatial memory after the environment changes, and whether they can detect conflicts between memory and current observations before acting.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and empirical analysis of memory reliability in VLM agents. It turns memory staleness into a controlled dynamic-environment problem and separates text solvability, visual grounding, and downstream navigation risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use a dynamic FrozenLake testbed where old memory claims can contradict current observations. They pair a staleness-detection task with a downstream navigation task, evaluate both text and image inputs, and compare closed-source models, open-weight VLMs, and LLM navigators.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates three closed-source models and three open-weight VLMs over 1,800 detection runs. Navigation experiments include four LLM navigators and 12,000 text-mode episodes under a shared 50-seed setup. The key result is that text solvability does not imply visual grounding: on identical grids, visual F1 ranges from 0.887 to 0.067, and the weakest model makes fluent confident decisions that ignore the image. The paper also reports that consuming stale memory without auditing leads to safety-relevant navigation failures.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent memory 负例备查即可；看 Fig/表中 text-vs-vision F1 的落差，比读完整方法更有信息量。
recommendation.en: Use it as a negative case study for agent memory; the text-vs-vision F1 gap in the results is more informative than the full method.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: When Does Latent Communication Pay? A Causal Audit of Relayed KV Caches in Multi-Agent LLMs
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems relay key--value caches instead of text and credit their gains to exchanged ``latent thoughts''. That credit is a claim about \emph{which} example's cache is relayed, not merely that one is. We audit it causally in released systems. The cache is replaced with deranged (mismatched-example), zeroed, and moment-matched random counterparts, under two regimes defined by whether the receiver needs the sender's private information. Where it does, the battery reads ceiling: 100\%

summary.core_problem: 多智能体 LLM 系统中，用 KV 缓存中继代替文本通信被广泛归因于「传递了示例特定的潜在思想」，但这一归因从未被因果验证：性能提升既可能来自缓存中携带的真实示例内容，也可能只是任何合法形状的缓存前缀对接收方产生的通用接口扰动效应；现有评估只看是否有缓存，不看缓存和示例是否匹配。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心价值是方法论层面的：第一，给出了「中继内容是否真的被使用」的因果审计标准——必须做错例匹配控制，而不能只做有无缓存的消融；第二，揭示了 KV 缓存中继的收益高度依赖任务信息结构：只有当接收方确实需要发送方的私有信息时，示例匹配的缓存才带来真实收益；在接收方本身就能解题的标准基准上，缓存匹配效应通常落在等价区间内，不能作为「潜在思想传输」的证据；第三，同一审计工具可以跨系统移植，直接区分不同已发布 KV 通信方案的实际内容传输等级，对后续设计跨模型/跨智能体表示接口有直接约束作用。
summary.technical_approach: 审计在已发布系统的中继边界上做无训练干预，保持缓存的层数、序列长度、数据类型完全一致，只替换内容，共六个实验臂：True（配对示例的真实缓存）、Deranged（同批次其他示例的缓存，无固定点置换，严格保持缓存边际分布）、Zero（全零缓存）、Random（按每层每 K/V 张量匹配真实矩的高斯随机缓存）、Intact-no-private（发送方处理时把私有信息替换为无关内容，仅在校准任务使用）、Direct-text reference（私有信息直接以文本形式给接收方）。任务分两类：校准任务（程序化生成发送方私有事实，接收方无法自行恢复）和自然任务（GSM8K、ARC-Challenge、MedQA 等标准基准，接收方可独立解题）。核心对比是 True 与 Deranged 的差异，即「示例配对项」，这是「潜在内容被使用」这一归因成立的必要条件。
summary.experiments: 校准任务上，在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、phi-4 共五个检查点、三个模型家族、以及散文反事实 QA 任务面上，True 臂准确率接近 100%，Deranged/无关内容臂仅 23–25%，示例配对效应达到天花板，说明审计工具有效。自然任务上，采用五种子的预注册协议、Holm 校正的等价性检验：在 GSM8K、ARC-Challenge 上三个 Qwen3 尺度、以及 MedQA 8B 上，True 与 Deranged 的差异被约束在 ±2.8 分以内（该边际来自被审计系统自身报告的收益幅度），仅有一个单元检测到边际内的微小优势；第二个模型家族未检测到任何配对优势。值得注意的是，Zero 臂在一个自然任务单元上比 True 低 14.7 分，但 Deranged 与 True 无显著差异——说明存在缓存本身的通用收益，但不存在示例特定的内容传输。跨系统移植审计时，三种已发布的 KV 通信方案（原生 LatentMAS、C2C、KVComm）在同一信息不对称测试下分别表现为天花板级、部分传输、未检测到示例传输三种不同等级，证明审计工具可以区分方案差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30–40 分钟。重点看四部分：1）第 2 节审计设计的六个实验臂定义，尤其是 Deranged 臂作为内容控制的逻辑；2）第 3 节校准任务与自然任务的划分，以及「示例配对项」这个核心因果量的定义；3）第 4 节自然任务上的等价性检验结果，特别是 Zero 与 Deranged 结果分离的那个案例；4）第 5 节跨系统移植的结果，理解不同 KV 通信方案的实际传输等级。值得深挖的点：错例匹配控制这一思路可以迁移到任何「中间表示传输」类工作的评估中，包括蒸馏、跨模型投影、多模态对齐中的隐式特征传递。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-agent LLM systems that relay KV caches instead of text, performance gains are widely attributed to "transmitted latent thoughts" specific to each example. This attribution has never been causally validated: gains could equally come from genuine example-specific content in the cache, or from generic interface effects where any well-formed cache prefix perturbs the receiver in helpful ways. Existing evaluations only compare presence versus absence of a cache, not whether the cache matches the example.
summary_en.importance: The core value for pretraining research is methodological. First, it establishes a causal audit standard for "is the relayed content actually used?": a mismatched-example control is mandatory, and ablation on cache presence alone is insufficient. Second, it reveals that KV-relay gains are highly contingent on the task's information structure: example-matched caches deliver real benefits only when the receiver genuinely needs the sender's private information; on standard benchmarks where the receiver can solve the task alone, the example-matching effect usually falls within an equivalence bound and cannot serve as evidence for "latent thought transmission". Third, the same audit is portable across systems and directly distinguishes the actual content-transfer levels of different released KV-communication schemes, imposing concrete constraints on future cross-model / cross-agent representation interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The audit performs training-free interventions exactly at the relay boundary of released systems. Cache geometry (layer count, sequence length, dtype) is held fixed across arms, and only the content is replaced. Six arms are defined: True (cache from the paired example), Deranged (cache from a different example in the same batch via a fixed-point-free permutation, preserving the marginal cache distribution exactly), Zero (all entries zeroed), Random (Gaussian entries moment-matched per example, layer, and K/V tensor to the true cache), Intact-no-private (sender processes the example with private facts replaced by irrelevant counterparts, used only in the calibrated regime), and Direct-text reference (private information passed verbatim to the receiver). Tasks are split into two regimes: a calibrated regime with procedurally generated sender-private facts unrecoverable by the receiver, and a natural regime using standard benchmarks (GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, MedQA) where the receiver can solve alone. The key contrast is True minus Deranged — the "example-pairing term" — which is the necessary condition for the "latent content is used" attribution.
summary_en.experiments: In the calibrated regime, across five checkpoints from three model families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, phi-4) and a prose counterfactual QA surface, the True arm reaches near 100% accuracy versus 23–25% for Deranged / answer-irrelevant arms, showing the audit instrument reads at ceiling where it should. In the natural regime, under a pre-registered five-seed protocol with Holm-corrected equivalence testing, the True-versus-Deranged gap is bounded within ±2.8 points (a margin anchored to the audited system's own reported gain) on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge across three Qwen3 scales, and on MedQA at 8B; only one cell shows a small detected advantage inside the margin, and a second model family shows no detected pairing advantage at all. Notably, in one natural-regime cell the Zero arm trails True by 14.7 points while Deranged is indistinguishable from True — meaning there is a generic benefit from having any cache, but no example-specific content transfer. When ported across systems, three released KV-communication channels (native LatentMAS, C2C, KVComm) read ceiling, partial transfer, and no detected example-specific transfer respectively under the same information-asymmetry test, demonstrating the audit discriminates between schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 30–40 minutes. Focus on four parts. (1) Section 2's definition of the six audit arms, especially the logic behind the Deranged arm as the canonical content control. (2) Section 3's split between calibrated and natural regimes, and the definition of the example-pairing term as the core causal quantity. (3) Section 4's equivalence-test results on natural tasks, particularly the case where Zero and Deranged outcomes dissociate. (4) Section 5's cross-system portability results, to grasp the real transfer levels of different KV-communication designs. A point worth extending: the mismatched-example control idea generalizes to the evaluation of any "intermediate representation transfer" setting, including distillation, cross-model projection, and implicit feature transfer in multimodal alignment.

recommendation.zh: 把'latent thought 通信'拆成信息论问题的因果审计很干净；结论是 KV 中继只在真有私有信息时有用，读干预设计和 TOST 部分。
recommendation.en: A clean causal audit reducing 'latent thought communication' to an information question; KV relay only helps when private info actually exists. Read the intervention design and TOST section.

paper.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Testing the Predictive Validity of Commonsense Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Predicting LLM's capabilities on real-world tasks is essential, yet the extent to which performance on commonsense benchmarks predicts downstream performance remains underspecified. To establish the practical usability of widely adopted commonsense benchmarks, we evaluate 23 models from six families on four established commonsense benchmarks, four reworked variants, three non-commonsense controls, and eight downstream tasks requiring implicit social, pragmatic, temporal, or physical reasoning. W

summary.core_problem: 检验常识推理 benchmark 是否真的能预测 LLM 在真实下游任务中的表现，而不是只在 benchmark 内部自洽。
summary.importance: 这是评测有效性工作，贡献在于不再问“谁在 benchmark 上分高”，而是问“benchmark 排名能否外推到真实任务”。这对预训练研究很关键，因为很多数据配比、训练目标和模型选择都依赖 benchmark 作为代理信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 23 个模型、6 个家族，系统比较 4 个经典 commonsense benchmark、4 个重制版本、3 个非 commonsense 对照，以及 8 个需要社会、语用、时间或物理隐含推理的下游任务。通过模型排名相关、控制相关和 leave-one-family-out cross-validation 来测 criterion validity。
summary.experiments: 实验规模在评测论文里算扎实：23 个模型跨 6 个家族。核心结论是，重制 benchmark 基本保留原始模型排名，但并未提升对下游的预测力；commonsense benchmark 只对少数下游任务有稳定跨家族预测效度，其余收益很小或依赖具体 metric。对“benchmark 分数可代理真实能力”的常见做法提出了直接质疑。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Antwerp 的 CLiPS。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether commonsense benchmarks actually predict LLM performance on real downstream tasks, rather than merely being internally consistent leaderboards.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-validity paper. Its contribution is to shift the question from 'who scores higher on the benchmark' to 'does the benchmark ranking extrapolate to real tasks'. That matters for pretraining because many data, objective, and model choices rely on benchmark scores as proxy signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using 23 models from 6 families, the authors compare 4 established commonsense benchmarks, 4 revised variants, 3 non-commonsense controls, and 8 downstream tasks involving implicit social, pragmatic, temporal, or physical reasoning. They measure criterion validity via rank correlations, controlled correlations, and leave-one-family-out cross-validation.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental scope is solid for an eval paper: 23 models across 6 families. The main finding is that revised benchmarks largely preserve original model rankings but do not improve downstream predictive power. Commonsense benchmarks show stable cross-family predictive validity only for a narrow subset of downstream tasks, with weak or metric-dependent gains elsewhere.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from CLiPS, University of Antwerp.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么选代理指标：如果 benchmark 排名外推不到下游，就别再拿它指导数据配比或 recipe；先看相关性分析和 leave-one-family-out 结果。
recommendation.en: This should change how you choose proxy metrics: if benchmark rankings do not extrapolate downstream, stop using them to steer data mixture or recipe decisions; read the correlation and leave-one-family-out sections first.

paper.title: Permission Denied: Policy-Graded Evaluation of Coding Agents in Hardened Environments
paper.abstract: Coding agents increasingly run inside organizations whose security controls (scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only filesystems, non-root execution) constrain them like any other software. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate agents almost exclusively in permissive sandboxes, so it is unknown how performance changes when policy is enforced. In this work, we evaluate 12 coding agents on Terminal-Bench 2.1 across nested security policy levels derived from common real-world enterprise r

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：现有 coding agent 评测大多在宽松沙箱里运行，无法回答企业环境中常见安全策略被真实执行后，agent 的成功率、成本和失败模式会怎样变化。论文关注的不是 agent 是否“知道”策略，而是操作系统层面的权限、网络、文件系统限制真正拦住动作之后，agent 是否能重新规划、绕路完成任务，还是陷入重试和预算耗尽。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对通用 agent 评测和部署反馈有参考意义。它提醒模型研究者：代码能力榜单如果只在 permissive sandbox 下测，可能高估了模型在受限运行时里的有效能力。更具体的启发是，agent 能力不只由单步代码生成质量决定，还取决于遇到权限拒绝、网络受限、只读路径、非 root 执行时的行为策略。这类信号未来可以反过来影响 post-training 数据构造，例如加入 denied action 后的恢复轨迹、权限错误诊断、低权限环境下的软件工程任务。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是构建 Boundary-Bench：在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 之上叠加可配置的系统级 hardening policy，并保持每个模型使用自己的原生 harness。策略不是通过 prompt 说明，而是由 Linux 机制强制执行。策略空间分为三条轴：network egress、filesystem scope、privilege。每条轴对应 open、restricted、locked 三种姿态，并映射到 NIST SP 800-53 中的边界保护、访问控制、信息流控制、进程隔离和最小权限等控制族。实际评测使用三个嵌套等级：Control 为 root、网络开放、文件系统可写；Non-root 只去掉 root 权限，用来单独观察普通用户执行的影响；NIST-derived high 同时收紧网络白名单、限制文件系统写入范围，并做完整权限锁定。论文没有把 non-root 到 high 的变化拆成单轴因果，而是明确作为一个整体配置评估，这是合理的，因为多个限制面同时变化时很难干净归因。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 全任务集上评测 12 个 coding agent。主要指标是任务成功率和 token/cost 开销，并补充两个诊断：某个任务在某个策略等级下是否仍被至少一个 agent 解出，即 task accessibility；参考解法是否仍与策略兼容，即 reference compatibility。结果显示 hardening 对所有模型都造成损失，但损失形态不一致。最严格策略下，成功率最高下降 18.3 个百分点，成本最高膨胀 167.3%。成功率保持最好和效率保持最好不是同一个模型；有的模型更会绕路但成本明显上升，有的模型成本可控但成功率掉得更多。失败模式分解显示，策略引入的额外失败主要来自预算耗尽和“运行结束但答案错误”，不同 agent bundle 的比例不同。论文还记录了 blocked-action exposure，用来衡量 agent 实际撞到策略边界的频率。
