summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Boundary-Bench 设计部分，尤其是三条 policy axis、三个嵌套 policy level，以及为什么不做单轴归因。实验部分优先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 success–cost Pareto frontier 如何随策略收紧移动；再看 Table 3 的失败模式和 blocked-action exposure。Appendix A 可快速扫一遍，确认网络白名单、只读目录和权限锁定的具体实现。对预训练研究者，最值得保留的是评测信号：权限拒绝后的恢复能力可能是 coding agent post-training 中被低估的数据维度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a gap in coding-agent evaluation: most benchmarks run agents in permissive sandboxes, while deployed enterprise environments enforce scoped credentials, restricted egress, read-only paths, and non-root execution. The key question is not whether an agent can recite a policy, but how its success rate, cost, and failure behavior change when the operating system actually denies actions during task execution.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful for agent evaluation and for understanding deployment-derived training signals. It shows that unconstrained coding-agent scores can misrepresent real operating points under security controls. For model training, the useful signal is behavioral: agents differ in how they respond to denied actions, missing privileges, blocked network access, and read-only filesystems. Such trajectories could inform post-training data for robust coding agents, especially recovery after permission errors and planning under least-privilege constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Boundary-Bench, a hardening layer over Terminal-Bench 2.1. Policies are enforced by native Linux mechanisms rather than by natural-language instructions. The policy space has three axes: network egress, filesystem scope, and privilege. Each axis has open, restricted, and locked postures, mapped to relevant NIST SP 800-53 control families such as boundary protection, access control, information-flow control, process isolation, and least privilege. The evaluation uses three nested levels: Control, where the agent runs as root with open network and writable filesystem; Non-root, which isolates the effect of dropping root privileges; and NIST-derived high, which combines an egress allow-list, a mostly read-only filesystem with a small writable set, and full privilege lockdown. The jump from Non-root to the high setting is treated as a whole configuration rather than decomposed into per-axis causal effects, which is appropriate given the coupled nature of these restrictions.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 12 coding agents on the full Terminal-Bench 2.1 task set. The main metrics are task success and token/cost usage. Two secondary diagnostics are added: task accessibility, measuring whether any evaluated agent can solve a task under a policy level, and reference-solution compatibility, measuring whether the canonical solution remains feasible under that policy. Hardening hurts every model-harness bundle, but not uniformly. Under the strictest policy, success losses reach 18.3 percentage points and cost inflation reaches 167.3%. The model that best preserves success is also the one that loses the most efficiency, so policy changes the success-cost frontier and can change model choice. Failure decomposition attributes the additional failures mainly to budget exhaustion and completed-but-wrong solutions, with different proportions across bundles. The paper also measures blocked-action exposure at the enforcement boundary.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Boundary-Bench design, especially the three policy axes, the nested policy levels, and the decision not to over-attribute the high-policy effect to individual axes. Then read the main success-cost plots in Figure 1 and Figure 2 to see how the Pareto frontier moves as policies tighten. Table 3 is useful for the failure-mode breakdown and blocked-action exposure. Appendix A is worth a quick check for the concrete allow-list, read-only paths, and privilege-lockdown implementation. The main takeaway for pretraining-oriented readers is that recovery from runtime denials is a distinct behavioral capability that standard coding benchmarks often miss.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表和失败分解就够：它把“最小权限”变成评测主轴，且揭示 success 与 cost 在硬化下强解耦，训练目标可能得改。
recommendation.en: Just read the main tables and failure breakdown: it makes least-privilege hardening a primary eval axis and shows success vs cost decouple sharply—your training objective may need to reflect that.

paper.title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. We introduce HazMart, a human-written dat

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型的Chain-of-Thought推理轨迹用于模型监控时存在根本张力：模型需要足够高的忠实度（输出严格由推理轨迹推导而来）才能被有效监控，同时又需要足够的鲁棒性，在推理轨迹指向有害行为时能够拒绝执行。此前没有工作系统量化这一忠实度与安全性的权衡关系。
summary.importance: 明确了推理模型的忠实度并非越高越好，而是与安全性存在明确的权衡，这对推理模型的对齐目标设计、RL训练流程都有直接参考价值。提出的Targeted Reasoning Replacement方法相比传统基于prompt提示的忠实度评估，能更准确地衡量推理轨迹与模型行为之间的因果关系。白盒表征分析的结果也为理解推理模型的对齐机制、表征操控提供了新的依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究构建了HazMart数据集，包含77个人工编写的场景、覆盖11个危害类别，模型在其中扮演AI店主，通过函数调用与环境交互；每个场景设置两个等价的安全选项和一个有害选项。核心评估方法为Targeted Reasoning Replacement：不在输入prompt中加入偏置提示，而是直接替换模型自身生成的推理轨迹中的关键内容——将指向某一安全选项的推理内容替换为指向另一安全选项（用于测量忠实度），或替换为指向有害选项（用于测量安全性），以此检验模型是否会跟随修改后的推理轨迹行动。此外还通过白盒探测和表征操控，定位残差流中控制忠实度与安全性的表征方向。
summary.experiments: 在被测模型中，QwQ-32B的安全表现最好，能拒绝73.88%的有害推理轨迹，但忠实度仅为74.7%，即仅在74.7%的情况下会跟随修改后的安全推理行动。DeepSeek-R1_Llama-70B的忠实度很高，97.5%的情况下会跟随修改后的安全推理，但仅能拒绝12.3%的有害推理，基本盲目遵循推理轨迹的结论。整体来看，模型忠实度越高，跟随有害推理的概率也越高，两者呈正相关。对QwQ-32B的白盒分析发现，残差流中存在反相关的两个表征方向，分别控制模型对推理轨迹的遵循与抵抗；在动作提交token处，安全方向的预测AUROC为0.94，忠实度方向为0.78。放大安全方向的表征可使安全行为提升9个百分点，同时不损失核心推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中对忠实度-安全性张力的问题定义、Targeted Reasoning Replacement方法的设计逻辑（与传统基于prompt的忠实度评估的差异），以及不同模型的对比结果。从事对齐或推理模型可解释性研究的读者可进一步关注白盒表征分析部分。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces are used for monitoring Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), a fundamental tension arises: models need sufficient faithfulness (outputs strictly derived from reasoning traces) to be monitorable, but also sufficient robustness to reject execution when reasoning traces point to harmful behavior. This faithfulness-safety tradeoff has not been systematically quantified in prior work.
summary_en.importance: The work clarifies that higher faithfulness is not universally beneficial for reasoning models, and that an explicit tradeoff exists between faithfulness and safety. This has direct implications for the design of alignment objectives and training recipes for reasoning models, including RL-based alignment. The proposed Targeted Reasoning Replacement method provides a more rigorous measure of the causal link between reasoning traces and model behavior, compared to traditional prompt-hint based faithfulness evaluation. The white-box representation analysis findings also inform research on alignment mechanisms and representation steering in reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The HazMart dataset is constructed with 77 human-written scenarios across 11 harm categories, where the model acts as an AI shopkeeper interacting with the environment via function calls. Each scenario includes two equivalent safe options and one harmful option. The core evaluation method, Targeted Reasoning Replacement, does not add biasing hints to input prompts. Instead, it directly replaces key content in the model's own generated reasoning trace: references to one safe choice are swapped with references to the other safe choice (for faithfulness measurement) or to the harmful choice (for safety measurement), to test whether the model follows the modified trace. White-box probing and representation steering are also used to identify residual stream directions that control faithfulness and safety.
summary_en.experiments: Among evaluated models, QwQ-32B achieves the best safety performance, rejecting 73.88% of unsafe reasoning traces, but has a faithfulness rate of only 74.7% — it follows modified safe reasoning in 74.7% of cases. DeepSeek-R1_Llama-70B has high faithfulness, following modified safe reasoning in 97.5% of cases, but rejects only 12.3% of unsafe reasoning, essentially blindly adhering to reasoning trace conclusions. Overall, higher model faithfulness correlates with a higher probability of following unsafe reasoning. White-box analysis on QwQ-32B identifies anti-correlated residual stream directions that control reasoning compliance and resistance, respectively. At the action-commit token, the safety direction has a prediction AUROC of 0.94, and the faithfulness direction has an AUROC of 0.78. Amplifying the safety direction improves safe behavior by 9 percentage points without impairing core reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing of the faithfulness-safety tension in the introduction, the design logic of Targeted Reasoning Replacement (and its differences from traditional prompt-based faithfulness evaluation), and the cross-model comparison results. Researchers working on alignment or reasoning model interpretability may further explore the white-box representation analysis section. Estimated reading time is 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 TRR setup 和 DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B 结果；它会影响你对“可监控 CoT”的安全 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the TRR setup and the DeepSeek-R1-Llama-70B results; it should update priors on monitorable CoT safety.

paper.title: ConlangBench: Exploring Language Knowledge and Learning in LLMs through Diverse Constructed Languages
paper.abstract: Constructed languages (conlangs) are intentionally created human languages with a rich tradition of linguistic creativity. Despite their potential for studying language learning in large language models (LLMs), existing conlangs remain largely underexplored in LLM research. We present ConlangBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating and training LLMs on 21 existing conlangs. We collect over 21M conlang-English parallel sentence pairs (including 430K pairs across the 20 non-Esperanto

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想用构造语言（conlangs）建立一个更可控的测试床，评估并训练 LLM 的语言知识与语言学习能力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark/data asset。构造语言的价值在于其设计动机和语言属性更可控，适合研究模型对词汇来源、语法设计、数据规模的敏感性。对预训练研究员来说，它更像一个可控实验平台，而不是直接改进 pretrain 方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ConlangBench，收集 21 种现有构造语言与英语之间的 2100 多万平行句对，以及 32.1 万词汇条目。实验主要做双向翻译和学习曲线分析，比较 a posteriori conlangs（词汇源自自然语言）与其他类型构造语言的可学性差异，并观察在有足够语料时模型能否学会这些语言。
summary.experiments: 数据规模上，21M 平行句对中大部分来自 Esperanto，20 种非 Esperanto conlangs 合计约 43 万句对。结果显示模型在 a posteriori conlangs 上表现更好；对 8 种语料足够的构造语言，模型可以学会，但学习曲线因语言设计方式不同而有差异。实验更偏 translation benchmark，而不是大模型预训练主线。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yonsei University 和 Seoul National University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses constructed languages as a controlled testbed to evaluate and train LLMs on language knowledge and language learning.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark/data asset. Constructed languages are attractive because their design properties are more controllable than natural languages, making them useful for studying sensitivity to lexical origin, grammar design, and data scale. For pretraining researchers, this is more of an experimental platform than a direct pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ConlangBench, collecting over 21 million conlang-English parallel sentence pairs across 21 existing constructed languages, plus 321k vocabulary entries. They run bidirectional translation and learning-curve analyses, comparing a posteriori conlangs—whose vocabularies derive from natural languages—against other conlang types, and testing whether models can learn them when enough data is available.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 21M parallel pairs, though most come from Esperanto, while the 20 non-Esperanto conlangs together contribute about 430k pairs. Models perform better on a posteriori conlangs, and can learn all eight conlangs with sufficient data, with learning curves varying by language design. The setup is more translation-benchmark-oriented than core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Yonsei University and Seoul National University.

recommendation.zh: 作为可控语言学习 testbed 值得知道，但离基座 recipe 很远；看数据构成和学习曲线结论就够，不必细读方法。
recommendation.en: Useful to know as a controlled language-learning testbed, but far from core pretraining; skim the dataset composition and learning-curve findings, then move on.

paper.title: Evaluation Blindness: How Silent Measurement Failures Corrupt AI Systems from Training to Deployment
paper.abstract: AI systems can fail silently. The failure propagates through training loops, evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring stacks until downstream harm makes it visible. This paper introduces evaluation blindness: a measurement function M exhibits evaluation blindness with respect to failure class F when it produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing, with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap.   The problem surfaces at two lifecycle stages the

summary.core_problem: AI系统的测量函数在系统实际失败时仍输出与健康状态不可区分的读数，这种'评估盲'（evaluation blindness）如何在训练和部署阶段被统一形式化与检测？
summary.importance: 将训练时（reward model被game、重要性采样静默算错、benchmark污染）和部署时（六类生产失败，含结构性100%静默的Operational类）的silent failure统一到一个可检测性谓词下；属于概念形式化与分类学贡献，对理解reward hacking和训练信号质量有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 定义evaluation blindness的形式化检测谓词：测量函数M对失败类F表现为评估盲，当且仅当系统实际失败时M的读数与健康状态不可区分且无辅助信号标记差异；将训练和部署两个生命周期阶段的失败纳入统一框架分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告具体实验；主要为形式化定义与失败分类（训练时三类、部署时六类），其中Operational类被论证为结构性100%静默。

summary_en.core_problem: How to formalize and detect 'evaluation blindness' — where a measurement function produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing — across both training and deployment stages.
summary_en.importance: Unifies training-time failures (reward model gaming, silent importance-sampling miscalculation, benchmark contamination) and deployment-time failures (six production failure classes, including an Operational category that is 100% silent by structural definition) under a single detectability predicate; a conceptual and taxonomic contribution relevant to reward hacking and training signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a formal detectability predicate for evaluation blindness: measurement M is blind to failure class F iff its readings are indistinguishable from a healthy state during actual failure with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap; analyzes training and deployment failures within this unified framework.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experiments reported in abstract; primarily formal definitions and failure taxonomy (three training-time classes, six deployment-time classes), with the Operational class argued to be structurally 100% silent.

recommendation.zh: 概念框架有用但缺LLM-specific实证，reward hacking和contamination部分可当检查清单扫一眼，不必通读。
recommendation.en: Useful conceptual framework but lacks LLM-specific evidence; skim the reward hacking and contamination sections as a checklist, no need to read in full.

paper.title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
paper.abstract: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA

summary.core_problem: 黑盒语言模型的成员推断（MIA）评估长期依赖聚合 ROC-AUC，但该指标已被证明会被成员/非成员的表面文本分布差异所混淆；同时现有采样类攻击缺乏统一的概率框架，且聚合指标无法捕捉单条训练数据的逐字泄露（如个人标识符提取）这一真实隐私危害。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据隐私审计有直接方法价值：一是将采样类 MIA 统一为输出分布泛函估计的视角，澄清了采样信号在聚合分类上的真实增益边界；二是指出隐私审计应从聚合 AUC 转向逐文档提取率，这一指标更贴近版权合规、PII 泄露检测的实际需求。
summary.technical_approach: 将给定前缀下的 N 次独立采样视为模型条件输出分布的经验估计，把三类采样泄露信号（与真实续写的平均重叠、极端重叠值、采样间自集中度）统一为该经验分布的泛函。沿用 Das 等人的盲基线校验范式，在成员/非成员同分布的基准上对比采样泛函与不访问模型的盲分类器（词袋、日期检测）的性能差异；进一步在包含真实邮箱、电话的 Pile 文档子集上做逐文档提取实验，通过错配前缀对照排除模型的通用生成能力干扰。
summary.experiments: WikiMIA 上盲词袋分类器 AUC 达 0.97（5% FPR 下 TPR 0.90），采样信号无额外增益；MIMIR 的 IID 切分上时间盲探针降至接近随机（AUC 0.56），但所有采样泛函相对残差盲基线的增量 AUC 95% 置信区间均包含 0，聚合分类无显著提升。在 500 条含真实标识符的 Pile 文档上，对 Pythia-6.9B 黑盒采样可逐字复现 83 条（16.6%）的标识符，其中邮箱提取率 21.3%；提取对温度、核采样参数不敏感，16 token 前缀即可触发，所需采样量与前缀长度负相关。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节的泛函统一框架与第 5 节的逐文档提取实验。第 4 节的盲基线对比用于建立评估规范，可快速浏览；附录中的采样预算与前缀长度的定量关系值得关注。预计阅读时间 40-50 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Membership inference (MIA) on black-box language models has long relied on aggregate ROC-AUC, a metric confounded by surface-level distributional gaps between member and non-member documents. Existing sampling-based attacks also lack a unifying probabilistic framework, and aggregate metrics fail to capture the concrete privacy harm of verbatim extraction of individual training records such as personal identifiers.
summary_en.importance: The work provides actionable methodology for pretraining data privacy audits. It unifies sampling-based MIA under a functional-estimation lens and clarifies the marginal gain of sampling signals for aggregate classification. More importantly, it argues that privacy audits should shift from aggregate AUC to per-document extraction rate, which aligns with real-world requirements of copyright compliance and PII leakage detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treat N independent samples drawn under a given prefix as an empirical estimate of the model's conditional output distribution. Three sampling leakage signals — mean overlap with the held-out continuation, extreme overlap value, and self-concentration among samples — are formalized as functionals of this empirical distribution. Following the blind-baseline discipline from Das et al., sampling functionals are compared against model-free blind classifiers (bag-of-words, date detection) on benchmarks with identically distributed members and non-members. A controlled verbatim extraction experiment is run on a Pile subset containing real emails and phone numbers, with a mismatched-prefix control to rule out generic generation capability.
summary_en.experiments: On WikiMIA, a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds no measurable gain. On the IID MIMIR split, a temporal blind probe collapses to near-chance (AUC 0.56), yet no sampling functional yields a significant incremental AUC over the residual blind baseline (95% CI includes 0). Across 500 Pile documents with real identifiers, black-box sampling from Pythia-6.9B reproduces the exact identifier for 83 documents (16.6%), with 21.3% extraction rate for emails. Extraction is insensitive to temperature and nucleus settings, triggers with a 16-token prefix, and the required sample budget scales inversely with prefix length.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the unifying functional framework and Section 5 for the per-document extraction results. Section 4 establishes the evaluation baseline and can be skimmed. The quantitative relation between sample budget and prefix length in the appendix is worth checking. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把 MIA 评估从聚合 AUC 拉回到可复现的 blind baseline 对照，结论可信；做数据脱敏或成员推断时应直接看尾部逐字提取表。
recommendation.en: A useful corrective to inflated MIA numbers: always compare against blind baselines and inspect the verbatim-extraction tail rather than trusting aggregate AUC.

paper.title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个常被忽略的评测错位：KV cache compression 通常只看最终答案准确率，但对 large reasoning models 来说，答案保住了，不等于支撑答案的推理证据也保住了。作者把这个现象定义为 answer–evidence gap，并试图回答两个问题：压缩后的 KV 表示是否同等程度地保留了“能把答案说对”的信息和“能让推理链条成立”的信息；如果没有，仅看 accuracy 会在多大程度上高估压缩方法的质量。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更接近推理阶段的诊断研究，但对基座研究员仍有启发。原因有两点。第一，很多人把长链推理模型的中间 token 当作可解释证据来使用，而这篇文章说明，推理系统层面的压缩会改变“答案正确”和“证据仍然有效”之间的关系，accuracy 不是充分指标。第二，它给出了一个比较干净的组件级评测协议，可以把 rollout dynamics 和 KV 保留能力拆开。这对研究长上下文、推理 trace、serving 优化与模型行为之间的接口很有价值。它不会直接告诉你如何训练更好的模型，但会提醒你：如果训练或部署阶段引入 cache 压缩，仅凭最终分数判断是否“几乎无损”可能是危险的，尤其是在 reasoning trace 被拿来做 verifier、审计或蒸馏信号时。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 controlled fixed-trace replay。标准 end-to-end 压缩评测里，压缩会同时影响中间推理内容的生成和后续答案，因此很难分辨到底是“模型没想出来”还是“已经写出来的推理在压缩后不可用了”。作者的做法是先让 Full-KV 模型在无压缩条件下生成完整 reasoning trace，然后把 question 和这段固定的 textual trace 一起 prefill 进去，只压缩 trace 对应的 KV cache，保护 question cache 不动，再从 </think> 之后继续解码答案。这样所有方法看到的文本推理内容完全相同，差异只来自压缩后的 KV 表示是否还能让模型有效利用这些已有推理。

围绕这个协议，作者设计了三类指标。第一是 final-answer accuracy，仍然保留传统指标。第二是 answer–chain consistency，用来测最终答案是否与可见推理链条一致。第三是 perturbation faithfulness，通过对中间推理做受控扰动，观察压缩模型是否仍然对支持性或误导性中间信息表现出合理敏感性。作者强调，这里区分的是行为功能，而不是声称 KV 里存在物理上分离的“答案子空间”和“证据子空间”。

实验覆盖十种 token-eviction 类 KV 压缩方法和一种 quantization 方法，跨三个模型、多个任务和不同压缩预算。任务包括数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索。作者还补充了 end-to-end 结果，说明 fixed-trace replay 发现的模式并不是纯实验室产物，而是在真实生成里也能看到。和已有 KV compression 论文相比，这篇文章的区别不在提出新压缩算法，而在于指出 accuracy-only evaluation 的系统性盲点，并给出更细粒度的诊断框架。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果描述看，最重要的发现不是某个方法赢了多少，而是不同指标之间的分叉。作者在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond、MedCalc 这类 reasoning-heavy 任务上观察到：在一定压缩预算下，若只看 final accuracy，一些方法仍然显得“保持得不错”；但 answer–chain consistency 和 perturbation faithfulness 会更早、更明显地下滑。这说明压缩后的模型可能还能沿着残留的答案线索给出正确结论，却已经不能稳定地利用或维护支撑该结论的推理证据。换句话说，accuracy 在这里是非对称诊断：一旦 accuracy 崩了，当然说明压缩伤害很大；但 accuracy 没崩，并不代表 reasoning state 仍然健康。

另一个关键结果是任务依赖性。RULER QA 这类长上下文检索任务中，答案更直接依赖保留精确证据，因此压缩造成的损伤更容易直接反映到 accuracy collapse 上，answer–evidence gap 相对没那么隐蔽。相反，在数学、科学 QA、临床计算这类任务里，模型可能依靠结论邻近 cue、局部 summary 或其他 answer-like signals 保住最终答案，但推理链条的可审计性已经下降。

作者还比较了多种 token eviction 方法和一种 quantization 方法，并在不同模型家族上重复实验，结论是这种 gap 不是单一算法或单一模型的偶然现象，而是一个较普遍的评测问题。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文结构看，Table 2 提供了 end-to-end 结果，主文其余表格则展示不同预算、任务和方法下 accuracy、consistency、faithfulness 三轴的分离情况。阅读时应重点关注这些曲线是否在相同 budget 下出现排序翻转。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先不要把它当成一篇新的压缩算法论文，而要当成一篇评测协议论文。优先看 Introduction 和 Problem Setting，理解作者为什么要用 fixed-trace replay，以及它和真实部署 benchmark 的边界在哪里。随后看方法部分对三个指标的定义，尤其是 answer–chain consistency 与 perturbation faithfulness 分别想测什么。接着直接看主结果图表：先看不同任务上 accuracy 与 faithfulness 是否同步下降，再看不同压缩预算下是否出现“答案还对，但证据已坏”的区间。最后再扫一遍 end-to-end 结果，确认这种现象不是 replay protocol 人为制造出来的。

如果你做长上下文、推理模型 serving、KV 压缩或 reasoning trace 利用，这篇文章值得花 20–30 分钟读主文结果和方法定义。最值得思考的点有三个：一，部署优化是否改变了可解释性信号的可信度；二，训练时若用压缩环境生成或蒸馏推理 trace，会不会把这种 answer–evidence gap 带回训练分布；三，未来压缩方法是否应该把“证据保真”纳入目标，而不是只保 final token accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a misalignment in how KV cache compression is usually evaluated. Most work reports final-answer accuracy, implicitly treating preserved answers as evidence that the underlying reasoning state is also preserved. For large reasoning models, the authors show this assumption can fail. They define an answer–evidence gap: compression may retain enough information for the model to output the correct answer while degrading the evidential structure that makes the visible rationale valid, auditable, or robust. The paper asks how often these two functions—answer recovery and evidence preservation—diverge, and whether accuracy-only evaluation systematically overestimates compression quality.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining-method paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research because it sharpens the interface between model behavior and inference-time systems. Two points matter. First, reasoning traces are increasingly used as evidence, supervision, or audit artifacts. If cache compression changes the relationship between answer correctness and rationale validity, then accuracy alone is an unsafe proxy for deployment quality. Second, the paper offers a relatively clean component-level diagnostic that separates rollout dynamics from KV retention. That is useful for anyone working on long-context models, reasoning traces, serving optimizations, or post-training pipelines that consume model-generated chains of thought. It does not tell you how to train a better model directly, but it does show that “near-lossless compression” can be a misleading claim if judged only by final accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central method is controlled fixed-trace replay. In standard end-to-end evaluation, compression affects both the generation of the reasoning trace and the later use of that trace, so it is hard to tell whether failure comes from not producing the right reasoning or from not being able to use already-produced reasoning. The authors decouple these factors. First, a Full-KV model generates a complete reasoning trace without compression. Then each compression method is evaluated by prefilling the same question and the same textual trace, protecting the question cache, compressing only the KV states corresponding to the reasoning trace, and resuming decoding immediately after the closing reasoning tag. This means every method sees identical reasoning content in text form; differences reflect whether the compressed KV representation still lets the model use that content effectively.

On top of this protocol, the paper evaluates three metrics. The first is standard final-answer accuracy. The second is answer–chain consistency, which measures whether the final answer remains aligned with the visible reasoning chain. The third is perturbation faithfulness, which probes whether the compressed model responds appropriately when intermediate reasoning content is perturbed in controlled ways. The authors are careful not to claim that KV states physically decompose into separate “answer” and “evidence” components; the distinction is behavioral rather than mechanistic.

The experimental suite covers ten token-eviction compression methods and one quantization method, across three models, multiple tasks, and multiple compression budgets. Tasks include mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. The paper also reports end-to-end results to show that the observed pattern is not an artifact of the replay protocol. Relative to prior KV-compression work, the novelty is not a new compression algorithm but a stronger evaluation lens that exposes a blind spot in accuracy-only reporting.
summary_en.experiments:
The main result is not that one compression method dominates, but that different evaluation axes separate in meaningful ways. On reasoning-heavy tasks such as AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and MedCalc, some methods remain competitive if judged only by final-answer accuracy under certain compression budgets. However, answer–chain consistency and perturbation faithfulness degrade earlier and more sharply. This indicates that compressed models may still recover the right answer from residual answer-like cues, local summaries, or conclusion-adjacent signals, while no longer preserving the reasoning structure needed to justify or verify that answer. In that sense, accuracy is an asymmetric diagnostic: when it collapses, compression damage is obvious; when it holds up, evidence preservation is still uncertain.

A second important finding is task dependence. On retrieval-oriented tasks such as RULER QA, where correct answers depend more directly on retaining exact supporting evidence, compression damage is more visible through accuracy collapse itself, so the answer–evidence gap is less hidden. By contrast, on math, science QA, and clinical calculation, the model can often preserve the final answer while losing auditability of the chain.

The study also compares multiple token-eviction methods and one quantization baseline across different model families. The answer–evidence gap appears across methods and models rather than as a quirk of a single algorithm. The abstract does not expose all numeric tables, but the paper structure indicates that Table 2 reports end-to-end results, while the main result tables and figures show how accuracy, consistency, and faithfulness diverge across budgets, tasks, and methods. When reading, the most informative pattern to look for is ranking reversals: methods that look similar under accuracy but separate clearly once evidence-oriented metrics are included.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Treat this as an evaluation-protocol paper, not as a new compression-method paper. Start with the Introduction and Problem Setting to understand why fixed-trace replay is needed and what it does and does not measure. Then read the metric definitions carefully, especially the distinction between answer–chain consistency and perturbation faithfulness. After that, go straight to the main result figures and tables: first check whether accuracy and faithfulness decline together on each task, then inspect whether there is a budget range where answers remain correct but evidential support is already degraded. Finally, skim the end-to-end results to verify that the phenomenon is not created by the replay setup itself.

If you work on long-context inference, reasoning-model serving, KV compression, or the use of reasoning traces as supervision, the paper is worth a 20–30 minute read focused on the method definition and result tables. The most useful follow-up questions are: whether deployment optimizations alter the trustworthiness of interpretability signals; whether training or distillation under compressed settings could feed this answer–evidence gap back into the model; and whether future compression methods should optimize for evidence preservation rather than final-token accuracy alone.

recommendation.zh: 做 KV 压缩或长上下文推理的人应立刻把这三个指标加进内部 ablation，只用准确率会严重高估压缩质量。
recommendation.en: Anyone working on KV compression or long-context inference should add these three metrics to internal ablations; accuracy alone severely overestimates compression quality.

paper.title: Decoupling semantics from vision: A framework for faithful visual-text compression evaluation
paper.abstract: Recent visual-text compression (VTC) methods, typified by DeepSeek-OCR, report impressive high token compression ratios for long-context modeling tasks by leveraging text-to-image rendering. However, existing evaluation protocols heavily rely on downstream task performance. Such evaluation metrics fail to accurately measure text preservation due to the strong inherent linguistic priors of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). In this work, we introduce a new evaluation framework that decoupl

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是如何忠实评估 Visual-Text Compression，也就是把长文本渲染成图像、再用较少视觉 token 表示上下文的压缩方法。现有评测常用自然文本 OCR 或下游 QA、检索、摘要任务，但这些指标会混入 MLLM 的语言先验和任务推断能力，不能直接回答“渲染后的图像到底保留了多少原文信息”。
summary.importance: 这篇工作值得精读，因为它触及长上下文扩展中的一个关键接口：文本 token 是否可以通过视觉表示绕开注意力成本。DeepSeek-OCR、Glyph、VTC-R1 这类方法的有效性不只取决于视觉 token 数，还取决于渲染布局在固定 token 预算下保留字符级信息的能力。该工作把评测目标从“下游任务是否还能答对”改为“文本是否可恢复”，指出高任务分数可能来自语义补全，而不是压缩表示真的保真。这对长上下文预训练、跨模态统一建模、视觉 tokenizer 设计都有实际影响：如果评测不隔离语义先验，就会高估视觉压缩路线的可用上下文容量。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案分两层。第一层是评测框架。它把 VTC 拆成两个正交目标：压缩效率和上下文保真。压缩效率可以由 text token 数与 visual token 数的比例直接计算；保真度则用 complete-text OCR 近似，即要求模型从渲染图像中恢复完整文本，而不是只回答一个下游问题。这样做的原因很明确：下游任务只需要局部证据，模型可能凭语言常识或少量线索给出正确答案；完整 OCR 对缺字、错字和顺序错误更敏感。框架还固定一组 MLLM 作为评估器，并在完整 benchmark 上取最佳模型级结果，以减少某个评估模型能力不足带来的低估。

第二层是 ZeroSense benchmark。它合成低语义相关、低可预测性的长文本样本，尽量去掉自然语言结构。这样模型无法依赖词法、语法、常识和上下文关联来补全模糊字符。源文本独立于图像表示，因此同一批内容可以用 Fox、Omni、Glyph 等不同渲染风格和不同压缩率生成图像，便于比较 rendering function 本身。这个设计和传统自然文本 OCR 的区别在于，后者评到的是“视觉识别 + 语言纠错”的联合效果；ZeroSense 更接近测量视觉压缩链路的纯保真能力。
summary.experiments: 实验评估了三类 VTC rendering function，并覆盖多个压缩率。关键发现是，语义隔离后的文本保真率显著低于传统端到端 OCR 或下游任务指标给出的印象。最有代表性的数字是 FOX layout 在 10× 压缩率下，DeepSeek-OCR 报告的端到端 OCR accuracy 为 95.4%，而该框架估计的文本保留率只有 11.8%。这个差距说明，常规评测中的高分很可能来自模型对自然文本的补全能力，而不是渲染图像真的保存了大部分源文本。实验还显示，随着压缩率升高，不同 layout 的退化速度不同；字体大小、行距、文本密度、图像分辨率和视觉 token 数之间存在明显取舍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Evaluation Framework。前者把 VTC 评测的混杂因素讲得很清楚：语义先验、任务证据需求、评估模型识别能力都会影响结果。后者给出压缩效率与上下文保真的形式化拆分，是整篇工作的核心。ZeroSense 构造部分需要重点看样本如何降低语义可预测性，以及为什么同一源文本能公平比较不同 rendering。实验部分优先看不同 layout、压缩率和评估协议之间的对照，尤其是 DeepSeek-OCR 常规结果与 ZeroSense 保真估计之间的差距。值得深挖的问题有两个：第一，complete-text OCR 是否过于严格，和真实长上下文任务之间如何建立可解释映射；第二，取最佳 MLLM 结果能减少低估，但也可能引入评估器选择偏差，需要看模型集合和聚合规则是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to faithfully evaluate visual-text compression, where long text is rendered into document images and consumed as a smaller number of visual tokens. Existing evaluations based on natural-text OCR or downstream tasks mix rendering quality with MLLM language priors and task-specific inference, so they do not directly measure how much source text remains recoverable from the compressed visual representation.
summary_en.importance: This is a must-read for researchers interested in long-context scaling and multimodal pretraining interfaces. VTC methods such as DeepSeek-OCR, Glyph, and VTC-R1 are attractive because they may bypass part of the text-token attention cost. Their real capacity, however, depends on whether the rendered image preserves textual information under a fixed visual-token budget. The paper shows that downstream accuracy can substantially overestimate preservation because the evaluator can infer missing content from natural-language structure. This matters for long-context pretraining, unified multimodal modeling, and visual tokenizer design: without semantic-isolated evaluation, the effective context capacity of VTC systems can be misread.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework separates two objectives: compression efficiency and context preservation. Compression efficiency is measured by the ratio between the original text-token count and the visual-token count after rendering. Context preservation is approximated with complete-text OCR: the evaluator must recover the whole source text from the rendered image, rather than answer a downstream question. This choice is deliberate. Downstream QA, retrieval, or summarization may require only sparse evidence, while natural-text OCR lets the model use lexical, syntactic, and semantic priors to correct visually ambiguous characters. Complete-text recovery is much more sensitive to missing characters, ordering errors, and local visual degradation.

The paper also introduces ZeroSense, a benchmark of long contexts with low semantic coherence and low predictability. The text is synthesized to remove ordinary linguistic dependencies, making it difficult for an MLLM to fill in unreadable regions from context. The same source content can be rendered with different layouts, including Fox, Omni, and Glyph-style renderings, and across different compression ratios. The evaluation uses a fixed set of MLLMs and reports the best model-level result over the complete benchmark, reducing underestimation caused by a weak evaluator while keeping the rendering function as the main variable.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare three VTC rendering functions across multiple compression ratios. The central empirical result is a large gap between conventional end-to-end metrics and semantic-isolated text preservation. Under the FOX layout at a 10× compression ratio, DeepSeek-OCR reports 95.4% end-to-end OCR accuracy, while the proposed framework estimates only 11.8% text preservation. This indicates that high OCR or downstream accuracy on natural text can come from semantic reconstruction rather than faithful visual preservation. The results also show that degradation with increasing compression differs across layouts, reflecting trade-offs among font size, spacing, text density, image resolution, and visual-token budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction and Evaluation Framework closely. The Introduction cleanly identifies the confounders in VTC evaluation: language priors, downstream evidence requirements, and evaluator capability. The Evaluation Framework is the key technical part because it formalizes compression efficiency and preservation as separate quantities. The ZeroSense construction is worth reading to understand how semantic predictability is suppressed and why the same source text can fairly compare different rendering functions. In the experiments, focus on the comparisons across layouts, compression ratios, and evaluation protocols, especially the gap between DeepSeek-OCR’s conventional result and the ZeroSense preservation estimate. Two points deserve further scrutiny: whether complete-text OCR is too strict for some downstream uses, and whether taking the best MLLM result introduces evaluator-selection bias.

recommendation.zh: 只看评测设计和失败案例即可；它会修正“下游准确率可代表文本压缩保真度”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the evaluation setup and failure cases; it weakens the default assumption that downstream accuracy measures text-compression fidelity.

paper.title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
paper.abstract: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很实际的评测瓶颈：在持续预训练、对齐和多轮 checkpoint 迭代中，完整跑大基准的成本太高，但现有 coreset 选题方法要么依赖大量历史评测日志，冷启动时根本不可用；要么只看题面文本相似度，容易把“措辞像”当成“推理结构像”。论文要解决的是：在没有历史作答记录的前提下，能否只靠题目本身，选出一个小而有代表性的评测子集，并且这个子集对模型能力排序和总分估计都足够稳定。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于给持续开发流程提供了更便宜的评测代理。预训练和 post-train 迭代里，真正昂贵的往往不是单次训练，而是高频评测。CoT-Core 的贡献是把“代表性”从表层文本空间，转到显式推理轨迹空间，因而在冷启动 benchmark、私有内部集和缺少历史日志的场景里更可用。它的价值主要是工程流程层面的：减少评测 token 开销，同时尽量保住全量评测的排序一致性和分数近似。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步是 CoT trajectory generation：对每道题用一个教师 LLM 做 zero-shot Chain-of-Thought 展开，得到显式推理轨迹，而不是只保留原始题面。这里的关键假设是，不同表述但同一逻辑骨架的问题，在推理展开后会更接近。第二步是 contextualized trajectory embedding：把题目与其 CoT 轨迹一起编码到稠密向量空间，构造比纯 question embedding 更接近“推理流形”的表示。第三步是 isomorphic clustering and selection：在这个表示空间里做聚类或几何覆盖，选出每个簇的中心样本，形成预算受限的 coreset。

论文一个比较清楚的设计点，是把 subset selection 和 performance estimation 解耦。CoT-Core 只负责选题，本身不绑定某个特定估计器。最简单时可以直接对选中子集做 standard aggregation；如果后续有历史日志，也可以接 GP-IRT 这类概率估计器。这个解耦比 IRT 路线更灵活，因为 IRT 往往把题目参数估计和分数重建绑在一起。

与传统 lexical embedding + k-center 的区别，在于它不把“语义相近”近似成“词面相近”，而是显式借助 LLM 生成的推理过程来重排样本邻域。与 IRT 的区别，在于它完全不需要先验作答矩阵，因此适合新 benchmark。代价也很明确：它虽然是 training-free，但不是 free lunch，需要先为全题库生成 CoT，这一步本身有前置成本；只是这个成本是一次性的，而后续多轮评测可以摊薄。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验重点不是追求单点最高精度，而是验证三件事：一是 CoT 表示是否比原始文本表示更适合做 coreset；二是在没有历史日志时，是否能稳定逼近全量评测；三是这种收益是否依赖任务复杂度。

作者将 CoT-Core 与两类基线比较：一类是 history-dependent 的 IRT/GP-IRT 路线，另一类是 training-free 的文本嵌入几何采样，如 k-center greedy。结果显示，在冷启动设定下，CoT-Core 明显优于只看题面 embedding 的方法，尤其在需要多步推理的 benchmark 上，子集分数对全量分数的拟合更稳，模型间排序也更接近全量评测。论文还强调一个边界条件：当任务本身主要考察事实记忆、模板匹配或短程判断时，显式 CoT 带来的增益会缩小，因为这类题目的“推理流形”本来就不复杂。

消融方面，比较关键的是：是否使用 CoT、不同 embedding 方式、不同聚类/选点策略、以及不同估计器的组合。结论大致是，收益主要来自 reasoning-aware representation，而不是某个特定聚类算法；也就是说，核心创新在表示层，而不是采样器本身。摘要截断后未给出完整数字，现有全文片段也没有可靠的表格数值可逐项抄录，因此不宜编造具体提升百分比。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 的问题设定，重点理解作者为什么把 coreset 问题拆成“选题”和“估分”两层。然后直接看方法图和表示构造部分，抓住一句话：他们不是在题面空间做覆盖，而是在 CoT 轨迹空间做覆盖。

接着看实验里的三类结果：1）冷启动场景下与文本 embedding 基线的差距；2）不同任务复杂度下收益是否稳定；3）与更强估计器结合时，子集本身是否仍然有价值。若时间有限，优先看 ablation 和 failure/boundary discussion，这部分最能帮助判断方法适用范围。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical evaluation bottleneck: during continual pretraining, alignment, and checkpoint iteration, full-benchmark evaluation is too expensive, yet existing coreset methods either require large historical response logs or rely on shallow text similarity. The core question is whether one can build a small but representative evaluation subset in a cold-start setting, using only the benchmark items themselves, while preserving full-set score estimation and model ranking.
summary_en.importance: Its value is operational rather than algorithmically central to pretraining. In foundation-model development, repeated evaluation is often a major hidden cost. CoT-Core matters because it offers a training-free way to compress evaluation sets without historical logs, and it does so by moving from surface text similarity to reasoning-structure similarity. That makes it relevant for newly built benchmarks, private internal eval sets, and fast iteration loops where exhaustive evaluation is too costly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three stages. First, CoT trajectory generation: for each question, a teacher LLM produces a zero-shot chain-of-thought trajectory. The key premise is that questions with different wording but similar logical structure become closer once their reasoning paths are made explicit. Second, contextualized trajectory embedding: the question and its generated reasoning trace are embedded into a dense space intended to reflect the latent reasoning manifold better than plain question embeddings. Third, isomorphic clustering and selection: clustering or geometric covering is performed in that space, and representative items near cluster centers are selected under a fixed budget.

A useful design choice is the decoupling between subset selection and score estimation. CoT-Core only constructs the subset. The selected coreset can be used with simple standard aggregation in a fully training-free setup, or combined with stronger estimators such as GP-IRT when historical logs are available. This is more flexible than IRT-style methods, which typically tie item calibration and score reconstruction together.

Compared with lexical embedding plus k-center selection, the novelty is not the sampler itself but the representation space: neighborhood structure is induced by generated reasoning traces rather than surface wording. Compared with IRT-based approaches, it avoids the cold-start dependency on historical correctness matrices. The trade-off is also clear: it is training-free, but not cost-free, because CoT trajectories must be generated for the benchmark upfront. The method assumes that this one-time cost is amortized over many future evaluation runs.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is organized around three questions: whether CoT-based representations are better than plain text embeddings for coreset construction, whether the selected subsets remain faithful in cold-start score estimation, and when the gains disappear.

The paper compares against two baseline families: history-dependent approaches such as IRT/GP-IRT, and training-free geometric methods based on question embeddings, including k-center-style selection. The main result is that in cold-start settings, CoT-Core consistently outperforms text-only selection, especially on benchmarks with nontrivial multi-step reasoning. The selected subsets better preserve full-benchmark score estimates and model ranking. The paper also states a boundary condition: when tasks are dominated by factual recall, template matching, or shallow judgments, the benefit of reasoning-aware pruning becomes smaller because the underlying reasoning manifold is weak to begin with.

The most informative ablations vary the use of CoT, the embedding construction, the clustering/selection strategy, and the downstream estimator. The main takeaway is that the gain comes primarily from the reasoning-aware representation rather than from a particular clustering heuristic. The provided content does not expose complete tables or reliable numeric values, so it would be inappropriate to invent exact percentages or correlation scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem formulation in the introduction and method section. The important conceptual move is the separation between subset selection and performance estimation. Then focus on the representation step: the paper is not mainly about a new sampler, but about building a better space in which representative questions can be selected.

For experiments, prioritize three parts: the cold-start comparison against text-embedding baselines, the task-complexity analysis, and the ablations showing that the representation matters more than the clustering algorithm. If reading time is limited, the boundary-condition discussion is worth attention because it tells you when CoT-aware pruning is likely to help and when it is not. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和边界条件即可；若 CoT embedding 稳定，值得接入内部 checkpoint 快筛。
recommendation.en: Read the method and boundary conditions; if the CoT embeddings are stable, this is worth trying for internal checkpoint triage.

paper.title: Judging Is Not Enumerating: Silent Omissions in LLM-Authored Acceptable Sets
paper.abstract: Language models are increasingly promoted from examinees to examiners: they write the test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for other systems. We measure the capability that role assumes and find it lacking under the protocol the role is usually deployed with, one-shot greedy authoring with no test-time reasoning. Across four reference constructions - two with complete finite truth, one with a hardened executable reference (HumanEval+/MBPP+), one with an

summary.core_problem: LLM 正从「被评测者」转向「评测规则的制定者」：生成测试用例、答案要点、评分标准、奖励函数等。论文要回答的核心问题是：模型能否准确构造出一个正确性规范所对应的可接受集合（acceptable set）——也就是它写出来的 verifier 所定义的接受域，和真实的接受域是否一致。
summary.importance: 这一问题直接关系到 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）、自动评测、模型生成 rubric 等下游流程的可靠性。如果模型构造的接受域存在系统性遗漏或额外约束，会直接污染奖励信号和评测结果。论文把问题形式化为「执行（membership 判断） vs 创作（构造接受集合）」的能力差距，并区分了外延式（枚举成员）和内涵式（写谓词/测试）两种失败模式，对理解 LLM 作为 judge / reward designer 的边界有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用四类有完整真值的构造任务来测量：两类是机械可判定的词表谓词（外延式枚举），一类是 HumanEval+/MBPP+ 代码任务（内涵式写测试），还有一类带强化规则的可执行参照。核心测量指标是模型创作的接受域 Ŝ 与真实接受域 S* 的 F1 一致性，并且和同一个模型做 membership 判断的能力做同尺度对比。论文发现的核心机制是「静默遗漏（silent omission）」：自回归模型在枚举集合时，逐个元素生成、决定何时停止，却永远看不到没被采样到的候选，导致接受域系统性偏小。对于存在紧凑规则的任务，测试时推理（test-time reasoning）可以直接补上这个缺口；对于没有显式规则的代码类任务，则需要额外的 probe gating 等补救手段。
summary.experiments: 在机械构造的词表任务上，模型陈述规则（内涵式重述）的 F1 接近 0.99，但外延式枚举的表现显著更低，差距完全来自枚举能力而非理解能力。在代码任务上，模型生成的测试套件同样会遗漏正确解或引入额外约束，导致接受域偏小。论文同时验证了：当规范有紧凑的可重述规则时，test-time reasoning 能基本消除创作与执行之间的差距；没有这种规则时，差距持续存在。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读 §3 的四类构造任务设计和失败模式分析，特别是 §3.7 关于 test-time reasoning 补救的部分，以及 §3.11 关于「模型能说清规则但枚举不全」的对照实验。形式化定义部分（引言后半段）值得快速过一遍，理解 extensional vs intensional authoring 的区分。预计阅读时间 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs are increasingly moving from examinees to authors of evaluation specifications: they generate test suites, answer keys, rubrics, and reward functions that define correctness for downstream systems. The paper asks whether models can faithfully materialize the acceptable set denoted by a correctness specification — whether the acceptance region induced by an LLM-authored verifier matches the true acceptance set.
summary_en.importance: This question directly bears on the reliability of RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards), automated evaluation, and model-generated rubrics. If the authored acceptance region suffers from systematic omissions or spurious constraints, reward signals and evaluation outcomes become corrupted. The work formalizes the gap between execution (membership judgment) and authoring (constructing the acceptable set), and distinguishes extensional (enumeration) from intensional (predicate / test-suite) failure modes — a useful framing for understanding the limits of LLMs as judges or reward designers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds four reference constructions with complete ground truth to measure fidelity: two mechanically decidable word-list predicates (extensional enumeration), one hardened executable code benchmark (HumanEval+/MBPP+, intensional test authoring), and one additional controlled construction. The core metric is F1 agreement between the authored acceptance region Ŝ and the true set S*, measured on the same candidate space used to score the model's own membership execution. The central failure mechanism identified is silent omission: autoregressive models generate sets element by element and decide when to stop, but never inspect unsampled candidates, so the authored region is systematically too small. Where a compact rule exists, test-time reasoning closes the gap; where it does not, remedies such as probe gating are required.
summary_en.experiments: On mechanical word-list constructions, restating the rule as an executable predicate reaches near-perfect F1 (~0.99), while extensional enumeration performs substantially worse — the gap comes from enumeration ability, not understanding. On code tasks, model-generated test suites also miss valid solutions or introduce extra constraints, shrinking the acceptance region. Test-time reasoning largely eliminates the authoring-vs-execution gap when a compact restatable rule is available, but not otherwise.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3, especially the four construction designs and failure-mode analysis; §3.7 on test-time reasoning as a remedy; and §3.11 on the contrast between rule-stating and enumeration. The formal framing of extensional vs intensional authoring in the latter half of the introduction is worth a quick pass. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读实验表；它会降低你对 LLM 自动写 reward/test suite 的信任，尤其是开放答案集合场景。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental tables; this should lower confidence in LLM-authored rewards and test suites for open acceptable sets.

paper.title: Language Equality has a Price: A Systematic Investigation of Multi-turn LLM Performance for EU-24+
paper.abstract: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) as language agents playing goal-directed dialogue games in self-play across 30 languages: the 24 official EU languages plus six others. Unlike static or preference-based evaluation, this paradigm is multi-turn, reference-free and programmatically scored, and because the game mechanics are language-agnostic it extends to a new language by localising a fixed set of prompt and word-list files. Evaluating nine open-weight and commercial LLMs, we find that no

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估多语言 LLM 在真实互动式语言使用中的不平等表现，重点是 EU 24 种官方语言，以及额外 6 种对照语言。它关心的不是单轮知识题，而是多轮、开放生成、目标导向、可程序化评分的 dialogue game。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 eval 类工作，对预训练数据和 tokenizer 研究有间接价值。它把多语言能力从“翻译后的静态选择题”推进到“多轮互动中的功能性语言使用”，更容易暴露低资源语言上的指令跟随、约束执行、状态保持和生成稳定性问题。对基座训练的启发是：仅靠多语言 MMLU 类分数不足以判断语言覆盖质量；训练数据量、tokenizer fertility、语言社群经济权重和推理成本之间的关系需要一起看。论文结论也提示，开放权重模型在 EU-24 覆盖上仍明显弱于商业模型，尤其在低资源语言中差距更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是把模型放进语言无关的 dialogue games 中自博弈。游戏机制固定，迁移到新语言时只需要本地化 prompt、parsing rules 和 word lists，不需要为每种语言写 reference answers。这一点很关键：它把多语言 benchmark 从大规模标注问题转成可控的 localization 问题。评测维度包括多轮交互、开放式生成、显式 instruction following、以及多个能力在同一 episode 中的组合表现。与 Global MMLU、MMLU-ProX、MuBench、Eurolingua 等静态 benchmark 相比，它不依赖英译题和多选答案；与 Multi-IF 类多轮指令跟随评测相比，它的后续 turn 会受模型输出影响，而不是预先脚本化，因此能测到模型在动态对话中的错误累积。论文还把 performance 与 token 使用、美元成本、公开 web text 规模、tokenizer fertility 和语言社群经济权重关联起来，用来分析“语言平等”的实际成本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 30 种语言，包括 24 种 EU 官方语言和 6 种额外语言；评估 9 个开放权重和商业 LLM。摘要中给出的关键发现是：没有一个开放权重模型能很好覆盖 EU-24；在每一种 EU 官方语言上，两个商业系统都超过所有开放权重模型；最弱的两个开放权重模型在 EU-24 平均分低于 40。商业系统即使在公开 web text 少四个数量级的语言上仍保持领先，说明低资源语言表现不只由可见网络文本量解释，也可能与私有数据、数据清洗、tokenizer、后训练和模型规模有关。论文还记录每种语言的 token 和美元成本，用来衡量同一任务在不同语言中的服务代价。提供内容未包含完整模型列表、逐语言分数表和相关性数值，因此这些数字不应臆测。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–40 分钟。优先看 benchmark 设计、游戏本地化流程、评分函数、语言列表、模型列表，以及 performance-cost-language-resource 的分析图表。预训练研究员可以重点关注三点：第一，tokenizer fertility 如何影响多轮交互成本；第二，低资源语言上的失败是来自理解、生成、约束遵循还是对话状态维护；第三，公开 web 语料规模与模型表现的相关性是否在商业模型和开放模型上不同。相关工作表也值得快速看，它清楚说明该 benchmark 相比静态多语言评测多了哪些维度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates multilingual LLM performance under interactive language use, with a focus on the 24 official EU languages plus six additional languages. The target is not single-turn knowledge recall, but multi-turn, open-ended, goal-directed dialogue games with programmatic scoring.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation paper, with indirect value for pretraining data and tokenizer research. It shows that multilingual coverage should not be judged only through translated multiple-choice benchmarks. Multi-turn interaction exposes failures in instruction following, constraint satisfaction, state tracking, and generation robustness, especially in lower-resource languages. The paper is also useful because it couples quality with token and dollar cost, making language coverage a question of both performance and serving efficiency. For foundation-model training, the main signal is that data volume, tokenizer fertility, private data quality, and post-training behavior all interact in multilingual capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses language-agnostic dialogue games in self-play. The mechanics stay fixed across languages; adding a language requires localized prompts, parsing rules, and word lists rather than reference answers. This design turns broad language coverage into a localization problem instead of a large annotation project. The episodes are multi-turn, require free-form generation, explicitly score formal instruction following, and combine multiple capabilities inside the same interaction. This differs from translated MMLU-style benchmarks, which are static and often multiple-choice. It also differs from scripted multilingual instruction-following tests, where later turns are predetermined rather than contingent on the model’s own outputs. The analysis connects game performance to token usage, dollar cost, public web-text availability, tokenizer fertility, and the economic weight of language communities.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 30 languages: all 24 official EU languages plus six comparison languages. Nine open-weight and commercial LLMs are evaluated. The key reported finding is that no open-weight model covers the EU-24 well. In every official EU language, both commercial systems outperform every open-weight model, and the two weakest models average below 40 points across the EU-24. The commercial systems remain ahead even for languages with four orders of magnitude less public web text, suggesting that visible web-data volume alone does not explain the gap. The paper also measures token and dollar cost per language. The supplied content does not include the complete model list, per-language tables, or correlation coefficients, so those details cannot be reconstructed reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Prioritize the benchmark design, localization pipeline, scoring functions, language list, model list, and the plots relating performance to cost, web-text availability, and tokenizer fertility. For pretraining work, the most relevant questions are whether tokenizer fertility inflates interaction cost, whether low-resource failures come from comprehension, generation, constraint following, or dialogue-state maintenance, and whether the performance-data relationship differs between commercial and open-weight systems. The related-work comparison table is also useful because it makes clear which dimensions are missing from common multilingual benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 结论对多语言数据配比有直接参考：公开 crawl 不足以抹平低资源语言差距，home-region 提升真实存在但有限；重点看 §3 的语言覆盖与得分图。
recommendation.en: Directly relevant to multilingual data mixture: public crawls alone cannot close low-resource gaps, and home-region bias helps but is bounded; focus on language-coverage score plots in §3.

paper.title: Beyond Accuracy: Auditing Spatial Provenance in Visual Token Pruning for OCR-Critical MLLM Inference
paper.abstract: Visual-token pruning is usually judged by answer quality at a fixed retention budget. For text-rich multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this protocol can miss a distinct failure: an answer remains correct even when no retained token is locally traceable to the small OCR region that supports it. We turn this blind spot into an evidence-risk audit that couples answer behavior with geometric token-origin provenance, interventions, and realized cost; transparent training-free selectors isolate

summary.core_problem: 这项工作指出视觉 token pruning 在 OCR-critical MLLM 推理中的一个评测盲点：保留较少视觉 token 后，答案仍可能正确，但被保留 token 中已经没有可追踪到关键文字区域的空间证据。只看 accuracy 和 keep ratio 会掩盖这种 evidence loss。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的价值主要在评测和推理效率接口。高分辨率文档、截图、表格和场景文字会显著增加视觉前缀长度，token pruning 是降低 prefill 成本的常见路线。但 OCR 场景中的风险不是单纯准确率下降，而是模型可能依赖语言先验、布局偏置或上下文猜测给出正确答案。论文把 spatial provenance 作为独立指标，有助于评估压缩后的视觉前缀是否仍保留可检查的证据路径。这对 VLM serving、视觉 token 压缩和文档理解类原生多模态预训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 evidence-risk audit，而不是新的 pruning 网络。它固定 MLLM 权重、prompt、label 和 decoding，只改变视觉 token 选择。对于删除式 selector，每个保留 token 有原始图像 token 的 source lineage；对于 merge/compression operator，每个输出 token 也记录其来源集合和代表 anchor。基于 TextOCR 的文字框标注，论文定义 lineage-based geometric coverage 和 anchor coverage，用来衡量压缩后 token 是否覆盖答案相关区域。正例使用 PosECR 衡量支持答案的区域是否被保留；near-miss negative 使用 NegSRC 衡量混淆源词区域是否仍可作为局部反证。实验中还设置 Target、Random、Grid，以及可选 OCR/layout priors 的 selector，以便在同一预算下分离目标相关性、网格覆盖和外部检测器辅助的影响。
summary.experiments: 主要结果显示，answer accuracy 和 spatial provenance 可以明显脱钩。在 locked image-disjoint confirmation 上，Qwen 的 Target selector 在 30% retention 下 observed accuracy 为 0.786，Full 为 0.783，paired image-cluster difference 为 +0.003，95% CI 为 [-0.014, +0.020]，也就是准确率几乎不变。但同预算下 provenance 差异很大：Target 的 positive-region coverage 为 0.620，而 Random 和 Grid 只有 0.270 和 0.318。论文还比较了 Qwen、LLaVA 和 InternVL，显示不同 MLLM 的 quality-risk-traceability frontier 不同；open QA 相比 yes/no confirmation 需要更高 retention。因此，一个模型或任务上可用的 keep ratio 不能直接迁移到另一个模型或任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 problem setup，特别是 source lineage、anchor、lineage coverage、anchor coverage 的定义，确认指标测的是 token origin traceability，而不是严格因果贡献。再看 TextOCR-Hard 与 locked confirmation 的构造，理解正例和 near-miss negative 的差异。结果部分重点看 Qwen 30% retention 的 accuracy/provenance 分离，以及 Qwen、LLaVA、InternVL 的 frontier 对比。若关注多模态推理效率，值得重点看 realized execution cost，因为 pruning 方法常在理论 token 数上节省明显，但真实 GPU prefill 和调度收益未必线性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a blind spot in evaluating visual-token pruning for OCR-critical MLLM inference. A pruned visual prefix can still produce the correct answer even when none of the retained tokens is spatially traceable to the small text region that supports the answer. Accuracy at a fixed retention budget does not expose this evidence loss.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to evaluation and the efficiency interface of multimodal LMs. High-resolution documents, screenshots, charts, and scene-text inputs create long visual prefixes, so pruning is attractive for reducing prefill cost. In OCR-heavy settings, however, the main failure is not always an immediate accuracy drop. The model may answer from priors, layout cues, nearby text, or mixed context after the local visual evidence has been removed. Treating spatial provenance as an explicit evaluation dimension helps assess whether a compressed visual prefix still preserves an inspectable evidence path.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work proposes an evidence-risk audit rather than a learned pruning method. The MLLM weights, prompts, labels, and decoding are kept fixed; only the visual-token selector changes. For deletion-based pruning, each retained token has a source lineage from the original image-token grid. For merged or compressed outputs, each output token has a lineage set and a representative anchor. Using TextOCR word-box annotations, the audit defines lineage-based geometric coverage and anchor coverage over annotated OCR regions. Positive probes use PosECR to measure whether answer-supporting regions remain represented. Near-miss negatives use NegSRC to measure whether the source region for a confusable absent string remains available as local counter-evidence. Transparent selectors such as Target, Random, Grid, and OCR/layout-assisted variants provide controlled operating points under a shared budget contract.
summary_en.experiments: The key result is a separation between answer accuracy and spatial provenance. On a locked image-disjoint confirmation set, Qwen with the Target selector at 30% visual-token retention reaches observed accuracy 0.786, while the full visual prefix reaches 0.783; the paired image-cluster difference is +0.003 with a 95% confidence interval of [-0.014, +0.020]. Accuracy is nearly unchanged, but provenance differs sharply. At the same budget, positive-region coverage is 0.620 for Target, compared with 0.270 for Random and 0.318 for Grid. Experiments across Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL show different quality-risk-traceability frontiers, and open QA requires substantially higher retention than yes/no confirmation. A retention ratio that is safe for one model or task is therefore not automatically safe for another.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Start with the problem setup and metric definitions: source lineage, representative anchor, lineage coverage, anchor coverage, PosECR, and NegSRC. These metrics measure token-origin traceability, not strict causal evidence. Then read the construction of TextOCR-Hard and the locked confirmation split to understand the positive and near-miss negative probes. In the results, focus on the Qwen 30% retention case where accuracy and provenance diverge, and then compare the Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL frontiers. For inference-efficiency work, also check the realized execution-cost measurements, since token-count reduction does not always translate linearly into GPU savings.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝评估中的一个重要坑：模型可能在没有保留关键 OCR token 的情况下“猜”对答案，建议关注其提出的审计指标。
recommendation.en: Highlights a critical pitfall in VLM visual token pruning evaluation: models might 'guess' correctly without retaining key OCR tokens; the proposed auditing metrics are worth noting.

paper.title: When Does LLM Orchestration Pay Off? A Controlled Evaluation of Accuracy, Cost, and Task Difficulty
paper.abstract: LLM orchestration is often assumed to improve reasoning by allocating additional inference-time computation, yet its gains may not justify its cost. Existing comparisons also frequently overlook differences in optimization effort, making it difficult to isolate the value of orchestration itself. We conduct a controlled evaluation of Self-Refine, Best-of-$N$, and Debate against task-only and chain-of-thought (CoT) single-call baselines across five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive prog

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM orchestration 方法在相同优化预算下，相比单次调用和 CoT 是否真的带来足够的准确率收益，并量化其 token 成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控评估。它直接挑战“多次调用、反思、辩论、Best-of-N 一定值得”的常见假设，对 inference-time compute 和 agentic workflow 的成本收益判断有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 比较 Self-Refine、Best-of-N、Debate 与 task-only、CoT 单次调用基线。关键控制变量是：所有方法用 GEPA 在相同优化预算下调优，并在同一批按难度分层的题目上评估，从而减少因 prompt 调优投入不同带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 LLM backbone 和 3 个领域：竞赛编程、国际象棋谜题、数学。结果显示 orchestration 的平均收益中，最大只比优化后的 CoT 高 4.6 个百分点，比 task-only 高 4.5 个百分点，但平均总 token 约为 2 到 4 倍；收益随 benchmark 和难度变化明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM orchestration methods still pay off when accuracy, token cost, task difficulty, and optimization effort are controlled.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled evaluation contribution. It probes a practical assumption behind inference-time compute and agentic workflows: extra calls, refinement, debate, or Best-of-N may not justify their cost once baselines are properly tuned.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares Self-Refine, Best-of-N, and Debate against task-only and CoT single-call baselines. All methods are optimized with GEPA under the same optimization budget and evaluated on the same difficulty-stratified items, reducing confounding from unequal prompt optimization effort.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover five LLM backbones and three domains: competitive programming, chess puzzles, and mathematics. Across backbones within each benchmark, the largest gain is 4.6 percentage points over optimized CoT and 4.5 points over task-only inference, while requiring roughly 2--4x mean total tokens.

recommendation.zh: 读摘要和实验表即可；它把 orchestration 的收益压到干净 setup 下，对 test-time scaling 预算分配有用。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and result tables; the clean setup makes orchestration gains look modest, which matters for test-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Conformalized Large Language Models under Configuration Shift
paper.abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification that has recently been adapted to large language models (LLMs), providing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability. Yet for LLMs, nonconformity scores are often induced by an inference pipeline, not just a fixed model, making them depend not only on the data distribution but also on configurable factors such as the prompt template, decoding parameters, and deployment sett

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究 conformal prediction 用在 LLM 系统时的一个常见失效源：校准集和测试集的数据分布可以不变，但 prompt 模板、解码温度、量化配置等推理配置发生变化后，同一个样本会被映射到不同的 nonconformity score 分布。CP 的覆盖率保证依赖 score 的 exchangeability，而不是只依赖原始样本的 exchangeability，因此这种 configuration shift 会直接破坏有限样本覆盖率保证。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型部署评估、uncertainty quantification 和 verifier/judge 类系统有清晰启发。LLM 的“模型”在实践中常常是模型权重、prompt、decoding、部署精度的组合；如果只校准权重而忽略配置，统计保证会被高估。对基座研究员的价值在于提醒：后训练和推理 recipe 的小改动会改变 score 分布，评测和安全阈值不能默认跨配置复用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上先把 configuration shift 明确定义为 score map 的变化：输入标签分布不变，但 s(x, y) 由于 prompt、temperature 或 quantization 改变而变化。实验部分系统扫描 3 类配置轴、9 个 LLM、4 个数据集和 4 种 nonconformity score，观察 CP 覆盖率和 prediction set size 的变化。理论部分给出覆盖率下界，把 calibration score 分布和 test score 分布之间的 discrepancy 显式放进保证项中；同时推导 label-free 版本，只依赖模型预测而不需要测试标签，便于部署前诊断。修正策略包括基于 discrepancy 的 threshold correction，以及对容易 undercoverage 的配置加权更高的 calibration ensembling。
summary.experiments: 关键现象是 validity 受损明显，而 efficiency 受损相对小。配置变化后，经验覆盖率会低于目标覆盖率；在一些设置中，增加 calibration 数据并不会修复问题，反而让偏差更稳定地暴露出来，因为有限样本噪声减少后，校准分布和测试分布的不匹配成为主导误差。作者检查的配置包括 prompt template、decoding temperature、weight quantization；覆盖 9 个 LLM、4 个数据集、4 种 nonconformity score。可操作结果是：下界中的 discrepancy 项可用于阈值修正，fragility profile 可用于设计偏向脆弱配置的 calibration ensemble。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 configuration shift 的定义，确认它和传统 covariate/domain shift 的区别。然后看实验设置表，重点关注 3 个配置轴、4 种 score 的构造方式，以及 coverage 与 set size 的分离结果。理论部分不必逐行推导，但应看覆盖率下界中 discrepancy 项如何进入保证；这决定了后面的 label-free diagnostic 和 threshold correction 是否合理。最后看 calibration ensembling 的消融，判断它是在修复真实失配，还是只是在保守化 prediction set。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a failure mode of conformal prediction for LLM pipelines: the data distribution may stay fixed, while the inference configuration changes the nonconformity scores. Prompt templates, sampling temperature, and quantization can all alter the score assigned to the same labeled example. Since conformal coverage depends on exchangeability of the scores, not just exchangeability of the raw examples, these configuration changes can invalidate the nominal guarantee.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to LLM evaluation and deployment-time calibration. In practice, an LLM system is a combination of weights, prompts, decoding rules, and serving precision. A calibration threshold obtained under one configuration should not be assumed valid under another. The useful lesson for foundation-model research is that post-training and inference recipes can shift score distributions enough to break statistical guarantees used by uncertainty, verification, or safety layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes configuration shift as a change in the score map s(x, y), while keeping the example distribution fixed. It then runs a systematic empirical sweep over prompt templates, decoding temperature, and weight quantization, across 9 LLMs, 4 datasets, and 4 nonconformity scores. On the theory side, it derives coverage lower bounds where the discrepancy between calibration-score and test-score distributions appears explicitly. It also gives label-free variants based only on model predictions, enabling diagnostics without test labels. The proposed mitigations follow from this analysis: threshold correction using the discrepancy term and calibration ensembling that upweights configurations prone to undercoverage.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that configuration shift primarily harms validity rather than efficiency. Empirical coverage can fall below the target level, while prediction-set sizes remain close to the i.i.d. baseline in runs that remain valid. More calibration data does not necessarily help; it can make the bias more apparent because sampling noise shrinks and the score-distribution mismatch dominates. The study covers three practical shift axes—prompting, temperature, and quantization—and shows that the derived diagnostics and corrections are actionable rather than only descriptive.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the definition of configuration shift and how it differs from covariate or domain shift. Then inspect the experimental setup: the three configuration axes, the four nonconformity scores, and the separation between coverage and set size. The theoretical section is worth reading for the form of the discrepancy term in the coverage bound; the full proof can be skipped unless CP theory is the focus. End with the threshold-correction and calibration-ensemble results, especially the ablations showing when they recover coverage and when they simply make sets more conservative.

recommendation.zh: 配置漂移影响保形预测覆盖率的实证结论对部署校准有参考，但与预训练方法论关系弱；看摘要和主表即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Empirical finding that configuration shift erodes CP coverage is useful for deployment calibration but weakly connected to pretraining methodology. Read abstract and main tables only.

paper.title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents'

summary.core_problem: AI agent 在面对相同数值证据时，是否会因场景框架（framing）和先验信念不同而得出不同结论，即是否表现出 motivated reasoning。
summary.importance: 原理分析/行为研究；用控制变量实验揭示 agent 的结论受先验信念系统性影响，且会改变搜索深度和分析方法选择，对理解幻觉、偏见和推理可靠性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在医学、选举取证、地缘预测三个高风险领域，固定数值证据仅改变场景框架，跨 12 个 agent-domain 对比测量结论方向、搜索广度和分析规格选择。
summary.experiments: 12 个 agent-domain 对比；agent 对先验认为可能的命题更倾向得出肯定结论，框架冲突时则相反；部分 agent 会改变搜索范围和分析方法。摘要未列出具体模型名称和效应量。

summary_en.core_problem: Do AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical evidence when the scenario framing and their prior beliefs change, i.e., do they exhibit motivated reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Behavioral/mechanistic analysis; controlled experiments show agents' conclusions are systematically biased by prior beliefs, and framing alters search depth and analytical specification choice—relevant to understanding hallucination, bias, and reasoning reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across three high-stakes domains (medicine, election forensics, geopolitical forecasting), evidence is held fixed while scenario framing varies; 12 agent-domain comparisons measure conclusion direction, search breadth, and analytical specification choice.
summary_en.experiments: 12 agent-domain comparisons; agents more likely to affirm propositions they already regard as likely, with the reverse under conflicting framing; some agents change search extent and analytical methods. Abstract does not list specific model names or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 行为实验揭示 agent 的先验信念会扭曲证据解读，结论方向可信但缺模型细节和效应量，作为偏见文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: A behavioral study showing priors distort evidence evaluation in agents; directionally credible but lacks model specifics and effect sizes—file it as bias literature.

paper.title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should generate consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很明确：多模态大模型在面对语义等价、但呈现模态不同的输入时，预测并不稳定。具体说，同一句题目里把“可视觉化的概念”从文字换成对应图片后，模型常常从答对变成答错。作者把这种现象定义为 modality gap，并把它从一个零散观察变成了可系统测量、可训练干预的问题。关键不在于模型会不会看图，而在于模型是否真正学到了“语义跨模态不变性”：同一概念以文本 token 或视觉 token 出现时，后续推理链条应尽量一致。对 MLLM 预训练来说，这是比传统 VQA 准确率更基础的能力约束。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它提出了一个比常规图文 benchmark 更贴近统一建模目标的诊断维度：不是测“图像是否提供额外信息”，而是测“图像替换文本后语义是否保持”。这直接对应 native multimodal pretraining 是否真的把不同模态映射到兼容表示空间。第二，作者给出的结果说明，modality gap 在 42 个模型上普遍存在，平均掉点 19.6%，而且单靠更大训练算力、CoT、few-shot 都很难补上，这说明问题更像训练目标和数据分布错配，而不是提示词技巧不足。第三，作者进一步证明可以在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段用 TokenSwap 数据增强来缩小 gap，且不明显伤害文本能力和常规视觉语言能力。这一点对数据配比、跨模态 curriculum、以及 post-train 是否能修补 pretrain 缺口，都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 TokenSwap：从纯文本样本中找出可视觉化、且对任务有贡献的概念，把这些概念替换成语义对齐的自然图像，形成 image-interleaved 输入。它不是把整段文字渲染成图片，也不是构造传统图文问答，而是在 token/phrase 粒度做替换，尽量保持原始句法结构、上下文和推理负担不变。这样做的好处是控制变量更干净：文本版和多模态版之间，唯一主要变化就是某些语义单元从文字 token 变成视觉 token。

构建 TokenSwap-Bench 时，作者以 MMLU 为底座，经过三步处理。第一步，用 Gemini-2.0-Flash 识别题目和选项中可视觉化的概念，通常是具体实体或视觉可落地的短语。第二步，用文生图模型为每个概念生成对应图像。第三步，做一套比较严格的过滤，避免 benchmark 测到的是图像生成噪声而不是模态差异。这里有几个过滤点比较关键：
1. 图像忠实性验证：检查生成图像是否真的表达了目标概念，且在当前语境下不改变原意。
2. 任务相关性验证：把被替换概念从原文本里删掉，若模型性能不受影响，则说明这些概念并不关键，这类样本会被过滤掉。这样可以避免“替了也无所谓”的伪 gap。
3. 语义可恢复性验证：对替换后的图像做 caption，再把 caption 填回文本，检查是否能恢复原语义，尽量保证视觉替换不是不可逆的信息损失。

训练干预部分，作者不是提出新架构，而是提出一种数据增强思路：把 text-only 数据和 image-interleaved 对应样本一起用于训练。论文强调这种增强既可用于 pre-training，也可用于 post-training。它背后的假设很朴素：如果模型在训练中反复看到“同一语义内容以文本和视觉两种 token 形式出现”，就会被迫学习更稳定的跨模态表示与推理路径。相比只靠图文对齐 loss 或 caption-style 数据，这种做法更直接地监督“替换不变性”。
summary.experiments:
实验最重要的结论有四个。

第一，modality gap 普遍且幅度不小。作者在 42 个 MLLM 上测试，文本输入换成 image-interleaved 输入后，性能下降范围是 4.2% 到 47.4%，平均下降 19.6%，并给出 ±3.3% 的 95% 置信区间。这个量级已经不是边角误差，而是会系统影响多模态推理可靠性的缺口。

第二，reasoning-oriented 模型 gap 明显更小。文中报告 reasoning 模型平均 gap 约 10.1%，非 reasoning 模型约 25.5%。这说明较小的 gap 可能不是来自推理提示词，而是来自训练阶段的特殊机制，比如更强的中间过程监督、更多跨模态 reasoning 数据、或更强调一致性的后训练配方。

第三，常见 prompting 手段帮助有限。无论是 chain-of-thought 还是 few-shot，都不能稳定缩小 gap。这个结果很重要，因为它把问题从“推理时没想清楚”转回“表示层和训练分布没对齐”。

第四，单纯扩大训练算力收益很弱。作者提到训练 FLOPs 增加 10 倍，gap 只大约缩小 2.8%。这说明 scaling 对这个问题不是主解，至少在现有数据和目标下，模型不会自然学到足够强的跨模态不变性。

在训练增强实验里，TokenSwap 数据在 pre-training 和 post-training 两个阶段都能有效减小 modality gap，同时不牺牲 text-only 或常规 vision-language 表现，部分设置下还有轻微增益。摘要和正文片段没有给出完整表格数字，但从作者的表述看，结论不是“只在单一模型上有效”，而是具有一定普适性。阅读时应重点核对：不同模型规模、不同训练阶段、不同增强比例下，gap 缩小幅度是否稳定；以及 text-only / VL benchmark 是否真的没有明显回退。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题定义—benchmark 构造—现象分析—训练修复”四步来读。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2。这里把问题讲得最清楚：什么叫 modality gap，为什么 TokenSwap 比把整段文本变图片更干净，以及最终 benchmark 长什么样。

然后看 TokenSwap-Bench 构造细节，尤其是过滤流程。这里决定 benchmark 是否可信。重点看：概念抽取标准、图像生成质量控制、task relevance 检验、semantic recoverability 检验。如果这些环节不严，gap 可能只是替换噪声。

接着看 42 个模型的大表和 reasoning vs non-reasoning 的分组结果。这里最值得深挖的是：哪些模型 gap 小，是否与训练数据、视觉 encoder、interleaved pretraining、后训练 recipe 有对应关系。若正文或附录给了按架构、机构、训练范式的拆分，建议细看。

最后看训练增强实验。重点不是“能不能涨分”，而是三件事：一，pre-train 和 post-train 哪个阶段更有效；二，是否存在 text-only 能力回退；三，增强样本比例和收益是否线性。预计泛读 25–35 分钟，若要判断是否值得在自家配方里复现，过滤流程和训练实验至少要精读一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multimodal LLMs: they often change their prediction when semantically equivalent text spans are replaced by aligned images. The authors call this the modality gap. The key issue is not generic image understanding, but semantic invariance across modalities. If a concept appears as text tokens in one prompt and as visual tokens in another, a well-trained MLLM should preserve the same reasoning trajectory and final answer. The paper turns this from an anecdotal observation into a measurable benchmarked problem, and then asks whether training can reduce it.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is fairly direct. First, it introduces a diagnostic that is closer to the goal of unified multimodal modeling than standard vision-language benchmarks. Instead of testing whether images add complementary information, it tests whether images can substitute text without breaking semantics. That probes whether pretraining actually learned compatible cross-modal representations. Second, the empirical result is strong enough to matter: across 42 MLLMs, the average drop is 19.6%, and neither scaling, CoT, nor few-shot prompting fixes much of it. That points to a training-distribution and objective mismatch rather than an inference-time prompting issue. Third, the paper shows that TokenSwap-style augmentation can reduce the gap in both pre-training and post-training without hurting text-only or standard VL performance. That makes it relevant to data mixture design, multimodal curriculum, and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central method is TokenSwap. Starting from a text-only sample, the pipeline identifies visualizable concepts that matter for the task, replaces them with semantically aligned natural images, and keeps the surrounding text unchanged. This is different from rendering the whole prompt as an image or building a conventional image-question pair. The replacement happens at the concept or phrase level, so the text-only and multimodal versions remain structurally close. That gives a cleaner controlled test: the main change is that some semantic units move from text tokens to visual tokens.

TokenSwap-Bench is built on top of MMLU. The construction has three main stages. First, Gemini-2.0-Flash is used to identify concepts in questions and answer options that can be visually grounded. Second, each concept is turned into an image with a text-to-image model. Third, the benchmark applies several filters to ensure that measured gaps are not artifacts of poor substitutions. The important filters are:
1. Faithfulness verification: the generated image must correctly represent the intended concept in context.
2. Task relevance verification: if removing the replaced concepts from the original text does not affect prediction, the sample is not useful for measuring a meaningful gap and is filtered out.
