summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the limitations discussion in Section 1.2 and the task design logic across experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. The authors explicitly state this is not a model ranking; its value lies in identifying the value leakage phenomenon and proposing an evaluation paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 价值泄漏根源于预训练数据关联与后训练对齐信号的偏差，建议读§3的评测设计和§4的泄漏类型分析，可用于内部对齐审计
recommendation.en: Value leakage stems from pretraining data correlations and post-training alignment signal biases; read §3 evaluation design and §4 leakage type analysis for internal alignment audits.

paper.title: Partition, Prompt, Aggregate: Statistical Self-Consistency in Language Models
paper.abstract: In-context learning is commonly interpreted as a form of conditional inference, in which the prompt specifies a context and the model's output is treated as an estimate of the corresponding conditional distribution. If this interpretation holds, then LLM estimates should satisfy basic probabilistic identities. In particular, the law of total probability asserts that prior-weighted conditional distributions aggregate into population-level marginals over any valid partition of the population. In t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文检验一个常被默认接受的假设：LLM 的 in-context learning 是否真的像条件概率推断一样工作，特别是在 persona prompting 中，模型给出的子群体估计能否按全概率公式聚合回总体估计。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测和机制理解。它不是改进预训练 recipe 的工作，但它提出了一个干净的统计一致性测试：如果模型在 prompt 条件下输出的是条件分布估计，那么不同 partition 下的条件估计应当和直接总体估计一致。这个视角可用于分析 ICL 的概率校准、persona prompting 的可靠性，以及模型内部世界知识在不同上下文粒度下是否稳定。对基座模型评估来说，它比单点 accuracy 更接近“模型是否形成可组合的分布估计”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法用二叉树构造人口子群体 partition。根节点是基础 population，每一层用一个二元属性继续划分，例如年龄、就业状态或其他人口属性。每个节点都被转成自然语言 persona description，再要求 LLM 估计某个二元事件的概率，例如收入是否超过某个阈值。由于每一层节点构成对根 population 的合法划分，作者可以用真实或给定的 prior weight 对各子群体条件估计做加权求和，并和模型对根节点的直接估计比较。若两者差异大，就说明模型估计违反全概率公式。persona 数据还允许引入 ground-truth population statistics，把 self-consistency 和 external alignment 分开评估。
summary.experiments: 材料中能确认的实验框架包括：递归构造 binary conditioning tree；对每个节点用 ICL/persona prompt elicitation 得到 LLM 概率估计；在每一层按子群体 prior 加权重建 aggregate；比较重建 aggregate 与根节点直接估计，同时比较它们与真实人口统计数据。论文报告称会观察系统性 self-consistency violation，但给出的正文片段没有包含具体模型列表、数据源、误差数值、树深度设置或各类 ablation 结果。因此更适合把它视为一种评测协议和诊断工具，而不是直接得出某个模型强弱结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法部分，重点看 Figure 1、公式 (1)、binary tree 如何生成 partition、prior weight 如何获得、LLM 概率如何 elicitation。预计 20–30 分钟可以把核心方法读完。如果继续深入，优先看实验中 self-consistency error 的定义、不同 tree depth 下误差变化、direct marginal estimate 与 partition-aggregated estimate 谁更接近 ground truth，以及 prompt wording 是否显著影响结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether in-context learning behaves like conditional probabilistic inference. In particular, it asks whether LLM estimates elicited under persona prompts satisfy the law of total probability when subpopulation-level estimates are aggregated back to the population level.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly diagnostic. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it offers a clean way to probe whether a model’s contextual estimates are compositionally consistent. If a prompt-conditioned answer is treated as an estimate of a conditional distribution, then estimates over any valid partition should aggregate to the corresponding marginal. Violations expose a failure mode that is not captured by ordinary accuracy metrics. The idea is useful for studying ICL, calibration, persona prompting, and the stability of model knowledge under changes in conditioning granularity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation scaffold is a binary conditioning tree. The root represents a base population. Each split introduces a binary attribute, producing increasingly specific subpopulations. Every node is verbalized as a persona or context description, and the model is prompted to estimate the probability of a binary event, such as whether income exceeds a threshold. At any fixed tree depth, the nodes form a valid partition of the root population. The authors then reconstruct the population-level estimate by prior-weighted aggregation of the node-level conditional estimates and compare it with the model’s direct root-level estimate. When human reference statistics are available, they also compare both estimates against ground truth, separating self-consistency from external alignment.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided text, the confirmed experimental design includes recursive binary partitioning, persona-prompted probability elicitation at each node, aggregation using partition weights, and comparison against both direct marginal estimates and ground-truth population statistics. The paper reports systematic self-consistency violations as the main phenomenon under study. The excerpt does not provide the full model list, dataset details, numerical error magnitudes, tree depths, or ablation results, so the safest reading is that the paper contributes an evaluation protocol and a set of diagnostic observations rather than a model-improvement method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, Figure 1, equation (1), and the experimental setup. The key details are how the binary trees define valid partitions, how prior weights are obtained, and how probabilities are elicited from the model. A 20–30 minute read should be enough to understand the method. If going deeper, focus on the definition of self-consistency error, error trends with tree depth, whether aggregated or direct estimates better match ground truth, and the sensitivity to prompt wording.

recommendation.zh: 实验设计干净，直接检验ICL作为贝叶斯推断的核心假设，结论对理解LLM概率估计偏差有参考，重点看§3实验设计和§4结果。
recommendation.en: Clean experimental design directly testing the core assumption of ICL as Bayesian inference; focus on §3 setup and §4 results for insights on LLM probability estimation bias.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen

paper.title: Accuracy Without Grounding: Diagnosing Visual Dependency Dissociation in Video LLM Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Benchmark accuracy in video large language models (LLMs) is often treated as evidence of visual understanding. We audit this assumption across twenty models spanning 2-78B parameters and ten architecture families. We introduce the Visual Dependency Gap (VDG), the difference in per-question correctness between original-video and black-screen conditions. Paired McNemar tests on MVBench show that accuracy and visual dependency are separable: models differ on original video (p = 0.0003) but not on b

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是“怎样把视频模型做得更准”，而是一个更基础的评测问题：视频 LLM benchmark 上的高准确率，到底有多少来自真实视觉依赖，多少只是语言先验、题目模板和数据偏置。作者指出，现有视频榜单默认把 accuracy 当成 visual understanding 的代理，但这个假设未被严格检验。论文的核心任务就是把“答对了”与“确实依赖视频内容才答对”这两件事拆开，并给出可统计检验的诊断量。
summary.importance: 从基座研究视角看，这篇工作的重要性不在于提出新模型，而在于它直接挑战了多模态预训练和后训练里一个常见但危险的默认前提：benchmark 提升就等于感知能力提升。若这个前提不成立，很多架构选择、数据配比、视频 token 设计、甚至对 temporal module 的投入，都可能是在优化语言侧捷径而不是视觉建模本身。对 VLM/video LM 研究者，这篇论文的价值主要有三点。第一，它把 accuracy 与 visual dependency 明确区分成两条轴，而不是笼统说“有些题可以不看视频”。第二，它给出 per-question 的诊断指标 VDG，可直接用于数据筛选、benchmark 重加权、以及训练后审计。第三，它对“时间建模是否真的被 benchmark 需要”给出很不舒服但很有用的结论：在作者考察的设置里，temporal ordering 的贡献几乎为零，真正起作用的更多是空间线索和帧多样性。这对视频预训练的目标设计和采样策略都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上最核心的是 Visual Dependency Gap, VDG。对同一道题，在原始视频条件和 black-screen 条件下分别作答，VDG 定义为两种条件下正确性的差值，粒度是 per-question，而不是只看整体均值。这样做的好处是可以把题目按“是否真正依赖视觉输入”分层，也能比较不同模型在同一题上的依赖差异。作者进一步用 paired McNemar test 去证明 accuracy 与 visual dependency 是统计上可分离的：如果两个模型在原视频上准确率显著不同，但在黑屏条件下无显著差异，就说明更高 accuracy 并不自动意味着更强视觉依赖。除了黑屏对照，论文还设计了一个四级诊断 ladder：black screen、single frame、shuffled frames、original video。这个设计很聪明，因为它把视频信息拆成几种成分：有没有任何视觉内容、单帧空间信息是否足够、帧多样性是否重要、时间顺序是否重要。再配合 FPS 从 0.5 到 24 的消融，可以更细地看 benchmark 到底在奖励什么。作者还分析了压缩鲁棒性，用 CRF 曲线解释为什么一些模型在视频压缩下看起来“很稳”，其实可能只是 benchmark 中大量低视觉依赖题目把真正敏感题目的退化抵消了。实验覆盖 20 个模型、10 个架构家族、2B 到 78B，包括开源权重和 API 模型；主分析模型包括 Qwen2-VL-7B、LLaVA-Video-7B、InternVL2-8B，另外还有 Qwen2.5/3-VL、InternVL2/2.5、VideoLLaMA2 等。作者对 4-bit 量化结果专门加了 caveat，没有把它们用于强 scaling 结论，这一点比较严谨。
summary.experiments: 结果里最关键的不是某个模型第一，而是几组诊断结论。第一，在 MVBench 上，InternVL2-8B 在原始视频条件下显著优于 Qwen2-VL-7B，McNemar 检验 p=0.0003；但在 black-screen 条件下两者无显著差异，p=0.53。这个结果直接说明 accuracy 和 visual dependency 可以分离。第二，任务类型的 VDG 排名在 20 个模型上相当稳定：Attribute Perception 的视觉依赖最高，平均约 0.41；Temporal Reasoning 接近语言基线，约 0.06。这不是单模型偶然现象。第三，这个 task-type taxonomy 在不同 benchmark 上有一致性。作者称 Video-MME 的标签可以 100% 预测 MVBench 的分类（7/7），并且能泛化到 EgoSchema，说明“哪些题真依赖视觉”具有跨 benchmark 稳定性。第四，四条件 ladder 显示 temporal ordering 对准确率贡献几乎为零，而 frame diversity 才是主要来源；也就是说，打乱帧顺序往往不怎么伤性能，但退化成单帧会更明显。作者还指出 Qwen3-VL 相比 Qwen2.5-VL 出现 diversity-extraction collapse，说明新模型不一定在真正的视频利用上更好。第五，压缩实验里平坦的 CRF 曲线并不代表模型真的抗压缩，而是正负效应相互抵消；真正对 CRF 敏感的问题，往往恰恰是那些视觉依赖更高的问题。实验规模方面，主 benchmark 包括 Video-MME 的 600 题分层子集、MVBench 的 462 题，以及 EgoSchema；模型规模覆盖 2B–78B。论文还区分了全精度与 4-bit 量化两档，避免把量化噪声误当成架构结论。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合精读，重点不在模型细节，而在评测设计和统计论证。先看引言和 VDG 定义，确认作者到底在测“视觉依赖”而不是“视觉能力”的某个模糊替代物。然后直接读 Section 4.2 的 McNemar dissociation，这是全文最关键的证据链。接着看 task-type VDG spectrum 和 cross-benchmark consistency，理解哪些题型天然更容易被语言先验解掉。之后读 Section 5.5 的四条件 ladder，再结合 FPS ablation，看作者如何把视频信息拆成 spatial、diversity、temporal 三部分。压缩鲁棒性分析也值得看，因为它提醒人不要把 flat curve 误读成模型稳健。若做视频预训练或视频 benchmark，建议重点盯住图表里 black screen、single frame、shuffled frame 与 original video 的差值，而不是只看原始 accuracy 排名。阅读时长大约 45–60 分钟；若只抓主线，先看 VDG 定义、McNemar 表、task-type 排名图、四条件诊断图即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a foundational evaluation problem rather than a new modeling trick: when a video LLM scores well on a benchmark, how much of that accuracy actually depends on visual evidence, and how much comes from language priors, question templates, and dataset bias? Current leaderboards implicitly treat benchmark accuracy as a proxy for visual understanding. This work tests that assumption directly and asks whether correctness and visual dependency are in fact separable.
summary_en.importance: Its importance lies in evaluation hygiene for multimodal pretraining. If benchmark gains do not reliably track visual dependency, then architecture choices, data mixtures, temporal modules, and video tokenization strategies may be optimized against shortcuts rather than genuine video understanding. The paper contributes three things that matter to foundation-model research. First, it separates accuracy from visual dependency as two distinct axes instead of merely noting that some questions are solvable without video. Second, it introduces a per-question diagnostic, VDG, that can be used for benchmark auditing, data filtering, and post-training analysis. Third, it delivers a sobering result for video modeling: in the tested setups, temporal ordering contributes almost nothing, while spatial evidence and frame diversity account for most of the useful signal. That has direct implications for video pretraining objectives and sampling policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central tool is the Visual Dependency Gap (VDG). For each question, the model is evaluated under the original-video condition and under a black-screen condition; VDG is defined from the difference in correctness between the two. This per-question formulation is important because it allows the benchmark to be stratified by actual dependence on visual input rather than only by aggregate averages. The paper then uses paired McNemar tests to show statistical dissociation: if two models differ significantly on original videos but not on black screens, higher accuracy cannot be equated with stronger visual grounding. Beyond the black-screen control, the authors build a four-step diagnostic ladder: black screen, single frame, shuffled frames, and original video. This decomposes what the benchmark is rewarding: any visual content at all, static spatial information, frame diversity, and temporal order. An FPS ablation from 0.5 to 24 FPS provides an additional probe into temporal sensitivity. The paper also revisits compression robustness through CRF sweeps and argues that flat robustness curves can be an artifact of benchmark composition, where visually dependent and visually independent questions cancel each other. The study spans 20 models, 10 architecture families, and 2B–78B parameters, including open-weight and API systems. The authors are careful not to overclaim from 4-bit quantized runs and restrict defended scaling conclusions to full-precision models.
summary_en.experiments: The most important findings are diagnostic rather than leaderboard-oriented. On MVBench, InternVL2-8B significantly outperforms Qwen2-VL-7B under the original-video condition, with McNemar p = 0.0003, yet the same pair is statistically indistinguishable under black screens, with p = 0.53. That is the clearest evidence that accuracy and visual dependency are separable. Across 20 models, the ranking of task types by VDG is highly stable: Attribute Perception is the most visually dependent category at roughly 0.41, while Temporal Reasoning is close to the language-only baseline at roughly 0.06. The taxonomy also transfers across benchmarks: Video-MME labels reportedly predict MVBench classification perfectly for the mapped categories (7/7), and the pattern generalizes to EgoSchema. The four-condition ladder shows that temporal ordering contributes near-zero accuracy across open-weight models, whereas frame diversity matters much more; in practice, shuffling frames often hurts little, while collapsing to a single frame hurts more. The paper also highlights a diversity-extraction collapse in Qwen3-VL relative to Qwen2.5-VL, showing that newer models are not necessarily better at using video-specific information. In compression experiments, flat CRF curves are shown to be misleading because visually dependent questions are disproportionately compression-sensitive, and their degradation can be masked by many low-dependency questions. The benchmark suite includes a 600-question stratified subset of Video-MME, 462 MVBench questions, and EgoSchema, with models ranging from 2B to 78B.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a careful read for its evaluation methodology. Start with the introduction and the formal definition of VDG so the target quantity is clear: the paper is measuring dependence on visual input, not some vague notion of multimodal quality. Then go straight to the McNemar dissociation section, which is the strongest statistical argument in the paper. After that, read the task-type VDG spectrum and the cross-benchmark consistency analysis to understand which categories are structurally vulnerable to language-only solving. Next, study the four-condition ladder and the FPS ablation, since that is where the paper decomposes video information into spatial content, frame diversity, and temporal order. The compression section is also worth reading because it explains why apparent robustness can be a benchmark artifact. If you work on video pretraining or benchmark design, pay more attention to the deltas between black screen, single frame, shuffled frames, and original video than to raw accuracy rankings. A focused read takes about 45–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你看视频VLM结果的方式：先算VDG再谈“理解”；重点看诊断阶梯结论——时序几乎没学到，数据/任务可能在骗你。
recommendation.en: This changes how you interpret video-VLM results: compute VDG before claiming “understanding”; the diagnostic ladder suggests temporal order is barely learned—your data/tasks may be fooling you.

paper.title: VGIF-Score: Interpretable and Diagnostic Evaluation of Spatio-Temporal Instruction Following in Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent video generation models (VGMs) have made substantial progress in visual fidelity, yet their ability to follow long, compositional instructions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing evaluation protocols often rely on prompts that are short and semantically shallow, with limited atomic constraints and weak spatio-temporal dependencies. They also frequently depend on costly human evaluation or handcrafted vision pipelines, while providing little diagnostic insight into which instruction

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型的指令遵循评测多用短浅prompt、缺乏原子时空约束，依赖人工或手工视觉pipeline，无法诊断具体约束的成败原因。
summary.importance: 提出自动化、可解释的视频生成时空指令遵循评测框架VGIF-Score，属于评测方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含两个分支：1）客观完成分支：将prompt解析为时空有向无环图（ST-DAG），做依赖感知QA和短路诊断，定位失败的具体约束；2）主观满意度分支：用指令条件的AutoRubric评估电影感等主观质量维度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体被测模型与量化结果，仅声明框架可实现细粒度诊断、无需人工标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation instruction-following evaluations use short, shallow prompts with limited atomic spatio-temporal constraints, rely on costly human evaluation or handcrafted vision pipelines, and provide no diagnostic insight into specific failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Proposes VGIF-Score, an automated, interpretable evaluation framework for spatio-temporal instruction following in video generation, representing an evaluation method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two components: 1) An objective completion branch that parses prompts into Spatio-Temporal Directed Acyclic Graphs (ST-DAG) for dependency-aware QA with short-circuit diagnostics to localize failed constraints; 2) A subjective satisfaction branch that uses instruction-conditioned AutoRubric to assess subjective dimensions like cinematic quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific tested models or quantitative results, only claiming the framework enables fine-grained diagnostics without manual annotation.

recommendation.zh: 结构化DAG拆解指令+短路诊断的评测思路可迁移至LLM组合指令评测，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: The structured DAG prompt decomposition + short-circuit diagnostic design is transferable to LLM compositional instruction evaluation; keep as reference.

paper.title: The Model Knows Your Project, Not You: Measuring Recognition in LLMs with NameRank
paper.abstract: What a frontier model recalls about a person or tool from its own weights -- before any retrieval step -- often shapes the first description a human sees, making that parametric corpus presence a measurement problem. Citations explain about a third of whether a model recognizes a researcher; we target the residual and build NameRank, a [0,1] recognition score: each of 4,685 entities in 54 cohorts is probed with one open-ended question across 36 models, and an independent judge returns a binary v

summary.core_problem: 如何准确测量大模型在其预训练权重中对特定实体（如研究人员或工具）的记忆程度，排除幻觉和上下文猜测的干扰？
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的评测方法 NameRank，通过严格的二元判定标准，隔离了模型对实体的真实参数化记忆与幻觉/猜测，为理解模型预训练数据的记忆机制提供了更干净的测量工具。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含 54 个队列、4685 个实体的测试集，对 36 个模型进行开放式提问。引入独立裁判（judge）进行二元判定：模型是否陈述了关于该实体的特定、不可猜测的事实？通过合成的空实体（synthetic-null entities）作为基线，确保幻觉、上下文回声和猜测得分为零。
summary.experiments: 在 36 个模型上测试，发现模型对实体的识别度主要取决于该实体是否拥有命名的、可索引的产物（如论文、项目），而不是头衔或证书。奥运会级别的证书得分低于普通研究人员基线，因为奖牌没有附带命名的产物。

summary_en.core_problem: How to accurately measure the extent to which an LLM memorizes specific entities (e.g., researchers or tools) in its pre-trained weights, isolating true recall from hallucination and context guessing?
summary_en.importance: Introduces NameRank, a novel evaluation method with a strict binary verdict criterion that isolates a model's true parametric memory of an entity from hallucinations/guesses, providing a cleaner measurement tool for understanding memorization mechanisms in pre-training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a test set of 4,685 entities across 54 cohorts and probes 36 models with open-ended questions. Employs an independent judge for a binary verdict: did the model state a specific, non-guessable fact about this exact entity? Uses synthetic-null entities as a baseline to ensure hallucinations, context echoes, and guesses score zero.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 36 models, finding that a model's recognition of an entity depends primarily on whether the entity has named, indexable artifacts (e.g., papers, projects), rather than titles or credentials. Olympic-level credentials score below the baseline of a working researcher because medals do not come with named artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 提供了一个干净的 setup 来测量模型的参数化记忆，结论（模型记住的是 artifact 而非 title）对预训练数据清洗和实体注入有启发，值得看其评测设计。
recommendation.en: Provides a clean setup to measure parametric memory; the finding that models memorize artifacts rather than titles is insightful for pre-training data curation and entity injection.

paper.title: Epistemic Stance Flexibility Probing: Measuring Prompt-Conditioned Register Shift in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: A language model may be asked either what experts believe about a contested claim or what it believes about the claim itself. A trustworthy conversational agent should distinguish these two requests and respond in different epistemic registers: neutral attribution in the first case and stance expression in the second. Whether such a shift occurs-and whether it occurs coherently-is not directly assessed by existing benchmarks for accuracy, instruction following, or safety. We introduce ESFP, a be

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否能根据提示中的认识论角色变化，在“专家认为”与“模型自己认为”之间切换回答语体和立场。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法与小型 benchmark。它关注现有准确率、指令遵循和安全评测较少覆盖的 epistemic register shift，即模型能否区分外部归因陈述和自我立场表达。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ESFP，以外部归因提示和自我归因提示的成对对比作为基本测量单元。数据包含 104 个受控条目，覆盖 6 类认识论类别和 5 种措辞模板；评估维度包括词汇层自我归因、表示层对角色框架的响应、由 LLM judge panel 评估的句级立场密度，以及跨条件立场一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 ESFP 用于测量不同提示条件下模型回答的 register shift 和 coherence，但未给出具体被测模型、总体得分、模型间差异或人工验证结果。由于数据规模只有 104 条，更适合作为诊断探针而不是稳健排行榜。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Xi’an Jiaotong University, Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs shift epistemic register when asked what experts believe versus what the model itself believes.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method and small benchmark contribution. It targets epistemic register shift, a behavior not directly captured by standard accuracy, instruction-following, or safety benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: ESFP uses paired externally attributed and self-attributed prompts as the basic measurement unit. It contains 104 controlled items across six epistemic categories and five phrasing templates, and evaluates lexical self-attribution, representation-level responsiveness to role framing, sentence-level stance density via an LLM judge panel, and cross-condition stance consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes ESFP as a probe for register shift and coherence across prompt conditions, but does not list evaluated models, aggregate scores, model differences, or human validation. With 104 items, it is better treated as a diagnostic probe than as a stable leaderboard.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliation is the Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Xi’an Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 小而具体的对齐评测，读指标定义即可；104 条数据不足以支撑强模型结论，但可借鉴题型设计。
recommendation.en: A small but specific alignment eval; read the metric definitions, not the leaderboard claims, since 104 items cannot support strong model-level conclusions.

institutions: Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics

paper.title: Can LLMs Write Reliable Rubrics? A Meta-Evaluation for Experiment Reproduction
paper.abstract: Rubric-based evaluation is a promising approach for assessing open-ended outputs from LLM-based research agents, particularly in paper reproduction, where direct paper-to-repository comparison is prone to hallucination. However, constructing paper-specific rubrics requires substantial expert effort, limiting the scalability of benchmarks such as PaperBench. In this work, we present, to our knowledge, the first systematic meta-evaluation of LLM-generated rubrics for paper reproduction. We reformu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：LLM 能否自动生成足够可靠的 rubric，用于评估论文复现实验这类开放式研究代理任务，从而减少人工制定评分标准的成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是评测方法与 meta-evaluation。它不直接推进预训练，但对“用 LLM judge 评估复杂开放任务”这条线有现实价值，尤其是当社区越来越依赖自动 judge、自动 verifier、自动 benchmark 维护时，rubric 本身的质量会成为上游瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 paper reproduction 的 rubric 重写成 checklist 风格，并比较四种 rubric 生成设定、两个 backbone 模型。评估分两层：一是内在评估，看生成 rubric 与人工 rubric 的语义相似度；二是外在评估，看基于生成 rubric 得到的分数与 ground-truth rubric 的对齐程度。重点不是提出新模型，而是系统检查“LLM 生成评测标准”这件事是否站得住。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示，带增强的生成设定在下游评分对齐上明显更好，最强设定接近人工 baseline；但内在语义相似度提升较有限，说明 rubric 的表面相似与实际评测效用并不完全一致。实验覆盖两个 backbone、四种生成设定，任务场景是 experiment reproduction，和 PaperBench 一类 benchmark 相关。没有给出更大规模、多任务泛化或跨模型 judge 稳定性细节，因此更适合作为评测基础设施的局部证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Manchester、A*STAR I²R、ELLIS Manchester 等机构。Jiaoyan Chen、Sophia Ananiadou 在信息抽取、科学 NLP 与评测相关方向有较多工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs can generate reliable rubrics for evaluating open-ended experiment reproduction, reducing the expert effort needed to build paper-specific evaluation criteria.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is in evaluation methodology and meta-evaluation. It is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for the growing use of LLM judges, verifiers, and benchmark maintenance, where rubric quality can become an upstream bottleneck.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors reformulate reproduction rubrics into checklist-style formats and compare four rubric-generation settings across two backbone models. They evaluate generated rubrics both intrinsically, via semantic similarity to human rubrics, and extrinsically, via score alignment with ground-truth rubric-based evaluations. The core contribution is a systematic test of whether LLM-generated evaluation criteria are dependable.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, augmented generation settings substantially improve downstream score alignment, with the best setup approaching a human baseline, while intrinsic similarity gains are more modest. The study covers two backbones and four generation settings in the paper-reproduction setting related to benchmarks like PaperBench. It appears more like a focused evaluation infrastructure study than a broadly generalizable result across tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Manchester, A*STAR I²R, and ELLIS Manchester. Jiaoyan Chen and Sophia Ananiadou are known for work in information extraction, scientific NLP, and evaluation-related areas.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，知道“rubric 自动生成可用但别把语义相似当代理指标”就够了；读实验设计与外在对齐结果，不必细抠正文。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant; the useful takeaway is that rubric generation can work, but semantic similarity is a weak proxy—read the extrinsic alignment results and move on.

paper.title: On-Device Deep Research at 4B: Exposure Bounds Faithfulness, Retrieval Bounds Coverage
paper.abstract: On-device research agents search a corpus, read sources, and write a cited brief on a personal laptop. Whether their citations are faithful, and at what cost, is unmeasured for a deployable small model. This study fixes one 4B generator on a 24 GB laptop and asks what makes its citations faithful. It separates two quantities usually reported as one number. Cited claim faithfulness asks whether the cited source supports the claim. Trustworthy coverage asks whether the agent also cites the right s

summary.core_problem: 测量小模型 research agent 在本地设备上写带引用摘要时，引用是否真实支持结论，以及检索是否覆盖了正确来源。
summary.importance: 核心价值在评测拆分：把常被混在一起的 citation quality 分成 faithfulness 与 coverage 两个量。这对 RAG/agent 评测设计有启发，但对预训练本身较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定一个 4B 生成模型和 24GB 笔记本部署条件，交叉控制两个变量：生成器能看到的每篇源文档暴露长度（400 vs 1500 字符）和输入来源质量（gold papers vs retrieved papers）。据此区分 cited claim faithfulness 与 trustworthy coverage，并分析二者分别受什么因素限制。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出关键结果：在 retrieved sources 上，增加 exposure 可把 faithfulness 从 0.45 提到 0.58；在 gold sources 上从 0.37 提到 0.58，二者收敛，说明 faithfulness 主要受 exposure 限制。另一方面，coverage 主要受 retrieval 质量限制，而不是生成器看到每篇文档的长度。实验是单一 4B 模型、单设备设定，外推性有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures whether citations produced by an on-device small-model research agent actually support the claims, and whether retrieval covers the right sources in the first place.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is evaluative: it separates citation quality into faithfulness and coverage, two quantities that are often conflated. This is useful for RAG and agent evaluation design, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study fixes a 4B generator on a 24GB laptop and crosses two factors: how much of each source the generator sees (400 vs 1500 characters) and the quality of supplied sources (gold papers vs retrieved papers). It then evaluates cited-claim faithfulness and trustworthy coverage separately to identify what bounds each metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the key finding that increasing exposure raises faithfulness from 0.45 to 0.58 on retrieved sources and from 0.37 to 0.58 on gold sources, with convergence between the two settings. This suggests faithfulness is bounded mainly by exposure. Coverage, by contrast, is bounded by retrieval quality rather than source exposure length. The setup uses a single 4B model on one device, so external validity is limited.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但评测拆分是干净的：faithfulness 看 exposure，coverage 看 retrieval；读摘要和主结果表即可，不必深挖正文。
recommendation.en: The result is not surprising, but the metric split is clean: faithfulness tracks exposure, coverage tracks retrieval; the abstract and main result table are enough.

paper.title: PM-Bench: Evaluating Prospective Memory in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: A significant challenge in agentic AI is prospective memory: the ability to execute an intention at a specific future cue or state while other activities are ongoing. We introduce PM-Bench, a text-based benchmark for measuring prospective memory capabilities in modern LLM agents. Inspired by the Virtual Week paradigm from cognitive science, PM-Bench evaluates how well LLM agents maintain user intentions, execute delayed intentions, and monitor latent environment changes. Over the course of a sim

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM agent 在长期交互中维持未来意图、在正确时机触发延迟任务的 prospective memory 能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个认知科学启发的 agent benchmark。它补了现有 agent eval 对长期意图保持、潜在环境监控和延迟执行能力覆盖不足的空白，但对预训练方法的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PM-Bench，一个文本环境中的七天模拟任务框架，借鉴 Virtual Week 范式。agent 需要在持续进行当前活动的同时，维护用户意图、监控环境状态变化，并在未来 cue 或状态满足时执行 deferred tasks。作者还比较了多种 agent 配置，分析不同 memory/strategy 设计的效果差异。
summary.experiments: 评测 8 个前沿模型和 8 种 agent 配置。摘要给出的关键结果是：最佳方法 GPT-5.4 agent 也只有 65.1% F1，且没有一种统一策略在所有模型上都占优。这说明 prospective memory 是当前 agent 的真实短板，而不是某个 prompt 小技巧能解决的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates prospective memory in LLM agents: the ability to maintain future intentions and execute them at the right cue while other activities continue.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a cognitively motivated benchmark for agents. It fills a gap in current evaluations around delayed intentions, latent state monitoring, and long-horizon intention maintenance, but it is only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PM-Bench, a text-based seven-day simulation inspired by the Virtual Week paradigm from cognitive science. Agents must continue ongoing activities while remembering user intentions, monitoring latent environmental changes, and triggering deferred tasks when the right future cue or state appears. Multiple agent configurations are compared to probe strategy effects.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates eight state-of-the-art models under eight agent configurations. The headline result in the abstract is that the best setup, a GPT-5.4 agent, reaches only 65.1% F1, and no single improvement strategy dominates across models. This suggests prospective memory is a genuine weakness rather than something fixed by a simple prompting trick.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent 长程失败模式，这个 benchmark 值得记名；但它离 pretrain 很远，看 abstract 和主结果表就够。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing if you care about long-horizon agent failure modes, but it is far from pretraining; the abstract and main results table are enough.

paper.title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
paper.abstract: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodula

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是大规模 LLM benchmark 反复评测成本过高的问题：在不使用历史模型得分、正确率或 response 的前提下，只根据 prompt 文本、答案字段和元数据，从多个 benchmark 中选出少量 prompt，使子集上的模型分数和排序尽量接近完整评测套件。
summary.importance: 对基座训练团队的直接价值在评测侧。预训练和 mid-train 阶段需要高频比较 checkpoint、数据配比和训练 recipe，完整跑多套 benchmark 成本很高。已有 benchmark coreset 方法常依赖历史模型评测结果，适合老 benchmark，不适合新 benchmark 或私有 benchmark。这项工作把问题改成 evaluation-unsupervised selection，降低了构建快速评测集的冷启动成本。它不是预训练方法论文，但对训练动态监控、模型选择和回归测试有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 benchmark coreset 当作子模优化问题。选择单位不是整个 benchmark，而是跨多个 benchmark 的单个 prompt，这比只选 benchmark 子集更细，可以避免某个 benchmark 内部冗余过高、但仍有少量独特样本被整体丢掉。每个样本的表示由 prompt 与 ground-truth 字段拼接后再 embedding 得到，ground-truth 字段包括答案、约束、patch 等可观测信息，但不包括模型输出或模型得分。在此基础上，工作比较了多类 submodular objective：DPP 用于鼓励多样性，facility location 用于覆盖语义空间，submodular mutual information 用于在候选样本和目标分布之间做覆盖匹配。差异在于，DPP 更强调被选样本之间不要相似，facility location 更强调每个未选样本都能被某个已选样本代表，mutual information 类目标则更像在约束预算下保留与完整集合相关的信息。
summary.experiments: 实验设定覆盖 35 个异质 benchmark，任务类型包括知识、数学、代码、指令遵循和 agentic 行为等。评估目标不是只看一个 aggregate score，而是同时看完整评测套件的模型分数、模型排名，以及不同能力维度下的保真度。这一点很重要，因为只拟合总体均分可能掩盖能力维度上的偏差。给定内容没有提供完整表格中的具体数值，因此不宜补写具体提升幅度。可以确认的是，实验重点在比较不同无监督子集选择目标相对于随机采样、整 benchmark 选择等基线的 score/ranking preservation，并分析 benchmark 间和 benchmark 内部的冗余。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看问题定义部分，尤其是 evaluation-supervised 与 evaluation-unsupervised 的区分，以及为什么不使用历史模型 response。然后看样本表示构造和各类 submodular objective 的定义，重点比较 DPP、facility location、submodular mutual information 的选择偏好。实验部分重点看三类图表：子集比例与 score/ranking fidelity 的关系，不同能力维度下的误差，以及 benchmark 冗余分析。若用于内部评测体系，最值得复用的是“跨 benchmark、prompt 粒度、无模型得分”的构建流程，而不是某个单一 objective。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build a small prompt-level coreset for LLM evaluation suites without using prior model scores, responses, correctness labels, or item-response statistics. The goal is to approximate full-suite scores and rankings while selecting only from observable benchmark fields such as prompts, answers, constraints, and metadata.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is evaluation efficiency during model development. Pretraining and mid-training workflows often require frequent checkpoint comparisons, data-mixture checks, and regression tests. Running a large heterogeneous benchmark suite each time is expensive. Prior benchmark compression methods often rely on historical model evaluations, which makes them less useful for new, private, or contamination-sensitive benchmarks. This work is useful because it targets the cold-start setting: construct a fast evaluation subset before collecting score matrices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates benchmark coreset construction as submodular subset selection at prompt granularity. Instead of selecting whole benchmarks, it selects fractional prompt subsets across many benchmarks, which can preserve useful non-redundant examples from otherwise redundant datasets. Each item is embedded using model-independent semantic features built from the prompt concatenated with ground-truth fields such as answers, constraints, and patches. The paper then compares several submodular objectives. DPP-style objectives favor diversity among selected items. Facility-location objectives favor coverage of the full item set through nearest selected representatives. Submodular mutual-information objectives aim to retain information about the target suite under a budget. These objectives encode different tradeoffs between diversity, coverage, and fidelity to the full benchmark distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematics, coding, instruction following, and agentic behavior. The fidelity criteria include preservation of model scores, model rankings, and capability-wise behavior rather than only an overall average. This design matters because errors can cancel out in aggregate scores while still distorting specific capabilities. The supplied content does not include the complete result tables, so exact numerical gains should not be inferred. The important experimental axis is the comparison between unsupervised submodular selection, random selection, and coarser benchmark-level selection under different subset budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the problem setup, especially the distinction between evaluation-supervised and evaluation-unsupervised coreset selection. Then read the item representation pipeline and the definitions of DPP, facility-location, and submodular mutual-information objectives. In the experiments, look for curves of subset budget versus score/ranking fidelity, capability-wise error plots, and redundancy analysis. For an internal evaluation pipeline, the most reusable idea is the cold-start, prompt-level, cross-benchmark selection protocol rather than any single objective.

recommendation.zh: 做内部模型快速评测或ablation筛选时可直接复用FL子模块选prompt的思路，重点看§3的子模块函数设计和§4的相关性实验。
recommendation.en: For fast internal model evaluation or ablation screening, directly reuse the FL submodular prompt selection pipeline; focus on §3 function design and §4 correlation experiments.

paper.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
paper.abstract: Current Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) excel in question answering (QA) but largely operate as black boxes, providing textual answers without verifiable visual grounding. Existing explainability efforts rely on textual rationales or sparse bounding boxes, which struggle to capture complex video dynamics such as occlusions and non-rigid deformations. We propose Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA), a novel task requiring models to jointly output a semantic answer and precise

summary.core_problem: 现有视频大模型在视频问答任务中仅输出文本答案，缺乏可验证的时空视觉依据。现有可解释性方案要么依赖纯文字推理依据，要么仅在有限关键帧上提供稀疏边界框，无法处理遮挡、非刚体形变、交互过程中的目标身份持续跟踪等复杂视频动态；目前也没有标准化基准来衡量模型答案是否来自真实视觉感知，而非依赖语言先验或幻觉。
summary.importance: 工作暴露了当前视频大模型的核心能力缺口：问答准确率高不代表视觉感知正确，模型经常靠学到的语言先验甚至幻觉输出正确答案，并没有真正处理视觉信息。提出的任务形式把高层语义推理和像素级感知验证绑定在一起，为多模态预训练中设计耦合感知与推理的训练目标提供了具体参考，明确指出像素级grounding能力无法靠单纯扩大参数规模自然涌现。
summary.technical_approach: 定义E-VQA任务，要求模型同时输出三类结果：语义答案、支撑答案的相关视频时间段、关键证据目标的稠密跟踪式时空分割掩码（masklet）。构建ST-Evidence基准，包含两种评测设置：ST-Evidence-MCQ为选择题形式，分别评测模型选择正确答案、定位相关时间段、匹配正确空间掩码的判别式能力；ST-Evidence-Gen为生成式设置，要求模型直接输出完整三元组。同时构建16万样本规模的ST-Evidence-Instruct指令微调数据集，通过自动化流程将现有视频问答对与对应的时空掩码证据对齐，支撑端到端的接地视频推理训练。
summary.experiments: 对Qwen3-VL、OpenAI o3、Gemini 2.5 Pro等主流模型的评测显示，在ST-Evidence-MCQ上，模型的问答准确率和grounding能力没有相关性，多数开源模型的空间证据选择准确率接近随机猜测水平。生成式设置下，采用通用多模态大模型生成文本描述、再对接外部grounding模型的两阶段流程，时空定位得分都处于较低水平；UniPixel、Sa2VA这类专门优化接地能力的视频模型，在需要联合推理的E-VQA任务上也表现不佳。在ST-Evidence-Instruct上微调UniPixel后，模型的问答准确率和稠密grounding性能均有稳定提升，验证了针对性数据补充的价值；整体实验结果表明，单纯scaling参数无法填补这一能力缺口，需要架构、数据、训练目标的协同改进。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点关注证据接地的任务动机、基准设计逻辑，以及问答准确率与grounding能力解耦的核心实验结论，快速浏览数据集构建和微调部分即可，不需要深究标注流程的低层细节。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video large language models produce only textual answers for video QA tasks, with no verifiable spatio-temporal visual grounding for their outputs. Existing explainability approaches rely on either textual rationales or sparse bounding boxes on a small set of keyframes, which cannot capture complex video dynamics including occlusions, non-rigid deformations, and persistent object identity tracking across interactions. No standardized benchmark exists to measure whether models derive answers from genuine visual perception, rather than relying on learned language priors or hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a critical capability gap in current video LLMs: high QA accuracy does not equate to correct visual perception, as models often produce correct answers using language priors or hallucinations without processing actual visual signals. The task formulation couples high-level semantic reasoning with pixel-level perceptual verification, providing a concrete training and evaluation target for building more reliable multimodal models, and makes clear that dense grounding capability does not emerge naturally from parameter scaling alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The E-VQA task is defined to require three joint outputs from models: a semantic answer, the relevant temporal video segments supporting the answer, and dense tracked spatio-temporal segmentation masks (masklets) for key evidence objects. The ST-Evidence benchmark is built with two evaluation settings: ST-Evidence-MCQ uses a multiple-choice format to discriminatively evaluate models' ability to select the correct answer, identify relevant temporal segments, and match correct spatial masks; ST-Evidence-Gen uses a generative format requiring full triplet output. A 160k-sample instruction tuning dataset ST-Evidence-Instruct is also constructed, using automated pipelines to align existing video QA pairs with corresponding spatio-temporal mask evidence for end-to-end grounded video reasoning training.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across leading models including Qwen3-VL, OpenAI o3, and Gemini 2.5 Pro on ST-Evidence-MCQ show no correlation between QA accuracy and grounding performance, with most open-source models performing near random chance on spatial evidence selection. Under the generative setting, two-stage pipelines that pair general MLLMs with external grounding models produce low temporal and spatial grounding scores. Specialized grounded video models such as UniPixel and Sa2VA also struggle with the joint reasoning requirement. Fine-tuning UniPixel on ST-Evidence-Instruct yields consistent gains in both QA accuracy and dense grounding performance, confirming the value of targeted data supplementation. Overall results indicate that scaling model size alone cannot close this capability gap, which requires coordinated improvements to architecture, data, and training objectives.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the motivation for evidence grounding, benchmark design, and the core finding that QA accuracy decouples from grounding proficiency. Skim the dataset construction and fine-tuning sections; there is no need to dive into low-level annotation pipeline details. Expected reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看评测定义和失败案例；它提醒 VLM 训练别把语言答案当视觉理解的充分信号。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and failure cases; it is a useful warning that answer correctness is not a sufficient training signal for visual understanding.

paper.title: WILDTRACE: Benchmarking Natural Evidence Trails in Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Answering complex questions over long documents frequently requires integrating evidence that the source itself disperses naturally across distant passages. In an incident report, the operating condition, design flaw, and missed safety check that jointly explain a disaster may appear dozens of sections apart; in a novel, a character's true motive may surface only through scenes far removed from the moment it becomes relevant. This source-internal evidence integration is central to real-world lon

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的 long-context QA，而是更窄也更难的一类问题：在原始长文档里，证据并不会被任务设计者预先挑出来，也不会以“needle”方式人工插入；模型需要自己在同一文档内部发现分散、同文体、低显著度的关键线索，并恢复这些线索之间的因果、时间、比较、解释或反事实关系，最后给出有根据的结论。作者认为，现有长上下文评测往往把难点拆开测：要么测能不能在长序列里找到插入事实，要么测给定证据后的推理，要么测人为拼接的 multi-hop 链条；但真实分析任务更接近“source-induced evidence trail recovery”，也就是证据发现和关系恢复同时成立。WildTrace 的核心问题就是为这种能力建立一个更干净的评测边界。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练方法，而在于把 long-context 评测里的一个长期混淆点拆清楚了：很多模型在“长上下文”上表现不错，可能只是因为证据被设计得过于显眼、位置受控、词面匹配强，或者支持段落已经被外部检索器预选。WildTrace 试图把这些 construction cue 压低，让评测更接近真实文档分析。对预训练研究员，这类 benchmark 的意义主要有三点。第一，它更适合区分“记忆窗口变长”与“证据组织能力变强”这两件事。第二，它能更真实地暴露模型在 source-grounded reasoning 上的短板，尤其是证据必要性、关系塌缩、局部捷径等问题。第三，它为后续做长上下文预训练、文档级数据构造、过程监督、检索-推理接口设计提供了更可操作的误差分解框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是 source-first 构造，而不是 question-first。作者从 214 份公开长文档源出发，覆盖技术事故报告和较少被公众熟知的文学叙事。先把每个 source 切成重叠窗口，再把局部上下文转成 evidence record，记录实体、事件、属性、时间标记、引语、局部关系和短摘要等信息。随后把这些 record 连成一个带类型的 source-internal graph；只有当原文局部上下文明确支持两条事实之间的关系时，才加边。接着不是人工随意出题，而是用几类“evidence geometry”在图上挖自然形成的证据轨迹，包括 forward chains、intersections、comparisons、temporal reconstructions、causal fan-in、abductive explanations、counterfactual branches 七类。也就是说，题目先由文档内部结构诱导出来，再由人工写成公开问题、参考答案、关键事实和 rubric。

作者对 benchmark fidelity 的控制做得比较细。候选样本是高召回挖掘出来的，但进入正式集之前要过多道门。四类主要威胁分别是：source grounding、multi-hop necessity、shortcut resistance、answerability。对应地，他们做了 grounding 检查，确保答案、关键事实、证据 span 和评分标准都能被原文支持；做 leave-one-out 和 single-clue ablation，排除掉删去部分证据后仍能唯一作答的伪 multi-hop 样本；做 no-document probe，过滤公共常识或污染导致的无文档作答；还做 evidence-conditioned 检查，验证隐藏 trail 一旦提供，是否足以支持答案。再加上人工审核和外部审计，去掉 unsupported facts、冗余线索、歧义答案和几何类型不匹配的样本。这个流程的重点不是规模，而是尽量把“自然证据链”这个概念落到可验证的数据工艺上。
summary.experiments:
数据构造上，作者从 214 个长文档源中得到 3,506 个带验证跟踪的候选 trail-question artifact，最终公开集保留 481 个任务，存活率 13.7%。这个数字本身说明自然证据链 benchmark 很难做：高召回挖掘不难，难的是把伪多跳、局部捷径、公共知识泄漏和答案歧义清掉。

从全文给出的实验意图看，重点不是刷一个大而全的榜，而是证明现有模型在这种“证据未显式给出”的长文档推理上仍有明显缺口。作者区分了两类能力：一类是 evidence discovery，另一类是 relation recovery。很多模型在给定证据条件下会明显变好，说明瓶颈并不只是推理器不够强，而是先前没能在原文里找到真正 load-bearing 的片段，或者没能保持这些片段之间的依赖结构。消融检查也很关键：如果一个样本在 single-clue 或 leave-one-out 下仍可解，就会被剔除，这使得最终集对“多证据必要性”更严格。由于你给出的全文片段没有完整榜单数字，我不编造具体模型分数；但从构造与验证设计可以明确看出，这个 benchmark 的实验价值主要体现在错误类型分解，而不是单一平均分。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者为什么不满意 needle、retrieval-given、reverse-engineered multi-hop 三类评测讲清楚。这里定义了 WildTrace 的真正边界：不是长上下文本身，而是 source-induced evidence trails。然后重点看数据构造流程图和 verification pipeline，尤其是 evidence record、typed graph、geometry mining、promotion gates 这几步。理解这几步后，基本就能判断这个 benchmark 是否真的比现有集更干净。

如果时间有限，优先看三类内容：第一，七种 evidence geometry 的定义和示例；第二，leave-one-out、single-clue、no-document probe 这些 fidelity 检查；第三，模型误差分析里 evidence discovery 与 reasoning failure 的区分。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要贡献。若你做长上下文预训练或文档级数据合成，值得多看附录里的 annotation rubric 和 rejection case，因为那里最能看出作者如何处理“看起来像多跳、其实不是”的样本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a stricter setting than generic long-context QA: answers must be supported by naturally dispersed, source-internal evidence trails rather than benchmark-inserted facts, pre-selected passages, or reverse-engineered multi-hop chains. The model must discover which ordinary-looking fragments in a long document are actually load-bearing, determine how they relate, and then derive an answer from those relations. The missing evaluation boundary, as framed here, is not long context alone and not multi-hop alone, but full-document reasoning with hidden evidence and source-grounded dependencies.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic. WildTrace helps separate three capabilities that are often conflated: handling more tokens, finding the right evidence, and preserving the dependency structure that makes the evidence jointly sufficient. Existing long-context benchmarks often leak construction cues through inserted facts, lexical overlap, localized support, or externally supplied passages. This benchmark tries to remove those shortcuts. For foundation-model work, that matters because it gives a cleaner target for document-level pretraining, long-context data design, retrieval-reasoning interfaces, and process supervision aimed at evidence discovery rather than answer-only optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central design choice is source-first construction. Starting from 214 public long-form sources, including technical incident reports and lesser-known literary narratives, the authors segment each source into overlapping windows and convert local context into evidence records: entities, events, attributes, temporal markers, quotations, local relations, and short summaries. These records are then linked into a typed source-internal graph, with edges added only when the surrounding text supports the relation.

Benchmark items are mined from this graph using seven evidence geometries: forward chains, intersections, comparisons, temporal reconstructions, causal fan-in, abductive explanations, and counterfactual branches. Only after a natural trail is grounded in the source do the authors write the public question, reference answer, key facts, and rubric. This is a meaningful departure from question-first datasets, where evidence is often assembled around a target answer.

The verification pipeline is also a major contribution. Promotion to the final benchmark is organized around four threats: source grounding, multi-hop necessity, shortcut resistance, and answerability. Grounding checks ensure that answers, evidence spans, key facts, and rubric criteria are all supported by the source. Leave-one-out and single-clue ablations remove items where a proper subset of evidence already determines the answer. No-document probes filter contamination and public-knowledge shortcuts. Evidence-conditioned checks verify that the hidden trail is sufficient when supplied. Human review and external audits further remove unsupported facts, redundant clues, ambiguous answers, and geometry mismatches. The paper is less about scale and more about benchmark fidelity.
summary_en.experiments:
On the construction side, the pipeline starts from 3,506 validation-tracked candidate trail-question artifacts mined from 214 long-form sources, and only 481 tasks survive into the public release, a 13.7% acceptance rate. That low survival rate is informative: naturally occurring multi-hop evidence trails are easy to overgenerate but hard to verify cleanly.

The experimental message is not just that current models struggle, but why they struggle. The benchmark is set up to distinguish evidence discovery from downstream reasoning. Models can improve substantially when the relevant trail is supplied, which suggests that a large part of the failure is not pure reasoning weakness but failure to identify the right source fragments or to preserve the relation among them. The ablation-based filtering is also important experimentally: by rejecting items solvable from a single clue or a reduced evidence set, the final benchmark enforces genuine multi-evidence necessity more strictly than many prior datasets. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete leaderboard tables, so I will not invent model scores; the main empirical value lies in the benchmark design and the resulting error decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction. It clearly explains why needle-style probes, retrieval-given settings, and reverse-engineered multi-hop datasets are insufficient for this target capability. Then focus on the construction pipeline: evidence records, typed graph building, geometry-based trail mining, and the promotion gates. Those sections determine whether the benchmark is actually measuring what it claims to measure.

If time is limited, prioritize three parts: the definitions and examples of the seven evidence geometries; the fidelity checks such as leave-one-out, single-clue ablations, and no-document probes; and the error analysis separating evidence discovery failures from reasoning failures. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If your work touches long-context pretraining or document-level data curation, the annotation rubric and rejection examples are worth extra attention because they show how the authors operationalize “natural evidence trails” rather than merely naming them.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文的人该看：它不是新方法，但会直接影响你怎么看 needle 类结果；先读任务构造和误差分析，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on long context: it will change how much you trust needle-style wins; focus on task construction and failure analysis, not just leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
paper.abstract: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to dec

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLM 评测大多停留在单视角或弱多视角感知，缺少对模型是否能把多视角观察整合成统一、世界坐标系下 3D 场景表征的诊断。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测工作，贡献在于把“world-centric multi-view integration”单独拎出来测。对做原生多模态预训练的人有价值，因为它测的不是普通图文对齐，而是更接近具身和 3D 理解所需的跨视角一致性能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MultiView-Bench，专门构造需要跨视角聚合信息、并在固定全局坐标系中判断物体关系的任务。设计上刻意区分：单图 2D 关系、3D 空间关系、以及多视角整合，借此定位 VLM 是卡在几何理解本身，还是卡在跨视角记忆与整合。
summary.experiments: 作者系统评测了前沿 VLM，结论是：模型在单图 2D 平面关系上通常表现较强，但在 3D 空间关系和多视角信息整合上明显失效；同时还分析了视觉语言数据中的偏置会如何掩盖真实的空间推理缺陷。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合作为诊断基准而非性能论文来读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yale University 和 University of Edinburgh。未见可确认的一线基座模型作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM evaluations mostly test single-view or weak multi-view perception, but do not directly probe whether models can integrate multiple viewpoints into a coherent world-centric 3D representation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. Its value is in isolating world-centric multi-view integration as a distinct capability. For multimodal pretraining researchers, this matters because it targets cross-view consistency rather than generic image-text alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark built around tasks that require aggregating observations across viewpoints and reasoning in a fixed global coordinate frame. The setup separates single-image 2D relations, 3D spatial relations, and true multi-view integration, making failure modes easier to localize.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate frontier VLMs and find a consistent pattern: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but clear weakness on 3D spatial reasoning and cross-view aggregation. They also analyze dataset and prompt biases that can mask genuine spatial reasoning deficits. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact margins, so this is best read as a diagnostic benchmark rather than a performance paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Yale University and the University of Edinburgh. No clearly identifiable foundation-model lab authors can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态预训练可以记住这个 benchmark，但不必细读正文；价值在于它把“跨视角整合失败”从泛泛空间推理里单独剥出来了。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on multimodal pretraining; the main value is that it cleanly isolates cross-view integration failure from generic spatial reasoning.

paper.title: Do You Need a Frontier Model as a Citation Verifier? Benchmarking Rubric LLMs for Deep-Research Source Attribution
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning increasingly relies on an LLM judge to score each rubric criterion, and that judge acts as the reward model during training. Before such a signal can be trusted, we need to know how capable the judge must be and how biased it is. We study this calibration question for citation quality in deep-research systems, where a search-grounded LLM must support each claim it writes with a cited source. Citation quality is a structured rubric task in which each attribution-citation pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何做更好的 citation evaluation”，而是一个更具体、也更贴近 RL 后训练的问题：当 citation rubric 被拿来当 reward signal 时，离线评测里常用的 LLM judge 到底需要多强、偏差有多大、能不能用更便宜的模型替代前沿模型。作者把问题收缩到 deep-research 场景中的 attribution-citation pair 级别判断，重点看两个必须依赖 LLM 的维度：source relevance 和 factual support。前者判断引用源是否和 claim 主题相关，后者判断该源是否真的支撑 claim。论文的核心出发点很清楚：如果 judge 的方向性偏差没有被校准，那么 RLVR 学到的就不是“更真实的引用”，而是“更迎合某个 judge 的 rubric 偏好”的行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在训练 recipe 本身，而在 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口：很多后训练工作已经把 rubric-judged reward 当成默认做法，但 reward model 的能力边界和偏差结构常常没有被单独测量。这篇工作给出的价值主要有三点。第一，它把“LLM-as-judge 是否足够可靠”从泛泛讨论落到一个结构化、可人工复核的任务上，适合作为 RLVR reward calibration 的案例。第二，它说明 judge 选择不能只看单一 F1；pass-rate drift、false positive rate、false negative rate 会直接决定训练时被强化的行为方向。第三，它给出一个偏实务的结论：在定义清楚、输入受控的 rubric 任务上，便宜模型未必明显差于 frontier model，但不同维度可能需要不同 judge。这对构建低成本、可扩展的 reward pipeline 有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有提出新的 judge 架构，而是把 benchmark 和分析框架做得足够贴近真实训练使用场景。整体流程建立在已有的 source attribution evaluation pipeline 之上：先从 markdown 长文中用 AST parser 抽取 attribution-citation pairs，再对每个 pair 按 rubric 打分。作者这次补上的关键部分，是构造了一个受控、带对抗性的 long-form benchmark，并为两个 LLM-judged 维度建立 gold labels。

数据构造上，benchmark 是一篇覆盖 25 个主题域的长报告，里面故意混入 factual errors 和 misleading citations，让 judge 不能只靠表面词重合做判断。标注单元是 624 个 attribution-citation pairs，对应 1,248 个 rubric decisions。所有标签都经过人工复核，其中 378 个 hard cases 来自 judge disagreement 后再 adjudication，这一点很重要：它让 benchmark 更像是在测“judge 在边界样本上的稳定性”，而不是只测容易样本上的平均准确率。

评测对象是 8 个 off-the-shelf judges，来自 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 三个家族。作者没有做 task-specific fine-tuning，刻意模拟实际部署时“直接拿现成模型做 judge”的情形。指标设计也比常见的 judge benchmark 更贴近 reward 使用：主指标是 F1 和 Cohen’s kappa，用来衡量与 gold 的一致性；同时额外报告 pass-rate drift、FPR、FNR，用来刻画方向性偏差。这里的关键判断是：两个 judge 可能 F1 接近，但一个偏宽松、一个偏保守，在 RL 中会导向完全不同的策略更新。论文真正有信息量的地方就在这里，而不是简单排一个 judge 榜单。

从问题设定上看，这篇工作和一般 LLM-as-judge 论文的区别在于三点。第一，它不是开放式偏好评审，而是细粒度 rubric decision，更接近 process reward model 的 step-level judgment。第二，它把 citation quality 拆成 relevance 与 support 两个不同认知负担的子任务，避免把错误混在一起。第三，它强调 retrieval harness 会影响 judge 输入分布，因此 judge 评测结果只在给定 attribution extraction 和 source presentation 方式下成立，这种系统视角比单纯比较模型分数更实用。
summary.experiments:
核心结果有两个。第一，没有单一模型在两个维度上都占优。source relevance 上，GPT-5-mini 的 F1 最好，达到 0.908，kappa 为 0.636；factual support 上，Claude Opus 4.6 最强，F1 为 0.750，kappa 为 0.701。这个结果说明 relevance 和 support 不是同一种 judge 能力：前者更像主题匹配与局部证据对齐，后者更接近细粒度事实核验与证据充分性判断。

第二，方向性偏差差异显著，而且不能被 F1 反映。论文强调，不同 judge 在 pass-rate drift、FPR、FNR 上差别很大。也就是说，有些模型更容易“放过”不充分引用，有些模型更容易“错杀”本来合格的引用。对于 RLVR，这不是次要问题：高 FPR 会奖励虚假支撑，高 FNR 会压制本来正确但表达复杂的回答。虽然给出的摘要里没有列出全部模型逐项数值，但全文的重点显然不是谁分最高，而是“相近准确率下偏差结构不同”。

数据规模方面，benchmark 含 624 个 pair、1,248 个 LLM-judged decisions，全部 human-reviewed，其中 378 个是 hard cases，包含 263 个 relevance 难例和 115 个 support 难例。这个规模不算大，但对于人工复核的 citation-level benchmark 已经足够支撑 judge calibration 分析。论文还把任务放在 adversarial long-form setting 下，这比短问答式 citation checking 更接近 deep-research agent 的真实输出分布。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一看 Introduction，重点不是背景铺陈，而是作者如何把 citation judging 明确映射成 RLVR 中的 reward model 问题。第二看 benchmark construction 和 labeling protocol，确认 hard cases 是怎么来的、人工 adjudication 的标准是什么，因为这决定了结果可信度。第三看结果表里 F1/kappa 与 bias metrics 的并列展示，尤其是相近 F1 但不同 FPR/FNR 的模型对比，这是全文最该记住的结论。

如果时间有限，建议优先看：任务定义图、benchmark 统计表、主结果表、误差分析部分。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 factual support 的定义边界是否足够稳定，是否会受 source chunking 和上下文截断影响；二是如果把 judge 放进真实 RL loop，pass-rate drift 最终会怎样改变 policy behavior，这篇工作提出了问题，但没有真正做 closed-loop training 验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but operationally important question for RL with rubric-based rewards: how strong does an LLM judge need to be before citation-quality rewards become unreliable, and what kinds of bias do different judges introduce? The setting is deep-research systems that generate long-form answers with source attributions. Each attribution-citation pair is scored on two LLM-dependent dimensions: source relevance and factual support. The real target is not citation evaluation in isolation, but reward calibration. If the judge is systematically too lenient or too strict, the downstream RL loop will optimize toward that bias rather than toward faithful attribution.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly at the pretrain/post-train interface rather than in core pretraining mechanics. Many post-training pipelines now treat rubric-scored LLM judges as a default reward source, but the judge itself is often under-evaluated. This work contributes a concrete calibration study in a structured task with human-reviewed labels. Three points matter. First, it shows that judge quality can be studied on a task that is narrow enough to label carefully, yet realistic enough to matter for deployed research agents. Second, it argues that scalar agreement metrics are insufficient for reward design; pass-rate drift, false positives, and false negatives determine what behavior gets reinforced. Third, it suggests that cheaper off-the-shelf judges can be competitive on well-specified rubric tasks, though not uniformly across dimensions. That is useful for building scalable reward pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does not introduce a new judge model. Its contribution is a benchmark and an analysis protocol designed around actual reward-model use. The evaluation pipeline follows prior source-attribution work: parse attribution-citation pairs from markdown long-form outputs using an AST-based parser, then score each pair against rubric criteria. The new piece is a controlled adversarial benchmark with gold labels for the two LLM-judged dimensions.

The benchmark is a single long-form report spanning 25 topic domains, intentionally seeded with factual errors and misleading citations. This design prevents judges from succeeding through shallow lexical overlap alone. The labeled unit is the attribution-citation pair. In total there are 624 pairs and 1,248 rubric decisions. All labels are human-reviewed, and 378 hard cases are explicitly adjudicated from judge disagreements. That matters because it shifts the benchmark toward boundary cases, where reward signals are most fragile.

The study evaluates 8 off-the-shelf judges from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI, without task-specific fine-tuning. This is deliberate: the goal is to reflect realistic deployment, where teams often plug in a general-purpose model as a judge. Metrics are also chosen with reward use in mind. F1 and Cohen’s kappa measure agreement with gold labels, while pass-rate drift, false positive rate, and false negative rate expose directional bias. This is the central methodological point: two judges with similar F1 can induce very different RL behavior if one over-accepts weak citations and the other over-rejects valid but complex ones.

Relative to generic LLM-as-judge papers, the setup differs in three ways. It uses structured rubric decisions rather than open-ended preference judgments. It separates source relevance from factual support instead of collapsing them into one score. And it treats retrieval and source presentation as part of the evaluation context, acknowledging that judge behavior depends on the harness, not just on the model.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that no single judge dominates both dimensions. On source relevance, GPT-5-mini achieves the best F1 at 0.908 with kappa 0.636. On factual support, Claude Opus 4.6 leads with F1 0.750 and kappa 0.701. This split is informative: relevance looks more like topical matching plus local evidence alignment, while factual support requires stricter evidence sufficiency and factual verification.

The second key result is that directional bias varies substantially even when scalar accuracy is similar. The paper highlights large differences in pass-rate drift, false positive rate, and false negative rate across judges. That matters directly for RLVR. A high false positive rate rewards unsupported claims; a high false negative rate suppresses correct but nuanced attributions. The benchmark therefore does more than rank judges. It shows that reward design must account for the shape of judge errors, not just average agreement.

In terms of scale, the benchmark contains 624 attribution-citation pairs and 1,248 LLM-judged decisions, all human-reviewed, with 378 hard cases including 263 relevance disputes and 115 support disputes. This is not a massive dataset, but it is substantial for citation-level human adjudication, especially in an adversarial long-form setting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, the introduction, specifically where the paper reframes citation judging as a reward-model calibration problem for RLVR. Second, the benchmark construction and labeling protocol, because the credibility of the results depends heavily on how hard cases were generated and adjudicated. Third, the main results tables where F1 and kappa are shown alongside bias metrics. The most important takeaway is not the leaderboard, but the mismatch between similar scalar accuracy and different error directions.

If time is limited, read the task-definition figure, benchmark statistics, main comparison table, and the error-analysis section. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main message. The deeper questions worth following up are whether factual-support labels remain stable under different source chunking or context windows, and how these judge biases would actually alter policy behavior inside a closed-loop RL training run.

recommendation.zh: 做 RL judge 或 verifier 的人该看；结论未必能外推到所有 rubric，但“便宜 judge 在 relevance 上够用、support 上未必”这个分解很实用。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you build RL judges or verifiers; the result may not generalize to every rubric, but the split—cheap judges are often enough for relevance, not necessarily for factual support—is operationally useful.

paper.title: Understanding Axes of Difficulty For Long Context Tasks Via PredicateLongBench
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated rapidly improving long-context capabilities, prompting a wave of benchmarks designed to evaluate them. However, existing long-context evaluations - from Needle-in-a-Haystack (NIAH) tests to more recent multi-hop reasoning and summarization tasks - predominantly measure average-case performance, and many are either saturated or lack robustness. Notably absent is a systematic way to probe how models perform as we scale up the difficulty of tasks along

summary.core_problem: 长上下文评测常见问题是：要么只测平均表现、要么任务很快饱和、要么难度提升方式单一（只拉长 context 或加 needle/distractor），缺少一套能沿多条“难度轴”连续调参、且不依赖 LLM 生成/LLM judge 的压力测试。论文要解决的是：构建一种算法化、可控、可扩展的长上下文基准，用来系统分解并放大长上下文任务的不同难点来源。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产，对预训练研究的价值在于提供更可诊断的信号：把“长上下文能力”拆成可控的难度轴（长度、干扰结构、计算量/非局部性、搜索空间等），更容易定位模型退化来自注意力/检索失败、来自全局约束满足失败，还是来自计算步骤不足。对做长上下文预训练、数据课程、以及长上下文训练动态的人，这类可参数化基准比一次性任务集合更适合做 scaling 与 ablation。
summary.technical_approach:
PredicateLongBench 的核心任务形式是：给一个很长的由空格分隔的词序列作为上下文，要求模型找出满足一组谓词/约束的“最长连续子序列”。形式化为：给定谓词类 H，一组谓词 f1..fj∈H，找最大 k，使得存在连续子串 w=(w1..wk) 同时满足所有 fi(w)=1。

关键设计点是“难度轴可控”：
- 通过谓词类型控制计算与依赖结构：例如 unary predicate（只依赖某个位置的单词属性）相对更像检索/过滤；更复杂谓词会引入跨位置关系与全局一致性要求。
- 通过 distractor 的组织结构控制干扰强度，不仅是随机噪声，还研究“结构化干扰”对前沿模型的影响。
- 引入 search space 作为新轴：在固定 token budget 下扩大候选空间/组合空间，让任务更难但不必无限拉长上下文。

整体取舍是：任务生成与判分尽量算法化、确定性，避免引入 LLM judge 带来的噪声与可被投机的评分漏洞，同时又能覆盖从局部检索到更非局部的约束满足。
summary.experiments:
作者在多种难度轴设置下测试前沿模型，并报告一个关键现象：上下文中 distractor 的“结构”会显著影响表现，不同组织方式带来明显差异，说明很多模型的长上下文能力并非只由窗口长度决定，而与其检索/注意力在特定分布下的脆弱性相关。

由于你提供的全文片段未包含实验章节的具体模型列表、上下文长度范围、以及各设置下的准确率曲线/数值表格，这里无法可靠给出具体数字与排名。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看任务定义与谓词分类（Benchmark/Setup 部分），把“最长连续子序列 + 约束”的形式吃透。
- 重点看作者定义的难度轴：长度、distractor、计算/非局部性（文中提到会用 quantifier complexity 细化）、以及 search space。理解每个轴如何在不改变评测可判定性的前提下调难度。
- 快速看实验里关于 distractor 结构影响的图表与讨论：这是最直接的诊断结论。

如果你在做长上下文预训练：可以把这些轴当作 curriculum 维度，观察不同训练配方对哪类轴更敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context benchmarks often measure average-case performance, saturate quickly, or scale difficulty along a single dimension (e.g., longer context or more needles). The paper targets a more diagnostic evaluation: a benchmark family where difficulty can be scaled systematically along multiple axes without relying on LLM-generated data or LLM judges.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation contribution. Its relevance to pretraining is diagnostic power: it decomposes “long-context ability” into controllable difficulty axes (length, distractor structure, computation/non-locality, and search space). This makes it easier to attribute failures to retrieval/attention breakdown vs global constraint satisfaction vs insufficient multi-step computation—useful for long-context pretraining curricula, data mixture decisions, and scaling/ablation studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PredicateLongBench frames tasks as constraint satisfaction over a long token sequence: given a long context consisting of space-separated words, the model must output the longest contiguous subsequence that satisfies a set of predicates.

Formally, for a predicate class H and predicates f1..fj∈H, find the maximum k such that there exists a contiguous subsequence w=(w1..wk) with fi(w)=1 for all i.

The design emphasizes controllable difficulty:
- Predicate choice controls dependency structure and computational demands (e.g., unary predicates resemble filtering/retrieval; richer predicates induce cross-position relations and more global reasoning).
- Distractor design is treated as a first-class variable; they study how structured distractors change performance.
- A “search space” axis increases difficulty even under fixed token budgets by expanding the combinatorial space of candidates.

A key trade-off is keeping generation and scoring algorithmic and deterministic, avoiding LLM-judge noise and gaming, while still stressing both local and non-local long-context behaviors.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate frontier LLMs across multiple difficulty settings and highlight that distractor structure has a large effect on performance—suggesting long-context robustness depends strongly on the distribution/organization of irrelevant content, not just raw context length.

The provided excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures with exact models, context lengths, or accuracy curves, so I cannot report precise numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the benchmark/task definition carefully to understand the “longest contiguous subsequence under predicates” formulation.
- Focus on the difficulty axes and how each is scaled while keeping evaluation deterministic.
- Check the experimental section specifically for results on distractor structure; that’s the most actionable diagnostic insight.

If you work on long-context pretraining, treat these axes as potential curriculum dimensions and test which training recipes improve which axis.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对做长上下文 pretrain 很实用：别再只看 NIAH 均分，重点读它怎么把难度轴拆开，拿去重做 internal eval。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on long-context pretraining: stop trusting average NIAH scores, and steal their difficulty-axis decomposition for your internal evals.

paper.title: When the Judge Changes, So Does the Measurement: Auditing LLM-as-Judge Reliability
paper.abstract: An LLM-as-judge score can move even when the candidate responses stay fixed, simply because the evaluator has changed. We treat this evaluator-replacement ambiguity as a measurement-validity problem. Across four judgment datasets, we compare two upgrade paths available in practice: scaling Qwen3 dense judges from 1.7B to 32B parameters and moving across MiniMax M2-M2.7 released APIs. The main pattern is that judge upgrades are not interchangeable: only Qwen3 1.7B to 4B gives a robust adjacent ga

summary.core_problem: 审计 LLM-as-judge 的可靠性：当候选回答不变、只替换评判模型时，评测分数会如何漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测方法和测量有效性分析。它直接影响 SFT/RL 数据筛选、模型排行榜、自动评测闭环的可信度；对预训练研究员的价值在于提醒 judge 不是稳定仪器，模型升级会改变历史测量口径。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 evaluator replacement ambiguity 形式化为 measurement-validity 问题，比较两类实践中常见的 judge 升级路径：Qwen3 dense judge 从 1.7B 扩到 32B，以及 MiniMax M2 到 M2.7 的 API 版本迁移。分析内容包括数据切片、position bias、verbosity bias、重复采样 jury 的误差相关性，以及 structured debate 是否真正带来可归因的决策变化。
summary.experiments: 在四个 judgment datasets 上评估。主要发现是 judge upgrade 不可互换：Qwen3 1.7B 到 4B 是唯一稳健的相邻增益，MiniMax 相邻 API 发布并未表现出稳定改善。更强 judge 能降低但不能消除位置和冗长偏置；重复采样 jury 在错误高度相关时收益很小；structured debate 可明显移动决策，但缺少 parser 和 fallback logs 时无法确认变化来自 deliberation。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Imperial College London Dyson School of Design Engineering 和 Nanchang Institute of Technology；未见主流大模型评测团队或知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits LLM-as-judge reliability by measuring how scores shift when candidate responses are fixed but the evaluator model changes.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and measurement-validity contribution. It matters for SFT/RL data filtering, model leaderboards, and automated evaluation loops because it treats the judge as an unstable measurement instrument rather than a neutral oracle.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame evaluator replacement ambiguity as a measurement-validity problem. They compare two practical upgrade paths: scaling dense Qwen3 judges from 1.7B to 32B parameters and moving across MiniMax M2-to-M2.7 API releases. The audit covers dataset slices, position and verbosity bias, error dependence in repeated-sample juries, and attribution issues in structured-debate protocols.
summary_en.experiments: Across four judgment datasets, judge upgrades are found to be non-interchangeable. Only the adjacent Qwen3 1.7B-to-4B transition produces a robust gain, while adjacent MiniMax API releases do not. Stronger judges reduce but do not remove position and verbosity bias; repeated-sample juries add little when errors are correlated; structured debate can move decisions substantially, but those shifts are not attributable without parser and fallback logs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Imperial College London’s Dyson School of Design Engineering and Nanchang Institute of Technology; no major foundation-model evaluation lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 读实验结论和 bias probe 即可；它不会教你训模型，但会让自动评测报告少犯低级错。
recommendation.en: Read the findings and bias probes; it will not teach you how to train models, but it helps avoid naive automated-eval reporting.

institutions: Dyson School of Design Engineering, Imperial College London

paper.title: CausalDS: Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as integrated data-science agents, combining abstract reasoning with advanced tool use. Yet the relevant benchmark landscape largely divides into symbolic causal reasoning benchmarks without realistic data analysis or data analysis benchmarks without a principled causal data-generating structure. Furthermore, existing causal evaluation datasets are often restricted to curated examples from existing sources, with diversity coming from limited templati

summary.core_problem: 评测数据科学 agent 在带工具使用场景下的因果推理能力，弥补现有 benchmark 要么只有符号因果题、要么只有数据分析任务而缺少可控因果结构的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对 agent eval 有一定价值，尤其是把结构因果模型、观测数据和自然语言任务绑定在一起；但它离 LLM 基座预训练较远，更像下游能力测量资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CausalDS：每个样本由一个采样得到的结构因果模型、据此生成的观测数据，以及贴近真实领域的合成自然语言故事组成。可选地用经验分布来约束场景构成，使生成实例更接近真实数据科学工作流。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点是 benchmark 构建与 agentic workflow 评测框架，而非提出新模型。未见基座模型规模、训练 recipe 或预训练数据层面的实验贡献。
summary.authors_note: University of Michigan。作者信息未显示为该方向的广泛公认代表性团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates causal reasoning in data-science agents with tool use, addressing the gap between symbolic causal benchmarks and realistic data-analysis tasks with controlled causal structure.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution. It is useful for agent evaluation, especially because it ties structural causal models, observational data, and natural-language tasks together. Still, it is fairly far from foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CausalDS builds each instance from a sampled structural causal model, generated observational data, and a synthetic natural-language story grounded in a realistic domain. The benchmark can optionally use empirical distributions to make generated scenes more realistic.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the main contribution is the benchmark and evaluation setup for agentic workflows rather than a new model. There is no obvious pretraining-relevant model scale, recipe, or data contribution.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Michigan. The metadata does not indicate a widely recognized flagship team in this specific area.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent eval 的“因果+工具使用”缺口，可以留作资产备查；对基座训练本身帮助不大，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a benchmark reference if you care about the causal-reasoning-plus-tool-use gap in agent eval; it has limited direct value for foundation training.

paper.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Modern AI models achieve strong performance on many established benchmarks, yet they still fail on tasks that humans find almost trivial, such as manipulating a string or drawing a dog with five legs. These examples suggest that existing benchmarks may under-measure persistent blind spots in current systems. We introduce $\texttt{blind-spots-bench}$, a benchmark designed to expose such blind spots through tasks that appear simple for humans but remain challenging for modern AI. We collect raw qu

summary.core_problem: 现有 benchmark 往往测不出模型在人类看来很简单、但模型持续出错的“盲点”；这篇工作试图系统暴露这类能力缺口，覆盖语言、多模态和图像生成模型。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个小而尖的 blind-spot benchmark。它对基座研究的价值不在榜单，而在提醒研究者：常规评测可能高估了模型的通用性，尤其是对组合、操作性和常识外观简单任务的掌握。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从 AI 课程学生提出的原始问题中收集样本，清洗并标注参考答案，形成 235 条数据和一套任务 taxonomy；同时设计自动评分流程，统一评估开源/闭源 LLM、VLM 和图像生成模型在这些“看似简单”的任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 数据规模不大，仅 235 个样本，但覆盖语言、视觉语言和图像生成模型。结果显示闭源前沿模型整体优于开源模型，但即便强模型也存在稳定盲点；摘要强调的是 blind spot 的持续存在，而不是某家模型绝对领先多少。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中包含 Emmanuel Abbé。若为同名学者，则其在理论与学习方向有较高知名度；仅凭摘要无法确认团队完整背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in current evaluation: models often fail on tasks that look trivial to humans, yet standard benchmarks under-measure these persistent blind spots.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small but sharp benchmark for blind spots. The value for foundation-model researchers is not the leaderboard itself, but the reminder that standard evaluations may overestimate general competence, especially on simple-looking compositional or manipulative tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built from raw questions collected from students in an AI course, then cleaned and annotated with structured reference solutions. The authors also design an automated grading pipeline to evaluate open-weight and closed-source language, vision-language, and image-generation models.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 235 samples, so it is not large, but it spans LLMs, VLMs, and image generators. Results suggest frontier closed-source models outperform open-weight ones overall, yet even strong models retain systematic blind spots on seemingly easy tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Emmanuel Abbé. If this is the well-known researcher of the same name, that adds some credibility, but the full team background cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是大 benchmark，但方向对：拿来做 failure-case sanity check 很合适；正文未必值细读，先看 taxonomy 和错误例子。
recommendation.en: Not a major benchmark, but the direction is right: use it as a failure-case sanity check; the taxonomy and example failures matter more than the full paper.

paper.title: AgentLens: Production-Assessed Trajectory Reviews for Coding Agent Evaluation
paper.abstract: We present AgentLens, a production-assessed benchmark for interactive code agents.
