recommendation.zh: 若要读，只读 benchmark 构造细节；没有摘要支撑，先不要把它当强评测信号。
recommendation.en: If you read it, focus only on benchmark construction details; without an abstract, it should not be treated as a strong evaluation signal.

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search
paper.abstract: Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a central issue for these applications. In this paper, we focus on deep search scenarios, aiming to investigate the rot phenomenon and its mitigation strategies. By evaluating four flagship open-source models across three benchmarks, we reveal a prevalent but unnoticed rot ph

summary.core_problem: 长程搜索 agent 在不断累积搜索结果、网页内容和中间推理后，会出现 context rot：模型更容易放弃、提前给出不确定答案，或者无法稳定完成任务。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和后训练的启发在于，它把长上下文退化从单轮 needle test 推到真实 agent 轨迹。长上下文能力不能只看模型能否从长输入中找信息，还要看多轮工具调用、观察噪声、推理痕迹持续累积时，模型是否仍能保持任务驱动的决策。这个问题会影响 long-context pretraining eval、agent SFT/RL 数据组织、上下文压缩策略和推理时上下文管理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先定义长程搜索的 ReAct 轨迹，包括内部 reasoning、search/visit 工具调用、环境 observation 和 finish 输出。然后构建细粒度终止状态分类，不只看答案对错，而是区分 give up、uncertain answer、confident answer、no answer 等行为。诊断阶段通过四个主流开源模型和三个 benchmark 观察 context rot，并通过 pruning 实验分析累积上下文的作用。缓解阶段评估七种上下文管理方法，分为 context compaction、context trimming、context isolation 三类；同时提出 rot-aware filtering，用拒绝采样过滤容易体现 rot 的轨迹，不改 agent 框架即可提升最终结果。
summary.experiments: 核心发现有三点。第一，长上下文退化在长程搜索中普遍存在，且随着上下文增长，直接放弃和提前输出不确定答案的比例上升。第二，退化不只由轨迹长度或交互轮数决定，累积上下文的内容本身也会触发退化；完全移除累积上下文几乎可以消除 rot 行为，但会显著增加 unfinished trajectories，说明上下文不能简单丢弃。第三，context compaction 与 context trimming 组合在成本和效果之间较均衡；sub-agent 形式的 context isolation 更依赖模型能力，强模型上可能更有效。rot-aware filtering 在三种聚合方式下带来平均 2.6%–4.9% 的性能增益，并可与上下文管理方法叠加。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟左右。优先看错误分类表和 Figure 1，理解论文所说的 context rot 具体表现。然后看 pruning 实验，它回答“是长度导致退化，还是内容导致退化”。方法部分重点看七种 context management 的触发方式、成本定义和性能对比。若做 long-context pretraining 或 agent RL，建议多看 rot-aware filtering，因为它把失败模式转成可用于采样、筛选、评估的信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies context rot in long-horizon search agents: as the agent accumulates search results, visited pages, observations, and its own reasoning traces, it becomes more likely to give up, stop early, or provide uncertain answers.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for foundation-model research is that long-context degradation is evaluated in an agentic setting rather than in a single-pass retrieval test. A model may pass needle-style benchmarks yet still degrade when context is accumulated over many tool calls with mixed-quality evidence and intermediate thoughts. This matters for long-context evaluation, agent training data design, context compression, and inference-time memory management.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize deep search as a ReAct-style trajectory with reasoning steps, search and visit tool calls, observations, and a final finish action. They introduce a termination-state taxonomy that separates giving up, uncertain answers, confident answers, and no-answer cases, allowing them to diagnose behavior beyond exact-match correctness. They then run pruning experiments to test whether rot is driven by length, turn count, or accumulated content. For mitigation, they evaluate seven context-management methods under three groups: compaction, trimming, and isolation. They also propose rot-aware filtering, a post-hoc rejection-sampling strategy that removes trajectories showing rot-like failure patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates four flagship open-source models on three benchmarks. It finds that context rot is common in long-horizon search and worsens as context grows, especially through increased give-up and premature uncertain-answer behavior. Pruning shows that the content of accumulated context matters, not just trajectory length or number of turns. Removing all accumulated context nearly eliminates rot but causes many more unfinished trajectories, so naive deletion is not a good solution. Among mitigation methods, combining context compaction and trimming gives a good cost-performance trade-off. Context isolation with sub-agent calls is more model-dependent and works better with stronger backbones. Rot-aware filtering improves average performance by 2.6% to 4.9% across three aggregation methods and can be combined with context management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the error taxonomy and Figure 1 to understand what the authors count as context rot. Then read the pruning analysis, which is the most informative diagnostic part. For practical use, focus on the comparison among compaction, trimming, and isolation, including cost and trigger frequency. Researchers working on long-context pretraining or agent RL should also read the rot-aware filtering section, since it turns an observed failure mode into a usable sampling and evaluation signal.

recommendation.zh: 对长上下文能力的评估视角有新意：从『检索不准』转到『模型主动放弃』，重点看 §3 剪枝诊断实验和 §4.1 七类方法对比表
recommendation.en: A fresh evaluation angle on long-context capabilities, shifting from 'retrieval inaccuracy' to 'models voluntarily giving up'; focus on §3 pruning diagnostics and §4.1 comparison table of the seven methods.

paper.title: Supersede: Diagnosing and Training the Memory-Update Gap in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents operate over long, multi-session interactions in which facts change: a user moves, a price updates, a plan is revised. Acting correctly requires using the current value of a fact and discarding values that have been superseded. We isolate this ability on real conversational data and show that it is a distinct, unsolved failure. On the knowledge-update subset of LongMemEval, replacing an agent's full context with a bounded, self-maintained memory drops accuracy f

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在多轮、多会话交互中需要维护会变化的事实；这项工作聚焦一个更窄的问题：当旧事实被新事实取代后，agent 是否能在受限自维护 memory 中保留当前值、丢弃过期值。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与长期记忆 agent 的训练信号设计有启发。它把“记住更多信息”拆成一个更可训练的能力：识别事实更新关系，并让 memory policy 主动覆盖或删除旧值。这个视角比单纯扩大上下文窗口或 memory budget 更有诊断价值，因为实验显示失败主要来自 memory maintenance，而不是上下文阅读理解。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Supersede 环境。每个任务由多段会话和一个关于当前事实值的问题组成。agent 只能逐段读取会话，并维护一个有字符上限的 notes 字段；原始会话不会在最后重新喂给模型。最终回答只能依赖自维护 memory。奖励主要是 r_cur，即答案是否表达了当前值；在知道旧值的合成任务或有更新标注的数据上，还可加入 r_stale，对回答过期值施加惩罚。匹配器是程序化的，使用归一化 variant match 和 token overlap fallback，避免依赖额外 judge model。训练部分用 Qwen2.5-3B 做 GRPO + LoRA，让模型在环境中学习如何更新 memory。与已有 LongMemEval 类评测的区别在于，它不只是给 frozen model 打分，而是把 supersession correctness 做成可优化的 RL 信号。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有三组。第一，在 LongMemEval knowledge-update 子集上，full-context 与 bounded self-maintained memory 的差距明显；前者能看到完整历史，后者只能依赖 notes。作者报告 frontier model gpt-5.4 在 full context 下约 92%，换成 bounded memory 后降到 77%，paired McNemar p=0.0033。第二，扩大规模没有自然消除问题。full-context accuracy 接近饱和，但 memory 条件下仍有明显 gap；会话长度增长 24 倍时，准确率从 68% 降到 28%。给 memory 按比例扩容，在 n=25 的设置下没有可检测恢复，说明瓶颈不只是压缩率。第三，训练有一定效果。Qwen2.5-3B 在该环境上用 GRPO 训练后，在真实未见会话上的 supersession accuracy 从 9.0% 提升到 16.7%。提升幅度相对明显，但绝对数值仍低，且目前报告的是单次训练 run，多 seed 显著性还在进行中。合成模板任务在 full context 下被 frontier model 做到 100%，说明过于干净的“X now Y”任务不能暴露真实 memory 更新失败。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 supersession gap 的定义，以及 Section 5.1/5.2/5.3 的三组实验：full context 对 bounded memory、conversation scale 对 memory scale、GRPO 训练前后。环境设计部分也值得看，尤其是 no-re-feed 约束和程序化 reward 的构造。可以略读合成数据生成细节；它主要用于说明模板化更新任务太容易，不能代表真实会话中的更新维护难度。需要留意局限：训练收益还不大，且多 seed 结果未完成；对基座预训练的影响更多体现在“如何构造长期记忆训练信号”，不是模型架构或预训练数据配比层面的直接改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The work isolates a specific failure mode in long-horizon LLM agents: after a fact has been updated, can the agent maintain the current value and stop relying on the superseded one when it only has a bounded, self-written memory?
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to post-training and agent memory training than to base pretraining itself. Its useful point is the decomposition of long-term memory into an update-maintenance problem, rather than a generic retrieval or compression problem. The experiments suggest that larger context access and larger memory budgets do not automatically teach the policy how to overwrite stale facts. That is a concrete signal-design lesson for training memory-using models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Supersede, a trainable environment for conversational fact updates. An agent reads sessions one at a time and maintains a bounded notes field. The raw sessions are not fed again at answer time, so the final answer depends only on the agent-maintained memory. The main reward is r_cur, a binary check that the final answer conveys the current value. When superseded values are available, the environment can add r_stale, a penalty for asserting an obsolete value, although the reported training runs optimize r_cur alone. Scoring is programmatic, using normalized variant matching with a token-overlap fallback, so the setup avoids an auxiliary LLM judge. The training experiment fine-tunes Qwen2.5-3B with GRPO and LoRA. Compared with prior long-memory evaluations, the key change is that supersession correctness becomes an optimization target, not only an evaluation metric.
summary_en.experiments: The main diagnostic result is a gap between full-context answering and bounded self-maintained memory. On the knowledge-update subset of LongMemEval, the authors report that gpt-5.4 reaches about 92% with full context but drops to 77% with bounded memory; the paired McNemar test gives p=0.0033. The gap persists across model scale while full-context accuracy saturates. Scaling the conversation length makes the problem worse: with a 24x increase in conversation size, accuracy falls from 68% to 28%. Increasing the memory budget proportionally does not produce a detectable recovery in the n=25 setting, which argues against a simple compression-ratio explanation. Training helps but does not solve the task. GRPO fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-3B improves held-out real-conversation supersession accuracy from 9.0% to 16.7%. The paper also notes that synthetic templated updates are saturated by frontier models under full context, reaching 100%, so they are not sufficient for diagnosing the real failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus on the definition of the supersession gap, the no-re-feed environment constraint, and the three empirical sections: full-context versus bounded memory, conversation scaling versus memory scaling, and GRPO training. The procedural reward is worth checking because it shows how a forgetting-aware metric can be converted into a training signal. The synthetic-task details can be read lightly. The main caveat is that the reported training gain is from a single run, with multi-seed significance still pending, and the absolute accuracy remains low.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“长上下文够强就能替代记忆系统”这个 prior 拆得很干净；读实验设定和误差分解即可，适合拿来约束 memory-augmented LM 的训练目标。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly breaks the prior that long-context competence substitutes for memory maintenance; read the setup and error decomposition, then use it to constrain memory-augmented LM objectives.

paper.title: The Signal-Coverage Matrix: Stratifying Type and Semantic Errors in Statement Autoformalization
paper.abstract: Headline type-correctness (TC\%) of LLM autoformalization has climbed from $\sim$53\% to $\sim$76\% in two years, yet this scalar conceals which errors each method resolves. We propose a signal-coverage matrix that crosses the Lean elaborator (pass/fail) with a semantic-equivalence judgment (equivalent/not), sorting every output into one of four cells: true success (TS), type-only (TO), semantic-only (SO), or both fail (BF). On ProofNet\# and MiniF2F-test with DeepSeek V4-Pro across Vanilla, Lea

summary.core_problem: 自动形式化任务里，单一的 type-correctness 指标掩盖了模型究竟修复了类型错误还是语义错误，导致方法比较失真。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测分解工作，贡献是把 autoformalization 的错误拆成类型层和语义层两个维度，并给出可预测的分层分析框架。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“指标是否测到真正能力”这个问题有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 signal-coverage matrix，用 Lean elaborator 的 pass/fail 与语义等价判断的 equivalent/not 交叉，得到 true success、type-only、semantic-only、both fail 四个格子。然后用该矩阵分析 Vanilla、Lean-Retry、Sample-Filter 和 Stratified Autoformalization 等方法的改进来源。
summary.experiments: 在 ProofNet# 和 MiniF2F-test 上，用 DeepSeek V4-Pro 比较多种 autoformalization 策略。摘要给出：三种基于 elaborator feedback 的方法带来约 34-36 个 TS 增益，其中约 64% 来自类型层恢复；原始 semantic error 中 87.5% 被救回，同时新增 8 个语义错误；TO→TS 的恢复率为 23/61，并能把 held-out 方法的 ΔTS 预测到 2/186 误差内。实验更像评测诊断而非新模型。

summary_en.core_problem: In statement autoformalization, a single type-correctness metric hides whether progress comes from fixing type errors or semantic errors, making method comparisons misleading.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-decomposition paper. Its contribution is to separate autoformalization errors into type-level and semantic-level strata and provide a predictive analysis framework. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is methodologically useful for thinking about whether metrics measure the right capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a signal-coverage matrix that crosses Lean elaborator pass/fail with semantic-equivalence equivalent/not, yielding four cells: true success, type-only, semantic-only, and both fail. The matrix is then used to analyze where gains come from for Vanilla, Lean-Retry, Sample-Filter, and Stratified Autoformalization.
summary_en.experiments: On ProofNet# and MiniF2F-test with DeepSeek V4-Pro, the paper compares several autoformalization strategies. The abstract reports that the +34 to +36 gain in true success from three elaborator-feedback methods is about 64% type-stratum recovery; 87.5% of original semantic errors are rescued with 8 new semantic errors introduced; and the TO-to-TS recovery rate of 23/61 predicts held-out ΔTS within 2/186. This is primarily an evaluation diagnosis rather than a new model.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你 headline metric 会把“语法修复”误当“能力提升”；只看矩阵定义和那组 recovery numbers 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a clean reminder that headline metrics can mistake syntactic repair for real capability; the matrix definition and recovery numbers are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: CalBrief: A Pilot Diagnostic Benchmark for Evidence-Calibrated Scientific Briefing with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as research assistants, yet it remains unclear whether they can calibrate research takeaways to the strength and scope of the supporting evidence. We study evidence-calibrated scientific briefing: given a bounded package of related papers, a system should generate package-level takeaways with evidence strength, scope boundaries, and missing-evidence caveats. We contribute a verified pilot benchmark of 16 heterogeneous scientific evidence package

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 在给定一组相关论文时，能否生成与证据强度和适用范围相匹配的科学 briefing，而不是只会写流畅总结。
summary.importance: 这是一个小规模诊断型 benchmark。贡献在于把 scientific summarization 从“内容对不对”扩展到“证据强度是否校准、边界是否说清、缺失证据是否指出”，对研究助手类系统评测有一定价值，但对基座预训练的直接牵引较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 16 个异质 scientific evidence packages 和 96 条人工核验 takeaways，提出 CalBrief 这一可审计的 role/gap/strength 评测框架，并在公平 schema 下比较结构化组织、显式强度校准策略与直接生成基线。
summary.experiments: 评测对象包括 GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet、Gemini Flash 等闭源模型。摘要中的核心结论是：结构化组织有助于 role 和 gap reasoning，但显式 strength-calibration policy 反而系统性过于保守，表现低于 majority 和 direct-LLM baselines。数据规模仍然偏小，更像 pilot benchmark。
summary.authors_note: Sichuan University。更像研究助手/科学摘要评测方向的探索性工作，不属于基座模型训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can produce scientific briefings calibrated to evidence strength and scope, rather than merely fluent summaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a small diagnostic benchmark. Its contribution is to expand scientific summarization evaluation from correctness to calibration of evidence strength, scope boundaries, and missing-evidence caveats. The direct impact on pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build 16 heterogeneous scientific evidence packages and 96 human-verified takeaways, and introduce CalBrief, an auditable role/gap/strength evaluation framework. They compare structured organization, explicit strength-calibration policies, and direct-generation baselines under a fair schema.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is tested on GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini Flash. The main result in the abstract is that structured organization helps role and gap reasoning, but an explicit strength-calibration policy becomes systematically over-conservative and underperforms majority and direct-LLM baselines. The scale is still pilot-level.
summary_en.authors_note: Sichuan University. This is better viewed as an exploratory benchmark for research-assistant behavior than a foundation-model training paper.

recommendation.zh: 小 benchmark，不值得深读；只看结论即可：显式“保守校准”策略可能把模型推成过度保守，这对后训练 reward 设计算个弱提醒。
recommendation.en: This is a small benchmark and not worth a deep read; the only useful takeaway is that explicit calibration policies can over-regularize models into excessive conservatism.

institutions: research takeaways to the strength and scope of the supporting evidence
expanding the label space from binary {moderate, weak} to four-way
labels carry information that strict matching hides. Label-level strength
rently in tension, and should be evaluated separately for LLM research
LLM evaluation · Research briefing · Scientific summarization
of this failure to expanding the label space, finds that adding gap and scope

paper.title: The Capability Frontier: Benchmarks Miss 82% of Model Performance
paper.abstract: Existing benchmarks typically report accuracy for a single model on a single run. This systematically understates real-world LLM capabilities, particularly under heterogeneous data distributions: (i) different models get different questions correct according to their specializations, and (ii) given a budget, multiple generations can be sampled and selectively retained. To quantify this gap, we introduce the Capability Frontier: a Pareto frontier over a set of models that characterizes the best a

summary.core_problem: 传统基准通常报告单模型、单次运行的准确率，无法反映真实系统可通过模型路由和多次采样获得的能力上界；但直接用有限样本做 oracle 选择又会因为“取最大值”而高估性能。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对大模型评测有明确启发：单点 benchmark 分数低估了模型集合在异质 workload 上的可用能力，也会误导对模型 scaling、数据专长和推理成本的判断。它把“模型能力”从单模型静态准确率，改写成质量、成本、延迟约束下的系统级 Pareto frontier。对基座研究员有用的地方在于，它能帮助区分两类现象：模型本身是否更强，以及模型族之间是否存在可被路由利用的互补性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 Capability Frontier：给定一组模型、每个 prompt 的多次生成、质量指标、成本和 P95 延迟，构造在不同成本水平下可达到的最优质量前沿。核心对象是 oracle router，它假设知道每个 prompt-模型对的真实期望表现，并按 prompt 选择模型或生成结果。难点在于真实期望不可观测，常见做法用有限生成样本均值替代，再对模型取最大值；这会系统性偏高，因为被选中的往往是采样噪声中的正向离群点。论文提出两类校正：一类是基于生成次数外推的 debiasing，利用 bias 随 G 增大衰减的经验规律；另一类是概率图模型，显式建模每个 prompt、模型和 generation 的表现分布，再估计去噪后的 oracle frontier。与 RouterBench、RouteLLM 等路由工作相比，这篇论文的重点不是训练一个可部署 router，而是估计路由和多采样策略在有限样本评测中的真实上界，并校正 oracle 估计偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 21 个 LLM 和 16 个 benchmark，任务包括代码、推理、医学、事实性、指令遵循和 agentic tasks。主要结果是：在成本匹配条件下，Capability Frontier 相比每个 benchmark 的最佳单模型，平均错误率降低 54%；如果进一步考虑多次生成后的 post-hoc selection，错误率降低达到 82%。反过来，在 frontier 上可以用低 85% 的成本匹配最佳单模型准确率。有限样本 oracle 的偏差不可忽略：朴素 oracle 估计最多会把准确率抬高 8.7%，并把成本估计扭曲最多 88%。论文还给出形式化和实证分析，说明 oracle bias 随每个 prompt 的生成数 G 近似按 O(G^{-λ}) 衰减。合成 workload 实验显示，oracle gain 随 workload entropy 单调增大，说明增益主要来自任务分布异质性，而不是某个 benchmark 的偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Problem Setting，先把 Capability Frontier、oracle router、质量-成本前沿这几个定义弄清楚。重点看 Oracle Bias and Debiasing Methods，尤其是为什么有限样本取最大值会产生正偏，以及外推校正和概率图模型各自依赖什么假设。实验部分建议优先看跨 21 个模型、16 个 benchmark 的主结果图，以及 bias 随 generation 数变化的图。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。若关注评测体系或 inference-time scaling，可以细看 appendix 中关于 cost、latency、multi-run selection 的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard benchmarks report a single model on a single run, which misses the performance available from per-query model selection and multiple generations; naive oracle estimates of that performance are themselves biased upward because they maximize over noisy finite samples.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in evaluation, not pretraining methodology. Its value for foundation-model research is that it separates single-model capability from system-level capability created by model complementarity, sampling, cost constraints, and workload heterogeneity. This matters when interpreting scaling curves, benchmark gaps, and model specialization: a model family may have more deployable capability than any single reported score suggests, while a naive oracle analysis may overstate that capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines a Capability Frontier: a Pareto frontier over quality, cost, and latency for a set of models and stochastic generations. For each prompt, an oracle router would select the model or generation with the best true expected utility under a cost constraint. Since the true prompt-model expectation is unobserved, the usual estimator replaces it with a sample mean over G generations and then takes a maximum across models. That estimator is positively biased because the selected model is disproportionately likely to have received favorable noise. The paper corrects this with extrapolation-based debiasing, using how the bias decays as G grows, and with a probabilistic graphical model that estimates latent prompt-model performance while accounting for generation noise. The distinction from routing papers such as RouterBench and RouteLLM is clear: the goal here is not to train a practical router, but to measure the attainable frontier and avoid finite-sample oracle inflation.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses 21 LLMs on 16 benchmarks spanning coding, reasoning, medicine, factuality, instruction following, and agentic tasks. At matched cost, the Capability Frontier reduces average error by 54% relative to the best single model on each benchmark. When post-hoc multi-generation selection is included, the error reduction reaches 82%. Conversely, frontier selection can match the best single-model accuracy at 85% lower cost. The paper also quantifies the finite-sample oracle bias: naive oracle estimates can inflate accuracy by up to 8.7% and distort cost estimates by up to 88%. The bias is analyzed as decaying approximately as O(G^{-λ}) with the number of generations per prompt. Controlled simulations show that oracle gains increase monotonically with workload entropy, supporting the claim that heterogeneous data distributions drive much of the measured frontier gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Problem Setting first to pin down the frontier definition, the oracle router, and the quality-cost-latency objectives. Spend more time on the oracle-bias section, where the max-over-noisy-estimates issue and the two debiasing methods are introduced. In the experiments, prioritize the main frontier plots across 21 models and 16 benchmarks, plus the figures showing how bias changes with the generation budget. Expected reading time is about 30–45 minutes. Readers working on inference-time scaling or evaluation methodology may want to inspect the implementation details for cost, latency, and post-hoc selection.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变 benchmark 数字的读法；重点看噪声校正和 cost matching，别只记住 82% 这个标题数。
recommendation.en: This changes how benchmark numbers should be read; focus on noise correction and cost matching, not just the 82% headline.

paper.title: Beyond Function Calling: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents under Tool-Environment Unreliability
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that solve tasks by interacting with external tool environments. Although recent tool-use benchmarks increasingly cover complex task settings, they still largely assume clean, stable, and trustworthy tool environments, leaving tool-environment unreliability insufficiently examined. We introduce ToolBench-X, a benchmark for evaluating agents under recoverable reliability hazards. ToolBench-X contains executable multi-step tasks across dive

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用评测大多假设工具环境稳定、接口文档可信、返回值规范。ToolBench-X 关注更接近真实系统的问题：当工具存在可恢复的不可靠性时，Agent 是否还能完成多步任务，而不只是生成正确的函数名和参数。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把工具使用失败拆成可控的环境不可靠性，而不是只看 function calling accuracy。这有助于区分模型的调用能力、错误诊断能力、证据校验能力和恢复策略能力。对后训练和推理时扩展也有启发：很多失败不是任务不可解，而是模型没有正确识别异常、没有复核中间证据，或过早给出答案。
summary.technical_approach: ToolBench-X 构造了 1106 个可执行多步任务和 4956 个 Python 工具，覆盖顺序、并行、混合三类工作流。每个任务有确定性工具和标准最终答案，支持自动执行和 exact-match 评测。核心设计是从干净工具环境出发，系统注入五类 reliability hazards：Specification Drift、Invocation Error、Execution Failure、Output Drift、Cross-Source Conflict。注入的错误必须是 disruptive 但 recoverable，即会干扰模型，但任务仍保留至少一条可行恢复路径，例如重试、fallback、交叉验证、输出归一化、证据补全。这个设计区别于简单的工具破坏或噪声注入，因为它评估的是恢复能力，而不是把任务变成不可解。
summary.experiments: 基准规模为 1106 tasks / 4956 tools。与 BFCL、ToolBench、τ-bench、T-EVAL、UltraTool、AgentNoiseBench 等相比，ToolBench-X 同时覆盖五类工具环境不可靠性，并包含顺序、并行、混合工具流。实验结论是当前被测模型在可靠性 hazard 下整体脆弱，所有模型成功率均低于 60%。作者还测试了 targeted hints 和 failure-triggered test-time scaling：当模型遇到困难时提供针对性提示，或允许模型基于失败反馈进行额外反思和多轮推理，任务完成率会明显提升。这说明一部分失败可以通过更好的诊断和推理预算缓解。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对工具环境不可靠性的定义，Table 1 中与已有工具评测的差异，以及 benchmark construction / hazard taxonomy 部分。实验部分主要看不同 hazard 下的失败模式、hint 的增益、failure-triggered test-time scaling 的设置。对预训练研究者更有价值的是错误类型设计和自动评测协议，而不是具体排行榜数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Most tool-use benchmarks assume clean APIs, stable documentation, and trustworthy outputs. ToolBench-X evaluates a harder and more realistic setting: whether an agent can finish multi-step tasks when the tool environment contains recoverable reliability hazards, not merely whether it can emit the right function call.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to pretraining, but it is useful for evaluating agent robustness. It separates function-call correctness from failure diagnosis, evidence verification, and recovery behavior. This distinction matters for post-training and inference-time scaling: many failures are not caused by unsolvable tasks, but by the model trusting suspicious observations, failing to cross-check evidence, or stopping before the required information is complete.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolBench-X contains 1,106 executable multi-step tasks and 4,956 Python tools, covering sequential, parallel, and mixed workflows. Each task has deterministic tools and a canonical final answer, enabling automatic execution and exact-match evaluation. Starting from clean environments, the benchmark injects five structured hazard types: specification drift, invocation errors, execution failures, output drift, and cross-source conflicts. A key design constraint is recoverability. The injected hazards should disrupt the agent, but every task should still preserve at least one viable recovery path, such as retrying, falling back to another tool, normalizing outputs, cross-checking sources, or verifying incomplete evidence. This makes the benchmark different from simple API corruption or random noise injection.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark scale is 1,106 tasks and 4,956 tools. Compared with BFCL, ToolBench, τ-bench, T-EVAL, UltraTool, and AgentNoiseBench, ToolBench-X jointly covers five forms of tool-environment unreliability and supports sequential, parallel, and mixed tool-use workflows. The evaluated models remain fragile under these hazards, with all reported success rates below 60%. Targeted hints substantially improve task completion when the model gets stuck. Failure-triggered test-time scaling, where the model reflects on failed attempts and spends additional reasoning rounds, also improves performance. These results suggest that better diagnosis and recovery policies can recover a nontrivial fraction of failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, Table 1 for the benchmark comparison, and the sections defining the hazard taxonomy and benchmark construction. In the experiments, look at per-hazard failure patterns, the effect of targeted hints, and the failure-triggered test-time scaling setup. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the taxonomy and evaluation protocol rather than the absolute leaderboard numbers.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测里这个 setup 比普通 function-calling 更干净；看 hazard taxonomy 和 recovery-path 标注即可。
recommendation.en: This setup is cleaner than ordinary function-calling benchmarks; read the hazard taxonomy and recovery-path construction.

paper.title: From Sounds to Scenes: A Benchmark for Evaluating Context-Aware Auditory Scene Understanding in Large Audio Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio perceptual tasks across individual acoustic layers, including speech, sound, and music. However, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate these layers in isolation, overlooking the complex contextual relationships that arise when multiple acoustic sources co-occur in real-world auditory scenes. Real-world auditory interpretation requires Context-Aware Auditory Scene Understanding (CASU): the ability to compre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要评估大型音频语言模型是否真正理解“场景级”音频，而不是只会分别识别语音、事件声或背景声。核心问题是：同一句话在不同声学上下文中含义会改变，模型能否把 speech、acoustic event、background 三层信息合在一起做语义推断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把音频 LM 的能力边界从单层感知推进到跨声源条件推理。当前很多 Audio LLM 训练和评测仍偏向 ASR、事件识别、caption 等局部任务，容易高估模型的“音频理解”。CASU 暴露的是多层声学 token/表示是否被统一建模的问题，对后续音频-语言预训练的数据构造、混合音频建模目标、跨层对齐 loss 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是构造一个可控的半合成 benchmark。每个样本先由 GPT-4o 生成结构化 JSON 剧本，明确三类语义层：连续背景声、人物语音、离散事件声，并为每层标注文本描述、起止时间和跨层语义关系。随后进行人工筛选，保证场景逻辑成立。语音层用 Zonos TTS 合成，并从 People’s Speech 采样说话人 embedding 增加说话人多样性；非语音层通过匹配分数检索真实背景声和事件声，再做时间对齐混合。这样的设计不是简单混音，而是让非语音事件成为语义约束。Benchmark 设计了四类任务：contextual reasoning、entity extraction、role inference、counterfactual reasoning，分别测试模型是否能解释场景、抽取相关实体、判断声音角色，以及在替换某一层声音后更新推理结论。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了多种当前大型音频语言模型。主要发现是 perception-understanding gap：模型在单层任务上可以接近人类表现，例如较好完成语音转写，但在需要跨 speech、event、background 建立逻辑依赖的 CASU 任务上明显退化。消融实验显示，移除任意一层声学信息都会导致 CASU 任务性能显著下降，说明任务不能靠单一 speech transcript 或单一事件标签完成。文中强调，失败更多来自跨层整合不足，而不是单纯听不清某个声音。给出的材料未包含完整分数表，精确模型排名和数值需要查看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 benchmark 构造部分和任务定义，而不是只看总体分数。Figure 1 有助于区分 single-layer audio perception、mixed-layer input 和 context-aware scene understanding。Figure 2 展示半合成流水线，值得关注它如何把语义关系写进 JSON 剧本，再映射到可听音频。实验部分重点看 layer ablation 和错误分析：如果模型在有 transcript 的情况下仍不能使用事件声或背景声，就说明现有音频表示和语言推理接口之间还有断层。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether large audio language models can understand an auditory scene as a contextual whole, rather than recognizing speech, sound events, and background ambience in isolation. The key question is whether a model can revise the meaning of the same spoken utterance when the surrounding acoustic event or background changes.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. It shows that strong ASR or sound-event performance does not imply scene-level audio understanding. For audio-language pretraining, this points to a missing training signal: models need to bind speech content, transient events, and environmental context into a shared representation, and then use that representation for reasoning. The benchmark is useful when designing audio tokenizers, mixed-audio objectives, and unified audio-text pretraining recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: CASU is built with a controlled semi-synthetic pipeline. Each example starts from a GPT-4o-generated structured JSON script containing three semantic layers: background sound, speech, and acoustic events. Each layer has a textual description and time boundaries, and the script encodes the intended contextual relationship among layers. Human curation filters inconsistent or unrealistic scenes. The speech layer is synthesized with Zonos TTS, with speaker embeddings sampled from People’s Speech for diversity. Non-speech layers are retrieved from real recordings using a matching-score-based procedure and then time-aligned with the speech. The benchmark defines four tasks: contextual reasoning, entity extraction, role inference, and counterfactual reasoning. These tasks force the model to decide whether a sound is irrelevant noise or a semantic constraint.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate a range of recent large audio language models. The central empirical result is a perception-understanding gap: models that perform well on isolated perceptual tasks, including high-quality transcription, often fail when the answer depends on logical relations across speech, events, and background ambience. Ablations show that removing any one acoustic layer causes large degradation on CASU tasks, indicating that the benchmark cannot be solved by relying on a transcript alone or by detecting a single event label. The excerpt does not expose the full score tables, so exact model rankings and numerical margins should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and task definitions. Figure 1 clarifies the distinction between single-layer perception, loosely mixed audio inputs, and context-aware scene understanding. Figure 2 is the most useful part for pretraining researchers because it shows how symbolic scene semantics are converted into controlled audio mixtures. In the results, prioritize the layer ablations and error analysis; they reveal whether current audio-language models actually fuse acoustic layers or merely transcribe and classify local cues.

recommendation.zh: 做音频 LM 或统一多模态预训练的人值得看：先看任务定义和数据合成流程，分数本身次要，关键是它把评测单位从单声道标签改成了场景级语义。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on audio LMs or unified multimodal pretraining: focus on the task design and data-construction pipeline, because the real contribution is moving evaluation from isolated labels to scene-level semantics.

paper.title: LibEvoBench: Probing Temporal Knowledge Stratification in Code Generation Models
paper.abstract: Large software projects often depend on older versions of libraries, even as APIs continue to evolve across releases. This creates a challenge for LLMs: they must maintain knowledge of multiple API versions, not merely the latest or most common one. However, current LLMs are trained on temporally mixed corpora and lack explicit mechanisms for such version-specific reasoning, leading to anachronistic errors - calling APIs as they exist in a different library version. To systematically evaluate th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作评估代码模型是否能区分同一个 Python 库在不同版本中的 API 知识。核心问题是版本错位：模型可能生成一个真实存在的 API 调用，但它属于另一个版本，因此在目标项目的 pinned dependency 下是错误的。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练和持续学习都有直接启发。代码语料通常把不同时间、不同版本的库文档和代码混在一起训练，next-token 目标会把这些冲突知识压进同一组参数。LibEvoBench 说明，扩大模型规模不一定能自然获得版本条件化能力；模型需要更明确的时间/版本条件、检索接口、数据组织方式，或 continual pretrain 中的版本分层机制。它也提醒代码预训练评测不能只看“API 是否真实”，还要看“在指定版本是否可用”。
summary.technical_approach: LibEvoBench 围绕 API 生命周期分析构建。作者跟踪多个常用 Python 库在不同版本中的公开 API 和函数签名，区分 stable APIs 与 evolving APIs：前者跨版本不变，后者会新增、删除或修改签名。Benchmark 包含三类任务。API Calling 给定不完整代码片段，要求补全正确 API 调用；API Identification 给定描述，要求识别对应 API；Signature Recall 测试模型是否记得特定版本的函数签名。API-C 样本来自依赖固定库版本的开源仓库，并用静态解析引擎把调用点映射到 pinned 版本中的具体 entry point。论文还设计了多级噪声控制：L0 只给原始代码上下文，L1 加入不暴露 API 名称的 docstring，L2 加入显式版本约束，L3 进一步提供更强提示，用来分离上下文理解、API 召回和版本条件化能力。SEUS 用来度量模型在 stable 与 evolving APIs 上沿版本轴的一致性，并惩罚 anachronistic errors。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 的前沿闭源模型，以及 Qwen-3.5 系列。主要结果有三点。第一，stable APIs 上性能较平稳，但 evolving APIs 上明显下降；即使最强模型也存在约 7–10 个点的 stable/evolving accuracy gap。第二，Qwen-3.5 不同规模模型在 evolving APIs 上呈现相似下降趋势，说明问题不只是参数量不足。第三，把正确 API 文档放进 prompt 可以带来约 10–20 个点的 API-calling accuracy 提升，但只加入显式库版本约束几乎没有可测提升。这说明模型能利用明确给出的文档，却不会自动把版本号映射到对应 API 状态。错误分析显示，很多错误不是凭空编造，而是从同一库中选了另一个版本有效的符号或参数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造、API lifecycle analysis 和 SEUS 定义。API-C 的 L0–L3 设计值得细看，因为它把代码上下文、文档检索、版本条件化拆开了。实验部分重点看 stable vs evolving 曲线、不同 Qwen-3.5 规模的趋势，以及 prompt 中加入版本号和加入文档的对比。对做代码预训练或持续学习的人，最值得深挖的是数据侧问题：训练语料是否应该保留 dependency manifest、文档版本、发布时间戳，以及模型是否需要显式版本条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether code generation models can reason over version-specific API knowledge. The failure mode is anachronism: a model may generate a valid API call for the same library, but for the wrong version, making the code invalid under the project’s pinned dependency.
summary_en.importance: The benchmark is relevant to pretraining and continual learning because code corpora mix source files and documentation from many library versions. A standard language modeling objective compresses these conflicting API states into one parameter set, without an explicit mechanism for version stratification. The results suggest that scale alone does not reliably solve this issue. Code pretraining may need version-aware data organization, temporal metadata, retrieval, or continual-pretraining recipes that preserve API evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: LibEvoBench is built on API lifecycle analysis. The authors track public APIs and signatures across multiple versions of widely used Python libraries, then separate stable APIs from evolving APIs. Stable APIs remain unchanged across selected versions; evolving APIs are added, removed, or modified. The benchmark contains three tasks: API Calling, where a model fills in a missing API call in real code context; API Identification, where a model maps a description to the right API; and Signature Recall, where it must produce version-specific signatures. API-C examples come from open-source repositories with pinned dependencies, and a static resolution engine maps each call site to a concrete entry point in the required version. The paper also introduces noise-control levels: L0 uses raw code context, L1 adds a redacted docstring, L2 adds an explicit version constraint, and L3 provides stronger API-related hints. SEUS measures consistency across stable and evolving APIs and penalizes version-axis errors.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers frontier proprietary models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, plus the Qwen-3.5 family. The main findings are clear. Performance on stable APIs stays relatively flat, while performance on evolving APIs drops, with even the strongest models showing a persistent 7–10 point accuracy gap between stable and evolving APIs. Different Qwen-3.5 model sizes follow similar downward trends on evolving APIs, indicating that the issue is not only a capacity problem. Providing the correct API documentation in the prompt improves API-calling accuracy by about 10–20 points, but adding an explicit library version constraint alone produces no measurable improvement. Error analysis shows that many mistakes are confusions within the same library rather than fabricated symbols; parameter-level anachronistic calls remain a recurring error type.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction, API lifecycle analysis, and SEUS definition first. The L0–L3 design in API-C is the most useful diagnostic component because it separates context inference, API recall, document use, and version conditioning. In the experiments, focus on the stable-versus-evolving curves, the Qwen-3.5 scaling comparison, and the contrast between adding version constraints and adding documentation. For code pretraining work, the most useful angle is data design: whether dependency manifests, documentation versions, and timestamps should be retained as first-class conditioning signals.

recommendation.zh: 把“版本盲/时间混合”这个老问题做成可量化基准；只看任务构造+SEUS定义和“指定版本也没用”的实验就够用来反推数据策略。
recommendation.en: Turns the hand-wavy “version blindness from temporal mixing” issue into a measurable benchmark; focus on dataset construction, SEUS, and the result that prompting the version barely helps to inform data/conditioning choices.

paper.title: Erased, but Not Gone: Output Forgetting Is Not True Forgetting
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) is commonly judged by output forgetting, such as low forget-set accuracy or reduced logit-level membership inference. But if output-level success can coexist with retraining-inconsistent residuals in representation space, what kind of forgetting are current evaluations actually certifying? We study this question through retraining-consistent representation forgetting, using the retrained model (i.e., trained from scratch without the forget data) as an operational referenc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是：当前 machine unlearning 用输出层指标判定“忘掉了”是否可靠，还是只是把输出抹平了而内部表征仍保留了被遗忘数据的痕迹。
summary.importance: 贡献属于机制分析与评测视角修正。它把“真正遗忘”定义为与从头重训且不含 forget data 的参考模型在表征空间上一致，指出现有输出级评测会系统性高估 unlearning 成功率。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 retraining-consistent representation forgetting 的分析框架：以重训模型作为 operational reference，比对不同 unlearning 方法在 forget/retain 样本上的表征对齐程度，并结合理论分析说明输出遗忘与表征遗忘可以脱钩。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖多种 unlearning 方法、数据集和模型。主要发现是：很多方法在输出层看似已忘记，但相对重训模型仍存在结构化残差；对 forget 样本部分对齐，对 retain 样本反而更不一致，并留下可检测的表示痕迹。未见 LLM 规模实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether standard machine-unlearning metrics certify real forgetting, or merely suppress outputs while leaving residual traces in representation space.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation correction paper. It defines stronger forgetting through consistency with a retrained reference model and argues that output-level metrics systematically overestimate unlearning success.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a retraining-consistent representation forgetting lens: use a model retrained from scratch without the forget set as the operational target, then compare representation alignment of different unlearning methods on forget and retain samples. They also provide theory showing output forgetting and representation forgetting can decouple.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the study spans multiple unlearning methods, datasets, and models. The main finding is that many methods look successful at the output layer yet retain structured mismatches relative to retraining, including residual signatures in representation space. No LLM-scale setup is stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但它提醒你别把 output-level forgetting 当真；只看定义与主结果，适合作为数据删除/成员推断讨论的反例材料。
recommendation.en: Not directly pretraining, but it is a useful warning: output-level forgetting is a weak certificate; read the setup and main result as a cautionary reference for data deletion claims.

paper.title: You Don't Need to Run Every Eval
paper.abstract: A modern model release reports scores on 40+ benchmarks and the same evaluations were run many more times before it: to track training progress, compare design choices, and select the checkpoint for the release. But do we need to run every eval? We compile a public score matrix of 84 frontier models on 133 benchmarks (2,604 cells, 23.3% filled) and find it is approximately rank-2: a model's scores across all 133 benchmarks are largely determined by just two numbers. We confirm this in two ways:

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是大模型评测成本过高的问题：一次模型发布常报告几十个 benchmark，训练过程中还会反复跑这些评测用于 checkpoint 选择、recipe 比较和回归监控。作者想回答一个更具体的问题：给定少量已知分数，能否可靠推断同一模型在其他 benchmark 上的大致表现。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读，因为它把评测套件中的冗余性做成了可操作的统计工具。对预训练研究的直接影响有三点。第一，训练中期和后期 checkpoint selection 可以少跑一部分昂贵评测，用少量 probes 估计完整 scorecard，降低实验迭代成本。第二，它提醒研究者：很多公开 benchmark 分数主要反映少数共享能力轴，而不是独立测量。第三，它给 eval planning 提供了新的约束：可被高精度预测的 benchmark 不等于没用，但它对模型排序和进度跟踪的边际信息可能有限。这个结论会影响 eval suite 的设计、训练监控频率，以及新 benchmark 是否真的补充了新的能力维度。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先构建一个公开分数矩阵，行是 84 个 frontier models，列是 133 个 benchmarks，共 2604 个观测 cell，覆盖率 23.3%。数据来自 release blog、system card、technical report、Hugging Face model card 等公开来源，并做了模型变体和评测配置的规范化。随后他们检查矩阵几何结构：用 rank-sweeping Soft-Impute 做缺失值预测，发现 held-out error 在 rank 2 附近最优；再对最大 fully-observed submatrices 做 SVD，发现前两个因子解释超过 90% 的模型间方差。基于这个观察，作者提出 BenchPress：在 logit space 中做 rank-2 alternating least squares matrix completion。logit 变换的作用是把 0–100 分数映射到更适合线性低秩建模的空间，减少接近上下界时的尺度扭曲。他们比较了 7 种 feature transforms 和 12 种 prediction methods，最后选择 logit-space rank-2 ALS，因为它在完整覆盖预测和误差之间更稳。
summary.experiments: 核心数字很清楚。公开矩阵为 84×133，观测 2604 个 cell，占 23.3%。低秩诊断显示 rank 2 已能解释 90% 以上共享评测子矩阵中的方差。BenchPress 在 held-out cell 上达到 4.6 个 score points 的 median absolute error，并且能对所有缺失 model–benchmark cell 给出预测。在 probe-set 场景中，即使限制在低成本 benchmark allowlist 内，只跑 5 个 probes，pooled MedAE 仍为 4.55 分。排序实验中，在允许真实分数有 5 分 margin 的条件下，BenchPress completion 保留了 92.1% 的同一 benchmark 上模型两两排序。对新发布模型的压力测试中，即训练矩阵时间早于模型发布，只给 5 个 seed scores，median absolute error 为 5.0 分。论文还分析了何时应信任预测：目标模型覆盖度、目标 benchmark 覆盖度、相似 peer models、邻近 benchmarks、训练锚点的新近程度都会影响误差；ensemble spread 可作为多个合理预测器分歧程度的可靠性信号，并用于估计 trust probabilities 和 conformally calibrated 90% prediction intervals。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Section 3，尤其是数据收集、canonicalization、coverage filter，以及 rank-2 证据；这里决定了结论是否可信。再看 Section 4，重点是为什么 logit-space rank-2 ALS 优于其他变换和预测器，尤其要关注 held-out protocol，避免把公开报告偏差误读成受控评测精度。Section 5 是最有工程价值的部分：5-probe scorecard recovery、ranking preservation、新模型压力测试分别对应训练监控、模型选择、发布前后预测。Section 6 需要仔细看 reliability modeling，因为低秩补全最容易被误用；可信区间、ensemble spread 和 support factors 是实际使用时的安全阀。Appendix B 的数据来源和清洗规则也值得看，特别是同名模型变体、benchmark 配置差异、vendor-reported 与 third-party 分数混合带来的系统误差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a modern LLM evaluation suite has to be run in full. Model releases report dozens of benchmark scores, and training teams run similar suites many times for checkpoint selection, recipe comparisons, and regression tracking. The central question is whether a small number of observed scores can recover the rest of a model’s benchmark profile accurately enough for many practical uses.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful paper for pretraining work because evaluation cost now affects the training loop. If benchmark scores are highly redundant, teams can run a compact probe set during training and reserve full evaluations for fewer checkpoints. The paper also changes how benchmark suites should be interpreted: many public scores appear to lie close to a two-dimensional capability surface, so some benchmarks add less marginal information for ranking or progress tracking than their count suggests. This does not make those benchmarks unnecessary; they may still expose failure modes, contamination, distribution shift, or incentive effects that score prediction cannot replace.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a public score matrix with 84 frontier models and 133 benchmarks. It contains 2,604 observed entries, or 23.3% coverage. Scores are collected from public release blogs, system cards, technical reports, and model cards, with canonicalization of near-duplicate model variants and benchmark configurations. They then study the matrix geometry. A rank sweep with Soft-Impute finds that held-out prediction error is minimized around rank 2. SVDs on the largest fully observed submatrices show that two factors explain more than 90% of the variance among models on shared benchmarks. BenchPress operationalizes this observation with rank-2 alternating least squares in logit space. The logit transform makes bounded 0–100 scores more suitable for a low-rank linear model, especially near score ceilings and floors. The method is selected after comparing seven feature transforms and twelve prediction methods.
summary_en.experiments: The main held-out prediction result is a median absolute error of 4.6 score points while producing predictions for every missing model–benchmark cell. For budgeted evaluation, five probes recover the remaining scorecard with a pooled MedAE of 4.55 points, even when probes are restricted to a low-cost benchmark allowlist. For ranking, completed scores preserve 92.1% of pairwise model orderings on the same benchmark when a five-point margin is allowed on the true scores. A temporal stress test on newly released models gives 5.0-point median absolute error with five seed scores, even when the training matrix predates the release. The paper further identifies reliability factors: coverage of the target model and target benchmark, availability of similar peer models and neighboring benchmarks, recency of anchor scores, and ensemble spread. These are used to estimate trust probabilities and conformally calibrated 90% prediction intervals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 3 closely. The data pipeline, canonicalization choices, coverage filters, and rank-2 diagnostics are the foundation of the claim. Section 4 is the technical core: focus on the comparison across transforms and predictors, and on the held-out protocol. Section 5 is the most actionable part for training and release workflows, covering five-probe scorecard recovery, ranking preservation, and temporal stress tests on new models. Section 6 is important for safe use, since low-rank completion can fail on models or benchmarks outside the observed support. The appendix on data sourcing and auditing is worth checking for public-score heterogeneity, duplicated model variants, benchmark configuration drift, and vendor versus third-party reporting differences.

recommendation.zh: 秩2结论可能受公开模型同源性、规模/对齐两维度主导的干扰，但直接击中预训练评测冗余痛点，建议在内部checkpoint流中验证5-benchmark子集的有效性
recommendation.en: The rank-2 finding may be confounded by model relatedness and dominant size/alignment axes, but it directly addresses eval bloat in pretraining; validate the 5-benchmark subset on internal checkpoint trajectories.

paper.title: MEMPROBE: Probing Long-Term Agent Memory via Hidden User-State Recovery
paper.abstract: Long-term memory promises LLM agents that grow more capable across sessions, maintaining an accurate, evolving understanding of the user that interaction forms. In practice, however, this memory is evaluated mostly through downstream behavior, such as later answers, personalization quality, or task success, which tests that understanding only indirectly and leaves the memory artifact itself largely unaudited. We argue that long-term memory should instead be evaluated as an auditable post-interac

summary.core_problem: 如何不再只通过下游任务表现，而是直接审计 agent 长期记忆中究竟保留了多少可恢复的用户状态。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测视角与 benchmark。它把长期记忆从“行为是否变好”转成“记忆产物是否可审计、可恢复”，对 agent memory、个性化系统和记忆压缩研究有价值，但与预训练关系较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEMPROBE：让带长期记忆的 agent 与携带隐藏用户状态库的模拟用户交互，在泄漏受控的任务轨迹后，从 agent 留下的 memory store 中重建结构化用户状态，并分别评测 full-store 与 top-k access 条件。关键设计是用 synthetic ground truth 提供可精确核对的用户状态标签。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或分数，但 benchmark 关注的是记忆内容本身的可恢复率，而非最终任务成功率。评测设置区分完整记忆访问与检索受限访问，有助于分离“记住了什么”和“能取回什么”两类问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to evaluate long-term agent memory directly, instead of inferring memory quality only from downstream behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation perspective and benchmark. It reframes long-term memory from 'does behavior improve?' to 'what user state can be audited and recovered from the memory artifact?', which is useful for agent memory and personalization systems, though only indirectly tied to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEMPROBE lets memory-equipped agents assist simulated users that carry hidden, taxonomy-anchored user-state banks. After leak-controlled interaction trajectories, the benchmark reconstructs structured user state from the resulting memory store under both full-store and top-k access settings. Synthetic ground truth enables precise auditing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes or headline scores, but the benchmark explicitly measures recoverability of memory content rather than downstream task success. By separating full-store from top-k access, it helps disentangle what was stored from what can later be retrieved.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory，这个评测视角是对的；如果你做 pretrain，只需记住“行为好不等于记忆干净可审计”。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory, the evaluation lens is useful; for pretraining, the main takeaway is that good behavior does not imply clean, auditable memory.

paper.title: On the Stability of Prompt Ranking in Large Language Model Evaluation
paper.abstract: Prompt-based interaction has become a dominant paradigm for using large language models (LLMs), where multiple candidate prompts are evaluated and the top-ranked one is selected for downstream use. This workflow implicitly assumes that prompt rankings are stable under minor variations in evaluation conditions. In this paper, we systematically study prompt ranking stability under common sources of variability, including random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. Across three open-weight LLMs an

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM prompt 评测中一个常被默认成立的前提：在随机种子或评测子集轻微变化下，prompt 排名是否稳定。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法工作。它的重要性不在提出新 prompt，而在指出 prompt selection pipeline 本身可能不稳，尤其是 top-1 prompt 的身份会频繁变化。对预训练研究员的价值主要是实验设计层面：很多 prompt-based ablation 的结论可能比表面看起来更脆弱。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统考察两类常见扰动：随机种子变化，以及只用有限评测子集做 prompt 排名。虽然整体 rank correlation 往往中高，但 top prompt 的具体身份不稳定。为此提出一个简单的 stability-aware 选择策略，用 lower confidence bound 同时考虑平均性能和方差，而不是只按均值排序。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源模型和 2 个 benchmark 任务。主要发现是：整体相关性看起来不差，但真正用于部署时最关键的 top prompt 经常换人，导致选择不可靠。所提 lower-confidence-bound 策略在不稳定设置下更稳健，在稳定设置下也保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体模型名和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether prompt rankings in LLM evaluation remain stable under small changes such as random seeds or limited evaluation subsets.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. Its value is not in proposing a new prompt, but in showing that the prompt-selection pipeline itself can be unstable, especially when the identity of the top prompt changes. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is experimental hygiene: many prompt-based ablations may be less reliable than they appear.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically vary two common sources of noise: random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. They find that overall rank correlations can look moderately high while the actual top-ranked prompt changes frequently. To mitigate this, they propose a simple stability-aware selection rule based on a lower confidence bound that accounts for both mean performance and variance.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses three open-weight LLMs and two benchmark tasks. The main result is that top-prompt identity is often unstable even when aggregate rank correlation seems acceptable, making selection decisions unreliable. The lower-confidence-bound strategy improves robustness in unstable settings while remaining competitive in stable ones. The abstract does not provide exact model names or gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是实验卫生论文，不会改你的模型设计，但会改你看 prompt ablation 的方式；只看“rank correlation 高但 top-1 不稳”这个结论和 LCB 选择法就够了。
recommendation.en: This is an experimental-hygiene paper, not a model-design paper; the useful bit is that high rank correlation can still hide unstable top-1 prompt selection, plus the simple LCB fix.

paper.title: Beyond 'One Language, One Script': Quantifying Orthographic Bias in Multilingual VLMs with PuMVR
paper.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are celebrated for their multilingual capabilities, yet they operate under a flawed assumption: that one language corresponds to a single writing system. This overlooks billions of users of multi-script languages like Punjabi, Serbian, Hindi-Urdu, Kurdish, among many others, for whom a model's capability may be fractured by orthographic bias. We introduce PuMVR (Punjabi Multimodal Visual Reasoning), the first benchmark designed to quantify script-dependent b

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估多语言 VLM 是否把“语言”和“文字系统”混为一谈：同一张图、同一语义问题，只改变 Punjabi 的书写系统，模型表现是否会显著变化。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测型工作，对预训练研究的启发在于 multilingual multimodal capability 不能只按语言覆盖率衡量，还要看 orthographic robustness。对基座模型训练来说，脚本差异牵涉 tokenizer 覆盖、图文对齐数据分布、低资源文字系统的数据质量，以及 Romanization 等非标准文本形态。若模型在 Gurmukhi、Shahmukhi、Roman 三种 Punjabi 表达上表现不一致，说明视觉 grounding 没有完全消除文本侧表示偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PuMVR，一个 Punjabi multimodal visual reasoning benchmark。它把 Punjabi 作为多脚本语言案例，覆盖 Gurmukhi、Shahmukhi 和 Roman 三种活跃书写系统。核心控制变量是 orthography：图像和语义内容保持一致，只替换脚本。评测包含 375 个专家构造任务，分为六类文化相关的图像推理问题。除 accuracy 外，作者引入 Script Consistency Rate，用于衡量模型是否能在三个脚本版本上同时保持一致正确。论文还分析 Chain-of-Thought 输出，观察同一视觉证据下脚本变化是否会诱发不同的显式推理路径。CoT 不能等同于内部计算，但可作为行为层面的不稳定性信号。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 10 个 VLM。主要发现是显著的 Script Gap：同一任务在不同脚本下的准确率差异最高达到 16%。Script Consistency Rate 最低只有 24.8%，说明模型经常能在一种脚本下答对，却在等价的另一种脚本下失败。CoT 分析显示，脚本切换会让模型关注不同视觉特征或采用不同推理线索，作者称为 reasoning divergence。实验规模不大，且集中在 Punjabi，因此不宜把数值外推到所有多脚本语言；但它给出了一个清晰的诊断协议。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15 分钟。重点看 benchmark 构造方式、Script Consistency Rate 定义、10 个 VLM 的跨脚本结果表，以及 CoT divergence 的案例。对预训练研究更有用的是错误模式：哪些脚本退化最明显，Roman transliteration 是否比原生文字更不稳定，模型是否表现出文化概念与特定脚本绑定的迹象。无需深读公平性叙述部分，核心信息在任务控制、指标设计和跨脚本失败样例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multilingual VLMs treat language and script as interchangeable, by testing whether identical Punjabi visual-reasoning tasks produce different outcomes when only the writing system changes.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation contribution, but it has clear implications for multimodal pretraining. Multilingual capability should not be measured only by the number of languages covered; it also depends on robustness across scripts and transliteration forms. The results point to issues in tokenizer allocation, multilingual image-text data balance, script-specific sparsity, and the coupling between cultural knowledge and orthographic form. Visual grounding does not automatically remove text-side representation bias.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce PuMVR, a Punjabi Multimodal Visual Reasoning benchmark with parallel versions in Gurmukhi, Shahmukhi, and Roman scripts. The key control is orthography: the image and semantic content are held fixed while the script changes. The benchmark contains 375 expert-curated tasks across six culturally grounded visual-reasoning categories. Beyond accuracy, the paper defines Script Consistency Rate, which measures whether a model remains correct across script variants of the same item. The paper also inspects Chain-of-Thought outputs to identify reasoning divergence, where a script change leads the model to attend to different visual cues or produce different reasoning traces. These traces are treated as behavioral evidence, not as a direct readout of internal computation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 10 VLMs. The main empirical result is a sizable Script Gap: accuracy can differ by up to 16 percentage points across scripts for equivalent tasks. Script Consistency Rate can be as low as 24.8%, meaning models often solve an item in one script but fail its parallel form in another. The CoT analysis suggests that script choice can act as a trigger for different visible reasoning paths under the same image evidence. The benchmark is small and focused on Punjabi, so the exact numbers should not be generalized too broadly. Its stronger contribution is the controlled evaluation protocol for multi-script multimodal robustness.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15 minutes. Read the benchmark construction, the definition of Script Consistency Rate, the model comparison table, and the examples of reasoning divergence. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful parts are the failure modes: which scripts degrade, whether Romanized input is less stable than native scripts, and whether cultural concepts appear tied to a particular orthographic form. The broader motivation can be read quickly; the technical value lies in the controlled script intervention and the consistency metric.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会改你看 multilingual VLM 数据覆盖的口径；只看 benchmark 设计和 script gap 主表就够了。
recommendation.en: It will not change your method stack, but it should change how you audit multilingual VLM coverage; read the benchmark design and the main script-gap table.

paper.title: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant approach to scalable evaluation in NLP pipelines, yet judges themselves carry systematic biases that raw accuracy hides: they favor responses placed in slot A (position bias), they prefer longer responses regardless of quality (verbosity bias), and their reliability degrades sharply in lower-resource languages. We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes -- position bias, verbosity b

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 LLM-as-a-judge 的可靠性审计问题：一个 judge 模型即使在配对选择上有不错的原始准确率，也可能同时存在位置偏置、冗长偏置、顺序不一致和跨语言退化。论文的重点不是提升 judge，而是提供一个不依赖人工偏好标注的测试框架，把这些隐藏失效模式显式量化。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 研究的直接启发在于：LLM judge 已经被大量用于偏好数据构造、RLHF/RLAIF、模型选择和自动评测，如果 judge 在低资源语言或长回答上存在系统性偏置，训练信号会被污染。BabelJudge 的贡献偏评测基础设施，量级不在模型能力提升，而在提供一个可复用的可靠性诊断工具。它提醒研究者不要只看 judge accuracy，还要看 order consistency、position bias 和 verbosity susceptibility 这类会影响训练数据质量的指标。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 gold-labelling by degradation。给定高质量参考回答 r，对它施加受控退化得到 p，并把 gold label 定义为偏好 r。这样可以从任意参考语料自动生成配对评测样本，不需要人工偏好标注。框架设计了 5 类语言无关扰动，基于空白 token、句子分隔符和数字模式操作，因此可以直接迁移到多语言场景。其中 repeat_pad 是冗长偏置探针：扰动答案更长但质量更差，如果 judge 偏好它，就说明 judge 在奖励长度而不是质量。每个样本以 ref-first 和 pert-first 两种顺序提交给 judge，从而直接测量位置偏置和顺序一致性。最终指标不是简单平均，而是把准确率、位置偏置惩罚、冗长偏置惩罚、顺序一致性组合成 multiplicative reliability score。这个设计有明确取舍：如果一个 judge 准确率高但偏置大，乘法门控会比加法平均给出更低分，更适合暴露评测风险。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit 作为 judge，在 Apple Silicon 上本地运行。数据来自 Aya 多语言数据集，每种语言抽取 10 条参考回答，覆盖英语、印地语、阿拉伯语和斯瓦希里语。5 种扰动、2 个严重程度、2 种展示顺序，对每种语言形成约 200 次 judge 调用，四种语言约 800 次调用。结果显示，宏平均 accuracy 为 0.770，但宏平均 reliability 只有 0.614，差距达到 15.6 个百分点。斯瓦希里语 reliability 为 0.550，比印地语 0.714 低 23 个百分点；但两者 accuracy 差距只有 17.5 个百分点，分别为 0.660 和 0.835。主要问题来自 order consistency：斯瓦希里语只有 0.480，说明交换候选答案顺序后，判决接近随机翻转。英语的 verbosity susceptibility 很低，为 0.075，说明该 judge 在英语 repeat_pad 样本上不太容易被更长但更差的回答误导。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 gold-labelling by degradation 的构造逻辑、repeat_pad 为什么能隔离冗长偏置、双顺序评测如何分离位置偏置和顺序一致性。Results 部分建议看 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，对比 accuracy 与 reliability 的差异，以及不同语言上的退化来源。如果关心自动评测或偏好数据质量，值得细看 composite reliability score 的乘法惩罚设计；如果只关心模型能力提升，可以跳过 agent trajectory 扩展和工程适配细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses reliability auditing for LLM-as-a-judge systems. A judge can show reasonable pairwise accuracy while still suffering from position bias, verbosity bias, order inconsistency, and cross-lingual degradation. The goal is not to train a better judge, but to build a reusable audit harness that exposes these hidden failure modes without human preference labels.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training is signal quality. LLM judges are now used in preference data generation, RLHF/RLAIF pipelines, model selection, and automated evaluation. If the judge systematically favors slot A, longer answers, or high-resource languages, the resulting supervision can be biased. BabelJudge is best viewed as evaluation infrastructure. Its contribution is to move judge assessment beyond raw accuracy toward reliability metrics that are more predictive of whether the judge can safely be used as a training or evaluation signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is gold-labelling by degradation. Starting from a high-quality reference response, the framework applies a controlled degradation to create a worse response, and defines the gold label as preferring the original reference. This produces pairwise items from any reference corpus without human annotation. The perturbations are designed to be language-agnostic, relying on whitespace tokens, sentence boundaries, and digit patterns. The repeat_pad perturbation is the verbosity-bias probe: it makes the degraded response longer while keeping it strictly worse, so a preference for the padded response indicates a length bias. Each item is evaluated in both reference-first and perturbed-first orders, which makes position bias and order consistency directly measurable. The final reliability score combines accuracy with multiplicative penalties for bias and inconsistency, intentionally lowering the score of judges that are accurate but unstable or biased.
summary_en.experiments: The experiment audits mlx-community/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-4bit, a quantized Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct judge running locally through MLX on Apple Silicon. The data is sampled from Aya, with 10 reference responses per language across English, Hindi, Arabic, and Swahili. Five perturbation types, two severity levels, and two presentation orders yield about 200 judge calls per language, or roughly 800 total calls. The macro accuracy is 0.770, while macro reliability is 0.614, a 15.6-point gap. Swahili reliability is 0.550, 23 points below Hindi at 0.714, even though the accuracy gap is smaller: 0.660 versus 0.835. The main driver is order consistency. For Swahili it is 0.480, meaning the judge’s decision nearly flips at random when the answer order is swapped. English verbosity susceptibility is reported as low, 0.075, suggesting the audited judge is not easily fooled by longer degraded answers in English.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the methodology: the degradation-based labelling scheme, the repeat_pad probe for verbosity bias, and the two-order design for separating position bias from answer quality. In the results, Figure 2 and Figure 3 are the useful parts: they show why accuracy and reliability diverge, and which failure modes dominate per language. For readers building automated evaluation or preference-data pipelines, the composite reliability score is worth a closer look. The agent-trajectory extension and backend adapters can be read lightly unless they match an immediate engineering need.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 构造即可；若你用 judge 过滤 RL 数据，这类偏差会直接变成训练信号噪声。
recommendation.en: Read the metric construction; if judges filter your RL data, these biases become training-signal noise rather than evaluation trivia.

paper.title: StatABench: Dataset and Framework for Evaluating Statistical Analysis Capabilities of LLMs
paper.abstract: Statistical analysis is a broad, complex field requiring both domain knowledge and tool proficiency. While prior work has evaluated large language models (LLMs) in this domain, existing benchmarks remain limited in scope and format. To bridge this gap, we introduce StatABench (Statistical AnalysisBenchmark), a benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs' statistical analysis capabilities. StatABench comprises two complementary components: Stat-Closed, containing 404 questions across 18 stat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个评测缺口：现有 LLM 统计分析 benchmark 往往只测概念题，或者只测一般性的工具调用，难以覆盖真实统计工作里“选方法—调参数—跑工具—解释结果—写成分析结论”这一整条链路。论文把问题拆成两个层面：一是封闭式统计知识与程序化操作能力，二是开放式、接近建模竞赛的端到端统计分析能力。更具体地说，它要回答的不是“模型会不会背统计学”，而是“模型能不能在有工具的前提下，稳定完成真实统计分析任务”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要不在于提出新训练方法，而在于提供了一个较干净的能力切面：统计分析是典型的高知识密度、强工具依赖、强程序约束任务，能较好地区分语言表面流畅性与真正的结构化分析能力。这个 benchmark 的价值有三点。第一，它把工具使用纳入评测主轴，而不是附属设置，这对研究“预训练是否学到可操作知识”很有帮助。第二，它显式做了 contamination 缓解，虽然不能完全排除泄漏，但比直接拼装公开题库更严谨。第三，结果显示即便强模型在封闭题和开放题上都远未饱和，说明当前模型在统计方法选择、参数设定、结果解释和长链分析上仍有明显短板。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这类 benchmark 可以用来检验模型是否真的学会了可执行分析，而不是只会生成像样的答案。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成两个 benchmark 资产和一套统一执行框架。Stat-Closed 包含 404 道题，覆盖 18 个统计主题，题型包括选择、填空、决策和 practical application。这里的关键设计不是题量，而是把 practical application 做成“问题 + 数据集 + 工具参数真值”的三元组，让模型必须调用 SAToolKit 才能完成任务。SAToolKit 提供 35 个可调用统计函数，覆盖描述统计、假设检验、回归、因果、生存分析、高维分析等主题。这样评测的不是自由发挥，而是：模型能否选对函数、填对参数、理解输出。

数据构建上，作者从教材、已有 benchmark、公开考试与资源库中收集题目，然后做 modify-and-verify 流程来降低污染风险。具体做法是先用 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 试答；若题目被正确答出，则视为潜在泄漏样本，人工改写题干、扰动选项、翻转真假条件等，再次验证，只有至少一个模型失败或经专家确认质量足够的样本才保留。这个流程并不完美，但比简单去重更贴近“语义层面的去污染”。

Stat-Open 则是 30 个开放式统计建模任务，来自 MCM/ICM、CUMCM、MAS 等建模竞赛，要求完成数据清洗、探索分析、建模和结构化报告生成。这里作者没有用标准答案打分，而是采用结构化报告输出 + LLM-as-Judge 评审协议，并强调做了人机一致性验证。执行层面，封闭题主要通过 LangChain MCP 接 SAToolKit，也额外比较了 Qwen Agent、CrewAI、AutoGen、Smolagents 等 agent 框架；开放题则用不同建模框架生成报告，再交给 judge 打分。整体上，这篇工作更像是在构建一个“统计分析能力测试台”，而不是单纯出一套题。
summary.experiments:
关键结果有几组。第一，Stat-Closed 上，即便 GPT-5.1 也只有 68.6% 准确率，最强开源模型 Qwen2.5-72B 为 60.6%。这说明在有工具可用的情况下，统计分析仍不是接近解决的问题。第二，Stat-Open 上，最佳 agent framework 的平均分是 61.86，说明开放式端到端建模更难，瓶颈不只是知识，还包括任务分解、工具编排和结果表达。第三，作者使用 Friedman test 给出显著性结果 p = 2.87 × 10^-9，说明不同模型/框架之间差异不是噪声。

从全文设定看，更值得注意的是实验结构而不是单个分数。作者比较了多种 agent 框架，意味着同一底模在不同 orchestration 下表现会变；这对 post-train 和 agent system 研究很重要，因为它提示“能力上限”与“系统实现”是耦合的。另一个值得留意的点是题型分层：选择/填空类更接近知识检索，practical application 更接近真实分析，开放题则进一步要求长程规划和报告生成。若全文表格里给出了分 topic 或分题型结果，阅读时应重点看哪些主题掉点最明显，例如因果推断、生存分析、高维统计这类通常更能暴露模型的概念边界与工具调用错误模式。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。优先看四部分。第一，看 benchmark 设计章节里 Stat-Closed 与 Stat-Open 的任务定义，弄清楚它到底在测什么，尤其是 practical application 和 open-ended task 的边界。第二，看数据构建与 contamination 缓解流程，重点是 modify-and-verify 算法和专家复核规则，这决定 benchmark 的可信度。第三，看 SAToolKit 的函数覆盖范围与接口形式，判断它是在测统计能力，还是在测某个工具 API 的熟练度。第四，看主结果表和按题型/主题拆分的结果，关注模型失败是因为不会选方法、不会设参数，还是不会解释输出。

预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。若只想判断是否值得纳入自己的评测集，重点看 Figure 2、任务样例、主结果表，以及附录里关于数据来源和 judge 验证的部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete evaluation gap: existing LLM benchmarks for statistics either test textbook-style knowledge or generic tool use, but rarely the full workflow of statistical analysis—choosing a method, configuring it correctly, executing tools, interpreting outputs, and writing a coherent conclusion. The benchmark is designed around two levels of difficulty: closed-form statistical reasoning with executable operations, and open-ended end-to-end modeling tasks that resemble real statistical work.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining research is indirect but real. Statistical analysis is a useful stress test for whether a model has acquired operational knowledge rather than fluent surface patterns. The benchmark matters for three reasons. First, tool use is treated as a first-class part of the task, not an auxiliary setting. That makes it relevant for studying whether pretraining yields actionable procedural knowledge. Second, the authors make a nontrivial effort to reduce contamination, which is important for any benchmark built from public educational material. Third, the results show that strong models are still far from reliable on method selection, parameter specification, output interpretation, and long-horizon analytical workflows. For researchers working on the pretrain/post-train interface, this is a useful evaluation asset for checking whether models can actually perform structured analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work consists of two benchmark components plus a unified execution setup. Stat-Closed contains 404 questions spanning 18 statistical topics, with multiple formats: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, decision-making, and practical application. The practical-application subset is the key design choice: each instance is a triplet of statistical question, dataset, and ground-truth function parameters, so the model must interact with the provided toolkit rather than answer purely in prose.

The toolkit, SAToolKit, exposes 35 callable statistical functions covering descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, survival analysis, high-dimensional analysis, and more. This lets the benchmark evaluate three distinct abilities in a controlled way: selecting the right procedure, specifying valid parameters, and interpreting the returned results.

For data construction, the authors aggregate material from textbooks, prior benchmarks, and public exam-style resources. To mitigate contamination, they use a modify-and-verify pipeline: questions answered correctly by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct are flagged as potentially leaked, then manually perturbed by rewriting stems, changing distractors, shuffling options, or inverting conditions. Only items that at least one model subsequently fails, or that experts explicitly validate as high quality, are retained. This is not a formal guarantee against leakage, but it is stronger than naive collection from public sources.

Stat-Open contains 30 open-ended tasks adapted from mathematical modeling competitions such as MCM/ICM, CUMCM, and MAS. These require end-to-end data cleaning, exploratory analysis, model building, and structured report generation. Since there is no single gold answer, the authors use structured outputs and an LLM-as-Judge protocol, with claimed human alignment validation. On the execution side, Stat-Closed is run mainly through LangChain MCP with SAToolKit, and the paper also compares several agent frameworks including Qwen Agent, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Smolagents.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline numbers are straightforward. On Stat-Closed, GPT-5.1 reaches only 68.6% accuracy, while the strongest open model reported, Qwen2.5-72B, gets 60.6%. On Stat-Open, the best agent framework achieves an average score of 61.86. The paper also reports a Friedman test with p = 2.87 × 10^-9, indicating that the performance differences across systems are statistically significant.

More interesting than the absolute numbers is the structure of the evaluation. The benchmark separates easier knowledge-centric formats from practical tool-based tasks and then from open-ended modeling. That layered design helps identify where models fail: conceptual recall, procedural execution, or long-horizon analytical planning. The comparison across agent frameworks is also informative, because it shows that the same underlying model can move noticeably depending on orchestration and tool-calling setup. If the full tables include per-topic or per-format breakdowns, those are worth checking carefully—topics like causal inference, survival analysis, and high-dimensional statistics are likely where conceptual and operational weaknesses become most visible.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on four parts. First, read the task definitions for Stat-Closed and Stat-Open to understand exactly what is being measured. Second, inspect the contamination-mitigation pipeline; that is central to benchmark credibility. Third, look at the SAToolKit function inventory and interface design to judge whether the benchmark is testing statistical competence or mostly API handling. Fourth, read the main result tables and any breakdown by topic or question type to see where current models fail.

About 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main value. If you only need to decide whether to adopt it as an evaluation asset, prioritize the benchmark construction section, the modify-and-verify procedure, example tasks, and the main result tables.

recommendation.zh: 偏 benchmark，不直接推进 pretrain；知道“连 GPT-5.1 做统计分析也不稳”就够了，除非你在做 tool-use eval，否则正文可不细读。
recommendation.en: Mostly a benchmark paper, not a pretraining lever; it is enough to note that even GPT-5.1 is far from saturated on statistical analysis unless you specifically care about tool-use evaluation.

paper.title: PlanBench-XL: Evaluating Long-Horizon Planning of LLM Tool-Use Agents in Large-Scale Tool Ecosystems
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in large tool ecosystems, where real-world tasks require discovering relevant tools, inferring implicit sub-goals, and adapting to dynamic environments over long horizons. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate planning under retrieval-limited tool visibility. To address this gap, we introduce PlanBench-XL, an interactive benchmark of 327 retail tasks over 1,665 tools that tests whether agents can iteratively retrieve usable tools, invoke them to uncover int

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文提出 PlanBench-XL，用来评测 LLM tool-use agent 在大型工具生态中的长程规划能力。它关注的不是单个 API 调用是否正确，而是 agent 在只能看到检索到的一小部分工具时，能否逐步发现相关工具、形成隐含子目标、调用工具获得中间证据，并在关键工具缺失、失败或误导时重新规划。
summary.importance: 它属于 agent 评测工作，对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 和 agent RL 环境有参考价值。现有很多工具使用评测给定完整工具集，或者把中间目标写得很清楚，这会低估真实工具生态中的难度。PlanBench-XL 把问题改成检索介导的部分可观测规划，更接近企业 MCP、软件 API 和大型平台工具环境。对训练研究的启发在于：tool-use agent 的失败不只来自模型不会调用函数，还来自工具检索、子目标发现、路径中断检测和恢复规划之间的耦合。
summary.technical_approach: PlanBench-XL 构造了一个零售场景下的交互式工具使用基准，包含 327 个任务实例和 1,665 个工具，平均每个任务约 25 轮交互。agent 不能一次看到完整工具列表，而是通过 retriever 在大工具空间中逐步检索候选工具。基准设计强调 bi-directional anticipation：一方面从已有证据向前探索，寻找下一步可用工具；另一方面从目标结果向后推断需要哪些中间状态或工具，再尝试桥接当前状态与目标状态。环境包含默认噪声工具，某些工具描述或返回会表明其可能不相关、过期或错误。除此之外，论文设计了可选 block mode，在检索时替换或破坏路径关键工具，并保持任务仍然可解，从而测试 agent 是否能识别当前路径失效并寻找替代路径。论文还描述了一个可扩展的 LLM-based task generator，用于生成 grounded queries 及其配套工具生态。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 10 个开源和闭源前沿模型。总体结果显示，大规模工具生态中的长程规划仍然困难。在默认设置下，多数模型准确率低于三分之二；加入 retrieval-time blocking 后性能显著下降。文中报告 GPT-5.4 在只保留一条可行路径时降到约 30%，在只保留最长恢复路径时略高于 10%。误差分析强调，成功不仅需要广泛探索工具空间，还需要精确利用已经发现的信息，并稳定调用工具。换言之，增加检索次数并不自动带来成功；如果模型不能把中间证据转化成新的查询意图，或不能意识到某条路径已被阻断，长程任务会很快失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction、retrieval-mediated tool visibility、blocker module 和实验分析。Table 1 可用于快速了解它和已有工具评测的区别。Figure 1 有助于理解工具生态、retriever 和交互环境之间的关系。实验部分建议关注默认模式与 block mode 的性能差异，以及作者对 exploration、exploitation、tool invocation 三类失败的拆分。若目标是构建 agent RL 训练环境，可以进一步看任务生成器和阻断机制；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可快速扫过。

summary_en.core_problem: PlanBench-XL evaluates whether LLM tool-use agents can plan over long horizons in a large tool ecosystem when only retrieved subsets of tools are visible. The benchmark stresses iterative tool discovery, implicit subgoal formation, intermediate evidence gathering, and recovery when plausible tool paths fail.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent evaluation paper, not a core pretraining paper. Its value for LLM research is in the post-training and RL environment design side. Many tool-use benchmarks expose a fixed tool set or provide clear intermediate goals, which hides the difficulty of partial observability in real tool ecosystems. PlanBench-XL makes tool use retrieval-mediated: the agent must search for tools, use outputs to form new retrieval intents, and adapt when path-critical tools are missing, failing, or distracting. This helps diagnose whether failures come from planning, retrieval, evidence use, or tool invocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is an interactive retail-domain environment with 327 tasks and 1,665 tools. Each task requires about 25 turns on average. Agents do not receive the full tool inventory; they retrieve candidate tools from a large tool space at each step. The design supports bidirectional anticipation. Forward anticipation means searching from currently accumulated evidence toward the next useful action. Backward anticipation means reasoning from the desired final outcome to hypothesized intermediate states and tools. The environment includes default noisy tools whose descriptions or outputs may be irrelevant, stale, or erroneous. An optional blocking mode adds retrieval-time disruption by replacing or disabling path-critical tools while preserving at least one feasible solution path. The paper also describes a scalable LLM-based task generator that creates grounded user queries and paired tool ecosystems.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates ten leading open and proprietary LLMs. Performance remains limited even without blocking: most models are below two-thirds accuracy in the default setting. Blocking causes a large degradation. GPT-5.4 drops to around 30% when only one feasible path remains, and to slightly above 10% when only the longest recovery path is preserved. The analysis suggests that successful agents need more than broad exploration.
