They must exploit discovered evidence precisely, invoke tools reliably, and detect when a current plan has become invalid. More retrieval alone is insufficient if the model cannot convert intermediate observations into the next useful search or re-plan after failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction, the retrieval-mediated visibility setup, the blocker design, and the error analysis. Table 1 is useful for positioning the benchmark relative to prior tool-use evaluations. Figure 1 explains the interaction loop among the tool ecosystem, retriever, and agent. The most relevant experimental results are the default-versus-blocking comparisons and the breakdown of failures into exploration, exploitation, and tool invocation. For agent RL environment design, the task generator and blocking mechanism are worth a closer read. For pure pretraining interests, a quick skim is enough.

recommendation.zh: 首个千级工具集下的长程规划benchmark，看§3实验设置和Table 2阻塞场景结果即可，揭示当前模型动态纠错能力极弱。
recommendation.en: First long-horizon planning benchmark with 1000+ tools; read §3 setup and Table 2 blocking results, which show current models have extremely weak dynamic error recovery.

paper.title: Uncertainty-based Debiasing and Unlearning for Decontamination
paper.abstract: Benchmark-based evaluation is the dominant paradigm for assessing large language model (LLM) capabilities, yet data contamination inflates reported performance and undermines fair comparison. Existing decontamination methods are evaluated solely through aggregate accuracy, which can obscure substantial differences in per-sample model behaviour, and many require access to an uncontaminated model. In this paper, we propose a sample-level evaluation framework for decontamination that complements ac

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 benchmark contamination 之后，如何判断“去污染”是否真的把模型行为拉回未污染状态，而不只是把总体准确率调到看起来合理。现有去污染方法大多只看数据集级别 accuracy，容易掩盖样本级行为偏移：两个模型可能总分接近，但在具体题目上的概率分布、置信度结构、错误模式完全不同。论文进一步把问题拆成两层：一是评估层，去污染应当比较每个样本上的输出分布，而不是只比较 aggregate metric；二是方法层，在没有未污染参考模型、也不知道原始预训练语料的前提下，能否利用模型自身不确定性来识别更可能受污染的样本，并做有针对性的 debiasing / unlearning。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要不在“又一个 unlearning 方法”，而在于把 contamination 从 dataset-level 指标问题，推进到 sample-level 行为恢复问题。这个视角对预训练数据治理很重要，因为 contamination 的真实风险并不只是 benchmark 分数虚高，而是模型在少量记忆样本上形成异常尖锐、异常稳定的分布。论文提出用分布距离来补充 accuracy，等于把“是否去掉记忆捷径”变成可测对象。第二个价值是把 uncertainty 当作 contamination signal，而不是只看 loss。低 loss 既可能来自真正容易样本，也可能来自被记住的困难样本；如果这个区分成立，那么它对数据去重、成员推断、持续预训练中的污染监控都有方法论意义。量级上，这更像评估框架和诊断信号的补强，而不是会直接改写主流预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成。第一部分是评估框架。论文在 MCQ 场景下，不只比较去污染前后或与未污染模型之间的 accuracy，还比较每个样本上的输出分布距离。核心思想是：如果去污染有效，模型不应只是“少答对几题”，而应在每道题上恢复到更接近未污染模型的概率分配，例如对正确选项的异常过度集中应被削弱，对干扰项的相对排序也应更接近未污染模型。文中使用 distributional distance 作为样本级指标，意图衡量行为恢复而非结果巧合。

第二部分是 UBD，核心信号来自 deep ensembles 估计的不确定性。作者不是直接假设高置信样本就是污染样本，而是利用 ensemble disagreement / predictive uncertainty 去区分两类都可能表现为低 loss 的样本：真正简单、模型普遍一致的样本；以及由于记忆导致单模型看似自信、但在扰动或多模型视角下暴露异常的样本。基于这个信号，论文给出两类去污染路径：
1. debiasing：对疑似污染样本的输出分布做校正，削弱被污染后对正确答案的异常偏置；
2. unlearning：对疑似污染样本进行更直接的遗忘式更新，使模型在这些样本上的行为远离污染态。

和依赖未污染教师模型做 KL 对齐的方法相比，UBD 不需要 reference clean model；和 paraphrasing、choice permutation 这类输入侧扰动方法相比，它不是通过“把题目改写得不那么像训练样本”来绕开记忆，而是直接利用模型不确定性估计污染程度，再决定如何修正输出或参数。这个区别很关键：前者更像 benchmark 规避，后者更接近模型行为层面的去偏。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验重点有三类。第一类是评估层验证：作者展示仅看 aggregate accuracy 会掩盖显著的样本级差异，而 distribution-distance 指标能区分不同去污染方法是否真的恢复了未污染模型的行为。第二类是方法对比：UBD 在样本级输出分布上，比 paraphrasing baseline 和 choice-permutation baseline 更接近未污染模型。第三类是信号分析：uncertainty 能把“hard but memorized”与“genuinely easy”区分开来，即便两者在污染模型上都呈现低 loss。这一点是全文最值得注意的实验结论，因为它说明 loss 不是足够好的 contamination proxy。

不过当前提供的正文片段没有给出完整表格、具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、ensemble 大小、以及分布距离改善的精确数值，因此无法可靠填写参数量、数据规模和提升幅度。若要精读，需重点核对实验章节中的：使用了哪些 MCQ benchmark；污染是如何注入的；distribution distance 具体采用哪几个指标；deep ensemble 的构造成本；debiasing 与 unlearning 各自带来的收益和代价；以及在 accuracy 基本接近时，样本级距离能拉开多大差异。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点不是公式推导，而是问题定义和实验设计。建议先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，确认作者如何定义 contaminated / uncontaminated model，以及为什么 accuracy 不够。然后直接看实验部分里关于 sample-level metric 的案例分析，尤其是“总分接近但样本行为不同”的例子。若时间有限，再看 UBD 方法部分中 uncertainty 的定义、ensemble 如何构造、以及 debiasing 和 unlearning 分别如何落地。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你关心数据污染检测或 benchmark 可信度，再花时间看附录里的指标定义和实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than standard decontamination work: after benchmark contamination, how do we tell whether a method actually restores the model’s clean behavior, rather than merely lowering aggregate accuracy to a plausible level? Existing work mostly evaluates decontamination with dataset-level metrics, which can hide large sample-level shifts. Two models may end up with similar accuracy while assigning very different probabilities on individual questions. The paper therefore reframes decontamination as both an evaluation problem and a method problem: evaluate recovery at the per-sample distribution level, and design a decontamination method that does not require access to a clean reference model or the original pretraining corpus.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. It moves contamination analysis from benchmark-level score inflation to sample-level behavioral distortion. That matters because contamination is not only about overstated leaderboard numbers; it is also about abnormal confidence concentration and memorization-driven shortcuts on a subset of examples. The proposed distribution-distance view makes “behavioral recovery” measurable. A second useful idea is to treat uncertainty, rather than loss alone, as a contamination signal. Low loss conflates genuinely easy examples with hard-but-memorized ones. If uncertainty can separate these cases, the idea is relevant beyond benchmark cleanup: it touches data curation, memorization analysis, membership inference, and contamination monitoring in continual pretraining. This is better read as an evaluation and diagnosis contribution than as a new dominant unlearning recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two technical pieces. First, it introduces a sample-level evaluation framework, mainly for multiple-choice benchmarks. Instead of relying only on accuracy, it compares output distributions on each sample. The intended criterion is not just whether the decontaminated model gets the same answer as a clean model, but whether its probability allocation over choices looks similar to the clean model. A contaminated model often over-concentrates mass on the gold answer; a successful decontamination method should reduce that distortion and recover a more natural distribution over alternatives.

Second, it proposes UBD, a family of uncertainty-based decontamination methods built on deep ensembles. The key idea is that loss is an unreliable proxy for contamination: both easy examples and memorized hard examples can have low loss after contamination. Ensemble-based predictive uncertainty is used to identify suspicious samples more selectively. On top of that signal, the paper develops two intervention styles: (1) debiasing, which adjusts the output distribution for likely contaminated samples to reduce contamination-induced overconfidence; and (2) unlearning, which applies a stronger forgetting-style update to move the model away from the contaminated behavior on those samples.

Compared with methods that minimize KL to a clean teacher, UBD does not require a clean reference model. Compared with paraphrasing or answer-permutation baselines, it does not try to evade memorization by changing the input surface form. It instead estimates contamination through uncertainty and then corrects the model behavior directly. That distinction is important: the former is closer to benchmark-side mitigation, while UBD aims at model-side debiasing.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, the experiments appear to support three claims. First, aggregate accuracy can make different decontamination methods look similar even when their sample-level behavior differs substantially. Distribution-distance metrics expose those differences. Second, UBD produces per-sample output distributions that are closer to those of an uncontaminated model than paraphrasing and choice-permutation baselines. Third, uncertainty is shown to separate hard-but-memorized samples from genuinely easy ones, even when both have low loss under the contaminated model. That is the most interesting empirical point, because it argues that loss alone is not a sufficient contamination indicator.

The provided text does not include the full tables, exact benchmark list, model sizes, ensemble size, or precise gains, so it would be unsafe to invent numbers. When reading the experimental section, the key details to extract are: which MCQ benchmarks were used, how contamination was injected, which distribution-distance metrics were reported, how expensive the deep ensemble is, and how debiasing and unlearning trade off behavioral recovery against raw accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and problem formulation to understand the paper’s reframing: decontamination should be judged at the sample level, not only by aggregate accuracy. Then jump to the experimental section, especially the examples where similar dataset-level scores hide different per-sample distributions. If you have a bit more time, read the method section only for the uncertainty definition, how the deep ensemble is constructed, and how debiasing differs from unlearning. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main contribution.

recommendation.zh: 预训练评测污染绕不开这类工作；只看 metric 定义和 ensemble memorization 估计，实验数值次要。
recommendation.en: Relevant to pretraining evaluation hygiene; read the metric definition and ensemble-based memorization estimate, not just the headline scores.

paper.title: Reliability without Validity: A Systematic, Large-Scale Evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge Models Across Agreement, Consistency, and Bias
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant evaluation paradigm for language models, but judge validation in practice relies on exact-match agreement, a metric that does not correct for chance and systematically overstates discriminative ability. We present the largest systematic evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge to date: 21 judges from nine providers across MT-Bench, JudgeBench, and RewardBench, evaluated under three protocols (agreement, consistency, bias audit) over 118 runs and approximately 541,000 i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM-as-a-Judge 的验证问题：当前很多评测管线用 exact match 或 raw agreement 来说明 judge 与人类一致，但这些指标没有扣除随机一致性，会系统性高估 judge 的判别能力。论文进一步指出，judge 的高复测一致性也不等于有效性，因为同一个偏差可以被稳定重复。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏评测方法的工作，但对预训练和 post-train 都有直接影响。现代基座研发越来越依赖自动评测来筛模型、调数据、做 reward model 诊断、比较 SFT/RL 版本。如果 judge 的 headline metric 不可靠，训练决策会被错误排序牵引。论文的贡献不是提出一个新 judge，而是把 judge validation 从“看起来和人类一致”推进到 chance-corrected agreement、跨 benchmark 可迁移性、复测一致性和偏差审计的联合检查。量级上，它覆盖 21 个模型、9 个 provider、3 个 benchmark、118 次运行和约 54.1 万次判断，是一个较系统的 judge 元评测。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案由三层组成。第一层是模型覆盖：作者选取 21 个通用 LLM judge，来自 9 个 provider，按能力和成本分成三个 tier，参数规模从 8B 到 100B 以上，并包含 2026 年 4 月的较新模型。第二层是 benchmark 覆盖：MT-Bench 提供 2391 个带专家人类标注的 pairwise comparison；JudgeBench 提供 350 个覆盖数学、代码、创意写作和分析的客观正确性条目；RewardBench 提供 2981 个 chosen-versus-rejected pair，并对每个 item 做位置随机化，避免 chosen 总在同一侧。第三层是协议设计：agreement protocol 做单次判断，报告 Cohen’s κ、Krippendorff’s α 和去 tie 的 exact match；consistency protocol 对每个 item 独立运行 3–5 次，关闭缓存，并同时测试 AB 与 BA 顺序，报告 test-retest reliability、self-consistency 和 position flip rate；bias-audit protocol 用 AB+BA 加 response length 分析，测 position bias 和 verbosity bias。关键区别在于，论文没有把 judge 当作一个普通分类器只看准确率，而是把“是否能稳定、无偏、可迁移地模拟评价标准”拆成多个可诊断维度。
summary.experiments: 实验在 2026 年 3–4 月的五周内完成，共 118 个 evaluation runs，约 541,000 次单独判断，temperature 设为 0；一致性实验关闭 response caching，以避免重复调用返回缓存答案。核心结果很清楚。第一，MT-Bench 上所有 21 个 judge 都出现 kappa deflation：exact match 相比 Cohen’s κ 高估 33.8–41.3 个百分点，平均高估 38.6 个百分点。即使表现最好的 Gemini 3.1 Pro，exact match 为 0.849，κ 只有 0.511，差距仍为 33.8 个百分点；所有 Tier 3 模型的 Δκ 都不低于 30 个百分点。第二，judge 排名不能跨 benchmark 直接迁移，模型在不同 benchmark 上的排名最多移动 14 位。第三，论文报告了 consistency–bias paradox：高 test-retest reliability 可能和严重 position bias 同时存在，说明“稳定”不等于“有效”。第四，verbosity bias 在这批模型中显著减弱，所有 21 个模型的相关指标都低于 0.011，和 2023 年文献中 20–40% 方差可由长度解释的现象不同。第五，JudgeBench 的区分度明显强于 MT-Bench，κ spread 为 60.4 个百分点，而 MT-Bench 为 13.5 个百分点，约为 4.5 倍。这说明 benchmark 本身的标签分布和任务结构会强烈影响 judge 评估的分辨率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中的五个主发现，尤其是 kappa deflation、rank non-transferability 和 consistency–bias paradox。然后看 Methodology，重点关注三套 protocol 的定义，因为这些比具体模型排名更可复用。Table 1 用来了解 judge 覆盖范围；Table 2 和 Figure 1 是理解 exact match 与 Cohen’s κ 差异的关键；偏差审计部分适合和内部评测管线对照。最值得深挖的是两个问题：第一，为什么 exact match 在 A/B/Tie 或类别不均衡场景中会高估 judge；第二，为什么关闭缓存、AB/BA 对称评测、chance-corrected metrics 应该成为自动评测系统的默认配置。预计精读时间 1.5–2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM-as-a-Judge systems are actually valid evaluators, not merely repeatable ones. Its central claim is that exact-match agreement, the common validation metric, overstates judge quality because it does not correct for chance agreement. High reliability can also be misleading when a model repeats the same positional or format bias consistently.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation paper, but it has direct consequences for foundation-model development. Automated judges are now used to compare checkpoints, tune post-training recipes, filter data, score synthetic instruction data, and diagnose reward models. If the judge is validated with a weak metric, model selection and training decisions can be misranked. The paper’s main contribution is a large-scale judge validation protocol combining chance-corrected agreement, consistency, cross-benchmark transfer, and bias audits. The scale is substantial: 21 judges from nine providers, three benchmarks, 118 runs, and about 541,000 individual judgments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study is organized around three components. First, it covers 21 general-purpose LLM judges across nine providers and three tiers, ranging from 8B-class systems to models above 100B parameters, including April 2026 frontier-generation systems. Second, it evaluates them on MT-Bench, JudgeBench, and RewardBench. MT-Bench contributes 2,391 pairwise comparisons with expert human labels; JudgeBench contributes 350 items across math, coding, creative writing, and analysis with objective correctness labels; RewardBench contributes 2,981 chosen-versus-rejected pairs with per-item position randomization. Third, it uses three protocols. The agreement protocol reports Cohen’s κ, Krippendorff’s α, and tie-excluded exact match. The consistency protocol runs each item independently 3–5 times with response caching disabled and with both AB and BA orderings, measuring test-retest reliability, self-consistency, and position flip rate. The bias-audit protocol uses paired AB/BA presentations and response-length analysis to estimate position and verbosity bias. The important design choice is to separate accuracy-like agreement from repeatability and bias, rather than collapsing judge quality into a single raw agreement number.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments were run over five weeks in March and April 2026, with temperature set to zero. The full procedure produced 118 evaluation runs and roughly 541,000 judgments. The main empirical result is universal kappa deflation on MT-Bench: across all 21 judges, exact match exceeds Cohen’s κ by 33.8 to 41.3 percentage points, with a mean gap of 38.6 points. Even the best chance-corrected judge, Gemini 3.1 Pro, has exact match of 0.849 but κ of 0.511, a 33.8-point gap. All Tier 3 models show Δκ of at least 30 points. Rankings are not stable across benchmarks, with models moving by as many as 14 positions. The paper also reports a consistency-bias paradox: some judges can be highly reliable under repeated testing while still showing strong position bias. Verbosity bias appears much lower than in earlier judge studies, with all 21 models below 0.011, contrasting with 2023 reports where length explained 20–40% of variance. JudgeBench separates models more sharply than MT-Bench, with a 60.4-point κ spread versus 13.5 points on MT-Bench, about a 4.5× difference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the introduction’s five findings, especially kappa deflation, cross-benchmark rank instability, and the consistency-bias paradox. Then spend time on the methodology, because the three-protocol design is more reusable than the individual model rankings. Table 1 clarifies judge coverage; Table 2 and Figure 1 are central for understanding the gap between exact match and Cohen’s κ. The bias-audit sections are worth comparing against any internal LLM evaluation pipeline. The key technical lessons are that chance-corrected metrics, AB/BA position swaps, cache-disabled repeated runs, and separate bias reporting should be defaults for serious judge evaluation. A careful read should take about 1.5–2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 会改变内部评测默认值：别再只报 exact-match judge agreement，应立刻加 kappa、位置偏差和跨集排名稳定性审计。
recommendation.en: This should change internal eval defaults: stop reporting only exact-match judge agreement, and add kappa, position-bias, and cross-benchmark rank-stability audits.

paper.title: CREDENCE: Claim Reduction for Decomposition & Enhanced Credibility -- Semantic Metrics and Convergence Analysis
paper.abstract: Decomposing compound sentences into atomic, verifiable claims is a prerequisite for reliable automated fact-checking. Prior work has relied on token-overlap (Jaccard) metrics that systematically underestimate decomposition quality for paraphrastic claims, and has lacked formal termination analysis for the repair loop. We present Credence, a revised claim decomposition and evaluation framework addressing both shortcomings. Our contributions are: (1) Semantic-F1: we use BGE-large cosine similarity

summary.core_problem: 如何更可靠地评估“把复合句分解为可核验原子claim”的质量，并分析claim修复循环何时会收敛/发散。
summary.importance: 贡献点在评测指标与流程性质分析：用语义相似度替代token-overlap，外加对rule-based与LLM self-repair的终止性讨论；对训练侧间接相关（可用于构造更干净的监督/评测信号）。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Semantic-F1：用BGE-large的余弦相似度做fidelity匹配，缓解Jaccard对同义改写的惩罚；并给出repair pipeline的性质定理：rule-based repair在“oracle parser”假设下单调且有限终止，而LLM自修复非单调，需要early-exit guard。
summary.experiments: 提供三个跨域评测基准（社媒/百科/新闻）并展示Semantic-F1相较Jaccard更贴近分解质量且提升下游fact-checking；摘要未给出具体模型规模与显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: Vietnamese-German University; Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate atomic-claim decomposition quality more faithfully and analyze convergence/termination of claim-repair loops.
summary_en.importance: Main value is an evaluation metric plus pipeline convergence analysis; indirectly useful for cleaner supervision/evaluation signals in reliability/fact-checking setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Semantic-F1 using BGE-large cosine similarity to match paraphrastic claims beyond token overlap; proves properties of repair pipelines: rule-based repair is monotone and finitely terminating under an oracle-parser assumption, while LLM self-repair is non-monotone and needs an early-exit guard.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces three cross-domain benchmarks (social media / encyclopedic / news) and reports improved downstream fact-checking when using Semantic-F1 vs Jaccard; limited quantitative detail in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Vietnamese-German University; Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology

recommendation.zh: 把它当“评测信号更语义化 + 自修复循环会不收敛”的小提醒：只看Semantic-F1定义和收敛性定理，别指望对预训练有直接配方。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reminder: semantic metrics matter and LLM self-repair loops can be non-convergent—read the Semantic-F1 definition and the convergence theorems, not for direct pretraining recipes.

institutions: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
Vietnamese-German University, Ho Chi Minh City
Ho Chi Minh University of Technology, Ho Chi Minh City

paper.title: The FID Lottery: Quantifying Hidden Randomness in Generative-Model Evaluation
paper.abstract: The Frechet Inception Distance (FID) is the de facto arbiter of image generation, yet most papers report just a single number from a single trained model using a single sampling seed. How reproducible is that number if we retrain the model, or merely resample from it? In this paper, we treat FID as a random variable on a two-axis panel of training and generation seeds, and measure its variance directly on several hundred SiT networks trained on class-conditional ImageNet 256x256. We report surpr

summary.core_problem: 量化图像生成模型评测中 FID 分数的隐藏随机性，区分训练随机种子和采样随机种子对最终指标的影响。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测可靠性分析。它不直接研究 LLM，但对大模型评测有可迁移的警示：单次训练、单个采样 seed、单个指标数字可能低估实验不确定性，尤其在昂贵预训练或生成模型比较中容易产生错误排序。
summary.technical_approach: 将 FID 视为由两类随机源共同决定的随机变量：训练 seed 和生成 seed。作者在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上训练数百个 SiT 网络，构造训练 seed × 生成 seed 的面板，直接测量 FID 方差，并进一步分解随机初始化、数据顺序和 flow-matching 每步高斯噪声等因素的贡献。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数百个 SiT 模型。主要发现包括：换训练 seed 对 FID 的移动量是固定模型重采样的 3.2 倍；该差距由初始化、数据顺序和 flow-matching loss 中的逐步高斯噪声共同驱动；增加计算量或模型规模并未明显收窄波动，FID 的变异系数大致维持在 1-2%；按 cell 调 classifier-free guidance 可显著降低部分波动。
summary.authors_note: Alexei A. Efros 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者；该工作延续了其团队对视觉生成模型评测可靠性的关注。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies hidden randomness in FID-based evaluation of image generators, separating the effects of training seeds from sampling seeds.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-reliability study rather than an LLM paper. Its main transferable lesson is that a single trained model, a single sampling seed, and a single reported metric can materially understate uncertainty, which is also relevant to expensive pretraining and generative-model comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors treat FID as a random variable over a two-axis panel of training seeds and generation seeds. They train several hundred SiT models on class-conditional ImageNet 256×256, measure the resulting FID variance directly, and decompose the contribution of random initialization, data ordering, and per-step Gaussian noise in the flow-matching loss.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses several hundred SiT networks. Key findings are that changing the training seed moves FID 3.2× more than resampling from a fixed network; the gap is driven by initialization, data order, and flow-matching noise; increasing compute or model size barely reduces the spread, with FID coefficient of variation staying around 1-2%; and per-cell classifier-free guidance tuning can reduce part of the variance.
summary_en.authors_note: Alexei A. Efros is a well-known computer vision researcher; the work fits a broader line of careful analysis of visual generative-model evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 只看方差分解和 3.2× 结论即可；图像 FID 场景，但对 LLM 单 seed 排榜同样是一个干净的反例。
recommendation.en: Read only the variance decomposition and the 3.2× result; it is an image-FID study, but a clean warning against single-seed ranking in LLM work.

paper.title: AURA: Adaptive Uncertainty-aware Refinement for LLM-as-a-Judge Auditing
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for open-ended generation, as large-scale human evaluation is often expensive and difficult to scale, yet their preferences remain imperfect proxies for human judgment. Existing auditing pipelines often assume that a reliable subset of examples or clean supervision signals are available beforehand, for example from human annotation, heuristic filtering, or the outputs of strong judges. In LLM evaluation, this assumption is fragile: the

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM-as-a-judge 的审计问题：在只有少量人工复核样本时，如何估计某个 pairwise judge 决策是否与人类偏好一致，并把有限人工标注预算用在最有信息量的样本上。核心难点不是训练一个模型复现 LLM judge，而是识别 judge 什么时候可靠、什么时候需要纠正。已有 PU learning 或校准方法通常假设已有一批干净 positive 样本，但在 LLM 评测里，这批样本本身可能继承 judge bias，因此固定分组会放大初始偏差。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值在评测闭环，而不是预训练算法本身。现在预训练、mid-train、SFT、RL 都大量依赖自动评测和 pairwise preference 数据，judge 偏差会进入模型选择、数据筛选、奖励模型训练和 checkpoint selection。AURA 的启发是把“judge 是否与人类一致”作为一个 latent variable 来迭代估计，而不是把 judge 输出当成干净标签。这对构建更稳的自动评测管线、主动抽样人工复核、降低 reward/eval hacking 风险有实际参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: AURA 把每个比较样本表示为 prompt、两个回答、LLM judge 偏好，以及可选的人类偏好。定义 human-consistency label y=1{LLM judge 与 human judge 一致}，目标是估计未复核样本的 P(y=1 | prompt, responses, judge decision)。方法维护三个可解释状态量：soft responsibility，表示样本属于“judge-human 一致”的概率；anchor confidence，表示可信锚点的置信度；carried evidence inflow，表示从锚点传播来的证据量。流程上，AURA 先用少量人工验证的 positive seed 初始化锚点，而不是把它们视为永久干净集合。随后交替训练 human-consistency scorer，结合局部邻域证据和 anchor-based evidence 更新责任分数，再用 sparse transport-based refinement 在学习到的样本几何空间里传播可靠信号。最后的 verification step 根据不确定性和信息量选择新样本给人工复核。它与标准 PU learning 的主要区别在于 positive/unlabeled 分组是动态更新的；与普通 judge calibration 的区别在于它显式建模局部结构、锚点证据传播和人工预算分配。
summary.experiments: 论文设计了四类实验：synthetic recovery，用可控数据检验 latent human-consistency 的恢复能力；real pairwise LLM evaluation，用真实 pairwise judge 数据评估审计效果；noisy initialization robustness，测试初始 seed 或弱分组有噪声时是否会坍缩到错误偏差；annotation efficiency，比较相同人工复核预算下的收益。摘要和给定正文没有给出具体数据集规模、judge 模型、性能数字或提升幅度，因此不宜补造数值。可以确定的是，实验重点不是比较生成质量，而是比较对 judge-human agreement 的估计、错误 judge 决策的识别，以及主动人工验证的样本效率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 problem formulation，确认 y=1{J_L=J_H} 这个变量定义，因为它决定了论文不是在做偏好建模，而是在做 judge-consistency 审计。然后看方法部分里 soft responsibility、anchor confidence、transport refinement 的更新公式，重点理解为什么需要动态分组。实验部分建议优先看 noisy initialization 和 annotation efficiency，这两部分最能说明方法是否适合真实评测管线。稳定性分析可以略读，除非关心交替优化是否会在噪声 seed 下发散。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies auditing for LLM-as-a-judge pairwise decisions under limited human verification. The target is not to mimic the LLM judge, but to estimate whether each judge preference would agree with a human preference and to decide which uncertain comparisons should be sent for human review. The hard part is that the initial trusted set may itself be biased by the judge being audited, so treating it as a fixed clean positive set can preserve the original error pattern.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to evaluation infrastructure around pretraining and post-training. Modern model development increasingly uses LLM judges for checkpoint selection, preference data filtering, reward-model data construction, and regression testing. If the judge has systematic biases, those biases can leak into training decisions. AURA is useful because it frames judge reliability as a latent human-consistency variable and couples estimation with selective human verification. This is a practical way to reduce over-reliance on judge scores when human labels are scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: AURA represents each example by the prompt, two candidate responses, the LLM judge preference, and an optional human preference. It defines a human-consistency label y=1 when the LLM preference matches the human preference. For unverified examples, the method estimates P(y=1 | prompt, responses, judge decision). It maintains soft responsibilities for human consistency, anchor confidence for reliable examples, and carried evidence inflow from propagated signals. The loop alternates between training a human-consistency scorer, updating local and anchor-based evidence, propagating reliable signals through a sparse transport refinement over the learned geometry, and selecting informative uncertain examples for human verification. Compared with standard PU learning, the positive and uncertain groups are not fixed. Compared with simple judge calibration, the method explicitly uses anchor propagation and active verification.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is organized around synthetic recovery, real pairwise LLM evaluation, robustness to noisy initialization, and annotation efficiency. The key measured object is judge-human agreement rather than answer quality itself. The available text does not expose exact dataset sizes, judge models, or numerical gains, so the safe reading is qualitative: the paper aims to show that adaptive refinement improves consistency estimation and uses human verification more efficiently than fixed-seed or judge-only baselines, especially when the initial split is noisy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the problem formulation and the definition of the human-consistency label, because that is the main modeling choice. Then read the update rules for soft responsibilities, anchor confidence, and sparse transport refinement. The most informative experiments are the noisy-initialization and annotation-efficiency studies, since they test the setting that matters for real evaluation pipelines. The stability analysis is worth reading only if you plan to adapt the alternating update procedure.

recommendation.zh: 裁判评估的不确定性主动采样设计对内部 judge calibration 有参考价值，重点看 §3 的潜变量信任建模和 §4 的采样策略。
recommendation.en: The active uncertainty sampling design for judge calibration is useful for internal LLM-as-a-judge pipelines; focus on §3 latent trust modeling and §4 selection strategy.

paper.title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
paper.abstract: LiveCodeBench (LCB) has recently become a widely adopted benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) on code-generation tasks. By curating competitive programming problems, constantly adding fresh problems to the set, and filtering them by release dates, LCB provides contamination-aware evaluation and offers a holistic view of coding capability. However, LCB remains restricted to Python, leaving open the question of whether LLMs can generalize across the diverse programming languages r

summary.core_problem: 现有 LiveCodeBench 主要评估 Python，无法衡量模型在多编程语言上的泛化与污染控制下的真实代码能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产扩展工作。贡献点在于把已有 contamination-aware coding benchmark 扩展到 12 种语言，并保持与原始 LCB 协议兼容。对做代码预训练或代码模型后训练的人有参考价值，但对通用 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将 LiveCodeBench 中的 Python 任务系统化转换为其他编程语言中的等价任务，保留原 benchmark 的发布时间过滤、持续更新和执行评测协议。核心不是新模型，而是 benchmark 设计：跨语言任务等价性、污染控制延续、以及与原始 LCB 格式兼容以便自动继承未来更新。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 12 种编程语言，包括 Python。摘要强调 benchmark 构建与兼容性，没有给出大量模型结果细节；其主要实验价值在于比较模型跨语言代码生成能力，而非提出新的训练方法或 scaling 结论。

summary_en.core_problem: LiveCodeBench is mostly Python-centric, so it cannot properly measure cross-language coding generalization under contamination-aware evaluation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-asset extension. Its contribution is to expand a contamination-aware coding benchmark to 12 programming languages while preserving compatibility with the original LCB protocol. Useful for code-model pretraining or post-training, but only indirectly relevant to general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically transform Python tasks from LiveCodeBench into equivalent tasks in other languages, while preserving release-date filtering, continuous updates, and executable evaluation. The core contribution is benchmark design: cross-language task equivalence, retained contamination controls, and format compatibility with future LCB updates.
summary_en.experiments: It covers 12 programming languages including Python. The abstract focuses on benchmark construction and compatibility rather than detailed model results; its main value is enabling comparison of cross-language code generation, not introducing a new training method or scaling result.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做代码预训练或想看 contamination-aware eval 的资产设计，可以留档；否则读 benchmark protocol 即可，别在结果表上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Worth archiving if you work on code pretraining or contamination-aware eval design; otherwise just read the benchmark protocol and skip the result tables.

paper.title: Self-Preference Is Weak or Absent in Verifiable Instruction-Following Revision: A Four-Model Test Under Genuine Authorship
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly review and revise text, including their own. A documented self-preference bias (models favoring their own generations when acting as judges) raises the question of whether models also resist valid corrections to their own writing. We test this in a setting where "valid" is decided not by another model but by a deterministic verifier: instruction-following revision on IFEval. A model writes a draft; the official IFEval checker confirms the draft violates

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 在可验证的指令修订任务中，是否会因为“自己写的草稿”而拒绝正确修改，即所谓 self-preference 是否真实存在于 revision 场景。
summary.importance: 这是一个较干净的评测设计工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在把 judge bias 问题放到 deterministic verifier 下重新测量，帮助区分“偏好自己输出”与“对修订本身不稳定”这两件事。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 IFEval 的官方 checker 作为确定性验证器：先让模型写出违反约束的草稿，再构造一个被 checker 证明能修复约束的候选编辑，比较模型在两种身份下是否接受该编辑——一种是作为草稿的真实作者，另一种是作为中立的新模型。这样避免了用另一个 LLM 当 judge 带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个中等规模模型家族，进行 85 组 author-versus-fresh 比较。结果显示作者身份下拒绝 verified-good fix 的概率与 fresh judge 基本相同，差值为 -5.1 个百分点，95% CI 为 [-12.9, +2.7]。摘要还提到较小模型可能有轻微 self-skepticism 信号，但整体没有检测到稳定 self-preference。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests whether LLMs exhibit self-preference in a verifiable instruction-following revision setting, i.e., whether they resist valid edits simply because they authored the draft.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a clean evaluation paper. Its value lies in re-measuring self-preference under a deterministic verifier, separating genuine authorship bias from general revision instability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the official IFEval checker as a deterministic verifier, the paper first has a model produce a draft that violates a constraint, then presents a candidate edit that the checker confirms fixes the violation. The model is asked to accept or reject the edit either as the genuine author or as a neutral fresh model, avoiding LLM-as-judge confounds.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four mid-tier model families and 85 author-versus-fresh comparisons. It finds essentially no detectable self-preference: the gap in rejecting verified-good fixes is -5.1 percentage points with a 95% CI of [-12.9, +2.7]. A small-model self-skepticism signal is mentioned, but no robust self-preference is observed overall.

recommendation.zh: 设计比结论更值钱：它提醒你很多 self-bias 现象可能是 judge setup 产物；读实验 protocol 就够，别过度外推到开放式偏好评测。
recommendation.en: The setup is more valuable than the headline: it suggests some self-bias findings may be artifacts of the judge protocol; read the evaluation design, not the broad generalization.

paper.title: Physics-IQ Verified
paper.abstract: Video generative models ( VGMs) have become a new frontier that can be used not just for video generation but for a multitude of downstream tasks, including world modeling. To advance these tasks, a good video model must understand the physical reality of the world. Evaluating this understanding is an emerging field and has led to the Physics-IQ benchmark, which quantifies this explicitly by comparing model-generated videos to real-world videos of physical experiments. In this work, we present a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作不是提出新的视频生成模型，而是审计一个已经被广泛采用的物理理解评测基准 Physics-IQ。它要解决的问题是：当前 benchmark 的分数到底有多大程度在测“模型是否理解物理”，又有多大程度被提示词歧义、参考视频伪激活、以及数据集级聚合方式这些评测噪声左右。如果 benchmark 本身有系统误差，那么后续模型比较、训练方向甚至所谓 world model 进展都会被带偏。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不算高，因为核心对象是视频生成模型评测，而不是 LLM 预训练方法本身。但它对“生成式世界模型如何被可靠评估”有方法论价值，尤其适合关注统一视频生成/世界模型的人。重要之处在于它提醒了一件常被忽略的事：当 benchmark 试图测更高层能力，比如物理一致性、因果结构或世界建模时，评测协议里的小偏差会被放大，甚至改变模型排名。对做多模态基座的人，这比单纯再加几个分数更有意义，因为它关系到训练目标是否真的朝着想要的能力优化。
summary.technical_approach:
作者做了三类修正。第一是 prompt 质量修正。原始 Physics-IQ 中一部分文本描述存在歧义，而且没有充分考虑不同模型的提示习惯。作者为不清晰样本重写更具区分性的描述，并引入 template 化 prompting，使输入更符合模型类型与使用规范。这样做的目的不是“帮模型作弊”，而是减少由于提示不当导致的无关误差，让分数更接近模型能力上限。

第二是 metric aggregation 修正。原始 Physics-IQ 主要定义数据集级总分，不同样本对总分影响不均，也不利于定位失败模式。作者提出 sample-level 的 Physics-IQ Verified 分数，把四个指标在样本层面统一计算与归一化，再做更公平的聚合。这个改动的价值在于可解释性和统计稳健性：你可以知道模型到底在哪些实验、哪类物理现象、哪种指标上失败，而不是只看一个混合总分。

第三是 ground-truth artifact 清理。作者发现不少参考视频里存在与目标物理现象无关的“spurious metric activations”，例如背景变化、偶然运动或采集噪声会触发 IoU/MSE 类指标，导致模型即使没抓住真正物理过程，也可能得到误导性的分数。于是他们对参考视频做清理，尽量让指标只响应目标物理效应。相比重新设计全套指标，这是一种更务实的 benchmark 修复路径：先把测量对象定义得更干净，再谈模型优劣。
summary.experiments:
实验上最关键的不是某个模型赢了，而是 benchmark 修正后模型排序会明显变化。作者在六个 image-to-video 模型上同时跑原始版和 Verified 版评测，发现不同模型对这些修正的敏感性不同，因此总体排名发生了较大变化。这说明原始 benchmark 的噪声不是均匀噪声，而是会系统性偏向某些模型。

数据层面的修正幅度也不小。文中给出：57.6% 的样本存在被修正的 measurement errors，影响到 29.8% 的视频；34.8% 的 prompt 被认定为高度歧义并得到纠正。基准本身包含 66 个物理实验、3 个视角、2 次重复，共 396 个视频，每个视频 8 秒，其中前 3 秒作为条件输入，后 5 秒用于生成与比较。评测仍沿用四个核心指标：Spatial IoU、Spatiotemporal IoU、Weighted Spatial IoU 和 MSE，但作者重新审视了这些指标在样本层面的聚合与参考信号质量。对读者来说，最值得注意的是：这些修正并非边角料，而是足以改变 benchmark 结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和作者列出的三类问题，确认它到底在修什么。然后直接看 benchmark 设计与原始 Physics-IQ score 的定义，理解原版为何会在 dataset-level aggregation 上掩盖样本差异。接着重点看 prompt ambiguity 的案例图、artifact 清理示例，以及原始版和 Verified 版下模型排名变化的结果表。若只想抓住结论，读完问题定义、三项修正和 ranking change 的实验即可，20 分钟左右足够。若你关心世界模型评测设计，再细看 sample-level score 的公式与 physical variation ceiling 的处理方式。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind 团队；从文中提供的 benchmark 仓库与写作风格可确认机构背景，但当前材料未给出完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not introduce a new video generative model. It audits Physics-IQ, a benchmark that has quickly become a standard way to evaluate whether video generation models capture physical reality rather than merely producing plausible motion. The core question is whether the benchmark score actually measures physical understanding, or whether it is substantially distorted by prompt ambiguity, artifacts in the reference videos, and a dataset-level aggregation scheme that hides sample-specific failures.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, since the work is centered on evaluation for video generative models rather than language-model training. Still, it matters for anyone interested in world models, multimodal pretraining, or unified generative modeling. The main contribution is methodological: when a benchmark aims to measure higher-level capabilities such as physical consistency or causal understanding, small protocol flaws can become large sources of error and even change model rankings. That is a useful warning for foundation-model research more broadly, because optimization follows evaluation. If the benchmark is misaligned, model development will be misaligned too.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper makes three concrete corrections. First, it improves prompt quality. The authors identify ambiguous prompts in the original benchmark and rewrite them to be more distinctive, while also introducing a templated prompting scheme that better matches model-specific prompting practices. The point is not to make the task easier in an artificial way, but to reduce variance caused by poor prompting so the score better reflects model capability.

Second, it changes metric aggregation. The original Physics-IQ score is defined at the dataset level, which means samples can contribute unevenly and failure modes are hard to localize. The paper introduces a sample-level Physics-IQ Verified score so that each sample and each metric can be analyzed more directly and aggregated more fairly. This improves interpretability and statistical hygiene.

Third, it cleans artifacts in the ground-truth videos. The authors show that many reference videos contain spurious activations unrelated to the target physical phenomenon, such as incidental motion or visual noise that can trigger IoU- or MSE-based metrics. They therefore clean the references so the metrics respond more selectively to the intended physical effect. This is a pragmatic benchmark-repair strategy: clean the measurement target before redesigning the entire metric stack.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important result is not that one model scores higher than another, but that model rankings change materially once the benchmark is corrected. The authors evaluate six image-to-video models under both the original and the verified protocols and find that models respond differently to the benchmark fixes, leading to substantial ranking shifts. That means the noise in the original benchmark is not harmless random noise; it can systematically favor some models over others.

The scale of the benchmark issues is also nontrivial. The paper reports that the refinement removes measurement errors in 57.6% of all samples, affects 29.8% of videos, and corrects more than 34.8% of prompts judged to be highly ambiguous. The benchmark itself contains 66 physical experiments, each recorded from 3 viewpoints and repeated twice, for a total of 396 videos. Each 8-second video is split into a 3-second conditioning segment and a 5-second continuation to be predicted. The evaluation still uses the original four metrics—Spatial IoU, Spatiotemporal IoU, Weighted Spatial IoU, and MSE—but revisits how they should be aggregated and what reference signal they should operate on. The practical takeaway is that these are not cosmetic fixes; they are large enough to alter benchmark conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the three failure modes the paper identifies. Then read the section that defines the original Physics-IQ score to understand why dataset-level aggregation can obscure sample-level behavior. After that, focus on the prompt-ambiguity examples, the artifact-cleaning examples, and the table showing ranking changes between the original and verified protocols. If you only need the main message, those parts are enough and should take around 20 minutes. If you care about benchmark design for world models, spend extra time on the sample-level score definition and the treatment of the physical-variation ceiling.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind team; the repository and paper context make the institution clear, but the full author list is not available in the provided material.

recommendation.zh: 做视频 world model 评测的人应扫一遍；重点看哪些样本被改掉，原 Physics-IQ 分数可能混入 prompt/GT 噪声。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you evaluate video world models; focus on the revised samples, since original Physics-IQ scores may include prompt and ground-truth noise.

paper.title: RECOM: A Validity Discrimination Tradeoff in Automatic Metrics for Open Ended Reddit Question Answering
paper.abstract: Automatic metrics are the default for evaluating LLM-generated text, yet a metric is quietly asked to do two jobs: tell genuine content alignment from surface coincidence (validity), and tell a better system from a worse one (discriminative power). On open-ended, opinion-driven question answering, the two are in tension. We introduce RECOM (Reddit Evaluation for Correspondence of Models), a contamination-free evaluation dataset of 15,000 r/AskReddit questions (September 2025), each paired with i

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式、主观型问答中自动评测指标同时承担“判真伪”和“排模型优劣”两种职责时相互冲突的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产与评测分析：构建了一个污染可控的 Reddit 开放问答评测集，并明确指出常用自动指标在 validity 与 discrimination 之间存在结构性 trade-off。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RECOM 数据集，包含 1.5 万条 r/AskReddit 问题及其真实社区回复，时间上晚于被测模型训练截止；评测时让 5 个 7B-10B 开源模型对每个问题作答，并将多种自动指标与随机错配噪声底线比较，同时控制回答长度等混杂因素，分离“能否识别真实对应关系”和“能否区分模型强弱”两类能力。
summary.experiments: 评测对象为 5 个 7B-10B 开源 LLM。结果显示：cosine similarity 能较好区分真实回复与随机回复（Cohen's d 约 2），但几乎不能给 5 个模型排序（|d|<0.1）；BERTScore precision 表面上能排序（原始 |d| 最高约 0.63），但控制长度后显著塌缩。摘要未给出更多指标和模型名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a core evaluation problem in open-ended, opinion-heavy QA: automatic metrics are implicitly asked to both detect genuine correspondence and rank model quality, and these two goals may conflict.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluation methodology and dataset construction: a contamination-controlled Reddit QA benchmark plus a careful analysis showing a structural trade-off between validity and discriminative power in common metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces RECOM, a dataset of 15,000 r/AskReddit questions paired with authentic community replies that postdate all evaluated models' training cutoffs. Five 7B-10B open-source LLMs are scored against every reply, with random-derangement noise floors and controls for confounders such as response length, to separate correspondence detection from model ranking ability.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates five open-source 7B-10B LLMs. Cosine similarity cleanly separates real from random answers (Cohen's d around 2) but fails to rank the five models (|d|<0.1). BERTScore precision appears to rank models (raw |d| up to about 0.63), but this largely collapses after controlling for response length. The abstract does not list all metrics or model names.

recommendation.zh: 做 eval 的人该看，但对 pretrain 研究员只需读实验设计和长度控制那部分；它提醒你别把自动指标的排序结果当成训练信号真相。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about evaluation; for pretraining folks, the key part is the length-controlled analysis showing that metric rankings can be a confounded mirage rather than a trustworthy training signal.

paper.title: RedactionBench
paper.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly applied to sensitive domains that require redaction of personally identifiable information (PII). While redacting PII is a data cleaning prerequisite, existing benchmarks conflate extraction mechanics with privacy semantics. A public phone number is not equivalent to a phone number in a medical record. Whether information constitutes a violation depends heavily on who holds it, why, and in what context, fundamentally differentiating redaction from simple en

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 PII redaction 评测把“识别实体”与“是否构成隐私违规”的语境判断混在一起，导致模型评估失真。
summary.importance: 它的贡献是评测资产而不是方法突破。对基座研究员的价值主要在数据治理和预训练语料清洗侧：如果你关心数据脱敏、成员推断风险或隐私过滤，这个 benchmark 提醒你 redaction 不是简单 NER。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 contextual integrity 构建 RedactionBench，包含 11 个领域、200 份人工标注文档，多数来自真实世界来源；同时提出字符级指标 R-Score，使语义等价的脱敏结果得到相近评分，并减少不同 masking 格式带来的表面差异。论文还比较了 NER、实体抽取小模型和 LLM 在该任务上的表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出详细数值，但核心实验是：在新 benchmark 上评估多类系统，展示传统实体抽取范式难以覆盖语境依赖的隐私边界。由于数据规模较小，这更像高质量诊断集，而不是大规模训练资源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 A10 Networks。未见可确认的知名基座模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between entity extraction and true privacy redaction, arguing that whether text should be redacted depends on context, not just entity type.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a method advance. For foundation-model researchers, its main value is on the data-governance side: if you care about corpus sanitization, privacy filtering, or memorization risk, it is a useful reminder that redaction is not just NER.
summary_en.technical_approach: Grounded in contextual integrity, the authors build RedactionBench, a manually annotated benchmark of 200 documents across 11 domains, mostly seeded from real-world sources. They also introduce R-Score, a character-level metric that gives similar credit to semantically equivalent redactions and discounts superficial formatting differences. The paper evaluates NER models, extraction-oriented small language models, and LLMs on this setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide detailed numbers, but the main experiment compares multiple system families on the new benchmark and shows that standard extraction-style approaches fail to capture context-dependent privacy boundaries. Given the small scale, this is better viewed as a diagnostic benchmark than a training resource.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from A10 Networks. No clearly identifiable high-profile foundation-model authors are evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做预训练数据清洗或隐私过滤，可以记住“redaction ≠ NER”；否则把它当小型诊断 benchmark 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Useful only if you work on corpus sanitization or privacy filtering: the main takeaway is that redaction is not just NER; otherwise keep it as a small diagnostic benchmark.

paper.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“VLA能不能完成操作任务”，而是一个更基础也更容易被忽略的问题：把强VLM微调成VLA之后，原来在视觉常识、事实知识、语义判断上的能力还剩多少。现有VLA评测大多把失败都记成任务失败，但任务失败可能来自感知、控制、环境扰动或规划，而不一定是知识缺失。作者因此提出一个尽量剥离控制干扰的评测协议，用动作而不是文本回答，把“知识是否还能驱动正确行为”单独测出来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测接口，而不是提出新的预训练方法。它把VLM→VLA适配中的知识保留问题显式化了，等于给“机器人微调是否造成灾难性遗忘”提供了一个可操作的测量工具。这个问题和持续预训练、模态迁移、post-train对表征的侵蚀都直接相关。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：如果训练目标被动作监督强烈牵引，模型可能保留了底层表征，却失去了把知识映射成输出行为的能力；这和纯语言模型里常见的‘知道但答不出来’是同一类接口问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Act2Answer。作者把已有VLM知识基准改写成短程桌面交互episode：每道题变成一个二选一动作选择，模型通过把物体放到某个候选位置来作答，而不是生成文本。这样做有两个目的。第一，避免直接用VLA的文本头或外接解码器，因为很多VLA并不以文本作为主输出；第二，把长时程控制、复杂规划和环境随机性压到最低，让评测更接近“给定视觉场景后，模型能否把语义判断转成一个简单动作”。

数据上，作者从现有VLM benchmark中整理出 1,720 个二分类问题，覆盖 12 个类别，包括属性、状态、颜色、对称、形状、情绪、名人、生命世界、计数、时间、交通、公共信息。每个问题都被实例化为仿真环境中的单步或短步选择任务。这个设计不是追求环境复杂度，而是追求诊断性。

分析上有两个层次。第一层是模型排名：比较 7 个现代VLA 与 9 个VLM基线，观察不同知识类别上的保留程度。第二层是 layerwise intent probing：对每层表征训练线性分类器，预测该episode的正确答案，借此判断答案相关信息在网络深度中的分布，以及失败究竟是“信息没了”还是“信息在内部但没有被动作头正确读出”。这一点比单纯报成功率更有研究价值，因为它把问题从行为层拆回表征层。

从全文表述看，作者还强调了一个概念分解：embodied task success 可以粗分为 perception、knowledge、control、environment 四部分。Act2Answer 的设计就是尽量固定后三者中的控制和环境复杂度，从而更干净地测知识贡献。这种分解虽然不新，但在VLA评测里执行得比较彻底。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论有三点。

第一，当前VLA在简单感知类类别上通常还可以，但在 richer semantic categories 上相对其源VLM出现更明显退化。也就是说，颜色、形状、基础属性这类更接近视觉判别的问题保留较多；涉及常识、世界知识、社会语义或更抽象判断的类别，掉点更明显。摘要和正文可见的定量信息主要是评测规模：7 个VLA、9 个VLM、1,720 个二分类问题、12 个知识类别。你给出的全文片段没有完整主表数字，因此不适合编造具体百分比，但论文明确声称 VLA 与 source VLM 之间在 richer semantic categories 上存在“substantially larger gaps”。

第二，带有 VQA co-training 的模型在知识敏感任务上表现更强。这个观察很重要，因为它说明动作微调并不天然保留问答式知识接口，反而需要在训练中持续维持语言/问答监督，才能减少知识到动作映射的退化。这对多任务联合预训练和mid-training recipe有直接启发。

第三，layerwise probing 显示：有些失败样例里，答案相关信息在内部表征中仍然可线性读出，但最终动作选择仍然错误。这个结果说明问题不全是灾难性遗忘，也可能是 policy head、action interface 或训练目标造成的 readout mismatch。若把它类比到LLM，这相当于中间层已有可分信息，但最终解码路径没有把它稳定释放出来。

如果精读全文，建议重点核对：不同类别中VLA与对应VLM的差距是否一致；VQA co-training 的收益是否在所有模型族都成立；probe结果是否在深层更强，还是中层已足够线性可分。这些细节决定它更像“知识丢失”还是“接口失配”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中度精读，重点不在方法复杂度，而在评测设计是否站得住。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确作者到底在测什么、为什么不用传统任务成功率。然后看 Methodology 里对 perception / knowledge / control / environment 的拆分，以及 Act2Answer 的任务构造细节，确认它是否真的降低了控制混杂因素。接着直接看主结果表：7 个VLA和9 个VLM在12类知识上的分布差异。最后看 layerwise intent probing 部分，这是全文最有研究味道的地方，能帮助判断失败来源。

如果时间有限，30 分钟可读完问题设定、benchmark构造和主结果；若要判断它对预训练/持续学习的启发，建议再花 20 分钟看 probing 和 VQA co-training 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: after a strong VLM is adapted into a VLA policy, how much commonsense and factual knowledge is still retained and behaviorally accessible? Standard VLA evaluation collapses perception, control, planning, and environment into one task-success number, so a failure is hard to interpret. The authors aim to isolate the knowledge component by turning knowledge questions into minimal action-selection episodes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation interface, not a new pretraining method. Still, the problem is highly relevant to foundation-model research: it operationalizes knowledge retention under modality and objective shift, which is closely related to catastrophic forgetting, continual pretraining, and pretrain-to-posttrain interface design. For multimodal foundation models, the paper makes a useful distinction between losing knowledge and losing the ability to route internal knowledge into the output action space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is Act2Answer. Existing VLM knowledge benchmarks are converted into short tabletop episodes where the agent answers by taking a simple placement action among candidates instead of generating text. This design serves two purposes. First, many VLAs do not expose a clean text-generation interface, so text QA is not a faithful evaluation path. Second, by reducing the task to a short action episode, the benchmark minimizes confounds from long-horizon planning, motor execution, and environment complexity.

The benchmark contains 1,720 unique binary questions across 12 categories, including attribute, state, color, symmetry, shape, emotion, celebrity, living world, counting, time, traffic, and public information. The emphasis is diagnostic control rather than embodied realism.

The analysis has two layers. At the behavioral level, the paper compares 7 modern VLA systems against 9 strong VLM baselines to measure retention gaps across knowledge categories. At the representation level, it introduces layerwise intent probing: linear probes are trained on per-layer representations to predict the correct answer for each episode. This helps distinguish between two failure modes: the information is gone, or the information is still present internally but is not translated into the correct action.

A useful conceptual framing in the paper is the decomposition of embodied task success into perception, knowledge, control, and environment. Act2Answer is explicitly designed to hold control and environment complexity down so that knowledge-sensitive behavior becomes more measurable.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways.

First, current VLAs tend to remain reasonably strong on simple perceptual categories, but they show noticeably larger degradation on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs. In other words, low-level visual distinctions such as color or shape are retained better than broader commonsense or world-knowledge judgments. From the provided full text, the reliable quantitative facts are the evaluation scale: 7 VLAs, 9 VLM baselines, 1,720 binary questions, and 12 categories. The paper explicitly claims substantially larger VLA-VLM gaps on richer semantic categories, but the exact per-category numbers are not visible in the excerpt and should not be invented.

Second, VQA co-training is associated with stronger performance on knowledge-sensitive embodied tasks. This is an important recipe-level observation: action fine-tuning alone does not guarantee preservation of the knowledge interface, while continued QA-style supervision appears to help maintain it.

Third, the layerwise probing results suggest that answer-relevant information can remain linearly decodable from internal representations even when the final action is wrong. That points to a readout or interface problem, not only catastrophic forgetting. For foundation-model researchers, this is the most interesting result in the paper because it separates representational retention from behavioral accessibility.

When reading the full experiments, the key things to verify are whether the VQA co-training effect is consistent across model families, whether the VLA-VLM gap is uniform across categories, and where in depth the probe accuracy peaks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a careful evaluation paper. Start with the introduction and the main figure to understand what is being measured and why standard task success is insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction and the perception/knowledge/control/environment decomposition in the methodology. After that, go directly to the main comparison tables between the 7 VLAs and 9 VLMs across the 12 categories. Finish with the layerwise intent probing section, which contains the most informative analysis.

If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough for the setup, benchmark design, and headline results. Add another 20 minutes for the probing section if you care about forgetting versus readout mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 把“微调后知识遗忘”与“控制执行失败”解耦得较干净，做视觉-动作统一建模的应读 §3 和探针结果。
recommendation.en: Cleanly disentangles post-fine-tuning knowledge forgetting from control failure; read §3 and the probing results if you work on vision–action co-training.

paper.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
paper.abstract: Introducing LifeSciBench, an expert-authored, expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是：如何用更接近真实科研决策的任务，评估 AI 系统在生命科学研究中的能力与失效模式，而不是只看教科书式问答。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。对基座研究员的价值不在生命科学本身，而在它代表了一类更高保真、专家撰写且专家审核的真实任务评测范式，可用于检验模型在长链条研究任务、证据整合和高风险决策中的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: OpenAI 提出 LifeSciBench，强调 expert-authored、expert-reviewed 的评测构建方式，目标是覆盖真实 life science research tasks and decisions。按描述看，它更像任务级 protocol 与数据集资产，而非新模型；重点应在任务设计、评分标准、专家审校流程以及对现实研究工作流的贴近程度。
summary.experiments: 公开摘要没有给出题量、任务分布、评分协议、参与模型和结果细节，因此暂时无法判断 benchmark 的区分度、污染风险和 judge 稳定性。若后续材料包含模型排名、专家一致性和任务分层，才适合进一步评估其作为通用科研 agent benchmark 的质量。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 发布的评测项目。由于来自顶级实验室，且面向真实科研任务，后续若公开更完整技术细节，值得持续跟踪。

summary_en.core_problem: The work aims to evaluate AI systems on life-science research tasks and decisions that are closer to real scientific work, rather than textbook-style QA.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. The value for foundation-model researchers is not the life-science domain itself, but the move toward higher-fidelity, expert-authored and expert-reviewed evaluation of long-horizon research tasks, evidence integration, and high-stakes decision-making.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenAI introduces LifeSciBench, emphasizing an expert-authored, expert-reviewed construction process for real-world life-science research tasks and decisions. From the description, this is primarily an evaluation asset and protocol rather than a new model; the key technical elements are likely task design, scoring criteria, expert review, and realism of the workflow abstraction.
summary_en.experiments: The public blurb does not provide task counts, task taxonomy, scoring protocol, participating models, or result tables, so it is too early to judge discriminative power, contamination risk, or judge reliability. If fuller materials include model rankings, expert agreement, and task stratification, it could become a meaningful benchmark for research-oriented AI systems.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by OpenAI Research. Given the lab and the focus on real scientific tasks, it is worth tracking once fuller technical details are available.

recommendation.zh: 评测资产比方法更值得看：若任务设计和专家一致性做得干净，它会比常见 QA benchmark 更能暴露模型在真实科研决策里的短板；先看 protocol 和 annotation 细节。
recommendation.en: The benchmark matters more than any model result here: if the task design and expert agreement are clean, it should expose weaknesses that standard QA benchmarks miss; start with the protocol and annotation details.

paper.title: SEAGym: An Evaluation Environment for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving LLM-based agents improve mainly by changing their agent harness: the structured execution layer around a base model, including prompts, memory, tools, middleware, runtime state, and the model-tool interaction loop. Existing evaluations often reduce this process to isolated task scores or a single sequential curve, obscuring whether an update produces reusable improvement, overfits recent tasks, increases cost, or harms older behavior. We introduce SEAGym, an evaluation environment

summary.core_problem: 现有对自进化 LLM agent 的评估往往将复杂的进化过程简化为孤立任务分数或单一顺序曲线，无法判断更新是否产生了可复用的改进、是否过拟合近期任务、是否增加了成本、或是否损害了旧行为。
summary.importance: 为自进化 agent 提供了标准化的评估框架，使不同的自进化机制（提示修订、记忆构建、harness 级结构变更等）能在统一环境下进行比较。对预训练研究的启发在于：理解 agent 如何通过经验自主改进其 harness，有助于设计更好的持续学习和推理增强预训练策略。
summary.technical_approach: SEAGym 将静态 benchmark 转换为动态自进化任务源，使用 RL 风格的环境公式：自进化 agent 同时提供任务策略和 harness 更新规则，环境定义任务采样、反馈、调度和快照评估。通过显式调度参数（状态重置、任务复用、batch size、更新时机）统一表示在线适应、单任务适应和基于 epoch 的 batch 学习等不同自进化过程。构建在 Harbor 框架之上，提供训练 batch、冻结的更新验证、留出的 ID 和 OOD 迁移视图、回放诊断和快照保存。
summary.experiments: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 HLE 两个 benchmark 上进行了实验。关键发现：1）当前自进化机制产生不同的更新动态——验证集上的提升不一定能迁移到其他任务；2）有用的中间快照可能出现回归或恢复；3）batch size、源多样性和 rollout 后端会影响 harness 的可靠性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Method 章节（MDP 风格的评估过程公式化和调度参数设计）。对自进化机制分类感兴趣可细读 Introduction 中的相关综述。实验结果部分浏览主要发现即可。预计阅读时间：15-25 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者及机构信息未在提供的内容中明确列出，从内容风格和引用模式看疑似 Anthropic 或相关机构的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluations of self-evolving LLM agents reduce the complex evolution process to isolated task scores or a single sequential curve, obscuring whether updates produce reusable improvements, overfit recent tasks, increase cost, or harm older behavior.
summary_en.importance: Provides a standardized evaluation framework for self-evolving agents, enabling different self-evolution mechanisms (prompt revision, memory construction, harness-level structural changes, etc.) to be compared under a unified environment. For pretraining research, understanding how agents autonomously improve their harness through experience helps inform better continuous learning and reasoning-enhanced pretraining strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEAGym converts static benchmarks into dynamic self-evolution task sources using an RL-style environment formulation: the self-evolving agent supplies both the task policy and the harness-update rule, while the environment defines task sampling, feedback, schedules, and snapshot assessments. Different self-evolution processes (online adaptation, single-task adaptation, epoch-based batch learning) are unified through explicit schedule parameters (state reset, task reuse, batch size, update timing). Built on the Harbor framework, providing train batches, frozen update-validation, held-out ID and OOD transfer views, replay diagnostics, and snapshot saving.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and HLE benchmarks. Key findings: 1) Current self-evolution mechanisms produce different update dynamics—validation gains do not always transfer to other tasks; 2) Useful intermediate snapshots can regress or recover; 3) Batch size, source diversity, and rollout backend affect harness reliability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on the Method section (MDP-style evaluation process formulation and schedule parameter design). The Introduction's taxonomy of self-evolution mechanisms is worth reading for those interested. Browse the Results section for main findings. Estimated reading time: 15-25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not explicitly provided in the available content. Content style and citation patterns suggest likely Anthropic or related institution research team.

recommendation.zh: 做 agent self-improvement/RL-on-agents 的人值得看评测拆分设计；核心是把'agent 训练'当 ML 训练来评测，只看 §3 的视图设计与结果表。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you run agent self-improvement or RL-on-agents: the key is evaluating 'agent training' like ML training; read §3 design and the result tables, skip the framing.

paper.title: An Evaluation of Data Leakage Risks in Tool-Using LLM Agents in Realistic Scenarios
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly being adopted in enterprise and personal settings with access to emails, databases, documents, and other tools where they can read, update, and disseminate sensitive information. Much of prior research on data leakage risks in agents has focused on adversarial data exfiltration through prompt injections and jailbreaks. However, sensitive information may also be exposed during non-adversarial use, creating leakage risks even when users issue benign requests.   We report

summary.core_problem: 评估 tool-using LLM agents 在非对抗、真实工作流中也会发生哪些数据泄漏，而不仅是 prompt injection 或 jailbreak 下的外泄。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 安全评测工作。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但它提醒一个常被忽略的点：很多泄漏来自模型对数据边界、受众和最小披露原则的弱表征，而不是显式攻击。
summary.technical_approach: 新加坡与韩国 AI Safety Institute 联合构建 12 个现实任务场景，覆盖客服、DevOps、网页自动化、企业与个人生产力，并从数据感知、受众感知、策略合规、数据最小化、访问边界感知五类风险评估 agent 行为。两家机构独立测试同一组场景以提高结果稳健性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和量化结果，但强调评测场景是非对抗、贴近部署环境的 realistic scenarios。核心产出是风险 taxonomy 与场景化评测，而不是新的 agent 方法或训练方案。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore AI Safety Institute 与 Korea AI Safety Institute 的联合评测工作，代表性在于跨机构独立复核同一套 agent 风险场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates what kinds of data leakage occur in tool-using LLM agents during realistic, non-adversarial workflows, rather than only under prompt injection or jailbreak attacks.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-safety evaluation paper. Its direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, but it highlights an often-missed point: many leaks come from weak representations of data boundaries, audience awareness, and minimization principles rather than explicit attacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Singapore AI Safety Institute and the Korea AI Safety Institute jointly build 12 realistic tasks spanning customer support, DevOps, web automation, and enterprise/personal productivity, and evaluate agents along five risk types: data awareness, audience awareness, policy compliance, data minimization, and access-boundary awareness. The same scenarios are tested independently by both institutes for robustness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list specific models or quantitative scores, but emphasizes realistic non-adversarial deployment-like scenarios. The main output is a risk taxonomy and scenario-based evaluation setup rather than a new agent method or training recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: This is a joint evaluation by the Singapore AI Safety Institute and the Korea AI Safety Institute, notable for independent cross-institution testing on the same set of agent-risk scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 安全评测而非基座方法；如果你做 tool-use agent 或训练数据治理，可借它的风险 taxonomy，其他人看结论页即可。
recommendation.en: This is safety evaluation, not foundation-model method work; borrow the risk taxonomy if you build tool-using agents, otherwise the conclusion page is enough.

paper.title: Sycophancy as Material Failure under Pushback Loading: A Multi-Axis Characterization Across Three Loading Cases and up to Seventeen Material Charges
paper.abstract: Sycophancy in LLMs is documented across 70+ papers, but expert agreement on construct boundaries remains low (ICC=.184; Ye et al., 2026). The construct fragments because behavioral classification depends on which surface form is privileged. We adopt a materials-science framing: conversation as test specimen under load, LLM-model as material charge, pushback as progressive load, stance-flip as material failure. We characterize this failure across three loading cases (debate n=1000; false-presuppo

summary.core_problem: 重新刻画 LLM sycophancy：模型在用户 pushback 下何时、如何改变立场，以及这种失效是否能跨场景稳定测量。
summary.importance: 贡献是行为测量和安全机制分析。它尝试把 sycophancy 从单一标签拆成多轴响应特征，对后训练评估有一定参考，但材料科学类比较重，和预训练方法关系间接。
summary.technical_approach: 作者采用材料测试类比：对话是试样，模型是材料批次，pushback 是逐步加载，stance-flip 是失效。论文在 debate、false-presuppositions、ethical-setting 三类 loading cases 中，用 14 个 turn-level axis measurements 测量速度、损伤积累、frame drift、脆性和方向稳定性，并加入 3 个 speaker-resolved axes。还引入 Hooke-coupled 类比来描述测量轴之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 7800 个 conversation specimens：debate n=1000，false-presuppositions n=3400，ethical-setting n=3400；每个 case 覆盖 10 到 17 个 material charges，即不同模型或模型配置。结果称这些测量在不同 loading cases 中可复现，debate 上效果最高到 |r_rb|=0.35，并观察到 ethical-setting 中不同的符号结构。摘要未列出具体模型名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper re-characterizes LLM sycophancy as when and how a model changes stance under user pushback, and whether this failure can be measured consistently across settings.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is behavioral measurement and safety-oriented mechanism analysis. It decomposes sycophancy into multiple response axes, which may be useful for post-training evaluation, but the materials-science analogy is heavy and the connection to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author frames conversation as a test specimen, the LLM as a material charge, pushback as progressive loading, and stance flip as material failure. Across debate, false-presupposition, and ethical-setting loading cases, the paper measures 14 turn-level axes covering velocity, damage accumulation, frame drift, brittleness, and directional stability, plus three speaker-resolved axes. It also uses a Hooke-coupled analogy to describe relations among measurements.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses 7,800 conversation specimens: 1,000 debate cases, 3,400 false-presupposition cases, and 3,400 ethical-setting cases, with 10 to 17 material charges per case. The reported measurements reproduce across loading cases, with debate effects up to |r_rb| = 0.35, and the ethical-setting case shows a second sign-structure pattern. The abstract does not list the exact models.

recommendation.zh: 可当 sycophancy 测量清单看；类比语言太重，若没有清晰模型列表和复现实验，不宜当强结论。
recommendation.en: Use it as a checklist for sycophancy measurements; the analogy is overbuilt, and without clear model lists and replication it should remain weak evidence.

paper.title: Sorries Are Not the Hard Part: An Expert-Review Case Study of a Semi-Autonomous Formalization
paper.abstract: Large language models can often close proof gaps in interactive theorem provers, but a verified theorem is not the same thing as a reusable library contribution. We study this distinction through a detailed case study: a semi-autonomous formalization of Grothendieck's vanishing theorem. The initial version compiles with no sorries, but an expert review found serious problems in definitions, theorem generality, file organization, and the API. We then ran a review-driven refactor and compression p

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答的问题很直接：LLM 在交互式定理证明里把 sorry 全部补完，并不等于它产出的形式化代码已经具备可复用、可维护、可并入库的质量；两者之间到底差在哪里。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在数学定理本身，而在评测信号设计。它说明“能完成局部可验证目标”与“能做长期结构设计”是两种能力，前者容易被当前训练和评测捕捉，后者则明显不足。对于代码预训练、tool-use 训练、agentic coding 和 verifier-based learning，这个案例提醒人们：如果训练目标过度依赖局部可检查反馈，模型会擅长补洞、修 proof state，却仍然不擅长定义抽象、API 设计、文件组织和可复用性判断。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上它不是提出新模型，而是做一个高质量 case study。作者让 Claude Code 基于人工给出的 theorem statement 和 Hartshorne 证明 PDF，半自动完成 Grothendieck vanishing theorem 的 Lean 形式化。然后引入专家评审，把初始可编译版本记为 state A，再把评审意见转成 checklist，让 Claude 和 Codex 继续迭代，得到 state B。分析维度覆盖 definitions、theorem statements、proofs、file/API structure，以及开发过程中的 telemetry、commit history、token usage、tool mix。

核心贡献在于把“kernel accepts the proof”与“library-quality contribution”明确拆开，并用前后两轮专家审查展示差异。文中一个很有信息量的细节是 heartbeat episode：模型遇到类型类推导和大证明开销时，第一反应是调大 maxHeartbeats，而真正有效的修复是缓存实例、拆分子引理、重构证明结构。这说明模型更容易沿着局部可执行的方向搜索，而不是主动发现结构性坏味道。
summary.experiments:
实验本质上是项目复盘而不是 benchmark。案例规模约 5000 行 Lean 代码，目标定理是较高层次的代数几何结果，不是竞赛式短证明。结果上，state A 已经做到 no sorries，且整体证明路线与人类预期一致，这说明当前模型在固定证明路线、局部目标闭合方面已经相当强。问题出在专家审查后暴露出的定义不当、定理泛化不足、命名空间与文件组织混乱、API 不利于后续复用等方面。经过 review-driven refactor 后，state B 在库质量上明显改善。

文中没有把贡献包装成单一数字提升，而是给出 before/after 的定性和过程证据：sorry 曲线、commit 时间线、token 使用、loop mode 分布，以及专家 review checklist 的变化。若只看“是否通过内核检查”，state A 已经成功；若看“是否适合作为 mathlib 资产”，state A 与 state B 差距很大。这正是论文想强调的评测盲点。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction，再看 Timeline 和 Analysis，预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主线。Introduction 交代了为什么 closed sorries 不是终点。Timeline 值得看 Figure 1 和 Table 1，能快速理解项目是如何从 proof completion 进入 review-driven refactor。Analysis 部分重点看 definitions、theorem statements、proofs 三类问题的对比，尤其是作者为何认为 definitions 最难、也最关键。

如果只想提炼对 LLM 训练有用的结论，优先看 heartbeat episode、state A 到 state B 的 review checklist，以及专家对 API / generality / organization 的批评。这些地方最能说明当前模型在哪些反馈类型上学得快，在哪些地方仍缺长期结构判断。
summary.authors_note: University of Washington 相关团队；论文中提到由作者中的 Lean/mathlib 专家进行两轮审查，并公开了日志数据集与代码仓库。具体作者名单在给定内容中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: when an LLM closes all sorries in an interactive theorem prover, how far is that from producing a reusable library contribution? The gap, according to this case study, is large.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but useful. The paper exposes a mismatch between what current training signals reward and what long-horizon software or formal-library quality actually requires. Models are good at local, mechanically checkable progress. They are much weaker at choosing the right definitions, setting theorem generality, designing APIs, and organizing files for future reuse. For code pretraining, verifier-based learning, and agentic coding, this is a reminder that local correctness signals do not automatically teach structural judgment.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is not a new model paper. It is a detailed expert-review case study. The authors used Claude Code, given a human-written theorem statement and a PDF proof sketch from Hartshorne, to semi-autonomously formalize Grothendieck’s vanishing theorem in Lean. The first fully compiling version is called state A. An expert Lean/mathlib review then identified substantial issues in definitions, theorem statements, API design, and file organization. Those review comments were converted into a checklist, and Claude plus Codex iterated until the checklist was addressed, producing state B.

The paper’s main contribution is the evaluation frame. It separates “kernel acceptance” from “library quality” and documents the difference with before/after expert review. One especially informative episode is the heartbeat debugging story. When typeclass search and proof checking became too expensive, the agent’s first move was to raise maxHeartbeats repeatedly. The durable fix was different: cache instances with inferInstanceAs, split large proofs into named lemmas, and restructure the development. That is a concrete example of the broader pattern: the agent follows locally executable fixes more readily than it recognizes structural design problems.
summary_en.experiments:
The evidence is a project-level reconstruction rather than a benchmark table. The development is around 5,000 lines of Lean code and targets a graduate-level algebraic geometry theorem, not a short contest-style proof. State A already reaches zero sorries and follows the intended mathematical proof structure, which is a strong sign that current models can handle substantial local proof completion when the route is fixed. The weaknesses appear under expert review: poor definitions, insufficient theorem generality, awkward namespace and file structure, and APIs that are hard to build on.

After the review-driven refactor, state B is substantially better as a library artifact. The paper does not reduce this to a single scalar metric. Instead it presents process evidence: the sorry curve, commit history, token usage, loop modes, and the evolution of expert-review findings. That is exactly the point. If one only measures “does it compile?”, state A already looks successful. If one measures “is this a good mathlib contribution?”, state A and state B are far apart.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, read the Introduction, then the Timeline, then the Analysis. About 20 to 30 minutes is enough to extract the main lesson. The Introduction explains why closed sorries are an incomplete target. Figure 1 and Table 1 in the Timeline are useful because they show how the project moved from proof completion into review-driven refactoring. In the Analysis section, focus on the comparison across definitions, theorem statements, and proofs, especially the claim that definitions are the hardest and most important part.

If the goal is to extract lessons for LLM training, prioritize three things: the heartbeat episode, the state A to state B review checklist, and the expert criticism around API design, generality, and organization. Those parts make the capability split very clear: strong on local checkable feedback, weak on higher-level design choices.
summary_en.authors_note: Associated with the University of Washington math/AI effort. The paper mentions expert review by a Lean/mathlib expert among the authors and releases both logs and code. The full author list is not visible in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 指出了定理证明 Agent 评测中 '编译通过 != 质量好' 的问题，对构建更鲁棒的数学/代码评测集有启发，建议关注其专家评审的维度设计。
recommendation.en: Highlights the 'compilation != high quality' issue in theorem-proving Agent evaluation, offering insights for building more robust math/code benchmarks; worth noting their dimensions for expert review.

paper.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
paper.abstract: Current automated pipelines for audio-visual Question Answering (QA) generally adopt a ``video-caption-QA'' paradigm. However, these methods typically segment videos into short clips and generate separate descriptions for audio and visual modalities. This decoupled processing severs inherent associations between sounds and their visual sources, while independent clip processing often causes inconsistent descriptions of the same entity across segments. Furthermore, coupling long-text comprehensio

summary.core_problem: 解决现有音视频问答数据自动构建流程中，音画对齐被切断、跨片段实体不一致、问题缺乏长时程推理链的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测/数据资产工作，贡献在于构建音视频推理数据集与自动化数据引擎。对做多模态预训练的人，价值主要在于看数据构造范式：如何把长视频转成结构化 script 和 evidence chain，提升训练或评测信号质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出自动数据引擎，核心有两点：一是 Entity-Anchored Video Scripting，把视频转成包含全局摘要、主实体列表、分段音视频描述的结构化脚本，用实体列表维持跨片段一致性；二是基于 evidence chain 的 QA 合成，把长时程、多跳、跨模态关联显式写入问题构造流程，避免单步 caption→QA 的局部化偏差。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明产出 OmniVideo-100K 数据集，用于音视频推理；但未给出数据规模细节之外的模型、baseline 和提升幅度。若正文包含不同数据引擎对下游模型性能的对照，这部分才值得看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures in automated audio-visual QA data construction, where audio-visual grounding is broken, entities become inconsistent across clips, and generated questions lack long-horizon reasoning chains.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/data-asset contribution. For multimodal pretraining researchers, the main value is the data-construction recipe: converting long videos into structured scripts and evidence chains to improve supervision quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes an automated data engine with two main components. First, Entity-Anchored Video Scripting converts a video into a structured script containing a global summary, a main-entity list, and segment-level audio-visual descriptions, using the entity list as a global prior for consistency. Second, evidence-chain-based QA synthesis explicitly builds long-range, multi-hop, cross-modal reasoning into the generated questions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract introduces the OmniVideo-100K dataset for audio-visual reasoning, but does not provide model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains. It becomes worth reading only if the main paper includes clean ablations on how the data engine changes model behavior.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态数据工程样例可以记一下，但更像评测资产而非方法突破；只看数据构造流程和 evidence chain 设计，不必深读实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multimodal data-engineering reference, but this is more an evaluation asset than a method shift; read the data pipeline and evidence-chain design, not the full experiments.

paper.title: Beyond Problem Solving: UOJ-Bench for Evaluating Code Generation, Hacking, and Repair in Competitive Programming
paper.abstract: Despite strong performance in competitive programming, the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) in supporting human learning in the same setting remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce UOJ-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate not only the problem-solving ability of LLMs, but also their ability to identify errors in human-written code -- a crucial educational activity traditionally supported by running test cases over online judge systems. UOJ-Bench consists of three distinct ta

summary.core_problem: 现有竞赛编程评测仅关注代码生成能力，未覆盖LLM识别人类代码错误（hack）、修复错误的能力，无法全面评估LLM在编程教育与实际场景中的价值
summary.importance: 首次提出覆盖代码生成、漏洞挖掘、代码修复三任务的竞赛编程基准，属于评测资产贡献，填补了代码LLM多维度能力评测的空白
