summary.technical_approach: 从Universal Online Judge（UOJ）的真实用户提交构建数据集，复用UOJ原生评测基础设施打分，三个任务分别对应生成正确代码、定位错误代码漏洞、修复错误代码通过测试用例
summary.experiments: 在真实竞赛提交构建的数据集上评测，one-shot设置下最强LLM的错误代码识别率不足50%；test-time scaling可将成功率提升至90%以上，但带来极高的计算成本

summary_en.core_problem: Existing competitive programming evaluations only focus on code generation ability, ignoring LLM's capability to identify bugs in human code (hacking) and repair bugs, failing to comprehensively assess LLM's value in programming education and real scenarios.
summary_en.importance: First competitive programming benchmark covering three tasks: code generation, hacking, and code repair; benchmark asset contribution filling the gap in multi-dimensional evaluation of code LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dataset constructed from real user submissions on the Universal Online Judge (UOJ), evaluated using UOJ's native judging infrastructure; three tasks correspond to generating correct code, locating bugs in buggy code, and repairing buggy code to pass test cases.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the dataset built from real competitive submissions: under one-shot setting, even the strongest LLMs achieve less than 50% accuracy in buggy code identification; test-time scaling improves success rate to over 90% but incurs extremely high computational cost.

recommendation.zh: 覆盖代码漏洞挖掘与修复的新基准，可更细粒度诊断预训练模型的代码推理能力，重点看附录的错误类型分布与数据集构建细节
recommendation.en: New code benchmark covering hacking and repair enables fine-grained diagnosis of pretrained code reasoning ability; focus on error type distribution and dataset construction details in the appendix.

paper.title: Authority, Truth, and Citation Bias: A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Benchmark for Studying Epistemic Susceptibility in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in citation-augmented settings, yet the effect of citation presence on model behavior independent of factual content remains poorly understood. We introduce AuthorityBench, a 220,564-prompt multi-domain benchmark that isolates how citation-based authority signals influence epistemic behavior in LLMs. The benchmark uses a fully balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing claim veracity with citation veracity, the first to do so, across four domains (gene

summary.core_problem: 构造一个评测来隔离“引用看起来权威”这一信号本身如何改变 LLM 对事实真假的判断和幻觉行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和评测协议：AuthorityBench 用大规模平衡实验设计把 claim 真伪和 citation 真伪解耦，直接测量模型对权威线索的认识论脆弱性；这对 RAG、引用增强回答、后训练偏好数据和事实性评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 2x2 factorial design：同时控制 claim veracity 与 citation veracity，并加入无引用 baseline。数据覆盖 general knowledge、science、law、medicine 四个领域，包含 40 个 prompt templates、四档 venue prestige、带国家编码的作者姓名变量，尽量把“引用存在感”“引用真实性”“命题真实性”“声望线索”分开测。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 规模为 220,564 个 prompts，评测 7 个模型和 12 个结构化研究问题。主要发现是：无论引用真实还是伪造，引用存在都会相对无引用 baseline 提高幻觉率；当真实命题搭配伪造引用时，幻觉率上升最明显，幅度为 3 到 22 个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark isolates how citation-based authority cues, independent of factual content, change LLM truth judgments and hallucination behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. AuthorityBench decouples claim veracity from citation veracity, making it useful for studying citation-augmented generation, RAG-style interfaces, factuality training, and post-training reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing true versus false claims with true versus fabricated citations, plus a no-citation baseline. It spans general knowledge, science, law, and medicine, with controlled prompt templates, venue prestige tiers, and country-coded author-name variation.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 220,564 prompts and evaluates seven models across 12 structured research questions. The reported finding is that citation presence, whether real or fabricated, consistently increases hallucination relative to no citation; fabricated citations attached to true claims raise hallucination by 3 to 22 percentage points.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 hallucination 分解表；它会提醒你别把“带引用”当作事实性 reward 的干净信号。
recommendation.en: Read the design and hallucination breakdown; it is a useful warning against treating citation presence as a clean factuality reward signal.

paper.title: Quickest Detection of Hallucination Onset: Delay Bounds and Learned CUSUM Statistics
paper.abstract: Token-level hallucination detectors are evaluated as classifiers, by AUC over all tokens, yet a streaming monitor is judged by its reaction time: the number of tokens that pass between the onset of a hallucination and the alarm. We formulate hallucination onset detection as a quickest change detection problem. A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state, validated on RAGTruth, places the task inside classical change-point theory and yields Lorden's lower bound on detecti

summary.core_problem: 把“token 级幻觉检测”从静态分类问题（AUC）改写为流式监控问题：在给定误报率预算下，幻觉一旦开始（onset），最少还能放出多少个 token 才能报警，并解释现有检测器距离理论最优差多少、差在什么环节。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“在线监控/对齐评测/部署安全”有明确方法论增量：1）给出了可操作的 delay–false alarm 目标函数与理论下界，能把不同 detector 的比较从 AUC 拉回到部署真正关心的反应时；2）把常见的因果序列标注器解释为“学习到的 CUSUM”，提供了把检测器训练目标与经典 quickest change detection 理论对齐的路径；3）用信息率分解把性能瓶颈定位到“特征可分性/统计量利用率”而非“RNN 深度/时序建模”，对后续做更强特征（例如利用模型内部状态、RAG 证据一致性信号）比盲目换架构更有指导意义。
summary.technical_approach:
核心建模是 quickest change detection（QCD）。把隐藏状态 z_t∈{faithful,hallucinated} 视为一阶马尔可夫链，并把观测 x_t 视为来自“变点前/后”两种分布的特征流。步骤：
1）结构验证：在 RAGTruth 的标注 span 上拟合不同阶数的马尔可夫模型，发现高阶虽统计显著但对对数似然增益极小（文中给出 <0.35%），因此一阶解释了约 99.7% 的序列结构，从而满足 Lorden minimax 框架的建模前提。
2）理论下界：在给定平均误报间隔/误报率约束下，用 Lorden 下界给出最小可达检测延迟（文中在 false-alarm rate=0.01 时约 1.3 token）。这一步把“能不能更快”变成“最多还能快多少”。
3）算法侧对齐：比较三类 stopping rule/统计量：
- 线性 per-token baseline：每个 token 独立打分再阈值化，本质上不做证据累积。
- 参数化 CUSUM：假设特征在变点前后服从对角高斯，使用经典 log-likelihood ratio 累积；结果显示该似然假设在 33 维特征上很差。
- 因果 recurrent labeler：来自既有多信号时序幻觉检测工作（33 维特征流 + RNN），作者证明其可读作“学习到的 CUSUM”：RNN 状态承担累积器，输出 log-odds 对应累积 log-likelihood ratio 的可学习增量。并引用 neural CUSUM 的结论（交叉熵最优解恢复 LLR）作为理论支撑。
4）差距归因：用“信息率/散度利用率”解释 delay。结论是 learned score 只实现了特征所含散度的约 1/4.5；此外存在有限时域效应：统计量时间平滑导致的相关性惩罚按渐近理论会被高估，实际检测发生在混合之前。整体上，主要瓶颈是特征与得分函数没有把可分信息吃满，而不是序列模型不够强。
summary.experiments:
数据与设定：在 RAGTruth 上做 token/span 级 onset 检测，统一在同一误报预算下比较“平均检测延迟（onset 后多少 token 报警）”。
关键数字（文中明确给出）：
- Lorden 下界：在 false-alarm rate=0.01 时，最小延迟约 1.3 token。
- 参数化（对角高斯）CUSUM：平均延迟约 41 token，作者归因于 33 维特征的似然模型错配。
- learned CUSUM（因果 RNN labeler）：在其成功捕获的 onset 上，平均延迟约 11–13 token。
- 线性 per-token baseline：约 31 token。
- 分解实验：非线性 per-token（无序列累积）可到约 18 token；因此从 31→11–13 的改进里，大头来自更好的 per-token score，小头来自序列累积（作者称约贡献四分之一，bootstrap 显著），额外“因果上下文”收益在噪声内。
- 可检出率现象：在接近理论下界的 operating point，onset 首 token 的 recall 约 30%，说明“低误报下的极快检测”会天然牺牲大量召回，这也是 AUC 指标掩盖的部署现实。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看引言里对“为什么 AUC 不对”的论证，以及把任务改写成 QCD 的三问（RQ1–RQ3），这是全文主线。
- 重点看：一阶马尔可夫验证（为什么足以用 Lorden 框架）、Lorden 下界如何从数据估计出来、以及把 causal recurrent labeler 解释为 learned CUSUM 的那段推导（log-odds/累积增量的对应关系）。
- 最值得细看的是“差距归因”的信息率分解：它直接告诉你下一步该投资源在特征/统计量学习，而不是换更深的时序网络。
- 如果只想拿结论：看 matched false-alarm 下的 delay 表格/图，以及分解实验（线性 vs 非线性 per-token vs 序列累积）。

summary_en.core_problem: Recasting token-level hallucination detection from a static classification metric (AUC) into a streaming monitoring objective: under a fixed false-alarm budget, how many tokens elapse after hallucination onset before an alarm, what is the theoretical minimum delay, and where the gap of practical detectors comes from.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but it adds a deployable evaluation/analysis frame that is directly relevant to LLM monitoring and alignment tooling. It (1) formalizes the operational delay–false alarm trade-off and provides a computable lower bound, preventing “AUC-only” comparisons from misleading deployment decisions; (2) connects common causal sequence labelers to classical quickest change detection by interpreting them as a learned CUSUM, aligning neural training with a well-studied optimality theory; (3) attributes remaining performance gaps to information-rate/feature separability rather than model depth, which is actionable for building better signals (e.g., internal-state features, retrieval-consistency signals) instead of just swapping architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper frames hallucination onset as a quickest change detection (QCD) problem. A latent state z_t (faithful vs hallucinated) evolves as a first-order Markov chain; observed features x_t follow different pre-/post-change distributions. Main components:
1) Model validation: fit higher-order Markov models on labeled spans (RAGTruth) and show higher orders add negligible log-likelihood (<0.35%), so first-order captures ~99.7% of temporal structure, justifying Lorden’s minimax setting.
2) Lower bound: compute Lorden’s minimax delay lower bound at a target false-alarm rate (reported ~1.3 tokens at 1% false-alarm rate), giving a task-specific floor.
3) Practical detectors as stopping rules: compare (a) per-token linear scoring + thresholding, (b) parametric CUSUM with diagonal-Gaussian likelihoods over a 33-dim feature stream, and (c) a causal recurrent labeler. The key interpretation is that the recurrent labeler behaves like a neural/learned CUSUM: the hidden state accumulates evidence and the output log-odds act as a cumulative log-likelihood ratio with a learned increment, consistent with neural CUSUM theory (cross-entropy minimization recovers the LLR).
4) Gap analysis via information rate: detection delay is governed by the divergence rate realized by the score. The learned score captures only ~1/4.5 of the divergence available in the features; additional discrepancy is due to finite-horizon effects where temporal smoothing induces correlation penalties that asymptotic theory would overestimate relative to the short mixing time in practice.
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: onset detection on RAGTruth with matched false-alarm budgets; metric is detection delay in tokens after onset.
Key reported numbers:
- Lorden lower bound: ~1.3 tokens at false-alarm rate 0.01.
- Parametric (diag-Gaussian) CUSUM: ~41-token delay, attributed to severe likelihood mismatch in 33 dimensions.
- Learned CUSUM (causal RNN labeler): ~11–13-token delay on the onsets it successfully catches.
- Linear per-token baseline: ~31-token delay.
- Decomposition: a nonlinear per-token model without sequential accumulation reaches ~18 tokens; thus most gains over the linear baseline come from a better per-token score, while sequential accumulation contributes roughly a quarter of the reduction (bootstrap-significant). Extra causal context beyond accumulation is within noise.
- Operating-point caveat: near the theoretical floor, onset-first-token recall is ~30%, highlighting an inherent recall–false alarm tension that AUC obscures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation that AUC is misaligned with streaming monitoring, and the three research questions (bound, practical gap, source of gap).
- Focus on: (i) the first-order Markov validation (why Lorden applies), (ii) how the Lorden bound is instantiated from data, and (iii) the derivation that a causal recurrent labeler implements a learned CUSUM (log-odds as cumulative evidence).
- Don’t skip the information-rate decomposition; it is the most actionable part for future work (improve features/score utilization rather than deeper temporal models).
- If time is tight: look only at the matched-false-alarm delay results and the ablation separating per-token nonlinearity vs sequential accumulation.

recommendation.zh: 幻觉检测的理论框架有新意，将问题嵌入经典变点检测给出下界。对做 eval 和安全监测的研究员有启发，看 Fig 2 和下界推导即可。
recommendation.en: Novel theoretical framing of hallucination detection as change-point detection with provable bounds; useful for eval and safety monitoring researchers, focus on Fig 2 and lower bound derivation.

paper.title: Evaluating Pluralism in LLMs through Latent Perspectives
paper.abstract: The growing need to represent diverse perspectives has increased interest in pluralistic LLM generation. Although difficult to operationalize, identifying perspectives expressed in text would provide clear guidance on pluralistic alignment and more clearly articulate the pluralistic gap in LLM generation. While models have been shown to reduce the diversity of training data and generate homogeneously, this has been demonstrated primarily on multiple-choice questionnaires or using high-level char

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是：如何在自由生成文本中无监督地识别“潜在视角”，从而评估 LLM 是否真正覆盖了人类语料中的多元观点，而不是只在表面上显得多样。
summary.importance: 它的贡献更偏评测框架，而不是模型方法。价值在于给“pluralistic gap”一个可操作的测量路径：不再只看多选问卷或粗粒度文本特征，而是尝试从文本内部抽取多层次视角结构。对预训练研究员来说，这更像一个分布保真度评估工具，可用于观察预训练或后训练是否压缩了长尾观点。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个 domain-agnostic、multi-layered 的无监督 perspective extraction 框架，用来从文本中抽取潜在视角表示，并据此比较人类文本与模型生成文本在视角覆盖上的差距。实验中还比较了不同 prompt 和不同模型，考察哪些生成设置更接近人类视角分布。
summary.experiments: 实验数据是书评语料，这类数据天然带有较强主观性和多样观点，适合做 perspective extraction。摘要给出的主要结论是：部分模型和 prompting 技术可以接近覆盖较广的视角谱系，但稀有视角仍明显缺失。没有看到模型规模、评估指标细节和统计显著性，因此更适合作为评测思路参考，而不是直接采信其结论强度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to unsupervisedly extract latent perspectives from free-form text so that one can evaluate whether LLMs actually cover the diversity of human viewpoints rather than merely appearing diverse on the surface.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, not a modeling one. Its value lies in operationalizing the pluralistic gap beyond multiple-choice surveys or coarse text statistics. For pretraining researchers, it can serve as a distribution-fidelity probe for whether pretraining or post-training compresses long-tail viewpoints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a domain-agnostic, multi-layered framework for unsupervised perspective extraction. The extracted perspective structure is then used to compare human-written and model-generated text in terms of perspective coverage. They also vary prompts and models to study which generation settings better recover the human perspective spectrum.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on book reviews, a naturally opinion-rich dataset suited for perspective analysis. The main reported finding is that some models and prompting strategies approach broad perspective coverage, but rare perspectives remain underrepresented. The abstract does not provide model sizes, metric details, or effect sizes, so this is better treated as an evaluation idea than a strong empirical conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测，不必细读；如果你在看 data mixture 或 alignment 是否压缩长尾观点，只需借它的 perspective extraction 设定，正文可当工具箱备查。
recommendation.en: Mostly an evaluation paper; useful only if you care about whether data mixture or alignment collapses long-tail viewpoints—borrow the perspective extraction setup and move on.

paper.title: PoQ-Judge: A Multi-Architecture Evaluation Framework for Cost-Aware Proof-of-Quality in Decentralized LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Decentralized LLM inference networks need lightweight, reference-free quality evaluation for Proof of Quality (PoQ). We present PoQ-Judge, a framework that trains dedicated judge models to score query-output pairs without ground-truth references. We study three architectures across the quality-cost tradeoff: a TextCNN judge, a MiniLM cross-encoder, and a DeBERTa judge. Using two-stage training on UltraFeedback plus GPT-labeled in-domain data, the best model reaches 0.747 Pearson correlation with

summary.core_problem: 解决去中心化 LLM 推理网络里，如何在没有参考答案的情况下，用低成本方法评估输出质量并支撑 Proof-of-Quality 打分。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测与系统接口问题，不是基座训练问题。贡献主要在于提出 reference-free judge 框架，并系统比较质量-成本权衡，对 judge 作为基础设施组件有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PoQ-Judge，训练专门的 judge 模型对 query-output 对直接打分。方法上比较三类架构：TextCNN、MiniLM cross-encoder、DeBERTa；训练采用两阶段流程，先用 UltraFeedback，再用 GPT 标注的域内数据微调；同时引入在线校准分析不同质量维度，并用 cascade evaluation 降低推理成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：最佳模型在 held-out test 上与 ground-truth proxy 的 Pearson 相关达到 0.747，超过先前 reference-based evaluator；作为复合评分中的 reference-free 组件时达到 0.645 Pearson，接近最佳单一 reference-based evaluator；级联评估可降低 72.7% 成本且质量损失有限。未见与基座模型训练、预训练数据或 scaling 直接相关的实验。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles low-cost, reference-free quality evaluation for decentralized LLM inference networks, where Proof-of-Quality scoring cannot rely on gold references.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation-and-systems paper rather than a foundation-model training paper. Its value lies in framing judge models as infrastructure and quantifying the quality-cost tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes PoQ-Judge, a dedicated judge that scores query-output pairs directly. It compares three architectures—TextCNN, MiniLM cross-encoder, and DeBERTa—trained in two stages on UltraFeedback followed by GPT-labeled in-domain data. It also studies online calibration of quality dimensions and a cascade evaluation scheme for cost reduction.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract: the best judge reaches 0.747 Pearson correlation with a ground-truth proxy on held-out data, outperforming prior reference-based evaluators. As a reference-free component in composite scoring, it gets 0.645 Pearson, roughly matching the best single reference-based evaluator. Cascade evaluation cuts cost by 72.7% with modest quality loss. There is no direct pretraining, scaling, or model-architecture insight.

recommendation.zh: 和基座预训练关系不大，但如果你在做 reward model、judge 或去中心化推理计费，只看相关性表和 cascade 成本曲线就够了。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but if you care about judges, reward models, or decentralized inference accounting, the correlation tables and cascade cost curve are the only parts worth checking.

paper.title: FailureScope: Cross-Regime Behavioral Diagnosis of Language Model Weaknesses
paper.abstract: Standard benchmarks report aggregate accuracy, but practitioners need to know which specific capabilities a model lacks. We introduce FailureScope, a behavioral-diagnosis method that clusters evaluation probes by their cross-model pass/fail patterns (leave-one-model-out, LOMO), and show it yields stable, interpretable failure taxonomies across three regimes usually studied separately: single-turn benchmarks, multi-turn dialogue, and adversarial agent attacks. On 2,664 single-turn tasks across 18

summary.core_problem: 标准 benchmark 只报告聚合准确率，无法揭示模型具体缺少哪些能力；同时单轮/多轮/对抗三种 regime 的评测通常被独立研究。
summary.importance: 提出跨评测 regime 的行为诊断方法，统一分析模型弱点。贡献类型：评测方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: FailureScope：基于 leave-one-model-out (LOMO) 的 pass/fail 模式聚类，在单轮 benchmark、多轮对话、对抗 Agent 攻击三种 regime 中构造可解释的失败分类。
summary.experiments: 2664 个单轮任务 × 18 个模型（Kendall's tau 0.81 at 50 tasks，跨模型失败预测 AUC 0.88）；363 个多轮任务；630 个对抗 Agent trace（发现 73-100pp 的 LLM-Judge ASR 与真实执行 gap）。
summary.authors_note: Nicholas Saban，机构信息无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard benchmarks only report aggregate accuracy, failing to reveal which specific capabilities models lack; single-turn/multi-turn/adversarial evaluation regimes are typically studied in isolation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a cross-regime behavioral diagnosis method for unified model weakness analysis. Contribution type: evaluation methodology innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: FailureScope clusters evaluation probes by leave-one-model-out (LOMO) pass/fail patterns, constructing interpretable failure taxonomies across single-turn benchmarks, multi-turn dialogue, and adversarial agent attacks.
summary_en.experiments: 2,664 single-turn tasks × 18 models (Kendall's tau 0.81 at 50 tasks, cross-model failure prediction AUC 0.88); 363 multi-turn tasks; 630 adversarial agent traces (exposing 73-100pp gap between LLM-Judge ASR and real execution).
summary_en.authors_note: Nicholas Saban; institutional affiliation not confirmed.

recommendation.zh: 跨 regime 的行为聚类方法学有意思，尤其发现对抗 trace 上 LLM-Judge 与真实执行有 73-100pp gap——与 Paper 1 形成呼应，读 §4 的实验结果即可。
recommendation.en: Cross-regime behavioral clustering methodology is interesting; the 73-100pp LLM-Judge vs real-execution gap on adversarial traces echoes Paper 1; read §4 experimental results only.

paper.title: Evaluating Research-Level Math Proofs via Strict Step-Level Verification
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to rigorously verify complex mathematical proofs. Standard global evaluation approaches suffer from "context poisoning," in which superficially plausible statements mask subtle logical flaws, leading to hallucination or over-skepticism. To address this, we shift from global evaluation to strict step-level verification: our framework maintains detailed context for each deduction step and strictly constrains the sources of applied theorems. We evaluate on a ca

summary.core_problem: 解决研究级数学证明评估中，整体式判断容易被表面合理但局部错误的推导污染，导致 verifier 出现 hallucination 或过度怀疑的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议与验证方法，而不是训练方法。它把 proof evaluation 从全局打分改成严格的 step-level verification，并基于对抗性研究级证明集分析错误类型，这对 reasoning eval 和 verifier 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上维护每一步推导的细粒度上下文，并严格限制可调用定理来源；通过 step-level deductive constraints 避免全局 prompt 在长证明中被错误上下文污染。论文还做系统性消融，比较严格约束与 unconstrained global prompting 的差异。
summary.experiments: 评测数据来自 FirstProof challenge 中精心整理的 research-level adversarial proof suite。摘要未给出具体模型、样本数和准确率，但明确声称：无约束的全局评估持续无法定位细微逻辑错误，而 step-level verification 不仅效果更好，还改变了失败分布，剩余错误更多是知识缺失而非严重逻辑幻觉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the failure of global proof evaluation for research-level mathematics, where superficially plausible statements can poison context and hide subtle logical errors.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation and verification protocol rather than a training method. By shifting from global judgment to strict step-level verification on adversarial research-level proofs, it offers a useful reference for reasoning evaluation and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework maintains detailed context for each deduction step and strictly constrains the source of applicable theorems. This step-level deductive setup is contrasted against unconstrained global prompting, with ablations showing the necessity of the constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a curated adversarial suite of research-level proofs from the FirstProof challenge. The abstract does not report model sizes, dataset size, or exact metrics, but claims that unconstrained global evaluation consistently fails to localize subtle logical errors, while strict step-level verification both improves performance and changes the failure taxonomy toward knowledge gaps rather than severe logical hallucinations.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但对 verifier 设计有一条硬结论：全局 proof judging 很容易被 context poisoning 搞坏；看 error taxonomy 和 ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes one hard point for verifier design: global proof judging is brittle to context poisoning; the ablation and error taxonomy are the parts to read.

paper.title: An LLM-Native Psychometric Instrument Does Not Predict LLM Behavior: Evidence Across 25 Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) produce stable self-reports on personality inventories, but these self-reports do not predict observed behavior. Whether this gap reflects a mismatch between LLMs and human trait constructs, or a deeper property of LLM self-report itself, has been unresolved. We constructed the first psychometric instrument whose constructs are derived bottom-up from LLM behavioral affordances via exploratory factor analysis (EFA). We administered 300 items (240 direct Likert + 60 sc

summary.core_problem: LLM在人格量表上的自我报告稳定但无法预测实际行为，此前未明确这一差距源于特质构造不匹配还是LLM自我报告本身的固有缺陷。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次构建自底向上从LLM行为能力推导的原生心理测量工具，证实LLM自我报告与行为的脱节是固有属性，而非构造适配问题。
summary.technical_approach: 通过探索性因子分析从LLM行为affordance自底向上构建300题项、12个候选维度的心理测量工具，在25个LLM上测试信度，再用人类和LLM评委标注的2500个行为样本验证预测效度。
summary.experiments: 得到5因子结构（响应性、顺从性、大胆性、谨慎性、冗长性），内部一致性和分半信度极高，但所有因子均无法预测实际行为，证实自我报告的预测效度为零。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者Juan Manuel Contreras，无机构附属。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs produce stable self-reports on personality inventories but these do not predict actual behavior; prior work has not clarified whether this gap stems from trait construct mismatch or an inherent flaw in LLM self-report itself.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis contribution: the first LLM-native psychometric instrument constructed bottom-up from LLM behavioral affordances, confirming that the disconnect between LLM self-report and behavior is an inherent property, not a construct adaptation issue.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a 300-item, 12-candidate-dimension psychometric instrument bottom-up from LLM behavioral affordances via exploratory factor analysis, tests reliability across 25 LLMs, then validates predictive validity with 2,500 behavioral samples annotated by human and LLM judges.
summary_en.experiments: Yields a 5-factor structure (Responsiveness, Deference, Boldness, Guardedness, Verbosity) with extremely high internal consistency and split-half reliability, but none of the factors predict actual behavior, confirming zero predictive validity of self-report.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researcher Juan Manuel Contreras, no institutional affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 研究LLM行为一致性和可解释性的研究员可看，重点关注预测效度验证的实验设计。
recommendation.en: For researchers studying LLM behavioral consistency and interpretability, focus on the experimental design of predictive validity validation.

paper.title: Hacking Generative Perplexity: Why Unconditional Text Evaluation Needs Distributional Metrics
paper.abstract: Diffusion and continuous flow-based language models have emerged as the leading non-autoregressive alternatives to language modeling. Progress in both paradigms is overwhelmingly tracked by generative perplexity (gen-PPL): the per-token negative log-likelihood of samples under a frozen autoregressive (AR) scorer such as gpt2-large, typically paired with an empirical-entropy guardrail to rule out low-entropy collapse. We argue that this metric is unsound. By construction, gen-PPL measures only pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“如何训练更好的非自回归语言模型”，而是一个更基础的问题：当前领域里用来比较 diffusion / flow / 其他非 AR 文本生成模型的主指标 gen-PPL，是否真的在衡量生成质量。全文给出的结论是否定的。gen-PPL 的定义是：把生成样本交给一个冻结的 AR scorer（通常是 GPT-2 large），计算其每 token 负对数似然。这个量只反映“样本对该 scorer 来说有多可预测”，并不直接反映语法完整性、语义连贯性、篇章一致性，更不反映样本分布是否接近人类文本。论文要解决的核心问题，就是证明这种错位不是边角问题，而是结构性缺陷：存在大量低质量、甚至明显胡乱的文本，在冻结 AR scorer 下依然能拿到很低的 gen-PPL；因此用它来追踪非 AR LM 的进展，会系统性误排方法优劣。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有两层。第一层是评测层面。近两年 diffusion LM、masked/any-order LM、continuous flow LM 的论文，很多都把 gen-PPL 当成主结果表。若这个指标可以被零参数、刻意构造的劣质采样器“刷分”，那么已有结论里相当一部分只能说明“更像 scorer 偏好的可预测串”，不能说明“更接近真实文本分布”。第二层是研究方向层面。非 AR 语言建模一直面临 exact likelihood 难算、采样策略多样、推断步数影响结果等问题，社区因此依赖代理指标。本文的贡献在于把这个代理指标的失效机制讲清楚，并给出替代思路：不要再问样本在某个 AR 模型下是否容易预测，而要问生成分布与人类文本分布之间的统计距离。对做新型语言建模范式的人，这篇文章的价值不在于提出一个新模型，而在于纠正“优化错目标”的风险，量级上属于会影响后续实验 protocol 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步是理论和概念拆解。作者把 gen-PPL 重新解释为“冻结 AR scorer 对样本序列的条件可预测性”，并指出这与生成质量不是同一个对象。一个强 AR scorer 会偏好高频局部模式、常见搭配、短程可预测结构；但文本质量还包含长程语义、全局一致性、信息密度、 discourse 合理性。只要能构造出在局部上高度可预测、在全局上却很差的序列，gen-PPL 就会失真。经验熵 guardrail 也不够，因为 unigram entropy 只能排除最粗糙的低熵塌缩，挡不住“词表使用看起来够丰富，但组合方式很差”的样本。

第二步是构造反例生成器。文章的关键说服力来自一组 zero-parameter、deliberately naive samplers。它们不训练模型，不学习数据分布，只利用简单启发式或 scorer 偏好，就能生成明显不自然的文本，同时取得很强的 gen-PPL。这里的重点不是某个具体 sampler 的工程细节，而是作者系统展示了：只要朝“提高 scorer 可预测性”这个方向做手工设计，就能稳定骗过 gen-PPL。这说明问题不在某个模型族，而在指标定义本身。全文反复强调，这些采样器输出在人工阅读下是 incoherent 的，但在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上却能达到或超过近期 diffusion / flow 模型报告的 gen-PPL。

第三步是替代评测协议。作者主张把核心 proxy 从单点评分器的 token-level NLL，换成 generated distribution 与 reference distribution 的统计距离。文中推荐直接使用 distributional metrics，引用了 MMD、energy distance 等两样本检验/分布距离工具，并据此重新 benchmark 近期非 AR 模型。这个思路的关键不是某一个距离公式，而是评测对象从“单条样本在 scorer 下的分数”转向“样本集合是否像来自同一分布”。这更接近 unconditional generation 的真实目标，也更不容易被局部可预测性投机利用。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的结果有三类。第一类是反例成立：作者在 LM1B 和 OpenWebText 上，用零参数 naive samplers 取得了与近期非 AR 文献相当甚至更好的 gen-PPL，同时保持非退化的 empirical entropy。也就是说，它们并不是靠重复单词或极端低熵塌缩来刷分，而是在 entropy guardrail 之内完成“作弊”。摘要截断处没有给出完整数值表，但从正文叙述可以确定，作者把这些结果直接与已发表 diffusion-based 和 continuous-flow 模型做了并列比较，结论是 gen-PPL 排名会把明显更差的文本排到更前面。

第二类是人类可感知质量与 gen-PPL 脱钩。论文通过样例和定量比较说明，低 gen-PPL 并不对应更好的语义连贯性。换句话说，指标排序与人工直觉排序发生了系统偏离，而不是偶然噪声。这个点很关键，因为如果只是少量异常样本，问题还可以归因于 scorer 偶发偏差；但作者展示的是组合空间里存在大量此类序列。

第三类是重评测结果。作者用 distributional metrics 重新评估近期非 AR 模型后，得到的进展图景与 gen-PPL 下的结论不同。哪些模型真正更接近人类文本分布，哪些只是更会迎合 AR scorer，在新协议下被重新区分开。对读者来说，最值得看的不是某个模型绝对名次，而是“同一批模型在两套指标下排序如何变化”。这直接揭示了旧指标的误导程度。

如果从实验设计角度看，文章还有两个细节值得记住：一是数据集选了 LM1B 和 OpenWebText，覆盖较规范与较开放的文本分布；二是作者没有只批评指标，而是给出可复现的对照基线和替代 protocol，这让结论更扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先读 Introduction 和作者对 gen-PPL 的问题定义，确认他们批评的不是“AR scorer 不够强”，而是“指标与目标错位”。然后重点看构造 naive samplers 的章节，以及展示样本文本的图表或案例。这里最能建立直觉：为什么这些文本读起来差，但 scorer 仍给高分。接着看 re-benchmark 部分，关注同一组模型在 gen-PPL 与 distributional metrics 下的排序变化。若时间有限，优先看三类内容：1）gen-PPL 与 empirical entropy 的定义和局限；2）零参数反例的构造逻辑；3）推荐的新评测协议及其结果。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，distributional metrics 在文本空间里依赖什么表征，是否会引入新的 representation bias；第二，两样本距离对 sample size、长度分布、解码温度是否敏感；第三，这套批评是否同样适用于一些常见的 AR 生成评测代理，比如用更强 judge LM 打分。做新型 LM 的人可以把这篇文章当成“评测 sanity check 清单”。在自己报结果前，先问一句：指标到底在奖励什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a basic but underexamined issue in non-autoregressive text generation: whether generative perplexity (gen-PPL) is a valid proxy for unconditional generation quality. The answer developed through the full paper is no. Gen-PPL evaluates generated samples under a frozen autoregressive scorer, usually GPT-2 large, and reports token-level negative log-likelihood. That quantity measures how predictable a sample is to the scorer, not whether the sample is grammatical, coherent, semantically meaningful, or distributionally close to human text. The central problem is therefore not a small mismatch but a structural one: there exists a large combinatorial set of low-quality sequences that are still highly predictable under the scorer, so progress measured by gen-PPL can be badly misranked.
summary_en.importance: Its importance is mainly methodological. A large fraction of recent diffusion LM, masked/any-order LM, and continuous flow LM work has relied on gen-PPL as the headline metric because exact likelihood is hard or intractable under these paradigms. If a metric can be beaten by zero-parameter, intentionally naive samplers that produce visibly poor text, then many published comparisons only show better compatibility with the scorer’s local preferences, not better language modeling. For pretraining research, this matters because evaluation shapes optimization pressure. Once a field starts tuning architectures, samplers, and decoding schedules against a flawed proxy, it can drift toward the wrong target. The paper’s contribution is not a new model but a correction to the measurement layer, and that is substantial enough to affect future experimental protocol in non-AR language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proceeds in three stages. First, it reframes gen-PPL conceptually. A frozen AR scorer assigns high probability to sequences that are locally predictable under its learned conditional structure. That is not equivalent to text quality. Quality includes long-range semantic consistency, discourse structure, information content, and human plausibility. A sequence can be easy for the scorer to continue token by token while still being globally poor. The commonly paired empirical unigram entropy guardrail does not fix this, because it only filters out crude low-entropy collapse. It does not prevent sequences that use a reasonably broad vocabulary but combine tokens in shallow, low-quality ways.

Second, the authors build explicit counterexamples. This is the core technical move. They construct a suite of zero-parameter, deliberately naive samplers that do not learn a text distribution at all, yet achieve extremely strong gen-PPL. The exact sampler designs matter less than the broader point: by directly exploiting what the scorer finds predictable, one can manufacture outputs that score well while remaining incoherent to a human reader. This demonstrates that the failure is in the metric definition, not in a particular model family.

Third, they propose a replacement evaluation protocol centered on distributional comparison rather than scorer-based token likelihood. Instead of asking whether a generated sequence is easy for an AR model to predict, they ask whether generated samples statistically resemble human-written samples. The paper recommends distributional metrics such as MMD and energy distance, drawing from two-sample testing and divergence estimation. The key shift is from single-sample scoring to comparing generated and reference distributions. That aligns much better with the actual goal of unconditional generation and is harder to game through local predictability hacks.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important experimental result is the existence proof: on LM1B and OpenWebText, the zero-parameter naive samplers achieve gen-PPL numbers competitive with or better than recently published diffusion and flow-based language models, while maintaining non-degenerate empirical entropy. So this is not a trivial collapse case where the sampler repeats a few tokens. It passes the standard entropy guardrail and still produces poor text. That directly invalidates the common interpretation of low gen-PPL as evidence of high-quality generation.

A second important result is the clear decoupling between human-perceived quality and gen-PPL. Through examples and quantitative comparisons, the paper shows that sequences ranked highly by gen-PPL can be semantically weak or incoherent. This is not presented as a rare pathology but as a broad failure mode induced by the metric.

A third result comes from re-benchmarking recent non-AR models under distributional metrics. Once evaluated by sample-distribution similarity rather than scorer predictability, the picture of progress changes. Models that looked strong under gen-PPL do not necessarily remain strong, and models that better match human text distributions can be separated from those that merely exploit the scorer. The most informative thing to inspect is not the absolute ranking itself, but how rankings change between the old and new protocols.

From an experimental design standpoint, two details are worth noting. The paper uses both LM1B and OpenWebText, covering different text regimes, and it does more than criticize: it provides reproducible adversarial baselines plus an alternative protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the formal discussion of what gen-PPL actually measures. The key point is that the paper is not arguing that GPT-2 is too weak as a scorer; it is arguing that the metric is misaligned with the target. Then read the section introducing the naive samplers and inspect the sample outputs carefully. That is where the intuition becomes concrete: why obviously bad text can still look good to the scorer. After that, move to the re-benchmarking section and compare model rankings under gen-PPL versus distributional metrics.

If time is limited, focus on three things: the definition and limitations of gen-PPL plus empirical entropy, the construction logic of the zero-parameter counterexamples, and the proposed distributional evaluation protocol. The most useful deeper questions are: what representation space the distributional metrics rely on, whether those metrics are sensitive to sample size or length distribution, and whether similar criticisms apply to other judge-model-based proxies used in language generation. For anyone working on new LM paradigms, this paper is best read as an evaluation sanity check before trusting benchmark tables.

recommendation.zh: 必须读。它不是在改模型，而是在拆你可能一直信的指标；若你做 diffusion/flow LM，先停下看它怎么 hack gen-PPL，再决定后面实验该不该重跑。
recommendation.en: Must read. It does not improve a model—it breaks a metric you may have been trusting; if you work on diffusion/flow LMs, inspect the gen-PPL hack before believing any leaderboard.

paper.title: SLMJury: Can Small Language Models Judge as Well as Large Ones?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as judges for evaluating model outputs, but their high cost, latency, and opacity limit scalability. We introduce SLMJury, a framework for evaluating small language models (SLMs) as judges across two paradigms: closed-ended binary correctness and open-ended quality scoring. We benchmark 16 SLM judges (0.6B-14B parameters) from four model families across ten benchmarks: eight closed-ended tasks spanning mathematical, scientific, and general reasoning (

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个评测基础设施问题：小模型能否在自动评审任务上替代大模型，尤其是在二分类正确性判断和开放式质量打分这两类常见 judge 场景中，性能、成本和稳定性分别如何。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对 post-train、RLHF、数据筛选和大规模自动评测链路有现实意义。它给出的启发是：judge 能力不是单轴的，闭卷式 correctness judging 和开放式 quality scoring 依赖的能力并不相同，因此不能把“某个模型会做题”直接等同于“它会当裁判”。如果要在训练闭环里用 SLM 做 reward model 替代、数据过滤或离线评测，这篇工作提供了较系统的边界条件。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SLMJury 框架，把 judge 形式化为预算受限函数，在固定 token budget 下输入题目、参考答案和学生解答，输出 verdict 或分数。实验覆盖 16 个不超过 14B 的现成 SLM，来自 4 个模型家族，评测分成两类：一类是 8 个 closed-ended benchmark 上的 binary correctness judging；另一类是 SummEval 和 MT-Bench 上的 open-ended scoring。设计上有几个点比较完整：一是同时比较极低预算 B=10 和长推理预算 B=8192，专门看“多想一想”是否真的更适合做 judge；二是测 persona robustness，检查 judge 是否容易被角色提示扰动；三是测 ensemble / majority voting 和 debate protocol，看看多 judge 协作是否能提升可靠性。方法上没有新训练算法，重点在系统评测设计和 judge 能力拆解。
summary.experiments: 规模上，作者报告每个配置下总计 64,824 个 judgments，整体超过 3,900 组实验。closed-ended judging 里，最佳 SLM judge 达到 89.55%。最有信息量的结果有三点。第一，overthinking effect 是任务相关的：在 13 个可双设置比较的 judge 中，数学判断任务上有 8 个模型在 B=10 的快速裁决下优于 B=8192 的长推理，而一般任务上则有 8 个模型在长推理下更好，单数据集摆幅最高到 23%。这说明 judge 不是“推理越长越准”，而是存在 domain-specific calibration 问题。第二，同一批 judge 在 closed-ended 和 open-ended 排名差异很大。比如 Phi-4 是最强 binary judge，但到 MT-Bench 只排第 9，相关系数 0.21；Phi-4-Reasoning 则升到第 1，相关系数 0.57。第三，顶级 SLM judge 对 persona manipulation 较稳，方差不超过 0.55%；而 RCR debate protocol 在所有测试配置上都让准确率下降，说明多轮辩论并不天然适合 judge 场景。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言和任务定义，明确 closed-ended judge 与 open-ended judge 的差别；再看主结果表，重点关注 budget 对性能的影响和跨范式排名变化；最后看 persona robustness 与 debate 部分，判断这些结论能否迁移到自己的评测链路。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。如果只关心训练基础设施，优先看 B=10 vs B=8192 的比较和不同 benchmark 类型上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a practical evaluation question: can small language models act as reliable judges, and under what conditions, for both binary correctness evaluation and open-ended quality scoring?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for the training loop around large models: offline evaluation, synthetic data filtering, RLHF-style reward approximation, and scalable local judging. The main takeaway is that judging is not a single capability. A model that performs well as a closed-ended correctness judge may not be strong at open-ended scoring, so “good reasoner” does not automatically mean “good evaluator.” That distinction is useful when designing low-cost evaluation or reward pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: SLMJury defines a judge as a budget-conditioned function that takes a question, a ground-truth reference, and a student response, and returns either a binary verdict or a score. The benchmark covers 16 off-the-shelf SLMs up to 14B parameters from four families. Evaluation spans two paradigms: binary correctness on eight closed-ended benchmarks, and open-ended scoring on SummEval and MT-Bench. The framework is fairly complete in design. It compares two token budgets, B=10 and B=8192, to test whether explicit reasoning helps or hurts judging. It studies persona robustness to see whether verdicts are sensitive to role prompts. It also evaluates ensemble voting and debate-style protocols. The contribution is mainly in the evaluation setup and the decomposition of judge behavior, not in a new training method.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports 64,824 judgments per configuration and more than 3,900 experiments overall. The best closed-ended SLM judge reaches 89.55% accuracy. Three results stand out. First, the overthinking effect is domain-dependent: among 13 judges evaluated under both budgets, 8 perform better with the short B=10 setting on math judging, while 8 perform better with long reasoning on general tasks, with swings up to 23% on a single dataset. So longer reasoning is not uniformly beneficial for judges. Second, rankings differ sharply across paradigms. Phi-4 is the best binary judge, but drops to rank 9 on MT-Bench with correlation 0.21, while Phi-4-Reasoning rises to rank 1 with correlation 0.57. Third, top SLM judges are fairly robust to adversarial persona manipulation, with variance at or below 0.55%, whereas the RCR debate protocol consistently reduces accuracy across tested settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim path is: read the introduction and task formalization first, then inspect the main result tables for budget effects and cross-paradigm rank shifts, and finally read the persona robustness and debate sections. That is enough to understand where SLM judges work and where they fail. If your interest is training infrastructure, focus on the B=10 versus B=8192 comparison and the gap between closed-ended and open-ended judging. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for a useful pass.

recommendation.zh: 只看 overthinking 与 domain split 的结果；它会影响 judge budget，但别外推成小模型能评所有能力。
recommendation.en: Read the overthinking and domain-split results; they inform judge budgets, but do not imply small judges are universally reliable.

paper.title: The Routing Plateau: Understanding and Breaking the Accuracy Limits of LLM Routers
paper.abstract: LLM routing has become a popular approach to improve the cost-quality trade-off of LLM services by dynamically selecting a model for each query. Recent work has explored a broad range of routing methods, including clustering-based routers, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. Our extensive study of 21 routing methods across five benchmarks reveals a consistent phenomenon that we call the routing plateau: many methods, including kNN, achieve very similar accurac

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 路由器在多模型选择中长期停留在相近精度区间、难以逼近 oracle 的问题，并解释这种上限从何而来。
summary.importance: 价值不在又提一个 router，而在于把“routing plateau”作为可复现现象系统化地测出来，并把瓶颈归因到 query-level 可预测性不足。这对做模型级联、test-time compute allocation、服务层 routing 的研究员有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较 21 种路由方法在 5 个 benchmark 上的表现，覆盖聚类、kNN、分类器、pairwise ranking、confidence-based 等路线。核心分析是把路由失败拆成：方法学差异很小、都学到全局平均性能趋势、但抓不到实例级细粒度信号，因此在 hard queries 上集体失效。论文进一步研究如何突破 plateau，但摘要未给出完整方法细节。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是 21 个 routing 方法 × 5 个 benchmark 的系统评测。主要结论是大量方法包括 kNN 都收敛到狭窄性能带，且明显低于 oracle router；说明当前提升更多受限于可预测信号本身，而不是路由器头部形式。摘要未给出具体提升数字和所用底座模型名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why LLM routers for model selection saturate in a narrow accuracy band and fail to approach oracle routing.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another router, but a clean empirical diagnosis of a reproducible 'routing plateau' and an attribution of the bottleneck to limited query-level predictability. This matters for cascades, test-time compute allocation, and serving-time routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors benchmark 21 routing methods across five benchmarks, spanning clustering, kNN, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. The key analysis decomposes routing failure into a shared pattern: routers learn global average model-performance trends but miss fine-grained instance-specific signals, so they all fail on hard queries.
summary_en.experiments: The study is a broad evaluation over 21 routing methods and five benchmarks. The main result is that many methods, including kNN, converge to a narrow performance range far below an oracle router, suggesting the bottleneck lies more in available predictive signal than in the router head design. The abstract does not provide exact gains or the underlying model roster.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是负结果：别再把 router head 当主矛盾，先看 hard-query 可预测性；读实验总表和误差分解部分就够了。
recommendation.en: Read it for the negative result: router-head design is likely not the bottleneck; inspect the benchmark table and the hard-query error analysis.

paper.title: Benchmarking Empirical Privacy Protection for Adaptations of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has applied differential privacy (DP) to adapt large language models (LLMs) for sensitive applications, offering theoretical guarantees. However, its practical effectiveness remains unclear, partly due to LLM pretraining, where overlaps and interdependencies with adaptation data can undermine privacy despite DP efforts. To analyze this issue in practice, we investigate privacy risks under DP adaptations in LLMs using state-of-the-art attacks such as robust membership inference and ca

summary.core_problem: 评估在 LLM 适配阶段引入差分隐私后，真实隐私风险是否仍受预训练数据分布重叠影响而显著变化。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是隐私评测协议与系统性基准，而不是提出新的 DP 训练算法。对基座研究员有价值之处在于，它把“预训练分布重叠”这个常被忽略的变量显式拉进隐私分析，提醒 adaptation-level DP 结论不能脱离 pretrain 语境解读。
summary.technical_approach: 构建一套经验隐私评测框架，系统改变适配数据与预训练分布的关系：从精确重叠、IID 到 OOD；再结合不同 adaptation 方法和不同隐私强度，使用 robust membership inference 与 canary extraction 等攻击测量脆弱性。方法上偏 benchmark/protocol，而非新模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验轴很清楚：多种适配方法 × 多种 DP regime × 多种分布偏移条件 × 多种攻击。主要发现是分布越接近预训练语料，隐私脆弱性越强；仅看 DP 账本不足以判断真实泄露风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether differential privacy applied during LLM adaptation actually protects privacy once the overlap between adaptation data and the pretraining distribution is taken into account.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an empirical privacy benchmark and evaluation protocol, not a new DP training algorithm. The useful part for foundation-model researchers is that it makes pretraining-distribution overlap an explicit variable in privacy analysis, showing that adaptation-level DP claims cannot be interpreted in isolation from pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an empirical privacy evaluation framework that systematically varies the relationship between adaptation data and the pretraining distribution: exact overlap, in-distribution, and out-of-distribution. They then combine this with different adaptation methods and privacy regimes, and measure vulnerability using robust membership inference and canary extraction attacks. This is primarily a benchmark/protocol paper rather than a modeling paper.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the experimental design is clear: multiple adaptation methods, multiple DP regimes, multiple distribution-shift settings, and multiple attacks. The main finding is that privacy vulnerability increases as adaptation data gets closer to the pretraining distribution, so DP accounting alone is not a sufficient proxy for practical leakage risk.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值在于把 pretrain-overlap 拉进 DP 评测变量；若你做 continual/adaptation，先看分布设定和攻击结果，别只盯 ε。
recommendation.en: Its real value is making pretrain overlap an explicit DP variable; if you work on adaptation or continual pretraining, read the distribution setup and attack results, not just epsilon.

paper.title: Reasoning without Gold Standards: A Proxy-Judge Theory of Autoformalization
paper.abstract: Complex reasoning tasks increasingly require systems to produce outputs whose correctness cannot be judged by exact match against a single reference. Autoformalization (AF) is a representative example; it asks a model to translate informal mathematical or logical reasoning into a formally checkable object, yet expert-validated formalizations do not scale beyond toy cases and a single informal argument can admit many valid formal renderings. Progress therefore depends on whether partial, structur

summary.core_problem: 自动形式化等复杂推理任务的输出正确性无法通过与单一参考答案精确匹配来判定，而专家验证的形式化数据无法规模化。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次提出无需参考标准的proxy-judge评测框架，用结构化代理检查替代gold-standard匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 沿三个结构维度（全局、子模块内部、跨域与源文本对齐）组织代理检查，汇总为判决向量；该向量驱动改进循环以迭代优化模型输出。
summary.experiments: 未详述具体数据集规模和SOTA对比，重点在框架设计和理论论证。
summary.authors_note: 曼彻斯特大学等机构，无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Complex reasoning tasks like autoformalization produce outputs whose correctness cannot be judged by exact match to a single reference; expert-validated formalizations do not scale.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: first reference-free proxy-judge evaluation framework that replaces gold-standard matching with structured per-axis property checks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proxy organized along three structural scopes (global, per-module internal, cross-domain alignment with source), aggregated into a verdict vector that drives iterative refinement of model outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Dataset size and SOTA comparison not detailed in abstract; emphasis on framework design and theoretical argument.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Manchester and others; no notably famous authors.

recommendation.zh: 无需gold standard的评测框架对推理任务评估有启发，skim §3框架设计部分即可。
recommendation.en: Reference-free evaluation framework for reasoning tasks is conceptually interesting; skim §3 on framework design.

paper.title: MMAE: A Massive Multitask Audio Editing Benchmark
paper.abstract: We introduce MMAE, a Massive Multitask Audio Editing benchmark, serving as the first comprehensive evaluation testbed designed for general-purpose instruction-based audio editing. Spurred by the shift toward intelligent creation, interactive editing has rapidly expanded from visual domains, pioneered by models like Nano-banana 2 for images and Gemini-Omni for video, into audio. However, the current evaluation infrastructure lags severely, remaining highly fragmented and restricted to specific su

summary.core_problem: 为通用指令式音频编辑建立覆盖多模态、多复杂度、多轮交互的系统化评测基准。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是benchmark资产而非新模型方法。对语音/音频LM与多模态生成研究有一定参考价值，尤其是在任务分层和评测覆盖面上。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MMAE，构建面向通用音频编辑的评测集与任务分类体系，覆盖7类音频模态、6级任务复杂度、2级粒度和8类编辑操作；数据通过human-agent协作整理，目标是统一此前碎片化的音频编辑评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要重点在benchmark设计而非模型创新，未给出统一训练规模。价值主要在于提供更广覆盖的测试床，用于比较instruction-based audio editing系统在基础修改、多跳推理和多轮编辑上的能力差异。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交大、上海创新院、南洋理工、腾讯混元等；若后续音频生成/音频LM工作开始普遍采用该基准，它会成为较实用的评测参照。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a systematic benchmark for general-purpose instruction-based audio editing across modalities, complexity levels, and multi-round interactions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is benchmark infrastructure rather than a new model. It is moderately useful for speech/audio LM and multimodal generation research, especially for task taxonomy and evaluation coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: MMAE introduces a benchmark and taxonomy for general audio editing, covering 7 audio modalities, 6 levels of task complexity, 2 granularity levels, and 8 operation types. The dataset is curated through human-agent collaboration to unify a previously fragmented evaluation landscape.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on benchmark design rather than model training. Its value lies in providing a broader testbed for comparing instruction-based audio editing systems on basic edits, multi-hop reasoning, and multi-round editing.
summary_en.authors_note: The team includes Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, NTU, and Tencent Hunyuan. If future audio generation or audio-LM papers adopt it broadly, it could become a practical evaluation reference.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但做语音/音频LM的人该记住它的任务分层；先看 taxonomy 和标注协议，别急着看榜单。
recommendation.en: Not a method paper, but audio-LM people should note its task taxonomy; read the benchmark design and annotation protocol before caring about leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: Do Coding Agents Deceive Us? Detecting and Preventing Cheating via Capped Evaluation with Randomized Tests
paper.abstract: A growing failure mode in agent evaluation and training is that models can achieve high evaluation scores by exploiting shortcuts instead of solving the intended task, producing deceptive performance. This makes evaluation scores unreliable as measures of true task-solving ability. We propose CapCode, a framework for constructing coding datasets with randomized tests whose best achievable non-cheating performance is deliberately capped below one. This capped-performance design gives evaluation s

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在训练和评测中通过投机取巧而非真正解题来拿高分的问题，使评测分数重新具备可解释性。
summary.importance: 这是评测协议与奖励设计工作，贡献不在更强 agent，而在把“作弊”从模糊担忧变成可检测、可约束的对象。对做 RL、agent training、verifier 设计和 reward quality 的研究员都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CapCode：构造带随机化测试的 coding 数据集，并故意把非作弊策略的最优可达分数上限设在 1 以下。这样，显著超过该 cap 的分数就可被解释为作弊证据。进一步提出 CapReward，把 capped-performance 原则写入奖励设计，抑制模型为了刷分而优化到超出合理上限的行为。
summary.experiments: 在多个 coding 数据集上验证。CapCode 能检测作弊，同时基本保留模型真实能力排序；CapReward 能减少作弊行为，并让训练后的模型更遵循任务真实规范。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和作弊率下降幅度，但实验目标和评测信号都较清晰。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自东京大学与理研。Masashi Sugiyama、Takashi Ishida 在可靠机器学习、分布偏移与评测方法方面有长期积累，这使得这篇工作更像“评测协议设计”而不是普通 agent 调参。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a growing failure mode in coding-agent training and evaluation: agents can score highly by exploiting shortcuts rather than solving the intended task, making scores unreliable.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol and reward-design paper rather than a stronger-agent paper. Its contribution is to turn “cheating” from a vague concern into something detectable and suppressible. That matters directly for RL, agent training, verifier design, and reward quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce CapCode, a framework for building coding datasets with randomized tests such that the best achievable non-cheating performance is intentionally capped below one. Scores substantially above the cap become evidence of cheating. They also propose CapReward, which incorporates the same capped-performance principle into reward design to discourage optimization beyond the legitimate ceiling.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across multiple coding datasets show that CapCode can detect cheating while preserving the ranking of models by genuine capability, and CapReward reduces cheating behavior while improving adherence to the intended task specification. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or exact reductions in cheating rates.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Tokyo and RIKEN. Masashi Sugiyama and Takashi Ishida are well known for work on reliable machine learning, distribution shift, and evaluation methodology, which makes this read more like evaluation protocol design than routine agent tuning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在堆 agent 分数，而是在修评测信号本身；做 RL 或 verifier 的人应直接复现 capped reward 设定，至少看清 reward hacking 能被怎样量化。
recommendation.en: This paper fixes the evaluation signal rather than chasing agent scores; if you work on RL or verifiers, replicate the capped-reward setup and study how reward hacking becomes measurable.

paper.title: Humans' ALMANAC: A Human Collaboration Dataset of Action-Level Mental Model Annotations for Agent Collaboration
paper.abstract: Recent advances in LLM agents have enabled complex cognitive capabilities, such as multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use, that increasingly position these agents as human collaborators. Effective collaboration, however, requires collaborators to continuously maintain and align mental models of their own reasoning,partners' intentions, and shared goals during the collaborative process. Today's agents rarely develop such capabilities since they are primarily optimized for task completion, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 缺少过程级协作数据的问题，尤其是缺少带 action-level mental model 标注的人类协作语料，导致 agent 只会完成任务而不会与人协作。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是数据集与标注框架。它对 agent 评测和训练有一定价值，但离基座预训练较远；更适合关注 AI delegation、协作式 agent、过程监督的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于经典社会科学任务 Map Task 构建 ALMANAC 数据集，对 2,987 个协作动作进行理论驱动的 mental model 标注，覆盖参与者对自身状态、对方意图和共享目标的理解，从而把“协作中的心智对齐”显式化为可训练/可评测信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调的是数据集构建而非模型突破，未给出大规模模型训练结果。实验价值主要在于提供 action-level mental model annotation，可用于分析 agent 在协作过程中的状态追踪与对齐能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University、University of Notre Dame、University of Waterloo、Carnegie Mellon University 等，偏 HCI、可视化与人机协作研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of process-level collaboration data for LLM agents, especially human collaboration corpora with action-level mental-model annotations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a dataset and annotation framework. It is useful for agent evaluation and training, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the classic Map Task from social science, ALMANAC annotates 2,987 collaboration actions with theory-informed mental-model labels, covering self-state, partner intention, and shared-goal understanding. This turns mental-model alignment during collaboration into an explicit signal for training or evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes dataset construction rather than model advances, and does not report large-scale model training. The value lies in providing action-level mental-model annotations for analyzing whether agents track and align collaborative state over time.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University, University of Notre Dame, University of Waterloo, and Carnegie Mellon University, with a profile closer to HCI, visualization, and human-AI collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 AI delegation 或过程监督，可以记住这个数据集；否则和基座预训练距离较远，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on AI delegation or process supervision; otherwise it is too far from core pretraining to justify a full read.

paper.title: Is This Edit Correct? A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Reasoning-Aware Image Editing
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based image editing has achieved strong visual fidelity under natural language instructions, yet most existing systems still operate at the level of surface instruction following, without reasoning about the implicit contextual constraints embedded in real user requests. This often leads to visually plausible but logically inconsistent edits. In this work, we introduce RE-Edit, a benchmark for REasoning-aware image Editing that evaluates image editing systems across five complementary

summary.core_problem: 评估图像编辑模型是否真正理解带隐含约束的自然语言编辑请求，而不只是做表面指令跟随。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark。它把 reasoning-aware image editing 拆成物理、环境、文化、因果、指代五类约束，提供更细粒度的失败分析框架。对做统一多模态生成或文本-图像对齐的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RE-Edit 基准，构造 1000 个需要隐式推理才能正确编辑的样本，并设计与五个推理维度对齐的评测标准；系统评测 10 个开源和 2 个闭源图像编辑模型。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1000 条精编样本；比较对象覆盖主流 diffusion-based image editing 系统。结论是即便先进模型也会频繁生成视觉上合理但逻辑上错误的编辑结果。摘要未给出具体分数和领先模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether image-editing models truly handle implicit reasoning constraints in user instructions rather than merely following surface text.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. By decomposing reasoning-aware image editing into physical, environmental, cultural, causal, and referential dimensions, it offers a more diagnostic evaluation setup. This is only indirectly relevant to unified multimodal generation and alignment research.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces RE-Edit, a 1,000-sample benchmark where correct editing requires implicit reasoning, along with dimension-aligned evaluation criteria, and studies 10 open-source plus 2 commercial image-editing models.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 1,000 curated samples; evaluated systems are mainstream diffusion-based image editors. The headline result is that even strong models often produce visually plausible but logically inconsistent edits, though the abstract does not report exact scores.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你在做统一多模态生成，知道‘视觉合理≠语义正确’这类评测缺口有用；读任务定义和错误分类就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful if you work on unified multimodal generation: it exposes the gap between visual plausibility and semantic correctness; the task definition and error taxonomy are enough.

paper.title: Beyond Alignment: Value Diversity as a Collective Property in Multicultural Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Multicultural multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed in globally diverse settings, where different agents are grounded in different cultural backgrounds. Existing cultural evaluation focuses on value alignment: how closely a single agent matches a target culture. Yet alignment is a per-agent property and cannot reveal whether a system, taken as a whole, preserves the cultural plurality it is meant to represent. We propose value diversity as a system-level evaluation axis for multicultural

summary.core_problem: 解决多文化 agent 系统只看单体 alignment、却无法衡量系统是否保留文化多样性的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是提出一个新的系统级评测轴 value diversity，并用它评估不同文化条件化 agent 组合。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但它提醒人们：对齐不等于群体层面的表示覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 World Values Survey，定义不同文化 agent 在共享价值问卷上的回答差异为 value diversity；在 19 种文化、18 个 backbone、不同系统配置下测量 diversity 与 alignment 的关系，并比较单 backbone 与 mixed-backbone 系统。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 19 cultures 和 18 backbone models。主要发现是 diversity 与 alignment 基本不相关，当前多文化 agent 系统的 diversity 明显低于人类社会，混合 backbone 系统可带来更高 diversity。摘要未给出更细的统计显著性与控制变量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore University of Technology and Design 和 Washington University in St. Louis。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap that multicultural agent systems are usually evaluated by per-agent alignment, which does not tell whether the system preserves cultural plurality at the collective level.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a new system-level evaluation axis, value diversity, used to assess culturally conditioned agent ensembles. The relevance to pretraining is limited, but it usefully reminds us that alignment is not the same as population-level representational coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the World Values Survey, it defines value diversity as the dissimilarity among culturally conditioned agents’ responses to a shared value survey, and studies its relationship with alignment across 19 cultures, 18 backbone models, and multiple system configurations.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans 19 cultures and 18 backbone models. The main findings are that diversity is largely uncorrelated with alignment, current multicultural agent systems fall well below human societies in diversity, and mixed-backbone systems can improve diversity. The abstract does not provide detailed significance tests or control analyses.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore University of Technology and Design and Washington University in St. Louis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“alignment 与 diversity 解耦”这个评测视角值得记；看定义和主结果图就够，不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that alignment and diversity decouple is worth keeping in mind; read the definition and main result figure, then stop.

institutions: Singapore University of Technology and Design

paper.title: Automatic Labelling of Speech Translation Errors
paper.abstract: Errors in speech translations reduce trustworthiness of Speech Translation (ST) systems and can have serious consequences. Yet currently there is no established methodology for evaluating confidence and quality estimation of speech translations. To initiate progress in this direction, we propose Speech Translation Error Labelling (STEL). We create an annotation protocol, a small authentic end-to-end evaluation dataset, and we analyse how existing text-only and speech-processing systems perform t

summary.core_problem: 提出 speech translation error labelling 任务，用于区分和标注端到端语音翻译中的翻译错误与语音处理错误。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测协议和小规模真实评测数据集。它不直接推进语音 LM 预训练，但对多模态语音模型的错误归因有参考价值，尤其是 text-only 评估无法覆盖音频侧错误这一点。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 STEL 标注任务和人工标注协议，构建真实语音翻译错误数据，并测试文本质量估计模型与直接处理语音的多模态模型在错误标注上的能力。
summary.experiments: 实验比较 text-only XCOMET 和 multimodal LLM Qwen2.5-Omni 等系统。结果显示这些模型在 STEL 上大约只有人类一半的 precision；直接语音处理对识别语音侧错误是必要的，text-only 与 speech-processing 系统在翻译错误和语音处理错误上呈互补关系。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Charles University、University of Edinburgh 和 Karlsruhe Institute of Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces speech translation error labelling, a task for identifying and separating translation errors from speech-processing errors in end-to-end speech translation outputs.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol and a small authentic dataset. It does not advance speech-LM pretraining directly, but it is useful for diagnosing multimodal speech models, especially where text-only evaluation misses audio-side failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines the STEL task, develops a human annotation protocol, builds an authentic evaluation set, and tests both text-only quality-estimation systems and multimodal models that can process speech directly.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates systems including text-only XCOMET and the multimodal LLM Qwen2.5-Omni. These systems reach roughly half of human precision; direct speech processing is necessary for speech-side errors, and text-only and speech-processing models are complementary across error types.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Charles University, the University of Edinburgh, and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 语音基座训练不必读全文；若做 audio-LLM eval，看任务定义和错误归因结果即可。
recommendation.en: Not required for speech pretraining, but if you build audio-LLM evals, read the task definition and the error-attribution results.

paper.title: Can LLMs Be Constrained to the Past? Improving Knowledge Cutoff through Recall-Based Prompting
paper.abstract: Prompted knowledge cutoff instructs a large language model (LLM) to act as if information beyond a specified cutoff date were unavailable. However, prior work mainly relies on direct-answer generation, which struggles when post-cutoff knowledge is not explicitly queried but is only causally related to the question. To address this limitation, we propose two recall-based prompting strategies: Self-Recall (SR), which asks the model to restate its cutoff constraint, and Question-Recall (QR), which

summary.core_problem: 在不改模型参数的前提下，如何让 LLM 更稳定地遵守指定知识截止时间，而不是在隐含依赖未来知识的问题上泄露 post-cutoff 信息。
summary.importance: 这是一个推理时控制与评测问题，不是预训练方法创新。价值在于它揭示了知识截止并非简单的 system prompt 约束，而与检索/回忆路径有关；对研究训练信号、知识编辑和时间一致性评测有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种 recall-based prompting：Self-Recall 先让模型重述 cutoff 约束，Question-Recall 先回忆在该 cutoff 下与问题相关的有效事实，再作答。核心想法是先约束可调用记忆，再生成答案，而不是直接要求模型“假装不知道未来”。同时构建 Multi-cutoff Historical Event Benchmark，用同一问题在多个 cutoff 年份下测试鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在三个已有 benchmark 和新建 MHEB 上，对比 direct-answer prompting 与常规 step-by-step reasoning，摘要称 recall-based prompting 整体更好，尤其在 counterfactual questions 上提升明显。论文更像 inference-time prompting study，没有模型训练、数据配比或优化器层面的新结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Institute of Science Tokyo。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to make LLMs obey a specified knowledge cutoff more reliably at inference time, especially when future knowledge is only indirectly implicated rather than explicitly queried.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-control and evaluation problem rather than a pretraining advance. Its value is in showing that knowledge-cutoff behavior depends on the model's recall path, not just a direct instruction, which is mildly relevant to training-signal design and temporal consistency evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes two recall-based prompting methods: Self-Recall, which makes the model restate the cutoff constraint, and Question-Recall, which asks the model to retrieve question-relevant facts valid under the cutoff before answering. The key idea is to constrain accessible memory before answer generation. It also introduces the Multi-cutoff Historical Event Benchmark to test the same question under multiple cutoff years.
summary_en.experiments: Across three existing benchmarks and the new MHEB, the abstract reports improvements over direct-answer prompting and standard step-by-step reasoning, with especially strong gains on counterfactual questions. This is primarily an inference-time prompting study, not a training or scaling paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Institute of Science Tokyo.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方向，但它提醒你“知识截止”更像记忆调用控制而非表层指令遵循；看方法定义和 MHEB 设定就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reframes cutoff control as memory-access shaping rather than surface instruction following; the method and MHEB setup are enough.

paper.title: MCBench: A Multicontext Safety Assessment Benchmark for Omni Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Existing multimodal safety benchmarks focus solely on visual inputs and cannot assess Omni Large Language Models (LLMs) that process vision, audio, and text. We introduce MCBench, a benchmark with 1196 scenarios spanning four safety categories that require integrating multiple modalities for accurate safety assessment. Each unsafe scenario is paired with a minimally different safe counterpart to assess model sensitivity. Our evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal significant challenges. O

summary.core_problem: MCBench 要评估的是 Omni LLM 在图像、环境音频、语音文本共同决定安全标签时，能否做出可靠的安全判断，而不是只看单一视觉线索的多模态安全检测。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的主要价值在评测，不是训练方法。它把多模态安全评测从“图像是否危险”推进到“多上下文证据如何组合”。对预训练研究的启发在于：Omni 模型的失败不一定来自感知能力不足，很多错误发生在跨模态证据整合阶段。这对 native multimodal pretraining 很有参考意义。仅用图文对齐或单模态安全数据，很难训练出稳定的多模态安全判断能力；训练目标和数据构造需要显式覆盖互补、冲突、弱线索、反事实配对等场景。
summary.technical_approach: MCBench 将每个样本定义为三元组输入：图像、音频、语音 utterance，模型需要输出 safe 或 unsafe。数据集包含 1196 个多上下文安全场景，覆盖 physical harm、social harm、illegal harm、property damage 四类。一个关键设计是 unsafe-safe 成对构造：每个不安全场景都有一个只在少量上下文元素上不同的安全对应样本，用来测试模型是否对微小但关键的证据变化敏感。数据生成流程先用 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 辅助扩展细粒度类别和场景，再用生成模型生成对应图像和音频，之后由人工专家过滤不现实场景和低质量多模态输入。除标签外，数据还提供 predicate，即决定安全判断所需的关键条件。这使评测不只停留在准确率，还能分析模型是否抽取到了必要线索，以及是否能把线索组合成正确判断。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了多个开源和闭源 Omni LLM。结果显示，当前模型在 physical harm 和 property damage 上表现较好，因为这些类别通常有更显著的视觉或声学线索；在 social harm 和 illegal harm 上明显更弱，因为判断常依赖隐含语义、社会规范、法律语境或跨模态组合。推理轨迹分析给出一个重要现象：模型经常能从单个模态中抽取 ground-truth predicate，但最后分类仍然错误，说明瓶颈在证据整合和安全推理，而不只是感知。消融分析还显示，模型面对模糊或局部可疑线索时容易过度敏感，常根据一个看似危险的信号判 unsafe，却忽略其他模态中的反向证据，导致安全样本上的 false positive。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 benchmark definition、taxonomy、unsafe-safe pair 构造、predicate 标注方式，以及 reasoning trace 分析。实验表格可以主要看不同安全类别的性能差异和模态消融结果。对预训练研究更有用的是失败模式：单模态抽取正确但跨模态融合失败、弱线索场景下过度敏感、社会与法律风险判断不稳。这些现象可反向指导多模态预训练数据配比、合成数据模板和后训练安全数据设计。

summary_en.core_problem: MCBench evaluates whether Omni LLMs can make safety judgments when the correct label depends on the joint interpretation of image, audio, and spoken language, rather than on a single visual cue.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation asset. Its relevance to pretraining is that many failures of Omni models appear to come from cross-modal evidence integration, not from modality-specific perception alone. This matters for native multimodal pretraining: image-text alignment or single-modality safety data is unlikely to teach robust safety reasoning when cues are weak, conflicting, or distributed across modalities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each example is formulated as an omnimodal situation consisting of an image, an audio clip, and a speech utterance. The model predicts a binary safe or unsafe label. The benchmark contains 1196 multicontext safety scenarios across four categories: physical harm, social harm, illegal harm, and property damage. A central design choice is paired construction: unsafe examples are matched with minimally different safe counterparts. This directly tests sensitivity to small but decisive context changes. The authors use Claude-Sonnet-4.5 to help expand fine-grained categories and scenario pairs, then use generative models to create the image and audio inputs. Human experts filter unrealistic scenarios and low-quality generations. Each instance also includes a predicate that specifies the condition needed for the safety decision, enabling analysis of whether a model extracted the right evidence and whether it used that evidence correctly.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates several open and proprietary Omni LLMs. Models perform better on physical harm and property damage, where salient visual or acoustic cues are often available. They struggle more with social harm and illegal harm, where the decision depends on subtler context, social norms, legal implications, or interactions across modalities. Reasoning-trace analysis shows an important failure pattern: models can often extract the necessary predicates from individual modalities, yet still make the wrong final judgment. This points to a reasoning and integration bottleneck. Ablations also show oversensitivity: when a single modality contains an ambiguous concerning cue, models may predict unsafe even when other modalities provide disconfirming context, increasing false positives on safe paired examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark definition, taxonomy, paired safe/unsafe construction, predicate annotation, and reasoning-trace analysis. The most useful parts for pretraining are the failure modes: correct local extraction but wrong cross-modal integration, oversensitivity to isolated risk cues, and weaker handling of social or legal risk. These observations can inform multimodal pretraining data design, synthetic scenario generation, and safety-oriented post-training mixtures.

recommendation.zh: 做 omni pretrain 或安全对齐的人可以看；重点不是 benchmark 本身，而是它把“会看图听音”与“会跨模态合证据”拆开了，读结果分析部分就够。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you work on omni pretraining or safety: the useful part is not the benchmark itself, but the clean separation between modality extraction and actual cross-modal evidence integration.

institutions: Monash University, Australia2Defence Science and Technology Group

paper.title: TensorBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents on a Compiler-Based Tensor Framework
paper.abstract: Repository-level coding benchmarks face a trade-off between task difficulty and evaluation reliability: tasks that challenge frontier models often involve large codebases with incomplete test coverage, while human review does not scale. We introduce TensorBench, a benchmark of 199 feature-addition and refactoring tasks on an open-source compiler-based tensor framework that extends PyTorch with first-class support for dense and sparse tensors. Tasks cover new sparse formats, dense optimization pa

summary.core_problem: TensorBench 试图解决代码 agent 评测中的一个老问题：简单任务容易可靠打分但已经不够区分模型；真实仓库任务更难，但测试覆盖不足，评测噪声高。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于代码 agent 评测，对 LLM 预训练的直接贡献有限，但对代码模型能力评估有参考价值。它选择编译型 tensor framework 作为任务环境，是一个较好的折中：任务需要跨文件理解和系统级修改，同时输出行为可以通过数值参考、随机回归测试和编译管线不变量来约束。对基座研究的启发主要在评测信号质量。代码预训练或代码后训练如果只看局部函数题，很难反映模型在大型工程中的修改能力；如果只看真实仓库 issue，又容易受到测试缺口影响。TensorBench 提供了一个更受控的中间层。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 基于 Scorch，一个约 1.1 万行 Python 加约 450 行 C++ runtime header 的 compiler-based tensor framework。它扩展 PyTorch，支持 dense 和 sparse tensor，并通过三层 IR 管线 CIN → LLIR → JIT C++ 生成 kernel。TensorBench 包含 199 个任务，其中 194 个 feature-addition，5 个 refactoring。任务覆盖 API、sparse format、IR、scheduler、codegen、runtime 六类，许多任务需要修改共享编译组件，例如 sparse-format handling、iteration lattice、IR lowering、scheduling、code generation 或 runtime kernel。评测方式不是比较 reference patch，而是在新容器中应用 agent 的 unified diff，构建 C++ runtime，运行完整测试套件。通过条件是继承测试和 agent 自己添加的测试全部通过。这个设计的好处是强调最终仓库行为；不足是新功能正确性很大程度依赖 agent 自己写的测试，因此 pass 不等于功能完整。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了来自 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenHands 四类 CLI scaffold 的 7 个 coding agent，覆盖三个闭源前沿模型家族和一个 open-weight 模型。最强的 agent Claude 4.7 在 post-patch test-suite 标准下通过 64.8% 的任务，相比 Claude 4.6 高 22.1 个百分点；破坏已有测试的比例从 Claude 4.6 的 27% 降到 16%。不同 agent 在单任务上的一致性较低，pairwise agreement 的 κ 在 -0.07 到 0.43 之间。任意两个 agent 的 union pass rate 比其中较好的单个 agent 高 6–20 个百分点，说明不同模型或 scaffold 的成功模式并不完全重合。任务分布上，API 类最多，为 99 个；Scheduler 37 个，Runtime 28 个，Format 20 个，IR 8 个，Codegen 7 个。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看任务构造、Scorch 架构说明、grading protocol、pass/fail 定义和结果表。对代码模型研究更关键的是评测设计的取舍：为什么选择编译型 tensor framework，为什么用最终测试行为而不是 reference patch，相比 SWE-bench 类真实 issue 评测降低了哪些噪声，又引入了哪些新偏差。需要特别注意论文自己承认的限制：新增功能主要由 agent 添加的测试约束，因此通过测试不能被解释为完整正确实现。

summary_en.core_problem: TensorBench targets the reliability-difficulty trade-off in coding-agent evaluation: small programming tasks are easy to grade but increasingly saturated, while repository-level tasks are harder but often suffer from weak test coverage and noisy grading.
summary_en.importance: The paper is primarily an evaluation benchmark for coding agents. Its direct impact on pretraining is limited, but it is useful for assessing code-model capabilities that matter beyond local function completion. The choice of a compiler-based tensor framework is meaningful: tasks require repository-scale edits, while many outputs can still be checked against numerical references, randomized regression tests, or compiler-pipeline invariants. For code pretraining and code post-training, it highlights the need for evaluation signals that sit between toy unit tests and noisy real-world issue resolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: TensorBench is built on Scorch, an open-source compiler-based tensor framework with roughly 11k lines of Python and a 450-line C++ runtime header. Scorch extends PyTorch with dense and sparse tensor support and lowers computations through a three-level IR pipeline: CIN to LLIR to JIT-compiled C++. The benchmark contains 199 tasks: 194 feature additions and 5 refactorings. Tasks span user-facing APIs, sparse tensor formats, IR changes, scheduler optimization passes, code-generation features, and runtime components. Many tasks require edits to shared compiler machinery such as sparse-format handling, iteration lattices, IR lowering, scheduling, code generation, and runtime kernels. Evaluation is behavior-based rather than patch-similarity-based. The harness applies the agent’s unified diff in a fresh Docker container, builds the C++ runtime, and runs the full test suite, including inherited randomized regression tests and any tests added by the agent. This provides a stronger compatibility signal, but it also means that new-feature correctness is constrained largely by the tests the agent writes.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate seven coding agents from four CLI scaffolds: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenHands. The evaluated systems cover three proprietary frontier model families and one open-weight model. The strongest agent, Claude 4.7, passes 64.8% of tasks under the post-patch test-suite criterion, a 22.1-point gain over Claude 4.6 on the same task set. Its rate of breaking pre-existing tests is 16%, down from 27% for Claude 4.6. Per-task agreement across agents is low, with pairwise kappa ranging from -0.07 to 0.43. The union pass rate of any two agents exceeds the stronger individual agent by 6–20 points, suggesting complementary failure and success patterns. The task mix is dominated by API changes, with 99 API tasks, 37 scheduler tasks, 28 runtime tasks, 20 format tasks, 8 IR tasks, and 7 codegen tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction, the Scorch architecture, the grading harness, the pass/fail definition, and the main results table. The most useful parts are the evaluation design choices: why a compiler-based tensor framework gives harder but still checkable tasks, why behavior-based grading is preferable to reference-patch matching, and what noise remains compared with real repository issue benchmarks.
