Pay close attention to the stated limitation: passing the suite should not be read as proof of full feature completeness, because new functionality is mainly tested by the agent’s own added tests.

recommendation.zh: 看 benchmark 设计和 grading protocol 就够了；若你关心 agent eval 是否被脏测试集污染，这篇比又一个 SWE 变体更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and grading protocol; if you care about cleaner agent eval rather than another noisy SWE variant, this one is worth a skim.

paper.title: Dense Contexts Are Hard Contexts: Lexical Density Limits Effective Context in LLMs
paper.abstract: Input length and the position of relevant information are widely cited as the primary causes of degraded LLM long-context performance. Here, we study lexical density -- the rate at which a context introduces distinct information -- as a third, largely overlooked factor that systematically reduces the effective context window of LLMs. We quantify the impact of lexical density on open-weight LLMs (9B-685B) using three "find-the-needle" style benchmarks with identical length (~12k tokens) and contr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论长上下文失效的一个被低估因素：在相同 token 长度、相同 needle 位置下，context 的信息密度不同，模型可用上下文长度会明显不同。论文把这个因素定义为 lexical density，即上下文引入不同词项或不同信息的速度。
summary.importance: 对预训练和长上下文评测的启发在于，标称 context window 不能只按长度衡量。许多长上下文 benchmark 的 haystack 很稀疏，模型可以靠冗余文本跳读，因此会高估真实场景能力。agent 配置、工具输出、代码、表格化规则、检索拼接材料往往更密集，这类输入会更早触发检索失败。对基座训练而言，这提示长上下文数据配比和评测集需要显式控制每 token 信息量，而不是只扩长度或调位置。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用 MATTR，即 Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio，度量局部窗口内不同 token 类型的比例。MATTR 越高，文本重复越少，局部信息越密。实验设计采用 find-the-needle 风格，但固定总长度约 12k tokens、固定结构和 needle 放置策略，只改变 haystack 的 lexical density。三个主要 benchmark 分别是 MK-NIAH，MATTR 约 0.58；Scene-Rules，MATTR 约 0.75；WordChecker，MATTR 为 1.0，接近每个 token 都引入新词项。为了排除任务类型差异，论文还做了 within-benchmark intervention：在同一个任务、同一长度、同一位置下人工降低或提高密度，观察性能变化。这个设计比单纯比较不同长上下文任务更干净，因为它把长度、位置、任务格式这些常见混杂因素固定住。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 8 个开源权重模型，参数规模从 9B 到 685B。核心结果很直接：模型在稀疏 MK-NIAH 上接近满分，但在更高密度的 Scene-Rules 和 WordChecker 中，检索性能会在 4k 到 6k tokens 后明显下滑，部分设置低于 60% retrieval score。这个失效点远早于只按长度预测的失效区间。论文还观察到 position effect 会被密度放大：needle 在中间位置的弱点在 dense context 中更早暴露。密度干预实验进一步显示，在任务、长度、位置不变时，降低 lexical density 可以恢复性能，说明问题不只是任务更难或位置更差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 length、position、density 三个轴的拆分；Figure 1 展示不同密度下的性能坍缩，是论文最核心的证据；benchmark 构造部分需要看清 Scene-Rules 和 WordChecker 如何控制密度；within-benchmark intervention 部分最值得细看，因为它决定了 density 是否只是任务差异的替代解释。对预训练研究者，更有价值的问题是后续如何把 lexical density 纳入长上下文数据采样、curriculum 和 eval harness，而不是只把它当成一个新 benchmark 指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates lexical density as a missing variable in long-context failures. At the same sequence length and with the relevant evidence placed at the same position, contexts that introduce more distinct information per token are substantially harder for LLMs to use.
summary_en.importance: The main value is diagnostic. It shows that advertised context length and standard needle-style evaluations can overstate usable context capacity when the haystack is redundant. Real inputs in agents, tool logs, configuration files, code, retrieved snippets, and rule lists are often much denser than synthetic filler text. For pretraining and long-context evaluation, this means that data mixtures and benchmarks should control information density, not only token length and evidence position.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors quantify density with MATTR, the Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio, which measures how many distinct token types appear in a local window. They compare three needle-style benchmarks with matched length, structure, and needle-placement policy, all around 12k tokens, but with increasing density: MK-NIAH at MATTR 0.58, Scene-Rules at MATTR 0.75, and WordChecker at MATTR 1.0. Because these tasks differ in surface form, the paper adds within-benchmark interventions that vary density while holding the task, length, and position fixed. This is the strongest part of the design, as it separates lexical density from ordinary task difficulty and positional effects.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers eight open-weight LLMs ranging from 9B to 685B parameters. Models that are nearly perfect on the sparse MK-NIAH setting drop sharply on denser contexts, with failures appearing around 4k to 6k tokens and retrieval scores falling below 60% in harder settings. The paper also reports that lost-in-the-middle behavior becomes more severe under high density. When density is reduced inside the same benchmark, performance recovers, supporting the claim that density is an independent driver of long-context degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the decomposition into length, position, and lexical density. Figure 1 is the key empirical result. The benchmark construction section is useful for understanding how Scene-Rules and WordChecker differ from standard NIAH. The within-benchmark density intervention is the most important section to inspect, since it tests whether density is a causal factor rather than a proxy for task type.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你看 long-context eval 的口径：别再只盯长度和位置，先看密度控制实验；读实验设计和 collapse 曲线就够，方法部分不用细抠。
recommendation.en: This should change how you read long-context evals: stop looking only at length and position, and inspect density-controlled setups first; the experimental design and collapse curves are the main value.

paper.title: LLMs Can Leak Training Data But Do They Want To? A Propensity-Aware Evaluation of Memorization in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models can reproduce training data, but existing memorization evaluations mostly measure whether models can be forced to do so, rather than whether they do so under ordinary use. We introduce PropMe, a propensity-aware framework for memorization evaluation that contrasts prefix-based capability attacks with non-adversarial evaluations. We propose a metric transformation that, applied to existing functions, allows to create propensity metrics. We further introduce SimpleTrace, a li

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作区分了两类训练数据泄露问题：模型是否能在攻击性前缀提示下复现训练样本，以及模型是否会在普通、非攻击性使用中主动生成训练样本。论文把后者称为 memorization propensity。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在数据治理和训练动态分析。已有 memorization 评测多测 capability，即把训练集中真实前缀喂给模型，看它能不能续写原文。这会高估日常使用中的泄露风险，也无法回答持续预训练后旧语料和新语料的泄露倾向如何变化。PropMe 试图把 memorization 从单一攻击成功率，拆成普通使用倾向、攻击可诱导性、以及两者之间的差距。这对开源预训练语料审计、版权风险分析、PII 风险评估和 continual pretraining 后的回归测试都有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两个部分。第一是 PropMe，一个 propensity-aware memorization evaluation 框架。它设置从非攻击到攻击的多级提示条件：非攻击设置使用真实可见的普通 prompt，且不直接来自训练集、与训练样本低词面重叠，用来测模型在普通使用中复现训练数据的倾向；攻击设置采用 prefix attack，直接给出训练样本前缀，用来测模型被诱导复现训练数据的能力。论文还提出一种 metric transformation，把已有 memorization 指标转换成 propensity metric，使指标能同时考虑行为发生频率和诱导条件。第二是 SimpleTrace，一个基于 infini-gram 的轻量 tracing pipeline，用于把模型生成文本确定性地匹配回大规模训练语料，计算 verbatim、near-verbatim 和 propensity-transformed memorization 指标。相对只用相似度分类器或网页搜索片段的方法，确定性语料检索能减少归因不确定性，并能指出具体源文档。
summary.experiments: 实验使用两个完全开放模型：英文模型 Comma，以及在 Comma 基础上继续训练得到的丹麦语 DFM Decoder。设置覆盖两个语料来源，并比较原始语料与持续预训练新增语料上的记忆行为。论文的实验重点不是证明某个模型泄露率最高，而是展示同一个模型在普通 prompt 和 prefix attack 下的泄露差异，以及 continual pretraining 后记忆来源如何转移。SimpleTrace 支持对生成结果做 verbatim 和 near-verbatim 归因，因此可以区分严格复现、近似复现和被 propensity transformation 调整后的风险。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。先看 PropMe 的定义，尤其是 propensity setting 与 capability setting 的提示构造差异；再看 metric transformation，确认它如何把普通 memorization 指标改造成 propensity-aware 指标；SimpleTrace 部分值得快速扫一遍，重点是 infini-gram 检索、近似匹配和源文档归因流程。实验部分建议关注 Comma 到 DFM Decoder 的持续预训练设置，因为它更接近基座模型迭代中的真实问题：新数据会带来新记忆，同时可能改变旧数据的泄露倾向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether memorization should be evaluated only as a capability elicited by adversarial prefixes, or also as a propensity: whether a model tends to reproduce training data during ordinary, non-adversarial use.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is useful for pretraining data governance and continual-pretraining audits. Prefix attacks answer whether a model can be forced to emit memorized text, but they do not estimate the risk under normal prompting. PropMe separates ordinary leakage propensity from adversarially elicited memorization capability. This distinction matters for copyright analysis, privacy review, training-data deduplication policies, and regression testing after continued training on a new corpus.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two components. PropMe defines a multi-level evaluation protocol ranging from generic prompts with low lexical overlap to the training set, intended to measure propensity, to prefix attacks that condition the model on prefixes from training examples, intended to measure capability. The paper also introduces a transformation that converts standard memorization metrics into propensity-aware metrics by conditioning the measured behavior on the prompting regime. SimpleTrace is the tracing component. It is built on infini-gram and searches model generations against large-scale training corpora to provide deterministic attribution. It supports verbatim matches, near-verbatim matches, and propensity-transformed memorization scores. Compared with probabilistic detectors or web-snippet matching, the key advantage is direct attribution to source documents in the actual training corpus.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two fully open models: Comma, a monolingual English model, and DFM Decoder, a Danish model continually trained from Comma. The setup compares memorization against the original corpus and the newly introduced continual-pretraining corpus. The reported analysis focuses on the gap between non-adversarial prompts and prefix attacks, and on how continued training changes the source of memorized generations. SimpleTrace enables the authors to separate exact reproduction, near reproduction, and propensity-adjusted leakage estimates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus first on the definitions of propensity and capability, since that distinction is the main conceptual contribution. Then inspect the metric transformation to see how existing memorization scores are adapted. The SimpleTrace section is worth reading for its corpus-level deterministic attribution pipeline. In the experiments, the most relevant part for pretraining researchers is the Comma to DFM Decoder continual-pretraining comparison, because it resembles model iteration under changing data mixtures.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会修正你对“记忆=泄露风险”的默认读法；只看方法定义和主结果表就够，重点是 capability/propensity 必须分开报。
recommendation.en: This usefully breaks the lazy equation of memorization with leakage risk; read the metric definition and main tables, then start reporting capability and propensity separately.

paper.title: Benchmark Everything Everywhere All at Once
paper.abstract: Benchmarks are fundamental for evaluating and advancing LLMs and MLLMs by providing standardized and explicit measures of performance. However, their construction is labor-intensive and hard to reuse, raising concerns about sustainability and scalability. Moreover, existing benchmarks often quickly reach performance saturation after their release, resulting in insufficient discrimination among state-of-the-art models. To address these challenges, we introduce Benchmark Agent, a fully autonomous

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 benchmark 构建过程过度依赖人工、难复用、迭代慢，同时现有 benchmark 很快饱和，难以区分新模型能力差异的问题。它提出用一个自动化 agent 系统，把用户的抽象评测需求转成可运行、可刷新、可定制的 benchmark。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的核心贡献是评测基础设施，不是预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于，模型迭代速度已经超过很多静态 benchmark 的生命周期，评测资产需要从一次性人工构建转向可持续生成和质量控制。对 pretrain 研究员来说，它更适合作为评测管线和数据治理的参考：如何把能力维度拆成子任务，如何做样本生成、标注、过滤和一致性检查，如何控制 LLM-as-a-judge 带来的偏差。它不会直接告诉你如何训练更好的模型，但能帮助设计更贴近目标能力的评测闭环。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark Agent 采用 Planner 和 Executor 两级结构。Planner 是高层决策模块，负责把用户需求解析成子任务集合、数据配置和 benchmark 转换方案，并检查每个子任务是否有可行的数据 grounding。Executor 是执行模块，按 Planner 的规格调用工具完成数据生成、标注、格式化和质量控制，最后产出可运行 benchmark。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：如果只用单个 LLM agent 端到端生成 benchmark，长链路任务容易失控，也难以对数据条件和执行约束做一致校验；Planner/Executor 拆分后，高层任务设计和底层数据处理可以分别约束。论文强调三个特性：面向用户需求的定制化、低人工成本下的质量控制、面向新模型和新领域的持续刷新。
summary.experiments: 论文实现 Benchmark Agent 并生成 15 个代表性 benchmark。引言中用 Qwen 和 Qwen-VL 系列的历史结果说明 benchmark 饱和现象：很多分数在短时间内超过 80%，剩余区分空间有限。评测部分包括人工评估、LLM-as-a-judge 评估、一致性检查、时间和成本分析，以及组件消融。根据给出的内容，作者声称生成 benchmark 在可靠性、区分度、效率和成本上都可接受；但当前材料没有列出具体人工一致率、成本数值、构建耗时或各消融项下降幅度。阅读时需要重点核对这些数字，否则很难判断系统是否真的适合高风险模型评测。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看系统流程图和 Planner/Executor 的接口定义，确认它如何从一句自然语言评测需求落到子任务、数据源和评价指标。然后看质量控制部分，尤其是样本过滤、标注校验、一致性检查和 LLM judge 的使用方式。实验部分不必细读所有生成 benchmark 的案例，优先看人类评估和一致性结果，再看成本与构建时间。若用于内部评测建设，需要额外关注两点：生成数据是否会引入模型偏好，自动刷新是否会破坏不同模型版本之间的可比性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and fragility of benchmark construction. Existing benchmarks are usually built by human-heavy, benchmark-specific pipelines, and many saturate quickly as model capabilities improve. Benchmark Agent aims to turn a high-level evaluation request into an executable, customizable, and refreshable benchmark with much less manual work.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly evaluation infrastructure rather than a modeling or pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research lies in evaluation lifecycle management. As model iteration accelerates, static benchmarks can lose discriminative power shortly after release. A reusable benchmark-building pipeline may help pretraining teams define finer-grained capabilities, generate targeted test sets, and maintain evaluation freshness. The key caution is quality control: automatically generated benchmarks must be checked for judge bias, annotation errors, data leakage, and comparability across model versions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Benchmark Agent uses a two-component design. The Benchmark Planner maps user requirements into concrete benchmark specifications, including subtask decomposition, data configuration, and transformation plans. It also checks whether each subtask can be grounded in available data. The Benchmark Executor then turns the plan into a runnable benchmark by using tools for sample generation, annotation, formatting, and quality control. This split is sensible for a long-horizon task: a single end-to-end agent would have to handle high-level task design, data constraints, execution details, and validation in one loop. Separating planning from execution makes the pipeline easier to constrain and audit.
summary_en.experiments: The system is used to produce 15 representative benchmarks. The introduction motivates the need with an analysis of Qwen and Qwen-VL benchmark results, where many scores exceed 80% within a short time, reducing headroom for discrimination. The evaluation covers human assessment, LLM-as-a-judge assessment, consistency checks for sample discriminativeness, time and cost efficiency, and ablations of system components. The provided text does not include exact agreement rates, construction costs, runtime numbers, or ablation deltas, so the strength of the empirical claim depends on the missing tables and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the system diagram and the Planner/Executor interface: how a natural-language evaluation need becomes subtasks, data sources, sample formats, and scoring rules. Then read the quality-control pipeline, especially filtering, annotation verification, consistency checks, and the use of LLM judges. In the experiments, prioritize human validation, discriminative-power tests, and cost/runtime analysis. If adapting the idea for internal model evaluation, pay special attention to two risks: generated benchmarks may inherit model-specific biases, and frequent benchmark refreshes may reduce comparability across model releases.

recommendation.zh: 核心idea有意思——用agent自动造benchmark解决评测饱和问题，但这类方法的数据质量和污染检测存疑，看摘要+实验设计即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting idea (agent-generated benchmarks to fight saturation), but data quality and contamination detection are open questions; read abstract + experimental design only.

paper.title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled powerful software engineering (SE) agents capable of navigating complex codebases and resolving real-world issues. However, these agents remain fundamentally episodic: they fail to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks, repeatedly reconstructing context from scratch and reproducing similar mistakes. Even with memory support, they offer no remedy for the absence of a principled, task-agnostic \textit{memory utility}, making them difficult to

summary.core_problem: 现有的软件工程（SE）Agent 通常是片段式的，缺乏跨任务保留、提炼和重用经验的机制；而现有的记忆增强方法缺乏与下游任务表现挂钩的、任务无关的记忆效用评估标准。
summary.importance: 提出了一个闭环的记忆优化框架 MemOp，将记忆效用严格定义为对下游任务性能的因果提升，为 Agent 记忆机制的评估和无监督优化提供了原则性方法。
summary.technical_approach: MemOp 包含两个核心创新：1) 将记忆效用定义为双重工具：既是评估基准，也是优化信号，完全基于下游任务的实际表现。2) 闭环记忆优化：通过轨迹级反思从完成的任务中提取候选记忆，然后通过性能验证（测量其对下游结果的因果影响）将候选记忆转化为训练信号，从而在无外部监督的情况下自适应地优化记忆模型。
summary.experiments: 在单回合记忆生成和跨回合记忆演化两种设置下进行了评估。结果表明，MemOp 显著提升了 SE Agent 的性能（成功率绝对提升高达 5.25%），训练后的记忆模型能生成高质量的反思，并具有很强的适应性，同时大幅降低了计算成本（相对降低 $\ge 9.79\%$）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 2 节（MemOp 框架）和第 3 节（记忆效用的定义与闭环优化机制）。理解其如何将“记忆是否有用”转化为可计算的因果影响，这对于设计具备持续学习能力的复杂 Agent 架构非常有价值。
summary.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

summary_en.core_problem: Current Software Engineering (SE) agents are episodic, lacking mechanisms to retain, refine, and reuse experience across tasks. Existing memory-augmented approaches lack a task-agnostic utility metric tied to downstream performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MemOp, a closed-loop memory optimization framework that strictly defines memory utility as the causal improvement on downstream task performance, providing a principled approach for evaluating and unsupervisedly optimizing agent memory mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemOp introduces two key innovations: 1) Principled memory utility as a dual harness: serving as both an evaluation benchmark and an optimization signal, grounded entirely in downstream performance. 2) Closed-loop memory optimization: candidate memories are distilled from completed trajectories via reflection, and then validated by measuring their causal impact on downstream outcomes. This validation converts candidates into training signals, enabling adaptive memory optimization without external supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated under single-episode memory generation and cross-episode memory evolution settings. MemOp significantly improves SE agent performance (up to 5.25% absolute increase in Success Rate). The trained memory models produce high-quality reflections, exhibit robust adaptability, and substantially reduce computational costs ($\ge 9.79\%$ relative reduction).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (MemOp framework) and Section 3 (definition of memory utility and closed-loop optimization). Understand how it translates 'memory usefulness' into a computable causal impact, which is highly valuable for designing complex agents with continual learning capabilities.
summary_en.authors_note: Xuehang Guo (William & Mary), Xingyao Wang (OpenHands)

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“memory 有用”定义成可验证下游收益这一步很干净；只看任务定义和评测协议，别在代码 Agent 细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the move of defining memory utility via validated downstream impact is unusually clean; read the task formulation and eval protocol, not the code-agent plumbing.

paper.title: The Geometry of LLM-as-Judge: Why Inter-LLM Consensus Is Not Human Alignment

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是“LLM judge 准不准”这种泛泛问题，而是一个更尖锐的结构性问题：为什么不同 LLM 评审彼此高度一致，却和人类评审只弱相关；这种一致性到底代表共享有效信号，还是共享偏差。作者的核心判断是，很多主观、多语言、文化依赖强的评测场景里，LLM judge 并不是在逼近人类评价函数，而是在一个低秩、冗余、偏向模型可读特征的子空间里彼此对齐。于是 inter-LLM consensus 不能当作 human alignment 的替代证据。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的影响比题目看上去更大。第一，它直接触及 post-train 与 eval 的接口：现在大量偏好数据构造、reward model 校验、自动评测、self-improvement pipeline 都默认 LLM judge 可作为廉价代理。如果 judge 之间的一致性主要来自共享投影偏差，那么很多训练信号会系统性偏离人类目标，尤其在主观、跨文化、多语言任务上。第二，这篇工作把“judge failure”从零散现象上升为几何结构问题，给出可操作的诊断量，而不是只报几个相关系数。第三，它对预训练研究也有反向启发：如果 judge 子空间更贴近语料频繁、流畅性主导、模型熟悉的方向，那么 pretrain 数据分布、post-train 偏好目标和评测协议之间可能在共同塑造一种低维偏差。这个结论对做 reward 建模、合成偏好数据、自动化 eval 的人都很重要。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上最有价值的是它把 LLM-as-judge 形式化成“潜在质量流形上的低秩投影器”。作者先假设一个回答表示 h 可以分解为 style、fact、culture 等近似正交的子空间；人类评分函数会按 rubric 在这些子空间上加权，客观 rubric 更偏 fact，主观 rubric 则会把 cultural/contextual 维度也纳入。LLM judge 则被建模为一个秩较低的正交投影 PJ，分数由投影后能量决定。若 judge 的表征基础主要来自 next-token 预训练和常见 post-train 目标，它更容易对 fluency、常见事实、模型熟悉的表达方向敏感，而对文化语境、社区规范、细微价值判断这些低频但人类在意的维度投影不足。这样就会出现：不同 LLM judge 因共享训练分布和对齐目标而投向相似低维子空间，所以彼此相关；但这个子空间和人类评分子空间夹角很大，所以和人类不对齐。

围绕这个几何假设，论文提出四类诊断量。1）score spread compression：比较 judge 与 human 的打分方差，若 σJ/σH 明显小于 1，说明 judge 把主观差异压扁了。2）effective rank：看评分矩阵需要多少主成分才能解释 95% 方差，若 judge 的有效秩显著低于 human，说明其评价维度更少。3）principal angle to human subspace：直接测 judge 子空间与 human 子空间的主夹角，并与 inter-human 的夹角下界比较。4）stacked correlations / null-space fraction：看 LLM-LLM 相关是否系统高于 LLM-human，以及人类评分变化中有多少落在 judge 的“盲区”。

方法设计上还有两个细节很关键。其一，作者不是只测原始 judge，还系统比较了 in-context demonstration、SFT、DPO、以及 post-hoc demonstration-anchored calibration 四种干预，想回答“训练能不能把 judge 拉回人类子空间”。其二，数据选在 Indic 多语言、社区健康、文化问答这类真实主观场景，而不是英语单一、事实核验型 benchmark，这让几何诊断更接近真实部署难点。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4 个社区构建的 Indic 数据集、8 种 Indic 语言、41 个 LLM judges。数据里既有文化问答，也有社区健康场景；每个样本有 3 位独立人类评审，rubric 横跨 objective 到 subjective。模型侧包含 14 个基础 judge，以及 27 个经过训练、偏好优化或校准的变体，来自 3 个模型家族，规模从 3B 到 405B。统计上使用 paired item bootstrap 给出区间，而不是只报点估计。

主结果很清楚。对于主观 rubric，LLM judge 的 score spread 只有人类的一部分，σJ/σH 约在 0.3–0.5，说明打分动态范围被明显压缩。几何上，judge 子空间与 human 子空间几乎正交，主夹角约 87–89°，而人类之间的夹角约 78–81°；也就是说，judge 离 human 比 human 彼此之间更远。相关性上，LLM-LLM Pearson 大约 0.35，而 LLM-human 约 0.1 左右甚至更低，形成“彼此一致但不贴近人类”的典型模式。只有在带可验证事实答案的 objective rubric 上，这个 gap 才明显收敛，说明问题不是 LLM 完全不会评，而是对高内在维度的主观评价会发生秩塌缩。

干预实验也很有信息量。SFT 和 DPO 往往能恢复一部分 score spread，让 judge 不再那么“缩分”，但 principal angle 改善很有限，说明训练可能让分数更分散，却没有真正学到人类评价维度；有些 rubric 上甚至会退化。相对而言，post-hoc 的 demonstration-anchored calibration 是唯一一个在 community-health 四个 rubric 上都带来一致提升的方案，但仍达不到人类可靠性水平。作者还给出 boundary condition：当 judge 的可表达维度 kJ 小于某个 rubric 下人类评分流形的内在维度 dR 时，就会出现 consensual blindness。这个解释和实验现象是对得上的：客观 rubric 的 dR 低，主观 rubric 的 dR 高。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读。建议先看第 2 节的几何建模，再看第 4 节实验。读法上不要先盯相关系数表，而要先弄清四个诊断量各自回答什么问题。score compression 回答“judge 是否把差异压平”；effective rank 回答“judge 实际用了多少评价维度”；principal angle 回答“judge 看问题的方向是否接近人类”；stacked correlations 回答“高 inter-LLM agreement 到底是不是好事”。把这四个量串起来，论文的主张就很完整了。

重点图表应优先看：主观与客观 rubric 的 spread 对比图、effective rank 分布、judge-human 与 human-human 的 principal angle 图、以及不同训练阶段的几何量变化图。尤其要看训练干预部分，因为它回答了一个很现实的问题：靠 SFT/DPO 能不能把 judge 修好。作者给出的答案是“只能修表面，难修方向”。

如果从预训练/对齐研究角度精读，最值得深挖的点有三个。第一，低秩投影假设和 next-token 预训练之间的关系：为什么 fluency-dominated 语料会诱导 judge 偏向 style/fact 而忽视文化维度。第二，demonstration-anchored calibration 为什么比继续训练更有效，它是在重标定分数尺度，还是在局部旋转评价子空间。第三，几何诊断能否前置到 reward model 或 synthetic preference pipeline 中，作为训练前的质量门槛。完整读完大约需要 60–90 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharper question than whether LLM judges are merely “good” or “bad”: why do LLM judges agree strongly with each other while agreeing only weakly with humans, especially on subjective multilingual tasks? The central claim is that this is not evidence of shared alignment, but often evidence of shared projection bias. On subjective rubrics, many LLM judges appear to collapse onto a low-rank, redundant subspace that tracks model-legible features, while missing dimensions that humans actually use.
summary_en.importance: This matters directly for the pretrain-posttrain-eval loop. A large fraction of current pipelines rely on LLM judges for preference data generation, reward-model validation, automatic evaluation, and self-improvement. If inter-LLM agreement mostly reflects shared bias rather than proximity to human judgment, then these pipelines can reinforce the wrong signal at scale. The paper is also valuable methodologically: instead of reporting a few correlations, it reframes judge failure as a geometric mismatch problem and introduces diagnostics that can be checked before trusting an evaluator. For foundation-model work, the broader implication is that pretraining distributions, post-training objectives, and evaluation proxies may all be co-producing the same low-dimensional blind spots.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper models LLM-as-judge as a low-rank projection operator on a latent quality manifold. A response representation h is decomposed into approximately orthogonal components such as style, factual content, and cultural/contextual content. Human scoring is modeled as a rubric-dependent weighted combination over these components: objective rubrics put most weight on factual dimensions, while subjective rubrics spread weight across cultural and contextual dimensions as well. An LLM judge, by contrast, is modeled as an orthogonal projector P_J with relatively small rank k, and the score is derived from the energy of the projected representation.

The intuition is that next-token pretraining and common post-training objectives make judges especially sensitive to fluency, common factual regularities, and model-familiar directions, but relatively insensitive to culturally grounded or community-specific dimensions. If multiple judges are trained on similar corpora and aligned with similar objectives, they can project onto similar low-rank subspaces. That yields high judge-judge agreement even when all of them remain far from the human scoring subspace.

From this framework, the paper derives four diagnostics. First, score-spread compression compares judge variance to human variance; strong compression indicates that judges flatten distinctions humans care about. Second, effective rank measures how many principal components are needed to explain most score variance; lower rank for judges indicates fewer active evaluation dimensions. Third, principal angle to the human subspace directly measures whether judges and humans are looking in similar directions. Fourth, stacked correlations and null-space fraction quantify whether judge-judge agreement systematically exceeds judge-human agreement and how much human variation lies in the judges’ blind space.

A strong design choice is that the paper does not stop at raw judges. It evaluates in-context prompting, supervised fine-tuning, DPO, and post-hoc demonstration-anchored calibration, asking whether training can actually rotate judges toward the human subspace rather than merely rescale outputs. Another strong choice is the dataset regime: Indic multilingual, culturally situated, community-grounded tasks, where the subjective/objective distinction is real rather than synthetic.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers four community-built Indic datasets, eight Indic languages, and 41 LLM judges. The data include cultural QA and community-health settings, with three independent human raters per item and rubrics spanning the objective-to-subjective spectrum. On the model side, the paper evaluates 14 base judges and 27 trained, preference-optimized, or calibrated variants from three model families ranging from 3B to 405B parameters. Uncertainty is reported with paired item bootstrap intervals rather than point estimates alone.

The main findings are consistent across datasets. On subjective rubrics, LLM judges use much less of the human score range, with sigma_J / sigma_H around 0.3 to 0.5. Geometrically, judge subspaces are nearly orthogonal to the human subspace: principal angles are around 87 to 89 degrees, whereas human-human subspace angles are around 78 to 81 degrees. So judges are farther from humans than humans are from each other. Correlation patterns show the same asymmetry: judge-judge Pearson correlations are roughly 0.35, while judge-human correlations are around 0.1 or lower. The gap closes only on the rubric with a verifiable factual answer, which supports the paper’s boundary-condition story: objective rubrics have lower intrinsic dimensionality, while subjective rubrics require more dimensions than the judges effectively use.

The intervention results are especially informative. SFT and DPO often restore some score spread, so judges stop compressing scores as severely, but they barely improve the principal angle to the human subspace. In some cases they even hurt certain rubrics. That means training can make judges look more expressive without making them more human-aligned. Post-hoc demonstration-anchored calibration is the only intervention that improves all four community-health rubrics together, but it still falls short of human reliability. This is an important negative result: better scaling or more preference optimization does not automatically solve the structural mismatch.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a full read. Start with the geometric formulation before looking at the result tables. The paper becomes much clearer once each diagnostic is mapped to a distinct question: score compression asks whether judges flatten distinctions; effective rank asks how many dimensions they actually use; principal angle asks whether they evaluate along human-like directions; stacked correlations ask whether inter-judge agreement should be trusted at all.

The most important figures are the subjective-versus-objective spread comparisons, the effective-rank plots, the principal-angle comparisons between judge-human and human-human subspaces, and the intervention plots across prompting, SFT, DPO, and calibration. The intervention section is especially worth close attention because it answers a practical question many teams implicitly assume away: can standard training repair judge misalignment? The paper’s answer is mostly no; it can widen the score range, but it rarely rotates the evaluation geometry enough.

From a foundation-model perspective, three follow-up questions are worth tracking while reading. First, how exactly does next-token pretraining induce a fluency- and familiarity-biased judge geometry? Second, why does demonstration-anchored calibration help more consistently than additional training—does it mainly rescale outputs, or does it locally re-anchor the evaluation basis? Third, could these geometric diagnostics be inserted upstream into reward-modeling or synthetic-preference pipelines as a gating criterion? Expect roughly 60 to 90 minutes for a careful read.

recommendation.zh: 这类“judge 一致≠人类一致”的诊断会直接改写自动评测与 reward 设计的 prior；优先看它给的可操作检验与失败样本结构。
recommendation.en: This can reset your priors on auto-judging and reward design; focus on the actionable tests and the structure of failure cases, not the headline claim.

paper.title: CoEval: Ranking Language Models for Custom Tasks Without Labeled Data or Trustworthy Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Choosing or ranking language models for a specific application is hardest when no task-specific labeled data exists, and standard public benchmarks cannot be trusted, their items having likely leaked into pretraining, so scores reflect memorization rather than fitness. We present CoEval, an open-source, reusable framework that closes this gap end to end: from only a description of a task or domain, teacher models synthesize a fresh, attribute-controlled benchmark with no human labels, contaminat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是无标注数据、公共 benchmark 又可能被污染时，如何为某个自定义任务选择和排序语言模型。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测基础设施工作，对基座研究的直接价值在于动态评测和污染规避。它不改进预训练算法，但针对当前模型选择中的一个真实痛点：静态公开题集容易进入预训练语料，分数可能反映记忆而不是泛化。CoEval 的思路是每次按任务描述重新生成评测集，并用跨模型家族 judge ensemble 评分。这个框架对内部模型迭代、continual pretrain 后的能力回归测试、以及面向特定数据分布的模型选择都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: CoEval 包含两步。第一步，teacher model 根据任务或领域描述生成 attribute-stratified benchmark，也就是按用户声明的能力、难度、子领域等属性控制题目分布。由于题目每次运行时新生成，目标是降低静态 benchmark 泄漏到训练语料中的风险。第二步，candidate models 在这些题目上作答，再由来自不同模型厂商或模型家族的 judge ensemble 评分。论文强调 judge panel 的关键不是数量，而是组成：跨家族、多来源的 judge 更能降低同源偏好；如果盲目加入低一致性的 judge，可靠性反而下降。聚合时利用不同 judge 对长答案偏好的方向差异抵消 verbosity bias，并通过 vendor-disjoint 设计减少 self-preference。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了一个四任务中等规模实验，产生 7,978 条有效评测，总成本为 5.89 美元。在有 ground truth 的设置中，CoEval 能恢复真实模型排序，并且 label-free judging 与 ground-truth correctness 的相关性达到 rho=0.86。实验还分析了 judge ensemble 的组成与可靠性的关系，结论是 vendor diversity 比单纯增加 panel size 更重要；加入低一致性 judge 会降低整体可靠性。论文还给出 rubric generalization、污染抵抗、成本，以及三个自定义垂直场景的端到端案例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看框架定义部分，理解 declarative task specification 如何变成可执行 benchmark；再看 Section 5.1 和 Table 3，确认它在有 ground truth 场景下能否恢复正确排序；随后看 judge ensemble 的消融，尤其是 composition-over-size 的结果。对预训练研究员来说，最值得借鉴的是“动态生成评测分布 + 跨家族 judge 聚合”的工程设计，而不是某个具体任务上的排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses model selection for a custom task when there is no labeled task-specific data and public benchmarks may be contaminated by pretraining exposure.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-infrastructure paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from dynamic evaluation and contamination control, rather than from a new training method. Static public benchmarks are increasingly weak signals for model choice because items can leak into pretraining corpora. CoEval proposes a renewable evaluation pipeline: generate a fresh task-specific benchmark from a task description and rank candidate models with a cross-family judge ensemble. This is useful for internal model iteration, continual-pretraining regression tests, and deployment-oriented model selection under a target distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoEval has two main components. First, a teacher model synthesizes an attribute-stratified benchmark from a domain or task specification, controlling dimensions such as capability, difficulty, and subdomain coverage. Since items are generated anew for each run, the benchmark is designed to reduce exposure to student-model training data. Second, candidate model responses are scored by a judge ensemble drawn from different model vendors or families. The paper’s central methodological point is that judge composition matters more than judge count. A diverse panel can reduce same-family self-preference, while adding low-agreement judges can make reliability worse. The aggregation scheme also aims to cancel verbosity bias because individual judges may have biases with different signs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported medium-scale study covers four tasks and produces 7,978 valid evaluations at an end-to-end cost of USD 5.89. In settings where ground truth exists, CoEval recovers the correct model ranking and its label-free judging correlates with ground-truth correctness at rho = 0.86. The experiments also examine judge-panel reliability and find that vendor diversity is a stronger lever than simply increasing the number of judges. Additional analyses cover rubric generalization, contamination resistance, cost, and three end-to-end custom-domain case studies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the framework section to understand how a declarative task specification is turned into a generated benchmark. Then check Section 5.1 and Table 3 for validation against ground-truth rankings. The most useful part is the judge-ensemble analysis, especially the composition-over-size finding. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the evaluation design: dynamically generated target distributions combined with cross-family judging, not the ranking outcome for any single task.

recommendation.zh: 做模型选型和内部 eval 的人可以看；新意在 judge panel 设计而不在生成 benchmark，本身不改 pretrain prior，但可直接影响你怎么搭无标注评测流水线。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you build internal eval stacks; the useful bit is judge-panel composition rather than benchmark synthesis, and it won’t change pretraining priors but may change how you run label-free model ranking.

paper.title: Reasoning Structure of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are often evaluated using metrics such as final-answer accuracy or token count. However, identical scores on these metrics can hide fundamentally different reasoning structures. To address this limitation, we introduce a scalable LRM benchmark of logic puzzles and a pipeline that converts unstructured traces into verifiable reasoning graphs of claims and dependencies. This turns reasoning into a structured, measurable object whose topology can be quantitatively anal

summary.core_problem: 当前对大推理模型（LRM）的评估依赖一维指标（最终答案准确率或 token 数），但相同的分数可能隐藏根本不同的推理结构——两个模型可能以相同准确率和相似 trace 长度解决同一个问题，但一个是聚焦推理，另一个是散漫探索。论文要解决的问题是如何把推理变成可测量的结构化对象。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评估方法论层面：如果 token 数和准确率都无法区分散漫探索和有效推理，那么仅靠这些指标优化推理模型（如通过 RL 奖励推理质量）可能会误导优化方向。推理效率指标 η 提供了一个新的评估维度，可用于诊断不同模型的推理策略差异，对理解和改进推理型 LLM 的训练目标（如 CoT 数据构造、RL 奖励设计）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 主要贡献有三个方面：(1) 构建了一个可扩展的 2D 网格逻辑谜题 benchmark（21 个谜题），支持难度缩放的推理研究。(2) 开发了一个流水线，将非结构化的自由文本推理 trace 转换为可验证的推理图——节点是原子声明（claim），边表示演绎依赖关系，节点颜色编码声明正确性，透明度区分明确陈述和推导出来的声明。(3) 定义了推理效率指标 η，量化模型逻辑流的集中度（相对于最小必要声明集），能区分聚焦推理与散漫探索，即使在准确率相同、trace 长度相似的情况下。
summary.experiments: 在开源推理模型上的分析显示：结构测量能区分被 token 数和准确率混同的行为。token 数是推理质量的次优代理，因为额外 token 主要转化为验证开销而非有效推理。即使模型在更高难度下消耗显著更多 token，最难的区域仍基本未解决，表明当前限制不是简单分配更多计算就能解决的。η 指标在准确率饱和、token 预算重叠的区域仍能暴露模型间推理结构差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Section 3 的推理图提取流水线和推理效率 η 的定义（核心创新）。图 1 和图 2 有直观的可视化示例，建议先看。实验结果集中在后续章节，主要看图 6 的 η 指标对比。对评估方法论感兴趣的读者值得关注推理图的构建过程。阅读时间约 30-40 分钟。
summary.authors_note: ETH Zurich，Frédéric Berdoz（第一作者兼通讯作者）。该论文已被 ICML 2026（第 43 届机器学习国际会议，韩国首尔）接收。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on one-dimensional metrics (final-answer accuracy or token count), but identical scores can mask fundamentally different reasoning structures—two models may solve the same problem with identical accuracy and similar trace length, yet one uses focused reasoning while the other engages in diffuse exploration. The paper addresses how to turn reasoning into a measurable, structured object.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is at the evaluation methodology level: if token count and accuracy cannot distinguish diffuse exploration from effective reasoning, optimizing reasoning models by these metrics alone (e.g., via RL for reasoning quality) may mislead optimization. The reasoning-efficiency metric η provides a new evaluation dimension that can diagnose differences in reasoning strategies across models, informing the design of CoT data construction and RL reward signals for reasoning-capable LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core contributions: (1) A scalable benchmark of 21 2D grid logic puzzles that supports difficulty-scaled reasoning studies. (2) A pipeline that converts unstructured free-text reasoning traces into verifiable reasoning graphs—nodes are atomic claims, edges indicate deductive dependencies, node color encodes claim correctness, and opacity distinguishes stated vs. derived claims. (3) A reasoning-efficiency metric η that quantifies the concentration of a model's logical flow (relative to the minimal necessary claim set), capable of distinguishing focused reasoning from diffuse exploration even when accuracy and trace length are matched.
summary_en.experiments: Analysis on open-source reasoning models shows structural measurements separate behaviors that token count and accuracy conflate. Token count is a suboptimal proxy for reasoning quality because extra tokens primarily translate into verification overhead rather than effective reasoning. Even as models spend substantially more tokens at higher difficulty levels, the hardest regime remains largely unsolved, indicating current limitations are not resolved by simply allocating more compute. The η metric exposes reasoning structure differences across models even in regimes where accuracy is saturated and token budgets overlap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on Section 3 for the reasoning graph extraction pipeline and the definition of reasoning-efficiency η (the core innovation). Figures 1 and 2 provide intuitive visual examples and should be read first. Experimental results focus on Figure 6 for η metric comparisons. Readers interested in evaluation methodology will benefit from tracing the graph construction process. Estimated reading time: 30–40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: ETH Zurich, Frédéric Berdoz (first and corresponding author). Accepted at ICML 2026 (43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea).

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练法，但会改你看 reasoning trace 的方式；先看 reasoning graph 定义和 efficiency metric，足够判断值不值得内化到 eval pipeline。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your training recipe, but it may change how you inspect reasoning traces; read the graph construction and efficiency metric first.

paper.title: Benchmarks are Not Enough: RAMP for Runtime Assessing of Agentic Models in Production Systems
paper.abstract: LLM agents are rapidly evolving from coding assistants into autonomous software engineering systems. However, existing evaluation methodologies remain largely centered on static, isolated, and short-horizon benchmarks that fail to capture the dynamic complexity of real-world production workflows. As a result, benchmark performance may poorly reflect practical capability under realistic runtime environments involving long execution chains, tool interactions, dependency management, and iterative f

summary.core_problem: 解决现有软件工程 agent 评测过于静态、短程、脱离生产环境，导致 benchmark 分数无法反映真实运行时能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测基础设施工作，贡献类型是 runtime evaluation protocol 与执行平台。对预训练研究员不是主线，但如果关心 post-train 后 agent 能力是否真实可迁移，这类长时程、工具交互型评测比静态题集更接近部署约束。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RAMP，一个面向生产系统的长时程软件工程 agent 运行时评测框架。它基于统一编排与执行接口，提供真实编译器构建类任务、串行依赖、复杂工具链交互，以及 staged recovery 机制，用于分析 agent 在部分错误后的恢复与继续执行能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调其评测环境包含长执行链、工具调用、依赖管理和迭代反馈回路，任务设定比传统 benchmark 更接近真实生产工作流。当前摘要未给出参与评测的模型、样本规模和量化结果，因此更像评测资产发布而非结论型论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between static short-horizon software-agent benchmarks and real production behavior, where benchmark scores often fail to reflect runtime capability.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation infrastructure paper, contributing a runtime evaluation protocol and execution platform. It is not central for pretraining, but if you care whether post-trained agent skills transfer to deployment, long-horizon tool-interaction evaluation is more informative than static benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RAMP, a production-grounded runtime assessment framework for long-horizon software engineering agents. It provides unified orchestration and execution interfaces, realistic compiler-construction workloads, serial dependencies, complex toolchain interactions, and a staged recovery mechanism to analyze how agents recover from partial failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes long execution chains, tool use, dependency management, and iterative feedback loops, making the setup closer to production workflows than standard benchmarks. The abstract does not provide evaluated models, dataset size, or quantitative results, so this currently reads more like an evaluation asset release than a conclusion-heavy paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像评测基建，不是方法论文；知道有这么个 runtime SWE 评测就够了，除非你正做 agent eval 平台。
recommendation.en: This is evaluation plumbing rather than a method paper; know it exists, and only read deeper if you're building agent runtime eval infrastructure.

paper.title: When RLHF Fails: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Reward Hacking, Collapse, and Evaluator Gaming
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) makes large-scale post-training possible by replacing an underspecified human objective with learned and scalable proxies. The same substitution creates a structured failure surface: optimization can raise the learned reward while external quality falls, degrade both proxy and judge scores, reveal proxy under-alignment, or produce evaluator-specific disagreement. We present an empirical failure-mode study of a compact RLHF pipeline with proximal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是提出新的 RLHF 算法，而是把 RLHF 训练失败这件事拆细。作者认为“reward hacking”这个词过于粗糙，掩盖了几种机制不同的失败：代理奖励上升但外部质量下降、代理和外部评估一起下降、代理本身就没学对、模型几乎不动、以及不同 judge 给出相反结论。论文试图给这些现象建立一个可审计、可复现的 checkpoint-level 与 prompt-level taxonomy。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为它不涉及 pretrain recipe、数据或优化器创新；但对 post-train 诊断和 pretrain↔post-train 闭环有启发。价值在于两点。第一，它提醒人不要把 RLHF 失败都归因于 reward hacking，很多时候是 collapse、under-alignment 或 evaluator disagreement。第二，它强调 row-level transition 分析，而不是只看 checkpoint 平均分。这种诊断思路对研究训练动态、奖励信号质量、以及 judge 可靠性都有帮助。贡献量级更接近诊断框架和实验方法学，而不是新的训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构建了一个小规模但完整的 RLHF pipeline：SFT 起点、reward model、PPO 若干 KL 设置、DPO 评估、UP-PPO 变体、reward uncertainty via MC dropout、近似 KL 漂移、diversity/repetition 指标，以及两个外部 LLM judges。核心不是这些组件本身，而是如何定义 failure taxonomy。

论文把分析单位设为 transition，而不是单个 checkpoint。对每个 prompt，比较两个 checkpoint 之间代理奖励 Rφ、主 judge 分数 R†、第二 judge 分数 R2† 的变化方向。主 judge 的方向决定主类别，第二 judge 用来标记 evaluator disagreement。由此把转移分成 stable alignment、reward hacking、optimization collapse、proxy under-alignment、conservative stagnation、evaluator gaming 等类型。这个设计的好处是：它不把不同失败混在一个平均数里，而是能定位“哪一类 prompt 在哪一段训练中开始坏掉”。

作者还尝试做 early-warning：只用转移前的信号去预测后续会不会进入某类失败。可用特征包括 reward uncertainty、近似 policy drift、重复度、多样性等。UP-PPO 在这里不是新架构，而是 shaped-reward PPO：在计算标量 advantage 前，从 reward model 分数里减去 uncertainty penalty。论文把 mitigation 和 diagnosis 分开处理，没有把 UP-PPO 包装成通用解法。
summary.experiments:
实验建立在 GPT-2 量级策略模型和 Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts 上，重点看不同 PPO 强度、DPO、以及 UP-PPO 的失败分布。论文给出的一个明确数字是：aggressive PPO 条件下，256 个 row-level transitions 中有 37 个被判为 reward hacking，占 14.45%；β=0.03 的 PPO 也有 9.38% 的 reward-hacking 占比。作者强调，很多 failure 只有在 row-level 才看得见，checkpoint 平均分会把局部坏例子冲淡。

另一个关键结果是 judge disagreement 被单独当成 failure mode，而不是评测噪声。也就是说，同一训练转移可能在一个 judge 看来是改进，在另一个 judge 看来是退化，这会影响对“是否 reward hacking”的判定。UP-PPO 相比 aggressive PPO 往往更保守，能减少一部分明显失败，但论文没有声称它系统性解决了所有问题。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数值，这里不补写未出现的具体指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读。先看 Introduction 和 Failure-Mode Taxonomy，弄清作者为什么坚持用 transition-based、row-level 的分类，而不是 checkpoint aggregate。然后看 Experimental Design，确认 pipeline 的边界：小模型、HH-RLHF、两个 LLM judges、UP-PPO 只是 uncertainty-penalized reward shaping。最后看 Results 里 taxonomy 统计表和若干 prompt-level case study。预计 25–35 分钟。

阅读时要带着两个问题：第一，taxonomy 是否足够稳健，还是高度依赖 judge 和阈值设定；第二，这套诊断在更大模型、更强 reward model、或 reasoning-heavy RL setting 下是否仍然成立。若只关心方法启发，重点看 row-level localization 和 two-judge disagreement 这两部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not proposing a new RLHF algorithm. Its main goal is to decompose RLHF failure into a more precise taxonomy. The authors argue that the term 'reward hacking' is too coarse: a run where proxy reward rises while external quality falls is different from one where both collapse, different again from a run where the proxy is under-aligned from the start, and different from evaluator-specific disagreement. The paper tries to make these distinctions explicit at both checkpoint and prompt-transition levels.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, since it does not change pretraining recipes, data, or optimization. Still, it is useful for the post-training side of the loop and for understanding training signal quality. The main value is methodological. First, it separates several failure mechanisms that are often conflated under the label of reward hacking. Second, it shows that row-level transition analysis can reveal localized failures that disappear under checkpoint averages. That is useful for anyone studying RLHF dynamics, judge reliability, or reward-model overoptimization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental setup is a compact but fairly complete RLHF pipeline: an SFT starting point, a learned reward model, PPO with different KL settings, DPO evaluations, uncertainty-penalized PPO, reward uncertainty estimated via Monte Carlo dropout, approximate KL drift, and lexical diversity and repetition diagnostics, plus two external LLM judges. The novelty is not in these ingredients individually, but in how they are used to define a failure taxonomy.

The key design choice is to classify transitions rather than isolated checkpoints. For each prompt, the paper compares the change in proxy reward R_phi, primary judge score R_dagger, and secondary judge score R_dagger_2 between two checkpoints. The direction of the primary judge defines the main class, while the second judge is used to detect evaluator disagreement. This yields categories such as stable alignment, reward hacking, optimization collapse, proxy under-alignment, conservative stagnation, and evaluator gaming. The benefit is that it localizes where and when failure begins, instead of averaging everything into a single checkpoint score.

The paper also explores early-warning prediction using only pre-transition signals, including reward uncertainty, approximate policy drift, repetition, and diversity. UP-PPO is treated carefully: it is not a new architecture, only a shaped-reward PPO variant where uncertainty is subtracted from the reward before computing the scalar advantage. The paper keeps mitigation separate from diagnosis, which is the right framing here.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use GPT-2-scale policies and Anthropic HH-RLHF prompts. The focus is on how different PPO regimes, DPO evaluation, and UP-PPO distribute across failure categories. One explicit result reported in the text is that aggressive PPO produces 37 reward-hacking transitions out of 256 row-level transitions, or 14.45%. PPO with beta = 0.03 still shows a non-trivial reward-hacking share of 9.38%.

A central empirical point is that many failures are visible only at the row level. Checkpoint averages can hide localized degradation on specific prompts. Another important result is that judge disagreement is treated as a first-class failure mode rather than mere evaluation noise. A transition can look like improvement under one judge and degradation under another, which changes how one should interpret apparent reward hacking. UP-PPO appears more conservative than aggressive PPO and reduces some obvious failures, but the paper does not claim that it solves the problem in a general sense. The provided excerpt does not include the full set of tables and metrics, so no additional numbers should be invented.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the taxonomy section to understand why the authors insist on transition-based, row-level classification instead of checkpoint-level aggregates. Then read the experimental design carefully to keep the scope in view: small models, HH-RLHF prompts, two LLM judges, and UP-PPO as uncertainty-penalized reward shaping rather than a new RL method. Finish with the taxonomy tables and a few prompt-level case studies. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, how robust is the taxonomy to judge choice and threshold settings? Second, would the same categories remain informative at larger scale, with stronger reward models and reasoning-heavy RL setups? If you only want the main methodological takeaway, focus on row-level localization and two-judge disagreement.

recommendation.zh: 读 taxonomy 和 transition 定义即可；setup 偏小，但能校准“RL 信号=质量”的天真假设。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and transition definitions; the setup is small, but it usefully weakens the naive ‘RL signal equals quality’ prior.

paper.title: Building Better Activation Oracles
paper.abstract: Activation Oracles (AOs) are promising methods for interpreting residual stream activations. However, current AOs face important issues, such as hallucinations and vagueness. Additionally, text-inversion confounds make them hard to evaluate. To this end, we improve the Activation Oracle (AO) training regime in four ways: training on on-policy rollouts, improving the conversational dataset, feeding more layers and an improvement to the injection formula. The capability improvements are marginal,

summary.core_problem: Activation Oracles（AOs）是将LLM内部激活映射到自然语言解释的微调模型，但现有AO存在三个关键问题：幻觉（输出虚假信息）、模糊（输出通用不可证伪的回答）、以及text-inversion混淆（模型通过重建周围文本而非真正理解激活来回答问题，导致评估困难）。
summary.importance: 对可解释性研究有具体推动：提供了首个针对AO的综合评测套件AObench，以及一系列工程改进经验。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，改进后的AO可以更可靠地用于分析模型内部表征，从而为理解训练动态、设计更好的训练目标提供诊断工具。但能力提升幅度有限，属于工程性改进而非范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 四个改进方向：1) 构建新的对话数据集：用Sonnet 4.6基于目标模型的CoT生成QA对，前缀+后缀结构设计确保问题难以仅从前缀文本回答（抗text-inversion），但可从前缀激活回答；2) 增加激活注入层数：从随机选择单层改为注入21-25层的5个连续层；3) 用on-policy数据（待解释模型的生成文本）替代FineWeb预训练数据做past/future-lens训练；4) 改进激活注入公式增大注入强度。核心创新是新数据集和AObench评测套件。
summary.experiments: 关键发现：仅替换LatentQA数据集一项就带来全面评测提升；单层注入在第22层（约62%深度）性能峰值；5层连续注入带来额外提升，尤其在模型差异（model diffing）任务上；on-policy数据替换FineWeb仅有小幅但可测量的提升；在Ivanova et al.任务上的窄范围post-training持续无法超过简单linear probe性能。所有实验基于Karvonen et al. (2025)的原始AO配方做消融。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，约20分钟。重点看：第3章Improving Activation Oracle training中的数据集构造细节（第3.1节附近）和层注入消融；图3（数据集替换消融）、图6（on-policy替换消融）；AObench的评测维度设计。核心价值在工程经验和评测套件，而非理论突破。
summary.authors_note: 机构含CES（Center for Effective Altruism/可解释性研究社区）等；代码开源：https://github.com/japhba/activation_oracles；模型和数据发布在HuggingFace ceselder collection下。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation Oracles (AOs) are finetuned LLMs that map internal LLM activations to natural language explanations. Current AOs suffer from hallucination (outputting false information), vagueness (outputting generic unfalsifiable answers), and text-inversion confounds (the model can succeed by reconstructing surrounding text rather than truly understanding activations, making evaluation unreliable).
summary_en.importance: Practical engineering improvements to AO training and the first comprehensive evaluation suite (AObench) for AO quality. For pretraining research, better AOs can serve as more reliable diagnostic tools for analyzing model internal representations, training dynamics, and designing better objectives. However, capability gains are marginal—this is engineering refinement rather than a paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: Four improvements: 1) New conversational dataset built with Sonnet 4.6 using target model CoT traces, structured as prefix+suffix QA to ensure questions are hard to answer from prefix text alone (anti-text-inversion) but solvable from prefix activations. 2) Multi-layer activation injection: feeding 5 contiguous layers (21-25) instead of random single layers. 3) On-policy data (generations from the model being interpreted) replacing FineWeb for past/future-lens training. 4) Increased activation injection magnitude. Core novelties are the new dataset and AObench.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: Replacing LatentQA alone yields broad evaluation uplifts; single-layer injection peaks at layer 22 (~62% depth); 5-layer contiguous injection gives additional gains especially on model diffing tasks; on-policy replacement of FineWeb yields only small but measurable improvements; narrow post-training on Ivanova et al. tasks consistently fails to outperform simple linear probes. All ablations are on Karvonen et al. (2025) recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, ~20 minutes. Focus on: Section 3 dataset construction details and layer ablation; Figure 3 (dataset ablation) and Figure 6 (on-policy ablation); AObench evaluation dimension design. Primary value is engineering experience and evaluation infrastructure, not theoretical breakthroughs.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include CES (interpretability research community). Code: https://github.com/japhba/activation_oracles; models and data on HuggingFace ceselder collection.

recommendation.zh: 不是能力突破，但评测思路比方法本身更值钱；做 interpretability 的人应先看 AObench 设计，再决定是否跟 AO 这条线。
recommendation.en: Not a capability leap, but the evaluation cleanup is the real payload; read AObench first, then decide whether Activation Oracles are worth your time.

paper.title: The Deliberative Illusion: Diagnosing Factual Attrition and Stance Homogenization in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation

summary.core_problem: 多智能体“讨论/审议”在提升事实性与多样性上是否真的有效，还是会出现事实信息流失（factual attrition）与立场同质化（stance homogenization）。
summary.importance: 属于对 multi-agent deliberation 的失效模式诊断：如果结论成立，会直接影响用“多代理互评/互辩”来替代更强监督信号（人类标注、检索证据、验证器）的路线选择。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕多轮代理交互过程做过程级分析：跟踪事实陈述在轮次间的保留/丢失、立场分布随轮次收敛的趋势，并将其与单模型生成或不同交互协议作对照，以定位“讨论导致信息被平均化/稀释”的机制性迹象。
summary.experiments: 题目与摘要信息不足，无法确认所用模型、任务集、交互协议（投票/辩论/critique）、以及量化指标与提升幅度；更像是现象学诊断而非大规模系统报告。
summary.authors_note: Xi’an Jiaotong University、National University of Singapore、Yunnan University、A*STAR；Min-Yen Kan、Nancy F. Chen 团队常做 NLP 评测与分析类工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether multi-agent LLM deliberation truly improves factuality and diversity, or instead causes factual attrition and stance homogenization over rounds.
summary_en.importance: A failure-mode diagnosis of deliberation-style multi-agent setups; if true, it weakens the case for replacing stronger supervision (human labels, retrieval evidence, verifiers) with “agents debating each other”.
summary_en.technical_approach: Process-level analysis across interaction rounds: track retention/loss of factual claims and measure stance distribution collapse, comparing against single-model baselines and alternative protocols to isolate averaging/dilution effects.
summary_en.experiments: Insufficient public details (no abstract provided) to confirm models, datasets, protocols, or effect sizes; likely an observational/diagnostic study rather than a large-scale systems report.
summary_en.authors_note: Xi’an Jiaotong University, National University of Singapore, Yunnan University, A*STAR; groups around Min-Yen Kan and Nancy F. Chen often publish evaluation/analysis-oriented NLP work.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“多代理审议会变差”的反例素材库：只需确认指标定义与对照是否干净，别指望给出可直接复用的训练配方。
recommendation.en: Use it as a counterexample bank for deliberation: check whether the metrics and controls are clean, but don’t expect a reusable training recipe.

institutions: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)

paper.title: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
paper.abstract: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge. This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: effectiveness, i.e., how this capability is measured, and efficiency, i.e., how it is learned. On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the

summary.core_problem: 两个核心问题：一是Agent工具调用的评测结果高度依赖未标准化的实现细节，导致结果不可复现、排名不可靠；二是基于RL的工具调用训练存在严重的计算效率瓶颈，包括大量零方差prompt产生无效梯度、策略更新阶段耗时远高于轨迹生成阶段。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环研究有两方面具体影响：第一，指出了当前工具调用能力评测的系统性漏洞，为基座工具调用能力的标准化评估提供了校验基准；第二，提出的两个RL训练加速方法可直接推广到通用RLHF/GRPO训练流程，评测部分修正了领域普遍存在的评估偏差，效率部分可带来3-5倍的端到端训练墙钟时间加速，且不损失最终性能，属于RL后训练范式的实用级效率优化。
summary.technical_approach: 研究分为两部分：第一是评测有效性分析，以BFCL基准为案例，控制变量分析随机种子、系统提示词、多轮模板构造、交互历史处理方式等变量对最终性能的影响；第二是训练效率优化，提出两个互补的加速方法：1）在线预轨迹过滤，跳过前k个epoch中轨迹全部正确的prompt，避免冗余采样；2）方差感知的轨迹下采样，仅选择奖励方差最大的子集轨迹用于策略更新，在保留梯度信息量的前提下减少更新阶段的计算量。与现有方法的区别：预过滤方法之前仅在数学推理RL训练中尝试，在工具调用场景下仅需跳过1-2个epoch的正确prompt即可生效；方差感知下采样的现有研究没有专门针对工具调用RL中更新阶段占比极高的特性做适配。
summary.experiments: 评测部分测试了Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Llama3.2-3B-Instruct共5个主流模型，发现不同实现细节下的性能波动最高可达20%以上，多轮场景下波动幅度远高于单轮，甚至会导致模型排名反转。训练效率部分训练了Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct（单轮）和Qwen3-4B（多轮）两个模型，发现RL训练中最高80%的prompt属于零方差prompt，即所有轨迹奖励相同、无梯度贡献，策略更新阶段的计算成本是轨迹生成阶段的3-5倍；两个加速方法结合可带来3-5倍的端到端墙钟时间加速，最终工具调用性能与全量训练无统计差异，消融实验显示仅预过滤即可带来约2倍加速，仅方差感知下采样即可带来约1.5-2倍加速。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点关注第3节的评测变量控制实验，特别是图2-4的性能波动和排名反转结果、第4节的RL训练效率瓶颈分析，即图5-6的零方差比例和时间占比统计、第5节的两个加速方法的消融实验；核心创新点一是对工具调用评测脆弱性的系统性量化，二是针对RL训练中零梯度和更新高成本问题的极简有效优化；值得深挖的点包括：评测脆弱性的结论是否可以推广到其他Agent能力评测、零方差prompt的分布特性是否可以用于训练数据的预处理、方差感知下采样的最优比例是否和任务类型相关。
summary.authors_note: Amazon，作者为Amazon Nova团队研究人员，该团队开发了Nova-1模型，是本次评估的模型之一。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core problems are addressed: first, agent tool-calling evaluation results are highly sensitive to unstandardized implementation details, leading to non-reproducible results and unreliable leaderboard rankings; second, RL-based tool-calling training suffers from severe computational efficiency bottlenecks, including a large share of zero-variance prompts that produce no valid gradients, and policy update stages that take far more time than rollout generation.
summary_en.importance: It delivers two concrete impacts on pretrain-posttrain closed-loop research: first, it identifies systematic flaws in current tool-calling capability evaluation, providing a validation baseline for standardized assessment of foundation model tool-calling capabilities; second, the two proposed RL training acceleration methods can be directly generalized to general RLHF/GRPO training pipelines. The evaluation analysis corrects widespread assessment biases in the field, and the efficiency optimizations deliver 3-5x end-to-end wall-clock speedup without sacrificing final performance, representing a practical efficiency improvement for RL post-training paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Research is split into two parts. For evaluation effectiveness, controlled variable analysis is conducted on the BFCL benchmark to measure the impact of random seeds, system prompts, multi-turn template construction, and interaction history handling on final performance. For training efficiency, two complementary acceleration methods are proposed: 1) Online pre-rollout filtering, which skips prompts whose rollouts were all correct in the previous k epochs to avoid redundant sampling; 2) Variance-aware rollout down-sampling, which selects only the subset of rollouts with the highest reward variance for policy update, reducing update-stage computation while retaining gradient information. Differences from prior work: Pre-filtering was previously only tested on math reasoning RL training. For tool-calling scenarios, skipping correct prompts for just 1-2 epochs is sufficient to deliver gains. Variance-aware down-sampling was not previously adapted to the unique characteristic of tool-calling RL where the update stage dominates wall-clock time.
summary_en.experiments: For evaluation analysis, 5 mainstream models are tested: Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct. Performance fluctuations can exceed 20% across different implementation choices, with far larger fluctuations in multi-turn settings than single-turn, even leading to reversed model rankings. For training efficiency, two models are trained: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct for single-turn tool-calling and Qwen3-4B for multi-turn tool-calling. Up to 80% of prompts in RL training are zero-variance prompts with identical rewards across all rollouts and no gradient contribution, and the policy update stage costs 3-5x more computation than rollout generation. The combination of the two acceleration methods delivers 3-5x end-to-end wall-clock speedup with no statistically significant difference in final tool-calling performance compared to full training. Ablation studies show pre-filtering alone delivers ~2x speedup, and variance-aware down-sampling alone delivers ~1.5-2x speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for controlled evaluation variable experiments, especially Figures 2-4 for performance fluctuation and ranking reversal, Section 4 for RL training efficiency bottleneck analysis, specifically Figures 5-6 for zero-variance share and time breakdown, and Section 5 for ablation studies of the two acceleration methods. Core innovations include the systematic quantification of tool-calling evaluation fragility, and simple, effective optimizations for zero-gradient and high update cost issues in RL training. Worth further exploration: whether evaluation fragility findings generalize to other agent capability evaluations, distribution characteristics of zero-variance prompts for training data preprocessing, and whether optimal down-sampling ratio correlates with task type.
summary_en.authors_note: Amazon, authors are researchers from the Amazon Nova team, which developed Nova-1, one of the evaluated models.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你做 tool-use/RL 的实验习惯：先别信 leaderboard，先复查 prompt、history carry-over 和无效 rollout 比例；至少把评测协议和 token waste 统计补上。
recommendation.en: This should change how you run tool-use/RL experiments: trust no leaderboard before auditing prompt templates, history carry-over, and wasted-rollout ratios; at minimum, add protocol controls and token-waste accounting.

paper.title: TrustLDM: Benchmarking Trustworthiness in Language Diffusion Models

summary.core_problem: TrustLDM 评测语言扩散模型在任意顺序生成和带后文条件生成时的可信性风险，重点是安全、隐私和公平性。核心问题是：现有 LLM 安全评测大多假设从左到右生成，不能覆盖 LDM 中 suffix/post-context、动态生成位置和不同解码顺序带来的风险。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于评测资产，对新型语言建模范式有参考价值。LDM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练目标和解码方式改变了安全控制点：AR 模型通常可以把风险拦截放在早期 token 或 prefix 条件上，而 LDM 会同时受前文、后文、mask 位置和更新顺序影响。TrustLDM 的主要启发是，非 AR 模型的 alignment 不能简单复用 AR 的评测协议；评测输入需要显式控制 context 位置、context 长度、generation length、block size 和 decoding order。
summary.technical_approach: TrustLDM 包含静态评测和自动化评测两部分。静态评测覆盖三类风险：安全使用 AdvBench 的 50 个 harmful questions 和 JailbreakBench 的 misuse behaviors；隐私使用 Mireshghallah 等工作的 500 个样例，把 LDM 模拟为数据库管理器并测试其是否泄露敏感信息；公平性从 UCI Adult 抽取 200 个性别均衡样例，让模型预测收入是否超过 50K，并观察不同性别组上的失败分布。评测模型包括 LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-MoE 和 Dream，其中 LLaDA-1.5 经过强化学习增强，Dream 来自自回归 backbone 改造。实验固定 temperature=0.0，默认 generation length 为 256，step size 为 256，block size 为 64，并在 instruct 版本上运行。评测变量包括 prefix/suffix context、短/长 context、六类静态 context、六种 decoding order，以及生成长度。TrustLDM-Auto 进一步用层级搜索为特定模型构造 adversarial context，先粗筛容易被利用的解码设置，再缩小搜索空间做 targeted exploration。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：只给用户 prompt、不添加额外 context 时，LDM 通常表现出较高可信性；一旦在 masked response 周围加入恶意 post-context，alignment 行为明显下降。后文条件比传统 prefix-only 设置更能暴露 LDM 的特殊弱点，因为模型在填充 mask 时会同时利用未来文本。实验还显示，context 更长不一定攻击更强，原因可能与模型容量和长上下文利用能力有关。decoding order 和 generation length 会显著改变评测结果，说明 LDM 的风险不是单一 prompt 属性，而是 prompt、mask 布局和采样过程共同决定。TrustLDM-Auto 在所有模型和三类维度上达到接近完全成功的攻击效果，说明静态 benchmark 可能低估模型特异性漏洞。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。优先看 benchmark design：三类风险数据如何构造、prefix/suffix 与长短 context 如何组合、六种 decoding order 如何定义。然后看四个模型的主结果表，特别是无 context、malicious prefix、malicious suffix/post-context 的差异。TrustLDM-Auto 的层级搜索流程值得单独看，因为它说明 LDM 评测不应只固定一种解码设置。若关注 LDM 预训练或 post-training，应重点思考 alignment 数据是否需要覆盖后文条件、任意 mask 填充和不同生成顺序。

summary_en.core_problem: TrustLDM evaluates trustworthiness risks in language diffusion models under arbitrary-order generation and post-context conditioning. The main issue is that most existing LLM safety benchmarks assume left-to-right generation, while LDMs can condition on suffixes, dynamic masked positions, and different decoding schedules.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to new language-modeling paradigms. LDMs, masked LMs, and any-order LMs change where safety control happens. In autoregressive models, risk is often handled through prefix conditioning and early-token behavior. In LDMs, the generated span can be affected by prefix, suffix, mask layout, generation length, and update order. The paper’s useful message is that alignment evaluation for non-AR models needs its own protocol; reusing AR benchmarks can miss important failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: TrustLDM has a static benchmark and an automated evaluation pipeline. The static benchmark covers safety, privacy, and fairness. For safety, it uses 50 harmful questions from AdvBench and misuse behaviors from JailbreakBench. For privacy, it uses 500 examples from prior privacy-evaluation work and frames the LDM as a database manager queried for sensitive information. For fairness, it samples 200 gender-balanced examples from the UCI Adult dataset and asks the model to predict whether income exceeds 50K, then analyzes failure distributions across gender groups. The evaluated models are LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, LLaDA-MoE, and Dream. LLaDA-1.5 is strengthened through reinforcement learning, while Dream is adapted from an autoregressive backbone. The experiments fix temperature at 0.0 and use 256 generation length, 256 step size, and 64 block size by default on instruct models. The benchmark varies prefix versus suffix context, short versus long context, six static-context categories, six decoding orders, and generation length. TrustLDM-Auto adds a hierarchical search procedure that constructs model-specific adversarial contexts by first identifying vulnerable decoding settings and then narrowing the search for targeted attacks.
summary_en.experiments: The main finding is that LDMs are relatively trustworthy when only the user prompt is provided, but their alignment degrades clearly when malicious post-contexts are attached around masked responses. Suffix or future-context conditioning exposes a weakness that prefix-only AR-style evaluation does not cover. Longer contexts are not always more harmful, likely because limited model capacity and context utilization constrain the effect. Decoding order and generation length also change the measured risk, so the failure mode is not just a property of the prompt; it depends on the masking and denoising process. TrustLDM-Auto achieves near-perfect attack performance across the evaluated models and dimensions, suggesting that fixed static tests can underestimate model-specific vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the benchmark design: how the three risk dimensions are instantiated, how prefix and suffix contexts are constructed, and how the six decoding orders are defined. Then read the main result tables comparing no-context, malicious-prefix, and malicious-suffix settings. The TrustLDM-Auto hierarchical search is worth separate attention because it shows why LDM evaluation should not fix a single decoding configuration. For readers working on LDM pretraining or post-training, the key question is whether alignment data should explicitly cover suffix conditioning, arbitrary mask filling, and multiple generation orders.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 的安全评测不能照搬 AR；先看任务定义和失败案例，分数表反而次要。
recommendation.en: Trust evaluation for diffusion LMs cannot simply inherit AR assumptions; read the task design and failure cases before the score tables.

CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

paper.title: PolySpeech-100: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across 100+ Languages and Dialects
paper.abstract: While End-to-End (E2E) Speech-Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs) are rapidly evolving, their evaluation methodologies remain limited to the era of simple transcription. Existing benchmarks suffer from three critical limitations: a pronounced bias towards high-resource languages, a focus on low-level recognition (ASR) rather than semantic reasoning, and a neglect of regional dialects. To bridge this gap, we introduce PolySpeech-100, a massive-scale benchmark designed to assess `native-level' spe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 Speech-LLM 评测仍停留在 ASR 时代的问题：现有评测偏向英语和普通话，任务多是转写或简单指令，缺少对低资源语言、方言和语义理解的系统测试。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在评测信号。PolySpeech-100 把语音模型的能力边界从“能否听清”推进到“能否在语音输入上完成跨语言阅读理解”。这对语音 LM、native multimodal LM 和统一语音-文本预训练有参考意义：如果模型只依赖转写能力，重口音和方言场景会暴露明显短板；如果预训练捕获了声学、韵律和方言线索，端到端模型可能优于 ASR+LLM 级联系统。
summary.technical_approach: 数据基础来自 Belebele 的平行阅读理解任务，保留 passage、question、multiple-choice options 的跨语言语义对齐，因此不同语言之间的差异更多来自语音建模和语言覆盖，而不是题目内容不同。数据构建采用三路混合策略：73 种语言使用 2M-BELEBELE 的人工录音作为高保真基准；低资源语言和方言通过生成式语音补齐；中文方言重点覆盖 19 个 regional variants。合成部分使用 CosyVoice 3.0，通过 instruction 控制口音、语调和方言特征，而不是传统 TTS 的平直朗读。作者还做了多层质量控制，并报告合成语音评测结果与人工录音评测结果有较高相关性，r=0.83，用来支持“高质量合成语音可作为稀缺方言评测代理”的设定。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 22 个模型，包括商业 API、开源端到端 Speech-LLM，以及传统 ASR+LLM pipeline。主要观察有三点。第一，在重方言场景中，开源端到端模型相对传统 ASR pipeline 更有优势，说明 ASR 前端可能过滤掉对语义判断有用的声学细节。第二，在 Zulu、Lao 等低资源语言上，多数开源模型退化明显，而商业模型更稳，提示训练数据覆盖和语音 tokenizer/encoder 规模仍是核心瓶颈。第三，在音频模态上直接要求 CoT 并不总是有效，许多 Speech-LLM 在直接回答时反而更好，说明文本 LLM 中常见的推理提示策略不能简单迁移到语音输入。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。建议重点看 Dataset Creation 中 Belebele 到语音 QA 的转换方式、人工录音与合成语音的分层设计、合成语音质量验证，尤其是 r=0.83 相关性实验。实验部分重点看端到端 Speech-LLM 与 ASR+LLM 在方言上的差异，以及 direct answer 和 CoT prompting 的对比。对基座预训练研究来说，值得带走的是评测设计思想：方言、低资源语言和语义理解应同时出现，否则很容易把 ASR 能力误判为语音理解能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in Speech-LLM evaluation: current benchmarks are still close to ASR evaluation, with strong bias toward English and Standard Mandarin, limited semantic reasoning, and weak coverage of dialects and low-resource languages.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is the evaluation signal rather than a new training recipe. PolySpeech-100 tests whether a speech-native model can answer comprehension questions directly from speech across many languages and dialects. This matters for speech LMs and native multimodal pretraining because cascaded ASR+LLM systems can lose accent, prosody, and dialectal cues before the LLM sees the input. The benchmark makes that failure mode explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark is built on Belebele, which provides parallel reading-comprehension passages and multiple-choice questions across languages. This gives controlled semantic content while varying the spoken realization. The dataset construction uses a hybrid pipeline. For 73 languages, it reuses human recordings from 2M-BELEBELE as the high-fidelity track. For dialects and low-resource languages, it uses synthetic speech generation to increase coverage. The dialect portion includes 19 Chinese regional variants. The synthesis pipeline uses CosyVoice 3.0 with instruction control over accent and intonation, rather than relying on conventional TTS. The authors add multi-level quality assurance and report a correlation of r=0.83 between synthetic-speech-based evaluation and human-recording-based evaluation, supporting synthetic speech as a practical proxy when real recordings are scarce.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 22 systems, including proprietary APIs, open-source end-to-end Speech-LLMs, and ASR+LLM cascades. The reported findings are mainly qualitative in the provided text. First, on heavy dialects, open-source end-to-end models can outperform ASR pipelines, suggesting that acoustic information removed by ASR may be useful for downstream semantic disambiguation. Second, on low-resource languages such as Zulu and Lao, many open-source models degrade substantially, while commercial models remain more robust. Third, Chain-of-Thought prompting in the audio modality is not consistently helpful; under the evaluated settings, direct answers often work better than asking the model to produce intermediate reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset construction section: how Belebele is converted into spoken QA, how human and synthetic tracks are separated, and how synthetic speech quality is validated. In the results, look for the comparison between end-to-end Speech-LLMs and ASR+LLM pipelines on dialectal inputs, and the direct-answer versus CoT prompting comparison. The useful takeaway for foundation-model work is the benchmark design: dialect coverage, low-resource coverage, and semantic comprehension need to be tested together.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做语音 LM 或统一多模态，这个 benchmark 值得存档；重点看 open E2E 胜过 cascade 的条件边界，别把结论外推到所有语音任务。
recommendation.en: If you work on speech LMs or unified multimodal pretraining, keep this benchmark on file; focus on the boundary conditions where open end-to-end models beat cascades, and do not overgeneralize beyond this setup.

institutions: Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

paper.title: BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
paper.abstract: While agents are increasingly spending more resources, today agent cost is mostly measured only after execution. A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric. We first systematically define budget estimation as internal budgets (from agent computation) and external budgets (from agent actions). We then formalize budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent研究只把预算（token消耗、API调用费用、时间等）作为事后统计指标，从未系统评估Agent是否能在执行过程中主动估计剩余预算并判断任务可行性。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出并评估Agent的预算感知能力。对于预训练研究的启发在于：这是一种独立于任务表现的元认知能力，现有模型在这方面表现普遍较差；SFT可以唤起潜在的可行性判断能力（25.5%→≈90%），但区间估计需要RL配合，这对后训练阶段能力塑造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将预算分为两类：内部预算（Agent自身推理的token消耗）和外部预算（行动带来的API费用、金钱、时间等）。提出渐进区间估计（progressive interval estimation）：在Agent每步执行后，要求其给出剩余预算的上下界置信区间，或声明任务不可完成。评估通过rollout-replay协议实现：先无约束记录完整轨迹，再在每步单独查询Agent对剩余预算的估计。分解为三个子能力：可行性预测、早期失败检测、区间校准。
summary.experiments: 在4个环境（Sokoban、Search-R1、SWE-bench、企业级Warehouse）上评测5个前沿模型。关键发现：(1)任务表现与预算感知弱相关（r≈0.35），强表现模型不一定有强预算感知；(2)SFT使Qwen-7B可行性准确率从25.5%提升至≈90%，但区间覆盖率SFT+RL后仅达47%；(3)所有20个模型-环境对都偏乐观，弱模型更乐观；(4)失败轨迹中，模型在60%预算消耗后仍预测可行性>70%，警报只在最后20%时才触发；(5)基于不可行预测的early-stop策略可节省28%-64%token，仅损失1.6-4.2个百分点成功率；(6)RL无SFT暖启动时预算估计训练完全崩溃。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读§3（评估协议定义）、§4-§5（核心实验发现）、§6（训练干预结果）。第2节的单点估计失败分析提供了很好的动机。图5展示的系统性乐观偏差和图6展示的首步/全步估计不一致值得细看。整体为概念性+实验性论文，无复杂数学推导，约45分钟可读完核心内容。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent research has only treated budget (token consumption, API costs, time, etc.) as an ex-post metric, never systematically evaluating whether agents can proactively estimate remaining budget and judge task feasibility mid-execution.
summary_en.importance: First systematic formulation and evaluation of agent budget awareness. For pretraining research, the key insight is that budget awareness is a distinct metacognitive capability separable from task performance. Existing models are universally weak at it; SFT alone unlocks latent feasibility detection (25.5%→≈90%), but interval calibration requires RL—relevant for post-training capability shaping.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes budget into internal (token consumption from agent reasoning) and external (cost of agent actions: API calls, money, time, inventory). Proposes progressive interval estimation: at each execution step, the agent must predict an upper/lower bound on remaining budget, or declare the task impossible. Evaluation uses a rollout-replay protocol: record a full unconstrained trajectory, then separately query the agent at every turn given logged progress. Decomposes into three sub-capabilities: feasibility prediction, early failure detection, and interval calibration.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated five frontier models across four environments (Sokoban, Search-R1, SWE-bench, enterprise Warehouse). Key findings: (1) Task performance and budget awareness are weakly correlated (r≈0.35); strong task models are not necessarily strong budget estimators. (2) SFT raises Qwen-7B feasibility accuracy from 25.5% to ≈90%, but interval coverage reaches only 47% after SFT+RL. (3) All 20 model-environment pairs are optimistically biased; weaker models are more optimistic. (4) On failed trajectories, models still predict >70% feasibility after 60% of budget is consumed; alarms fire only in the final 20%. (5) Early-stop keyed on impossible predictions saves 28%–64% of tokens on failed runs at cost of 1.6–4.2pp success rate. (6) RL without SFT warm-start collapses entirely.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 (evaluation protocol definition), §4–§5 (core empirical findings), and §6 (training interventions). Section 2 provides a concise motivating probe of single-point estimation failures. Figures 5 (systematic optimism bias) and 6 (first-turn vs all-turn disagreement) are particularly informative. Conceptual + experimental paper with no heavy math; core content readable in ~45 minutes.
