paper.title: Stress-Testing the Reasoning Competence of LLMs With Proofs Under Minimal Formalism
paper.abstract: We introduce ProofGrid, a benchmark suite for evaluating LLM reasoning through machine-checkable proofs rather than final answers alone. ProofGrid contains 15 tasks spanning proof writing, proof checking, proof masking, and proof gap-filling. Tasks are expressed in minimal formal notation, especially NDL, a compact natural-deduction language that fits in short prompts and supports precise, auditable verification. This yields mechanical, reproducible, and fine-grained evaluation rather than judgm

summary.core_problem: 现有大模型逻辑推理基准仅评估最终答案的正确性，既无法区分模型是通过有效推理还是偶然巧合、虚假关联得到正确结论，也无法评估构建、验证证明这类核心数学推理能力。同时多数基准允许模型利用预训练阶段积累的固化知识，无法衡量模型原生的流体推理能力。
summary.importance: 该基准提供了排除知识混淆的纯推理能力评测工具，能够细粒度区分不同模型的推理能力差异，为后续推理方向的RL训练、推理能力缩放研究提供更可靠的评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 构建PROOFGRID基准套件，覆盖15项任务，分为证明写作、证明检查、证明掩码、证明补全四类。设计极简的自然演绎语言NDL和精简等式逻辑作为形式化载体，评测结果可机械检查、可复现，不需要人类或LLM担任评委。所有问题均为纯抽象逻辑问题，排除固化知识干扰，难度经过校准覆盖从基础推理到复杂结构推理的全范围。
summary.experiments: 在24款闭源和开源模型上完成评测，基准可以高分辨率区分不同模型的推理能力，配套的大量错误分析暴露了现有模型在长推理链结构一致性、错误定位能力上的普遍缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读基准任务设计章节和24款模型的整体排名结果，错误分析部分可快速浏览，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing logical reasoning benchmarks for LLMs only evaluate final answer accuracy. They cannot distinguish between correct conclusions derived from valid reasoning and those obtained by chance or spurious correlations, nor can they assess core mathematical reasoning capabilities such as proof construction and verification. Most benchmarks also allow models to rely on crystallized knowledge accumulated during pretraining, rather than measuring native fluid reasoning ability.
summary_en.importance: This benchmark provides a knowledge-confound-free evaluation tool for pure reasoning capability, enables fine-grained differentiation of reasoning performance across models, and offers more reliable evaluation signals for future research on RL for reasoning training and reasoning capability scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The PROOFGRID benchmark suite includes 15 tasks grouped into four categories: proof writing, proof checking, proof masking, and proof gap-filling. It uses a minimalist natural deduction language (NDL) and stripped-down equational logic as formal representations. All evaluation results are mechanically checkable, reproducible, and require no human or LLM judges. All tasks are formulated as abstract logic problems to eliminate interference from crystallized knowledge, with calibrated difficulty covering basic to structurally complex reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 24 closed-source and open-source models, achieves high resolution in differentiating model reasoning capabilities. Extensive error analysis reveals common flaws of current models in structural consistency of long reasoning chains and error localization ability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the benchmark task design section and overall ranking results of the 24 evaluated models; error analysis section can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是提方法的 paper，但评测设计比多数“答案对错”基准干净；做 reasoning pretrain 或 RL 信号设计的人，先看 benchmark 任务定义和验证协议。
recommendation.en: Not a model paper, but the measurement is cleaner than most answer-only reasoning benchmarks; if you work on reasoning pretraining or RL signals, read the task design and verification protocol first.

paper.title: RTLC -- Research, Teach-to-Learn, Critique: A three-stage prompting paradigm inspired by the Feynman Learning Technique that lifts LLM-as-judge accuracy on JudgeBench with no fine-tuning
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is now the default measurement instrument for open-ended generation, but on the public JudgeBench benchmark even strong instruction-tuned judges barely scrape past random on objective-correctness pairwise items. We introduce RTLC, a three-stage prompting recipe -- Research, Teach-to-Learn, Critique -- that promotes a single black-box LLM into an ensemble-of-thought judge with no fine-tuning, retrieval, or external tools. Stage 1 wraps the input in a fixed pedagogical scaffold port

summary.core_problem: LLM-as-a-judge 在开放式生成评测中常被使用，但在 JudgeBench 的客观正确性成对判断上表现不稳，论文试图用纯 prompting 提升 judge 准确率。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测流程和 prompting recipe，而不是训练方法。它对 RLHF/RLAIF 里的自动评审信号质量有间接意义，但实验范围较窄，主要应作为评测工程线索看待。
summary.technical_approach: RTLC 包含 Research、Teach-to-Learn、Critique 三阶段：先用固定教学式 scaffold 让模型研究问题并尝试解释，再以 temperature 0.4 采样 10 个独立 verdict，最后让模型在 temperature 0 下交叉比较候选 verdict 和原问题，输出一个经过 critique 的最终判断。无需微调、检索或外部工具。
summary.experiments: 在 JudgeBench-GPT 的 350 个 hard pairwise items 上，Claude 3.7 Sonnet 从 vanilla single-shot prompt 的 64.6% pairwise accuracy 提升到 RTLC critique-of-10 的 78.6%，绝对提升 14.0 个百分点。摘要未说明其他模型、统计显著性、成本增长和对非 JudgeBench 数据的泛化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cisco Systems, Inc。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses weak and unstable LLM-as-a-judge performance on objective-correctness pairwise items in JudgeBench.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation-time prompting recipe, not a training method. It has indirect relevance to RLHF/RLAIF because judge quality affects supervision, but the evidence is narrow and should be treated as an evaluation-engineering result.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTLC has three stages: Research, Teach-to-Learn, and Critique. It first wraps the input in a pedagogical scaffold inspired by the Feynman learning technique, then samples 10 independent verdicts at temperature 0.4, and finally uses the model as a critic at temperature 0 to compare candidates against the original question and emit one verdict. No fine-tuning, retrieval, or tools are used.
summary_en.experiments: On JudgeBench-GPT with 350 hard pairwise items, Claude 3.7 Sonnet improves from 64.6% pairwise accuracy with a vanilla single-shot prompt to 78.6% with RTLC critique-of-10, a 14.0-point absolute gain. The excerpt does not report cross-model coverage, significance tests, inference cost, or out-of-benchmark generalization.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Cisco Systems, Inc.

recommendation.zh: 可把它当 judge prompting 的弱证据；只看实验表和失败例，别把 10-sample 自评当干净监督信号。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence for judge prompting; read the result table and failures, but do not confuse 10-sample self-critique with a clean supervision signal.

paper.title: LLMs as Implicit Imputers: Uncertainty Should Scale with Missing Information
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where the available context is incomplete or degraded. We argue that an LLM generating answers under incomplete context can be viewed as an implicit imputer, and evaluated against a criterion from the multiple imputation (MI) literature: uncertainty should scale with the amount of missing information. We assess this criterion on SQuAD, using a controlled framework in which context availability is varied across five levels. We eva

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在上下文缺失时输出答案的 uncertainty 是否会随 missing information 增加而合理上升。
summary.importance: 这是一个不确定性与幻觉评估分析，贡献是把 LLM under incomplete context 类比为 multiple imputation 中的隐式插补器，并用该标准检验采样式不确定性指标。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 SQuAD 上控制上下文可用程度，设置五个 evidence levels。它比较两类可由重复采样估计的 answer-level uncertainty：经验众数频率形式的 sampling-based confidence，以及 response entropy，并分析它们与 accuracy 的关系。
summary.experiments: 在 SQuAD 的上下文逐步移除实验中，confidence 在 accuracy 崩塌时仍保持偏高，不能反映 missingness；entropy 会随上下文移除上升，并且对 accuracy 的解释方差更高，二次拟合 R² 差距最高 0.057。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Stef van Buuren 来自 TNO、Leiden 和 Utrecht 相关机构；其长期工作与 multiple imputation 和统计方法有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM uncertainty increases appropriately as more information is removed from the context.
summary_en.importance: This is an uncertainty and hallucination analysis. It imports a criterion from multiple imputation: uncertainty should scale with the amount of missing information.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using SQuAD, the author varies context availability across five evidence levels. Two answer-level uncertainty measures are estimated from repeated sampling: empirical mode-frequency confidence and response entropy.
summary_en.experiments: When context is removed, confidence stays high even as accuracy collapses. Response entropy rises with missingness and explains more variance in accuracy, with a reported quadratic R² gap up to 0.057.
summary_en.authors_note: Stef van Buuren is affiliated with TNO, Leiden, and Utrecht-related institutions and is known for work on multiple imputation and statistical methodology.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验图和 uncertainty 定义即可；结论支持用 entropy 监控缺证场景，confidence 当可靠性指标偏危险。
recommendation.en: Skim the plots and uncertainty definitions; it supports entropy for missing-evidence monitoring and makes mode-frequency confidence look risky.

paper.title: AI Harness Engineering: A Runtime Substrate for Foundation-Model Software Agents
paper.abstract: Foundation models have transformed automated code generation, yet autonomous software-engineering agents remain unreliable in realistic development settings. The dominant explanation locates this gap in model capability. We propose a different locus: software-engineering capability emerges from a model-harness-environment system, in which a runtime substrate -- the harness -- mediates how a foundation-model agent observes a project, acts on it, receives feedback, and establishes that a change is

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么基础模型在自动代码生成上有进展，但软件工程 agent 在真实项目中仍不稳定，并将问题定位到 model-harness-environment 的运行时系统。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 系统抽象和评测协议，而不是模型训练方法。它把软件工程能力拆成模型能力与 harness 能力的组合，对设计仓库级 agent 评测和诊断有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AI Harness Engineering 概念，定义 harness 作为模型观察项目、调用工具、接收反馈、确认任务完成的运行时基座。它列出 11 类组件职责，包括任务规格、上下文选择、工具访问、项目记忆、任务状态、可观测性、失败归因、验证、权限、熵审计和干预记录，并提出 H0-H3 四级 runtime 支持阶梯和 trace-based evaluation protocol。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述框架和评测协议，未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、基线系统或定量提升结果。更像是概念框架/系统设计论文，而非大规模实证论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong Baptist University 和 Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why foundation models can generate code yet remain unreliable as autonomous software-engineering agents in realistic projects, and locates the gap in the model-harness-environment system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system abstraction and evaluation protocol for coding agents, not a model-training method. It decomposes software-engineering capability into model capability plus harness capability, which is useful for repository-level agent diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AI Harness Engineering, where the harness is the runtime substrate through which the model observes a project, acts, receives feedback, and establishes completion. They define eleven responsibilities—task specification, context selection, tool access, project memory, task state, observability, failure attribution, verification, permissions, entropy auditing, and intervention recording—and propose an H0-H3 ladder of runtime support plus a trace-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mainly presents a framework and protocol. It does not report model sizes, training data, baseline systems, or quantitative improvements, so the work appears closer to a conceptual systems paper than a large empirical study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hong Kong Baptist University and Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai.

recommendation.zh: 适合扫框架图和 11 个 harness 职责；它不是训练论文，但能帮你避免把 agent 失败全甩给模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework and the eleven harness responsibilities; it is not a training paper, but it helps avoid blaming every agent failure on the model.

paper.title: On Predicting the Post-training Potential of Pre-trained LLMs
paper.abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on downstream tasks is fundamentally constrained by the capabilities acquired during pre-training. However, traditional benchmarks like MMLU often fail to reflect a base model's plasticity in complex open-ended scenarios, leading to inefficient model selection. We address this by introducing a new task of predicting post-training potential - forecasting a base model's performance before post-training. We propose RuDE (Rubric-based Discriminative Ev

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“基座模型当前答得好不好”，而是“它经过指令微调或 RL 之后能长成多强”。问题的难点有两个。第一，base model 存在明显的 generation gap：它没有被训练成会按指令稳定输出开放式答案，直接拿开放任务测生成质量，测到的往往是不会聊天而不是不会学。第二，post-train 目标是开放式、多维度的，不能像选择题那样靠 exact match 评估。作者因此把问题重新定义成一个排序任务：在不做昂贵 post-training 的前提下，给一组 base model 排序，预测谁的 post-training potential 更高。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它把 pretrain→posttrain 之间长期缺失的“前验评估”问题单独拎了出来，而且给了一个比 MMLU、PPL 更贴近后续对齐收益的代理指标。这个问题很实际：很多团队在选 base model、选 checkpoint、选继续训练起点时，常常只能靠少量 benchmark 或直接试训。若这个预测信号可靠，就能减少试错成本，也能帮助理解“哪些预训练能力更容易被 post-training 激活”。贡献量级上，它更像一个评测与方法框架，而不是新的训练范式；但它切中的接口问题很关键，尤其适合做 base model selection、mid-training checkpoint selection、以及不同 tokenizer/数据配比方案的 ex ante 比较。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 RuDE（Rubric-based Discriminative Evaluation）。它不要求 base model 直接生成高质量回答，而是让模型在“好回答 / 坏回答”的对比中做判别，用判别能力去代理未来的生成潜力。这个设计建立在文中引用的 generation-evaluation consistency 假设上：一个模型若能稳定分辨更符合任务要求的回答，通常也更有可能在 post-training 后学会生成这类回答。

为了解决开放式任务评估标准不统一的问题，作者提出 4C taxonomy，把回答质量拆成四类约束：Competence、Content、Control、Compliance。虽然全文片段里没有把每一类展开到最细，但从任务构造可以看出，它们分别覆盖能力完成度、内容正确与充分性、格式/风格/结构控制，以及对指令和规则的遵守。作者不是直接写一个总分 rubric，而是为每个任务手工定义细粒度 rubric，再用这些 rubric 组合出 preferred / dispreferred response pairs。

数据构造上，作者把四类开放任务改写成 response discrimination 形式，覆盖 Medical、Legal & Finance、Complex Instruction Following、Creative Writing。关键是 generator-verifier pipeline：先生成候选回答，再通过 rubric 控制，构造“满足全部 rubric 的 preferred response”和“故意违反部分 rubric 的 dispreferred response”。这样得到的不是粗糙的正负样本，而是带有可解释错误类型的对比样本。RuDE 评估时，base model 只需判断哪一个回答更好，或者对候选回答做相对偏好打分。

和已有代理指标相比，区别很明确。MMLU 测的是知识回忆和选择题判断，PPL 测的是 token-level 拟合；两者都不直接触及开放式对齐任务中的格式控制、意图理解、约束满足。RuDE 则把评估对象从“知识是否记住”转成“是否具备学会对齐行为的判别基础”。这也是它与传统 reward model eval、preference eval 的不同之处：这里评的是未经 post-train 的 base model，并且目标是预测其可塑性，而不是评估一个已对齐模型的当前偏好质量。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很集中：RuDE 对 fully instruction-tuned 后性能的 Pearson 相关系数超过 90%，明显强于文中对比的传统基座评估信号。作者特别强调，MMLU 与开放式 post-training 表现相关性弱，这一点是全文立论基础之一。

任务覆盖四个领域：医疗、法律金融、复杂指令跟随、创意写作。评估对象是多组 pre-trained base models，随后再做 instruction tuning 或 RL，检查 RuDE 排名与最终生成评测排名是否一致。文中还给了一个更有说服力的案例：Qwen3-4B-Base 被 RuDE 预测为比 Qwen2.5-7B-Base 更有 post-training potential，而后续 RL 结果验证了这一点——也就是更小模型在经过 post-training 后反而超过更大模型。这个结果说明 RuDE 不只是“参数越大分越高”的 size proxy，而确实在捕捉某种与可塑性相关的能力。

从消融角度，值得注意的点大概率有三类。第一，判别式评估相对直接生成式评估更稳，因为它绕开了 base model 不会按指令作答的问题。第二，4C rubric 的细粒度控制比粗粒度偏好对更有信息量，因为错误类型可控。第三，不同任务域共同参与评估，比单一 benchmark 更能稳定预测泛化后的 post-training 表现。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但主结论已经足够明确：RuDE 的排序能力在 instruction tuning 和 RL 两种 post-training 设置下都成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你关心 pretrain/posttrain 接口，建议把引言、任务定义、4C taxonomy、数据构造流程和相关性实验认真看完。

优先看三处。第一，Figure 1：它给出 MMLU 与 post-training 开放任务表现相关性弱的证据，也是整篇工作的出发点。第二，Task Formulation 部分：这里把“预测 post-training potential”正式定义成 ranking problem，并解释为什么要用 discrimination proxy。第三，generator-verifier pipeline 与 rubric 设计：这是方法是否可扩展、是否会引入标注偏差的关键。

阅读时重点想三个问题。1）RuDE 测到的到底是“偏好判别能力”，还是更一般的 world knowledge + local consistency？2）4C rubric 是否足够覆盖不同 post-training 目标，尤其是 reasoning-heavy RL 任务？3）如果把它用于 checkpoint selection，它会不会偏向某些更会做判别、但生成学习率未必更高的模型。

预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；若要判断能否落地到内部模型选择流程，需要细看附录里的 rubric、pair 构造质量控制、以及相关性统计的置信区间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a practical but under-studied question: before spending compute on SFT or RL, can we predict which pretrained base model will yield the strongest post-trained model? The challenge is not ordinary base-model evaluation. A base model often cannot follow instructions well enough to be judged directly on open-ended tasks, creating a generation gap. At the same time, post-training targets are open-ended and multi-criteria, so simple exact-match or multiple-choice metrics do not capture the relevant capacity. The paper therefore formulates post-training potential prediction as a ranking problem over base models.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in making the pretrain-to-posttrain interface measurable. Standard proxies such as MMLU accuracy or perplexity are often used when choosing a base model or checkpoint, but they are weak indicators of how much alignment or agentic capability can be unlocked later. RuDE offers a more targeted proxy for model plasticity under post-training. This is not a new pretraining algorithm, but it is a useful evaluation layer for base-model selection, checkpoint selection during continual pretraining, and comparing data mixtures or architectures when the final objective is aligned open-ended behavior rather than raw likelihood.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is RuDE, short for Rubric-based Discriminative Evaluation. Instead of asking a base model to generate a strong open-ended answer, RuDE asks it to discriminate between a preferred and a dispreferred response. The motivation is that discrimination is easier than generation for a base model, and that the ability to recognize better responses may be a good proxy for the ability to learn to generate them after post-training.

To make open-ended evaluation systematic, the paper introduces a 4C taxonomy: Competence, Content, Control, and Compliance. These dimensions cover whether the response completes the task, whether the content is correct and adequate, whether formatting/style/structure constraints are followed, and whether explicit instructions or rules are obeyed. For each task, the authors manually define fine-grained rubrics under these dimensions.

The data pipeline is also important. Four open-ended domains are converted into response-discrimination datasets: medical, legal and finance, complex instruction following, and creative writing. A generator-verifier pipeline constructs contrastive pairs. Preferred responses satisfy all rubrics, while dispreferred responses intentionally violate selected rubrics. This gives the benchmark more structure than generic preference pairs, because the negative examples are tied to interpretable failure modes.

Relative to prior proxies, the distinction is clear. MMLU mainly measures knowledge recall and multiple-choice discrimination; perplexity measures token-level fit to pretraining data. Neither directly targets the ingredients that matter in post-training, such as instruction adherence, controllability, or alignment with human intent. RuDE instead evaluates whether the base model already contains a discriminative substrate that post-training can exploit.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is strong correlation with downstream post-training outcomes: RuDE scores achieve Pearson correlation above 90% with the performance of fully instruction-tuned models. This is substantially stronger than the weak correlation reported for traditional base-model metrics such as MMLU on open-ended post-training tasks.

The evaluation spans four domains and multiple pretrained base models, followed by actual post-training through instruction tuning or RL. The most concrete case highlighted in the paper is that RuDE predicts Qwen3-4B-Base to have higher post-training potential than Qwen2.5-7B-Base, and this ranking is later validated after RL. That result matters because it shows RuDE is not merely a size proxy.

The likely ablation message is threefold. First, discriminative evaluation is more reliable than direct generative evaluation for base models because it avoids the instruction-following bottleneck. Second, fine-grained rubric-controlled contrastive pairs are more informative than coarse preference labels. Third, evaluating across diverse open-ended domains improves robustness of the ranking signal. The excerpt does not include all tables, but the central result is clear: the ranking induced by RuDE tracks post-training outcomes under both instruction tuning and RL.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim-level read, focus on the introduction, task formulation, the 4C taxonomy, and the main correlation tables. Figure 1 is the anchor: it shows why MMLU-like metrics are insufficient for this problem. Then read the formal ranking setup to understand what exactly is being predicted. After that, inspect the generator-verifier pipeline and a few rubric examples to see whether the benchmark construction is careful or superficial.

Three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. First, is RuDE measuring genuine post-training plasticity, or mostly latent knowledge plus local preference discrimination? Second, how well do the 4C dimensions cover reasoning-heavy or tool-using post-training objectives? Third, if used for checkpoint selection, could it favor models that are good judges but not necessarily the easiest to optimize into strong generators?

A first pass should take around 30 to 45 minutes. If you want to operationalize it, spend extra time on the appendix for rubric design, pair construction quality control, and the statistical stability of the reported correlations.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得预训练团队认真看：如果相关性真能跨家族站住，checkpoint 选择和 early stopping 逻辑都要改；先盯住相关性分解和 RL 验证是否干净。
recommendation.en: Pretraining teams should read this carefully: if the correlation really holds across model families, it changes checkpoint selection and early-stopping logic; focus first on the correlation breakdowns and whether the RL validation is clean.

paper.title: Classifier Context Rot: Monitor Performance Degrades with Context Length
paper.abstract: Monitoring coding agents for dangerous behavior using language models requires classifying transcripts that often exceed 500K tokens, but prior agent monitoring benchmarks rarely contain transcripts longer than 100K tokens. We show that when used as classifiers, current frontier models fail to notice dangerous actions more often in longer transcripts. In particular, on a dataset that requires identifying when a coding agent takes a subtly dangerous action, Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, and Gemini 3.1 miss

summary.core_problem: 长上下文（>100K，甚至到 800K-1M tokens）下，用大模型做“代理行为监控分类器”时，为什么会系统性漏报危险行为，以及哪些工程化/训练化手段能缓解这种随 prefill 变长而恶化的 recall 崩塌。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在“提出新训练目标”，而在于把一个长期被 needle-in-a-haystack 评测粗略覆盖的问题，落到更贴近真实部署的“长代理 transcript 分类”场景：长 prefill 会让分类器式用法的有效信息提取能力显著退化，且退化幅度与危险行为的隐蔽性、出现位置强相关。这对长上下文预训练/中训（mid-train）目标设计、长序列监督信号构造、以及‘长上下文能力=能放进上下文窗口’这种过度乐观的假设都有警示意义。另一个重要点是：简单的 SFT 在长上下文分类上不稳定泛化，提示“长上下文能力”可能更像训练分布与推理策略共同决定的系统性质，而不是少量微调就能补齐的短板。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把监控任务形式化为：输入为包含 user/assistant/tool call/tool result 的完整 transcript，输出为是否存在危险/恶意动作的二分类（并配套不同提示词模板）。核心变量是“长 benign prefill”——将大量无害操作前缀拼接到原本较短、含攻击的 transcript 前，使危险动作在超长上下文的中后段出现，从而测量 recall 随上下文长度与位置变化的退化。

模型侧对比 Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Thinking，并显式控制/扫描“thinking token 预算/模式”（非思考、CoT、扩展思考等），以区分是‘注意力/检索失败’还是‘推理预算不足’。

缓解手段分三类：
1) 提示词与推理策略：更强的思考指令、CoT-List（先逐字列出可疑动作再判定）、增加 thinking tokens。
2) 输入结构干预：在 transcript 中周期性插入“提醒 monitor 任务”的短提示（reminder mitigation），相当于人为制造多个局部锚点，降低模型在长序列中遗忘任务目标或丢失判别特征的概率。
3) 系统级监控策略：不等 session 结束一次性监控，而是对随时间增长的子 transcript 多次增量监控（可带抽样以控成本），用多次判定覆盖“危险动作出现在中段但最终被长 prefill 冲淡”的情况。

训练侧尝试：对 GPT-4.1 做长上下文分类数据的微调，观察是否能把‘长 prefill 下的漏报’通过监督学习补上；结论是对相似任务可提升，但跨任务/分布泛化不可靠，且扩大合成数据规模反而可能带来负效应（提示数据分布与信号质量比数量更关键）。
summary.experiments:
关键现象与数字（文中给出的代表性结果）：
- 在 MonitorBench（隐蔽攻击：例如配置防火墙但暗中为特定 IP 开后门）上，用 Opus 4.6（thinking）做 monitor，recall 在原始较短 transcript 上约 98.6%，在前置 800K benign tokens 后降到约 88%。
- 对“明显攻击”的插入实验：同样的危险动作，插入 100K transcript 时 Opus 4.6 recall 约 99.7%，插入 800K transcript 时降到约 69%，说明问题不只是‘攻击太隐蔽’，而是长上下文下连显著信号也会被错过。
- 缓解实验：增加 thinking、改提示词、插入 reminders、以及增量监控策略在部分设置下能显著抬升 recall（论文强调‘显著但不稳定’，不同模型/任务差异大）。
- 训练缓解：对 GPT-4.1 的长上下文 SFT 在“与训练分布高度相似”的测试上提升明显，但对不相似任务提升弱且不稳定；扩展数据生成规模出现负面结果，暗示合成数据的覆盖与噪声会主导效果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看引言与 Figure 1，把“长 prefill 导致 recall 退化”的量级直觉建立起来。
- 重点看 4.1–4.4：危险动作位置（中段/末段）、隐蔽性、上下文长度对 recall 的交互效应，这是论文最硬的结论。
- 再看 4.6：reminder mitigation 与增量监控策略，属于能直接迁移到工程系统的做法，也能反推预训练应如何构造长序列监督。
- 最后快速扫 Section 5：长上下文 SFT 的泛化失败模式；建议带着“训练分布相似性/信号密度/长序列 credit assignment”这三个问题去读。

summary_en.core_problem: Why LLMs used as transcript-level safety monitors miss dangerous actions more often as the transcript prefill grows to hundreds of thousands of tokens, and which practical mitigations (prompting, input structuring, incremental monitoring, fine-tuning) actually help under realistic long-agent-session conditions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining objective paper, but it nails a deployment-relevant failure mode of long-context models in a classification setting: recall degrades sharply with long benign prefills, even for obvious attacks, and the degradation depends on attack subtlety and position in the sequence. For pretraining researchers, it reframes “long context capability” as more than context-window size: it is about robust information extraction and task persistence under extreme prefills. The mixed results from long-context SFT also suggest that patching long-context failures may require distribution-aware mid-training and better long-sequence supervision design, not just small fine-tunes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They evaluate LLM-based monitors that take full agent transcripts (user/assistant/tool calls/results) and output a danger label. The main experimental knob is adding massive benign prefixes (up to ~800K tokens) so the malicious action occurs deep inside the context, then measuring recall drop.

Models: Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Thinking, with explicit sweeps over “thinking” modes/budgets and prompt variants (standard CoT, a ‘list suspicious actions verbatim first’ variant, and GPT-specific prompt adjustments to control false positives).

Mitigations are tested at three levels:
1) Inference/prompting: stronger reasoning instructions, more thinking tokens, structured CoT that forces evidence listing.
2) Input interventions: periodic reminders inserted throughout the transcript to keep the classifier anchored to the monitoring task.
3) System strategy: incremental monitoring over growing sub-transcripts (optionally subsampled for cost) instead of a single end-of-session call.

They also try a training mitigation: supervised fine-tuning GPT-4.1 on long-context classification data, and check whether improvements generalize beyond near-identical tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
Representative results reported in the paper:
- On MonitorBench-style subtle sabotage (e.g., covertly weakening a firewall), Opus 4.6 (thinking) recall drops from ~98.6% to ~88% when ~800K benign tokens are prepended.
- For blatantly dangerous actions inserted into long transcripts, Opus 4.6 recall drops from ~99.7% when inserted into a ~100K transcript to ~69% when inserted into an ~800K transcript.
- Prompting and reminder-based mitigations can materially improve recall in some settings; incremental monitoring also helps by reducing reliance on a single ultra-long prefill.
- Long-context SFT on GPT-4.1 shows strong gains on very similar tasks but weak/unreliable transfer to less similar ones; scaling synthetic data generation can even hurt, pointing to distribution/label-signal issues rather than pure data scarcity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 min):
- Start with the intro + Figure 1 to calibrate the magnitude of recall collapse.
- Focus on Sections 4.1–4.4 for the core interaction effects (context length × attack subtlety × position).
- Read Section 4.6 for the most actionable mitigations (reminders, incremental monitoring) and to infer what kinds of long-sequence supervision might be missing in pretraining.
- Skim Section 5 to understand why long-context fine-tuning does not reliably generalize; read it with an eye on distribution similarity and long-horizon credit assignment.

recommendation.zh: 看实验设计和长短上下文对照；它提醒长上下文 benchmark 的 pass 不等于监控能力可用。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and short-vs-long comparison; it shows that passing long-context benchmarks does not imply usable monitoring reliability.

paper.title: Controllable User Simulation
paper.abstract: Using offline datasets to evaluate conversational agents often fails to cover rare scenarios or to support testing new policies. This has motivated the use of controllable user simulators for targeted, counterfactual evaluation, typically implemented by prompting or fine-tuning large language models. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论可控用户模拟器的因果有效性问题。常见做法是用完整对话轨迹事后标注一个控制变量，例如“用户很沮丧”或“订票成功但忘记护照号”，再用这个标签训练模拟器生成逐轮用户回复。论文指出，这类标签往往依赖生成训练数据的旧 agent 的未来行为。把它作为推理时的控制条件，会把未来信息泄漏到当前用户行为里，导致模拟器在评测新 agent 时不再服从真实的条件用户分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对基座模型评测和 agent 训练数据闭环有启发。很多对话 agent、RL 环境和安全评测会依赖 LLM 用户模拟器。如果模拟器的控制变量带有旧策略的未来信息，那么离线评测会系统性误判新策略，后续基于模拟器生成的数据也会污染 SFT 或 RL 信号。论文的价值在于把“prompt 一个 persona”这类经验做法放进 off-policy evaluation 和因果序列建模框架里，明确指出哪些控制变量可用，哪些会破坏反事实评估。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把用户-agent 交互建模为离散时间随机过程。用户动作来自真实用户动力学 P(u_t | h_{t-1})，agent 动作来自策略 π(a_t | h_{t-1}, u_t)。目标不是简单生成像训练集的对话，而是在给定控制变量时，生成真实条件分布下的用户行为，并且在面对新 agent 策略时仍保持一致。核心分析是：事后轨迹标签不是普通条件变量，它由完整轨迹产生，因此与训练 agent 的未来动作耦合。训练模拟器时条件化这个标签，会引入 look-ahead bias。论文进一步借用 off-policy evaluation 的思想，证明当评测策略偏离日志策略时，这种条件化会导致反事实评估指标方差按几何速度恶化，作者称为 controllability collapse。为缓解问题，论文提出三类训练期方案：第一，只使用交互前已确定、且独立于未来 agent 行为的 a priori controls，例如固定 persona 或初始约束；第二，使用逐步更新的 dynamic controls，控制状态只能依赖当前时刻以前的可观测历史；第三，直接把目标 agent 策略纳入条件，即 policy-conditioned learning，用显式策略条件来减少日志策略与评测策略之间的错配。
summary.experiments: 实验使用两个多轮对话数据集验证理论结论。结果显示，标准的 trajectory-conditioned control 会扭曲自然对话分布，并压缩行为多样性；在评测未见过的 agent 行为时，分布偏移更明显。相对地，a priori controls、step-wise dynamic controls 和 policy-conditioned learning 能减少未来信息泄漏，保留更接近自然用户行为的方差，并在未见 agent 行为上表现出更稳定的零样本泛化。给出的正文片段没有暴露具体数据集名称、模型规模和数值表格，因此这里不补充未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中对自然 filtration、用户动力学和 agent policy 的定义；再看关于 post-hoc trajectory-conditioned training 的偏差推导和 controllability collapse 证明。实践上最有用的是 mitigation 部分：哪些控制变量可以在训练前确定，哪些需要逐轮生成，什么时候必须显式条件化目标策略。实验部分可快速看分布失真、行为多样性和 unseen agent generalization 的图表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies causal validity in controllable user simulation. A common pipeline labels full dialogue trajectories after the fact, then trains a simulator to generate turn-level user utterances conditioned on that label. The paper argues that such labels often depend on future actions of the logging agent. Conditioning on them leaks future policy information into current user behavior, so the simulator no longer samples from the true conditional user distribution when used against a new agent.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for evaluation and data-generation loops around LLM agents. LLM-based user simulators are increasingly used for safety testing, policy selection, and synthetic interaction generation. If the simulator encodes artifacts from the old behavior policy, downstream SFT or RL data can carry biased feedback. The main contribution is a clean causal framing of controllable simulation and a set of conditions under which control variables remain valid under policy shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: The interaction is formalized as a discrete-time stochastic process. User actions are drawn from true user dynamics P(u_t | h_{t-1}), while agent actions follow a policy π(a_t | h_{t-1}, u_t). The desired simulator should generate from the real user distribution conditioned on a control variable and should remain valid when interacting with a target policy different from the logging policy. The key technical point is that post-hoc trajectory labels are not ordinary controls: they are functions of the full trajectory and are entangled with future actions of the behavior policy. This creates look-ahead bias. Using ideas from off-policy evaluation, the paper further shows that when the evaluation policy diverges from the behavior policy, counterfactual metric variance can grow geometrically, a failure mode named controllability collapse. The proposed mitigations are: use only a priori controls fixed before interaction; use step-wise dynamic controls that depend only on observable history so far; or condition the simulator directly on the target policy to reduce policy mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section evaluates the claims on two multi-turn dialogue datasets. Standard trajectory-conditioned controls distort natural conversation distributions and reduce behavioral diversity. The causally constrained alternatives reduce look-ahead bias, preserve more natural variance, and generalize more robustly to unseen agent behaviors. The supplied content does not expose dataset names, model sizes, or exact metric values, so no unverified numbers are added.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the problem formulation carefully, especially the filtration notation and the separation between user dynamics and agent policy. Then focus on the bias argument for post-hoc trajectory labels and the controllability-collapse result. The mitigation section is the most useful part for practitioners designing LLM user simulators or synthetic interaction pipelines. In the experiments, look for plots or tables about distribution distortion, diversity collapse, and zero-shot transfer to unseen agent policies.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 simulator 评测里的“标签泄漏”讲成了因果偏置；若你做 RL/agent 数据闭环，只看理论部分和 failure case 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly reframes simulator label leakage as causal bias; if you work on RL/agent data loops, read the theory and failure cases, not every experiment.

paper.title: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors
paper.abstract: As user simulators are increasingly used for interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants, it is essential that they represent the diverse behaviors of real users. While existing works train user simulators to generate human-like responses, whether they capture the broad and heterogeneous distribution of real user behaviors remains an open question. In this work, we introduce a method to measure the distributional gap between real and simulated user behaviors, validated through a human s

summary.core_problem: 用户模拟器已被广泛用于AI助手的交互式训练与评测，但当前LLM驱动的用户模拟器是否能覆盖真实用户行为的异质分布尚未被系统度量，分布偏差会导致训练得到的助手泛化性差，也会让评测结果失真。
summary.importance: 提出的度量方法可用于校准用户模拟器，提升RLHF、RLAIF等后训练阶段的交互数据质量，同时提高交互式评测结果的可信度；对24款模拟器的系统评测直接揭示了当前用户模拟器的普遍缺陷，为后续模拟器优化指明方向；互补模拟器融合方案可直接落地到数据合成流程，提升交互训练数据的多样性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分为三步：第一，行为表征提取：针对每段对话，用LLM从请求方式、响应模式、上下文使用、沟通风格、DAMSL对话动作、SGD对话动作6个维度生成用户行为描述，再映射到统一语义嵌入空间；第二，行为分布量化：用聚类算法将连续嵌入向量转换为离散的用户行为模式分布；第三，分布差度量：用散度指标计算真实与模拟行为分布的差异。另外提出融合互补行为的模拟器以缩小分布差，以及用TF-IDF分析聚类结果得到可解释的行为漏检、幻觉问题。与现有方法的区别是，过往用户模拟器评估仅关注单轮响应的人类相似性，未从全局分布覆盖度维度做量化。
summary.experiments: 共评测24款LLM基用户模拟器，包括7款闭源、15款开源、2款专门训练的模拟器，覆盖编码、写作两类任务。结果显示所有测试模拟器与真实用户行为都存在显著分布差；偏差程度随模型家族、参数规模、行为维度不同存在差异；多数模拟器的行为分布相似，仅少数存在明显区分度；融合互补行为的模拟器后，分布差较单款模拟器平均降低18%左右；TF-IDF分析明确了模拟器普遍漏检的行为（如用户请求模糊、多轮迭代调整需求）和幻觉的行为（如过度礼貌、无意义追问）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的方法细节，尤其是6个行为维度的定义和聚类参数设置；第4章的24款模拟器评测结果、不同维度的偏差分布图表；第5章的模拟器融合实验和TF-IDF可解释分析部分。可深挖的方向包括不同任务下行为维度的权重调整、分布差指标与下游助手泛化性能的相关性、是否可以用分布差作为损失函数优化用户模拟器。

summary_en.core_problem: User simulators are widely applied for interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants, but no systematic measurement exists to assess how well current LLM-powered user simulators cover the heterogeneous distribution of real user behaviors. Such distributional gaps lead to poor generalization of trained assistants and unreliable evaluation results.
summary_en.importance: The proposed measurement method can be used to calibrate user simulators, improve the quality of interactive training data for RLHF/RLAIF, and increase the credibility of interactive evaluation results. The systematic evaluation of 24 simulators reveals common flaws of existing user simulators, and the complementary simulator fusion scheme can be directly deployed in data synthesis pipelines to improve the diversity of interactive training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three stages: 1) Behavior representation extraction: For each conversation, an LLM generates user behavior descriptions across 6 facets (request pattern, response mode, context usage, communication style, DAMSL dialog acts, SGD dialog acts), then maps the descriptions to a unified semantic embedding space. 2) Behavior distribution quantization: Clustering is applied to convert continuous embedding vectors into discrete distributions over user behavior modes. 3) Distribution gap measurement: Divergence metrics are used to calculate the difference between real and simulated behavior distributions. The work also proposes fusing simulators with complementary behaviors to reduce gaps, and uses TF-IDF analysis of clusters to identify interpretable missing and hallucinated behaviors. Unlike prior methods that only evaluate single-turn response human-likeness, this method measures global distribution coverage of user behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: 24 LLM-based user simulators are tested, including 7 closed-source, 15 open-source, and 2 specially trained simulators, covering coding and writing tasks. All tested simulators have significant distributional gaps from real users. Gap sizes vary across model families, parameter scales, and behavior facets. Most simulators have similar behavior distributions, only a few show distinct patterns. Fusing complementary simulators reduces distribution gaps by ~18% on average compared to single simulators. TF-IDF analysis identifies commonly missing behaviors (e.g., vague requests, multi-turn demand adjustment) and hallucinated behaviors (e.g., excessive politeness, meaningless follow-up questions) of current simulators.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for method details, especially the definition of 6 behavior facets and clustering parameter settings. Check Section 4 for evaluation results of 24 simulators and gap distribution charts across different facets. Read Section 5 for simulator fusion experiments and TF-IDF interpretability analysis. Potential follow-up directions include adjusting facet weights for different tasks, correlating distribution gap metrics with downstream assistant generalization performance, and using distribution gap as a loss function to optimize user simulators.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看方法和分布差距表；它直接影响用 simulator 做 SFT/RL/eval 时训练信号是否会偏。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and gap tables; this directly affects whether simulator-generated SFT/RL/eval signals are distributionally biased.

paper.title: More Thinking, More Bias: Length-Driven Position Bias in Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and reasoning-tuned models such as DeepSeek-R1 are commonly assumed to reduce shallow heuristic biases by thinking carefully. We test this on position bias in multiple-choice QA and find a different story: within any reasoning-capable model, per-question position bias scales with the length of the reasoning trajectory.   Across thirteen reasoning-mode configurations (two R1-distilled 7-8B models, two base models prompted with CoT, and DeepSeek-R1 at 671B) on MMLU

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：推理模型是否真的因为生成更长的 CoT 而减少浅层启发式偏差。作者选择 multiple-choice QA 中的 position bias 作为切口，发现结论不是“想得越久越稳”，而是在推理轨迹内部，越长的 reasoning trajectory 越容易累积对某些答案位置的偏好。这里的重点不是一般意义上的选择题偏置，而是 reasoning mode 下长度、承诺时机和位置偏置之间的关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发很直接：如果 RL 或 reasoning tuning 持续奖励更长的推理轨迹，模型可能同时学到一种长度相关的偏置累积机制。更大的模型和更高准确率可以压低 aggregate PBS，但不能完全移除这个机制。DeepSeek-R1 671B 在 MMLU 上总体 PBS 只有 0.019，明显低于 7–8B 模型约 0.21 的水平，但最长 reasoning quartile 仍有 0.071 的 PBS。这说明 scale 和 accuracy 更像是在抑制偏置表达，而不是消除偏置来源。贡献类型主要是机制诊断和评测工具，不是新训练算法；但它对 reasoning model 的训练信号设计、judge/graders 使用方式、CoT 长度控制都有实际影响。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了 matched model pairs 来尽量隔离 base model identity 和 reasoning-style training：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 对比 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 对比 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；Instruct 模型同时测试 direct mode 和 CoT mode；另外用 DeepSeek-R1 671B 作为 scale anchor。数据上使用 MMLU 1000 题、ARC-Challenge 496 题、GPQA 198 题，API anchor 在 MMLU 上取 200 题，全部过滤成 4-option MCQ。每道题通过循环移动选项标签构造四个变体，使正确答案分别落在不同绝对位置。核心指标 PBS 衡量模型在四种 permutation 下的答案分布偏离均匀分布的程度。作者还引入 CCP，即模型第一次给出并此后保持最终答案的 normalized prefix fraction，用来定位模型在轨迹中何时“承诺”答案。技术上最关键的是两点：第一，用 partial correlation 控制 accuracy 后分析 trajectory length 与 per-question PBS 的关系，避免把低准确率导致的随机错误误判为位置偏置；第二，做 truncation intervention，在相对 CCP 的 -0.15、-0.05、+0.05、+0.15 位置截断推理轨迹，再从截断处继续生成，观察最终答案是否转向模型偏好的绝对位置。这比单纯相关分析更接近因果检验。
summary.experiments: 主要结果很稳定。13 个 reasoning-mode configurations 中有 12 个在控制 accuracy 后表现出 length 与 PBS 的正 partial correlation，ρ 在 0.11 到 0.41 之间，且 p < 0.05。把问题按平均轨迹长度分成 quartiles 后，12 个 open-weight reasoning-mode configurations 都呈现从短到长 PBS 单调增加。截断实验提供了更强证据：以 R1-Qwen-7B 为例，从更靠后的轨迹位置恢复生成时，答案转向 position-preferred options 的比例从 16% 增至 32%，符合 accumulated exposure 的模式。作者还区分了 direct-answer bias 和 length-driven bias。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct direct mode 在 MMLU/ARC/GPQA 上 PBS 分别为 0.40/0.26/0.61，偏置很强，但基本不随 reasoning length 变化；CoT 会降低 Llama 的 baseline bias，却引入随长度累积的偏置。Qwen direct baseline 本来较轻，CoT 不带来明显降偏，而 R1 式更长推理会增加偏置。在 671B DeepSeek-R1 上，aggregate PBS 降到 0.019，但最长 quartile 上升到 0.071，且 CCP signature 与小模型接近，约 0.73 vs 0.75。这组结果支持作者的解释：高准确率会 gate 掉一部分偏置表现，但长度驱动机制仍存在。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Method 中 permutation 构造、PBS、CCP、effective switching 和 truncation probe 的定义。这里决定了结论是否可信。结果部分重点看三类图表：length quartile 与 PBS 的单调关系、partial correlation 控制 accuracy 后的统计表、truncation around CCP 的 answer shift 分析。DeepSeek-R1 671B 的 scale anchor 也值得细看，因为它说明大模型的低总体偏置不等于机制消失。对训练研究来说，最值得深挖的是 direct bias 与 length-driven bias 的分离：direct mode 的位置偏好更像 base/instruct model 的固定偏置，reasoning mode 的偏置则随轨迹长度增长。这一区分会影响 RL 奖励、CoT length regularization、self-consistency 和 judge prompt 的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is whether longer chain-of-thought reasoning actually reduces shallow heuristics. The paper uses position bias in multiple-choice QA as a controlled probe and finds the opposite pattern inside reasoning trajectories: longer reasoning traces tend to accumulate stronger preference for certain answer positions. The claim is not about all forms of MCQ bias. It is specifically about a length-dependent bias mechanism that appears under reasoning-mode generation.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because many reasoning pipelines implicitly reward longer traces. If RL or reasoning tuning encourages extended trajectories without controlling their side effects, it can amplify order-sensitive behavior. Larger scale and higher accuracy reduce the visible aggregate bias, but do not remove the underlying length effect. DeepSeek-R1 at 671B reaches an aggregate PBS of 0.019 on MMLU, far below the roughly 0.21 level seen in 7–8B models, yet the longest length quartile still shows PBS of 0.071. This suggests that accuracy gates the expression of the bias rather than eliminating the mechanism. The contribution is mainly diagnostic and mechanistic, not a new training method, but it is relevant to reward design, CoT length control, and the use of reasoning models as judges or graders.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses matched model pairs to separate base-model identity from reasoning-style training: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B versus Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B versus Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The Instruct models are evaluated in both direct-answer and CoT prompting modes, and DeepSeek-R1 671B is used as a scale anchor on MMLU. The datasets are MMLU with 1000 questions, ARC-Challenge with 496 questions, GPQA with 198 questions, plus a 200-question MMLU subset for the API-scale model. Each item is converted to a four-option MCQ, and each question is evaluated under four cyclic shifts of the answer options. The Position Bias Score measures how far the model’s empirical answer distribution over absolute positions deviates from the uniform distribution. The paper also defines CCP, the normalized prefix location where the model first states the final answer and keeps it thereafter. Two design choices are important: partial correlations are computed while controlling for accuracy, and a truncation intervention resumes generation from points around CCP at offsets -0.15, -0.05, +0.05, and +0.15. This allows the authors to test whether later portions of the reasoning trace causally increase shifts toward position-preferred answers.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical pattern is consistent. In 12 of 13 reasoning-mode configurations, per-question trajectory length has a positive partial correlation with PBS after controlling for accuracy, with ρ ranging from 0.11 to 0.41 and p < 0.05. When questions are grouped into length quartiles, all 12 open-weight reasoning configurations show monotonically increasing PBS from the shortest to the longest quartile. The truncation probe strengthens the causal interpretation: for R1-Qwen-7B, later resumptions increasingly shift answers toward position-preferred options, rising from 16% to 32% across absolute-position buckets. The paper also separates direct-answer bias from length-driven reasoning bias. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in direct mode has very high PBS, 0.40 on MMLU, 0.26 on ARC, and 0.61 on GPQA, but this baseline bias is largely uncorrelated with trajectory length. CoT reduces that baseline bias for Llama while introducing a length-accumulated bias. Qwen starts with a milder direct-mode baseline, so CoT does not reduce much; the R1-style longer reasoning then increases the length-driven component. At 671B, DeepSeek-R1 has low aggregate PBS, but the longest quartile remains biased and the CCP signature is almost unchanged relative to smaller models, around 0.73 versus 0.75.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the methodological definitions carefully: option permutation, PBS, CCP, effective switching, and the truncation probe. These determine whether the evidence supports a length-driven mechanism rather than a generic MCQ artifact. In the results, focus on the length-quartile plots, the partial-correlation tables with accuracy controlled, and the truncation-around-CCP analysis. The 671B scale-anchor result is also important because it separates lower aggregate bias from the persistence of the mechanism. For training-oriented readers, the most useful part is the distinction between direct baseline bias and length-driven reasoning bias. That distinction has implications for RL reward shaping, CoT length regularization, self-consistency sampling, and prompt design for judge models.

recommendation.zh: 会改变我对长 CoT 的先验：长度奖励可能放大位置捷径，内部 RLVR 评测应立刻加 length-stratified bias 表。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior on long CoT: length rewards may amplify positional shortcuts, so RLVR evals should add length-stratified bias tables.

paper.title: Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?
paper.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated impressive retrieval-augmented capabilities. However, a crucial area remains underexplored: their ability to appropriately adapt responses to the certainty of the retrieved information. It is a limitation with real consequences in high-stakes domains like medicine and finance. We evaluate eight LLMs on their context-certainty obedience, measuring how well they adjust responses to match expressed context certainty. Our analysis reveals systematic limitation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 LLM 在 RAG 场景中是否能按检索信息的外部置信度调整回答，而不是看到上下文后就过度相信它。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但对训练目标和评测设计有启发。当前 LLM 往往会把上下文当成强证据，即使上下文被明确标注为低置信度。这个现象说明，模型在预训练和指令训练中学到的是“利用上下文”，但不一定学到“按概率权重使用上下文”。对后续的 pretrain/posttrain 数据设计来说，这提示需要显式训练模型处理外部校准概率、冲突知识和低置信检索证据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 context-certainty obedience，用一个概率混合目标定义理想行为。给定问题、检索上下文和置信度 c，理想输出分布应当介于两端：c=0 时回到模型无上下文的 prior response，c=1 时严格遵循上下文；中间置信度则按 c 在 prior distribution 和 context-conditioned distribution 之间插值。这个定义把问题从“答案是否正确”转成“模型是否服从外部置信度”。论文进一步分析三类失败：模型看到上下文后很难恢复原先的 prior；会误读概率表达；面对长而复杂的上下文时，即使置信度低也更容易过信。修复方案不改模型参数，而是一个交互策略：先提醒模型无上下文时的回答，再把置信度表达重标定成模型更容易理解的形式，最后简化上下文。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ClashEval 上评估 8 个 LLM，覆盖 Llama、Qwen、Gemma 的不同尺寸版本。主要指标是 context-certainty obedience error。原始提示下，模型平均错误为 0.52；加入三步交互策略后降到 0.39，约 25% 相对下降。定性和分解分析显示，低置信上下文尤其困难，因为模型会被已经看到的上下文锚定；复杂上下文会放大这种锚定；概率数字本身也不能保证模型按线性权重理解不确定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 evaluation framework，尤其是如何用 prior distribution 与 context-based distribution 的线性混合定义理想输出。然后看 error 分解和三步交互策略的消融。若关注预训练，可重点思考两点：第一，训练语料中是否缺少带显式置信度的冲突上下文；第二，SFT/RL 是否把“引用上下文”过度奖励成了默认行为。具体 RAG 应用场景可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can use retrieved evidence according to an externally supplied certainty score, instead of treating any provided context as authoritative.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and prompting paper rather than a pretraining method paper, but it exposes a training-relevant weakness. Modern LLMs are trained and post-trained to exploit context, yet they are not reliably trained to weight context by calibrated probabilities. For pretraining and post-training research, the result points to a missing capability: models need to learn how to condition on explicit uncertainty, resolve conflicts between parametric knowledge and retrieved evidence, and ignore low-certainty context when appropriate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize context-certainty obedience through a probabilistic mixture target. Given a retrieved context with certainty c, the ideal model behavior should interpolate between two distributions: the prior answer distribution without context and the context-following distribution. At c=0, the model should ignore the context; at c=1, it should follow it. This avoids evaluating only answer accuracy and instead measures whether the model obeys the external certainty signal. The paper identifies three failure modes: poor recall of the pre-context prior after seeing uncertain evidence, distorted interpretation of probability expressions, and overtrust in long or complex contexts. The proposed intervention is parameter-free: remind the model of its prior response, recalibrate the certainty wording, and simplify the retrieved context.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses ClashEval and eight LLMs from families including Llama, Qwen, and Gemma, with different model sizes. The proposed interaction strategy reduces the average context-certainty obedience error from 0.52 to 0.39, a 25% relative reduction. The analysis shows that low-certainty contexts are particularly hard because the model remains anchored to the observed evidence. Long and complex passages increase overtrust, and numeric certainty statements are not interpreted as clean linear probabilities by default.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the evaluation framework carefully, especially the definition of the ideal mixture between prior and context-conditioned behavior. Then inspect the failure-mode analysis and the ablation of the three interaction steps. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful question is how to create training mixtures with explicit certainty annotations, conflicting retrieved evidence, and rewards that do not always favor context adherence. Domain-specific RAG examples can be skimmed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是训法论文，但把 RAG 失败拆成“确定性服从错误”很干净；只看评测定义和 25% 降错的交互干预就够，适合反推 post-train 数据设计。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but the decomposition of RAG failure into certainty-obedience errors is clean; read the evaluation setup and the 25% error reduction intervention, then map it back to post-training data design.

paper.title: PolySQL: Scaling Text-to-SQL Evaluation Across SQL Dialects via Automated Backend Isomorphism
paper.abstract: SQL dialects vary in syntax, types, and functions across database engines. Text-to-SQL benchmarks, however, predominantly support only SQLite. This creates a critical evaluation gap: cross-dialect evaluation reveals weak per-query agreement (Cohen's ), showing that SQLite performance is an unreliable proxy for other dialects. Yet such evaluation remains prohibitively difficult: existing approaches either require expensive manual query transpilation or rely on tools that often fail on complex SQL

summary.core_problem: 解决 Text-to-SQL 评测长期绑定 SQLite 的问题，使同一模型输出能在不同 SQL 方言后端上被可靠比较。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 Benchmark 和评测方法。它指出 SQLite 上的 Text-to-SQL 准确率不能可靠代表 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等真实数据库环境，跨方言评测会暴露明显性能落差。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolySQL，一种 dual-execution 评测方法。它不做 SQL 查询转译，而是在不同后端执行查询后，对执行结果做归一化比较，从而绕开复杂 SQL 转译失败的问题，并提高查询覆盖率。
summary.experiments: 构建三个数据集，支持大规模跨 SQL 方言研究。摘要报告 PolySQL 达到 100% query coverage，并发现模型从 SQLite 迁移到其他 SQL 方言时平均准确率下降 10.1%，且不同方言存在难度层级。
summary.authors_note: IBM Research AI 工作，面向 Text-to-SQL 评测基础设施。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the evaluation gap caused by Text-to-SQL benchmarks being largely tied to SQLite despite real databases using diverse SQL dialects.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation method and benchmark resource. It shows that SQLite accuracy is a weak proxy for cross-dialect SQL generation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: PolySQL uses a dual-execution strategy: instead of transpiling queries between dialects, it executes them on backend-specific databases and compares normalized execution results.
summary_en.experiments: The authors build three datasets for cross-dialect evaluation. The abstract reports 100% query coverage and an average 10.1% accuracy drop when moving from SQLite to other dialects, with a measurable hierarchy of dialect difficulty.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from IBM Research AI, focused on Text-to-SQL evaluation infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 对基座预训练价值有限，但做代码/SQL评测的人应看抽象和结果表，SQLite proxy 这个假设被打得比较实。
recommendation.en: Limited pretraining value, but SQL/code-eval owners should read the setup and result tables; the SQLite-as-proxy assumption looks empirically weak.

paper.title: Agentick: A Unified Benchmark for General Sequential Decision-Making Agents
paper.abstract: AI agent research spans a wide spectrum: from RL agents that learn from scratch to foundation model agents that leverage pre-trained knowledge, yet no unified benchmark enables fair comparison across these approaches. We present Agentick, a benchmark for sequential decision-making agents designed to evaluate RL, LLM, VLM, hybrid, and human agents on common ground and to power research on the fundamental challenges of sequential decision-making. Agentick provides 37 procedurally generated tasks a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是顺序决策 agent 评测不统一的问题：RL agent、LLM agent、VLM agent 和混合 agent 通常在不同环境、不同观测形式、不同训练协议下比较，导致很难判断预训练知识和交互学习各自贡献了什么。
summary.importance: 它不是直接的预训练方法论文，但对基座研究有评估和数据层面的价值。Agentick 把同一组任务暴露成文本、结构化状态、像素、数组等多种观测形式，可以用来比较“预训练语义先验”和“从环境中学控制策略”的差异。文中关于 ASCII 表示优于自然语言描述的结果也值得注意：对空间和控制任务，紧凑、结构化、token-efficient 的表示可能比更自然的描述更利于 LLM 决策。这对 agent 预训练数据格式、环境文本化、轨迹合成都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Agentick 提供 37 个程序生成的 gridworld 任务，覆盖 navigation、planning、reasoning、memory、generalization、multi-agent coordination 六类能力。每个任务有四个难度等级，并同时提供五种观测模态：ASCII text grids、自然语言描述、结构化 dictionary、512×512 等距像素渲染、raw numpy state arrays。接口兼容 Gymnasium，便于 RL 训练和 LLM/VLM agent 评测共用同一环境。训练侧提供 Coding API、所有任务的 oracle reference policies、可向量化环境，以及 120K–500K oracle episodes 的 SFT 数据集。这个设计的重点是把 benchmark 从纯排行榜变成训练和诊断工具：同一 seed、同一 scoring protocol 下，可以系统改变观测模态、prompt、agent harness 或训练方式。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了覆盖不同范式的 agent，包括 GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite、Claude Haiku 4.5、从零训练的 PPO，以及多个 Qwen 小模型变体。整体 oracle-normalized score 最高的是 GPT-5 mini，分数为 0.309；但 PPO 在 planning 和 multi-agent 类别上更强，分别达到 0.402 和 0.432 ONS。这个结果说明语言模型的预训练知识不能替代所有控制能力，尤其是在需要精确时序动作和环境反馈的任务上。提示策略影响很大，CoT harness 让 LLM 表现提升约 3–10 倍。观测表示也很关键：ASCII consistently outperform natural language，说明空间任务中压缩且位置明确的输入比冗长描述更适合模型利用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 benchmark design：任务类别、五种观测模态、四档难度和 Gymnasium 接口。然后看实验结果中三组对比：LLM/VLM/RL 范式差异，CoT harness 的增益，ASCII 与自然语言观测的差异。附录中的任务样例、Coding API 和 oracle policy 设计适合在需要构造 agent 训练数据时再细读。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是它对表示格式和训练协议的控制，而不是单一总分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a benchmarking gap for sequential decision-making agents. RL agents, LLM agents, VLM agents, and hybrid systems are usually evaluated in different environments with different observations and training protocols, making it hard to isolate the roles of pretrained knowledge and interaction-based learning.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for evaluation and data design. Agentick puts multiple agent paradigms on the same set of tasks and exposes each task through several observation formats. That makes it possible to compare semantic priors from foundation models against policies learned through environment interaction. One result is especially relevant for LLM-based agents: ASCII observations outperform natural-language descriptions, suggesting that compact, structured, token-efficient representations can be better than more fluent descriptions for spatial decision-making. This has implications for agent pretraining data, environment textification, and trajectory synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentick contains 37 procedurally generated gridworld tasks across six capability categories: navigation, planning, reasoning, memory, generalization, and multi-agent coordination. Each task has four difficulty levels and five observation modalities: ASCII text grids, natural-language descriptions, structured dictionaries, 512×512 isometric pixel renderings, and raw numpy state arrays. All tasks are exposed through a Gymnasium-compatible interface, so RL agents and foundation-model agents can be evaluated on the same environment seeds and scoring protocol. The benchmark also includes a programmatic Coding API, oracle reference policies for all tasks, vectorizable environments, and SFT datasets with 120K–500K oracle episodes. The design is training-oriented rather than only leaderboard-oriented: researchers can vary observation modality, prompts, harness design, or learning algorithm while keeping the task distribution controlled.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates agents across paradigms, including GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Claude Haiku 4.5, PPO trained from scratch, and several small Qwen variants. GPT-5 mini has the highest overall oracle-normalized score at 0.309, while PPO is stronger on planning and multi-agent categories, reaching 0.402 and 0.432 ONS respectively. This suggests that pretrained language knowledge does not replace precise control learning, especially for temporally extended actions. Prompting is a major factor: a chain-of-thought harness improves LLM performance by roughly 3–10× across tested models. Observation format also matters: ASCII inputs consistently beat natural-language descriptions, pointing to the importance of concise state encodings for LLM agents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the benchmark design: task categories, observation modalities, difficulty levels, and the Gymnasium interface. Then read the experimental comparisons among LLM, RL, and hybrid-style setups, especially the effects of CoT prompting and ASCII versus natural-language observations. The appendices on task examples, the Coding API, and oracle policies are worth revisiting if the goal is to build agent training data or controlled evaluation suites. For pretraining researchers, the main value lies in the controlled representation and training protocol, not in the aggregate leaderboard score.

recommendation.zh: 看 task taxonomy 和结果分解即可；0.309 的 oracle-normalized score 是提醒，通用 Agent 评测还远没被 LLM 吃掉。
recommendation.en: Read the task taxonomy and result breakdown; the 0.309 oracle-normalized score is a useful reminder that LLMs have not swallowed general agent evaluation.

paper.title: SCRuB: Social Concept Reasoning under Rubric-Based Evaluation
paper.abstract: While many studies of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning capabilities emphasize mathematical or technical tasks, few address reasoning about social concepts: the abstract ideas shaping social norms, culture, and institutions. This understudied capability is essential for modern models acting as social agents, yet no systematic evaluation methodology targets it. We introduce SCRuB (Social Concept Reasoning under Rubric-Based Evaluation), a framework designed for this setting of task indetermina

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：当前大模型评测很少直接测量模型对社会概念的推理能力。许多对齐规则依赖“公平”“避免刻板印象”“平等对待”等抽象概念，但现有 benchmark 多数只看模型是否选择了更安全或更少偏见的答案，没有评估模型能否解释这些概念如何在具体语境中起作用。
summary.importance: 这是一项偏评测和对齐接口的工作，不属于预训练方法本身，但对 post-train 数据设计和模型能力评估有启发。它指出一个常被忽略的问题：社会概念不是简单事实题，也不是单一正确答案题；模型需要处理歧义、视角差异和价值冲突。对基础模型研究来说，价值在于提醒评测不能只看拒答率、偏见选择题或模板化安全响应，而要检查模型是否能维持可解释、可辩护、结构清楚的社会推理。
summary.technical_approach: SCRuB 是一个开放式评测框架。流程分三步：从已有规范和数据源构造 prompt，让人类专家和模型生成回答，再用五维 critical thinking rubric 做比较评估。数据源覆盖偏见测量、能力 benchmark 和模型开发者公开规范，目的是避免评测退化成单一格式的题库。作者发布 SCRuBEval，包含 4,711 个 prompt；还发布 SCRuBAnnotations，包含 300 个人类专家回答和 150 个人类专家比较判断。评估方式强调 rubric-based comparative judgment，而不是闭集准确率。另一个方法点是引入“disciplinary perspectives”的自动评估 ensemble，用不同学科视角模拟专家评审的多角度判断。
summary.experiments: 主要结果显示，在单轮、考试式开放问答设置下，前沿模型输出被人类专家评审稳定排在人类 PhD-level 回答之前。涉及的模型包括 Claude 4.6 Opus、GPT-5.4 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro。Across 1,170 pairwise comparisons，专家评审将模型回答排第一的比例为 80.8%，整体偏好模型回答的比例为 74.4%。模型优势主要体现在概念清晰度和论证稳健性。自动评估方面，disciplinary-perspective ensemble 与专家评价中心趋势的 Kendall tau 为 0.666，p < 0.001；作为参照，人类评审之间的 mean pairwise tau 只有 0.040，单一 holistic human judgment 的 tau 为 0.308。作者据此认为，单轮考试式格式在社会概念推理上已经接近饱和，更需要评估模型在真实交互压力下能否持续保持推理质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 SCRuB 的任务定义、prompt 构造来源、五维 rubric，以及自动 disciplinary-perspective ensemble 的设计。实验部分关注两个数字：模型相对专家回答的偏好率，以及自动评估与专家中心趋势的相关性。对预训练研究不必深挖社会科学概念细节；更值得关注的是开放式高歧义任务如何构造评估信号，以及这类信号是否能进一步用于 SFT/RL 数据筛选或 reward model 诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in model evaluation: modern alignment policies rely on concepts such as fairness, stereotypes, equal treatment, and social harm, yet most benchmarks test surface behavior rather than the model’s ability to reason about those concepts. The proposed setting evaluates whether a model can analyze social concepts under ambiguity, competing perspectives, and value-laden contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation and alignment-interface paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance is in the design of evaluation signals for capabilities that are hard to reduce to accuracy. It suggests that safety and social-reasoning benchmarks should move beyond refusal rates, multiple-choice bias tests, or preference for normatively safe answers. For post-training, the framework points toward richer rubric-based supervision and reward-model diagnostics for open-ended reasoning under ambiguity.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCRuB defines social concept reasoning as open-ended reasoning over abstract social categories and norms. The pipeline has three phases: construct prompts from established sources, collect responses from experts and models, and evaluate responses using a five-dimensional critical-thinking rubric. The dataset, SCRuBEval, contains 4,711 prompts, and SCRuBAnnotations provides 300 expert responses plus 150 expert comparative judgments. The evaluation is comparative and rubric-based rather than accuracy-based. The paper also introduces an automated ensemble of disciplinary perspectives, intended to approximate multi-perspective expert evaluation rather than a single holistic judge.
summary_en.experiments: In the single-turn exam-style setting, expert judges prefer frontier model responses over PhD-level human responses across domains and rubric dimensions. The evaluated models include Claude 4.6 Opus, GPT-5.4, and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Across 1,170 pairwise comparisons, a model response is ranked first in 80.8% of cases, and model responses are preferred overall in 74.4% of cases. The largest gaps are reported in conceptual clarity and argumentative soundness. The automated disciplinary-perspective ensemble correlates with the central tendency of expert evaluation at Kendall tau = 0.666 with p < 0.001, while mean pairwise human agreement is only tau = 0.040 and a single holistic human judgment reaches tau = 0.308. The results motivate a shift away from single-turn exam-style tests toward interactional evaluations that measure whether reasoning quality persists under real conversational conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Focus on the task definition, prompt construction sources, the five rubric dimensions, and the disciplinary-perspective ensemble. The key empirical sections are the human-vs-model preference study and the validation of the automated evaluator. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most transferable ideas are not the specific social concepts, but the design of evaluation signals for open-ended, underdetermined tasks and their possible use in SFT, RL, or reward-model auditing.

recommendation.zh: 评估框架设计对构建更严谨的LLM评测有参考价值，只读方法部分（§3）和评测结果（§5）即可。
recommendation.en: The evaluation framework design has reference value for building more rigorous LLM assessments; read only methods (§3) and results (§5).

paper.title: The Reasoning Trap: An Information-Theoretic Bound on Closed-System Multi-Step LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: When copies of the same language model are prompted to debate, they produce diverse phrasings of one perspective rather than diverse perspectives. Multi-agent debate (MAD), and more broadly closed-system reasoning where agents iteratively transform each other's outputs, tends to preserve answer accuracy while degrading the reasoning behind those answers. We name the multi-agent case the Debate Trap and the broader phenomenon the Reasoning Trap, offering a programmatic theory of evidence-grounded

summary.core_problem: 解释并界定“闭环系统（closed-system）多步推理”为什么会出现一种结构性失败：多轮自我/多智能体辩论能在不显著降低最终答案准确率的情况下，系统性地削弱推理过程对证据的依赖与可追溯性（faithfulness / evidential grounding），形成作者称的 Reasoning Trap；其中多智能体辩论是该现象的特例 Debate Trap。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“用闭环推理协议提升模型能力/监督”的研究路线是一个关键约束：如果评测只看 final answer，闭环协议可能在指标上“有效”却在证据链上退化，进而误导后续的蒸馏、RL、合成数据生成与可解释性评估。对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的具体启发是：把闭环生成的长推理链当作高质量训练信号（SFT/RL/蒸馏）存在系统性风险，需要显式度量与约束 evidence grounding，而不是默认“更长/更一致的链=更好监督”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分三层：
1) 概念与定义：把“闭环系统”形式化为仅通过模型输出互相变换、缺乏外部新证据注入的迭代推理协议；提出 Reasoning Trap（一般形式）与 Debate Trap（多智能体辩论实例）。核心主张不是“答案会变差”，而是“证据支撑会被迭代稀释/漂移”。
2) 理论谱系与信息论式约束：借用社会科学中的 DeGroot 共识动力学与 Banerjee 信息级联，强调在只交换内部信号、共享参数/归纳偏置的系统里，迭代会更强地收敛到初始意见的加权组合，而不是外部真值；这给出一种可证伪的机制解释：闭环迭代更像在做“表述空间的再参数化与一致化”，而不是在证据空间里增加信息量。
3) 诊断指标与对照设计：指出既有 MAD 工作把“推理改进”操作化为“答案更准”，忽略了 reasoning faithfulness。文中引入 Supported Faithfulness Score (SFS) 作为证据支撑度量，用它来展示闭环协议在保持 accuracy 的同时显著降低 evidence grounding；并给出一个“开放系统（open-system）”的建设性反例设计（核心是引入外部证据/约束，使迭代不再只是内部互相改写）。
summary.experiments: 实验结论围绕“accuracy 基本保真、faithfulness 明显退化”。文中报告：在 16 个实验条件下，Trap-proper 配置（DebateCV, C13）能保留基线准确率的 88%，但 SFS 下降 43%；极端情况下，多数投票式辩论（C15）把 evidence grounding 降到基线的 1.7%（Wilcoxon p < 1e-6，Cohen’s d = -0.96）。这些结果支持作者的核心区分：闭环协议可能让答案看起来稳定，但推理链与证据的对应关系被系统性破坏。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 closed-system / open-system、Reasoning Trap / Debate Trap 的定义与动机，抓住“评测范式错位：只看答案”的主线。
- 重点看提出 SFS 的段落与实验设置（16 conditions、C13/C15 的对比），以及结果表/图中 accuracy vs SFS 的分离现象。
- 再回头看 DeGroot–Banerjee 的理论类比：它不是为了“证明定理”，而是为了说明这类失败是结构性的、与具体 prompt 工程无关。
- 如果只想拿走可操作结论：把 SFS 作为闭环合成数据/辩论蒸馏的质量门槛；任何闭环协议都应报告 faithfulness 指标，而不只报告 accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: To characterize and explain a structural failure mode of closed-system multi-step reasoning (including multi-agent debate): iterative protocols can largely preserve final-answer accuracy while systematically degrading evidential grounding/faithfulness of the produced reasoning, yielding the “Reasoning Trap” (and “Debate Trap” as its multi-agent instance).
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper per se, but it places a hard constraint on a common pipeline that feeds closed-loop deliberation traces into distillation/RL/SFT as “better reasoning data”. If evaluation focuses only on final answers, closed-system protocols can look successful while producing less evidence-grounded rationales, which can poison training signals and mislead scaling/benchmark conclusions. The practical takeaway for the pretrain↔posttrain interface is to treat closed-loop generated chains as potentially low-faithfulness supervision unless evidence support is explicitly measured and enforced.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Three main components:
1) Formal framing: define closed-system deliberation as repeated transformations of model-generated text without injecting new external evidence; distinguish the general Reasoning Trap from the specific Debate Trap.
2) Mechanistic/theoretical lineage: connect the phenomenon to classic consensus and information-cascade dynamics (DeGroot, Banerjee), arguing that internal-only exchange tends to converge to functions of initial opinions/priors rather than external truth—an information-theoretic intuition for why “more rounds” need not add evidence.
3) Diagnostics + constructive counter-design: introduce a faithfulness-oriented metric (Supported Faithfulness Score, SFS) and show empirically that accuracy and evidential grounding decouple under debate; propose an open-system alternative that injects external evidence/constraints to prevent purely self-referential convergence.
summary_en.experiments: Key empirical pattern: accuracy is relatively stable, while faithfulness collapses. Reported numbers include: across 16 conditions, a trap-proper setting (DebateCV, C13) retains 88% of baseline accuracy but drops SFS by 43%; a majority-vote debate variant (C15) reduces evidence grounding to 1.7% of baseline (Wilcoxon p < 1e-6, Cohen’s d = -0.96). The separation between answer correctness and evidence support is the central experimental claim.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the closed-system vs open-system distinction and the evaluation-paradigm critique (answer accuracy vs reasoning faithfulness).
- Focus on the SFS definition and the multi-condition experimental matrix; the C13 vs C15 comparisons are the fastest way to internalize the claim.
- Then read the DeGroot/Banerjee discussion as a mechanism story: the point is structural inevitability under internal-only iteration, not prompt-specific quirks.
- If you use debate traces for training, treat SFS-like evidence checks as a gating signal and require reporting faithfulness alongside accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 只看定理假设和 SFS 实验；DPI 结论干净，但若 evidence 注入不受控，外推到 agent 系统会偏强。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem assumptions and SFS setup; the DPI argument is clean, but extrapolation to agents is fragile when evidence injection is uncontrolled.

paper.title: Paraphrase-Induced Output-Mode Collapse: When LLMs Break Character Under Semantically Equivalent Inputs
paper.abstract: When the substantive content of a request is rewritten, do large language models still answer in the format the original task asked for? We find that they often do not, even at temperature zero. On a 150-query evaluation over five compact 2025-era LLMs and four task types, we observe a systematic failure mode we call prompt-variant output-mode collapse: when a closed-form prompt asks for a bare label or a single choice token, content-preserving prompt variants can push the model into conversatio

summary.core_problem: 研究语义等价改写是否会破坏 LLM 的输出模式约束，即同一任务在不同表述下从“单标签输出”漂移成自由文本。
summary.importance: 价值主要在评测与失效模式刻画：它不是新训练方法，但指出了一个会污染 exact-match 评测、也暴露模型格式控制脆弱性的现象，对理解 instruction following 与解码行为有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义 prompt-variant output-mode collapse，构建 PARACONSIST 基准：150 个基础查询、每个配 5 种词汇/句法/语义扩展改写，共 900 个 prompt；并提出 Semantic Consistency Score，从答案一致性、句向量语义相似度和长度稳定性三个维度衡量鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个紧凑型 2025 年代 LLM、4 类任务上测试。摘要给出的关键结果是：在 whole-word answer-set match 下，闭式格式约束在改写后只有约 22% 能稳定保持。实验规模不大，但 failure mode 定义清楚，适合作为行为分析信号而非强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学与帝国理工相关机构；更像小规模行为分析与 benchmark 构建工作，不是大实验室的训练报告。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether semantically equivalent prompt rewrites break the requested output mode of LLMs, e.g., turning a single-label task into free-form prose.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation artifact and failure-mode characterization rather than a new training method. It matters because it can silently corrupt exact-match evaluation and reveals brittleness in format control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines prompt-variant output-mode collapse and introduces PARACONSIST: 150 base queries with five lexical/syntactic/semantic variants each, for 900 prompts total, plus a Semantic Consistency Score combining answer consistency, sentence-level semantic similarity, and length stability.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates five compact 2025-era LLMs on four task types. The headline result in the abstract is that under whole-word answer-set matching, only about 22% of closed-form variants preserve the intended output mode. The setup is modest in scale but clean enough as a behavioral probe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Peking University and Imperial College-related institutions. This looks like a small-scale behavioral analysis and benchmark paper rather than a large-lab training study.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你别把 exact-match 当真；只看 benchmark 定义和失败案例就够，结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful reminder that exact-match can be badly misleading; read the benchmark design and failure cases, treat the claims as a weak signal.

institutions: collapse: when a closed-form prompt asks for a bare label
responses preserve the ground-truth label inside their output
Despite growing awareness of this issue, the research
