paper.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of large vision-language models (LVLMs), fine-grained, state-conditioned GUI interaction remains challenging. Current evaluations offer limited coverage, imprecise target-state definitions, and an overreliance on final-task success, obscuring where and why agents fail. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{FineState-Bench}, a benchmark that evaluates whether an agent can correctly ground an instruction to the intended UI control and reach the exact target state. Fi

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI agent 评测中过于粗粒度的问题，尤其是无法准确判断模型是否定位到正确控件并把界面设置到精确目标状态。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent benchmark 工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在 GUI 本身，而在它把 agent 失败拆成定位、交互和状态达成几个阶段，评测信号比单一任务成功率更干净。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FineState-Bench，覆盖桌面、网页和移动端 2209 个实例；每个实例显式定义目标状态。配套 FineState-Metrics，用四阶段指标分别衡量定位成功、交互成功、定位时精确状态成功和交互后精确状态成功。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参评模型和数值，但从 benchmark 设计看，重点是暴露 LVLM/GUI agent 在细粒度状态设定上的系统性失败，而不是追求单一排行榜。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the coarse evaluation of GUI agents, especially the inability to tell whether a model grounded the right control and reached the exact target UI state.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent benchmark paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is not the GUI domain itself, but the cleaner decomposition of failures into localization, interaction, and exact-state achievement instead of relying on final task success alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: FineState-Bench contains 2,209 instances across desktop, web, and mobile platforms, each with an explicitly specified target state. FineState-Metrics provides a four-stage diagnostic pipeline measuring localization success, interaction success, and exact-state success at different stages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list the evaluated models or exact numbers. The main contribution is exposing systematic failure modes of LVLM/GUI agents in fine-grained state setting rather than building a leaderboard.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent 数据或 tool-use 后训练，这类分阶段指标比 end-task success 更有用；正文未必都要读，先看 metric 设计和失败案例。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent data or tool-use post-training, this staged evaluation is more useful than end-task success; read the metric design and failure cases, not necessarily the whole paper.

paper.title: The False Resonance: A Critical Examination of Emotion Embedding Similarity for Speech Generation Evaluation
paper.abstract: Objective metrics for emotional expressiveness are vital for speech generation, particularly in expressive synthesis and voice conversion requiring emotional prosody transfer. To quantify this, the field widely relies on emotion similarity between reference and generated samples. This approach computes cosine similarity of embeddings from encoders like emotion2vec, assuming they capture affective cues despite linguistic and speaker variations. We challenge this assumption through controlled adve

summary.core_problem: 检验语音生成中常用的“情感嵌入相似度”指标是否真的能评估生成语音的情感表达质量。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测与分析工作，价值在于指出语音生成评估中的一个常见 proxy 失真问题。对做语音 LM、离散语音 token 或 TTS 评测的人有参考意义，但对通用 LLM 预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用受控对抗任务和人类对齐测试，系统检验 emotion2vec 一类编码器的 embedding cosine similarity 是否能隔离情感因素。结论是这些表示空间虽然适合分类，但不适合 zero-shot similarity evaluation，因为说话人和语言内容干扰会压过情感特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但实验设计包含对抗构造、分类准确率与人类感知对齐比较，核心发现是高 embedding similarity 并不等价于高情感保真，指标更容易奖励 acoustic mimicry 而非真实情感合成。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自台湾大学与 USC/相关实验室；Hung-yi Lee 是语音与生成模型方向较知名研究者，Shrikanth Narayanan 在语音领域有长期影响力。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests whether the widely used emotion-embedding similarity metric actually measures emotional quality in speech generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation/analysis paper. Its value is in exposing a broken proxy commonly used in speech-generation assessment. It matters for speech LM, discrete speech tokenization, and TTS evaluation, but is only indirectly relevant to general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use controlled adversarial tasks and human-alignment tests to probe whether cosine similarity in spaces from encoders such as emotion2vec can isolate emotion. Their conclusion is that these representations may work for classification but fail for zero-shot similarity evaluation because speaker and linguistic factors dominate emotional cues.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but the setup includes adversarial constructions, classification-vs-human-alignment comparisons, and the central finding that high embedding similarity does not imply high emotional fidelity; the metric rewards acoustic mimicry more than genuine emotional synthesis.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NTU and related labs including USC-affiliated groups; Hung-yi Lee is a well-known researcher in speech and generative modeling, and Shrikanth Narayanan is a long-standing leader in speech research.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做语音 LM 或 TTS 评测，这篇能帮你避开一个常见坏指标；否则只记住结论：embedding similarity 可能在奖励声学模仿，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on speech LM or TTS evaluation, this helps you avoid a common bad metric; otherwise just keep the takeaway that embedding similarity may reward acoustic mimicry rather than emotion.

institutions: Graduate Institute of Communication Engineering, National Taiwan University
Graduate Institute of Electrical Engineering, National Taiwan University

paper.title: Real life is where context gets hard
paper.abstract:
🏠 CL-bench family 🧩 project page：[www.clbench.com](https://www.clbench.com/)
📄 CL-bench Life paper link: [download CL-bench Life paper](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/CL-bench/blob/main/clbench-life-paper.pdf)
🛠️ CL-bench family 🧩 code repository：[Tencent-Hunyuan/CL-bench-family](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/CL-bench)
🗂️ CL-bench Life data repository：[tencent/CL-bench Life](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tencent/CLBench-life)

## The other half of context learning

To truly solve real

summary.core_problem: 研究模型在更接近真实生活的杂乱、动态、未整理上下文中进行 context learning 的能力，而不是在人工清洗好的上下文里取巧。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark/评测设定上的修正：它不直接提出新预训练方法，但对如何评估长上下文、在线学习、记忆与检索能力有现实约束意义，能暴露很多在干净 benchmark 上看不见的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 CL-Bench 家族扩展出 CL-Bench Life，核心思路是把上下文从“预先整理、结构清晰、任务友好”的输入，替换为更贴近现实生活的信息流与环境噪声，考察模型从原始上下文中筛选、推理、记忆和持续利用信息的能力。博客明确强调此前 benchmark 给了模型一个过大的 shortcut。
summary.experiments: 从提供信息看，论文配套有项目页、代码仓库和 Hugging Face 数据集，但当前摘要未给出具体模型规模、参评模型名单、任务构成和量化结果。可合理预期实验会对比现有 LLM 在原版 CL-Bench 与更真实场景上的性能落差，并分析 context organization 对结果的影响；是否有强结论需以论文正文为准。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯混元团队博客解读，关联 CL-Bench Life 论文、代码与数据。作者 Shihan Dou、Pluto Zhou 来自 Tencent Hunyuan 语境；博客的重点是指出既有 context-learning 评测过于“干净”，低估了真实世界上下文处理难度。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether models can perform context learning in messy, dynamic, real-life context streams rather than in neatly curated inputs that make the task artificially easy.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark/evaluation correction rather than a new pretraining method, but it matters because it exposes failure modes in long-context, memory, and retrieval behavior that clean benchmarks often hide.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work extends the CL-Bench family with CL-Bench Life. The key move is to replace pre-organized, task-friendly context with more realistic information streams and environmental noise, then test whether models can filter, reason over, remember, and reuse relevant information. The blog explicitly argues that prior setups gave models an oversized shortcut.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided context, there is a project page, code, and a Hugging Face dataset, but no concrete model sizes, evaluated systems, task breakdown, or quantitative numbers are shown here. The likely experimental focus is the performance gap between original clean-context settings and more realistic settings, plus analysis of how context organization affects outcomes; the strength of the claims depends on the paper itself.
summary_en.authors_note: Tencent Hunyuan blog post tied to the CL-Bench Life paper, code, and dataset. The framing emphasizes that existing context-learning evaluations are too clean and understate the difficulty of real-world context handling.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不改训练范式，但会改你看长上下文结果的口径；先看任务构造和 clean-vs-messy 的性能落差，若掉点很大，内部评测集该重做。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training objective, but it may change how you trust long-context numbers; read the task construction and the clean-vs-messy gap first.

paper.title: Evaluation Revisited: A Taxonomy of Evaluation Concerns in Natural Language Processing
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have prompted a growing body of work that questions the methodology of prevailing evaluation practices. However, many such critiques have already been extensively debated in natural language processing (NLP): a field with a long history of methodological reflection on evaluation. We conduct a scoping review of research on evaluation concerns in NLP and develop a taxonomy, synthesizing recurring positions and trade-offs within each area. We also dis

summary.core_problem: 整理 NLP 评测方法论中的长期争议，并给出一套评测关注点 taxonomy 和 checklist。
summary.importance: 贡献是综述和方法论框架，不是新的模型或训练方法；对预训练研究员的价值在于提醒 benchmark 设计、解释和比较中的常见陷阱，尤其适合做内部评测规范时参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做 scoping review，归纳 NLP 历史上关于评测目标、数据构造、指标选择、可比性、解释边界等问题的反复讨论，并将其组织成 taxonomy 和实用 checklist。
summary.experiments: 没有模型训练实验；工作形式是文献梳理和分类框架。摘要未给出纳入文献数量、编码流程或互标一致性等系统综述细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Copenhagen；Anders Søgaard 是 NLP 评测、泛化和语言学交叉方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper consolidates long-standing methodological concerns in NLP evaluation into a taxonomy and checklist.
summary_en.importance: This is a review and evaluation-methodology contribution rather than a modeling or training paper. For pretraining researchers, its value is in benchmark design, interpretation, and avoiding common comparison errors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors conduct a scoping review of prior NLP evaluation debates and organize recurring concerns around evaluation goals, dataset construction, metrics, comparability, and interpretation into a taxonomy with practical checklist items.
summary_en.experiments: There are no model training experiments. The work is a literature synthesis and framework paper. The abstract does not specify the number of papers reviewed, coding protocol, or inter-annotator agreement.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Copenhagen. Anders Søgaard is a well-known researcher in NLP evaluation, generalization, and linguistically informed NLP.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；做新 benchmark 或 internal eval spec 时翻 taxonomy/checklist，避免重复踩老坑。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; use the taxonomy and checklist when drafting a benchmark or internal eval spec.

paper.title: LLMs Generate Kitsch
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate pictures, texts, music, videos, and other works that have traditionally required human creativity. LLM-generated artifacts are often rated better than human-generated works in controlled studies. At the same time, they can come across as generic and hollow. We propose to resolve this tension by arguing that LLMs systematically generate kitsch, and that this is a consequence of the way in which they are trained. We also show empirical

summary.core_problem: 解释一个常见但说不清的现象：为什么 LLM 生成内容常被评价为流畅、讨喜，却又显得空洞、套路化。
summary.importance: 这是偏概念与机制解释的论文，不是硬技术推进。它的价值在于提出一个可讨论的判断——LLM 倾向生成 kitsch，并把这种倾向追溯到训练机制与人类偏好评测之间的张力。对做数据质量、偏好优化和创造性任务的人有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出“LLMs generate kitsch”的论点，并通过受控读者研究检验：在控制受试者对 kitsch 定义理解后，读者会把 LLM 生成故事评价为更 kitschy。方法上更接近概念建模加行为实验，而不是神经网络机制层面的因果分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明有实证用户研究，比较人类与 LLM 生成故事在 kitsch 感知上的差异，但未给出样本量、模型名单、统计显著性和控制变量细节。实验若设计干净，可作为对“人类偏好评测是否奖励平均化审美”的弱证据；若控制不严，则更像文化批评包装下的用户研究。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Saarland University 和 University of Bamberg。Alexander Koller 在计算语言学领域较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to explain a familiar but poorly formalized phenomenon: why LLM outputs often feel fluent and appealing yet generic, hollow, or formulaic.
summary_en.importance: This is a conceptual and analytical paper rather than a technical advance. Its value is in offering a falsifiable framing—LLMs systematically generate kitsch—and linking that tendency to training dynamics and preference-based evaluation. It is mildly relevant for researchers working on data quality, preference optimization, and creativity-related tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue that LLMs generate kitsch and support the claim with controlled reader studies: when participants are aligned on what 'kitsch' means, they rate LLM-generated stories as more kitschy. Methodologically, this is closer to conceptual analysis plus behavioral evaluation than to mechanistic neural analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates empirical reader studies comparing human- and LLM-generated stories on perceived kitsch, but does not provide sample sizes, model names, significance tests, or control details. If the controls are clean, the paper offers weak but useful evidence that human preference evaluations may reward aesthetic averaging; if not, it remains closer to a well-argued cultural critique.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions are Saarland University and the University of Bamberg. Alexander Koller is a recognizable researcher in computational linguistics.

recommendation.zh: 不是技术 paper，但问题意识是对的：若你在做 preference data 或 creative coding，值得把“模型在优化讨喜而非新颖”当成一个可测假设记下来，正文未必需要细读。
recommendation.en: Not a technical paper, but the question is real: if you work on preference data or creative coding, keep the hypothesis 'models optimize for likability over novelty' in mind; you probably do not need a full read.

paper.title: VLM Judges Can Rank but Cannot Score: Task-Dependent Uncertainty in Multimodal Evaluation
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal systems, yet their scores provide no indication of reliability. We study this problem through conformal prediction, a distribution-free framework that converts a judge's point score into a calibrated prediction interval using only score-token log-probabilities, with no retraining. We present the first systematic analysis of conformal prediction for VLM-as-a-Judge across 3 judges and 14 visual task categories.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多模态自动评测里的可靠性问题。VLM judge 通常只给一个离散分数，但这个分数没有不确定性刻画，用户无法知道它是“有把握地打了 4 分”，还是“在 2 到 5 分之间都拿不准，最后碰巧输出了 4 分”。作者关心的不是如何让 judge 更高分，而是如何在不重训模型的前提下，把单点分数变成带覆盖保证的区间，并进一步分析这种不确定性在不同视觉任务上是否有系统差异。
summary.importance: 它和预训练的直接关系不强，更接近评测方法与 judge 可靠性分析，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但对做 VLM 预训练和多模态对齐的人仍有启发：第一，很多常用 judge 指标只看相关性或平均一致率，会把“能排序但不能定分”的模型误判为可用；第二，任务类型和标注质量对 judge 可靠性的影响，可能比模型规模本身更大，这意味着后续做多模态 reward model、偏好数据构造、自动数据清洗时，不能把所有任务的 judge 分数当成同质信号。对 post-train 和自动评测链路，这个结论比单纯提升几个点的相关性更有用。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 conformal prediction 用到 VLM-as-a-Judge。输入是 judge 在打分位置对各个评分 token 的 log-probability 分布，而不是只取 argmax 分数。作者用这个 K 维分布向量作为特征，构造非一致性分数，再在校准集上估计分位数，从而把单点预测转成满足目标覆盖率的预测区间。因为真实标签是离散 Likert 分数，文中还做了 boundary adjustment，把连续区间映射回合法的整数评分区间。标准 conformal prediction 只给一个全局阈值，作者进一步用了 Mondrian conformal prediction，按任务难度分组做条件校准。分组方式不是人工语义标签，而是先跑一轮标准 CP，根据各数据集区间宽度把 14 个任务分成 easy / medium / hard 三组，再分别估计组内阈值。论文的重点不在提出新的 CP 变体，而在于用这一套后处理工具揭示两个现象：一是不同任务的评测不确定性差异很大；二是 ranking quality 和 scoring reliability 可以明显脱钩。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 VLM judges、14 个视觉任务类别，数据主要来自 MLLM-as-a-Judge 相关基准。关键结果有几条。第一，区间宽度高度任务相关：自然图像、美学类任务的预测区间大约覆盖评分范围的 40%，而图表理解、数学推理等任务可扩到约 70%，说明这些任务上 judge 的绝对分数信息量很弱。第二，作者明确展示了“能排不能打”的失败模式：某些 judge 与人工分数的相关性不差，但 conformal 区间很宽，意味着它能大致排序，却无法给出可信的绝对分值。第三，数据质量影响很大；在更干净、多人标注的 captioning benchmark 上，同样的 judge 和同样的 CP 方法，区间可缩窄约 4.5 倍，说明瓶颈不只是模型，也在标注噪声和任务歧义。第四，Mondrian CP 相比全局校准，对简单任务能给更窄区间，对困难任务则提升覆盖，更符合实际使用需求。文中还提到额外尝试过熵、margin、actor-model entropy 等特征，但没有超过直接使用完整 score-token log-prob 向量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法部分前半，理解作者为什么强调 reliability 而不是 correlation。然后直接看按任务拆分的区间宽度图和 coverage 结果，这些图比平均指标更有信息量。接着看 ranking-scoring decoupling 的案例分析，那里最能说明为什么传统 judge benchmark 容易漏掉问题。若你做自动评测、reward modeling 或偏好数据筛选，建议再看 Mondrian CP 那一节，理解 task-conditional calibration 如何把简单任务和困难任务分开处理。预计 25 分钟左右能读完主线；附录可按需查看不同 judge 的 log-prob 可得性和实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a reliability gap in VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. A multimodal judge usually outputs a single discrete score, but that score comes with no uncertainty estimate. Users cannot tell whether a 4/5 reflects confident agreement or broad ambiguity over several possible ratings. The goal here is not to improve the judge itself, but to convert point scores into calibrated prediction intervals without retraining, and to analyze whether uncertainty behaves differently across visual task types.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to core pretraining is indirect, so skim is the right level. Still, it is useful for multimodal pretraining and post-training pipelines that rely on automated judges. Two takeaways matter. First, standard metrics such as correlation or agreement can hide a serious failure mode: a judge may rank outputs reasonably well while being unreliable at assigning absolute scores. Second, task type and annotation quality appear to drive reliability more than model scale in many cases. That matters for reward modeling, preference data construction, and automatic filtering, where judge scores are often treated as if they were homogeneous supervision across tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies conformal prediction to VLM judges. Instead of using only the predicted score, it extracts the log-probabilities over all rating tokens at the scoring position and uses that K-dimensional distribution as the feature representation. A conformal calibration procedure then turns the point prediction into a prediction interval with target coverage guarantees. Because the labels are discrete Likert scores, the paper applies boundary adjustment to map continuous intervals back to valid integer score ranges. Beyond standard global conformal prediction, it also uses Mondrian conformal prediction, which calibrates separate quantiles for different task groups. The grouping is data-driven: after an initial standard CP run, the 14 datasets are partitioned into easy, medium, and hard groups based on interval width, and group-specific calibration is applied. The novelty is not a new CP algorithm, but the use of this framework to expose two structural findings: strong task-dependent uncertainty and a decoupling between ranking quality and scoring reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 3 VLM judges and 14 visual task categories, mainly on MLLM-as-a-Judge style benchmarks. The main findings are clear. First, interval width is strongly task-dependent: natural-image and aesthetics tasks produce intervals covering roughly 40% of the score range, while chart understanding and mathematical reasoning can expand to around 70%, indicating weak absolute-score reliability on those tasks. Second, the paper shows a ranking-versus-scoring failure mode: some judges achieve decent correlation with human ratings yet still produce very wide conformal intervals, meaning they can order responses but cannot assign trustworthy absolute scores. Third, data quality matters a lot. On a cleaner multi-annotator captioning benchmark, the same judge and the same conformal method yield intervals about 4.5x narrower, suggesting that annotation noise and task ambiguity are major drivers of uncertainty. Fourth, Mondrian CP gives narrower intervals on easier tasks while improving coverage on harder ones, which is more practical than a single global calibration rule. The paper also reports that extra features such as entropy, margin, and actor-model entropy did not beat the raw score-token log-probability vector.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the first half of the method section to understand why reliability is the real target rather than correlation. Then go straight to the per-task interval-width plots and coverage tables; they carry more signal than aggregate metrics. After that, read the ranking-scoring decoupling examples, since they explain why standard judge benchmarks can be misleading. If you work on automated evaluation, reward modeling, or preference-data filtering, also read the Mondrian CP section to see how task-conditional calibration separates easy and hard tasks. About 25 minutes is enough for the main thread, with the appendix only needed if you care about log-prob access details or implementation specifics.

recommendation.zh: 做 VLM 训练或 judge-based eval 的人该看；不是方法突破，但它把“相关系数好看”这件事拆穿了，重点看 ranking-scoring decoupling 和各任务区间宽度。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you rely on VLM judges: not a modeling breakthrough, but it cleanly shows that good rank correlation can hide useless absolute scores; focus on the decoupling result and task-wise interval widths.

paper.title: HuM-Eval: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Human-Centric Video Evaluation
paper.abstract: Video generation models have developed rapidly in recent years, where generating natural human motion plays a pivotal role. However, accurately evaluating the quality of generated human motion video remains a significant challenge. Existing evaluation metrics primarily focus on global scene statistics, often overlooking fine-grained human details and consequently failing to align with human subjective preference. To bridge this gap, we propose HuM-Eval, a novel human-centric evaluation framework

summary.core_problem: 视频生成模型中人体动作质量很关键，但现有视频指标偏向全局场景统计，不能细致评估人体结构、姿态和运动稳定性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成评测框架和 benchmark。它把人类主观偏好中的人体因素拆成全局质量、解剖正确性和三维运动稳定性，适合评估人物视频生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HuM-Eval 粗到细评估框架：先用 VLM 做全局视频质量粗评，再用 2D pose 检查人体解剖正确性，并用 3D human motion 表征评估运动稳定性；同时引入 HuM-Bench 作为配套 benchmark。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 HuM-Eval 与人类偏好的平均相关性达到 58.2%，优于已有 baseline；未给出 benchmark 规模、模型列表或各子指标的详细提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院。摘要中没有显示知名 LLM 预训练团队或代表性基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evaluation of human-centric video generation, where global video statistics often miss anatomical plausibility and motion stability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation framework and benchmark for generated human-motion videos. It decomposes subjective quality into global quality, anatomical correctness, and 3D motion stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: HuM-Eval follows a coarse-to-fine design: a VLM first assesses global video quality, then 2D pose checks anatomical correctness, and 3D human-motion estimation evaluates temporal stability. HuM-Bench is introduced as the associated benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports an average human-correlation score of 58.2%, outperforming existing baselines. It does not provide benchmark size, evaluated model lists, or detailed per-component gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China. No direct foundation-model pretraining team signal is visible from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 对基座训练只提供评测侧弱信号；看相关性实验即可，方法本身偏人物视频生成质检。
recommendation.en: For pretraining work this is weakly relevant; the human-correlation study is the useful part, while the method is mostly video-generation QA.

paper.title: Below-Chance Blindness: Prompted Underperformance in Small LLMs Produces Positional Bias Rather than Answer Avoidance
paper.abstract: Detecting sandbagging--the deliberate underperformance on capability evaluations--is an open problem in AI safety. We tested whether symptom validity testing (SVT) logic from clinical malingering detection could identify sandbagging through below-chance performance (BCB) on forced-choice items. In a pre-registered pilot at the 7-9 billion parameter instruction-tuned scale (3 models, 4 MMLU-Pro domains, 4 conditions, 500 items per cell, 24,000 total trials), the plausibility gate failed. Zero of

summary.core_problem: 检验小型指令模型在被提示“故意考差”时，是否会出现低于随机水平的表现，从而可作为 sandbagging 的可检测信号。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是安全评测与行为机制分析。它把临床 malingering 检测中的 symptom validity testing 逻辑迁移到 LLM capability evaluation，结论是这个信号在 7B-9B 指令模型上不成立，容易把位置偏置误判为主动回避答案。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做了预注册 pilot，在 forced-choice MMLU-Pro 题目上设置 honest baseline 与 sandbagging instruction 等条件，观察模型在不同领域和条件下的正确率、答案分布、与诚实回答的一致性。分析重点不是提高模型，而是分解 underperformance 的行为模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 7B-9B 级别指令模型、4 个 MMLU-Pro 领域、4 种条件，每个 cell 500 道题，共 24,000 次 trial。12 个 model-domain cell 中没有一个在 sandbagging 指令下显著低于随机水平。Qwen-2.5-7B 和 Phi-3.5-mini 大多忽略指令，与 honest baseline 的回答重合率为 62%-88%；Llama-3-8B 更服从指令，但主要把回答压到中间字母选项，E 为 31.8%、F 为 26.1%。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者 Jon-Paul Cacioli。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether small instruction-tuned LLMs prompted to underperform exhibit below-chance accuracy, making sandbagging detectable through a symptom-validity-testing style signal.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and behavioral-analysis result for AI safety. It transfers clinical malingering-detection logic to LLM capability evaluation and finds that below-chance behavior is not a reliable signal at the 7B-9B instruction-tuned scale; positional bias can masquerade as intentional underperformance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author runs a pre-registered forced-choice MMLU-Pro pilot under honest and sandbagging-style prompt conditions, then analyzes accuracy, answer identity with the honest baseline, and option-position distributions. The work is diagnostic rather than a model-improvement method.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 3 instruction-tuned models in the 7B-9B range, 4 MMLU-Pro domains, 4 conditions, 500 items per cell, and 24,000 total trials. None of the 12 model-domain cells shows significant below-chance performance under sandbagging instructions. Qwen-2.5-7B and Phi-3.5-mini mostly ignore the instruction, with 62%-88% response identity to the honest baseline; Llama-3-8B complies more but collapses toward middle-alphabet options, especially E at 31.8% and F at 26.1%.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is independent researcher Jon-Paul Cacioli.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 eval 负例备查：结论不改 pretrain 方向，但提醒 sandbagging 指标很容易测到选项位置偏置。
recommendation.en: Useful as an evaluation cautionary case: it will not change pretraining practice, but it shows how sandbagging probes can measure option-position bias instead.

paper.title: Do LLMs Capture Embodied Cognition and Cultural Variation? Cross-Linguistic Evidence from Demonstratives
paper.abstract: Do large language models (LLMs) truly acquire embodied cognition and cultural conventions from text? We introduce demonstratives, fundamental spatial expressions like "this/that" in English and "zhè/nà" in Chinese, as a novel probe for grounded knowledge. Using 6,400 responses from 320 native speakers, we establish a human baseline: English speakers reliably distinguish proximal-distal referents but struggle with perspective-taking, while Chinese speakers switch perspectives fluently but tolerat

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 是否真正从文本中学到具身认知与文化差异，具体用指示词 this/that、这/那 的跨语言理解作为探针。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制与评测型工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在于给出一个较少见但语言学上很干净的 probe：用 demonstratives 测 LLM 是否掌握近指/远指、视角切换和文化约定，而不是只看常规 benchmark 分数。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先收集 320 名母语者、6400 个回答建立人类基线，再测试 5 个主流 LLM 在英语和中文指示词任务上的表现，比较模型是否呈现与人类一致的近远指区分、视角采择和跨文化差异。核心方法是行为探针与人机对照，而非训练新模型。
summary.experiments: 人类结果显示：英语使用者能稳定区分近指/远指，但较难做视角切换；中文使用者更能灵活切换视角，同时对远指歧义容忍更高。论文声称 5 个 SOTA LLM 普遍不能内生掌握近远指对比，也没有表现出文化差异，而是倾向英语中心式推理。摘要未给出模型名和量化指标细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学语言科学与技术系。工作带有明显语言学与认知建模背景，适合作为“LLM 学到的语言知识边界”类证据阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether LLMs truly acquire embodied cognition and cultural variation from text, using cross-linguistic demonstratives such as this/that and 这/那 as probes.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-and-evaluation paper. Its value is not a new model, but a linguistically clean probe for whether LLMs capture proximal/distal distinctions, perspective taking, and cultural conventions rather than merely scoring well on standard benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first build a human baseline from 320 native speakers and 6,400 responses, then evaluate five mainstream LLMs on English and Chinese demonstrative tasks. The method is a behavioral probe with human-model comparison, not model training.
summary_en.experiments: Humans show asymmetric patterns: English speakers reliably distinguish proximal vs. distal but struggle more with perspective shifts, while Chinese speakers switch perspectives more flexibly and tolerate distal ambiguity more. The paper claims that five state-of-the-art LLMs fail to inherently capture the proximal-distal contrast and show no cultural differentiation, defaulting instead to English-centric reasoning. The abstract does not provide model names or exact metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Department of Language Science and Technology at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. The work has a clear linguistics and cognitive-modeling flavor and is useful as evidence on the limits of language-only learning.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练方法论文，但 probe 设计挺干净；看人类基线和模型失配那几张表就够，用来提醒自己“文本共现不等于学到指称机制”。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the probe is clean; read the human baseline and model-mismatch tables as a reminder that text co-occurrence does not imply learned reference mechanisms.

paper.title: BenchGuard: Who Guards the Benchmarks? Automated Auditing of LLM Agent Benchmarks
paper.abstract: As benchmarks grow in complexity, many apparent agent failures are not failures of the agent at all - they are failures of the benchmark itself: broken specifications, implicit assumptions, and rigid evaluation scripts that penalize valid alternative approaches. We propose employing frontier LLMs as systematic auditors of evaluation infrastructure, and realize this vision through BenchGuard, the first automated auditing framework for task-oriented, execution-based agent benchmarks. BenchGuard cr

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂执行型 LLM agent benchmark 中，任务失败究竟来自模型能力不足还是 benchmark 规范、脚本与评测基础设施本身缺陷的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 审计工作，不直接改进预训练，但对 agent 评测可信度有现实价值。贡献主要是提出自动化审计框架，并实证说明现有知名 benchmark 中确实存在会误判模型能力的致命缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BenchGuard，用前沿 LLM 作为系统化审计器，对 benchmark 的任务说明、输入输出约束、执行脚本和评测逻辑做结构化交叉核验；可选地引入 agent 解答或执行轨迹作为额外诊断证据，以定位不可解任务、隐含假设、过于僵硬的评分脚本等问题。
summary.experiments: 在两个科学类 agent benchmark 上验证：在 ScienceAgentBench 中发现 12 个被作者确认的问题，其中包括使任务不可解的致命错误；在 BIXBench Verified-50 子集上，与专家识别问题的匹配率达到 83.3%，并发现部分人工审查遗漏的问题。摘要未给出更完整的模型配置与审计成本细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington Allen School、Phylo、Genentech。不是顶级实验室的基座研究论文，更像评测基础设施质量控制方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a basic but important question in execution-based LLM agent benchmarks: when an agent fails, is it a model failure or a benchmark infrastructure failure?
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark-auditing paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters for evaluation reliability. The main contribution is an automated auditing framework showing that prominent agent benchmarks contain defects severe enough to mis-measure model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: BenchGuard uses frontier LLMs as structured auditors to cross-check benchmark artifacts, including task specs, assumptions, execution scripts, and evaluation logic. It can optionally incorporate agent solutions or execution traces as extra evidence to diagnose unsolvable tasks, hidden assumptions, and overly rigid graders.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two scientific agent benchmarks: it found 12 author-confirmed issues in ScienceAgentBench, including fatal errors that make tasks unsolvable, and matched 83.3% of expert-identified issues on the BIXBench Verified-50 subset while catching issues missed by human review. The abstract does not provide full model/cost details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Washington Allen School, Phylo, and Genentech. This is better read as evaluation-infrastructure work than as frontier foundation-model research.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法论文，但如果你常拿 agent benchmark 做结论，这篇会提醒你先审 benchmark 再审模型；正文只看错误类型和人工一致性结果即可。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but if you use agent benchmarks to make capability claims, this is a useful reminder to audit the benchmark before blaming the model; the error taxonomy and human-agreement results are enough.

paper.title: ProEval: Proactive Failure Discovery and Efficient Performance Estimation for Generative AI Evaluation
paper.abstract: Evaluating generative AI models is increasingly resource-intensive due to slow inference, expensive raters, and a rapidly growing landscape of models and benchmarks. We propose ProEval, a proactive evaluation framework that leverages transfer learning to efficiently estimate performance and identify failure cases. ProEval employs pre-trained Gaussian Processes (GPs) as surrogates for the performance score function, mapping model inputs to metrics such as the severity of errors or safety violatio

summary.core_problem: ProEval 解决的是生成式 AI 评测成本过高且低效的问题。完整跑 benchmark 需要大量模型推理、人工或 LLM judge 评分；简单下采样又容易给出不稳定的总体分数，并漏掉稀有但严重的失败样本。论文把评测看成一个未知性能函数的主动学习问题：给定输入 x，模型在该输入上的错误严重度、安全风险或任务得分是 f(x)，目标是在少量评测调用下同时估计整体性能，并主动发现失败区域。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的价值不在模型结构，而在评测和训练闭环。大模型迭代中，pretrain、mid-train、SFT、RL 或数据清洗的小改动都需要反复评测。如果评测只能靠固定全量 benchmark 或随机抽样，迭代速度和失败发现能力都会受限。ProEval 提供了一种更有统计结构的评测方式：利用历史模型评测结果或语义 embedding 构造先验，再用不确定性驱动选择样本。它可以用于更便宜地比较 checkpoint、发现数据或对齐训练引入的退化，也可以为 failure-driven data generation 提供候选样本。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用预训练 Gaussian Process 作为性能函数 f(x) 的代理模型。GP 不从零开始学，而是通过迁移信息构造有信息量的先验。对于已有 benchmark，协方差可以直接来自历史评测矩阵：如果多个模型在两个样本上表现相关，这两个输入在 GP 中也应相关。对于新领域或新模态，论文使用现成文本或图像 embedding 模型把输入映射到特征空间，再预训练 encoder 参数和 GP 超参数，让 kernel 捕捉语义或视觉相似性。

在这个代理模型之上，ProEval 处理两个目标。第一是性能估计。它把总体性能写成积分 ∫ f(x)p(x)dx，并用 Bayesian quadrature 估计。与 Monte Carlo 平均不同，BQ 利用 GP posterior 给出积分估计及其方差，因此可以选择最能降低后验积分方差的样本。第二是失败发现。它把失败区域定义为 superlevel set，即 {x | f(x) ≥ λ}，其中 λ 是错误严重度或风险阈值。采样策略同时考虑高预测失败概率和高 epistemic uncertainty，避免只重复采同一类已知失败。

论文还加入主动合成。系统先用已发现的 hard examples 作为 in-context anchors，让 LLM 生成更难的新测试输入。为避免生成器集中到单一失败模式，作者设计了 bi-level sampling：先采样高层语义 topic，再在 topic 下生成具体测试样本。这样失败发现不仅依赖静态 benchmark，还可以扩展到更广的输入空间。
summary.experiments: 论文报告的核心结果是样本效率。性能估计方面，ProEval 通常只需评测 1 到 27 个输入，就能把总体指标估计误差压到 1% 以内，并优于随机抽样等竞争基线。失败发现方面，ProEval 的失败检测率约为其他 LLM 生成式方法的 2-5 倍，同时在语义空间中覆盖更多样的失败模式。消融实验表明三类组件都重要：迁移得到的 GP 先验提升冷启动质量；主动采样比被动抽样更快降低估计不确定性；topic-aware 的 LLM 合成比直接围绕 hard example 生成更不容易模式收缩。理论部分证明，在温和假设下，使用预训练 GP 的 BQ 估计是无偏且有界的，并且不要求真实 GP 先验已知。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看问题形式化：性能函数 f(x)、总体性能积分、失败阈值 λ 的定义，这决定了方法适用范围。然后重点读 GP prior 构造部分，尤其是两种迁移路径：历史评测矩阵和 embedding-based kernel。接着看 Bayesian quadrature 的 acquisition rule，它是样本效率的关键。失败发现部分要关注 superlevel set sampling 的探索-利用权衡，以及 LLM 主动合成中的 bi-level topic sampling。实验部分建议重点看 1% 误差所需样本数、2-5x 失败发现提升，以及 ablation；这些结果比单个 benchmark 分数更能说明方法是否可迁移。理论证明可按需阅读，重点确认其假设是否覆盖实际评测场景。

summary_en.core_problem: ProEval targets the cost and inefficiency of evaluating generative AI models. Full benchmark runs require many slow generations and expensive human or LLM-based ratings. Naive downsampling reduces cost but gives unstable aggregate estimates and often misses rare severe failures. The paper formulates evaluation as active learning over an unknown performance function f(x), where each input maps to a task score, error severity, or safety-risk measure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to the evaluation loop around pretraining and post-training. Model developers repeatedly compare checkpoints after data changes, mid-training interventions, SFT, RL, or safety tuning. If evaluation relies only on fixed full benchmark runs or random subsets, iteration becomes slow and failure discovery remains weak. ProEval gives a structured alternative: transfer prior information from historical evaluations or semantic embeddings, then use uncertainty-aware acquisition to choose what to evaluate next. This can support cheaper checkpoint comparison, regression detection, and failure-driven data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central surrogate is a pre-trained Gaussian Process over the performance function. The GP prior is not learned from scratch. For established benchmarks, its covariance can be derived from historical evaluation records across models, capturing that two inputs are related if models tend to succeed or fail on them together. For new domains or modalities, the method uses off-the-shelf text or image embedding models to represent inputs, then pre-trains encoder parameters and GP hyperparameters so the kernel reflects semantic or visual similarity.

On top of this surrogate, ProEval handles two objectives. For aggregate performance estimation, it frames the metric as an integral, ∫ f(x)p(x)dx, and uses Bayesian quadrature. Unlike Monte Carlo averaging, BQ treats the integral as a posterior random variable and provides an analytic estimate of its uncertainty. The acquisition rule then selects inputs that most reduce posterior variance of the aggregate metric. For failure discovery, the method defines failures as a superlevel set, {x | f(x) ≥ λ}, and selects points by balancing predicted failure probability with epistemic uncertainty. This prevents the search from repeatedly sampling only known failure types.

The paper also extends evaluation beyond a static dataset. It uses an LLM generator conditioned on discovered hard examples as in-context anchors. To reduce collapse into a single failure mode, it introduces bi-level sampling: first sample high-level semantic topics, then generate concrete test cases under those topics. This makes active failure discovery more diverse.
summary_en.experiments: The reported empirical signal is sample efficiency. For performance estimation, ProEval often reaches within 1% estimation error using only 1 to 27 evaluated inputs, outperforming competitive sampling baselines. For failure discovery, it achieves roughly 2-5x higher failure detection rates than other LLM-based generation methods and covers more diverse regions in semantic space. Ablations indicate that the transferred GP prior, the active acquisition rules, and the topic-aware synthesis procedure each contribute materially. The theory shows that Bayesian quadrature with a pre-trained GP estimator is unbiased and bounded under mild assumptions, without requiring the true GP prior to be known.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the formal setup: the performance function f(x), the aggregate integral, and the failure threshold λ. Then focus on how the GP prior is built from either historical evaluation matrices or embedding-based kernels. The Bayesian quadrature acquisition rule is the key mechanism for sample-efficient score estimation. For failure discovery, study the superlevel-set acquisition and the bi-level topic sampling used for LLM-based synthesis. In the experiments, prioritize the number of samples needed for 1% estimation error, the 2-5x failure discovery gains, and the ablation studies. The theory is useful for checking when the estimator’s assumptions match a real evaluation workflow.

recommendation.zh: 预训练人可只读 BQ 和 failure discovery 设定；若结果稳，它适合接到数据退火和安全数据挖掘闭环里。
recommendation.en: Skim the Bayesian-quadrature and failure-discovery setup; if robust, it plugs naturally into annealing evals and safety data mining.

paper.title: Benchmarking Testing in Automated Theorem Proving
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in formal theorem proving, yet evaluating semantic correctness remains challenging. Existing evaluations rely on indirect proxies such as lexical overlap with human-annotated proof, or expensive manual inspection. Inspired by the shift from lexical comparison to test-based evaluation in code generation, we propose T , a framework that evaluates the semantic correctness of formal theorems: a generated theorem is considered correct

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是形式化定理生成里的语义评测问题：Lean 编译通过只能说明生成的 statement 和 proof 在逻辑系统内自洽，不能说明它表达了自然语言题目的原意。典型失败是把应证明的命题改写成平凡恒等式，仍然可以编译通过。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在评测信号设计。形式数学和代码一样，表面匹配指标会高估模型能力；只用编译通过率也会鼓励模型学习“可证明但不忠实”的形式化策略。T2 把语义正确性转化为依赖图上的集成测试，为 formal reasoning 数据过滤、RL verifier 设计、自动形式化 benchmark 提供了更可靠的反馈信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Testing Accuracy。给定一个被模型生成的目标定理，论文不直接和人工参考定理做等价证明，而是把真实 Lean 仓库中的后继定理作为测试用例。如果替换目标定理后，依赖它的后继定理还能编译，说明生成定理在这些使用场景下保留了足够的语义；如果后继定理失败，则暴露出语义偏差。这个设计借鉴软件工程里的 integration testing，避免 BLEU、NLI、人工检查这类成本高或间接的指标。T2 从 5 个真实 Lean 4 仓库自动抽取目标定理和依赖关系，构造 2,206 个问题；每个问题平均有 41 个直接后继定理。论文还利用更深的依赖闭包扩大测试覆盖，在深度 7 时平均可形成约 1.6k 个后继测试。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 18 个开源和闭源模型。主要结论是编译准确率和测试准确率之间存在很大落差：部分模型生成的可编译定理中，最高有 93.1% 被判定为语义错误。BLEU 等文本相似度指标无法稳定区分语义正确和错误输出。专门的 theorem proving 模型在编译层面表现较好，但在 T2 的语义测试下可能低于相近规模的通用模型，说明它们可能更强地适配了 Lean 语法和证明模式，而不是自然语言到形式语义的忠实映射。论文还构造了 389 个问题的 Hard 子集，要求模型同时生成辅助命题和目标定理证明。另一个有用发现是，把后继定理作为上下文提供给模型能提升语义正确性，而只提供自然语言证明并不稳定有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中的 Figure 1 和 Table 1，理解为什么 compile pass、BLEU、BEq、人工检查都不足以作为语义评测。方法部分重点看 Testing Accuracy 的定义、successor theorem 的抽取方式和依赖深度设置。实验部分建议看编译准确率与 TA 的差距、Hard 子集结果，以及 successor context 的消融。对预训练研究更有用的是评测信号本身，而不是 Lean benchmark 的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses semantic evaluation in formal theorem generation. A Lean theorem may compile and still fail to express the intended natural-language statement; for example, a model can replace a commutativity claim with a tautology that is easy to prove.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is evaluation signal design. In formal reasoning, compile success alone creates a reward that can favor provable but unfaithful formalizations. T2 offers a stronger automatic signal for benchmarking autoformalization, filtering formal-math data, and designing verifiers for RL on theorem proving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is Testing Accuracy. Instead of proving equivalence to a reference theorem or comparing against a human annotation, the method replaces a target theorem in a real Lean repository with the generated theorem and checks whether successor theorems that depend on it still compile. This is analogous to integration testing in software: a component is tested through the modules that use it. The benchmark is built from 5 real-world Lean 4 repositories and contains 2,206 target problems, each paired with successor theorems. The paper reports an average of 41 direct successors per problem and expands coverage through dependency depth, reaching about 1.6k successor tests per problem at depth 7.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 18 open and closed models. The main empirical result is a large gap between compilation accuracy and testing accuracy: among compilable outputs, up to 93.1% can still be semantically incorrect under successor testing. BLEU does not reliably separate correct from incorrect formalizations. Specialized proving models can look strong under compilation-based metrics but perform worse on semantic correctness than similarly sized general-purpose models, suggesting overfitting to syntax and proof patterns. The benchmark also includes a Hard subset of 389 problems that require generating both auxiliary propositions and target proofs. Providing successor theorems as context improves semantic correctness, while natural-language proofs alone are not consistently helpful.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read Figure 1 and Table 1 first to understand the failure modes of compile success, BLEU, BEq, and manual inspection. Then focus on the definition of Testing Accuracy, the dependency extraction pipeline, and the depth-based successor coverage. In the experiments, the most useful parts are the compile-versus-TA gap, the Hard subset, and the ablation on successor context. For pretraining-oriented readers, the evaluation signal is more important than the Lean-specific benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练范式，但会改你看 formal reasoning 结果表的方式；只看 metric 定义和模型排名坍塌那张表，就知道旧 benchmark 有多松。
recommendation.en: It does not change training, but it should change how you read formal-reasoning tables; just inspect the metric definition and the leaderboard collapse to see how loose prior benchmarks were.

institutions: Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence, Seoul National University

paper.title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become central to modern AI workflows, powering applications from open-ended text generation to complex agent-based reasoning. However, debugging these models remains a persistent challenge due to their opaque and probabilistic nature and the difficulty of diagnosing errors across diverse tasks and settings. This paper introduces a systematic approach for LLM debugging that treats models as observable systems, providing structured, model-agnostic methods from is

summary.core_problem: 为LLM调试提供系统化流程，解决模型行为不透明、输出随机、跨任务错误难以定位的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程方法论和实践框架，而不是新的训练算法或机制发现。它把评测、可解释性、错误分析、提示调整、参数调整和数据修订放进统一调试闭环，对应用团队有用，对预训练团队更多是流程检查表。
summary.technical_approach: 将LLM视为可观测系统，从问题发现、错误归因、模型行为分析到模型或数据修正建立结构化步骤；方法强调模型无关性，可在缺少标准benchmark或清晰评测准则的场景下迭代诊断弱点，并支持prompt、参数和微调数据的调整。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline或量化提升，可能更偏框架性论文或实践指南。若正文缺少受控实验，其结论应按工程经验而非可复现实证结果处理。
summary.authors_note: 机构为IBM Research San Jose和IBM Research Bengaluru。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a systematic workflow for debugging LLMs, addressing opacity, stochastic behavior, and the difficulty of diagnosing failures across heterogeneous tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering methodology rather than a new training algorithm or mechanistic finding. It unifies evaluation, interpretability, error analysis, prompt refinement, parameter adjustment, and data adaptation into a debugging loop; useful for applied teams, but mostly a checklist for pretraining teams.
summary_en.technical_approach: It treats LLMs as observable systems and defines structured, model-agnostic steps from issue detection and error attribution to behavior analysis and model or data refinement. The approach is designed for settings without standardized benchmarks or crisp evaluation criteria, and supports iterative refinement of prompts, model parameters, and fine-tuning data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify models, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The work appears framework-oriented; if the full paper lacks controlled experiments, its claims should be read as engineering practice rather than reproducible empirical evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from IBM Research in San Jose and Bengaluru.

recommendation.zh: 可当LLM错误分析流程清单；若正文没有受控ablation，对预训练只提供低强度工程信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as an LLM error-analysis checklist; without controlled ablations, it provides only weak engineering signal for pretraining work.

paper.title: MEG-RAG: Quantifying Multi-modal Evidence Grounding for Evidence Selection in RAG
paper.abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) addresses key limitations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), such as hallucination and outdated knowledge. However, current MRAG systems struggle to distinguish whether retrieved multimodal data truly supports the semantic core of an answer or merely provides superficial relevance. Existing metrics often rely on heuristic position-based confidence, which fails to capture the informational density of multimodal entities. To address this,

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 RAG 中检索证据看似相关但未真正支撑答案语义核心的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是评估指标和 reranking 框架：MEG 试图把证据是否支撑高信息量语义单元量化，MEG-RAG 则用这个信号训练多模态 reranker，面向幻觉和证据选择质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Multi-modal Evidence Grounding 指标，使用 Semantic Certainty Anchoring 聚焦高 IDF、信息承载更强的 answer tokens，而不是依赖位置或表层置信度；再以 MEG 为训练目标或监督信号，使多模态 reranker 优先选择能支撑语义锚点的检索内容。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 或数值提升；可确认实验对象是 multimodal RAG evidence selection，比较对象包括传统 confidence 或启发式证据选择指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Zhejiang University、Peking University、UNSW、Macquarie University、CSIRO Data61 等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses evidence selection in multimodal RAG, where retrieved items may look relevant but fail to support the semantic core of the generated answer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a metric and reranking framework. MEG quantifies whether evidence grounds high-information answer units, and MEG-RAG trains a multimodal reranker using that signal to reduce superficial retrieval and hallucination.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEG introduces Semantic Certainty Anchoring, focusing on high-IDF information-bearing tokens rather than heuristic position-based confidence. MEG-RAG then aligns retrieved multimodal evidence with these semantic anchors through reranker training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numeric improvements. The confirmed evaluation target is multimodal RAG evidence selection against confidence-style or heuristic evidence metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, Peking University, UNSW, Macquarie University, and CSIRO Data61.

recommendation.zh: RAG 证据度量的想法合理，但对基座训练只有间接信号；看 metric 定义和 reranker loss 即可。
recommendation.en: The evidence metric is sensible but only indirectly relevant to base models; skim the metric definition and reranker loss, not the full paper.

paper.title: Knowledge Visualization: A Benchmark and Method for Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Recent text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in photorealistic synthesis and instruction following. However, their reliability in knowledge-intensive settings remains largely unexplored. Unlike natural image generation, knowledge visualization requires not only semantic alignment but also strict adherence to domain knowledge, structural constraints, and symbolic conventions, exposing a critical gap between visual plausibility and scientific correctness. To systemat

summary.core_problem: 这项工作评测并改进知识密集型文生图：模型生成的图像看起来合理，但可能违反教材中的结构、符号、空间关系和领域约定。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性不强，更偏多模态生成评测和约束式生成。但其中的 checklist 分解有参考价值：复杂知识生成不能只看整体偏好分，而应拆成可验证的原子约束。这对多模态 reward、自动评测器、基于约束的数据合成有启发。
summary.technical_approach: KVBench 覆盖高中六个学科：生物、化学、地理、历史、数学和物理。每个学科整理 150 个知识概念，并提供中英双语 prompt，总计 1,800 个样本。它不采用单一整体评分，而是从权威教材中抽取原子 checklist，逐项检查实体、标签、空间关系、结构组成和学科符号是否正确。方法部分提出 KE-Check，分两步：先做 Knowledge Elaboration，把抽象 prompt 扩展成结构化、领域化描述；再做 Checklist-Guided Refinement，构造约束清单，逐项审计生成结果，并用约束指导编辑。这个设计把知识注入和约束修正拆开，避免只靠更长 prompt 解决所有问题。
summary.experiments: 实验比较了多个文生图模型在 KVBench 上的知识可视化能力，结论是现有模型在视觉真实感之外仍存在稳定缺陷，包括结构遗漏、符号错误、关系不一致和中英文鲁棒性差异。KE-Check 能提升科学正确性，尤其有助于缩小开源模型和闭源模型之间的差距。给定材料中明确的规模数字是 1,800 个双语样本、六个学科、每学科 150 个知识概念；具体模型分数和分项提升幅度需要看实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看 KVBench 的数据构造、checklist 标注规范和 KE-Check 的 refinement 流程。实验部分主要看按学科和按错误类型拆分的结果，不必在意单个文生图模型的排名。若关注多模态 reward 或自动评测，可以多看 checklist 如何从教材标准转成可执行判据。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies knowledge-intensive text-to-image generation, where an image may look plausible but still violate textbook-level structure, symbols, spatial relations, or domain conventions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited; it is mainly a multimodal generation benchmark and refinement method. The useful part is the checklist-based decomposition of correctness. For complex knowledge generation, a holistic preference score is often too coarse. Atomic, verifiable constraints are more informative for multimodal rewards, automatic evaluators, and constraint-aware data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: KVBench covers six high-school subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Geography, History, Mathematics, and Physics. It curates 150 knowledge concepts per subject and provides bilingual English-Chinese prompts, resulting in 1,800 samples. Instead of using a single global judgment, the benchmark derives atomic checklist items from authoritative textbooks. These items verify entities, labels, spatial relations, structural components, and symbolic conventions. The proposed KE-Check framework has two stages. Knowledge Elaboration expands an abstract prompt into a structured, domain-specific description. Checklist-Guided Refinement then builds a constraint list, audits the generated image item by item, and applies constraint-guided editing. The separation is important: knowledge injection and constraint enforcement are handled as different steps rather than being folded into one longer prompt.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate several text-to-image systems on KVBench and show persistent failures beyond visual realism, including missing structures, incorrect symbols, inconsistent relations, and multilingual robustness gaps. KE-Check improves scientific fidelity and narrows part of the gap between open-source and proprietary models. The supplied material gives the benchmark scale clearly: 1,800 bilingual samples across six subjects, with 150 concepts per subject. Exact model scores and per-category improvements require checking the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the KVBench construction process, checklist annotation rules, and the KE-Check refinement pipeline. In the experiments, prioritize breakdowns by subject and error type rather than the ranking of individual image generators. For readers working on multimodal rewards or automatic evaluation, the most useful details are how textbook standards are converted into executable checklist criteria.

recommendation.zh: 把T2I从“像不像”拉回“对不对”的评测很实用；只看任务定义与失败类型统计，别指望它给出训练配方。
recommendation.en: Useful for shifting T2I evaluation from “looks right” to “is correct”; read the task spec and failure taxonomy, but don’t expect actionable training recipes.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Rethinking Math Reasoning Evaluation: A Robust LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Beyond Symbolic Rigidity
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have led to significant improvements across various tasks, including mathematical reasoning, which is used to assess models' intelligence in logical reasoning and problem-solving. Models are evaluated on mathematical reasoning benchmarks by verifying the correctness of the final answer against a ground truth answer. A common approach for this verification is based on symbolic mathematics comparison, which fails to generalize across diverse mathematica

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是数学推理评测里的一个老问题：现有基于符号规则或程序化比对的答案验证过于刚性，遇到等价表达、单位变换、近似值、不同格式书写时容易误判。论文关心的不是让模型更会做数学，而是让“答案是否正确”的判定更接近数学语义而不是字符串或符号形式。这个问题之所以重要，是因为它不仅影响 benchmark 排名，也直接影响 RLVR 这类用可验证奖励训练模型的方法；如果 verifier 有系统性漏判，训练信号就会偏。
summary.importance: 对预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train，尤其是数学 RL、verifiable reward、judge 设计，有现实意义。启发点主要有两个。第一，奖励模型或 verifier 不一定非要是硬编码符号系统，LLM judge 在某些结构化任务上可以作为更柔性的语义验证器。第二，judge 不能直接拿来用，必须处理 confirmation bias、position bias 和随机性，否则训练和评测都会被噪声污染。若关心 RLVR、自动评测、合成训练信号质量，这篇值得看；若只看预训练方法，优先级一般。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出的是一个多阶段 LLM-as-a-judge 数学答案验证框架，重点不在单次判分，而在如何把 judge 设计得更稳。第一步是 independent question answering：让 judge 在不看数据集 ground truth 的情况下，先自己解题，目的是减少对可能有误或过窄的标准答案的盲从，也缓解 confirmation bias。第二步是把 judge 生成的答案与数据集 GT 做验证和整合，形成一个更可靠的 verified reference answer，而不是直接把原始 GT 当唯一标准。第三步再用这个 verified reference 去评估模型输出。为了降低 LLM judge 的随机性，作者对同一预测做多次评估并用 majority voting 聚合。为了缓解 positional bias，对响应顺序做随机采样和打乱。整个框架的核心思想是：把“答案验证”从 brittle symbolic matching 改成“受约束的语义判断”，同时用多次采样和流程拆分来压低 judge 的偏差和方差。论文还把 pass@k 纳入评测，因为数学模型常常多次采样后才出现正确答案，单样本准确率不足以反映真实能力。
summary.experiments: 实验层面，论文主要做了两类验证。第一类是 meta-evaluation：由于不可能穷举所有等价答案形式，作者选取一小批题目和 Qwen2.5-7B 的回答，人工标注哪些答案在数学上应判为正确，用这个闭集来比较 LLM judge 与传统 symbolic verifier。结论是 LLM-based framework 明显更准确，尤其在不同表示、单位、精度和格式变化下漏判更少。第二类是 ablation，验证各个设计是否必要，包括独立解题、validated reference、multi-assessment majority voting、以及 response shuffling。摘要和引言没有给出完整数值表，因此不能准确写出提升百分点或覆盖了哪些具体 benchmark。可以确认的是，作者强调改进是“显著”的，并且分析了大量 symbolic 方法失败而 LLM judge 能正确处理的案例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把问题边界看清：它不是在做更强的数学求解器，而是在做更可靠的 verifier。然后直接看方法部分里 pipeline 设计，重点理解为什么要先 independent QA，再做 GT 校验，再做 judge，而不是直接让一个 LLM 对着 GT 判对错。接着看 meta-evaluation 设置和 ablation，判断这个框架到底是靠语义能力提升，还是靠流程工程减少偏差。若时间有限，优先看 failure cases、pipeline 图、以及各偏差来源对应的缓解设计。预计 20 分钟左右能读完关键内容。真正值得带走的是：在可验证奖励场景里，verifier 的鲁棒性和偏差控制与模型本身同样重要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent weakness in math-reasoning evaluation: symbolic or rule-based answer verification is too rigid. It often fails on mathematically equivalent answers expressed with different notation, units, approximations, or formatting. The goal is not to improve mathematical reasoning itself, but to make correctness verification align with mathematical semantics rather than surface form. This matters not only for benchmark scoring, but also for RL with verifiable rewards, where a brittle verifier directly corrupts the reward signal.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is useful for post-training, especially math RL, verifier design, and reward quality. Two lessons stand out. First, a verifier for structured reasoning tasks does not have to be a hard-coded symbolic system; an LLM judge can serve as a more flexible semantic validator. Second, an LLM judge is not reliable by default. Bias control and variance reduction are necessary, otherwise both evaluation and training become noisy. For researchers interested in RLVR, automatic evaluation, or synthetic supervision quality, this is a practical paper to skim.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a multi-stage LLM-as-a-judge framework designed to make judging more robust rather than simply replacing one verifier with another. Step one is independent question answering: the judge solves the problem without seeing the dataset ground-truth answer. This is meant to reduce confirmation bias and avoid blindly trusting a potentially narrow or even incorrect reference answer. Step two validates and reconciles the judge-generated answer with the dataset GT, producing a verified reference answer instead of treating the raw GT as the only acceptable form. Step three uses this verified reference to assess model outputs. To reduce stochasticity, the framework performs multiple judgments per prediction and aggregates them with majority voting. To mitigate positional bias, responses are shuffled and sampled across evaluation calls. The central design choice is to turn answer checking from brittle symbolic matching into constrained semantic verification, while explicitly controlling judge bias and variance through pipeline structure and repeated assessment. The paper also evaluates pass@k, which is appropriate for math reasoning because correctness may emerge only in one of several sampled outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments mainly provide two forms of evidence. First, a meta-evaluation: since it is impossible to enumerate all equivalent answer forms, the authors manually label a small closed set of responses from Qwen2.5-7B on selected questions, then compare the LLM-based verifier against a symbolic baseline. The reported outcome is that the LLM-based framework is substantially more accurate, especially on representation changes, unit conversions, precision differences, and formatting variation. Second, the paper includes ablations for the main pipeline components, including independent solving, validated reference construction, repeated judging with majority vote, and response shuffling. The provided text does not expose full metric tables or exact gains, so precise percentages should not be asserted. What is clear is that the paper documents many failure cases where symbolic verification undercounts correct answers and the LLM-based framework recovers them.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction to set the scope correctly: this is a verifier paper, not a stronger math solver. Then go straight to the pipeline section and understand why the authors do independent QA first, then GT validation, and only then final judging, instead of directly asking an LLM whether the prediction matches the reference. After that, inspect the meta-evaluation setup and the ablations to see whether the gains come from semantic flexibility or from bias-control engineering. If time is limited, prioritize the failure cases, the pipeline diagram, and the sections discussing confirmation bias, positional bias, and non-determinism. About 20 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. The durable takeaway is that in verifiable-reward settings, verifier robustness and bias control are as important as model capability.

recommendation.zh: 读失败案例和 judge 校准细节；它会影响数学 RLVR 的奖励噪声，但 LLM judge 偏差不能被当成已解决。
recommendation.en: Read the failure cases and judge calibration details; it matters for reward noise in math RLVR, but LLM-judge bias should not be treated as solved.

paper.title: On Benchmark Hacking in ML Contests: Modeling, Insights and Design
paper.abstract: Benchmark hacking refers to tuning a machine learning model to score highly on certain evaluation criteria without improving true generalization or faithfully solving the intended problem. We study this phenomenon in a generic machine learning contest, where each contestant chooses two types of effort: creative effort that improves model capability as desired by the contest host, and mechanistic effort that only improves the model's fitness to the particular task in contest without contributing

summary.core_problem: 研究机器学习竞赛中的 benchmark hacking：参赛者如何在提升榜单分数与提升真实泛化之间分配努力，以及这种扭曲何时会系统性出现。
summary.importance: 这是理论分析工作，不直接服务 LLM 训练，但对 benchmark 设计、reward hacking、评测信号失真有方法论价值。对做 post-train、agent benchmark、自动评测的人比对 pretrain 更相关。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把竞赛建模为一个博弈：每个参与者分配 creative effort（提升真实能力）与 mechanistic effort（只适配特定 benchmark）。论文证明了对称单调纯策略均衡的存在，并据此定义 benchmark hacking；进一步分析不同能力类型、竞争强度和奖励结构如何影响 hacking 行为。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，核心是理论建模与命题证明，而不是大规模实证。没有模型参数、训练数据或 LLM benchmark 实验。价值主要在概念澄清和机制推导。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies benchmark hacking in ML contests: how participants allocate effort between improving true capability and gaming the benchmark, and when such distortion emerges systematically.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory paper rather than a direct LLM training paper, but it is relevant to benchmark design, reward hacking, and evaluation signal quality. It is more useful for post-training, agent evaluation, and benchmark builders than for core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate a competition game in which each contestant allocates creative effort that improves true capability and mechanistic effort that only improves benchmark fitness. They prove the existence of a symmetric monotone pure-strategy equilibrium, define benchmark hacking relative to a single-agent baseline, and analyze how participant type, competition intensity, and incentives shape hacking behavior.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the contribution is primarily theoretical, centered on formal modeling and proofs rather than large-scale empirical evaluation. There are no model-scale, dataset, or LLM benchmark details in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 距离较远，但做 RL/benchmark 设计的人可以看定义与均衡结论；没有 LLM 实证，更多是概念工具箱。
recommendation.en: Somewhat far from pretraining, but useful if you work on RL or benchmark design; read it for the definitions and equilibrium results, not for LLM-specific evidence.

paper.title: Navigating Large-Scale Document Collections: MuDABench for Multi-Document Analytical QA
paper.abstract: This paper introduces the task of analytical question answering over large, semi-structured document collections. We present MuDABench, a benchmark for multi-document analytical QA, where questions require extracting and synthesizing information across numerous documents to perform quantitative analysis. Unlike existing multi-document QA benchmarks that typically require information from only a few documents with limited cross-document reasoning, MuDABench demands extensive inter-document analys

summary.core_problem: 评测并推动 LLM 在“大规模、多文档、半结构化集合”上的分析型 QA（需要跨文档聚合与定量计算）。
summary.importance: Benchmark 贡献为主：把 multi-doc QA 从“少量文档拼接”推到“多文档集合级分析与聚合”，并提供过程诊断信号；对预训练的直接启发有限，但对 RAG/长上下文与检索-推理耦合评测有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 用远程监督：结合文档级元数据与标注金融数据库构造问题与答案；提出评测协议：最终答案准确率 + 中间事实覆盖率（作为推理过程的辅助诊断）。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：80,000+ pages、332 个 analytical QA；实验显示把所有文档当平坦检索池的标准 RAG 表现较差（文中未给出完整数值细节于摘要）。

summary_en.core_problem: Benchmark LLMs for analytical QA over large, semi-structured multi-document collections requiring cross-document aggregation and quantitative analysis.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark: pushes multi-doc QA toward collection-level analysis and adds a process diagnostic (intermediate-fact coverage). Indirectly useful for RAG/long-context evaluation rather than pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: Distant supervision using document metadata plus annotated financial databases; evaluation includes final answer accuracy and intermediate-fact coverage as an auxiliary reasoning diagnostic.
summary_en.experiments: 80,000+ pages with 332 QA instances; standard flat-pool RAG performs poorly (full numbers not in the provided abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“RAG 在集合级分析任务会崩”的干净 benchmark 信号：只看数据构造与 intermediate-fact coverage 协议，别指望方法创新。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a clean signal that flat-pool RAG breaks on collection-level analytics; read the dataset construction and the intermediate-fact-coverage protocol, not for new methods.
