paper.title: AUDITA: A New Dataset to Audit Humans vs. AI Skill at Audio QA
paper.abstract: Existing audio question answering benchmarks largely emphasize sound event classification or caption-grounded queries, often enabling models to succeed through shortcut strategies, short-duration cues, lexical priors, dataset-specific biases, or even bypassing audio via metadata and captions rather than genuine reasoning Thus, we present AUDITA (Audio Understanding from Diverse Internet Trivia Authors), a large-scale, real-world benchmark to rigorously evaluate audio reasoning beyond surface-lev

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 audio QA benchmark 容易被捷径、短时声学线索、文本先验或元数据泄漏攻破，无法真实衡量音频推理能力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是音频理解 benchmark 工作。对语音/音频 LM 与统一多模态预训练有间接价值，因为它提供了更难、更少 shortcut 的评测集；但它本身不是新的建模方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 AUDITA 数据集，使用人工撰写、基于真实互联网音频的 trivia 问题，强调长程时间依赖、干扰项设计，以及不能仅靠文本或局部声学 cue 回答的 probing queries，用来审计人类与 AI 的音频问答能力差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出人类平均准确率 32.13%，说明任务难度较高；而现有最强 audio QA 模型明显落后。未见模型参数、训练数据和完整 baseline 细节，但 benchmark 目标很明确：压低 shortcut，逼近真实 auditory reasoning。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Columbia University、Davidson College、Haverford College 等；Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber 在评测与问答方向较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that existing audio QA benchmarks can often be solved via shortcuts, short acoustic cues, lexical priors, or metadata leakage rather than genuine auditory reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark paper for audio understanding. It has indirect value for speech/audio LM and unified multimodal pretraining because it offers a harder, less shortcut-prone evaluation target, but it is not a new modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: AUDITA is a human-authored trivia-style benchmark grounded in real-world internet audio, designed to require long-range temporal reasoning and resist answering from isolated text cues, captions, or local sound events alone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 32.13% average human accuracy, indicating substantial difficulty, while state-of-the-art audio QA systems perform much worse. Full model scales and baselines are not given in the abstract, but the benchmark intent is clear: reduce shortcuts and better measure true auditory reasoning.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Columbia University, Davidson College, Haverford College, and others; Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber is a recognizable name in evaluation and QA.

recommendation.zh: 若你做 audio LM 或统一多模态 eval，可以记住这个 benchmark；否则只需知道现有 audio QA 仍被 shortcut 污染，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on audio LM or multimodal evaluation; otherwise the main takeaway is simply that current audio QA is still heavily shortcut-contaminated.

paper.title: Revisiting Non-Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models: The Role of Entity Surface Forms
paper.abstract: Understanding what kinds of factual knowledge large language models (LLMs) memorize is essential for evaluating their reliability and limitations. Entity-based QA is a common framework for analyzing non-verbatim memorization, but typical evaluations query each entity using a single canonical surface form, making it difficult to disentangle fact memorization from access through a particular name. We introduce RedirectQA, an entity-based QA dataset that uses Wikipedia redirect information to assoc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型记没记住事实”这个老问题本身，而是更细的一层：同一个事实在参数里是否能被不同实体表述稳定访问。以往 entity-based QA 通常只用 canonical name 提问，于是“事实未记住”和“事实记住了但这个别名触发不出来”会混在一起。论文把 subject entity 的 surface form 当作受控变量，在固定 Wikidata 三元组与答案不变的前提下，只替换实体名称，专门测量 factual access 对表述形式的敏感性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它把 non-verbatim memorization 从单一实体频次问题，拆成了 entity-level memory 与 surface-level access 两层，这对解释知识记忆、长尾实体失败、以及 hallucination 的来源都更准确。第二，它说明 canonical-name 评测会系统性高估模型的事实可访问性，尤其当真实世界查询更常使用别名、缩写、拼写变体时。第三，它给出一个更贴近预训练机制的问题：模型到底是在记“实体-关系-答案”的抽象绑定，还是在记若干高频字符串模式；结果显示两者都不是极端成立，而是存在跨表述耦合但又不完全表述不变。这对数据去重、实体规范化、知识编辑、以及 retrieval 与 parametric memory 的接口设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，核心贡献是构建 RedirectQA。数据从 Wikidata factual triples 出发，把 subject entity 对齐到 Wikipedia article title 作为 canonical surface form，再利用 redirect pages 收集同一实体的其他表述。论文没有把所有 redirect 生硬纳入，而是做了较细的筛选与类别标注，区分 alternative names、abbreviations/initialisms、spelling variants、带或不带变音符号、标点差异、常见错误形式等，从而能按变体类型分析鲁棒性。评测设计上保持 relation 与 gold object 固定，只改 subject string，避免了不同问题模板或不同事实难度带来的混杂因素。分析层面，作者看了两类量：一类是 accuracy 本身，另一类是同一 canonical–redirect 对上的 prediction consistency。这样能区分“整体都不会”和“会但不稳定访问”。进一步，他们把频次拆成 entity aggregate frequency 与 individual surface frequency，分析两者与答对率的关系。如果只有 surface frequency 起作用，说明更像字符串级记忆；如果 entity frequency 还有独立贡献，说明不同表述之间存在共享的实体级表示或知识耦合。全文结论支持后者，但耦合并不强到足以实现完全表述不变。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个 LLM。文中最直接的诊断信号是：在 Pythia-12B 上，对 redirect-augmented PopQA 的初步检查里，23.7% 的 canonical–redirect 问题对给出不一致预测，这已经说明单用 canonical name 会漏掉大量访问失败。系统评测后，作者发现这种不一致在多模型上普遍存在，而且强烈依赖表述类别。对轻微正字法变化，诸如拼写差异、变音符号、标点变化，模型相对稳；对词汇层面变化更大的别名、替代名称、缩写，稳定性明显更差。频次分析是全文更有信息量的一部分：surface-level frequency 与 accuracy 正相关并不意外，但把 entity-level aggregate frequency 纳入后，后者通常仍有额外解释力，说明模型并非把每个表述完全独立记忆。换句话说，某个低频别名有时能借助高频 canonical form 获得一定可访问性，但这种迁移并不充分，因此仍会出现同事实跨表述失配。论文的重点不在追求单一 benchmark 分数，而在揭示误差结构；从这个角度看，类别分层结果和频次分解比总准确率更值得看。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction，把问题设定和 canonical-name 评测的盲点吃透；再看 RedirectQA 构建部分，重点关注 redirect 的筛选规则、类别定义，以及哪些 redirect 被排除，因为这直接决定数据是否真在测“同一实体的不同表述”。随后看结果部分里两张内容：一是不同 surface categories 下的 accuracy / consistency 对比，二是 entity frequency 与 surface frequency 的分解分析。这两部分基本构成全文的主要信息。若时间有限，优先读问题定义、数据构建原则、类别分层结果和频次回归/相关性分析，预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要结论。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种表述敏感性究竟来自 tokenizer 切分、预训练共现统计，还是实体链接能力不足；二是如果把 retrieval、entity normalization 或 contrastive alias training 接进预训练，会不会显著改善这类失败。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a narrower question than generic factual memorization: can an LLM access the same memorized fact reliably through different surface forms of the same entity? Standard entity-centric QA usually probes one canonical name per entity, which conflates two failure modes: the fact is not stored at all, or the fact is stored but not reachable through a particular alias. RedirectQA turns the entity surface form into a controlled variable while keeping the underlying Wikidata triple and gold answer fixed.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in the decomposition it forces. Factual recall is not just about entity popularity or corpus frequency; it also depends on how knowledge is indexed by names. That matters for interpreting parametric memory, long-tail failures, and hallucinations. It also shows that canonical-name evaluations can overestimate factual accessibility, because real queries often use aliases, abbreviations, or noisy forms. More importantly, the results argue against two simplistic views: knowledge is neither fully tied to individual strings nor fully surface-invariant at the entity level. There is partial cross-surface coupling. That has implications for tokenizer design, entity normalization in data pipelines, deduplication, knowledge editing, and the interface between retrieval and parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main technical contribution is the RedirectQA dataset. Starting from Wikidata factual triples, the authors map each subject entity to a Wikipedia article title as the canonical surface form, then use Wikipedia redirects to collect alternative mentions of the same entity. A useful detail is that redirects are not treated as uniformly valid aliases; the dataset construction includes filtering and category annotations, separating alternative names, abbreviations/initialisms, spelling variants, diacritic changes, punctuation variants, and common erroneous forms. The evaluation protocol holds the relation and gold object fixed and changes only the subject string, which removes confounds from template choice or fact difficulty. The analysis uses both answer accuracy and prediction consistency across canonical–redirect pairs, allowing the paper to distinguish “the model does not know the fact” from “the model knows it but accesses it unreliably.” A second key analysis decomposes frequency into entity-level aggregate frequency and surface-level frequency. If only surface frequency mattered, the phenomenon would look mostly string-local. If entity frequency still explained performance after controlling for surface frequency, that would indicate shared entity-level representations or cross-surface transfer. The paper finds the latter, but only partially.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 LLMs. A strong early diagnostic comes from Pythia-12B on a redirect-augmented PopQA setup: 23.7% of canonical–redirect question pairs produce inconsistent predictions. That already shows how much canonical-only evaluation can miss. In the full RedirectQA experiments, inconsistency remains common across models and depends strongly on the type of surface variation. Models are relatively robust to small orthographic changes such as spelling, diacritics, and punctuation, but much less stable under larger lexical shifts such as aliases, alternative names, and abbreviations. The frequency analysis is the most informative part of the paper. Surface-form frequency correlates with accuracy, as expected, but entity-level aggregate frequency often retains explanatory power beyond the specific surface frequency. This suggests that factual access is not learned independently for each alias. A low-frequency alias can sometimes benefit from a high-frequency canonical form, yet the transfer is incomplete, which is why the same fact can still fail under a different name. The paper is less about a single benchmark score and more about the structure of errors; the category-wise consistency results and the frequency decomposition are the main takeaways.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the exact failure mode the paper is targeting and why canonical-name probing is insufficient. Then read the dataset construction section carefully, especially the redirect filtering rules and category definitions; that is where the validity of the setup lives. After that, focus on two result blocks: category-wise accuracy/consistency comparisons, and the decomposition of entity frequency versus surface frequency. Those sections contain most of the paper’s signal. For a quick pass, 20–30 minutes is enough if you read the problem setup, dataset design principles, category-level findings, and the frequency analysis. The deeper questions worth carrying forward are whether the sensitivity comes mainly from tokenization, pretraining co-occurrence statistics, or weak entity linking, and whether alias-aware pretraining or retrieval-assisted normalization would reduce the gap.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会改你看 memorization 的尺子；只看数据构造和按 surface form 分桶的结果，就足够指导内部知识评测重做一版。
recommendation.en: It does not change modeling, but it should change how you measure memorization; read the dataset design and the surface-form breakdown, then redo your internal knowledge evals.

institutions: Nara Institute of Science and Technology

paper.title: Why are all LLMs Obsessed with Japanese Culture? On the Hidden Cultural and Regional Biases of LLMs
paper.abstract: LLMs have been showing limitations when it comes to cultural coverage and competence, and in some cases show regional biases such as amplifying Western and Anglocentric viewpoints. While there have been works analysing the cultural capabilities of LLMs, there has not been specific work on highlighting LLM regional preferences when it comes to cultural-related questions. In this work, we propose a new dataset based on a comprehensive taxonomy of Culture-Related Open Questions (CROQ). The results

summary.core_problem: 分析 LLM 在文化相关开放问答中是否存在隐藏的区域偏好，以及这种偏好在训练流程的哪个阶段出现。
summary.importance: 这是偏数据与行为分析的机制研究。价值不在提出新模型，而在指出文化偏差并不只是“英美中心化”，还可能表现为对特定国家文化的异常偏好；这对预训练数据配比、语言覆盖和 post-train 行为漂移分析有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 Culture-Related Open Questions（CROQ）数据集，基于较系统的文化问题 taxonomy，比较不同 LLM 在多语言提示下的回答国家分布、多样性和语言-国家耦合，并进一步分析偏差在训练阶段中的出现位置。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和完整实验表，但核心结果是：模型对日本等国家存在明显偏好；用英语或其他高资源语言提问时，输出更丰富，也更不容易偏向输入语言对应官方语言国家；作者还追踪了偏差在训练过程中的 emergence。更像行为审计而非 clean causal identification。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of the Basque Country EHU、HiTZ Center 和 Cardiff University；Jose Camacho-Collados 在多语言与知识密集 NLP 方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs exhibit hidden regional preferences in culture-related open-ended questions, and at what stage of training such biases emerge.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/data-analysis paper rather than a modeling paper. Its value is in showing that cultural bias is not merely Western or Anglocentric; it can manifest as disproportionate attraction to specific countries, which matters for data mixture design and pretrain/post-train bias analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build the CROQ dataset around a structured taxonomy of culture-related open questions, then analyze country preferences, output diversity, and language–region coupling across LLMs and prompting languages, including an emergence analysis over training stages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model scales or detailed tables, but the main findings are that many LLMs over-prefer countries such as Japan, and that prompting in English or other high-resource languages yields more diverse outputs and less bias toward countries where the prompt language is official. The training-stage analysis is interesting, though likely observational rather than fully causal.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of the Basque Country EHU, HiTZ Center, and Cardiff University; Jose Camacho-Collados is known for multilingual and knowledge-centric NLP work.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但它提醒你别把文化偏差简化成英美中心；若你管数据配比和 eval，结论可作弱信号，重点看 emergence 分析。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but it usefully warns against reducing cultural bias to simple Anglocentrism; treat it as a weak signal for data-mixture and eval design, especially the emergence analysis.

HiTZ Center - Ixa, University of the Basque Country EHU

paper.title: Who Defines "Best"? Towards Interactive, User-Defined Evaluation of LLM Leaderboards
paper.abstract: LLM leaderboards are widely used to compare models and guide deployment decisions. However, leaderboard rankings are shaped by evaluation priorities set by benchmark designers, rather than by the diverse goals and constraints of actual users and organizations. A single aggregate score often obscures how models behave across different prompt types and compositions. In this work, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the dataset used in the LMArena (formerly Chatbot Arena) benchmark and investigate t

summary.core_problem: 解决单一聚合分数的 LLM leaderboard 无法反映不同用户目标、提示分布和评价偏好的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测分析与可视化工具工作。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于提醒：公开排行榜的 prompt 分布和偏好聚合方式会扭曲模型比较，不能直接拿来指导训练决策。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 LMArena 数据集的主题分布、prompt slice 和偏好判断使用方式，再设计交互式可视化界面，让用户自行选择和加权不同 prompt slice，观察模型排名如何变化。核心不是新模型，而是 user-defined evaluation 框架。
summary.experiments: 实验重点是对 LMArena 数据分布偏斜、不同 prompt slice 下排名波动、以及 preference judgment 使用边界的分析。没有基座训练实验；贡献主要是评测诊断和界面原型。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yonsei University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between single-score LLM leaderboards and the diverse goals, prompt distributions, and evaluation priorities of real users.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-analysis and visualization paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is mainly as a warning: public leaderboard rankings can be distorted by prompt composition and preference aggregation, so they should not be used naively to drive training decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze the LMArena dataset in terms of topic skew, prompt slices, and the use of preference judgments, then build an interactive visualization interface that lets users define and weight prompt slices to see how rankings change. The contribution is a user-defined evaluation framework rather than a new model.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical focus is on dataset skew in LMArena, ranking variation across prompt slices, and ambiguity in how preference judgments are applied. There are no base-model training experiments; the contribution is diagnostic evaluation plus an interface prototype.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Yonsei University.

recommendation.zh: 做基座训练别把 Arena 排名当真值，这篇至少提醒你 benchmark composition 会改写结论；知道这个点就够了，不必细读界面实现。
recommendation.en: If you use Arena-style rankings to steer model work, this is a useful reminder that benchmark composition can rewrite conclusions; know the diagnosis, skip the UI details.

paper.title: A Metamorphic Testing Approach to Diagnosing Memorization in LLM-Based Program Repair
paper.abstract: LLM-based automated program repair (APR) techniques have shown promising results in reducing debugging costs. However, prior results can be affected by data leakage: large language models (LLMs) may memorize bug fixes when evaluation benchmarks overlap with their pretraining data, leading to inflated performance estimates. In this paper, we investigate whether we can better reveal data leakage by combining metamorphic testing (MT) with negative log-likelihood (NLL), which has been used in prior

summary.core_problem: 诊断 LLM 程序修复评测中的记忆化与数据泄漏，避免把背过 benchmark 当成真实修复能力。
summary.importance: 价值在于评测方法而非模型方法：把 metamorphic testing 和 NLL 结合，用更干净的方式测程序修复中的 memorization。这对预训练数据污染分析有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对 Defects4J 和 GitBug-Java 做语义保持变换，构造原题与变体 benchmark；再评估 7 个 LLM 在两者上的 patch success rate，并分析性能下降与 NLL 之间的关系，检验 NLL 作为记忆化代理指标是否可靠。
summary.experiments: 摘要指出所有被测模型在变换后 benchmark 上修复成功率都有明显下降，说明现有 APR 结果受 memorization 影响；具体模型名、降幅和相关性细节需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 JetBrains Research 和 Delft University of Technology，工作聚焦 LLM-based automated program repair 的评测可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: It aims to diagnose memorization and data leakage in LLM-based program repair evaluation, so benchmark recall is not mistaken for genuine repair ability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is methodological rather than model-centric: it combines metamorphic testing with NLL to obtain a cleaner probe of memorization in program repair. This has indirect value for pretraining data contamination analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors apply semantics-preserving transformations to Defects4J and GitBug-Java to create variant benchmarks, then evaluate seven LLMs on original versus transformed tasks and analyze how performance drops relate to NLL as a memorization proxy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial drops in patch-generation success rates for all tested models on transformed benchmarks, suggesting current APR results are materially affected by memorization; exact models, deltas, and correlation details require the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from JetBrains Research and Delft University of Technology, and the work focuses on evaluation validity for LLM-based automated program repair.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法论文，但如果你在意 contamination 评测，这篇比常见 NLL 打分更干净；先看变体构造和性能降幅表。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model methods paper, but if contamination measurement matters to you, this is cleaner than plain NLL probes; read the benchmark transformation setup and the drop tables first.

paper.title: GPT-5.5 System Card

summary.core_problem: 给出 GPT-5.5 的系统级风险、能力边界、部署缓解措施与评测结果，回答新一代旗舰模型在真实发布前如何做安全与能力披露。
summary.importance: 系统卡本身不是方法论文，但顶级实验室旗舰模型的 system card 往往包含训练后行为、能力分布、风险面与部署策略的关键信号。对基座研究员，它能反推哪些能力来自预训练，哪些来自后训练与产品化约束。
summary.technical_approach: 以 system card 形式汇总模型能力评测、风险分类、红队测试、滥用场景、缓解措施与发布门槛。若延续 OpenAI 近年的写法，通常会覆盖生物、网络安全、说服、隐私、越狱、工具使用等维度，并说明监控与拒答策略。
summary.experiments: 当前给定信息没有具体表格与数字，但 system card 的阅读重点通常不在单项分数，而在：1）哪些能力被列为 frontier-risk；2）哪些风险通过 post-training/monitoring 缓解；3）哪些失败模式仍然保留。对预训练研究员，最值得抽取的是能力-风险错配与评测盲区。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 OpenAI Research。旗舰系统卡通常代表 OpenAI 当前最接近生产部署的能力与风险判断，信息密度高于普通产品博客。

summary_en.core_problem: It documents GPT-5.5’s system-level risks, capability boundaries, deployment mitigations, and evaluations, i.e., how a frontier model is disclosed before release.
summary_en.importance: A system card is not a methods paper, but for a flagship model from a top lab it often reveals crucial signals about behavior, capability distribution, risk surfaces, and deployment constraints. For foundation-model researchers, it helps separate what likely comes from pretraining versus post-training and product constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work is presented as a system card summarizing capability evaluations, risk taxonomies, red-teaming, misuse scenarios, mitigations, and release thresholds. If it follows recent OpenAI practice, it likely covers domains such as bio, cyber, persuasion, privacy, jailbreaks, and tool use.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete tables are provided in the prompt, but the main value of a system card is usually not a single benchmark score. Instead, read for: (1) which capabilities are treated as frontier risks, (2) which risks are mitigated via post-training/monitoring, and (3) which failure modes remain unresolved.
summary_en.authors_note: From OpenAI Research. A flagship system card usually reflects the lab’s closest-to-production view of capability and risk, and is often denser than a standard product announcement.

recommendation.zh: 系统卡不是拿来学算法的，但它会暴露 frontier lab 真正在怕什么、靠什么缓解；先抓风险 taxonomy 和 deployment mitigations，能反推 post-train 的真实约束。
recommendation.en: A system card won’t teach you algorithms, but it reveals what a frontier lab actually worries about and how it mitigates those risks; read the risk taxonomy and deployment mitigations to infer the real post-training constraints.

paper.title: Open Sourcing Monitorability Evaluations
paper.abstract: We open-source datasets and code from our Monitoring Monitorability paper, and share a new filtering strategy for noise-dominated intervention evaluation instances.

summary.core_problem: 解决监控型对齐研究里“干预评估样本被噪声主导，导致 monitorability 结论不稳”的问题，并开放相关数据与代码。
summary.importance: 这是对齐/监控方向的重要基础设施更新。它不是预训练方法论文，但直接关系到如何构造更干净的训练与评测信号，属于 pretrain↔post-train 接口上值得关注的工作。
summary.technical_approach: OpenAI 开源 Monitoring Monitorability 论文的数据集与代码，并补充一种新的过滤策略，用于剔除噪声占主导的 intervention evaluation 实例，从而让对“模型是否可被监控、何时监控有效”的测量更稳定。
summary.experiments: 博客摘要未给出完整实验表，但核心增量在于评测数据与过滤流程的开放，以及对噪声样本筛除策略的补充。对研究员最有价值的是复现实验设置、检查过滤前后结论是否翻转，以及评估 monitorability 指标对数据清洗的敏感性。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 OpenAI Alignment。该团队长期关注监督、监控、对齐与可审计性问题；这次更新的价值主要在于把先前封闭的 monitorability 研究变成可复现资产。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a key issue in monitoring-based alignment: intervention-evaluation instances can be noise-dominated, making monitorability conclusions unstable, and it open-sources the relevant data and code.
summary_en.importance: This is an important alignment infrastructure release. It is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for cleaner training/evaluation signals and sits squarely at the pretrain↔post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenAI releases the datasets and code from its Monitoring Monitorability work and adds a new filtering strategy to remove noise-dominated intervention-evaluation instances, aiming to make measurements of monitorability more reliable.
summary_en.experiments: The blog summary does not provide full result tables, but the main contribution is the release of reproducible assets plus a filtering pipeline. The practical value is to inspect whether conclusions change before vs. after filtering and how sensitive monitorability metrics are to data cleaning.
summary_en.authors_note: From OpenAI Alignment, a team known for work on supervision, monitoring, alignment, and auditability. The main value here is turning a previously closed monitorability setup into a reproducible research asset.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法突破，但对齐评测最怕脏信号；如果你关心 RL/monitoring 训练信号质量，先看新过滤策略，再决定要不要接到内部 eval pipeline。
recommendation.en: Not a method breakthrough, but alignment evals often fail on noisy signals; if you care about RL or monitoring signal quality, read the new filtering step first and decide whether to port it into your eval pipeline.

paper.title: OMIBench: Benchmarking Olympiad-Level Multi-Image Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Model
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have made substantial advances in reasoning tasks at the Olympiad level. Nevertheless, current Olympiad-level multimodal reasoning benchmarks for these models often emphasize single-image analysis and fail to exploit contextual information across multiple images. We present OMIBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate Olympiad-level reasoning when the required evidence is distributed over multiple images. It contains problems from biology, chemistry, mathematic

summary.core_problem: 评测现有 LVLM 在多图像证据分散条件下的奥赛级推理能力，弥补单图 benchmark 无法覆盖跨图整合推理的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对做原生多模态预训练的人有间接价值，因为它把失败模式从“看懂单张图”推进到“跨图检索、对齐与组合推理”，更接近统一多模态建模的真实瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OMIBench，收集生物、化学、数学、物理奥赛题，要求模型在多张图像之间整合证据完成推理；同时提供人工标注 rationale，以及 exact match 与 semantic match 两类评测协议，用于更细粒度分析模型错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集规模，但给出关键结论：即便是最强模型之一 Gemini-3-Pro，在该 benchmark 上也只有约 50% 准确率，说明多图推理仍有明显缺口。实验应覆盖多种主流 LVLM，并比较不同评测协议下的表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中南大学、复旦大学、哈尔滨工业大学（深圳）、贵州大学等。未见顶级实验室背景，但 benchmark 选题本身较清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: It benchmarks Olympiad-level reasoning for LVLMs when evidence is distributed across multiple images, addressing the gap left by single-image benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It is indirectly useful for multimodal pretraining researchers because it shifts the failure mode from single-image understanding to cross-image retrieval, alignment, and compositional reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: OMIBench collects biology, chemistry, mathematics, and physics Olympiad problems that require integrating evidence across multiple images. It also includes manually annotated rationales and both exact-match and semantic-match evaluation protocols for finer-grained analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not state dataset size, but it gives one key result: even a top model such as Gemini-3-Pro reaches only about 50%, indicating a substantial gap in multi-image reasoning. The evaluation likely spans several leading LVLMs under multiple scoring protocols.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Central South University, Fudan University, Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), Guizhou University, and others. No obvious top-lab affiliation, but the benchmark target is well chosen.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但 failure mode 选得对；做 native multimodal pretrain 的人看榜单和错误分类就够，能帮助你决定是否要显式建模跨图证据聚合。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but it probes the right failure mode; if you work on native multimodal pretraining, the leaderboard and error taxonomy are enough to decide whether explicit cross-image evidence aggregation is worth modeling.

institutions: Education Engineering Research Center, Guizhou University

paper.title: Diagnosing CFG Interpretation in LLMs
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly integrated into agentic systems, they must adhere to dynamically defined, machine-interpretable interfaces. We evaluate LLMs as in-context interpreters: given a novel context-free grammar, can LLMs generate syntactically valid, behaviorally functional, and semantically faithful outputs? We introduce RoboGrid, a framework that disentangles syntax, behavior, and semantics through controlled stress-tests of recursion depth, expression complexity, and surface styles. Our exp

summary.core_problem: LLM 在 Agent 场景下必须遵循动态定义的机器可读接口（如 JSON schema 或函数签名），但它们究竟是真正内化了上下文提供的形式语法（CFG），还是仅仅依赖预训练记忆中的表面模式匹配？
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 作为“上下文解释器”的系统性泛化缺陷。证明了当前模型在处理复杂结构（如深层递归）时，其句法遵循能力与语义保真度存在严重脱节，这对构建可靠的 Agent 系统提出了底层挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RoboGrid 框架，将语法解释能力解耦为三个层次：句法有效性（符合生成规则）、行为等效性（执行结果正确）和语义正确性（AST 结构一致）。通过控制最大嵌套深度、分支概率和词汇熟悉度（引入“外星”词汇替换常见关键字）生成受控数据，进行语法判断、目标条件生成和指令到代码生成的压力测试。
summary.experiments: 实验发现 LLM 表现出一致的层次性退化：即使是最强的模型，在复杂约束下也往往能维持表面句法，但无法保持结构语义。随着递归深度增加，性能出现急剧的非线性衰减。当使用“外星”词汇剥离语义先验时，性能大幅下降，表明模型极度依赖词汇先验而非纯粹的符号归纳。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对三个评估层次的定义，以及 Preliminaries 中 RoboGrid 的设计和 EBNF 语法的控制变量（特别是嵌套深度和外星词汇的消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: In agentic scenarios, LLMs must adhere to dynamically defined machine-interpretable interfaces (e.g., JSON schemas or function signatures). Do they truly internalize the formal context-free grammar (CFG) provided in-context, or do they merely rely on surface pattern matching from pre-training memory?
summary_en.importance: Exposes a systemic generalization flaw in LLMs acting as 'in-context interpreters'. It demonstrates a severe disconnect between syntactic adherence and semantic fidelity when handling complex structures (like deep recursion), posing a fundamental challenge for building reliable agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the RoboGrid framework, which disentangles grammar interpretation into three layers: Syntax Validity (conforming to production rules), Behavioral Equivalence (correct execution results), and Semantic Correctness (consistent AST structure). It generates controlled data by manipulating maximum nesting depth, branching probability, and lexical familiarity (introducing 'Alien' lexicons to replace common keywords) to conduct stress tests on grammaticality judgment, goal-conditioned generation, and instruction-to-code generation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments reveal a consistent hierarchical degradation: even the strongest models often maintain surface syntax under complex constraints but fail to preserve structural semantics. Performance exhibits a sharp, non-linear decay as recursion depth increases. When 'Alien' tokens are used to strip away semantic priors, performance drops significantly, indicating a heavy reliance on lexical priors rather than pure symbolic induction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition of the three evaluation layers in the Introduction, and the design of RoboGrid and the control variables of the EBNF grammar (especially nesting depth and the ablation of alien lexicons) in the Preliminaries.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不会直接给你新训练 recipe，但会修正你对“结构化输出=会规则解释”的乐观判断；读实验设计和 Alien 设定就够了。
recommendation.en: It will not hand you a new training recipe, but it should weaken any optimism that structured output implies true rule interpretation; read the benchmark design and the Alien setup.

institutions: Jiangsu Key Lab of Language Computing

paper.title: The GaoYao Benchmark: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Multilingual and Multicultural Abilities of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Evaluating the multilingual and multicultural capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for their global utility. However, current benchmarks face three critical limitations: (1) fragmented evaluation dimensions that often neglect deep cultural nuances; (2) insufficient language coverage in subjective tasks relying on low-quality machine translation; and (3) shallow analysis that lacks diagnostic depth beyond simple rankings. To address these, we introduce GaoYao, a comprehensive

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多语言多文化 LLM 评测覆盖碎片化、主观任务依赖低质量翻译、诊断深度不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测与数据建设工作，价值在于把 multilingual 与 multicultural 能力放进统一框架，并尽量用本地化而非机器翻译来减少评测噪声；对做预训练的人，它更像数据与能力缺口的测温仪，而不是方法突破。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GaoYao 基准，包含 182.3k 样本、26 种语言、51 个国家/地区；将任务组织为三层文化能力（通用多语、跨文化、单文化）和九个认知子层；对主观评测做专家本地化扩展到 19 种语言，并为 34 种文化合成交叉文化测试集，强调诊断式分析而非只给总榜单。
summary.experiments: 摘要可见的规模是 182.3k 样本、26 语言、51 国家/地区，主观 benchmark 本地化到 19 语言，跨文化测试覆盖 34 种文化，覆盖率相对已有工作最高提升 111%。摘要未给出具体参评模型、排名和误差分析细节，但从定位看应是对主流闭源/开源 LLM 做系统比较，并输出分层诊断结果。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学团队。作者名单中包含 Hongxia Ma。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fragmented, translation-noisy, and weakly diagnostic evaluation of multilingual and multicultural abilities in LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark and dataset contribution. Its value is in unifying multilingual and multicultural evaluation and reducing benchmark noise via expert localization rather than raw machine translation. For pretraining researchers, it is more a capability thermometer than a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces GaoYao, a benchmark with 182.3k samples spanning 26 languages and 51 nations/areas. Tasks are organized into three cultural layers—general multilingual, cross-cultural, and monocultural—with nine cognitive sub-layers. Subjective benchmarks are localized by experts into 19 languages, and cross-cultural test sets are synthesized for 34 cultures, with an emphasis on diagnostic analysis beyond leaderboard ranking.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the benchmark scale is 182.3k samples, 26 languages, and 51 nations/areas. Subjective evaluation is localized into 19 languages, and cross-cultural tests cover 34 cultures, reportedly expanding prior coverage by up to 111%. The abstract does not expose the exact model roster or detailed findings, but the setup appears to benchmark major open and closed LLMs with layered diagnostics.
summary_en.authors_note: From Fudan University. The author list includes Hongxia Ma.

recommendation.zh: 做预训练不用通读；看任务分层和误差分析就够，若你在配多语数据或做文化对齐，这类 benchmark 能帮你发现训练集里哪些能力根本没被覆盖。
recommendation.en: Not a must-read for pretraining; skim the task taxonomy and failure analysis only—useful if you are tuning multilingual data mixtures or probing cultural coverage gaps in pretraining corpora.

paper.title: DialToM: A Theory of Mind Benchmark for Forecasting State-Driven Dialogue Trajectories
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to possess Theory of Mind (ToM) abilities. However, it remains unclear whether this stems from robust reasoning or spurious correlations. We introduce DialToM, a human-verified benchmark built from natural human dialogue using a multiple-choice framework. We evaluate not only mental state prediction (Literal ToM) but also the functional utility of these states (Functional ToM) through Prospective Diagnostic Forecasting -- probing whether models can id

summary.core_problem: 检验 LLM 的 Theory of Mind 能力究竟是在做稳健推理，还是只会识别表层心理状态标签而无法据此预测对话走向。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制分析加 benchmark 贡献。价值不在提出新模型，而在把 ToM 评测从“能否识别心理状态”推进到“能否利用状态预测后续社会互动轨迹”，因此更接近能力是否可用，而不是表面答对题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DialToM，一个基于自然人类对话、经人工校验的多选 benchmark。评测分两层：Literal ToM 测心理状态识别，Functional ToM 测这些状态是否能支持 Prospective Diagnostic Forecasting，即仅根据心理状态画像预测后续对话轨迹。还比较了模型推断与人类推断的语义相似度，以区分答对与真正理解。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示，作者评测了多种 LLM，发现多数模型在心理状态识别上表现较强，但除 Gemini 3 Pro 外，大多无法把这种“理解”转化为对社会轨迹的预测能力；同时，人类与模型生成推断之间的语义相似度较弱。论文贡献主要是 benchmark 和能力拆解，不是规模训练或方法突破，因此更适合作为机制侧参考材料。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自新加坡管理大学和澳大利亚国立大学。未见特别强的基座模型机构背景，这篇更偏认知能力评测与分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether LLM Theory-of-Mind performance reflects robust reasoning, or merely surface-level recognition of mental-state labels without the ability to forecast dialogue trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/benchmark contribution rather than a modeling paper. Its value is in moving ToM evaluation from state identification to state-conditioned trajectory forecasting, which is closer to whether the capability is actually usable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces DialToM, a human-verified multiple-choice benchmark built from natural human dialogues. It separates Literal ToM (mental-state prediction) from Functional ToM, measured via Prospective Diagnostic Forecasting: can a model choose the dialogue trajectory consistent with a given mental-state profile? It also compares semantic similarity between human and model-generated inferences.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, multiple LLMs are evaluated. Most models perform well on mental-state identification, but—with Gemini 3 Pro as the exception—fail to leverage that understanding to forecast social trajectories. The semantic overlap between human and model inferences is also weak. This is mainly useful as an analysis benchmark, not as a training or architecture result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University and the Australian National University. This appears to be a cognitive evaluation paper rather than work from a major base-model lab.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的能力拆解 benchmark：若你关心“模型会不会只是会贴心理标签”，看任务定义和失败案例即可，别指望它直接指导预训练配方。
recommendation.en: A clean capability-dissection benchmark: useful if you suspect models are just labeling mental states without using them, but it is unlikely to directly change your pretraining recipe.

paper.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild. The dataset currently contains 6,000 sessions, comprising more than 63,000 user prompts and 355,000 agent tool calls. SWE-chat is a living dataset; our collection pipeline automatically and continually discov

summary.core_problem: 现有AI编码Agent研究多依赖人工构建的基准数据集，缺乏真实场景下人类与编码Agent交互的实证数据，无法获知实际使用模式、真实失败模式以及Agent输出的实际有效率。
summary.importance: 公开首个大规模真实场景编码Agent交互数据集，可用于优化编码Agent训练数据、交互设计、基准构建，为编码Agent后训练、人机协作范式设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SWE-chat数据集，从公开GitHub仓库的Entire.io CLI日志中自动收集真实开发者与编码Agent的完整交互轨迹，包含用户prompt、Agent工具调用、代码diff、行级代码作者归因等多维度数据。
summary.experiments: 数据集当前包含6000个会话、6.3万条用户prompt、35.5万次Agent工具调用，覆盖200多个仓库。实证分析得到多组结论：1）最常见用户意图为理解现有代码，Agent三分之一的工具调用为执行bash命令而非编辑文件；2）使用模式呈双峰分布，41%的会话中Agent生成几乎所有提交代码（vibe coding），其余会话中Agent生成代码占比极低；3）仅不到一半的Agent生成代码最终被用户提交；4）vibe coding模式下每提交一行代码消耗3倍token和成本，引入的安全漏洞为人类自写代码的9倍、人机协作代码的5倍；5）99.9分位的单次交互时长超过100分钟，Agent极少主动询问用户澄清，5%的轮次用户主动中断Agent，39%的轮次用户反驳Agent输出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第2章数据集构建逻辑、第3-4章实证分析结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI coding agent research mostly relies on manually curated benchmark datasets, lacking empirical data of human-coding agent interaction in real scenarios, which makes it impossible to obtain actual usage patterns, real failure modes, and actual effectiveness of agent outputs.
summary_en.importance: This work releases the first large-scale real-scene coding agent interaction dataset, which can be used to optimize coding agent training data, interaction design, benchmark construction, and provides empirical basis for coding agent post-training and human-agent collaboration paradigm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SWE-chat dataset is constructed by automatically collecting complete interaction traces between real developers and coding agents from Entire.io CLI logs of public GitHub repositories, including multi-dimensional data such as user prompts, agent tool calls, code diffs, and line-level code authorship attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset currently contains 6000 sessions, 63,000 user prompts, 355,000 agent tool calls, covering more than 200 repositories. Empirical analysis draws multiple conclusions: 1) The most common user intent is to understand existing code, and one third of agent tool calls are executing bash commands instead of editing files; 2) Usage patterns show bimodal distribution: 41% of sessions have agents generating almost all committed code (vibe coding), while agents contribute very little code in the rest sessions; 3) Less than half of agent-generated code is finally committed by users; 4) In vibe coding mode, each committed line of code consumes 3x tokens and cost, and introduces 9x more security vulnerabilities than human-written code, 5x more than human-agent co-authored code; 5) The 99.9th percentile of single interaction duration exceeds 100 minutes, agents rarely actively ask users for clarification, users actively interrupt agents in 5% of turns, and users push back against agent outputs in 39% of turns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset construction logic in Chapter 2, empirical analysis results in Chapter 3 and Chapter 4, estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但数据分布很值钱：44% 代码保留率这类数字会直接影响你怎么定义 agent 训练目标与离线评测，先看 failure mode 统计。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the distributional evidence is valuable: numbers like 44% code survival should change how you define agent training targets and offline evaluation; start with the failure-mode analysis.

paper.title: Exploring the Capability Boundaries of LLMs in Mastering of Chinese Chouxiang Language
paper.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in general language tasks, their performance on Chouxiang Language, a representative subcultural language in the Chinese internet context, remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Mouse, a specialized benchmark designed to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs on NLP tasks involving Chouxiang Language across six tasks. Experimental results show that, current state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs exhibit clear limitations on mu

summary.core_problem: 评测并刻画通用 LLM 在中文互联网亚文化“抽象语言”上的能力边界与失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是小语种/变体语言的能力评测与误差分析；对预训练的直接方法论不多，但能作为“数据覆盖不足导致能力断层”的案例信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mouse 基准，覆盖 6 类任务（含翻译等）；对多种 SOTA LLM 做评测，并分析低分原因；额外检查 LLM-as-a-judge 在翻译任务上与人工偏好的一致性，以及影响抽象语言翻译的关键因素。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参评模型列表、样本规模与具体分数；结论是 SOTA LLM 在多任务上明显受限，但在“上下文语义理解”类任务相对更好；judge 与人类一致性存在偏差（需看正文量化）。
summary.authors_note: College of Computer Science, Inner Mongolia University

summary_en.core_problem: Benchmarking and characterizing the capability boundaries of LLMs on Chinese ‘Chouxiang’ (subcultural) language.
summary_en.importance: Mainly an evaluation + error analysis contribution for a non-standard language variant; limited direct pretraining methodology, but a useful signal of coverage gaps causing sharp capability drops.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Mouse benchmark with six task types (including translation), evaluates multiple SOTA LLMs, analyzes failure reasons, and checks whether LLM-as-a-judge aligns with human judgments for translation, along with factors affecting Chouxiang translation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model list, dataset size, and exact scores; reports clear limitations on multiple tasks, relatively better performance on contextual semantic understanding, and potential misalignment between LLM-judge and humans (needs quantitative details in the paper).
summary_en.authors_note: College of Computer Science, Inner Mongolia University

recommendation.zh: 作为“长尾语言变体覆盖不足会断崖式掉能力”的例子可以备查；只看任务定义、错误类型和 judge-人类一致性那一节就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth keeping as a case study of sharp capability cliffs from long-tail language variants; just read the task definitions, error taxonomy, and the LLM-judge vs human agreement section.

paper.title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Reasoning Models (MRMs) leveraging Chain-of-Thought (CoT) based thinking have revolutionized mathematical and logical problem-solving. However, we show that this paradigm struggles with generalized spatial intelligence. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of seventeen models across thirteen spatial benchmarks and identify a critical gap: CoT prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning. Furthermore, through a novel No-Image++ ablation, we demonstrate that

summary.core_problem: 多模态“推理模型”（通过SFT/RL学会长CoT）在数学/逻辑上常见收益，但在视觉空间推理上是否同样成立并不清楚。论文要回答两个问题：1) CoT提示或推理化后训练是否会系统性降低空间任务表现；2) 模型是否在空间题上依赖文本先验产生“无图也能答”的捷径与幻觉。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的启发点很具体：把“长文本推理”当作通用能力注入，可能会牺牲视觉空间任务的可靠性，甚至强化基于语言先验的捷径。它对做RL后训练、数据配比和训练目标的人有现实意义：如果奖励/监督主要鼓励可读的文本推理轨迹，模型可能学到‘用语言编一个看似合理的空间解释’，而不是提升视觉表征上的几何操作能力。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上是系统评测与对照实验。
1) 模型组：17个模型，包含8个多模态推理模型（MRMs）与多种backbone MLM（含不同规模Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL、LLaVA，以及GPT-4o）。多数MRM基于同一Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct蒸馏/后训练，便于做“推理化是否伤害视觉空间”的同源对照。
2) 数据集组：13个空间基准，覆盖2D静态关系、3D几何、以及动态/时序一致性（如BLINK、CV-Bench2D/3D、MMVP、SpatialBench、3DSRBench、MindCube、OmniSpatial等）。
3) 统一评测协议：用VLMEvalKit统一系统提示与多选格式；pass@1 greedy；固定推理长度上限（max new tokens 32768）与上下文长度；3个seed。
4) CoT对照：同一模型在base prompt与CoT prompt（要求<think>…</think>再<answer>…</answer>）下对比，隔离“仅提示词引入CoT”的影响。
5) No-Image++：在不给图（空白图）的情况下加入“Cannot determine”选项，检验模型是否会因为文本先验而继续自信作答，从而量化shortcut learning与视觉幻觉。
summary.experiments:
1) CoT提示整体负效应：在多种MLM上，CoT prompting平均降低约3%准确率。
2) 推理模型不如其backbone：7/8个MRM未能超过其蒸馏来源的backbone，在“泛化空间基准”上出现系统性回退。
3) No-Image++揭示捷径：给空白图且提供“Cannot determine”时，推理模型仍会根据文本先验编造视觉细节并选择错误答案，表现出强幻觉与过度自信。
4) 评测设置细节：使用vLLM在4×A100上批量推理，bfloat16，batch size 16，3 seeds，greedy decoding。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各数据集逐项分数表与显著性检验细节；若要更精确的“哪些基准跌得最多/哪些模型例外”，需要补充结果章节表格。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先抓结论，再看对照设计是否严谨。
1) 先看Introduction与Figure 1/主结果表（若在正文后续）：确认“CoT平均-3%”与“MRM不如backbone”的统计口径。
2) 重点读Methodology里三件事：a) 统一prompt与MCQ格式是否会偏置某些模型；b) CoT prompt的具体模板；c) No-Image++如何构造空白图与“Cannot determine”选项，是否会引入新的分布外因素。
3) 再看分组结果：2D vs 3D/动态任务上负效应是否一致，这决定问题是“几何操作”还是“视觉证据使用”。
预计阅读时间：20-30分钟可把方法与主结论读清；若要复现或用于训练决策，需要把13个基准的细项结果与附录prompt逐条核对。

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning-style multimodal models (post-trained with SFT/RL to produce long CoT) often help in math/logic, but it is unclear whether the same paradigm transfers to vision-centric spatial intelligence. The paper tests whether (1) CoT prompting and reasoning post-training systematically hurt visual-spatial benchmarks, and (2) models rely on textual priors to hallucinate spatial details even without images.
summary_en.importance: The takeaway for pretraining/post-training is operational: optimizing for verbose, text-first reasoning traces can reduce reliability on spatial tasks and amplify shortcut learning from language priors. This directly impacts RL/SFT objective design and data mixture decisions—rewarding “plausible explanations” may not train the underlying geometric/grounded operators needed for spatial reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A controlled evaluation study.
1) Model suite: 17 models including 8 open-source multimodal reasoning models (MRMs) and multiple backbone MLMs (Qwen2.5-VL at 3B/7B/72B, InternVL variants, LLaVA variants, plus GPT-4o). Many MRMs share the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, enabling apples-to-apples comparisons.
2) Benchmarks: 13 spatial datasets spanning 2D static relations, 3D geometry, and dynamic/temporal consistency (e.g., BLINK, CV-Bench2D/3D, MMVP, SpatialBench, 3DSRBench, MindCube, OmniSpatial).
3) Standardized protocol: VLMEvalKit-style uniform prompting and MCQ formatting; pass@1 under greedy decoding; fixed inference settings (up to 32k tokens).
4) CoT ablation: evaluate each model with a base prompt vs a CoT prompt requiring <think> then <answer>, isolating the effect of prompting alone.
5) No-Image++: feed a blank image and include a “Cannot determine” option to measure shortcut reliance and hallucination when visual evidence is absent.
summary_en.experiments:
1) CoT prompting is net negative: across diverse MLMs, CoT reduces accuracy by ~3% on average.
2) Reasoning models regress vs their backbones: 7/8 MRMs fail to outperform the backbone they were distilled from on generalized spatial benchmarks.
3) No-Image++ exposes shortcut learning: with blank images and an explicit abstain option, MRMs still hallucinate visual details and confidently choose wrong answers based on textual priors.
4) Compute/eval details: vLLM on 4×A100, bfloat16, batch size 16, 3 seeds, greedy decoding.
(Note: the provided excerpt does not include the full per-dataset score tables; identifying which benchmarks/models drive the regressions requires the results section/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with an eye for experimental control.
1) Start with the main results figure/table (and Figure 1 referenced) to confirm the averaging scheme behind “-3% with CoT” and the backbone-vs-MRM comparisons.
2) Read Methodology carefully: uniform prompt/MCQ formatting, the exact CoT template, and the No-Image++ construction (blank image + abstain option) to judge whether the ablation is fair.
3) Then check breakdowns by dataset category (2D vs 3D/dynamic) to infer whether the failure is about geometric operations or about using visual evidence at all.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for methods + headline results; longer if you need to reuse prompts or replicate the evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 别再默认“加 CoT 就更会推理”：这篇用 No-Image++ 把空间题的文本捷径暴露得很直白，优先看主表+无图消融。
recommendation.en: Don’t assume CoT is a free win: the No-Image++ ablation makes spatial-task shortcutting painfully obvious—read the main results table and the no-image section.

paper.title: A Systematic Study of Training-Free Methods for Trustworthy Large Language Models
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) receive increasing attention and are being deployed across various domains, their potential risks, including generating harmful or biased content, producing unsupported claims, and exhibiting vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks, have drawn significant attention. To enable quick and low-cost adaptation, training-free methods have recently emerged as cost-effective alternatives to post-training alignment techniques. Despite their promising results, these methods

summary.core_problem: 系统评估无需训练的 LLM 可信性干预方法，回答它们在安全、偏见、事实性、鲁棒性与效用之间到底如何取舍。
summary.importance: 这不是新方法论文，价值主要在评测框架与负结果整理：把分散文献中的 training-free trustworthiness 方法放到统一设置下重测，并显式检查副作用、脆弱性和计算开销。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先对现有 training-free 方法做分类，再在多种可信性场景下统一复现和比较，覆盖 harmfulness、bias、unsupported claims、adversarial vulnerability 等维度，同时测 utility degradation、robustness 和 overhead。核心不是提出新算法，而是用更一致的 protocol 重新审视这些方法是否真的比后训练对齐更划算。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点是跨方法、跨可信性维度的系统重评，而不是大规模模型训练。论文强调现有工作评测口径不一致、覆盖面有限，并指出不少 training-free 方法会带来效用下降和更高脆弱性。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，因此更适合作为评测结论参考，而不是方法复现目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically re-evaluates training-free interventions for trustworthy LLMs, asking how they trade off safety, bias, factuality, robustness, and utility in a unified setup.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new method paper; its value lies in evaluation discipline and negative findings. It consolidates scattered training-free trustworthiness methods under a consistent protocol and explicitly measures side effects, brittleness, and computational overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors categorize existing training-free methods and re-benchmark them across multiple trustworthiness settings, including harmfulness, bias, unsupported claims, and adversarial vulnerability, while also tracking utility degradation, robustness, and runtime cost. The contribution is a cleaner comparative study rather than a new alignment algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments focus on systematic cross-method evaluation rather than large-scale model training. The paper argues that prior evaluations are inconsistent and narrow, and that many training-free methods incur utility loss and increased brittleness. The abstract does not expose model sizes, dataset scale, or exact gains, so this is more useful as an evaluation reference than a method to reproduce.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测整理，不会改变预训练方法论；若你关心对齐副作用，只看方法分类和副作用表，别把单点安全提升当成稳健结论。
recommendation.en: Mostly an evaluation cleanup, not a pretraining-method paper; read the taxonomy and side-effect tables, and treat isolated safety gains as weak evidence.

paper.title: DPrivBench: Benchmarking LLMs' Reasoning for Differential Privacy
paper.abstract: Differential privacy (DP) has a wide range of applications for protecting data privacy, but designing and verifying DP algorithms requires expert-level reasoning, creating a high barrier for non-expert practitioners. Prior works either rely on specialized verification languages that demand substantial domain expertise or remain semi-automated and require human-in-the-loop guidance. In this work, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can automate DP reasoning. We introduce DPrivBenc

summary.core_problem: 评测大语言模型是否具备差分隐私推理能力，尤其是在需要形式化条件判断与机制验证的场景下，现有模型到底能做多少。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向高难度专业推理的 benchmark 贡献。对基座研究员的价值不在 DP 本身，而在于它提供了一个较干净的、难以靠模式匹配取巧的 reasoning stress test，可用于观察模型在形式化推理上的真实短板。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建 DPrivBench：每个样本要求模型判断某个函数或算法在给定假设下是否满足指定的 differential privacy 保证。数据覆盖多类 DP 主题、不同难度，并刻意设计为抗 shortcut reasoning。实验评测多个前沿模型在教材级机制与更复杂算法上的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示最强模型能处理 textbook 级 DP 机制，但在高级算法上全部明显失效，说明当前模型的形式化隐私推理能力存在系统缺口。未见与训练数据污染、工具辅助证明或 verifier-in-the-loop 的细分对照信息，需看正文确认 benchmark 清洁度与 error taxonomy。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Kamalika Chaudhuri、Yu-Xiang Wang 等隐私学习领域知名研究者；如果 benchmark 设计严谨，其结论在“LLM 是否真的会形式化推理”这个问题上有一定分量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how far LLMs can actually reason about differential privacy, especially in settings that require formal condition checking and mechanism verification.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark for difficult expert reasoning. For foundation-model researchers, the value is less about DP itself and more about having a relatively clean stress test for formal reasoning that resists shallow pattern matching.
summary_en.technical_approach: DPrivBench consists of instances where the model must decide whether a function or algorithm satisfies a stated differential-privacy guarantee under explicit assumptions. The benchmark spans multiple DP topics and difficulty levels and is designed to reduce shortcut-based success. Frontier models are then evaluated across these settings.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the strongest models can handle textbook mechanisms but all models struggle on advanced algorithms, exposing a substantial gap in formal privacy reasoning. The abstract does not reveal enough about contamination checks, tool use, or verifier-assisted baselines, so those details need validation in the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes well-known privacy-learning researchers such as Kamalika Chaudhuri and Yu-Xiang Wang; if the benchmark construction is clean, its conclusions carry weight for evaluating formal reasoning in LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但 benchmark 设计若足够干净，可当作‘形式化推理不会因会背教材而自动出现’的反例；先看任务构造和错误分布。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if the benchmark is clean it is a useful reminder that formal reasoning does not emerge just because models can recite textbook mechanisms; read the task design and error taxonomy first.

paper.title: CIG: Measuring Conversational Information Gain in Deliberative Dialogues with Semantic Memory Dynamics
paper.abstract: Measuring the quality of public deliberation requires evaluating not only civility or argument structure, but also the informational progress of a conversation. We introduce a framework for Conversational Information Gain (CIG) that evaluates each utterance in terms of how it advances collective understanding of the target topic. To operationalize CIG, we model an evolving semantic memory of the discussion: the system extracts atomic claims from utterances and incrementally consolidates them int

summary.core_problem: 如何量化“讨论对话是否带来信息推进”，而不是只看礼貌性/结构性指标。
summary.importance: 提出一个面向对话质量的可解释评测框架（信息增益+记忆动态）；对训练/对齐的直接方法贡献不大，但可作为评估信号或数据筛选指标的候选。
summary.technical_approach: 构建“语义记忆”状态：从每轮话语抽取原子claim并增量整合；基于记忆变化给每个utterance打三维分数：Novelty、Relevance、Implication Scope；并用记忆动态特征（如claim更新次数）解释人类对CIG的判断；同时给出LLM-based的CIG评估器。
summary.experiments: 标注80个片段（电视辩论+社区讨论），比较记忆动态特征与传统启发式（长度、TF-IDF等）对人类CIG评分的相关性；摘要称记忆动态相关性更强，但未给出具体系数。

summary_en.core_problem: How to measure whether a deliberative dialogue makes informational progress, beyond civility or argument-structure metrics.
summary_en.importance: An interpretable evaluation framework (information gain + memory dynamics); not a direct training method, but potentially useful as an evaluation signal or data filtering criterion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maintains an evolving semantic memory by extracting atomic claims per utterance and incrementally consolidating them; scores each utterance on Novelty, Relevance, and Implication Scope; uses memory-derived dynamics (e.g., number of claim updates) to explain human CIG judgments; builds an LLM-based CIG evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: Annotates 80 segments (TV debates + community discussions) and shows memory dynamics correlate better with human-perceived CIG than heuristics like length or TF-IDF; exact correlation numbers are not in the truncated abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为“对话数据筛选/评测信号”有点意思，但规模小且依赖claim抽取质量；只看指标定义和相关性实验即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting as a dialogue data filtering/eval signal, but small-scale and bottlenecked by claim extraction; read the metric definition and correlation study only.

paper.title: The Metacognitive Monitoring Battery: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for LLM Self-Monitoring
paper.abstract: We introduce a cross-domain behavioural assay of monitoring-control coupling in LLMs, grounded in the Nelson and Narens (1990) metacognitive framework and applying human psychometric methodology to LLM evaluation. The battery comprises 524 items across six cognitive domains (learning, metacognitive calibration, social cognition, attention, executive function, prospective regulation), each grounded in an established experimental paradigm. Tasks T1-T5 were pre-registered on OSF prior to data colle

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否具备跨任务、跨认知域的自我监控能力，尤其是能否在答错时识别并撤回答案，而不是只输出表面置信度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark/评测框架。它把人类元认知实验范式移植到 LLM 评估，关注 monitoring-control coupling，而不是常见的 calibration 单点分数；对机制研究有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个包含 524 个题目的跨域 battery，覆盖学习、校准、社会认知、注意、执行功能和前瞻调节六类任务。每次 forced-choice 作答后，再要求模型决定 KEEP/WITHDRAW 和 BET/decline，并以 withdraw delta 作为关键指标，衡量模型是否更倾向于撤回错误答案而保留正确答案。
summary.experiments: 在 20 个 frontier LLM 上共进行了 10,480 次评估。摘要称该 battery 能区分三类行为画像：blanket confidence、blanket withdrawal，以及更接近 Nelson-Narens 架构的 selective monitoring。但未给出具体模型名单、显著性检验和与传统 calibration 指标的对应关系。

summary_en.core_problem: It evaluates whether LLMs have cross-domain self-monitoring ability—especially whether they can detect likely errors and withdraw answers—rather than merely outputting surface-level confidence.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark/evaluation framework. It imports human metacognitive paradigms into LLM evaluation and focuses on monitoring-control coupling instead of standard one-shot calibration metrics, which is moderately useful for mechanism research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a 524-item cross-domain battery spanning learning, calibration, social cognition, attention, executive function, and prospective regulation. After each forced-choice answer, the model must decide KEEP/WITHDRAW and BET/decline; the key metric is withdraw delta, measuring whether the model withdraws incorrect answers more often than correct ones.
summary_en.experiments: It reports 10,480 evaluations across 20 frontier LLMs. The abstract says the battery separates three behavioral profiles: blanket confidence, blanket withdrawal, and more selective monitoring consistent with the Nelson-Narens framework. However, model identities, significance tests, and links to standard calibration metrics are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 这是评测设计，不是机制突破；如果你在做 uncertainty-aware training，可只看 withdraw delta 定义和模型分型，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: This is an evaluation design paper, not a mechanism breakthrough; if you care about uncertainty-aware training, just read the withdraw-delta metric and the model typology.

paper.title: How Hypocritical Is Your LLM judge? Listener-Speaker Asymmetries in the Pragmatic Competence of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied as repositories of linguistic knowledge. In this line of work, models are commonly evaluated both as generators of language and as judges of linguistic output, yet these two roles are rarely examined in direct relation to one another. As a result, it remains unclear whether success in one role aligns with success in the other. In this paper, we address this question for pragmatic competence by comparing LLMs' performance as pragmatic listener

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是：LLM 作为语言生成者和作为语言评判者时，能力是否一致，尤其在语用能力上是否存在系统性不对称。
summary.importance: 它的重要性在于提醒大家不要把 judge 能力和 generation 能力混为一谈。贡献类型属于机制/评测分析：通过 listener-speaker 对照实验，指出当前模型在 pragmatic judging 上往往强于 pragmatic generation，这对用 LLM 做 evaluator、reward model 或自我评估有直接警示意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在三个 pragmatic settings 下，同时评估多个开源和闭源 LLM 的两种角色：作为 listener 去判断语言输出是否合适，作为 speaker 去生成语用上合适的表达。核心方法不是新模型，而是把 judge/generator 两种常被分开讨论的能力放到统一框架里直接比较，并分析二者相关性。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖多个 open-weight 与 proprietary LLM，跨三个语用场景。主要发现是稳健的 listener-speaker asymmetry：不少模型在判断别人说得是否合适时明显强于自己生成合适表达；两种能力的对齐程度较弱。摘要未给出具体模型名单、样本规模和数值差距，但结论方向清楚，适合作为 evaluator 使用边界的证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs are equally competent as language generators and as judges, focusing on whether pragmatic competence is symmetric across these two roles.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in showing that judging and generating should not be conflated. This is a mechanism/evaluation paper: by directly contrasting listener and speaker roles, it finds that current models are often better at pragmatic evaluation than pragmatic generation, which matters for LLM-as-judge, reward modeling, and self-evaluation setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across three pragmatic settings, the authors evaluate multiple open-weight and proprietary LLMs in two roles: as listeners judging whether an utterance is pragmatically appropriate, and as speakers generating pragmatically appropriate language. The contribution is not a new model but a unified comparison framework that directly measures alignment between judging and generating abilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates experiments on multiple open and closed models across three pragmatic scenarios. The main result is a robust listener-speaker asymmetry: many models are substantially better at judging pragmatic appropriateness than at producing it, and the two abilities are only weakly aligned. The abstract does not provide exact model lists, dataset sizes, or margins, but the directional finding is clear and relevant to evaluator reliability.

recommendation.zh: 这篇对做 judge/reward 的人比对做预训练的人更有用；结论不新奇，但足够提醒你别把“会打分”当成“会生成”，看实验设计和相关性分析就够了。
recommendation.en: This matters more for judge/reward-model users than for pretraining, but it is a useful reminder not to equate scoring ability with generation ability; the setup and correlation analysis are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: KMMMU: Evaluation of Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding in Korean Language and Context

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态评测多为英文/翻译集，难以衡量模型在韩语语境与本土制度/文化约定下的多学科多模态理解能力；如何构建原生韩语的高信息密度评测？
summary.importance: 提供语言与文化/制度约定强相关的多模态理解benchmark，可用于诊断“从约定到标签映射”(convention-to-label mapping)与符号归纳等能力缺口；对多语种/本土化多模态预训练数据与评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建KMMMU：3,466道原生韩语试题式多模态问题，覆盖9学科与9类视觉模态；额外提供300题韩语特有子集与627题hard子集；并做分学科/子集评测与错误分析以定位失败模式。
summary.experiments: 在KMMMU全量与hard子集上评测开源与闭源模型：最强开源约42.05%（全量），最佳闭源在hard子集约52.42%；韩语特有子集存在最高约13.43%的性能差距；错误分析指出主要瓶颈更偏“约定/格式到标签映射”与少样本符号归纳，而非纯推理深度。摘要未给出具体模型名称与配置细节。

summary_en.core_problem: English-centric or translated multimodal benchmarks fail to measure multimodal understanding under Korean language, cultural, and institutional conventions; how to build a native Korean, information-dense evaluation?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a culturally grounded multimodal benchmark to diagnose gaps in convention-to-label mapping and few-shot symbolic induction, informing multilingual/localized multimodal pretraining and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds KMMMU with 3,466 native Korean exam-style multimodal questions across 9 disciplines and 9 visual modality categories, plus a 300-item Korean-specific subset and a 627-item hard subset; includes per-discipline evaluation and error analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks open and proprietary models: best open-source reaches ~42.05% on the full set; best proprietary gets ~52.42% on the hard subset; Korean-specific subset shows gaps up to ~13.43%. Error analysis points to convention-to-label mapping and few-shot symbolic induction as key bottlenecks. Specific model details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为韩语本土语境的多模态“约定→标签”压力测试很有用，但对预训练机制没新东西；当作多语种评测备查，扫题型分布与错误案例即可。
recommendation.en: Handy Korean-native stress test for convention-to-label mapping, but it won’t move pretraining priors; keep it as multilingual eval reference and just skim task taxonomy + failure cases.

paper.title: Seek-and-Solve: Benchmarking MLLMs for Visual Clue-Driven Reasoning in Daily Scenarios

summary.core_problem: 评测MLLM在日常场景中“从视觉噪声中定位关键线索并据此推理”的能力缺口，构建更偏推理而非识别/常识的基准。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：将评测重心从知识/感知转向“线索驱动推理”，对多模态预训练与后训练的数据构造、评测诊断有一定价值，但属于常规基准工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DailyClue基准：强调真实日常活动强 grounding，并设计需要主动寻找视觉线索、再进行后续推理的挑战性问题；覆盖4大日常域、16个子任务，并对多种MLLM与agentic模型进行系统评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模、具体模型列表与分数差距；结论是现有MLLM/agentic模型在该基准上表现仍具挑战性。

summary_en.core_problem: Fill the evaluation gap for MLLMs on visual clue-driven reasoning in daily scenarios, beyond recognition or prior-knowledge probing.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution shifting evaluation toward clue localization + reasoning; useful for diagnosing multimodal pre/post-training data needs, though largely a standard benchmark paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: DailyClue is built with strict grounding in authentic daily activities and queries that require actively identifying decisive visual clues before reasoning; spans 4 domains and 16 subtasks with evaluations across MLLMs and agentic models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits dataset size, model roster, and exact score gaps; it reports that the benchmark remains challenging for current MLLMs/agentic systems.

recommendation.zh: 又一个benchmark，但把重点放在“先找线索再推理”而非识别，适合用来做数据合成/后训练诊断；不必细读，扫任务定义与难例就行。
recommendation.en: Another benchmark, but the ‘seek clue then reason’ framing is useful for diagnosing data/finetune gaps; no need to deep read—skim task definitions and hard examples.

paper.title: Character Beyond Speech: Leveraging Role-Playing Evaluation in Audio Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: 如何评估并训练“语音角色扮演/角色对齐”能力：角色不仅体现在文本内容，也体现在音色、韵律等副语言信息，难以量化评测与对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献偏向多模态（音频LLM）对齐评测与数据集：提出评测框架+首个语音角色扮演评测数据集（含CoT标注），对多模态对齐/评测有一定参考价值，但对文本LLM预训练方法论影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RoleJudge：利用音频大模型从多模态、多维度评估“语音-角色”一致性；构建RoleChat数据集（真实与LLM生成语音样本，带链式思维标注）；并基于该数据集进行多阶段训练与强化学习式对齐（摘要中提到multi-stage与reinforcement learning/standard alignment）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据量、关键baseline与量化提升幅度；主要展示评测框架与数据集驱动的对齐训练有效性（需读正文确认指标与对比）。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating and aligning voice role-playing in audio LLMs, where character traits are expressed via both text and paralinguistic speech cues that are hard to quantify.
summary_en.importance: Multimodal alignment/evaluation contribution: an evaluation framework plus a role-playing speech dataset with CoT annotations; moderately useful for multimodal alignment research, less direct impact on text LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RoleJudge uses audio LLMs to score character alignment across modalities/dimensions; RoleChat dataset includes authentic and LLM-generated speech with chain-of-thought annotations; a multi-stage training pipeline with RL-style alignment is applied.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or exact gains; details require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 语音角色对齐把“音色/韵律”纳入可评测目标是亮点，但更像对齐数据与RL流程展示，离预训练改动较远；当作评测素材库，扫指标与标注设计即可。
recommendation.en: Nice to see role alignment evaluated beyond text into timbre/prosody, but it’s mainly an alignment dataset+RL pipeline, not a pretraining lever; treat it as eval material and skim metrics/annotation design.

paper.title: An Empirical Investigation of Practical LLM-as-a-Judge Improvement Techniques on RewardBench 2

summary.core_problem: 在不做任何微调的前提下，系统性回答“LLM-as-a-judge 在 RewardBench 2 上到底哪些可落地的提示/聚合技巧能稳定提升判别准确率、提升幅度与成本代价分别是多少”，并给出可复现的成本—准确率权衡与失败技巧的负面结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“用 judge 作为训练/搜索/门控信号”的整条链路（RLHF reward、自动提示优化、离线回归测试）影响很实：它把 judge 可靠性提升拆解为两类主要增益来源（任务准则注入与多次采样集成），并量化了收益/成本曲线与温度依赖，能直接指导后训练与评测系统的信号设计，减少把噪声 judge 当成真监督带来的训练不确定性。
summary.technical_approach:
论文围绕 RB2 的四选一评分任务（对每个候选打 1-10 分，取均分最高者；若与正确答案并列则判错）评估五类“即插即用”改进：
1) 集成打分（ensemble scoring）：对同一题请求 k 次独立 completion，按每个候选的均分决策。关键点是用 temperature=1.0 拉大方差以提升集成收益，并用 API 的 n 参数实现“输入只计一次、输出按 n 计费”的成本模型。
2) 任务特定准则注入（criteria injection）：在通用 judge prompt 上，按 RB2 五大类（Factuality/Focus/Mathematics/Precise IF/Safety）额外注入一句话的类别判分准则，属于极低成本的 prompt conditioning。
3) 校准上下文（calibration context）：塞入一个已评分参考样例作为锚点，试图校准 1-10 分标尺。
4) 自适应模型升级（adaptive model escalation）：先用便宜模型（mini）多次采样；若分数方差/不确定性高再升级调用 full 模型。
5) 组合与软融合（soft blending）：对 mini/full 的分数做加权融合；以及方差驱动的集成/路由变体。对涉及参数调优的策略，使用 80/20 切分并在 test 上报结果，避免“在评测集上调参”。
方法论上，论文强调保守的 tie 处理（并列即错）与 bootstrap 置信区间，避免把“不会区分”当成正确。
summary.experiments:
数据与设置：RewardBench 2 去掉 Ties 子集后共 1,753 题，覆盖五类；模型为 Azure OpenAI 的 GPT-5.4 full/mini/nano；temperature=1.0、reasoning_effort="none"、max 4096 输出。
核心结果（全文给出的关键数字）：
- 基线（k=1、无技巧）总体准确率 71.7%。
- 准则注入单独带来 +3.0 个百分点（几乎零额外成本）。
- 集成（k=5）单独带来 +9.8 个百分点，成本约 5×（更精确地说输出侧线性增长；文中综合估算为 5×量级）。
- 两者组合达到 83.6% 准确率，相对基线 +11.9pp，总成本约 5.3×。
- 温度消融：k=1 的准确率对温度不敏感；但集成收益随温度上升而增大（temp=0 时集成增益约 +4.6pp，temp=1.0 时约 +9.8pp），支持“用更高随机性换取可集成的多样性”。
- 成本—准确率分析：便宜模型从集成中获益更大。mini 在 k=8 时可匹配 full 的单次准确率，成本约 1.2×；nano 在 k=8 时接近 full 单次准确率，成本约 0.4×。
- 负面结果：校准上下文、模型升级路由、软融合在相近成本下不稳定或不优于“准则注入+简单集成”的强基线（论文的结论是“几乎所有可用增益都被这两招吃掉了”）。
统计：用 2,000 次 bootstrap 报 95% CI；对调参策略在 held-out test 上报，避免乐观偏差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Experimental Setup：尤其是“并列判错”的评测定义、bootstrap CI、以及成本估算（输入一次、输出按 n 计费）——这些决定了结论是否可迁移到你的评测/训练管线。
- 重点看温度与集成的关系（temperature sweep）和成本—准确率曲线：它直接告诉你在固定预算下该选“更强模型单次”还是“弱模型多次+集成”。
- 快速扫过 calibration/escalation/blending 的失败分析：用于避免在 judge 信号上做无效工程投入。
- 若你做 RLHF/自动提示搜索：把“准则注入”当作 reward spec 的最小可行改进，把“集成”当作降低 reward 噪声的工程手段，并注意 tie 处理会显著影响 reward 的稀疏性与梯度质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Empirically determine which practical, drop-in prompting/aggregation techniques (no finetuning) reliably improve LLM-as-a-judge accuracy on RewardBench 2, and quantify the accuracy–cost trade-offs as well as which commonly suggested tricks fail to beat a strong simple baseline.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but highly relevant to pretraining-adjacent pipelines that treat judge scores as supervision (RLHF reward modeling, automated prompt/search loops, release gating). It isolates where most real-world judge gains come from (criteria specification + sampling/ensembling), provides a budgeted accuracy frontier, and reduces the risk of optimizing against noisy judge signals that can destabilize downstream training and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper evaluates five non-finetuning interventions on RB2’s 4-candidate, 1–10 integer scoring setup, using a conservative decision rule (the correct response must be the unique top by mean score; ties count as wrong) and bootstrap CIs.
Key techniques:
- Task-specific criteria injection: add a one-sentence, category-aware scoring criterion (Factuality/Focus/Math/Precise-IF/Safety) to the generic judge prompt.
- Ensemble scoring: sample k independent judge completions and average per-candidate scores; use temperature=1.0 to increase diversity and leverage the API’s n parameter so input tokens are paid once while output scales with k.
- Calibration context: prepend a previously scored reference example to anchor the 1–10 scale.
- Adaptive escalation: run a cheaper model first and escalate to a stronger model when score variance indicates uncertainty.
- Soft blending/combination: weighted fusion of mini/full scores; tuned variants are evaluated on a held-out split to avoid in-sample optimism.
Methodologically, the work is about controlled ablations under a consistent inference configuration (reasoning_effort="none") and explicit cost accounting.
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: 1,753 RB2 examples (excluding the Ties subset), GPT-5.4 full/mini/nano via Azure OpenAI, temperature=1.0, reasoning_effort="none", max 4096 output tokens; 95% CIs via 2,000× nonparametric bootstrap.
Main numbers reported in the paper:
- Baseline (k=1) accuracy: 71.7%.
- Criteria injection: +3.0 pp at negligible cost.
- Ensembling: +9.8 pp at ~5× cost (output-dominated).
- Combined: 83.6% accuracy, +11.9 pp over baseline, at ~5.3× cost.
- Temperature sweep: k=1 accuracy is largely insensitive to temperature, but ensemble gains grow with temperature (about +4.6 pp at temp=0 vs +9.8 pp at temp=1.0).
- Cost–accuracy frontier: cheaper models benefit disproportionately from ensembling—mini with k=8 matches full single-shot accuracy at ~1.2× cost; nano with k=8 approaches it at ~0.4× cost.
- Negative results: calibration context, adaptive escalation, and soft blending do not reliably outperform the simpler “criteria + plain ensembling” baseline at comparable cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 minutes):
- Read the evaluation protocol carefully (unique-winner requirement, tie-as-wrong) and the bootstrap CI procedure; these choices materially affect conclusions.
- Focus on the temperature sweep and the cost–accuracy analysis: they translate directly into how you should budget judge calls in RLHF/evals.
- Skim the sections on calibration/escalation/blending mainly for the failure modes and why they don’t beat the strong simple baseline.
- If you use judge scores as training signals, treat criteria injection as “reward spec tightening” and ensembling as “reward noise reduction,” and consider how tie handling changes reward sparsity.

recommendation.zh: 只看成本-准确率曲线和失败技巧清单：把“准则注入 vs 多采样集成”的收益拆开量化，能避免你把噪声judge直接接进训练闭环。
recommendation.en: Just read the cost–accuracy tradeoff and the negative results: it separates gains from rubric injection vs sampling ensembles, helping you avoid wiring a noisy judge into training loops.

paper.title: LongCoT: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 如何可控、可验证地评测前沿模型在“超长推理链”(长时程CoT)上的规划与错误累积问题。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：把长时程推理失败从“单步能力不足”中剥离出来，直接测量跨数万到数十万推理token的长链依赖与状态管理能力，为长上下文训练、推理时计算分配、以及后训练/自我纠错研究提供靶标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LongCoT基准：2500道专家设计题，覆盖化学/数学/计算机/国际象棋/逻辑；题目输入短且答案可验证，但解题需要在“相互依赖步骤图”中推进，链长可达数十到数十万推理token；设计使得每个局部步骤对前沿模型都可解，从而将失败归因于长时程组织与累积误差。
summary.experiments: 报告发布时前沿模型在该基准上准确率<10%（如GPT 5.2: 9.8%，Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%）；其余训练规模/提示策略/对比设置摘要未展开。

summary_en.core_problem: How to rigorously and verifiably evaluate frontier models’ long-horizon chain-of-thought planning and error accumulation over extremely long reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution: isolates long-horizon reasoning failures from single-step capability limits, providing a target for long-context training, inference-time compute allocation, and post-training/self-correction research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces LongCoT: 2,500 expert-designed problems across chemistry, math, CS, chess, and logic. Inputs are short with verifiable answers, but solving requires traversing a dependency graph of steps spanning tens to hundreds of thousands of reasoning tokens. Each local step is intended to be tractable for frontier models, attributing failures to long-horizon limitations.
summary_en.experiments: At release, best models achieve <10% accuracy (e.g., GPT 5.2: 9.8%; Gemini 3 Pro: 6.1%). The abstract does not detail training scale, prompting protocols, or broader baselines.

recommendation.zh: 当benchmark备查即可：重点看任务如何可验证+错误累积统计，能把长上下文训练/推理算力分配的改动落到可测靶标上。
recommendation.en: Use it as a benchmark reference: focus on the verifiability design and error-accumulation stats—it gives a concrete target for long-context training and inference compute-allocation tweaks.

paper.title: Dataset-Level Metrics Attenuate Non-Determinism: A Fine-Grained Non-Determinism Evaluation in Diffusion Language Models

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（DLM）在推理时天然包含多重随机性与配置自由度（扩散步数、CFG、MC 采样、batch size、数值精度等），导致同一输入在不同运行/配置下输出不一致。现有评测往往只看固定配置下的 dataset-level 指标（accuracy、pass@k），但作者指出这种聚合会系统性“衰减/掩盖”非确定性：不同配置可能总体分数几乎一样，却在样本级出现大量 correctness flip 和完全不同的错误模式。本文要解决的是：建立一个细粒度、跨因素的非确定性评测范式，量化并归因 DLM 的不稳定来源。
summary.importance: 对预训练方法不是直接贡献，但对“评测可信度/可复现性/训练-推理耦合的随机性”非常关键，尤其是当社区开始探索非自回归/扩散式语言建模时。对基座研究的启发点：1）仅用 aggregate 指标做模型/配置对比会误判稳定性，可能影响 scaling/消融结论的可信度；2）提出 Factor Variance Attribution（FVA）把非确定性拆成‘因素选择带来的方差’与‘因素内部设置敏感性’，为后续研究训练动态、采样策略、数值实现对结果的影响提供了可复用的分析工具；3）发现任务依赖性很强（代码任务更敏感），提示在预训练/后训练评测中应按任务类型设计稳定性协议。
summary.technical_approach:
全文方法论贡献为主：
1）从 dataset-level 转向 sample-level：对同一输入，在不同推理因素/设置下重复运行，直接统计预测输出/正确性在配置间的翻转率（flip rate），并记录“错到对/对到错/错但错法不同”等细粒度现象，从而显式暴露被 aggregate 指标抵消的变化。
2）跨因素系统评测：把影响非确定性的来源分为 model-related（影响扩散动力学，如 MC 采样、CFG、扩散步数等）与 system-related（执行与数值，如 batch size、精度等），并强调不做性能导向的调参，避免把评测变成隐式优化。
3）FVA（Factor Variance Attribution）：用方差分解的方式，把观测到的非确定性拆解为：不同“因素”本身带来的方差贡献，以及在某个因素内部不同“设置”导致的敏感性贡献，从而回答“到底是换了哪类因素导致不稳定，还是同一因素下对具体取值很敏感”。这比单纯报告多次运行的均值/方差更可解释，也更利于复现实验协议。
summary.experiments: 作者展示了一个关键现象：在多个基准上，改变 batch size、CFG scale、MC 样本数等因素时，dataset-level accuracy 基本不变，但 sample-level 会出现非平凡的预测翻转率；并且即使都判为错误，不同配置也会给出不同的错误答案，意味着错误模式发生变化。论文还给出定性案例（文中提到 Table 1 和 Table 6）来展示系统因素（如数值精度）与模型因素（如 MC sampling）都能在不改变总体分数的情况下改变单样本输出。任务层面，代码生成对因素选择更敏感，QA 相对更稳。由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体 flip rate 数值、各因素的方差归因比例、所用 DLM 规模/推理步数等完整表格，这里无法逐项给出精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1（文中重点引用）：理解“总体分数不变但样本翻转明显”的核心证据。
2）读方法部分：sample-level 指标定义、flip 的统计方式、以及 FVA 的方差分解公式/实现细节（这是可迁移到你自己评测管线的部分）。
3）读实验分解：按任务（code vs QA）与按因素类别（model-related vs system-related）的归因结论，帮助你决定在做 DLM/非 AR LM 的 scaling 或消融时，哪些推理配置必须锁死、哪些需要报告区间/分布而非单点。
4）最后扫 Tables 1/6 的案例：看“错法不同”这一点，对构建更细粒度的错误分析与鲁棒性评测很有用。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion language models introduce inherent stochasticity and many inference-time degrees of freedom (diffusion steps, CFG, Monte Carlo sampling, batch size, numerical precision, etc.). Standard evaluations typically report dataset-level metrics under a fixed configuration, but such aggregation can systematically *attenuate* non-determinism: two configurations can have nearly identical accuracy/pass@k while producing very different outputs (and correctness flips) on individual inputs. The paper addresses how to evaluate and attribute DLM non-determinism at a fine-grained, cross-factor level.
summary_en.importance: While not a pretraining technique contribution, it matters for foundation-model research because evaluation stability underpins credible scaling-law studies, ablations, and reproducibility—especially as the community explores non-autoregressive/diffusion LMs. Key takeaways: (1) aggregate metrics can hide structured instability and distinct error modes; (2) the proposed Factor Variance Attribution (FVA) offers a reusable decomposition to pinpoint which inference factors dominate variability; (3) non-determinism is task-dependent (coding is more sensitive than QA), implying evaluation protocols should be stratified by task type and should report sample-level stability, not just mean scores.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper is primarily methodological:
- Sample-level evaluation: repeatedly evaluate the same inputs across runs/configurations and measure per-sample outcome variability (e.g., correctness flips), rather than only dataset-level averages.
