- Cross-factor design: systematically vary both model-related factors (affecting diffusion dynamics, such as MC sampling, CFG scale, diffusion steps) and system-related factors (execution/numerics, such as batch size and precision), without performance-driven tuning.
- Factor Variance Attribution (FVA): a variance-based decomposition that separates variability due to choosing different factors from sensitivity to specific settings within a factor, yielding a more interpretable and reproducible attribution than reporting a single run-to-run variance number.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple benchmarks, the authors show that changing factors like batch size, CFG scale, and number of MC samples can leave dataset-level accuracy largely unchanged while inducing non-trivial sample-level prediction flip rates. Qualitative tables (referenced as Tables 1 and 6) illustrate that even when correctness stays “wrong,” different configurations can produce different wrong answers—evidence of distinct failure modes masked by aggregate metrics. They also report strong task dependence: code generation is substantially more sensitive to factor choices than QA. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables (flip-rate magnitudes, FVA attribution percentages, model sizes), so exact figures cannot be reproduced here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
1) Start with Figure 1 to internalize the core phenomenon (stable aggregate score, unstable per-sample behavior).
2) Read the definitions of sample-level metrics and the exact FVA decomposition—this is the most reusable part for your own evaluation pipelines.
3) Scan the task-wise and factor-wise attribution results (coding vs QA; model-related vs system-related) to learn which knobs must be controlled or reported.
4) Finish with the qualitative examples (Tables 1/6) to see how “different wrong answers” can be invisible to accuracy/pass@k.

recommendation.zh: 只看FVA分解和样本级flip统计：它说明dataset-level指标会系统性掩盖DLM非确定性，做扩散LM消融/对比时应把稳定性协议当硬要求。
recommendation.en: Skim the FVA decomposition and per-sample flip stats: it shows dataset-level metrics systematically hide DLM nondeterminism—stability protocols should be a hard requirement for diffusion-LM ablations.

paper.title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs

summary.core_problem: 基准分数难以反映真实可用性时，如何理解并形式化用户常用的“vibe-testing”（基于个人工作流的非正式模型对比评估），使其可系统化与可复现。
summary.importance: 评测方法学贡献：把用户个性化的测试内容与主观判据显式建模，提出可操作的评测流水线雏形；对“离线benchmark→真实使用体验”的鸿沟提供结构化视角，但对预训练本身间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 基于两类经验资源（用户调研 + 社媒/博客的模型对比报告）归纳vibe-testing流程，并形式化为两部分个性化：个性化prompt生成 + 用户感知的主观评价准则；实现一个proof-of-concept pipeline，用用户感知标准比较模型输出。
summary.experiments: 包含对调研与“野外”对比报告的分析，并在若干任务上演示个性化评测流水线（摘要截断，未给出明确基准、模型集合与量化提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: When benchmark scores fail to capture real usefulness, how to understand and formalize users’ informal “vibe-testing” of LLMs so it becomes systematic and reproducible.
summary_en.importance: Evaluation methodology contribution: explicitly models personalization in both what users test and how they judge outputs, offering a structured view of the benchmark–real-world gap; indirectly relevant to pretraining via better evaluation signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes two empirical sources (a survey of user practices and in-the-wild comparison reports) and formalizes vibe-testing as personalized prompt generation plus user-aware subjective criteria; proposes a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline following this formulation.
summary_en.experiments: Includes analyses of survey and online reports and a demonstration pipeline; the abstract is truncated and does not provide detailed model/task sets or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但能改你对评测的 prior：只看他们如何把 vibe-test 任务与判据结构化成可复现流水线，适合拿来改内部模型选型流程。
recommendation.en: Not pretraining-centric, but it can shift your eval prior: read how they formalize vibe-tests into a reproducible pipeline, and port the idea into your internal model selection workflow.

paper.title: LiveClawBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Complex, Real-World Assistant Tasks

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以覆盖真实助手任务中的“组合式复杂度”，缺少更贴近部署场景的基准与复杂度刻画。
summary.importance: 重要benchmark/评测框架贡献：提出三轴复杂度框架并据此构建真实助手任务基准，有助于更可信地衡量Agent能力边界与失败模式（对训练数据合成、后训练目标设计也有间接启发）。
summary.technical_approach: 从真实OpenClaw使用案例抽象出Triple-Axis Complexity Framework（环境复杂度/认知需求/运行时适应性），并构建带复杂度因子标注的pilot benchmark，用于评测LLM Agent在现实助手任务中的综合能力。
summary.experiments: 提供pilot benchmark与复杂度标注；对多种LLM Agent在不同复杂度维度下的表现进行对比评测（具体模型与指标以论文为准）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks under-represent compositional, real-world assistant difficulty; a more deployment-faithful benchmark and complexity taxonomy are needed.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/framework contribution: introduces a three-axis complexity model and a pilot benchmark grounded in real OpenClaw use cases, enabling more realistic measurement of agent capability limits and failure modes (with indirect implications for training and post-training objectives).
summary_en.technical_approach: Derive a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework (environment complexity, cognitive demand, runtime adaptability) and build a pilot benchmark with explicit factor annotations to evaluate LLM agents on compositional real-world assistant tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Releases a pilot benchmark with complexity annotations and evaluates multiple LLM agents across the axes (exact models/metrics per paper).

recommendation.zh: 作为“真实助手任务”基准备查即可：只看复杂度三轴定义和失败案例汇总，能帮你更快定位 agent 评测的盲区。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reality-check benchmark reference: just read the complexity axes and the failure taxonomy to spot what your agent evals are missing.

paper.title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language World Models
paper.abstract: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language World Models (LWMs) that simulate domai

summary.core_problem: 现有 Agent benchmark 只覆盖少数有公共环境的领域，无法评测 Agent 在广泛专业职业场景的能力。
summary.importance: 用 LLM 驱动的 Language World Model 模拟工具响应，把 benchmark 可覆盖的职业数量从几个扩展到 100 个，是一种扩展 Agent 评测覆盖面的工程尝试。
summary.technical_approach: Language World Model (LWM) 作为环境模拟器生成工具响应；multi-agent 合成 pipeline 产出可解性、难度校准、文档锚定的评测实例；沿完成率和容错性两个维度评估。
summary.experiments: 100 个职业场景、10 大类、65 个专业领域，评测 15 个前沿模型；具体模型排名见正文。
summary.authors_note: 阿里/Qwen 团队相关人员参与（Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks only cover the few professional domains with public environments, leaving most real-world occupational tasks unevaluated.
summary_en.importance: Uses LLM-driven Language World Models to simulate tool responses, dramatically expanding benchmark coverage; a scaling attempt for agent evaluation breadth rather than a methods contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: LWMs simulate domain tool responses; a multi-agent synthesis pipeline generates solvable, difficulty-calibrated, document-grounded tasks; evaluation includes fault injection for environmental robustness.
summary_en.experiments: 100 scenarios across 10 categories and 65 domains; 15 frontier models evaluated on completion and robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Qwen-related authors (Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang).

recommendation.zh: 用 LLM 模拟环境做 Agent benchmark 本身就有评测可信度问题——simulator 和被测模型能力相关会污染信号，作为 literature 备查，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Benchmark validity is inherently suspect when the simulator is an LLM correlated with the models under test; keep as literature reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: Distorted or Fabricated? A Survey on Hallucination in Video LLMs

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理并机制化刻画 Vid-LLMs（视频大模型）中的“幻觉”失效模式：不仅是“说错了”，而是输出在时序演化、指代一致性、以及音视模态冲突下如何偏离可观测视频证据；并回答“视频幻觉与图像幻觉本质差异是什么、该如何分类评测、以及缓解策略应如何对因下药”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不在于提出新训练算法，而在于提供了一个面向视频时序与多模态对齐的机制驱动分类框架（dynamic distortion vs content fabrication），把以往零散的 benchmark/指标/干预方法统一到可解释的失效机理上。对后续预训练数据构造（反事实、去先验诱导）、架构设计（motion-aware temporal encoding、长视频记忆）、以及评测体系（时序定位/一致性/音视冲突）具有“研究路线图”级别的启发价值。
summary.technical_approach:
论文核心方法论是“按可观测失败模式+机制归因”来组织视频幻觉：
1) 定义与边界：将视频幻觉定义为“语言上合理但与可观测时空证据矛盾”的输出，并强调区别于静态图像幻觉的关键维度：因果/时序推理、时间定位、运动动力学、音视融合。
2) 机制驱动分类（taxonomy）：
- Dynamic Distortion（动态扭曲）：实体检测可能正确，但时空演化/一致性被扭曲。细分为：a) Spatiotemporal dynamics 错误（事件顺序、持续时间估计、频次计数等）；b) Referential inconsistency（跨帧人物/物体/场景指代混淆）。
- Content Fabrication（内容编造）：输出受先验或音频主导而脱离视觉证据。细分为：a) Context-driven hallucination（基于共现先验的“补全”）；b) Audio-visual conflict（音频压过视觉导致动作/情绪等被“听出来”）。
3) 归因分析：
- 动态扭曲主要来自：时间编码对细粒度运动线索缺失、长视频长程记忆弱、时间定位能力差。
- 内容编造主要来自：视觉落地（grounding）不足，使预训练先验或强音频信号覆盖视觉证据。
4) 面向归因的方向：提出 motion-aware 架构以保留细粒度时序特征；提出 counterfactual training 以解耦视觉证据与语言/共现先验，从训练分布层面抑制 fabrication。
summary.experiments: 该文为综述型工作，全文重点在于：汇总代表性失败案例、评测基准/指标与缓解策略，并将其映射到上述两大类机制；不以统一的自建实验给出单一 SOTA 数字。文中通过大量引用覆盖：事件排序/持续时间/计数、跨帧指代一致性、以及音视冲突导致的动作与情绪幻觉等典型现象，并讨论长视频场景下记忆与定位不足如何放大 dynamic distortion。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读路径（约30–45分钟）：
1) 先看 Definition & Scope：把“视频幻觉”与“图像幻觉”差异抓牢（时序、定位、音视融合）。
2) 精看 Taxonomy（含 Fig.2 的分层框架）：这是全文主贡献，后续评测/缓解都围绕它组织。
3) 看“root causes/机制归因”段落：把每类幻觉与训练/架构瓶颈对应起来（时间编码、长程记忆、grounding、音频主导）。
4) 最后看未来方向：motion-aware 与 counterfactual training 两条线分别对应 distortion 与 fabrication，适合转化为预训练数据与目标设计的研究选题。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a video-specific, mechanism-oriented understanding of hallucinations in Video-LLMs: what constitutes hallucination when temporal evolution, entity consistency across frames, and audio-visual fusion are involved; how to categorize these failures in a way that supports evaluation and targeted mitigation rather than ad-hoc symptom lists.
summary_en.importance: Not a new pretraining algorithm, but a useful research scaffold for foundation-model work on video: it reframes “hallucination” into two causal families (dynamic distortion vs content fabrication), aligning benchmarks, metrics, and interventions with underlying bottlenecks (temporal encoding, long-range memory, grounding, audio dominance). This is actionable for data design (counterfactuals, prior-breaking samples), architecture (motion-aware temporal modeling, long-video memory), and evaluation (temporal localization/consistency, AV conflict).
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper’s contribution is a mechanism-driven taxonomy and causal analysis:
1) Definition/scope: hallucination = fluent but contradicting observable spatiotemporal evidence; emphasizes why image-hallucination taxonomies do not transfer due to causality/temporal grounding/motion dynamics/audio-visual integration.
2) Taxonomy by observable failure modes (not by input attributes):
- Dynamic Distortion: entities may be detected, but their temporal progression or referential consistency is wrong. Subtypes: (i) spatiotemporal dynamics errors (event order, duration, frequency/counting), (ii) referential inconsistency (identity/scene conflation across time).
- Content Fabrication: outputs driven by priors or audio rather than visual evidence. Subtypes: (i) context-driven completions from co-occurrence priors, (ii) audio-visual conflict where audio overrides vision.
3) Root-cause mapping: distortion ↔ missing fine-grained motion cues, weak long-range memory, poor temporal localization; fabrication ↔ insufficient visual grounding enabling pretrained priors or dominant audio signals.
4) Research directions: motion-aware architectures to preserve temporal features; counterfactual training to disentangle evidence from priors and reduce fabrication.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not present a unified new model with headline SOTA numbers. Instead, it synthesizes evidence across many cited works: representative failure cases for ordering/duration/counting, cross-frame reference errors, and AV-conflict hallucinations, and discusses how long-video settings exacerbate distortion via memory/localization weaknesses.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Read Definition & Scope to internalize what is uniquely “video” about hallucination.
- Study the taxonomy section and the main figure (the layered framework is the key artifact).
- Focus on the root-cause analysis paragraphs: they translate symptoms into pretraining/architecture bottlenecks.
- Finish with future directions to extract concrete research hypotheses (motion-aware temporal modeling; counterfactual/prior-breaking training).

recommendation.zh: 当作路线图备查：它把视频幻觉按机制拆成 dynamic distortion vs fabrication，能指导你怎么设计数据反事实与评测维度；不必细读方法，抓分类框架即可。
recommendation.en: Keep as a roadmap: the mechanism-driven split (dynamic distortion vs fabrication) is useful for designing counterfactual data and eval axes; don’t dwell on mitigation details—take the taxonomy.

paper.title: The Verification Tax: Fundamental Limits of AI Auditing in the Rare-Error Regime

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“稀有错误（rare-error）”条件下 AI 审计/校准验证的统计极限：当模型错误率 ε 很低、预测置信度分布又高度集中在 1−ε 附近时，任何基于有限标注样本 m 的校准误差（如 ECE）估计都会遭遇不可突破的噪声地板；并进一步刻画在被动评测、无标签自评、主动查询、以及多组件系统组合（pipeline/agent loop）下，校准可验证性如何随 ε、m、L（校准函数 Lipschitz 常数）缩放。
summary.importance: 对预训练/Scaling 研究的直接影响在于：当模型能力提升（ε 下降）时，“验证难度”以相反方向同指数恶化，导致很多常见 benchmark 上的细微改进（尤其是安全/可靠性/校准类指标）在统计上不可分辨，必须被视为“并列”。这会改变我们对：1）小幅 SOTA 提升是否可信；2）LLM-as-judge/自一致性等无标签评估能否替代标注；3）复杂 agent/pipeline 端到端评测是否可行；4）应如何设计更可验证的评测协议（更大 holdout、主动采样、分解式验证）的判断。对训练侧的启发是：如果把“可验证性”当作目标（例如 RL pretrain/对齐阶段追求极低错误率），则需要同步扩大验证预算或改变验证范式，否则会出现“能力提升但无法被可靠测量/比较”的研究停滞。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是信息论/最小最大（minimax）分析，给出校准误差估计的下界并与可达上界匹配。
1）问题形式化：模型输出置信度 p(x)∈[0,1]，校准差 Δ(p)=η(p)−p，其中 η(p)=E[正确|p(X)=p]；考虑 Δ 属于 L-Lipschitz 函数类 F(L)。目标是用 m 个带标签样本估计 ECE（文中以 binned ECE 为例，但结论指向更广的校准误差估计）。
2）关键结论（被动/静态评测）：给出 minimax 风险 R*(m,ε,L)=inf_est sup_{Δ∈F(L)} E|Ĥ−H| 的最优速率为 Θ((L·ε/m)^{1/3})（忽略对数因子），并强调 ε 依赖是此前工作缺失的关键。直觉上：当错误稀有时，校准偏差也变成“稀有事件”，观测到足够多的错误以区分校准函数需要更高样本量；同时 Lipschitz 约束把“局部偏差”扩散到可检测尺度，形成 1/3 指数的非参数估计难度。
3）下界证明：构造两个分布/先验（P0 校准、P1 在 p0=1−ε 附近引入幅度 δ 的失配）使得 ECE 差异可控但 KL 散度也可控；通过 Bretagnolle–Huber 或两先验方法（Lepski et al.）把“不可区分性”转成风险下界。文中还给出在 score-mass 集中于 1−ε 附近时更强的 (Lε/m)^{1/3} 下界，并强调不依赖白噪声渐近等价（附录给出 Brown–Low 等价的替代推导）。
4）上界与可达性：用直方图/分箱估计并选择最优 bin 数 B*≈(L^2 m/ε)^{1/3} 达到同阶速率，完成 minimax 匹配。
5）四个“反直觉”结果：
- 自评无信息：任何不使用真实标签的估计（包括 LLM-as-judge、self-consistency、CoT verification、模型内部信号等）在最坏情形下对校准误差的估计无改进，甚至给出常数级下界（文中表述为 worst-case calibration error ≥1/2），除非白盒访问能把问题约束到低维参数族。
- 相变：当 m·ε≈1 以下，错误样本期望数不足，失配不可检测；大量论文报告的提升落在“验证地板”之下。
- 主动查询：若审计者可选择输入进行测试，minimax 速率提升到 Θ(√(ε/m))，且 Lipschitz 常数 L 消失，说明“输入选择权”能显著降低非参数难度。
- 组合爆炸：K 组件 pipeline 的验证成本呈 Ω(L^K·ε/δ^3) 增长，意味着长链路 agent/CoT/RAG 端到端验证会指数变难，必须分解验证或改变评测结构。
summary.experiments:
论文的实证部分主要用于“量级校准”和“验证地板对现实 benchmark 的影响”而非训练新模型：
- MMLU：n=14,042，ε≈0.16，估计的 Lipschitz 常数 ^L≈1.4。由理论给出的被动校准地板约 0.028；而对应的准确率地板约 0.006，意味着“验证校准”约比“验证准确率”难 4.7×。
- TruthfulQA：n=817 时，被动校准地板约 0.093–0.139，足以淹没许多论文声称的改进幅度。
- 进一步推演：即使未来模型在 MMLU 达到 ε≈0.05，被动地板仍约 0.016–0.018，提示“更强模型并不会自动带来更可验证的改进”。
- 主动查询验证：在生产级 LLM 上验证主动速率，尽管不同模型的 ^L∈[1.4,2.5]，但都“塌缩”到相同的主动查询速率标度，支持 L 在主动场景中被消除的理论预测。
- 统计噪声对排名：文中声称 65% 的 MMLU 分学科排名处于噪声主导区（需要结合其相变/地板计算理解）。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含所有表格/图的完整数值细节，例如 Table 1 的逐项列表；以上数字来自引言中明确给出的量级与区间。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“理论主线→四个惊讶→落地含义”走：
1）先读引言中四个 Surprise 的陈述与 MMLU/TruthfulQA 的地板数字，建立“为什么这会影响我们做预训练评测”的直觉。
2）重点精读：
- 定义与设定（校准函数 Δ、L-Lipschitz 类、minimax 风险 R*、ε 的角色），确保理解“为什么 ε 会进入速率”。
- 下界证明思路（两分布/两先验构造、KL 控制、Bretagnolle–Huber），这是论文的核心技术贡献；建议对照附录（文中指向 Appendix B/H/K）看构造细节。
- 上界（直方图分箱 + 最优 B* 的推导），理解 1/3 指数来自 bias-variance 权衡以及 ε 如何改变有效噪声。
3）四个 Surprise 中建议深挖两点：
- “自评无信息”的形式化假设边界：它到底排除了哪些可用信号？在什么条件下白盒/参数化假设能绕开？这直接关系到 LLM-as-judge 在研究评测中的适用范围。
- “组合指数爆炸”的推导条件：K 组件如何定义、L 如何在组件间传播、δ 的含义（有意义验证 δ=Θ(ε) 时样本复杂度到 Ω(1/ε^2)），这对 agent 评测与分解式验证设计很关键。
4）带着预训练研究问题回看：当你报告 0.2%～1% 的提升时，是否在该 benchmark 的验证地板之下？如果是，需要更大 holdout、主动采样、或把改进转移到更可验证的指标/设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper characterizes fundamental statistical limits of auditing model calibration in the rare-error regime. When a model’s error rate ε is small and confidence scores concentrate near 1−ε, estimating calibration error (e.g., ECE) from m labeled samples hits an unavoidable noise floor. It further analyzes how this limit changes under (i) passive benchmarking, (ii) label-free self-evaluation, (iii) active querying where the auditor chooses inputs, and (iv) composition in multi-component pipelines/agent loops.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model pretraining and scaling research, the key message is a “duality”: as models get better (ε decreases), verifiability of calibration gets harder with the same exponent in the opposite direction. This implies many reported small gains on popular benchmarks—especially safety/reliability/calibration-style metrics—are statistically indistinguishable and should be treated as ties unless evaluation budgets or protocols change. It also provides a principled critique of label-free evaluation (LLM-as-judge, self-consistency, CoT verification) for calibration auditing, and warns that end-to-end evaluation of long agentic pipelines can become exponentially expensive to verify. Practically, it pushes the community toward larger holdouts, active test selection, and decomposed verification if we want trustworthy comparisons as ε continues to fall.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work is an information-theoretic/minimax analysis of calibration-error estimation.
- Formalization: the calibration gap is Δ(p)=η(p)−p with η(p)=E[correct | p(X)=p]. The unknown calibration function Δ is assumed to lie in an L-Lipschitz function class F(L). The target is the minimax risk R*(m,ε,L)=inf_est sup_{Δ∈F(L)} E|Ĥ−H| for estimating ECE-like functionals.
- Main passive-evaluation rate: it proves a matching lower and upper bound of order Θ((L·ε/m)^{1/3}) (up to logs). The novel part relative to prior work is the explicit ε-dependence, which induces a phase transition and a “verification horizon”.
- Lower bound technique: construct two hypotheses/priors P0 (calibrated) and P1 (miscalibrated by δ around p0=1−ε) such that the ECE differs but the KL divergence remains small (scaling like m·δ^2/ε in a key construction). Apply Bretagnolle–Huber / two-prior methods (Lepski-style) to convert indistinguishability into a minimax lower bound. The paper emphasizes doing this directly in the Bernoulli observation model (with an alternative Brown–Low equivalence route in the appendix).
- Achievability: a histogram/binning estimator with an optimal bin count B*≈(L^2 m/ε)^{1/3} attains the same rate, completing the minimax characterization.
- Four “surprises” derived from the theory:
  1) Label-free self-evaluation provides zero information about calibration in the worst case (constant lower bound), unless white-box access identifies a low-dimensional parametric family.
  2) A sharp detectability phase transition around m·ε≈1.
  3) Active querying improves the minimax rate to Θ(√(ε/m)) and removes dependence on L.
  4) Verification cost for K-component compositions scales exponentially, Ω(L^K·ε/δ^3), making long pipelines/agent loops hard to audit end-to-end.
summary_en.experiments:
Empirical sections are used to calibrate the theory against real benchmarks and production LLM behavior:
- MMLU: n=14,042, ε≈0.16, estimated ^L≈1.4. The implied passive calibration floor is ≈0.028, while the accuracy floor is ≈0.006, making calibration about 4.7× harder to verify than accuracy at that sample size.
- TruthfulQA: n=817 yields a passive calibration floor of ≈0.093–0.139, large enough to swamp many reported improvements.
- Forward-looking implication: even at ε≈0.05 on MMLU, the passive floor remains ≈0.016–0.018.
- Active querying: experiments on production LLMs show convergence to the same active-rate scaling despite ^L ranging roughly 1.4–2.5, supporting the prediction that L drops out under active auditing.
(Your provided full-text excerpt does not include all table/figure details; the above values are those explicitly stated in the introduction.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a theory paper with direct evaluation implications:
1) Start with the introduction’s four “Surprises” and the concrete MMLU/TruthfulQA floor numbers to internalize why this matters for scaling-era evaluation.
2) Then focus on the minimax core: definitions (Δ, F(L), R*, role of ε), the lower-bound construction (two priors, KL control, Bretagnolle–Huber), and the matching upper bound via optimal binning (why B* scales as (L^2 m/ε)^{1/3}).
3) Deep-dive targets:
- The exact assumptions behind “self-evaluation gives zero information”: what signals are ruled out, and what kinds of parametric/white-box structure could evade the impossibility.
- The composition theorem: how L propagates across components and what δ=Θ(ε) (“meaningful verification”) implies for sample complexity (Ω(1/ε^2)).
4) Re-apply to your own pretraining papers: if your reported deltas are below the implied floor, you need larger holdouts, active test selection, or a redesigned metric/protocol.

recommendation.zh: 把“错误率越低越难验证”讲成硬下界，会迫使你把很多微小SOTA当作统计并列；动作是立刻检查自家评测的m与ε是否已落入不可分辨区。
recommendation.en: Turns “better models are harder to validate” into hard lower bounds, implying many tiny SOTA deltas are statistically tied; action item: audit whether your eval sample size m vs error rate ε already sits in the indistinguishable regime.

paper.title: Growing Pains: Extensible and Efficient LLM Benchmarking Via Fixed Parameter Calibration

summary.core_problem: LLM评测基准与模型发布速度过快，导致“每个模型×每个数据集×全量题目”的穷举评测成本不可承受；现实中leaderboard往往对不同模型评不同子集，造成分数不可比、排名不稳定。论文要解决的是：在基准集合随时间扩展、模型只在当时可用数据集上被评测的真实场景下，如何用少量锚题把新数据集/新模型与历史评测尺度对齐，并避免反复重跑历史模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在“更快、更可比的评估基础设施”：1）把动态扩展的评测建模为scale-linking（量表链接）问题，引入心理测量学的固定参数校准，使历史分数可持续对齐；2）显著降低评测推理成本（新模型只需做锚题即可估计历史池表现；新数据集可在不重评旧模型下完成整合），利于更快迭代数据配比/训练配方/持续学习实验；3）多维IRT提供“能力维度”视角，可用于分析训练数据或Tokenizer/指令调优对不同技能维度的影响（虽然论文本身聚焦评测）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心框架：多维2参数Logistic IRT（MIRT 2PL）+ 锚题 + 固定参数校准（FPC）。
- IRT建模：每道题i有区分度向量a_i（对多个潜在能力维度的敏感性）与截距/难度相关项d_i；模型m有能力向量θ_m。正确率由sigmoid(a_i·θ_m + d_i)给出。
- 问题在于并发校准（concurrent calibration）在基准演化时需要对“所有题×所有模型”重新估参，成本线性增长且会导致历史参数漂移，使旧θ不可比。
- 固定参数校准：为每个数据集保留一小组anchor items。新增数据集/新增题目时，保持已校准锚题参数不变，仅估计新题参数；通过一组reference models（在新旧题上都有作答的模型）把新题与旧量表连接起来。
- 两个用例：
  1）新模型评测：只跑每个数据集的锚题，用已校准IRT推断其在更大历史题库上的表现（减少推理量）。
  2）新数据集接入：用reference models在锚题+新题上的响应估计新题参数，然后用已存在的模型能力θ去预测旧模型在新数据集上的表现（避免重跑旧模型）。
summary.experiments:
在两个大规模套件上做顺序扩展模拟：Open LLM Leaderboard派生套件（6个数据集，395个模型）与MMLU（57个subject子集，428个模型）。关键结论（文中给出明确数字）：
- 每个数据集仅用100道锚题时，预测误差通常约2–3%，且随着新增数据集不会累积恶化。
- 成本分析：并发校准成本随样本/题目数增长；FPC的校准成本保持常数级（相对新增数据集规模不线性爆炸）。
- 观察到锚题规模存在收益递减；reference models数量适中即可在基准增长时保持准确预测与排名稳定性。（给定片段未包含更细的排名相关系数、不同anchor size曲线的具体数值表格。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读（30–45分钟）：
- Introduction：明确其“随时间扩展的评测”设定与两个用例。
- Background：重点读MIRT 2PL公式、并发校准为何导致不可比、以及FPC在心理测量中的等值思想。
- Experiments（若获取全文后半部分）：优先看anchor size=100的误差/排名稳定性结果、reference model数量消融、以及成本曲线图；这些最直接决定你是否能把它接入内部评测流水线。
- 对预训练团队的落地点：把IRT维度当作“能力坐标系”，用于对比不同数据配比/Tokenizer/持续学习策略在各维度的增益与遗忘。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM evaluation is becoming prohibitively expensive as both models and benchmarks proliferate. In practice, leaderboards evaluate different models on different subsets, making scores and rankings hard to compare over time. The paper addresses evaluation under evolving benchmark coverage: datasets arrive sequentially, and models are only evaluated on what existed at their release time—yet we still want directly comparable scores without re-running all historical models.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation-infrastructure contribution with direct leverage for pretraining iteration speed: (1) formulates evolving benchmark suites as a scale-linking problem and imports fixed-parameter calibration from psychometrics to keep historical scores comparable; (2) reduces inference cost for both new-model evaluation (anchor-only testing) and new-dataset integration (no need to re-evaluate old models); (3) multidimensional IRT yields a latent “skill space” that can be used to analyze how data mixtures, tokenizers, or continual learning affect different capability dimensions (even though the paper focuses on benchmarking).
summary_en.technical_approach:
Method: Multidimensional 2PL IRT (MIRT 2PL) + per-dataset anchor sets + Fixed Parameter Calibration (FPC).
- Each item i has a discrimination vector a_i over latent dimensions and an intercept/difficulty-related term d_i; each model has an ability vector θ. Correctness probability is sigmoid(a_i·θ + d_i).
- Concurrent calibration is unsuitable for evolving suites: it requires re-estimating all item and model parameters whenever new items are added, increasing cost and shifting the scale so historical θ’s are no longer comparable.
- FPC: keep previously calibrated anchor-item parameters fixed; when new datasets/items arrive, estimate only the new item parameters using a set of reference models that answer both old anchors and new items, thereby linking the new dataset onto the existing scale.
Use cases:
1) New model: evaluate only anchor questions, infer performance on the larger historical pool.
2) New dataset: calibrate new items via reference models, then predict old models’ performance on the new dataset from their existing θ without re-running them.
summary_en.experiments: Large-scale simulations on (i) an Open LLM Leaderboard-derived suite (6 datasets, 395 models) and (ii) MMLU (57 subject subsets, 428 models). Reported quantitative takeaway from the provided text: with 100 anchor questions per dataset, typical prediction error is ~2–3% and does not accumulate as more datasets are added. Cost analysis shows FPC has constant cost w.r.t. suite growth, unlike concurrent calibration. The excerpt also notes diminishing returns from very large anchor sets and that a moderate number of reference models is sufficient (additional detailed metrics/tables are not present in the provided content).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim (30–45 minutes):
- Intro for the real-world sequential setting and the two operational use cases.
- Background for the MIRT 2PL formulation and why concurrent calibration breaks comparability.
- Experiments (in the full paper): focus on anchor-size sweeps (esp. 100 anchors), ranking stability, reference-model ablations, and cost curves—these determine practical adoption in a pretraining evaluation pipeline.
- If you care about pretraining insights, treat the learned θ dimensions as a capability coordinate system for diagnosing data/recipe changes and continual-learning forgetting.

recommendation.zh: 把动态leaderboard当量表链接来做很对味；只看方法假设与锚题敏感性实验，能直接指导你们评测管线怎么省推理又保可比。
recommendation.en: Treating evolving leaderboards as scale-linking is the right framing; read the assumptions + anchor-item sensitivity to decide how to cut eval cost without breaking comparability.

paper.title: Evaluating Relational Reasoning in LLMs with REL

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 推理评测往往混杂了输入长度、模板变化、知识检索、实体数量等因素，难以单独刻画“高元关系绑定（higher-arity binding）”带来的推理瓶颈。论文要解决的是：给出一个任务无关、可控的难度维度来衡量关系推理，并构建能系统调节该维度的生成式基准，从而定位模型在科学推理中何时、为何随关系复杂度上升而崩溃。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个更“机制导向”的评测坐标轴：Relational Complexity（RC，关系复杂度/关系元数）与 Operand Complexity（OC，操作数/实体表征难度）解耦后，可以更清晰地诊断模型失败是否来自“同时绑定多个独立变量”的能力不足，而非上下文变长或实体变多。这对数据配比与合成数据设计（例如系统性提升高 RC 组合约束样本）、以及训练动态分析（模型随规模/数据变化在 RC 维度上的 scaling）都有直接启发：你可以把 RC 当作一条未饱和的能力曲线来做 scaling/ablation，而不是只看传统 benchmark 平均分。
summary.technical_approach:
论文引入并形式化 Relational Complexity（RC）：完成某一步推理所需同时绑定的独立变元/操作数的最小数量，本质对应关系的 arity（元数）。同时定义 Operand Complexity（OC）：在固定 RC 下，识别/表示/推断各 argument role 的 filler 的难度。基于该框架构建 REL：跨数学、生物、化学三域的一组生成式任务族，使 RC 可参数化上调，并通过控制/边缘化其他混杂因素来尽量隔离 RC 的影响。全文的关键方法点是：
1) 用认知科学中的 RC 概念作为统一难度刻度，而不是用 prompt 长度/实体数等 proxy；
2) 任务设计强调“同一表征/相近长度下提升关系元数”，从而把性能下降归因到绑定与组合；
3) 生成式基准：可持续生成新题，避免静态题库被记忆或过拟合，便于跨模型代际对比与 scaling 分析。
summary.experiments:
论文报告了随 RC 增加的显著退化，并给出跨域数字：
- REL-A（Raven 矩阵/张量类）：RC 从 3 提升到 9，性能下降 45%。
- REL-B1（进化历史推理）：RC 从 5 提升到 20，准确率下降 93%。
- 化学任务（SMILES 表征）：从 REL-C1 到 REL-C3，任务完成率下降 39.7%。
作者还强调 RC 与输入长度、实体数量等 proxy 的变化是互补的（即便控制这些因素，RC 仍能解释额外的性能塌陷）。若全文包含更细的分解（固定 OC 改 RC、固定 RC 改 OC；或不同模型家族/不同推理模式的对比），建议重点记录：哪类模型在高 RC 下更稳、是否存在“临界 RC”现象、以及错误类型是否呈现组合爆炸特征。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) Introduction：明确 RC 要解决的评测混杂问题，以及 REL 覆盖的三大科学域；
2) Defining Relational Complexity：这是全文最关键的定义部分，务必读清 RC/OC 的区分与例子（Raven 矩阵如何计算 RC）；
3) 任务章节：快速抓每个子基准如何参数化 RC、如何控制其他变量；
4) 实验结果图：优先看“性能 vs RC”的曲线与对照（长度/实体数等），以及跨域一致性；
5) 讨论/局限：关注作者如何解释高 RC 失败（绑定、工作记忆、组合泛化），以及对训练数据/架构的暗示。
如果你做预训练数据科学：建议把 REL 当作诊断集，做数据配比/合成（高 RC 约束组合）与 scaling（模型大小、tokenizer、上下文长度）对 RC 曲线的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM reasoning evaluations often conflate relational difficulty with confounders like prompt length, template changes, entity count, or background knowledge. This makes it hard to isolate failures caused specifically by higher-arity relational binding. The paper introduces a principled difficulty axis—Relational Complexity (RC)—and a controllable, generative benchmark (REL) to measure how model performance degrades as RC increases in scientific reasoning settings.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main value is a mechanism-oriented evaluation dimension that can be used for scaling and data diagnostics. By separating RC (how many independent variables must be jointly bound) from Operand Complexity (how hard it is to identify/represent the fillers), REL enables cleaner attribution: performance drops can be linked to binding/composition limits rather than to longer contexts or more entities. This is directly actionable for data curriculum/mixing (injecting high-RC multi-constraint samples), synthetic data generation, and studying scaling behavior specifically along the RC axis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes RC as the minimal number of independent sources of variation that must be simultaneously bound to apply a relation—effectively the relation’s arity. It also defines Operand Complexity (OC) to capture filler-identification/representation difficulty independent of arity. Building on these definitions, REL is a suite of generative tasks across math, biology, and chemistry where RC can be systematically increased while controlling or marginalizing confounders. The benchmark is designed to be scalable via generation (reducing memorization/overfitting to a fixed set) and to provide cross-domain evidence that RC is a distinct driver of difficulty.
summary_en.experiments: Reported degradations with increasing RC are large and consistent across domains: in REL-A (Raven-style matrices/tensors), performance drops by 45% when RC increases from 3 to 9; in REL-B1 (evolutionary history reasoning), raising RC from 5 to 20 reduces accuracy by 93%; in chemistry tasks using SMILES, task completion decreases by 39.7% from REL-C1 to REL-C3. The authors argue RC effects are complementary to proxies like input length and entity count, indicating an additional bottleneck attributable to relational binding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (30–45 minutes): read the Introduction for the motivation and confounder-control framing; carefully read the RC/OC definitions section (this is the conceptual core) and the Raven example for how RC is computed; then scan each REL component to see how RC is parameterized and what is held constant. In results, prioritize plots of performance vs. RC and any analyses contrasting RC with length/entity-count proxies. For pretraining/data work, treat REL as a diagnostic suite to test whether data curricula or synthetic multi-constraint generation improves the RC curve.

recommendation.zh: RC/OC解耦算是少见的干净诊断轴；只看难度控制生成器和随RC崩溃曲线，能指导你合成数据该补“高元绑定”而非堆长上下文。
recommendation.en: The RC vs OC disentanglement is a rare clean diagnostic; read the controllable generator + performance-vs-RC curves to decide whether to target higher-arity binding in synthetic data.

paper.title: Spatial Competence Benchmark

summary.core_problem: 缺少能系统评估大模型“空间能力（spatial competence）”的基准：不仅要会局部空间原语（旋转/投影/VQA），还要能维持一致的内部空间表征、推断离散结构、并在全局约束下规划可执行动作序列。论文提出SCBench，用可执行结构化输出+确定性校验器/模拟器评分，构建从公理推理→构造综合→规划三层难度梯度的空间能力评测。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的启发点在于：
- 评测形态从“选择题/自由文本”转向“可执行产物+程序化验证”，更接近检验模型是否真的学到可组合的空间表征与约束满足能力；这类评测对研究训练数据配比（几何/拓扑/程序化生成数据）、长链推理token预算、以及工具使用对能力的替代效应很有价值。
- 论文还给出token预算扫描的饱和现象与失败模式分析，可作为研究‘推理token扩展是否等价于能力提升’的实证材料。
但它本质是benchmark与分析工作，不是预训练方法/Tokenizer/Scaling law的新机制。
summary.technical_approach:
SCBench设计要点：
- 三层能力桶（hierarchical taxonomy）：
  1) Axiomatic inference：从规则/点集推断精确离散结构（几何/拓扑），尽量去除干扰，强调基础推理；
  2) Constructive synthesis：生成满足全局约束的几何对象（如3D实体并集、用乐高近似曲面等）；
  3) Planning：在物理/组合约束下输出长时序动作，动作改变环境，最终状态由模拟器评估。
- 输出形式：几乎所有任务要求结构化、可执行输出（坐标、边集、动作序列），而非自然语言解释。
- 评分机制：每题配确定性校验器或模拟器；复杂任务可给部分分；部分任务带程序化实例生成器以扩大题库、降低记忆风险。
- 评测设置：no-tools（纯提示输出）与tools（提供Python解释器与web search）两种，分析工具对不同能力桶的影响。
summary.experiments:
论文在22个任务（285个子任务）上评测三款前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 3 Pro Preview、GPT-5.2），并报告：
- 总体准确率（no-tools/综合）：Gemini与GPT-5.2并列57.6%，显著高于Sonnet 34.9%。
- 难度梯度：三模型均呈Axiomatic > Constructive > Planning的单调下降。
- 工具增益（总体pp）：Sonnet +3.2，Gemini +8.8，GPT-5.2 +6.8。
  - Constructive桶工具增益最稳定：Sonnet +4.3，Gemini +12.3，GPT-5.2 +15.0。
  - Axiomatic桶Gemini/GPT-5.2反而下降：-6.7/-4.0，提示工具开销可能挤占有效推理。
  - Planning桶差异最大：Gemini +23.6（主要由Hyper-Snake +59.3驱动），Sonnet与GPT-5.2下降。
- 具体任务例子：
  - Fluid Simulation：Sonnet 72.7%，Gemini 68.2%，GPT-5.2 100%。
  - Terrain Levelling：三者均0%。
  - Delaunay Triangulation工具提升巨大：Sonnet +56.0，Gemini +36.0，GPT-5.2 +48.0（库调用可绕开模型常失败的外接圆推理）。
- token预算扫描（axiomatic桶、no-tools高推理）：
  - GPT-5.2：B=1024时0.04，B=32768时0.76，B=65536时略降至0.73；
  - Sonnet：B=1025时0.12，B=32768时0.55，B=64000持平；且Sonnet在相近预算下“实际输出token”更多但精度上限更低，显示token堆叠无法弥补空间推理能力缺口。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45分钟）：
- 先看Benchmark design三桶定义与每桶代表任务，理解它如何把‘空间能力’拆成可验证的离散产物。
- 再看Table 1/2（总体与分任务）以及Figure 3（token预算扫描），这是对预训练/推理研究最有信息密度的部分。
- 最后看失败模式总结：论文指出失败多为“局部几何看似合理但全局不一致/约束未闭合”，这对数据合成（加入全局一致性约束）、训练目标（结构化约束/可执行验证回传）和长程规划建模都很有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no rigorous, end-to-end benchmark for “spatial competence” in frontier models—i.e., maintaining a consistent internal representation of an environment, inferring discrete geometric/topological structure, and producing executable plans under global constraints. Existing spatial evaluations often probe isolated primitives via VQA or multiple-choice formats and miss long-horizon, constraint-coupled reasoning. SCBench is introduced to fill this gap with structured outputs and deterministic/simulator-based grading.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is primarily evaluation infrastructure plus empirical analysis, but it is highly relevant to pretraining/post-training research loops: it operationalizes spatial reasoning as executable artifacts (coordinates/graphs/action sequences) with programmatic verification, enabling cleaner measurement of whether models learn compositional structure rather than surface heuristics. The token-budget sweeps and tool-vs-no-tool comparisons provide concrete evidence about saturation and about when tools substitute for reasoning—useful for studying data mixtures (geometry/topology/program synthesis), long-context reasoning limits, and training objectives that enforce global consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SCBench organizes 22 tasks (285 subtasks) into a three-level capability ladder:
1) Axiomatic inference: infer exact discrete structure from formal rules or point sets (geometry/topology) with minimal distractions.
2) Constructive synthesis: output geometric objects satisfying global constraints (e.g., watertight unions of 3D solids, Lego-like surface approximations).
3) Planning: produce long-horizon action sequences where actions modify the environment and constrain subsequent steps; evaluation is on the terminal simulated state.
Most tasks require schema-conformant, executable outputs rather than free-form text. Each task is paired with a deterministic checker or a simulator-based evaluator (often with partial credit). Some tasks include programmatic instance generators to scale question pools and reduce memorization risk. Two evaluation settings are used: no-tools vs tools (provider-hosted Python + web search).
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results on SCBench:
- Models: Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, GPT-5.2.
- Overall accuracy: Gemini and GPT-5.2 tie at 57.6%, both above Sonnet at 34.9%.
- Consistent difficulty gradient for all models: Axiomatic > Constructive > Planning.
- Tools uplift (overall): Sonnet +3.2 pp, Gemini +8.8 pp, GPT-5.2 +6.8 pp.
  - Constructive gains are consistent: +4.3 / +12.3 / +15.0 pp (Sonnet/Gemini/GPT-5.2).
  - Axiomatic slightly regresses with tools for Gemini (-6.7) and GPT-5.2 (-4.0), suggesting tool overhead can displace effective reasoning.
  - Planning shows the widest spread: Gemini +23.6 pp (notably Hyper-Snake +59.3), while Sonnet and GPT-5.2 decline.
- Notable tasks: Fluid Simulation scores 72.7% (Sonnet), 68.2% (Gemini), 100% (GPT-5.2); Terrain Levelling is 0% for all.
- Delaunay Triangulation sees large tool gains: +56.0 / +36.0 / +48.0 pp.
- Token-budget sweeps (axiomatic, no-tools): GPT-5.2 improves from 0.04 at B=1,024 to 0.76 at B=32,768 then slightly drops to 0.73 at B=65,536; Sonnet rises from 0.12 at B=1,025 to 0.55 at B=32,768 and plateaus at B=64,000. Realized tokens keep increasing while accuracy saturates, indicating capacity limits rather than budget limits.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim guide (30–45 min):
- Read the Benchmark Design section to understand the three-bucket taxonomy and why outputs are executable.
- Focus on Table 1/2 for per-bucket and per-task breakdowns, and Figure 3 for token-budget saturation.
- Pay attention to the failure-mode discussion: many errors are “locally plausible but globally inconsistent geometry,” which is a strong hint for future training data/objectives that enforce global constraint satisfaction (e.g., verifier-in-the-loop data generation or constraint-aware decoding).

recommendation.zh: 作为benchmark它胜在“可执行输出+程序校验”而非主观打分；只看三层任务设计和token预算扫描，能帮你判断推理token扩展是不是假提升。
recommendation.en: As a benchmark, the key is executable outputs with programmatic checking; read the 3-tier task design + token-budget sweeps to assess whether more reasoning tokens are real gains or artifacts.

paper.title: LLMs Struggle with Abstract Meaning Comprehension More Than Expected

summary.core_problem: 检验并量化LLM在“抽象意义理解”（abstract meaning comprehension）上的系统性困难程度，以及这种困难是否被现有评测低估。
summary.importance: 属于能力缺陷/泛化机制分析：如果结论成立，说明LLM在抽象语义、概念组合或去语境化理解上存在结构性短板，可反向指导预训练数据配比（更抽象的定义/解释/类比语料）、目标函数（对比学习/语义一致性约束）与评测设计。
summary.technical_approach: 从标题推断为：构建或选取一组强调抽象意义理解的测试集/探针任务，对多种LLM进行评测，并分析错误类型与难点来源（如依赖表层共现、对定义/类比/隐喻理解不足等）。具体任务形式与指标在无摘要情况下无法确认。
summary.experiments: 摘要缺失，无法确认：评测了哪些模型（开源/闭源）、是否控制提示/CoT、数据规模与构造方式、与哪些基线（常规阅读理解/词义消歧等）对比，以及“more than expected”的量化幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: To measure how much LLMs struggle with abstract meaning comprehension, and whether current evaluations underestimate this weakness.
summary_en.importance: A capability-gap/mechanism analysis: if validated, it highlights structural limitations in abstraction and decontextualized semantics, informing pretraining data mixture, objectives, and better evaluation probes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Likely introduces or curates abstraction-focused probes/benchmarks and evaluates multiple LLMs, with error analysis targeting reliance on surface statistics vs. true abstract semantic understanding. Exact task design and metrics are unclear without the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract not available; cannot verify evaluated models, prompting settings, dataset construction/size, baselines, or the magnitude of the reported gap.

recommendation.zh: 作为能力缺口备查即可：扫一眼任务定义与失败案例，除非你正做语义/抽象评测，否则正文多半是重复“模型不懂抽象”的现象罗列。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a capability-gap reference: skim the task definition and failure examples—unless you build semantic/abstraction evals, the rest is mostly cataloging the same deficit.

paper.title: Towards Platonic Representation for Table Reasoning: A Foundation for Permutation-Invariant Retrieval

summary.core_problem: 表格推理中常用“序列化/线性化”表示会破坏表格的几何与关系结构，导致对布局/排列变化极其脆弱；如何定义并度量“对排列不变”的表格表征与检索能力。
summary.importance: 提出“Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH)”将表格语义鲁棒性与Permutation Invariance绑定，并给出可操作的诊断指标（基于CKA与秩相关）来量化序列化偏置；对结构化数据进入LLM（表格/半结构化）时的表示学习与评测有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 概念上主张表格潜空间应内禀满足Permutation Invariant；方法上给出诊断框架：用Centered Kernel Alignment构造PI指标衡量在“结构完全打乱/derangement”下embedding漂移；再用Spearman相关的rho指标跟踪潜结构收敛趋势，用于分析不同表格表示/模型在排列扰动下的稳定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集与SOTA对比细节；主要贡献看起来是评测/诊断指标与分析框架，而非大规模预训练或显著性能刷新。

summary_en.core_problem: Table reasoning systems often rely on sequential linearization, which destroys geometric/relational structure and makes representations brittle to layout permutations; the paper asks how to define and measure permutation-invariant table representations for robust reasoning/retrieval.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) tying semantic robustness to permutation invariance, and proposes practical diagnostics (CKA-based and rank-correlation metrics) to quantify serialization bias—useful for analyzing how LLMs handle semi-structured/tabular inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argues for intrinsically permutation-invariant latent spaces for tables; proposes a diagnostic framework with (i) a CKA-based PI metric measuring embedding drift under complete structural derangement, and (ii) a Spearman-based rho metric tracking convergence of latent structures under perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or SOTA deltas; the contribution appears primarily methodological/analytical (metrics + framework) rather than large-scale pretraining results.

institutions: Data Science Lab, Royal Library of Belgium (KBR)Brussels

recommendation.zh: 作为“表格线性化偏置”诊断工具备查即可；只看他们的 invariance 指标定义与对比实验，PRH 更像 framing，别指望直接给出可训练解法。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly as a diagnostic lens for serialization bias in tables; skim the invariance metrics + key comparisons—PRH is more framing than an actionable training recipe.

paper.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?

summary.core_problem: 在长轨迹的软件工程Agent中，“写在system prompt里的分阶段计划（plan）”到底在多大程度上被模型真实遵循、何时/为何被违背、以及计划遵循与任务成功之间的因果关系如何评估。论文要解决的是：缺乏可规模化、可自动化的“计划遵循度”度量与系统性证据，导致我们无法判断Agent成功是来自正确的策略推理还是来自数据污染/过拟合/偶然路径。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新预训练算法，而在于提供了一个“过程级（process-centric）”的可量化观测框架：把计划当作外显的策略先验，测量其在长上下文压力下的衰减与偏离模式。这对预训练/持续学习的启发包括：1）计划遵循可作为训练目标或评测维度（类似policy adherence），用于区分“会做题”与“会按策略做事”；2）揭示prompt内计划只是软约束，模型内部化workflow与外部计划不一致时会系统性降效，提示后续可通过预训练数据配比/轨迹数据/对齐目标让模型学习“遵循外部程序化约束”；3）周期性提醒能提升遵循与成功率，暗示长上下文中早期指令的可达性问题与注意力/记忆机制相关，可反向指导长上下文预训练与指令保持（instruction retention）训练。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是对大规模Agent轨迹做“计划遵循度”的自动评估，并把遵循拆成三个互补维度：
1）Plan Phase Compliance：轨迹中是否出现计划要求的各阶段（navigate/reproduce/patch/validate等）的行为证据；
2）Plan Order Compliance：阶段出现的顺序是否与计划一致（是否跳步、回退、乱序）；
3）Plan Phase Fidelity：阶段内行为是否“像该阶段应有的行为”（不仅出现关键词/动作，还要符合阶段语义）。
实验设计上，他们不仅比较“标准计划 vs 无计划”，还构造6种计划变体（删除/新增/重排/重复阶段），用以检验模型是否真正‘听计划’而非仅执行其内部固化策略；并引入“周期性计划提醒”作为干预变量，测试在长轨迹中通过重复注入高层约束能否减少违背。另一个关键点是把计划遵循与成功率联动分析，并讨论潜在违背原因：微调范式差异、上下文窗口压力、数据污染/过拟合、短期奖励优化等。
summary.experiments:
数据规模：评估16,991条SWE-agent轨迹；基准：SWE-bench Verified与SWE-bench Pro；骨干模型：GPT-5 mini、DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、Devstral-small；计划设置：8种（标准、无计划、6种变体）并考虑重复实验以评估非确定性。
关键结论（按全文描述的定性+部分定量信息）：
- 标准计划下，Agent总体“会遵循但不稳定”，不同模型/难度下遵循率差异显著；严格按顺序执行的与会自适应覆盖计划的并存。
- 遵循标准计划总体提升issue解决成功率；无计划时成功率下降，说明外显计划对局部reason-act决策仍有正向约束。
- 删除某一阶段即使该阶段在标准设置下常被忽略，也会降低性能，表明计划作为全局先验会影响整体搜索/决策分布。
- “坏计划”比“无计划”更糟；新增看似合理的最佳实践阶段若与模型内部策略不对齐，反而降效。
- 周期性提醒减少计划违背并提升性能，支持‘计划在长上下文中会被稀释’这一机制解释。
- 泛化：在SWE-bench Pro上计划遵循率平均下降13%（论文给出的明确数字），且阶段流模式改变（更早放弃reproduce、更多用既有回归测试validate），推测与任务更难/污染更少/标准计划不再有效有关。
- 非确定性：存在但不改变主要结论（通过重复实验对比持久行为）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
1）先看§2的三个指标定义（Phase/Order/Fidelity），理解他们如何把“遵循计划”操作化；
2）看§4.1与§4.2：标准计划 vs 无计划，抓住“遵循与成功率相关”以及违背因素归因；
3）看§5（计划变体）尤其是“坏计划>无计划更糟”“新增阶段反降效”“周期性提醒有效”的对照实验逻辑；
4）看§6.1（SWE-bench Pro）理解为何更难、更少污染时计划失效与遵循下降（13%）并出现不同phase flow。
值得深挖点：把这些指标迁移到预训练/后训练数据构造中（例如轨迹级监督：阶段标签、顺序约束、提醒机制），以及将‘计划保持’作为长上下文训练目标来做机制验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantifying whether LLM-based software engineering agents actually follow an instructed multi-phase plan (embedded in the system prompt), when and why they violate it over long trajectories, and how plan adherence relates to task success—without relying on anecdotal inspection or confounding factors like benchmark contamination/overfitting.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it contributes a process-level measurement lens that is highly relevant to foundation-model training: (1) it operationalizes “strategy adherence” as measurable signals, which can become an objective/metric for pretraining or continual learning on trajectories; (2) it highlights a key failure mode of long-context instruction retention—global plans get diluted as context grows—suggesting targeted long-context pretraining or memory mechanisms; (3) it shows misalignment between an external plan and the model’s internalized workflow can hurt performance, implying that data/finetuning should teach models to execute externally specified procedures, not just solve tasks; (4) periodic plan reminders help, hinting at simple curriculum/formatting interventions that could be baked into training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: They run a large-scale, fully automated analysis over agent trajectories and introduce plan-compliance metrics along three axes: Phase Compliance (did the trajectory exhibit evidence of each required phase), Order Compliance (did phases occur in the instructed order), and Phase Fidelity (did the behavior within a phase semantically match what that phase intends, beyond superficial markers). The experimental design uses controlled plan interventions: standard plan vs no plan, plus six plan variants (phase removal/addition/reordering/repetition) to test whether agents truly condition on the plan rather than executing a fixed internal routine. They also test periodic plan reminders as an intervention to counter long-horizon drift. Finally, they connect compliance patterns to success rates and discuss plausible drivers of violations (finetuning paradigm, context-window pressure, contamination/overfitting, short-term reward optimization).
summary_en.experiments:
Scale and setup: 16,991 SWE-agent trajectories; benchmarks SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro; backbones GPT-5 mini, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, Devstral-small; 8 plan settings including standard/no-plan/6 variants; repeated runs to assess nondeterminism.
Key findings reported in the paper: (i) agents often follow the standard plan but with substantial variance; some are strict, others override adaptively as difficulty increases; (ii) having the standard plan improves issue-resolution success, while removing it reduces success; (iii) removing a phase hurts performance even if that phase is frequently skipped under the standard plan, indicating the global plan shapes local decisions; (iv) a bad plan is worse than no plan; adding seemingly helpful phases can degrade performance when misaligned with the model’s internal strategy; (v) periodic reminders reduce violations and improve performance; (vi) on SWE-bench Pro, compliance drops by 13% on average (explicit number) and phase-flow shifts (e.g., earlier abandonment of reproduction tests, validation via existing regression tests), consistent with higher difficulty and lower contamination; (vii) nondeterminism exists but does not overturn conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim path (30–45 min): start with the metric definitions in §2 (the main reusable contribution), then read §4.1–§4.2 for standard-plan vs no-plan behavior and the compliance–success relationship, followed by §5 for the plan-variant causal tests (especially “bad plan < no plan”, “adding phases hurts”, “reminders help”), and finish with §6.1 for the SWE-bench Pro generalization and the reported 13% compliance drop. If you care about pretraining implications, focus on how their metrics could be turned into supervision signals (phase labels/order constraints) and how reminder effects relate to instruction-retention under long context.

recommendation.zh: 建议只读度量定义+违背模式分析：它把“plan 只是软约束”这件事量化了，下一步动作是把 plan-adherence 做成训练/评测维度而非只看成功率。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and violation-pattern sections: it quantifies that plans are soft constraints, and it argues for making plan-adherence a first-class train/eval target beyond task success.

paper.title: Drawing on Memory: Dual-Trace Encoding Improves Cross-Session Recall in LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 带持久记忆的 LLM Agent 往往以“扁平事实”存储信息，缺乏学习时上下文，导致跨会话回忆、时间推理与更新跟踪能力弱。
summary.importance: 方法创新（记忆表示/写入策略）+ 明确量化收益：提出一种低门槛的记忆编码改造，在不改变底座模型的前提下显著提升跨会话召回与时间相关推理；对长期记忆、RAG/Memory 设计与评测具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: Dual-Trace Encoding：每条记忆由两部分组成——(1) fact trace：抽象事实；(2) scene trace：对“学习当下情境”的叙事性重建，强迫编码时承诺具体上下文细节，从而形成更可区分的记忆痕迹；与 fact-only 控制组在覆盖与格式上匹配以减少混杂因素。
summary.experiments: 在 LongMemEval-S（4,575 sessions，100 recall questions；其中 99 个问题用于与对照共享比较）上评测：dual-trace 总体准确率 73.7% vs 53.5%，提升 +20.2pp；在 temporal reasoning（+40pp）、knowledge-update tracking（+25pp）、multi-session aggregation（+30pp）等子能力上提升更显著，并报告置信区间与 bootstrap 显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents with persistent memory often store flat facts without learning context, hurting cross-session recall, temporal reasoning, and update tracking.
summary_en.importance: A practical memory-representation/write strategy with clear gains: improves long-term, cross-session recall without changing the base model, offering actionable insights for agent memory and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-Trace Encoding stores each memory as (1) a fact trace and (2) a scene trace—a narrative reconstruction of the learning moment—forcing commitment to contextual details to create more distinctive memory traces; compared against a format- and coverage-matched fact-only control.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongMemEval-S (4,575 sessions, 100 recall questions; 99 shared for controlled comparison): 73.7% accuracy vs 53.5% (+20.2pp). Larger gains on temporal reasoning (+40pp), knowledge-update tracking (+25pp), and multi-session aggregation (+30pp), with CIs and bootstrap significance.

recommendation.zh: 低改动却真提升跨会话回忆，值得立刻在自家memory/RAG栈做ablation；重点看双轨写入格式与跨会话评测那张主表。
recommendation.en: Small intervention with measurable cross-session recall gains—worth reproducing as an ablation in your memory/RAG stack; focus on the dual-trace write schema and the main cross-session table.

paper.title: Decomposing and Reducing Hidden Measurement Error in LLM Evaluation Pipelines

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦于一个常被忽视但会系统性误导结论的问题：LLM 评测/标注/审核等“测量流水线”本身存在大量隐藏测量误差（hidden measurement error）。这些误差来自提示词改写、judge 模型更换、温度/采样随机性、条目异质性以及它们的交互，足以导致分数波动、排名翻转、显著性结论反转；而常规只在“固定设置下重复抽样”的置信区间并未覆盖这些来源。
summary.importance: 重要性体现在三点：1）科学结论层面：忽略提示词/评委选择等设计自由度会造成严重 under-coverage，且随着样本量 N 增大反而更糟（因为被忽略的方差不随 N 收缩），导致“数据越多越自信但越错”。2）工程与治理层面：安全审计、内容审核、基准榜单等依赖评测分数做决策，隐藏误差会让近距离模型差异不可解释。3）对抗与激励层面：未度量的方差构成可被利用的攻击面，开发者可通过搜索 prompt/评分配置来“优化噪声”而非真实能力，类似 p-hacking 与 test-set overfitting 的评测版本。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Total Evaluation Error (TEE) 框架，将“方差分解 + 设计研究(D-study)投影”统一起来。
1）方差分解：为 LLM 评测流水线显式写出数据生成过程(DGP)，把 items、类别、prompt 变体、温度、judge 模型、重复调用等作为测量因子，区分 fixed/random facets，并分解总方差到主效应与交互项（例如 item×prompt 的 σ^2_{αρ}）。文中用希腊字母标注各来源：α(item)、κ(category)、ϵ(residual)、ρ(prompt)、τ(temperature)、λ(judge)及其交互。
2）D-study 设计投影：在估计出各方差分量后，借鉴 generalizability theory / total survey error 的思想，推算在不同资源分配方案下（增加 items vs 增加 judges vs 增加 prompt 变体 vs 增加重复次数）总体误差如何变化，从而给出“最省钱/最有效”的降误差路径，并指出最可被利用的设计自由度应优先被收缩。
核心贡献不是单一方差分解，而是：a) 交互项纳入总误差核算；b) 明确区分会随 N 收缩的方差与不会随 N 收缩的“研究者设计选择敏感性”；c) 用 D-study 把统计估计转成可操作的评测预算决策。
summary.experiments:
论文在多个经验域上应用 TEE（从二分类安全判定到更主观的意识形态标注等），展示不同任务的主导误差源不同，并在后续小节做跨任务分析（如评分方法选择、judge 模型敏感性、pilot 设计、benchmark gaming）。
文中明确给出的示例之一：AILuminate v1.0 安全分类（141 items、12 hazard 类别），采用全交叉因子设计：5 prompt 变体 × 3 温度 × 3 judges × 8 次重复，共 50,760 次调用（成本约 12 美元量级）。结果显示：在该设置下 judge disagreement 贡献了总方差的 44%，远高于 prompt wording（4%），提示“与其投入更精致 prompt，不如增加 judges 或 items”更能降低测量误差。论文也强调该 prompt 变体较保守，可能低估 prompt 相关不确定性。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + reading_guide）
- 先读 Introduction：把握问题定义（隐藏误差、under-coverage 随 N 变差、可被利用的自由度）与 TEE 的两段式方案（分解 + D-study）。重点看 Figure 1（流水线与误差源地图）与 Figure 2（under-coverage 随样本量恶化的直观/模拟证据）。
- 精读方法核心：Section 4（DGP 与方差分解设定，fixed/random facets 的处理，交互项的含义与估计方式）。阅读时建议把每个方差分量对应到真实评测动作：换 prompt、换 judge、调温度、换题目、重复采样分别对应哪一项。
- 精读“如何用结果指导设计”：D-study 相关章节（文中称 decision study / design study projections）。重点理解：哪些方差会被增加 items 平均掉，哪些不会；以及如何用估计的方差分量做资源分配。
- 重点案例：Results 中安全分类案例（对应 Figure 3 的示例解读）：理解为何 judge 方差压过 prompt 方差，以及这对安全审计意味着什么（多评委/多模型仲裁 vs prompt 工程）。
- 交叉分析章节（2.4–2.7）：用于把 TEE 从“统计分解”连接到“评测实践与攻防”（评分方法选择、judge 敏感性、pilot 设计、benchmark gaming）。建议带着问题读：哪些自由度最容易被 exploit？TEE 如何量化并建议收缩？

skim（泛读建议：方法概述 + reading_guide）
- 读 Introduction + Figure 1/2/3：快速建立“评测误差不是只靠 CI 能解决”的直觉，以及 TEE 输出是什么（误差来源占比 + 预算投影）。
- 读 Results 的每个任务各 1 个代表性图/表：只抓“主导误差源是谁（judge/prompt/item/temperature/交互）”与“因此应该加什么（items/judges/replications）”。
- 最后扫 2.4–2.7 的结论段：获取对 benchmark 可靠性与 gaming 风险的实践建议。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：LLM 评测应像严肃测量学一样对“总误差”负责，而不是只报告在固定配置下的抽样误差。TEE 的“Total”并非涵盖所有可能的运行时变化（作者明确说明当前是 within-layer 的分解，未建模跨层交互如被测模型与 judge 的复杂耦合），而是对研究者显式操控的评测因子做全量核算；其目标是让评测结论可解释、可复现、且更难被通过配置搜索来投机。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a pervasive but under-measured issue in LLM evaluation/annotation/moderation pipelines: substantial hidden measurement error. Small changes—prompt rephrasing, swapping the judge model, changing temperature, item heterogeneity, and their interactions—can shift scores enough to flip rankings or reverse statistical conclusions. Standard confidence intervals, which only reflect repeated sampling under identical settings, fail to account for these sources.
summary_en.importance: Why it matters: (1) Scientific validity—omitted variance leads to severe under-coverage, and it can worsen as the number of items grows because design-choice sensitivity does not shrink with N, yielding overconfident but wrong inferences. (2) Deployment and governance—safety audits and leaderboards rely on these scores; instability makes close model comparisons uninterpretable. (3) Incentives and adversarial surface—unmeasured degrees of freedom enable “evaluation p-hacking,” where developers optimize prompt/scoring configurations rather than true capability.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper introduces Total Evaluation Error (TEE), combining an interaction-inclusive variance decomposition with design-study (D-study) projections.
1) Variance decomposition: it specifies a data-generating process for LLM evaluation pipelines, treats facets (items, categories, prompt variants, temperatures, judge models, replications) as fixed/random, and decomposes total variance into named components including interaction terms (e.g., item×prompt σ^2_{αρ}). Components are labeled α (item), κ (category), ϵ (residual), ρ (prompt), τ (temperature), λ (judge), plus interactions.
2) D-study projections: leveraging generalizability theory / total survey error ideas, it projects precision under alternative evaluation designs (more items vs more judges vs more prompt variants vs more replications), identifying the most cost-effective path to reduce total error and to shrink the most exploitable source of variation.
Key contribution: not just decomposing variance, but (a) accounting for interactions, (b) separating variance that shrinks with N from sensitivity to researcher design choices that does not, and (c) turning estimates into actionable budget/design decisions.
summary_en.experiments: TEE is applied across multiple empirical domains (from binary safety classification to more subjective ideology annotation), showing that the dominant uncertainty source varies by task. A concrete example described in the text is AILuminate v1.0 safety classification (141 items across 12 hazard categories) with a fully crossed design: 5 prompt variants × 3 temperatures × 3 judges × 8 replications = 50,760 calls (~$12). In this setup, judge disagreement explains 44% of total variance, far exceeding prompt wording (4%), implying that adding judges/items reduces error more efficiently than further prompt engineering (with the caveat that conservative prompt variants may understate prompt sensitivity).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep technical analysis + reading guide)
- Read the Introduction carefully to internalize the failure mode (hidden variance, under-coverage worsening with N, exploitability) and the two-part TEE solution. Focus on Fig. 1 (pipeline variance map), Fig. 2 (under-coverage vs N), and Fig. 3 (worked decomposition example).
- Deep-read the core methodology section (DGP + variance decomposition): how facets are modeled as fixed/random, what each variance component means operationally, and why interaction terms matter.
- Deep-read the D-study portion: how estimated variance components translate into projected uncertainty under alternative designs, and which components can/cannot be reduced by increasing items.
- Study the safety-classification case around Fig. 3 to understand why judge variance dominates and what that implies for audit design (multi-judge arbitration vs prompt tuning).
- Read the cross-cutting sections (2.4–2.7) with an “attack surface” lens: which design choices are most gameable, and how TEE diagnoses and mitigates them.

skim (method overview + reading guide)
- Read Introduction + Figs. 1/2/3 to get the main message: CIs are insufficient; TEE outputs variance attribution + design recommendations.
- Skim Results by extracting, for each domain, the dominant variance source (judge/prompt/item/temperature/interactions) and the implied best lever (more items/judges/replications).
- Skim the conclusion paragraphs of 2.4–2.7 for practical guidance on reliability and gaming risk.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue LLM evaluation should adopt a measurement-science notion of “total error,” rather than reporting only within-setting sampling uncertainty. “Total” here means accounting for all pipeline facets the researcher explicitly varies (items, prompts, judges, temperatures, replications), not every conceivable operational variation; they explicitly note limitations such as not modeling certain cross-layer interactions (e.g., complex coupling between the system under test and the judge). The goal is to make evaluation conclusions interpretable, reproducible, and harder to game via configuration search.

recommendation.zh: 必须读：把prompt/judge/采样等评测自由度当成方差源建模，解释了为何N变大反而更“自信地错”；应立刻在内部榜单复现其误差分解流程。
recommendation.en: Must-read: it treats prompt/judge/decoding choices as real variance sources and shows why larger N can make you confidently wrong; you should replicate their variance decomposition on your internal eval pipeline ASAP.

paper.title: Why Don't You Know? Evaluating the Impact of Uncertainty Sources on Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 不确定性量化（UQ）方法通常输出单一置信度分数，但自然语言任务的不确定性来源多样（知识缺口、输出多解/可变性、输入歧义等）。核心问题是：不同不确定性来源会如何影响各类 UQ 方法的行为与有效性？现有评测缺乏对来源的可控隔离，导致比较不公平。
summary.importance: 在医疗、法律、教育等高风险场景，系统需要根据“不确定性来源”采取不同动作：知识不足→检索/拒答；多解可变→给多个答案或解释多样性；输入歧义→追问澄清。若 UQ 分数无法区分来源，可能触发错误策略（例如把“多解”当成“不会”而拒答），直接影响安全性与用户体验。因此需要来源可控的数据与系统性评测来揭示方法盲点。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的关键技术贡献是构建一个“按不确定性来源成组控制”的评测数据集，并在该数据集上系统评估多类 UQ 方法。
- 不确定性来源最小集合：
(1) 知识不确定性（问题明确且单一正确，但模型可能不知道）；
(2) 输出可变性/多正确答案（问题明确但存在多个语义上不同的正确回答，概率质量分散导致采样输出不一致）；
(3) 输入歧义（问题欠指明，需澄清才能确定所问）。
- 数据集设计：以 triplets 组织问题，每个三元组在长度、格式、领域等方面尽量可比，仅改变不确定性来源，从而控制混杂因素，实现对 UQ 方法的公平对比；并进行人工验证。
- 评测范围：覆盖多种 UQ 家族（如基于 token 概率、基于一致性/自一致、verbalized 等）与多个模型，分析不同来源下的系统性失效模式与家族弱点。
summary.experiments: 在三类不确定性场景下，对多种 UQ 方法与三种模型进行对比评测，并做失败案例分析。论文强调的经验现象包括：一致性类方法可能把“多正确答案导致的输出不一致”误判为高不确定（尽管模型其实可以自信给出任一正确答案）；输入歧义会让“是否知道答案”的判定变得更困难，且更应触发澄清而非简单拒答；不同方法家族对不同来源呈现特定脆弱性。数据集与分析用于揭示这些差异并指导方法选择/系统策略。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（为何“来源”重要以及对应的系统动作；Figure 1 的决策映射）；Dataset Creation（triplet 设计如何隔离混杂因素；三类来源的操作化定义与构造流程；人工验证标准）；实验与失败案例分析（按来源分桶的对比结果，逐类总结哪些方法在何种来源下失效以及原因）。
- 重点图表/内容：Figure 1（不确定性来源→系统响应）；数据集统计与示例 triplets（理解“只变来源不变其他”的控制思想）；按来源拆分的性能表/校准曲线/相关性分析（如果文中提供）。
- 创新点核对：①来源可控的 triplet 数据集；②跨方法家族、跨模型的系统评测；③面向部署决策的失败模式归因。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + 贡献点列表（理解三类来源与动机）+ Dataset Creation 的三类定义段落（知道每类在问答里长什么样）+ 实验结论/讨论（抓住“哪些 UQ 方法在多解/歧义下会误报”的主结论）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张 UQ 不应只追求单一“正确性置信度”，而应关注不确定性来源，因为来源决定系统应对策略；并通过 triplet 控制数据集证明：很多现有 UQ 信号在不同来源下含义会发生偏移，导致方法比较与部署决策都可能被误导。

summary_en.core_problem: Most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods output a single confidence score, but uncertainty in language tasks comes from distinct sources (knowledge gaps, output variability with multiple valid answers, and input ambiguity). The paper asks: how do these sources affect the behavior and effectiveness of existing UQ methods, and how can we evaluate this fairly under controlled conditions?
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes deployments, the right system action depends on the uncertainty source: lack of knowledge → retrieve/abstain; multiple valid answers → present alternatives; ambiguous input → ask for clarification. If a UQ score conflates sources, systems may take harmful actions (e.g., abstain when the question simply has many correct answers). A source-controlled benchmark is necessary to diagnose method weaknesses and guide safe decision policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main technical contribution is a controlled evaluation dataset and protocol that isolates uncertainty sources.
- Minimal, operational source set:
(1) knowledge uncertainty (well-specified, single correct answer, model may not know);
(2) output variability / multiple correct answers (well-specified but many semantically distinct valid answers; probability mass spreads, sampled outputs disagree);
(3) input ambiguity (underspecified question requiring clarification).
- Dataset design: questions are organized into triplets; within each triplet, questions are made comparable in length/format/domain while differing primarily in uncertainty source, reducing confounds and enabling fair method comparison; human validation is performed.
- Evaluation: benchmark a broad set of UQ method families (token-probability-based, consistency-based, verbalized, etc.) across multiple models, and analyze source-specific failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates many UQ methods on the triplet dataset across three models, reporting performance by uncertainty source and providing failure-case analyses. Highlighted findings include: consistency-based methods can over-report uncertainty for the “multiple valid answers” scenario (treating semantic disagreement as ignorance); ambiguity makes it hard to interpret confidence as knowledge and should trigger clarification rather than abstention; different UQ families exhibit characteristic vulnerabilities depending on the source.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Key sections: Introduction (why sources matter; the source→system-action mapping, esp. Figure 1); Dataset Creation (how triplets control confounds; operational definitions and construction; human validation); Experiments + failure analysis (results stratified by source; method-family weaknesses and causal explanations).
- Key figures/tables: Figure 1 (uncertainty source to downstream action); dataset examples/statistics showing triplet control; per-source performance/calibration plots if provided.
- Innovation checklist: (i) source-controlled triplet dataset; (ii) systematic cross-family, cross-model UQ evaluation; (iii) deployment-oriented failure attribution.

skim (quick read):
- Read Introduction + contributions, the three source definitions in Dataset Creation, and the main results/discussion to capture the headline: many UQ signals change meaning across sources, especially for multi-answer and ambiguous inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue UQ should be source-aware because the source determines the appropriate system response. Their controlled triplet benchmark shows that many existing UQ methods conflate sources, making both method comparisons and deployment decisions potentially misleading.

recommendation.zh: 把UQ拆成可控来源后才看得出方法在“多解/歧义”上乱报置信度；只读实验设计与分解结果表即可校准你对UQ分数的信任边界。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the controlled source-factorization: it exposes when UQ scores conflate ambiguity/variability with ignorance; read the setup + main decomposition table to recalibrate how much you trust a single confidence number.

paper.title: When Verification Fails: How Compositionally Infeasible Claims Escape Rejection

summary.core_problem: 科学主张验证（claim verification）需要遵循闭世界假设（CWA）：只有当主张所断言的每个约束都被证据正向支持时才接受，否则应拒绝。本文指出：现有验证基准的负例构造方式（只扰动一个显著约束）使得“完整 CWA 检查所有约束”和一种更弱的捷径“显著约束检查（salient-constraint checking）”在行为上不可区分，导致我们误以为模型具备严格验证能力。核心问题是：模型到底在做全约束验证，还是只检查最显眼的那一条？
summary.importance: 在科学/医疗/临床试验、表格与图表等高风险场景，验证系统若采用捷径，会系统性放过“组合上不可行”的错误主张（看似每个局部都对，但组合关系不成立），从而造成严重误导。本文的重要性在于揭示了基准设计的结构性盲点，并提供能区分两种验证标准的对抗性评测设置，为后续训练与评测提供更可靠的靶标。
summary.technical_approach:
本文提出一个理论框架与一个新的负例构造设置来“拆穿”捷径。

(1) 形式化：给定证据集合 E={e1..em} 与 claim c，其断言约束集合 C(c)={c1..cn}。在 CWA 下，接受当且仅当所有约束都被证据正向支持；任何约束缺乏支持都应拒绝。

(2) 捷径定义：显著约束检查只挑选 claim 中最显著/最易检索的一条约束进行核验：若该约束被支持则倾向接受，否则拒绝。由于现有基准的负例通常只破坏这一条显著约束，捷径在负例上也能高分，从而与完整 CWA“看起来一样”。

(3) 组合不可行（compositionally infeasible）负例：构造一种对抗负例，使“显著约束”在证据中看似成立，但在非显著约束处引入违背，且该违背需要跨多个证据单元组合推理才能发现（例如两句临床文本的组合关系、图表中两段趋势的组合、表格中两列/多列的组合约束）。

(4) 构造算法：graph-based corrupt-and-propagate。直观上先保留显著观察（让最显眼的那条仍可被证据支持），再通过在证据图结构上“腐化并传播”引入组合层面的矛盾，使得只有执行全约束检查（含组合约束）才能拒绝。

(5) 诊断与干预：作者还测试了 test-time guidance（闭世界指令、显式分解等）。结果显示这些干预更多是在 ROC 上移动阈值/权衡（改变接受-拒绝倾向），而非真正解决组合负例上的推理瓶颈。并引入 rubric-based LLM judge 对推理轨迹打分，评估是否逐条检查约束或在显著约束处提前终止，从“过程”层面验证失败机制。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖三类既有基准：NLI4CT（临床试验文本）、SCITAB（科学表格）、SciVer（图表）。关键现象：模型在“标准负例（单显著扰动）”上拒绝率/准确率高，但在“组合不可行负例（对抗负例）”上会显著更容易接受（over-acceptance），且该差距跨模型家族与规模都存在。作者还报告：闭世界指令与显式分解等测试时引导并未整体提升对抗负例表现，而是改变了接受/拒绝的 tradeoff；rubric judge 的轨迹评分进一步显示模型经常在检查显著约束后提前停止，符合“显著约束检查”而非完整 CWA。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Introduction：重点读 Figure 1 的对比（现有负例 vs 组合不可行负例）以及“为何现有基准无法区分 CWA 与捷径”的论证链。
- Theoretical Framework：精读 CWA 的形式化、约束集合 C(c) 的定义、以及 salient-constraint checking 的程序化刻画；这是全文的概念地基。
- 数据构造方法（graph-based corrupt-and-propagate）：这是论文最关键的技术贡献之一，建议对照案例理解“保留显著约束、在非显著组合处造假”的具体操作。
- 实验主结果（Figure 2 等）：关注三基准上标准负例 vs 对抗负例的接受率差距，以及跨模型/规模一致性。
- 干预实验 + rubric-based judge：这是作者证明“推理瓶颈而非策略选择”的证据链，建议精读评分维度与典型失败轨迹。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Abstract + Introduction 前两页，抓住：基准盲点→捷径→组合不可行负例。
- 快速浏览构造方法的高层描述与 1-2 个示例即可。
- 直接看主结果图表（标准负例 vs 对抗负例差距）与结论段，理解论文主张与影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：当前科学验证评测“看起来很强”的负例准确率，可能只是模型在做显著约束检查这一捷径；只有引入组合不可行负例，才能真正测试闭世界式的全约束验证能力。并且简单的提示词/分解并不能根治该问题，说明瓶颈更像是组合约束的系统性推理缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Scientific claim verification should follow the Closed-World Assumption (CWA): accept a claim iff every constraint it asserts is positively supported by the evidence; otherwise reject. The paper argues existing benchmarks build negative examples by perturbing a single salient element, making full CWA indistinguishable from an easier shortcut—salient-constraint checking—that verifies only the most salient constraint. The key question: are models truly enforcing CWA, or just checking the most prominent constraint?
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes domains (clinical trials, scientific tables, charts), shortcut verification can systematically let through claims that are locally plausible but globally impossible when constraints are composed across evidence units. The paper exposes a structural benchmark blind spot and introduces an evaluation setting that can separate genuine exhaustive verification from shortcut behavior, improving the reliability of both evaluation and future training targets.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper contributes a formal distinction and an adversarial negative construction.

(1) Formalization: Given evidence pieces E={e1..em} and a claim c asserting constraints C(c)={c1..cn}, CWA accepts iff all constraints are supported; lack of support for any constraint implies rejection.

(2) Shortcut: salient-constraint checking selects the most salient/easiest-to-retrieve constraint and decides based only on it—reject if it is violated, accept if it appears supported.

(3) Compositionally infeasible claims (adversarial negatives): Construct negatives where the salient constraint is supported by the evidence, but a non-salient constraint is violated in a way that requires compositional reasoning across multiple evidence units (e.g., combining two sentences, two chart trends, or multiple table columns).

(4) Construction algorithm: a graph-based corrupt-and-propagate procedure that preserves salient observations while introducing violations through composed relationships within the same evidence source.

(5) Diagnosis and interventions: Evaluate test-time guidance toward CWA (closed-world instructions, explicit decomposition). These interventions mainly shift the accept/reject tradeoff (movement along the ROC curve) rather than solving adversarial negatives. A rubric-based LLM judge scores reasoning traces for CWA compliance (checking all constraints vs early stopping at the salient one), providing process-level evidence of the shortcut.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations span three established benchmarks: NLI4CT (clinical trial text), SCITAB (scientific tables), and SciVer (charts). Main finding: models achieve high accuracy on standard negatives but accept compositionally infeasible adversarial negatives at much higher rates (systematic over-acceptance), and this gap persists across model families and scales. Test-time CWA guidance does not materially improve adversarial-negative performance overall, instead trading off acceptance vs rejection. Rubric-based trace scoring shows models often terminate after verifying the salient constraint, consistent with salient-constraint checking rather than full CWA.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Introduction: study Figure 1’s contrast (standard negatives vs compositionally infeasible negatives) and the argument for benchmark indistinguishability.
- Theoretical Framework: carefully read the CWA formalization, constraint-set definition, and the procedural definition of salient-constraint checking.
- Data construction (graph-based corrupt-and-propagate): this is a core technical contribution; read with examples to understand how salience is preserved while compositional violations are injected.
- Main results (e.g., Figure 2): focus on the standard-vs-adversarial gap across all three benchmarks and across model scales.
- Interventions + rubric-based judge: key evidence that the issue is a reasoning bottleneck, not merely a strategy choice.

skim (quick read):
- Read Abstract + first two pages of Introduction for the benchmark-blind-spot narrative.
- Skim the high-level construction description and a couple of examples.
- Jump to the main results figures/tables and conclusion for the headline empirical claim and implications.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s message: strong performance on existing verification benchmarks may reflect a shortcut (salient-constraint checking) rather than true closed-world, all-constraints verification. Compositionally infeasible adversarial negatives are necessary to test CWA compliance, and prompt-based guidance alone does not fix the underlying compositional reasoning bottleneck.

recommendation.zh: 它戳破“验证模型会做CWA全约束检查”的默认想象：很多只是在查最显眼约束；只看对抗负例构造与错误类型统计就能改评测prior。
recommendation.en: It breaks the comforting prior that claim verifiers do full CWA-style constraint checking—many just check the salient constraint; skim the adversarial negative construction and the error breakdown.

paper.title: Do LLMs Know Tool Irrelevance? Demystifying Structural Alignment Bias in Tool Invocations

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“工具无关（irrelevance）”场景下的一个系统性失败模式：当工具在语义上无法实现用户目标（semantic irrelevance）时，LLM 仍会因为“查询属性能一一映射到工具参数”（structural alignment）而倾向调用工具。作者将这种“用结构匹配替代语义核验”的机制性捷径形式化为 Structural Alignment Bias（SAB）。
summary.importance: 在真实工具生态里，不同服务常共享相似/统一的接口（参数名、字段类型、槽位结构），这使得“结构可对齐但语义无关”的情况非常常见。错误调用不仅带来延迟与误导，更可能在金融转账、数据库写入等高风险场景造成不可逆损失。论文指出以往评测对该类错误覆盖不足，导致我们高估了模型的“拒用无关工具”能力。
summary.technical_approach:
（1）概念与形式化：将工具函数ft与用户目标gq不一致定义为语义无关（ft ≢ gq），并将“查询中的属性可被有效赋值给工具参数集合Pt”的可映射性定义为结构对齐；SAB 即模型在决策时过度依赖结构对齐信号。
（2）数据集 SABEval：核心设计是“解耦结构对齐与语义相关”，构造更贴近现实的样本（强调不同服务共享统一接口，而非刻意的合成角落案例），从而系统测量在不同对齐程度下的误调用。
（3）因果验证：通过反事实分析（counterfactual）改变结构对齐因素，检验结构对齐对错误调用的因果贡献。
（4）机制解释：提出 Contrastive Attention Attribution（CAA）解释方法，在不要求反事实样本严格 token 对齐的前提下追踪信息流；作者发现模型内部存在两条“竞争路径”：一条负责语义核验（semantic checking），一条负责结构匹配（structural matching），最终是否调用由两条路径相对强度主导。
（5）缓解策略：基于上述竞争机制，提出“重新平衡两条路径”的精确干预方法，以降低结构匹配路径对决策的支配性，同时尽量保持一般工具使用能力。
summary.experiments: 作者在 5 个常用 tool-augmented LLM 上做系统实验。关键现象是：在以往研究常用的“结构不对齐”无关工具样本上，误调用率几乎可忽略（<0.2%）；但在 SABEval 的“结构对齐但语义无关”设置下，误调用率跃升到 41.9%，且随着对齐程度提高可进一步升至 90.4%。反事实分析进一步支持“结构对齐→错误调用”的强因果关系。缓解方法在多模型多工具上实现显著改进，报告约 80% 相对错误率下降，同时保持通用工具调用能力。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点读 Introduction：把握 SAB 的直观例子（Fig.1）与“结构对齐/语义无关”的定义边界。
- 重点读 Problem Formulation：看作者如何形式化 structural alignment（参数集合、可赋值映射）以及与 irrelevance setting 的关系。
- 重点读 SABEval 构建与“alignment degree”分层：这是论文贡献的核心，决定了为何以往评测会“低估错误”。
- 重点读实验主结果表/图：关注误调用率从 <0.2%→41.9%→90.4% 的条件与控制变量。
- 重点读 counterfactual/causal 分析章节：确认“相关性”如何被提升为“因果性”。
- 重点读 CAA 方法与可视化：理解两条竞争路径（semantic checking vs structural matching）如何被识别，以及它们如何影响最终 tool-call。
- 重点读 mitigation 方案与消融：验证“重平衡路径”是否以牺牲正常工具能力为代价。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Introduction + 贡献点列表：快速建立问题与结论。
- 读 SABEval 概述与主结果：抓住“结构对齐导致误调用暴涨”的核心证据。
- 读 mitigation 的总体思路与最终指标：确认是否能在不伤害通用能力的情况下减少误调用。
- 解释性方法（CAA）可只读方法直觉+关键图，不必逐行推导。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心主张是：工具拒用失败并非单纯“没学会语义”，而是存在可被数据集与解释方法揭示的机制性捷径（结构匹配优先）。因此，评测应显式控制/分解结构因素；改进也应针对内部竞争通路做定点干预，而不是仅靠更大模型或泛化式指令微调。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a systematic failure in the tool-irrelevance setting: even when a tool is semantically incapable of achieving the user goal (semantic irrelevance), LLMs still tend to invoke it whenever query attributes can be cleanly mapped to the tool’s parameters (structural alignment). The authors formalize this shortcut behavior as Structural Alignment Bias (SAB): models prioritize structural match over semantic verification when deciding tool calls.
summary_en.importance: Real tool ecosystems often standardize interfaces across services, making “structurally alignable yet semantically irrelevant” situations common. Erroneous tool calls add latency and misleading outputs, and can be catastrophic in high-stakes domains (financial transactions, database operations). The paper argues prior evaluations under-cover this regime, leading to overestimation of LLMs’ ability to refuse irrelevant tools.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(1) Formalization: define semantic irrelevance as ft ≢ gq (tool function vs user goal mismatch), and structural alignment as the existence of a valid attribute-to-parameter assignment from the query to the tool parameter set.
(2) SABEval dataset: explicitly decouples structural alignment from semantic relevance, mirroring realistic cases where distinct services share unified interfaces, enabling controlled measurement across different alignment degrees.
(3) Causal validation: counterfactual analysis that manipulates structural alignment to test its causal effect on erroneous invocations.
(4) Mechanistic interpretability: propose Contrastive Attention Attribution (CAA), which traces information flow without requiring strict token-level alignment between counterfactual pairs; reveals two competing pathways—semantic checking vs structural matching—whose relative strength drives tool-call decisions.
(5) Mitigation: a targeted intervention that rebalances these pathways to reduce SAB while preserving general tool-use capability.
summary_en.experiments: Across five tool-augmented LLMs, the paper reports a stark gap: on previously used irrelevant-tool samples that are structurally misaligned, error is negligible (<0.2%); on SABEval where tools are structurally aligned but semantically irrelevant, erroneous invocation jumps to 41.9%, and can reach 90.4% as alignment degree increases. Counterfactual results support a strong causal link from structural alignment to wrong tool calls. The proposed mitigation yields large improvements (about 80% relative error reduction) while maintaining general tool-use performance.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Introduction + Fig.1: internalize the SAB phenomenon and the semantic-vs-structural distinction.
- Problem Formulation: how structural alignment is defined (parameter sets, valid assignments) and how it interacts with irrelevance.
- SABEval construction + alignment-degree stratification: the key reason prior benchmarks miss the failure mode.
- Main results tables/figures: focus on the <0.2% → 41.9% → 90.4% jumps and the controlled conditions.
- Counterfactual/causal section: how causality is established beyond correlation.
- CAA method + visualizations: how the two competing pathways are identified and linked to tool-call decisions.
- Mitigation + ablations: verify robustness and whether general tool-use is preserved.

skim (quick read):
- Read Introduction + contributions: problem framing and headline claims.
- Read SABEval overview + main results: the core empirical evidence.
- Read mitigation idea + final metrics: whether SAB can be reduced without harming general tool use.
- For CAA, skim intuition + key figures; skip detailed derivations.
summary_en.authors_note: The central claim is that tool-refusal failures are not merely “weak semantics” but a mechanistic shortcut: structural matching can dominate decision-making. Therefore, evaluation should explicitly control for structural factors, and mitigation should use targeted interventions informed by internal competing pathways rather than relying only on larger models or generic instruction tuning.

paper.title: General365: Benchmarking General Reasoning in Large Language Models Across Diverse and Challenging Tasks

summary.core_problem: 如何系统评测LLM在“去专业知识依赖”的一般性推理（general reasoning）上的能力与泛化，而非仅在数学/物理等专门领域推理上表现。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献：提出General365以K-12背景知识约束来解耦“知识量”与“推理能力”，覆盖复杂约束、嵌套逻辑分支、语义干扰等更贴近日常复杂推理的难点，并提供多模型横评揭示当前SOTA短板。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含365个seed题与1095个变体题的数据集，划分8类任务；通过变体设计测试鲁棒性/泛化，并对26个主流LLM进行统一评测对比。
summary.experiments: 评测26个LLM；数据规模为365 seed + 1095 variants，8大类；摘要未给出具体最优模型名称与分数细节，仅指出最强模型表现仍有限。

summary_en.core_problem: How to systematically benchmark LLMs’ general reasoning ability—decoupled from specialized domain knowledge—and assess generalization and robustness on everyday-style challenging reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a benchmark that constrains required background knowledge to K–12 level to better isolate reasoning, and covers difficulty sources such as complex constraints, nested logical branching, and semantic distractions, revealing limitations of current leading models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs General365 with 365 seed problems and 1095 controlled variants spanning 8 task categories; uses variants to probe robustness/generalization and evaluates a broad set of LLMs under a unified protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks 26 popular LLMs on 365 seeds plus 1095 variants across 8 categories; reports that even the strongest models achieve limited performance, indicating substantial headroom in general reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 作为“去知识化推理”benchmark备查即可，能快速补齐你评测矩阵但不太指导训练；只看任务构成与leaderboard结论，别细读题库细节。
